ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_INFOGENERAL_0003406d_Oblivion_RES: A friend of mine is a member of the Legion. He said some Altmer nobleman was murdered, right here in the city! Faelian, I think his name was.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_SE07Decision_0001e3ec_Oblivion_RE: A friendly word of warning before you choose.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_INFOGENERAL_00066cce_Oblivion_RES: A gang of women in Anvil seducing men? Did you hear? Take my copy of the Black Horse Courier. Poor fools.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_MysteriumXarxes_000221f6_Oblivion: A gate can be opened from the outside, however. It will be more difficult, as I will have to temporarily bind myself to the book.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_KvatchTopic_000039d5_Oblivion_RES: A gate opened and daedra poured out. Everybody ran. Or they died.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_HELLO_0007b31f_Oblivion_RESP1: A genuine masterpiece comes from the heart, not the mind.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_SE30ForgeAmberHammerMagic_00016ce: A girl can always win an argument with a weapon like this.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_BrumaNQDQuestionResponses_000465c: A good healer makes for a happy town. And Cirroc almost seems like another Nord to me!
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_INFOGENERAL_0018bc7e_Oblivion_RES: A good man who honors the Nine may visit the Wayshrines of Akatosh for Blessings of Speed and Magicka.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_BarterSellItem_000091d6_Oblivion_: A good price for a good customer.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_FGC07Choice2_000091f9_Oblivion_RE: A great deal, over 1,000 septims. My father was quite a gambler. Quite a bad gambler.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_FGC07Choice2_000146b4_Oblivion_RE: A great deal, over 1,000 septims. My father was quite a gambler. Quite a bad gambler.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_JauffreTopic_000223da_Oblivion_RE: A great man, and a true believer, deep in faith and wisdom.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GREETING_00091aab_Oblivion_RESP4: A grim fate indeed, but one does not cross the Order of the Black Worm without suffering greatly for it.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_Mg12TravenGoOn_000835fa_Oblivion_: A group of Battlemages were dispatched to Mucianus's last known location, with the intent of bringing him in for questioning.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_BloodwormHelmTopic_0000c08c_Obliv: A group of mages led by Irlav Jarol took the Helm, and have retreated to Fort Teleman, in an effort to study it further.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GREETING_00028b83_Oblivion_RESP1: A guest has been murdered. So it begins. You mark my words. This entire party is a trap. Someone wants us all dead, and now they have their chance.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_HELLO_00062c92_Oblivion_RESP1: A hail and hardy welcome, friend.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_FGD06Weapon1_000288b2_Oblivion_RE: A hammer! Excellent! Good for bashing in puny goblin skulls!
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GOODBYE_0001e44a_Oblivion_RESP1: A happy customer is a returning customer.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_HELLO_00033578_Oblivion_RESP1: A hearty hello to you. So good to see you again!
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_ND07LathonGreetA1_00002b89_Knight: A holy knight, like you, questing for the Relics at the Prophet's call. I was his squire. I believed he was chosen by the gods to reclaim the Relics.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_NDProphetGreetA8_00002ade_Knights: A humble heart is a good starting point. The gods will decide if you are worthy to seek the Relics.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_ViranusDontonTOPIC_00003932_Obliv: A journal? Let me see that... Blackwood Company! Bastards! Rank amateurs!
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_ViranusDontonTOPIC_0002f9e2_Obliv: A journal? Sounds like he fought bravely. I should have known the Blackheart Company was involved. Reckless amateurs!
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GREETING_0000296a_Knights_RESP1: A knight is only as good as his blade. A bit more practice never hurt anyone.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_SE30ForgeGauntlets_0001f3db_Obliv: A lady might be a killer, but she shouldn't ruin her manicure by chipping a nail.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_INFOGENERAL_00043ef8_Oblivion_RES: A little bird told me that Syl is rounding up people again. That's silly, isn't it? Would you like some milk, little kitty? You look thirsty.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GREETING_0001dcb9_Oblivion_RESP1: A little bird told me that you've been asking around town about Glarthir. Our resident "eccentric." I'd like to know why.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_SE03XedilianTopic_0008e94d_Oblivi: A little busy here! I'm trying to decide what to have for dinner. Oh, how I love eating. One of my favorite things to do.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_Barter_00038995_Oblivion_RESP1: A little food and drink will do you some good.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_BattlehornMaidDrink_0000de4d_DLCB: A little food and drink will do you some good.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_BattlehornMaidFood_0000de4e_DLCBa: A little food and drink will do you some good.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_AnvilNQDResponses_0003c1f0_Oblivi: A little skill with a shield can save your life. Of course, she'll only train other Fighters Guild members.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GOODBYE_00013340_Oblivion_RESP1: A little stab in the back won't hurt too much. Then I'll have the magicka I need.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_ImperialCityTopic_00047748_Oblivi: A little tip. People who ask a lot of questions around here tend to be not very popular.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_Manor_0003cf9b_Oblivion_RESP1: A local gentleman has been looking to sell his manor. A bit run-down, but a magnificent place, and priced to move.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_BravilTopic_000488bc_Oblivion_RES: A local woman, Ursanne Loche, has a missing husband. She might appreciate some help from someone like you.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GREETING_000af05b_Oblivion_RESP1: A lot of good men died. But it could have been worse. A lot worse.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_SE11HowlingHalls_00016b7e_Oblivio: A lot of history has this place. It was I who led the apostles to steal the stones from Cyrodiil when the original temple was destroyed.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_INFOGENERAL_00049907_Oblivion_RES: A lot of mages swear by Rindir's Staffs.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_SE38TalkItem9_0008242c_Oblivion_R: A lovely little Oddity -- a key made from a Hound's Tooth. And no one even knows what it opens, imagine that! Shall we move on?
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_SEFlameofAgnonTopic_00019ad6_Obli: A lovely little treachery. The Golden Saints almost beg to be betrayed, true, but still, you took that little bit of extra time to think it through.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_Recharge_00066a4d_Oblivion_RESP1: A magic item without a charge is like a sword without a blade.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_SEMiscQuestResponses_0008e10a_Obl: A man with pockets as deep as a cave whom everyone wishes would just go away!
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_SE42Skyboat_00073233_Oblivion_RES: A marvelous contraption. I've gotten it to float in water perfectly. Now if I can just get the water to fly through the air.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_INFOGENERAL_000624ab_Oblivion_RES: A master sorcerer like Janus Hassildor inevitably outlives all his peers. It must be a lonely existence.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_DEM1Armor_00014e6d_AltarDeluxe_RE: A meaningless choice. Be more specific.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_DEM1Weapon_00014e4f_AltarDeluxe_R: A meaningless choice. Be more specific.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_INFOGENERAL_00002a16_Knights_RESP: A member of my pride was traveling in Leyawiin. There is an artifact hidden in the Chapel there, but he said that one has ever been able to claim it.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_HELLO_0005c0c3_Oblivion_RESP1: A merry dance for the Lord of Chance.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_SE10WhoAreYou_00016818_Oblivion_R: A messenger, sent by Issmi. You must go to Brellach at once! We are under attack!
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GREETING_00062bee_Oblivion_RESP1: A mighty feat of arms! The bards of Cyrodiil will be singing of the Fall of the Great Gate for years to come!
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GaltusPreviaTOPIC_0002d712_Oblivi: A mission? Well... of course! I'm sure we can do this. You say this came from Oreyn himself? Well. Perhaps I should speak with Mother first....
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_HELLO_000029b0_Knights_RESP1: A moment, if you please, good sir. We should speak.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_CheeseTOPIC_0003e205_Oblivion_RES: A more pungent cheese you'll never find. It looks smooth, but it stinks to the heavens and beyond!
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_SE13JyggalagVoice_00096050_Oblivi: A mortal to stand before Jyggalag? Fool!
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GREETING_00018f8a_Oblivion_RESP1: A mortal wandering the halls of holy Cylarne... and a male no less. Explain yourself.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_DAClavicusSpeech_000243c2_Oblivio: A mortal! Wonderful. Always a pleasure. Perhaps you'll do a service for me, mortal. And I'll reward you. A fair bargain, don't you think?
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_DASheogorathSpeech_00095908_Obliv: A mortal? Wait... a mortal I know. MY mortal. What are you doing here, mortal, when I've given you things to do?
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_ImperialOrrery_00033deb_Oblivion_: A most fascinating contraption. Bothiel is one of the few who understands how it worked, and kept it running.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_BloodgrassTopic_0005373f_Oblivion: A most interesting plant. From the planes of Oblivion itself, so it may require some effort to find.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_NecromancersMoon_00002dcf_Oblivio: A most interesting text, is it not? We are fortunate that at least one necromancer took the time to record the information.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_FGC01Choice1_0003662a_Oblivion_RE: A mountain lion? In my basement? But... how? That's not possible. But, it happened! What if there are more? What if it wasn't alone?
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_TGHieronymusLex_00064459_Oblivion: A neat bit of work we did to reassign him to Anvil. One of my better forgeries.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_MG13ChoiceWhatproblem_000039a4_Ob: A nest of vampires has sprung up in Bloodcrust Cavern, southeast of the town. They are a threat to the town, and must be eliminated.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_INFOGENERAL_00044239_Oblivion_RES: A new Duke in Crucible? They're all just bags of meat to me.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_INFOGENERAL_0005f225_Oblivion_RES: A new Gatekeeper is in the Fringe now. That's good. Fewer adventurers means more creatures for me to hunt.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_INFOGENERAL_0005f20d_Oblivion_RES: A new Gatekeeper protects the Fringe. But he does nothing to stop the spread of disease.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GREETING_0001ae3b_Oblivion_RESP1: A new Gatekeeper! Excellent. We might be onto something with you, after all. That should keep out the stragglers.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GREETING_00081d7d_Oblivion_RESP1: A new Gatekeeper! Excellent. We might be onto something with you, after all. That should keep out the stragglers.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_INFOGENERAL_0005f205_Oblivion_RES: A new Gatekeeper, eh? I'll bet he'd be willing to kill me!
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_INFOGENERAL_00041ecb_Oblivion_RES: A new adventurer in the Isles. Perhaps it's a sign?
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_INFOGENERAL_00042d98_Oblivion_RES: A new adventurer in the Isles. Perhaps this adventurer has some Skooma?
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_INFOGENERAL_00042d9e_Oblivion_RES: A new adventurer may set foot in the Shivering Isles, I hear. Perhaps I will bake him a fine treat in case our paths should cross.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GREETING_0001b6a6_Oblivion_RESP1: A new arrival! A shame about my Gatekeeper. I'm so happy, I could just tear out your intestines and strangle you with them.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_INFOGENERAL_00042d92_Oblivion_RES: A new face in the Isles. Brings the Fork, perhaps?
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_INFOGENERAL_000432be_Oblivion_RES: A new person in town? Maybe someone to talk to on long, sleepless nights.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_INFOGENERAL_000432c1_Oblivion_RES: A new person wandering around? Did anyone check to see if this person was diseased?
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_INFOGENERAL_000441fc_Oblivion_RES: A new ruler for Dementia! Perhaps blood was spilled. Great deals of blood. Syl's blood. Lovely blood.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_INFOGENERAL_00044224_Oblivion_RES: A new ruler for Dementia! This is the stuff epic novels are made of.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_INFOGENERAL_000441f1_Oblivion_RES: A new ruler for Dementia. Certainly the end times are upon us.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_INFOGENERAL_0005ed8e_Oblivion_RES: A new ruler for Mania? Great. They don't have the same cat problems we have in Dementia.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_INFOGENERAL_0005edaf_Oblivion_RES: A new ruler in Bliss? It doesn't concern me.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_SEWildernessRumorResponses_000617: A new ruler in Crucible, and an empty throne in Bliss. Amazing.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_INFOGENERAL_00044226_Oblivion_RES: A new ruler in Crucible? It doesn't concern me.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_INFOGENERAL_00044228_Oblivion_RES: A new ruler in Crucible? One more thing to keep me up at night.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_INFOGENERAL_00044227_Oblivion_RES: A new ruler in Dementia is no reason to lay about.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_INFOGENERAL_000441fd_Oblivion_RES: A new ruler of Dementia. Excellent. If I could only freeze this moment in time.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_INFOGENERAL_0005edae_Oblivion_RES: A new ruler of Mania. It doesn't sound good to me.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_Idle_0018b5d0_Oblivion_RESP1: A new scent is here. Who can it be?
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_INFOGENERAL_00042d9b_Oblivion_RES: A new visitor to our home. How wonderful. Better stay away from my wife....
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_SE01GateSpeech_0005a762_Oblivion_: A nice effort, though. A shame he's dead. These things happen.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_ErthorTopic_0002d6e9_Oblivion_RES: A nice enough guy, I suppose, but there was that awful scamp incident last year. That's when Adrienne told him he needed to practice somewhere else.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_DagailTopic_0003395b_Oblivion_RES: A nice lady, but strange. Talks to herself far more often than one should, in my opinion.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_tasks_00035678_Oblivion_RESP4: A note of caution: Skingrad is an... unusual place. Be prepared for the unexpected.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_MS12Stipend_00018232_Oblivion_RES: A particular relic has eluded me for many years. Possessing this piece of Akaviri antiquity would make my collection complete.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GREETING_00081a53_Oblivion_RESP3: A perfect job for you, my newest and only Noble in the realm! If Order has entered my army's stronghold, things have taken a disturbing turn.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GREETING_00038ad9_Oblivion_RESP1: A perfect tomato... one taste, and it is gone forever. And then... a lifetime of searching for the next one.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_ND05ThedretPhrase_00002afa_Knight: A phrase kept coming up in the writings I found: "When the eyes of the Guardians are upon you, Julianos will show you favor."
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_MG07Choice1B_0001e069_Oblivion_RE: A pity, but not unexpected. We shall speak again.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_TrainingAlterationNo_0018d15a_Obl: A pity. I was looking forward to this. Perhaps some other time, then.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_ShrineofNamiraTOPIC_0001ce98_Obli: A place of blessed darkness. A holy place where we may worship in our wretchedness. Why are you here?
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_MQWhatNext_00026ef5_Oblivion_RESP: A place where many have perished seeking its Great Stone. But nothing else will do, so you must succeed where all others have failed.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_BarterBuyItem_00062114_Oblivion_R: A pleasure doing business with you.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_DLC06DahliaTopicFence_0001601f_DL: A pleasure doing business with you.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_DLC06DahliaTopicFletcher_00016021: A pleasure doing business with you.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_DLC06DahliaTopicQuarters_00016022: A pleasure doing business with you.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_DLC06DahliaTopicSecurity_00016023: A pleasure doing business with you.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_DLC06DahliaTopicStealth_00016024_: A pleasure doing business with you.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_DLC06DahliaTopicSupplier_00016025: A pleasure doing business with you.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GREETING_00024c5d_Oblivion_RESP1: A pleasure to make your acquaintance. I'm Athragar of the Mages Guild. How can I serve you?
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GREETING_000038d2_Oblivion_RESP1: A pleasure to meet you again.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GREETING_000191c2_Oblivion_RESP1: A pleasure to speak with you.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_SE09RelmynaVerenim_00014ae7_Obliv: A powerful Sorceress. Maybe a genius. And a complete lunatic. All in all, my kind of person.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_SkingradTopic_00038aad_Oblivion_R: A primate has better things to do than provide tourist information. Beggars have plenty of time on their hands. I'm sure you'll have much in common.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_ServeSentence_00045766_Oblivion_R: A prison cell is better than you deserve, mortal scum.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_Dark03FinChoice1A_00023e54_Oblivi: A prisoner recently escaped from the prison, using a set of secret tunnels connecting to the Imperial City's sewer system. It's a perfect way inside.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_HackdirtTopic_000280be_Oblivion_R: A rather isolated village, south of Chorrol.  We do some business with the trader there.  Small volume, but she pays well.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_LeyawiinTopicDarJee04_000479b4_Ob: A real thigh-slapper, that one, eh? Phew. I heard lots others, only I can't remember them.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_INFOGENERAL_00044202_Oblivion_RES: A replacement for the Duchess of Dementia could put the wrong people in positions of power, if you get my drift.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_MS21AnotherTask_000a657c_Oblivion: A rival collector has an item which I very much want to add to my collection. But she stubbornly refuses to consider any of my offers.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_DASanguineSpeech_000b121c_Oblivio: A rousing success, mortal! And it appears you joined in the festivities as well. Good for you. You need to lighten up a bit.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_SE07ChMania_000139ac_Oblivion_RES: A safer choice, perhaps. Maybe you'll live through this. Thadon's a bit lost these days. Not that it's a bad thing. It suits him. Until now.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_MythicDawnTopic_00022b40_Oblivion: A secretive cult devoted to the Daedra Lord Mehrunes Dagon, the Prince of Destruction.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_SEManiaRumorResponses_00061769_Ob: A shame about Thadon. He lived life to its fullest.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_RolandJensericTopic_0001da6b_Obli: A shame he had to die. Before he turned, he was a fine man.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_RogueMage_0003020c_Oblivion_RESP1: A she, you say? And she's dead? Well, Arielle and Roliand did what needed to be done. No more innocent deaths. At least, for now.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_ImperialCityTopic_000476bb_Oblivi: A short stay in our lovely Imperial Prison should cool your enthusiasm for a life of crime. The drunk tank in particular has a unique aroma.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_DaedraShrineTopic_00154cdf_Oblivi: A shrine to Azura lies in the Jerall Mountains, far to the north, towards the Skyrim border.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_DEMShyDunmer_000090a2_AltarDeluxe: A shy Dunmer? Could it be Ranaline that you are looking for?
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_mission_000356f2_Oblivion_RESP1: A simple mission, nothing more. You should be fine. Please, head downstairs, and I'll brief you further.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_HELLO_00062c8d_Oblivion_RESP1: A sincere welcome to you. May you be forever blessed.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_SQ02Skooma_00189180_Oblivion_RESP: A small group of Skooma dealers led by a Dunmer named Kylius Lonavo is holed up in the Greyland Settlement just up the road.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_AleswellTopic_00030037_Oblivion_R: A small settlement to the west of here, on the other side of the Silver Road to Bruma.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GREETING_000459b3_Oblivion_RESP2: A small token of your appreciation might clear this up, or perhaps it's better if we leave at this time.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_SE30ForgeBowMagic_0001f3d8_Oblivi: A smart girl always keeps herself well out of harm's way.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_vampirehunters_000039bf_Oblivion_: A smelly lot, if you ask me, but their gold is as good as anyone else's. We can wipe down the rooms afterwards.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_DirectionsServices_0018bd98_Obliv: A smith, book shop, and general trader are west of the river, near the west gate.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_HELLO_0007b31e_Oblivion_RESP1: A splash of blue here... a dab of green there...
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_INFOGENERAL_00042da7_Oblivion_RES: A stranger in the Isles is interesting news. Perhaps this stranger has interesting things...?
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_KSharraProphecy_00026b0c_Oblivion: A stranger who knows about the K'Sharra Prophecy? It is one of our many prophecies. You should speak with Ri'Bassa, our shaman.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_TGSpecialJobs_0001ee41_Oblivion_R: A street scavenger made off with a ring that the widow Ahdarji values highly. She is offering a reward.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_HELLO_000982c7_Oblivion_RESP1: A string of thefts should do the trick.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_Idle_0018b5ba_Oblivion_RESP1: A strong post to sharpen my claws. That's what is needed.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GREETING_00038ad3_Oblivion_RESP1: A sweetroll? But, of course, Salmo is famous for his sweetrolls! One taste, and you are in heaven... on top of the world, yes!
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_FGD06Weapon2_00028d2b_Oblivion_RE: A sword isn't the worst thing in the world. Too bad you don't have one! Come back when you have a weapon for me!
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_FGD06Weapon2_00028d2a_Oblivion_RE: A sword would be wonderful. Unfortunately, it appears you don't have one. It looks like you have a hammer, though.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_FGD06Weapon2_000288ae_Oblivion_RE: A sword, huh? Hmm... good enough for me. I'll split scalps instead of bash skulls.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_FGD06Weapon2_00028d2c_Oblivion_RE: A sword? You don't even have one!
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_Dark08NelsNevConvo_000852c3_Obliv: A tavern! Ha ha ha ha ha! Oh, I should have known! Leave it to a barbarian to spend an entire chest full of gold on beer and mead. How pathetic.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_NDChapelAttackTopic_00002b98_Knig: A terrible crime. Everyone in the Chapel murdered! Who could have done such a thing, and why?
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_MSMiscKotT_000c4540_Oblivion_RESP: A thorn in our side is more like it! Those fools are nothing but a glorified club. They've never contributed to anything useful, and never will.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_MS22Mission_0002af34_Oblivion_RES: A time I find most fascinating. The drawing on the bottom of the page I gave you depicts a carved panel from the central chamber of the High Fane.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_INFOGENERAL_000607b2_Oblivion_RES: A toast to Sheogorath! Order is no more.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_INFOGENERAL_000441df_Oblivion_RES: A torch is lit. The light is lighted. Or lit. It's a Great Torch. Much better than most.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_vampirehunters_00034469_Oblivion_: A troublesome lot. I expect you to deal with them.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GREETING_00002964_Knights_RESP1: A true Knight never forgets his faith, and so I pray to the Nine every day.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_TrainingQuestTopic_0003c15a_Obliv: A true marksman is only as good as his bow. When you have a good, solid Elven bow, then I shall teach you what you need to know.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_EulogyDarkElf_0009f9bb_Oblivion_R: A valiant effort, Dark Elf, but take comfort. Your spirit is mine.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GREETING_0006bed3_Oblivion_RESP1: A victory beyond hope! You and Martin defeated Mehrunes Dagon in the very moment of his triumph! All hail the Champion of Tamriel!

ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GREETING_000251da_Oblivion_RESP1: Ah, dear friend, may I steal a moment of your time? I have a rather delicate situation I was hoping you could help me with.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_NelsTheNaughtyTopic_00028a04_Obli: Ah, don't let the name fool you. I had a bit too much mead a few years back, and there was this tavern wench.... Anyway, just call me Nels.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_ArenaBetChoice1A_0001e666_Oblivio: Ah, excellent! I knew you were the gambling type! Well, you can bet on the Yellow Team or the Blue Team.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_BloodgrassTopic_00053737_Oblivion: Ah, excellent. I hope getting it wasn't too much trouble for you.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_TG08BribeBeggar_00015f1b_Oblivion: Ah, fresh bread tonight! The Moth Priests live in the Imperial Palace. I don't know exactly what they do. Something to do with the Elder Scrolls.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GREETING_000008d3_Oblivion_RESP1: Ah, greetings. I have been waiting for you. As Vicente surely told you, your time working with him has come to an end.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GREETING_00035597_Oblivion_RESP1: Ah, have you reconsidered my offer? Do you wish to eliminate that treasonous Shadowscale for me?
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_MQ12Talk_0007be92_Oblivion_RESP1: Ah, here you are! I have good news, of a sort.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_HELLO_0002526a_Oblivion_RESP1: Ah, here you are. So good to finally meet you.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_HELLO_00062cca_Oblivion_RESP1: Ah, how quaint. How do you do?
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GREETING_00040364_Oblivion_RESP1: Ah, is Your Grace having difficulty with his choices?
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_NDTalkGarlas1_00002c46_Knights_RE: Ah, it was a terrible fight. Many an Auroran fell beneath my blade that day. But the Crusader -- he clove through their ranks like a scythe.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_MQ07BeggarPay_00020093_Oblivion_R: Ah, it's coming back to me now. Yeah, seems I saw someone looking out the window at Jearl's house the other day.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GREETING_0006fdc4_Oblivion_RESP1: Ah, it's good to see you, citizen! Oh yes, I know who you are. You've become something of a legend in these parts!
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_NDTalkDeadCarodus1_00002cf7_Knigh: Ah, it's nothing... I was thinking of Sir Carodus, actually. He was such a fine knight... how can he be dead? How could the gods let that happen?
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_JeanneFrasoricTopic_0001ceec_Obli: Ah, it's times like this I enjoy what I do.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GREETING_0002b730_Oblivion_RESP1: Ah, it's you! You're the one... err... who are you again?
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GREETING_00003431_Oblivion_RESP1: Ah, it's you. I figured you'd be by soon.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GREETING_0003013c_Oblivion_RESP3: Ah, me... Friend, you are welcome at the Aleswell Inn anytime. Free of charge.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_DarkVampChoice1_0004ce45_Oblivion: Ah, most excellent! Here is what you must do. Simply go to sleep here in the Sanctuary, at any time, and I will visit you as you slumber.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GREETING_0004d7e3_Oblivion_RESP1: Ah, my dear friend. It is so good to see you.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_HELLO_00050a9e_Oblivion_RESP1: Ah, my favorite patron! Anything Odd to show me? Ha ha ha.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_HELLO_00061568_Oblivion_RESP1: Ah, my savior. Back again for a visit are we?
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_contract_0000c0a2_Oblivion_RESP1: Ah, now this is the type of contract I live for! You must become pure shadow. It's as if you were never there, and then Roderick simply... dies.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_MQ05GwinasPhintiasA_00022b51_Obli: Ah, of course. Here you go. Keep us in mind for any future needs!
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_MS38Reward_0001dc32_Oblivion_RESP: Ah, of course. The gold. Here. But there is someone else I need you to investigate.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_contract_000039df_Oblivion_RESP1: Ah, of course. You're going to succeed where three previous family members have failed. How silly of me...
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_Dark09Choice1A_00035e06_Oblivion_: Ah, one of you again, eh? You Dark Brotherhood types are all the same. All sneak and no swing! You'll meet the same fate as the others! En garde!
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_HELLO_0008118e_Oblivion_RESP1: Ah, returned from the Fringe I see.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_HELLO_000029b1_Knights_RESP1: Ah, sir knight! I was hoping we could discuss a rather important matter.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GREETING_0002d393_Oblivion_RESP1: Ah, so Motierre has escaped? Well done! As payment, I am pleased to award you this amulet, Cruelty's Heart, as well as another advancement in rank.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GREETING_0001dc50_Oblivion_RESP1: Ah, so it's Bloodletter now, is it? I remember when I achieved that rank, so very long ago. I showed such promise... unlike yourself.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_Dark18Choice1C_00090791_Oblivion_: Ah, so you choose to play the stoic, hmm? You remain silent even when faced with my terrible countenance? Your silent obedience is to be commended.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GREETING_00034895_Oblivion_RESP1: Ah, so you infiltrated Fort Sutch, remained undetected, and replaced the medicine with the poison I provided. You are truly a master of shadow!
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GREETING_0003a8fd_Oblivion_RESP3: Ah, so you're an Arena combatant! It's always good to meet a fellow warrior, especially one who isn't here just to kill the Grand Champion! Ha ha ha!
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_ND06CurseTopic_00002b21_Knights_R: Ah, so you've heard of it, have you? Terrible curse, been in the family almost longer than anyone can remember.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GREETING_0003a901_Oblivion_RESP1: Ah, so you've returned. Come at last to challenge me for my Grand Champion title?
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GREETING_0002c4ea_Oblivion_RESP1: Ah, sorry friend, but it would appear the opponent you bet on lost that last fight. Better luck next time!
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GREETING_0002c4eb_Oblivion_RESP1: Ah, sorry friend, but it would appear the opponent you bet on lost that last fight. Better luck next time!
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GREETING_00000921_Oblivion_RESP2: Ah, sorry, I have no idea what time it is.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GREETING_00081b7d_Oblivion_RESP1: Ah, summoned again. My Lord does so enjoy that, as is His prerogative. I'll assume you're done for now.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_TrainingQuestTopic_00062445_Obliv: Ah, ten Welkynd Stones. Most useful for my research. Thank you. And now, I am at your service.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GREETING_0008e653_Oblivion_RESP1: Ah, the Flame of Agnon shines again! Soon the Great Torch will flare with the pure light of Dementia!
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_HELLO_0002ee99_Oblivion_RESP1: Ah, the Gray Mare! Chorrol's finest repository of wine, women and song!
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GREETING_0002ee2d_Oblivion_RESP1: Ah, the Gray Mare! From here I will be able to arrange for transportation out of Cyrodiil! You have served me well, assassin.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_SE06GreatTorchTopic_000910a9_Obli: Ah, the Great Torch. It is a symbol of Sheogorath's power and a source of great comfort for the citizens of New Sheoth.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_MQ08ArtifactC_00038faf_Oblivion_R: Ah, the Masque of Clavicus Vile. You are wise not to let yourself get further enmeshed in his plots.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_HELLO_000034a1_Oblivion_RESP1: Ah, the Thieves Guild's new favorite.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_DarMaTopic_00028741_Oblivion_RESP: Ah, the comely Argonian lass.  You may have met her if you've ever been in her mother's shop, Northern Goods and Trade.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_HELLO_0007e95f_Oblivion_RESP1: Ah, the ghost effect; an excellent demonstration of Xedilian's true power.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GREETING_000301d9_Oblivion_RESP1: Ah, the savior of Aleswell! Whatever you need, I'm at your service.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_MS21Special_0002b45d_Oblivion_RES: Ah, the treasure hunter. Please, have a seat.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_HELLO_00181c29_Oblivion_RESP1: Ah, there you are! It's good to see you again! No, really, I mean it!
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GREETING_00092d79_Oblivion_RESP1: Ah, there you are! Look... I've been thinking, and... Well... I guess I just want to say I'm sorry for the way I've treated you in the past.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GREETING_0001a78c_Oblivion_RESP1: Ah, there you are. It seems that we have a... bit of a problem. It's the Font of Madness... no doubt you were on your way there just now.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_HELLO_0018d7da_Oblivion_RESP1: Ah, there you are. We need to talk.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_Gift_0018bc33_Oblivion_RESP1: Ah, these look lovely. I'm sure she'll like them.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_DASheogorathSpeech_0009554b_Obliv: Ah, very good, Sire. your predecessor left everything in place for the final sign. You'll want to head to the center of town. Good day.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_DASheogorathSpeech_00095593_Obliv: Ah, very good. Your predecessor left everything in place for the final sign. You'll want to head to the center of town. Good day.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_HELLO_0008673b_Oblivion_RESP1: Ah, we meet again. No hard feelings, I hope!
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_DarkSancTalk5_00034058_Oblivion_R: Ah, well, I'd love to continue chatting, but I have to prepare for my next contract. You know... that Mages Guild matter. You understand.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GreetingDavid01_00038ae2_Oblivion: Ah, well, in all honesty, no. But our wines are very good. And much cheaper than Tamika's very fine product, I assure you.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_MQ04Conv_00037b51_Oblivion_RESP1: Ah, well, thank you! The honor is mine.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GREETING_00013452_Oblivion_RESP5: Ah, well. All over now. The Chalice helps, doesn't it? Indeed it does, and I could use some helping right now. I'll just take that back from you.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_MagesStaff_0002c67c_Oblivion_RESP: Ah, wonderful! I shall be most pleased to return this to its rightful owner. Thank you.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_MG05Choice2A_000224ba_Oblivion_RE: Ah, wonderful! I'll just take this from you, and get to work translating it. I'll need some time with this; come and find me tomorrow.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_MG05Choice2A_00028c03_Oblivion_RE: Ah, wonderful! I'll just take this from you, and get to work translating it. I'll need some time with this; come and find me tomorrow.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_BattlehornTrophyA_0000c529_DLCBat: Ah, wonderful! I'll just take this from you, and get to work. I'll need some time with this; come and find me tomorrow.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_BattlehornTrophyB_0000c52b_DLCBat: Ah, wonderful! I'll just take this from you, and get to work. I'll need some time with this; come and find me tomorrow.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_BattlehornTrophyC_0000c52d_DLCBat: Ah, wonderful! I'll just take this from you, and get to work. I'll need some time with this; come and find me tomorrow.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_BattlehornTrophyD_0000c52f_DLCBat: Ah, wonderful! I'll just take this from you, and get to work. I'll need some time with this; come and find me tomorrow.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_BattlehornTrophyE_0000c531_DLCBat: Ah, wonderful! I'll just take this from you, and get to work. I'll need some time with this; come and find me tomorrow.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_BattlehornTrophyF_0000c533_DLCBat: Ah, wonderful! I'll just take this from you, and get to work. I'll need some time with this; come and find me tomorrow.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_BattlehornTrophyG_0000c535_DLCBat: Ah, wonderful! I'll just take this from you, and get to work. I'll need some time with this; come and find me tomorrow.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_BattlehornTrophyH_0000c537_DLCBat: Ah, wonderful! I'll just take this from you, and get to work. I'll need some time with this; come and find me tomorrow.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_Gift_0018bc30_Oblivion_RESP1: Ah, wonderful! I'm sure they'll make her happy. It's the least I can do; she's brought so much joy into my life, whether she knows it or not.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_MS40MelisandeIhavethem_0005373b_O: Ah, wonderful! These will be most useful to me.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_MagesStaff_000355a1_Oblivion_RESP: Ah, yes! This is a big step for you, friend. Whether you know it or not.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_Dark18NightConvo_000096e0_Oblivio: Ah, yes, I have been expecting you. The Listener now kneels by Sithis, as does his successor. There is a traitor amongst you.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_DarkSancTalk3_0006a858_Oblivion_R: Ah, yes, that was quite a situation I got myself into. But I have to admit, I had quite a bit of fun cleaning up my own mess! He he he he.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GREETING_0003cd0f_Oblivion_RESP1: Ah, yes. A guild brother in search of a fence?
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_TG00MysteriousNoteTopic_00035653_: Ah, yes. Another scoundrel who served time in an imperial jail. The Gray Fox is offering you a chance to join the Thieves Guild.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_IngredientCollection_000aef8d_Obl: Ah, yes. Arch-Mage Traven was quite fond of making potions in his spare time. So much so, in fact, that it became difficult for me to meet his needs.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_ND06CasimirGauntlets_00002b24_Kni: Ah, yes. As proof of the deed, when I struck the poor man the Gauntlets slipped right off my hands and fell to the floor.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_MQ07Spies_00020075_Oblivion_RESP1: Ah, yes. I hope you can help. The gate guards have reported seeing strangers on the road for the past several nights.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_Recommendation_0002db97_Oblivion_: Ah, yes. I'm afraid I'm unable to issue a recommendation. Only Dagail can do that.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_Recharge_0005e085_Oblivion_RESP1: Ah, yes. Let's see if we can't recharge some items for you.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GREETING_0002b461_Oblivion_RESP1: Ah, yes. My treasure-hunting friend. What can I do for you?
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_SE45ForkTopic_00083f61_Oblivion_R: Ah, yes. The Fork of Horripilation. I have heard rumors about it. It appears that Lord Sheogorath has returned it to the Isles.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_MG05Choice2A_00023ff2_Oblivion_RE: Ah, yes. This is indeed the correct book. You've not been able to open it, I presume? Then all is well.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_MG05Choice2A_00023ff5_Oblivion_RE: Ah, yes. This is indeed the correct book. You've not been able to open it, I presume? Then all is well.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_MG04Choice2A_000300a1_Oblivion_RE: Ah, yes. Thought so. We get many of them traveling through here. Well, we used to.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GREETING_00022498_Oblivion_RESP1: Ah, yes. You are a Guild Mage, are you not? Yet, different from the others. Yes, yes -- this is good.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GREETING_000167e6_Oblivion_RESP1: Ah, you again! A pleasure, I'm sure. No time for chatter now; I have a few important things to attend to, or did I? Ah well...
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GREETING_00070403_Oblivion_RESP1: Ah, you again. Have you seen any of Ma'zaddha's things? A shiny spoon, or a broken bottle? I can't find them.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_DarkGiftTopic_0004ce46_Oblivion_R: Ah, you are interested, then? Shall I pass along the terrible power of my Dark Gift? Do you wish to become a vampire?
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GREETING_00003455_Oblivion_RESP1: Ah, you are the new thief. I am your new Doyen.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GREETING_0001dc28_Oblivion_RESP1: Ah, you came. You're sure you weren't followed? Good, I thought I could trust you. Nobody else in town. They're all in on it ... all watching me.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_HELLO_00053872_Oblivion_RESP1: Ah, you have arrived. Come now, we must speak. The Black Hand has need of your... talents.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_SE09HaskillBodyParts_00081daa_Obl: Ah, you have been asked to choose the pieces with which to construct the new Gatekeeper. Quite an honor.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GREETING_00003925_Oblivion_RESP1: Ah, you must be from the Fighters Guild. Excellent! I'm looking forward to our investigation. Fascinating subject, these Daedra.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GREETING_0008b604_Oblivion_RESP1: Ah, you're back. I told Jauffre not to worry.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GREETING_00016cfd_Oblivion_RESP1: Ah, you're back. You may have noticed that we have a... bit of a problem.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GREETING_0008e654_Oblivion_RESP1: Ah, you're the one who lit the Great Torch for us. Well done!
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_heirloom_00002e5a_Oblivion_RESP1: Ah, you've got it! Thank the gods! Finally, my mead will stay cold and won't taste like goblin piss. Take these, and my thanks.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_SE09HaskillFringe_00040368_Oblivi: Ah, your task is completed. Wonderful. Our Lord Sheogorath may wish to hear of your success. Perhaps you should tell Him yourself.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_SE09RebuildRequest_0001356d_Obliv: Ah, your tone is more in line with my station. Please, continue.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_INFOGENERAL_0003c224_Oblivion_RES: Ah-Malz at the Fighters Guild has gotten to be an expert on goblin hunting. He just hates the things.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GREETING_00038aba_Oblivion_RESP1: Ah-Malz of the Fighters Guild. Welcome to Skingrad County. Come hunting goblins, have you?
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_MQ06JauffreB_0008b617_Oblivion_RE: Ah. Good. You should take that to Martin right away.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_TG10JaksDiarySays_00015313_Oblivi: Ah. It seems you have stumbled over a bit of history that few in the Thieves Guild ever discover. I am not the first Gray Fox.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GREETING_000488dc_Oblivion_RESP1: Ah. S'krivva hears of you. Welcome, and well-fare in your craft and trade.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_SE09AuthorityMyOwn_0001356b_Obliv: Ah. That confirms it. You're the new Duke. The stink of hubris surrounds you! My Lord allows you to lick his boot straps, does he?
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GREETING_000c099d_Oblivion_RESP1: Ah. You must be the one I got the message about. How can I help you?
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_SE11RobeConv03_0005508c_Oblivion_: Ah... I see you well, my friend. With all the new recruits, it is hard to be certain who is who.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_SENewSheothTOPIC_00078cab_Oblivio: Ah... New Sheoth. My home away from places that aren't my home. The current location is much better than some of the prior ones. Don't you think?
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_FGD06Weapon1_00028880_Oblivion_RE: Ah... a hammer. Well, it seems you don't have one. However I see that you have a longsword....
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_FGD06Weapon1_00028881_Oblivion_RE: Ah... a hammer. Well. Not my first choice, but it will suffice. Let's go!
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_BookResponses_000277bc_Oblivion_R: Ah... an excellent read, though it's been a while since I've read it myself. Let me know how you like it.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_DASanguineSpeech_000b1232_Oblivio: Ah... another mortal come to beg Sanguine to add a bit of spice to an otherwise drab existence. I would have you perform a service for me.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GREETING_00081b7e_Oblivion_RESP1: Ah... our Lord has granted you the power to summon me. How wonderful for me.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_INFOGENERAL_000241d4_Oblivion_RES: Ah... pure magic. Research. Knowledge. That's why I love the Mages Guild.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GREETING_0000be6b_Oblivion_RESP1: Ah... you are from the Fighters Guild, I resume. Good show. I am Lord Rugdumph gro-Shurgak. Let us conversate on the Lady Rogbut.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GREETING_000356a8_Oblivion_RESP1: Ah... you must be from the Fighters Guild. Good. I have a problem. It has to do with the rats in my basement.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_ImpGallTOPIC_0002ee63_Oblivion_RE: Ah... you've got it. Looks fresh, too! I realize that you'll be paid by your superior, but take this as well. It might come in handy in your work.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GREETING_0006d17d_Oblivion_RESP1: Ah...you're here. Joy. You'll want to speak to the Lord Sheogorath.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_HELLO_000837e9_Oblivion_RESP1: Aha! There you are. Took you long enough to get here.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GREETING_000479e6_Oblivion_RESP2: Ahdarji trains, yes. Light Armor is the skill. Ahdarji must work very hard, now she is all alone in the world.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_TG04AmuseisPlot_00009332_Oblivion: Ahdarji uses ring much more wisely. I use it to collect and sell information. That ring can be used to read private messages the Count writes.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GREETING_000039bd_Oblivion_RESP2: Ahem. Citizen of... Skingrad. Please be advised that I am here on official business, and wish no harm...
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_SE07BThadonDeathSpeech02_0007b37a: Ahem. The lady fair, our love is told. With hair as fine as soft-spun gold.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GREETING_000131d3_Oblivion_RESP1: Ahh yes, THERE you are! You couldn't imagine how long I've been waiting for you. So little to do, and so much time.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GREETING_000400db_Oblivion_RESP1: Ahh! You burn with the purging Fire of Agnon, the flame of Truth, the flickering beacon of hope in the gloom of despond!
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_HELLO_0006a84b_Oblivion_RESP1: Ahh, magister. I just remembered, there's something I'd like to discuss with you.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GREETING_0001ce95_Oblivion_RESP1: Ahh... much better. You repulse me now, at least to a degree. Others should find you foul, disgusting. Namira may be pleased. Approach the shrine.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_StoneofStAlessiaTOPIC_0000392a_Ob: Ahh... you've found it! I can't thank you enough. Your work is greatly appreciated. Here, take these. I wish I could give you more.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GREETING_00028886_Oblivion_RESP1: Ahh... you've got the weapons. Let's talk about that weapons shipment you brought.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GREETING_000314f7_Oblivion_RESP1: Ahhh! You have returned from your investigation, and I am eager to hear the results.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_SE09MiscScreamingInPain_00046f67_: Ahhh!! No! No! Make it stop, make it stop! Aaayiiee!
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_SE07RitualYesM02_00013a67_Oblivio: Ahhh, but it was. As the bacchanal reached a crescendo, the people began to clutch their chests as their very hearts exploded!
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GREETING_00013ff9_Oblivion_RESP1: Ahhh, good to see you again.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_RaynilDralasTopic_00038431_Oblivi: Ahhh, you mean that vampire hunter. He's staying over at Olav's Tap and Tack. It's near the city gates; you can't miss it.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_HELLO_0009407f_Oblivion_RESP1: Ahhh. So good to be back home.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GOODBYE_00094ebd_Oblivion_RESP1: Ahhh... Rosentia will be so pleased!
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_INFOGENERAL_00082601_Oblivion_RES: Ahjazda in Crucible believes the world is ending.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_INFOGENERAL_0008dc13_Oblivion_RES: Ahjazda in Crucible believes the world is ending. She seeks all sorts of items to weather the storm portending.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_INFOGENERAL_00082602_Oblivion_RES: Ahjazda thinks the world is ending tomorrow. She's been saving magic items just in case.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_Corpse_0018d818_Oblivion_RESP1: Akatosh bless you and keep you.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_ImperialCityTopic_000476fd_Oblivi: Akatosh speaks to us all, but we never listen. Go to the Temple of the One. Read the Covenants. Praise the Nine!
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_lightthedragonfires_000223e4_Obli: Akatosh, the Supreme God of Time, gave the Amulet of Kings to St. Alessia, the first emperor, as a god-certain test of the true heir.

ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GREETING_0000be64_Oblivion_RESP3: And you've been demoted to the rank of Defender. Hell, even I don't think you deserved that. But, it is what it is. Move on.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GREETING_000c8521_Oblivion_RESP3: And you've been demoted to the rank of Defender. Hell, even I don't think you deserved that. But, it is what it is. Move on.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_SE11RakheranGreeting2a_00019fc8_O: And you, if you help me, then you can have what you want and no need to risk your neck, yes?
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_Dark01Choice2B_00022ba0_Oblivion_: And you, you are a cold-blooded killer, capable of taking life without mercy or remorse. The Night Mother has been watching, and she is most pleased.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_MQChampionOfCyrodiil_000add4d_Obl: And, as a small token of gratitude for your service to the Empire, I have ordered a suit of Imperial Dragon armor made for you.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_PurificationTopic_0002fd9c_Oblivi: And, hopefully, we kill the traitor in the process. Until the Purification is complete, no given Sanctuary will ever be considered secure.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_MountainLionsTOPIC_00036623_Obliv: And, if you can keep this our little secret, I can make it worth your while. There's a bit about acrobatics I can teach you. Give it some thought.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_VaronVamoriTopic_0002c6a9_Oblivio: And, of course, please keep this just between us.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_MagesStaff_0002c67c_Oblivion_RESP: And, to thank you more personally, I shall teach you this spell. You may find it useful in certain circumstances.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_Recommendation_0002fd6d_Oblivion_: And, what better way to learn the many uses of Restoration? Practical application is often the best educator. Even in life and death situations.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GREETING_00037ff3_Oblivion_RESP2: And... Ah, I see. So, you're an Arena combatant. Well isn't that nice. Now get out of my face.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GREETING_00002992_Knights_RESP2: And... And he's told you something you don't want to tell me. I need someone to please tell me what's going on. Please, help me. Have mercy on me.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GREETING_00037ff5_Oblivion_RESP2: And... Wait, I know you. You're that new Champion, right? Hmph. I guess I know why you're here. But let me tell you, you're making a big mistake.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GREETING_00037ff6_Oblivion_RESP2: And... Wait, I know you. You're that new Champion, right? Oh, don't tell me you've actually challenged the Gray Prince to a match! Are you insane?
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GREETING_00033560_Oblivion_RESP2: And... you didn't hear it from me, but I think you should go speak with Oreyn. Now. He'd like your help with a couple things.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_CheydinhalTopic_0004e89e_Oblivion: Andel Indarys doesn't help his case by having a prat for a son, and a wife that dies in very suspicious circumstances.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_INFOGENERAL_00062499_Oblivion_RES: Andel Indarys is an intemperate, bibulous philanderer. And a Dark Elf. Other than that, he is perfectly suited to be a count.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_INFOGENERAL_00062497_Oblivion_RES: Andel Indarys may or may not have killed his wife, and it may or may not have been an accident. And I doubt we'll ever know for sure.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GREETING_000476c8_Oblivion_RESP1: Angelie Blakeley. This is my father's house. He was lost at sea, many years ago.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GOODBYE_00033b20_Oblivion_RESP1: Anon us most soon again, for sooth.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_INFOGENERAL_00002a11_Knights_RESP: Another Chapel's been attacked. Bravil this time!
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_SE04JyggalagTopic_0009102c_Oblivi: Another Daedric Prince. Not a nice one. I don't think ANY of the other Princes like him, actually. I mean, Malacath is more popular at parties.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GREETING_000176b8_Oblivion_RESP1: Another High Elf has been taught the meaning of humility, thanks to the Blue Team's number one Warrior. You really earned your keep this time.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_SE38Oddity4_00079f51_Oblivion_RES: Another Pelvis of Pelagius? I don't think that's possible, honestly. It must be a fake.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_INFOGENERAL_00042d9a_Oblivion_RES: Another adventurer is trying to get into the Shivering Isles. If it's a Breton, it'll be the first one in 3.7 years.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_HELLO_0007e964_Oblivion_RESP1: Another chamber, another victim to eliminate. Hurry, the anticipation is overwhelming!
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_SEManiaRumorResponses_00061607_Ob: Another conspiracy in Crucible. Not a surprise.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_INFOGENERAL_00043eb5_Oblivion_RES: Another conspiracy in Crucible. That's fine. Just stay away from my things.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GREETING_000784b3_Oblivion_RESP1: Another fine day in Mania, is it not?
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_OblivionGateConv_00097faa_Oblivio: Another gate just opened! We'll take the fight to them this time.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_DAMolagBalSpeech_00037848_Oblivio: Another mortal come to do my bidding. I only wish suffering and death. You will bring me both. I want to see a man brought to the edge. And pushed.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_DASheogorathSpeech_000897c3_Obliv: Another mortal dares to summon me, and already I am bored. But enough about me. Let's talk about you.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_DASheogorathSpeech_00097612_Obliv: Another mortal dares to summon me, and already I am bored. But enough about me. Let's talk about you.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_INFOGENERAL_00042dab_Oblivion_RES: Another of my brood finally returns to the Isles. Oh, I wonder what this one will be like!
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_EulogyKhajiit_0009f9be_Oblivion_R: Another one bites the dust. The Khajiit is done.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_CheydinhalTopic_0004e896_Oblivion: Another possibility in that direction might be Kemen. It's an old Ayleid ruin.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_INFOGENERAL_00032e9f_Oblivion_RES: Another rat job? Not me. No thanks. Let the bottom boot do the rats. Unless you want the gig....
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_INFOGENERAL_00043ede_Oblivion_RES: Another round of torture in Crucible? At least if you're in a cell, no one can sneak up on you.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_HELLO_0001f3b6_Oblivion_RESP1: Another sheep returns to the flock.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_HELLO_000206b0_Oblivion_RESP1: Another sheep returns to the flock.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GREETING_00025e15_Oblivion_RESP1: Another theft! This is your final chance. Go back into the field, and return to me with the horns of twenty minotaurs.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GREETING_000488bf_Oblivion_RESP1: Antoine Branck. I just work here. If you want a horse, go inside and talk to Isabeau.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_MS18Convo_0001cb7b_Oblivion_RESP1: Antus, calm down. We'll be leaving soon enough.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_INFOGENERAL_00002a23_Knights_RESP: Anvil is all in an uproar. First the Chapel attacked, now the prophet ranting about the end of the world!
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_AnvilTopic_0003e0c8_Oblivion_RESP: Anvil wouldn't be my choice for a refit. No proper yard, neither spars nor scantlings in good supply. But, it's ill-luck to complain.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_AnvilTopic_0003e0ab_Oblivion_RESP: Anvil's a port town. That's why you'll see items here you won't find in the Imperial City. The captains keep an eye out for special items for me.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_BonusTopic_0002ff51_Oblivion_RESP: Any Brother or Sister who can complete a contract while following a specific request will receive a valuable bonus, oftentimes a powerful magic item.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_Shadowscale_000251fb_Oblivion_RES: Any Shadowscale who lives to come of age is accepted into the Dark Brotherhood as a full member of the family. So it was with myself, and Ocheeva.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GREETING_0018bb02_Oblivion_RESP1: Any citizen who takes the time to talk to a member of the Legion is okay in my book. With all that's happened, it's good to know we're appreciated.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GREETING_000af05a_Oblivion_RESP1: Any friend of Martin's is a friend of mine. How can I help you?
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GREETING_00023dda_Oblivion_RESP1: Any friend of the Society is a friend of mine.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GREETING_0000bc5c_Oblivion_RESP1: Any friend of the Society is a friend of mine. Have a look around.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_Question_0002529e_Oblivion_RESP1: Any idea what Gromm will do now that old Baenlin is dead?
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_SE09Victims_00081fdc_Oblivion_RES: Any loyal servant of the Madgod would respect His decision in this matter.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_Recommendation_0002d6e5_Oblivion_: Any luck finding Erthor yet? I'll need to speak with him before I can feel your recommendation has been earned.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GREETING_0018d92c_Oblivion_RESP1: Any luck on those bottles of Shadowbanish Wine yet?
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GREETING_0002c0cf_Oblivion_RESP1: Any luck talking with Varon Vamori yet? It should be no trouble at all once you use that scroll.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_INFOGENERAL_000432c7_Oblivion_RES: Any new adventurer trying to get into the Isles will have a tough time going up against the Gatekeeper.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_Question_000277b7_Oblivion_RESP1: Any new books you've been reading?
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_INFOGENERAL_00042d94_Oblivion_RES: Any new entry to the Shivering Isles is the chance for a new convert. I welcome it.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_HELLO_0001e7d1_Oblivion_RESP1: Any new information come to light?
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GREETING_0000b2db_Oblivion_RESP1: Any news about that certain task we discussed?
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_MagesGuildTopic_00062609_Oblivion: Any of the local guild heads can get you into the guild. If you're in a hurry, speak with Carahil. She should be somewhere around here.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_ArgonianBloodTopic_00053740_Obliv: Any old Argonian will do, and you needn't kill it, but do be careful. Stabbing strangers often doesn't sit well with townspeople or the town guards.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_MS40MelisandeIhavethem_0005373b_O: Any old Argonian will do, but the vampire must be very powerful indeed. If you succeed, I'll get you what you need. Any questions?
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GREETING_00028bf8_Oblivion_RESP1: Any progress yet? You should be working on getting the book for me.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GOODBYE_000807ef_Oblivion_RESP1: Any time you wish to visit me, I'll be here.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GREETING_0000a0f7_Oblivion_RESP1: Any word from Jeanne in Bruma?
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_SE05HerdirInvestigateWho_00083f4c: Anya Herrick, dear Inquisitor. She's been named as someone of interest. I do look forward to chatting with her, don't you?
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_SE05HerdirInvestigateCurrentTask_: Anya claims to have been approached by Ma'zaddha. Perhaps there's something to this after all.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_ImperialCityTopic_0004766d_Oblivi: Anyone can wear clothes. But the RIGHT clothes? That is not so easy. Go to any castle. They wear Palonirya's designs, or they're nobody.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_TeekeeusTopic_000253d4_Oblivion_R: Anyone capable of handling it should have access to that power, don't you think?
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_INFOGENERAL_00061433_Oblivion_RES: Anyone looking for work should consider the Fighters Guild. I hear they're always looking for recruits.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_SE40SleepOutside_0008f7d8_Oblivio: Anything I can do to help you. Really, you should speak with Uungor. He doesn't want to be here, anyway. Poor fellow believes himself sane!
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GREETING_0003843b_Oblivion_RESP1: Anything else I can help with, you just let me know.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GREETING_00022e51_Oblivion_RESP1: Anything else I can help with?
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_TG08AncestorMoth_00048973_Oblivio: Anything for a friend. The Moth Priests live in the Imperial Palace. I don't know exactly what they do. Something to do with the Elder Scrolls.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_TG01AmantiusAllectus_00048970_Obl: Anything for you! He lives in the Temple district on the far east side.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_NDTalk1_00002ba8_Knights_RESP1: Anything for you, my friend! What do you need?
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_HELLO_0001e0de_Oblivion_RESP1: Anything you require, you're welcome to it.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GREETING_0002df70_Oblivion_RESP6: Anyway, I digress. I'm sure you wish to hear of your reward.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_Dark11Choice4B_00002dda_Oblivion_: Anyway, I have duties to tend to. If you see my mother, tell her I'll visit soon! I promise!
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GREETING_000412c7_Oblivion_RESP3: Anyway, I'm always looking for new exhibits, so remember me when you come across anything Odd.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_SE34WhyNeed_0008f7b9_Oblivion_RES: Anyway, enough of my banter. So, will you please help me get back my Medallion?
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_MS29InvNice_0001d049_Oblivion_RES: Anyway, have fun looking around, and when you are ready to buy, give me a shout.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_MS46GoblinWar_0000ab72_Oblivion_R: Anyway, if you want to rile up a goblin tribe, steal their Tribal Head. Which is often what a rival tribe does, just to prove they're tougher.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GREETING_00062be9_Oblivion_RESP4: Anyway, sorry to go on so long. I'm sure you've got things to do. Just wanted to thank you personally.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_BlackwaterBrigands_0000c1ce_Obliv: Anyway, sorry to ramble. You better get below now and rest until we arrive safely at the Imperial City docks.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_SE42Confused_0007322d_Oblivion_RE: Anyway, you're going to help me find calipers and tongs. No point in denying it. You've already agreed tomorrow.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_SE03Xedilian_0006770c_Oblivion_RE: Anyway... there are those that have other ways into my Realm, and they're on the move. We don't want them here. Trust me.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_INFOGENERAL_000914af_Oblivion_RES: Apologies, citizen, but I must return to my post.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GREETING_00023e84_Oblivion_RESP2: Apologies, my good friend. I mistook you for someone else. Always being asked about it, I am. 'Didn't I see you in Cheydinhal?', they say.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_SE41Aquanostrum_0006ea4d_Oblivion: Apparently it only exists at the bottom of Knotty Bramble... ah well. So close, yet so far.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_NDRumorAttackResponse2_00002b9e_K: Apparently no one has any idea who did it. Now there's some prophet preaching doom in the streets of Anvil.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_INFOGENERAL_00000808_AltarESPMain: Apparently some fool tried to resurrect the Crimson Scars in Deepscorn Hollow. The Dark Brotherhood will not like that…
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_MatildePetitTopic_000286e1_Oblivi: Apparently the poor old woman thinks she is from a well-to-do family. Truth is, I have servants with more nobility in their blood than her.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_MQ05WhatBaurusLearned_00022b1e_Ob: Apparently worship the Daedra Lord Mehrunes Dagon. I've been tracking their agents in the Imperial City. I guess they noticed.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_INFOGENERAL_000465d0_Oblivion_RES: Apparently, Arentus Falvius at the chapel is quite a conjurer. He'll even teach the skill to those he likes.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_RaynilDralasTopic_00032679_Oblivi: Apparently, Bradon Lirrian was one of those vile creatures, and Raynil slew him. Kind of strange though. I never figured Bradon to be a vampire.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_INFOGENERAL_000465e0_Oblivion_RES: Apparently, Right-Wind teaches his blade skills to other Fighters Guild members.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_ICAllNQDQuestionResponses_000498e: Apparently, he can teach you the basics of lockpicking.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_BrumaNQDQuestionResponses_0004663: Apparently, she was wanted in Skyrim for murder. Shot a man dead from over 300 yards. Hard to believe.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_SECreatureResponses_00077c57_Obli: Apparently, some spells make them bigger and stronger.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_Fugitives_00009c37_Oblivion_RESP1: Apparently, there are three or four of them. Real nasty, from what I hear. You take care of them. Maybe you'll get lucky and they'll surrender.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_FGD08JeetumSpeech_000981a0_Oblivi: Apparently, they've been giving the locals some trouble. Shouldn't be a problem for you four, though.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_HELLO_0006a847_Oblivion_RESP1: Apprentice! Wait right there. We need to talk.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_ShrineofNocturnalTOPIC_000b97c4_O: Approach the shrine, if you dare.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_DASanguineChoice1_00027104_Oblivi: Approach then, and bring Sanguine a gift. Some Cyrodilic Brandy is an appropriate gift for your host.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_HELLO_0008d316_Oblivion_RESP1: Approach, Duchess of Dementia. The time is near and I am fading...

ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GREETING_0001ef74_Oblivion_RESP1: Blessed are you, who walks his true path. Enlightened are you, who learns of himself.

ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_SE09Components_00013571_Oblivion_: Blood Liqueur, Osseous Marrow, Dermis Membrane, and the Essence of Breath.

ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GREETING_0001fc4a_Oblivion_RESP3: Blood ran blue, and dragons flew high. Under broken towers and broken bodies it now lies, waiting to be found.

ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GREETING_00023fa3_Oblivion_RESP1: Books. I sell books. Go ahead. Look. Buy some.

ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_BravilTopic_00048918_Oblivion_RES: Bravil perhaps presents little scope for an ambitious member of our guild. Perhaps you may find the castle entertaining. Little else.

ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_SE07RitualYesD_0001365d_Oblivion_: By poisoning the sacramental wine, Arden-Sul was able to suppress any such conspiracy in one fell swoop.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_SQ08Wine_0018d92b_Oblivion_RESP1: By the Divines! You found some? Fantastic!

ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_FromTheDead_0001ce03_Oblivion_RES: By the Divines... I can't believe this! They would dare defile the dead to make a profit? The City Watch will hear of this.

ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GREETING_00027668_Oblivion_RESP1: By the Nine Divines, you did it! You actually won! You ain't so bad after all, Pit Dog. You may even survive enough matches to advance in rank.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_CharGenTaunt2_0003336b_Oblivion_R: By the Nine Divines, you're an ugly one. And female, no less. But then, all Orcs are ugly. The most repulsive race in all of Tamriel, really.

ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GREETING_0005371a_Oblivion_RESP1: By the way the guards tossed you in here, I can see you're no friend of theirs.

ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_BleakFlatsCaveTopic_0000a1e7_Obli: By we, I mean you, of course. I have something that may help - it's a basic fireball spell, in case you need to defend yourself.

ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GOODBYE_00002db3_Oblivion_RESP1: Bye now, sweetie. I look forward to seeing you again.

ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_TG09accept_00014826_Oblivion_RESP: Capital! Bring me the Arrow of Extrication. It has a key shaped head. Bravil's court wizard, Fathis Aren, recently acquired this unique item.

ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_TGPayBloodPrice_0001cf1b_Oblivion: Capital! I hearby reinstate you into the Thieves Guild.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_TGPayBloodPrice_0001cf1f_Oblivion: Capital! I knew you could not stand for a stain on your honor, or that of the guild.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_TGPayBloodPrice_0001cf38_Oblivion: Capital! I like the swiftness of your reply. Here is your reward for getting me those boots. Be ready. I may call for you again.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_TG08GiveStone_00014705_Oblivion_R: Capital! Now I can see past the palace defenses. It's a good thing the Emperor didn't know they had this stone.

ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_TG08accept_000146ff_Oblivion_RESP: Capital! The monastery is called the Temple of the Ancestor Moths. It is where retired, blind Moth priests go to wait out the rest of their days.

ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_MQ07SpiesResponse_00020076_Oblivi: Captain Burd in Bruma may also be able to help. I've asked the Countess to have the guard keep an eye out for strangers.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_MQ10JauffreA_00026efb_Oblivion_RE: Captain Burd is waiting for you outside the Bruma city gate. He'll show you the Oblivion Gate. Although I doubt it will be hard to find.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_BrumaTopic_0018d2a2_Oblivion_RESP: Captain Burd wanted to attack the Oblivion Gate immediately, but I ordered him to wait for you.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_INFOGENERAL_00000806_AltarESPMain: Captain Dugal's rumored treasure has to be true! I wonder if the first count of Anvil found it.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_INFOGENERAL_0006444c_Oblivion_RES: Captain Lex blames the Gray Fox for stealing the tax collection. He wants a bounty put on the Gray Fox, but the Legion Commander has refused.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_MS48IlendSlowDown_00098154_Oblivi: Captain Matius sent us in to try and close the gate. We were ambushed, trapped, and picked off.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GOODBYE_000688fd_Oblivion_RESP1: Captain. No news is good news, I hope.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GREETING_0002fd72_Oblivion_RESP2: Carahil has sent you, has she not?
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_AnvilTopic_0003e0c0_Oblivion_RESP: Carahil inherited the Anvil Mages Guild chapter from Hannibal Traven, the Archmage. She runs a clean hall, just like Traven did.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_MagesGuildTopic_0002d066_Oblivion: Carahil supported Arch-Mage Traven's appointment from the beginning, and I don't believe the rumors that she just wanted his job at this hall.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_LorgrenSpeech_0006e7f2_Oblivion_R: Carahil was justified in his actions. Slaying me was the only way to stop the madness. I have accepted that fate.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_MagesGuildTopic_0002d067_Oblivion: Carahil's a good leader. She's been a staunch supporter of the Council of Mages for as long as I've known her.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GREETING_000488d9_Oblivion_RESP1: Carandial. Mage-trained. Scholar by inclination. Student of our Aldmeri ancestors, the Ayleids.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_NecromancersAmuletTopic_0000c08a_: Caranya insisted on removing it from the University. She said it posed a threat to the safety of the Imperial City.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_HELLO_00073124_Oblivion_RESP1: Careful! Don't want to get squashed.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GOODBYE_0008ea29_Oblivion_RESP1: Careful. Beasts all around. You might taste good to them, no?
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GOODBYE_00068900_Oblivion_RESP1: Caroline, a good day to you. Or is it evening?
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_HELLO_000688f2_Oblivion_RESP1: Caroline. Don't let me keep you.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_SE30ForgeSword_0001651c_Oblivion_: Carve a happy smile. Let the blood wash over your hands.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_NDGauntletsoftheCrusader_00002b13: Casimir left with the Gauntlets when the Order dissolved. I heard that he lost them, but I had my own problems to deal with.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_INFOGENERAL_0008dc18_Oblivion_RES: Cast lots of spells at Gnarls. That's the best way to hurt them. Really!
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_DANamiraSpeech_0005dc89_Oblivion_: Cast this spell upon the priests. Allow my beloved Forgotten to kill the interlopers. When this is done, I shall reward you for your efforts.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_INFOGENERAL_000255c2_Oblivion_RES: Casta Scribonia has finished a new book. Nothing that interests me, though.

ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_INFOGENERAL_000624a4_Oblivion_RES: Chorrol appears to be clean, prosperous, and well-ordered. Countess Arriana, her staff and guard is to be praised.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GREETING_0018d294_Oblivion_RESP1: Chorrol breathes easier thanks to you. We are all in your debt.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_ChorrolTopic_0002c4d4_Oblivion_RE: Chorrol's got plenty to eat, and good, thick walls, and that suits me fine. I don't know what's going on out there in the woods, and I don't need to.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_ChorrolTopic_000237ba_Oblivion_RE: Chorrol? That's where we are, right? Really? Great. I don't care. And I'm not interested. But it's sure nice of you to let me know.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_ICAllNQDQuestionResponses_0004993: Cicero, Sergius, and Tertullian run a good shop.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_SE11RakheranGreeting3a_0008f12c_O: Ciirta brought us here with promises to show us the light, but always is about Sheogorath, is about revenge!
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_SE11CiirtaTopic_00016b82_Oblivion: Ciirta guides us to the light, but... her obsession with Sheogorath keeps us from achieving it! Ra'kheran, now he -- I've said too much.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GREETING_00016b59_Oblivion_RESP1: Ciirta has fallen into darkness. Ra'kheran will lead the Apostles to the light!
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_SE11CiirtaTopic_00016b81_Oblivion: Ciirta is a fool, and a liar! She allows her hatred for Sheogorath to interfere with our journey toward the light! She must be stopped!
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GREETING_0007dea0_Oblivion_RESP1: Ciirta is dead, and Ra'kheran has fallen. Who will guide us now?
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GREETING_0001a391_Oblivion_RESP1: Ciirta is dead, and now the Apostles fear that there is no one to lead them to the light.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GREETING_00016b77_Oblivion_RESP1: Ciirta is dead. Ra'kheran will guide us now.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_SE11CiirtaTopic_00016b85_Oblivion: Ciirta is the lightbringer. She has seen things that we can only imagine. If you are to join us, you must speak with her.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_SE11RakheranGreeting3a_0008f12c_O: Ciirta lied, but when she is done, I will lead the Acolytes to the light!
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_SE11TheLightTopic_0008f12d_Oblivi: Ciirta promised to bring us to the light. It is a way, a promise of a better future. Free from the shackles of Sheogorath.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_SE11DyusChoice1_00019ccf_Oblivion: Ciirta resides in the Howling Halls of Mania. Find her and bring me the eye that has seen that which no other has.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_SE11CiirtaTopic_0001a397_Oblivion: Ciirta's light has been darkened. Now is the time for another to rise and stand in her place.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_SE39SpoonChoice2_000781fb_Oblivio: Cindanwe is always trying to hurt my sweet Kishashi. Wouldn't want the slave-driver to get her hands on this spoon.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_INFOGENERAL_000825f2_Oblivion_RES: Cindanwe runs a tight ship in Fellmoor.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_SE39Cindanwe_000781f6_Oblivion_RE: Cindanwe think she tough lady. Not as mean as Relan. She okay. She let Relan kill things that need to be dead. Relan like biting off heads.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GREETING_0003be7b_Oblivion_RESP3: Cindanwe would breathe her last breath with my hands around her throat and my sweet Kishashi would take her place. If only...
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_INFOGENERAL_000465b9_Oblivion_RES: Cirroc is a good healer. He's a Redguard, but you'd think he was a Nord, the way he acts.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_NDProphetSpeechAmulet_00002d1f_Kn: Citizens, the Queen of Stars asks you: where is her issue? Where are the men who can walk in her steps? In whose blood has the dragon taken purchase?
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_MS31Lynch02Negative_000151e8_Obli: City Watch? I doubt it. But since you have aligned yourself with them, I think it's time to put an end to this conversation.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_INFOGENERAL_00046636_Oblivion_RES: City-Swimmer certainly lives up to her name. I've seen her in the canals many times.

ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_MS48Convo_00024829_Oblivion_RESP1: Civilians! It's time to move out! Let's go!
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_INFOGENERAL_0004994f_Oblivion_RES: Claudette Perrick runs a fine alchemy shop. You should check out The Gilded Carafe.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_ICAllNQDResponses_00049951_Oblivi: Claudette does a good job. Still, she should rename the place.

ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_Idle_0018b588_Oblivion_RESP1: Clearly he was wrong. Yet I do think he meant well.

ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_AxeofDragol_0001fdb5_Oblivion_RES: Clever ruse. I wonder how many have died falling for it?

ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GREETING_00081b74_Oblivion_RESP1: Clever. You've summoned me again. My Lord has made quite a choice for his champion.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_CharGenVoice_000150c7_Oblivion_RE: Close up left! Protect the Emperor!
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_BladesTalk2_0018d7ee_Oblivion_RES: Cloud Ruler Temple is home to the Blades, and has served us well. But I fear an assault. Mythic Dawn, Daedra... maybe both. We must be ready.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_CloudRulerTempleTopic_00034069_Ob: Cloud Ruler Temple was built long ago, by the founders of the Blades, back in the days of Reman Cyrodiil.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_MQ04KeepMartinSafe_0001ee2e_Obliv: Cloud Ruler Temple, I think. The hidden fortress of the Blades, in the mountains near Bruma. A few men can hold it against an army.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_CloudRulerTempleTopic_000626c2_Ob: Cloud Ruler is many things. Temple, fortress, safe haven. But it's also my home. I'll gladly die defending these walls, if it comes to it.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_INFOGENERAL_0018bcac_Oblivion_RES: Colovia is a land of rugged wastes and highland forests.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_INFOGENERAL_0018bcad_Oblivion_RES: Colovia is dotted with isolated farms and settlements, with most of the population in the coastal margin.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_SkingradNQDResponses_0003c193_Obl: Colovian Traders is a good shop. Perhaps I'll visit Gunder soon.

ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_HorseDecline_0004ce58_Oblivion_RE: Come back if you change your mind. We are the only place in Cyrodiil where you can get the magnificent White horse.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_CropsfordTopic_00033ee6_Oblivion_: Come back in a few weeks. You may be surprised at what we can accomplish.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GREETING_00066f33_Oblivion_RESP1: Come back to laugh at the pathetic old man, have we? To the pit with you! Leave me alone.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GREETING_0000299a_Knights_RESP1: Come back to see the doomed man, have you?
