ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_INFOGENERAL_00078167_Oblivion_RES: Earil's Mysteries sells a number of unique spells. Doesn't sell any mysteries, though.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_ImperialCityTopic_00047691_Oblivi: East of the city, at the head of the Red River, is a shrine to Vaermina.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_Barter_0005df55_Oblivion_RESP1: Eat well, while you have your health. I'm sure I have something that would interest you.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GREETING_0004765a_Oblivion_RESP1: Edgar Vautrine. You don't want the very best. You want cheap. And I got cheap.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GREETING_0003c9ba_Oblivion_RESP1: Edla. Edla Dark-Heart. If you want to be a Marksman, I can train you. If you can breathe, I can teach you.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GREETING_0003be7b_Oblivion_RESP1: Eh? Oh... I'm sorry. I was just... nothing. Never mind. I am Ranarr-Jo. I work the fields here in Fellmoor.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GREETING_00067dd2_Oblivion_RESP1: Eh? You again? You ready to hear about an old man's troubles?
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GREETING_00023e0c_Oblivion_RESP1: Eight of the evening watch, and all's well. And you, too, ma'am.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GREETING_00023ea2_Oblivion_RESP1: Eight of the evening watch, and all's well. And you, too, sir.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GREETING_00023e1b_Oblivion_RESP1: Eight of the morning watch, and all's well. Good day, ma'am.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GREETING_00023ee2_Oblivion_RESP1: Eight of the morning watch, and all's well. Good day, sir.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_MS46GoblinWar_0002f477_Oblivion_R: Either kill the attacking tribe's shaman, or recover the "tribal head" from the rival tribe, which is likely the cause of the war.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_TG03LexMyvryna_000355d2_Oblivion_: Either way, it's over. You didn't really think I'd trust the likes of you for very long?
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_SE39PodPitYes_00072c9a_Oblivion_R: Either way, you will have a piece of blue sky.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GOODBYE_0008da9d_Oblivion_RESP1: Either you have it, or you don't. Don't play games with me.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_NelsTheNaughtyTopic_00028246_Obli: Either you or Nels is the killer! I can't trust either of you, so just stay away from me!
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_MG05Choice2A_000224e7_Oblivion_RE: Either you're lying to me, or your feeble little mind has forgotten that you put it down someplace. I'm not amused. Go get the book.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_ElanteTOPIC_0000344e_Oblivion_RES: Elante is a scholar, interested in researching Daedra worship. Meet her in Brittlerock Cave, help her find the shrine, and keep her safe.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_INFOGENERAL_00032e53_Oblivion_RES: Elante of Alinor? She's the Daedric scholar, right? She'll live to write again, thanks to the Fighters Guild.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GOODBYE_0003ca36_Oblivion_RESP1: Elements... Dreamworld... HA! That's the best yarn I've heard in years!
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_MS05DreamworldTopic_0002c6d1_Obli: Elements? Inside a dream? Bah! That's the most foolish thing I've ever heard! Get away from me... you're clearly insane!
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_Necromancers_000355a5_Oblivion_RE: Eletta and Zahrasha dead? I can't believe it!
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_Necromancers_000355a8_Oblivion_RE: Eletta and Zahrasha dead? I can't believe it!
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GREETING_00023e04_Oblivion_RESP1: Eleven of the evening watch, and all's well. Long day, ma'am.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GREETING_00023e8a_Oblivion_RESP1: Eleven of the evening watch, and all's well. Long day, sir.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GREETING_00023e17_Oblivion_RESP1: Eleven of the morning watch, and all's well. Good day, ma'am.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GREETING_00023ec8_Oblivion_RESP1: Eleven of the morning watch, and all's well. Good day, sir.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_Dark04DrethConvo_00045f84_Oblivio: Eleven! Eleven years in this rat-infested hole! But I'm getting out, and you'll still be stuck in here! Ha ha ha ha ha!
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_EmfridHot_00023cd0_Oblivion_RESP1: Emfrid? She owns the Grey Mare, right? Huh. I go to the Oak and Crosier.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_MQ03MartinB3_0001e8d4_Oblivion_RE: Emperor Uriel Septim? You think the emperor is my father?
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_MQ02JauffreA2_00092d82_Oblivion_R: Emperor Uriel? Do you know something about his death?
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_OblivionGateTopic_0008571a_Oblivi: Emperor, Amulet, and Dragonfire--with these divine gifts, the daedra of Oblivion have been kept at bay for thousands of years.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_INFOGENERAL_0006691a_Oblivion_RES: Emperors have been assassinated before, but this time... I don't know. It's different. Can't you feel it? A shadow has fallen across all of Tamriel.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GREETING_00047647_Oblivion_RESP1: Enchanted to meet you. Delmar, Enchanter Extraordinaire to the Mages Guild! At your service. Got some enchanting in mind?
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_ImperialCityTopic_00047648_Oblivi: Enchanting city. A real eye-full. Just walk and gawk. Stroll along the Greenway and around the Palace.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_MG08Choice1A_00035621_Oblivion_RE: Enchanting staves can be a tricky business. Only certain spells will be truly useful to you, so I'll narrow it down some.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GREETING_0000bedd_Oblivion_RESP1: Enjoy the manor. It suits you well.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_DEMBladeAll_00014e66_AltarDeluxe_: Enjoy the might of Mehrunes. What else do you want?
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_DEMBluntAll_00014e6b_AltarDeluxe_: Enjoy the might of Mehrunes. What else do you want?
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_DEMHeavyArmorAll_00014e7b_AltarDe: Enjoy the might of Mehrunes. What else do you want?
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_DEMLightArmorAll_00014e75_AltarDe: Enjoy the might of Mehrunes. What else do you want?
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_Dark18TraitorTalk_000096e3_Oblivi: Enough! Enough of this! You will all suffer for the pain you have caused me! I will destroy your Night Mother, and the Dark Brotherhood will fall!
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_SE13JyggalagSpeech_00063723_Obliv: Enough! I am beaten. The Greymarch is ended.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_SE07AThadonLeaves_000206bb_Oblivi: Enough! I go to Jyggalag. I give myself to him, as a Priest of Order! This isn't done, Madgod. I think it's just started.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_SE06KanehMirel_00012104_Oblivion_: Enough! I've made my decision. We will attack down the main passage, as planned. The Mazken will not withstand us!
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_SE01HaskillChoice8_000133e7_Obliv: Enter or do not, but make your decision. I've other duties to which I must attend.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_Hit_0008ef77_Oblivion_RESP1: Ergh! What twisted mind spawned these beasts?
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GREETING_000039bc_Oblivion_RESP1: Eridor says I ain't supposed to chat with people in town. Sorry.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_vampirehunters_000039be_Oblivion_: Eridor's the chap in charge. I've talked to him and Shamar; didn't catch the names of the other two. They'll be back around midnight, I think.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_INFOGENERAL_0003aaa0_Oblivion_RES: Erina Jeranus isn't the most social inkeeper in the world, but she runs a good, clean house.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_MG01AdrienneConv_0002d901_Oblivio: Erm, well... yes. I'll just pack up my supplies and be on my way, then. Thank you for sending someone to help me.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_WeynonPrioryTopic_000247ea_Oblivi: Eronor, a lay brother, tends after the sheep and our little farm.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GREETING_00002dc7_Oblivion_RESP1: Err, look. If you're here for information, I'm afraid you'll have to find it on your own. I'm swamped right now; up to my ears in Necromancy.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_INFOGENERAL_0003c237_Oblivion_RES: Erthor is causing trouble at the Mages Guild again. Seems his experiments are always blowing up.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_SE08SheldenGreeting3_00018e6e_Obl: Escort me out of here, protect me, get me home, and those people will praise you more than you can imagine.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_ICAnnouncer_00048386_Oblivion_RES: Esteemed Grand Champion, you may leave the Arena now! See the Blademaster to receive your winnings, and be awarded your Raiment of Valor!
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_HackdirtTopic_00017789_Oblivion_R: Etira, she's the one that found them old books. Learned the runes, how to speak to them again. But they want blood, she says, or they'll not help us.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_INFOGENERAL_000255b9_Oblivion_RES: Eugal Belette is an odd one... and I swear I heard strange noises coming from his basement not long ago.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_INFOGENERAL_0008db8a_Oblivion_RES: Evade the horrid Hunger, the Madgod's favorite pet. If your strength lies in your use of shock, you've just increased its threat.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_SECreatureResponses_0008e12e_Obli: Evade the horrid Hunger, the Madgod's favorite pet. If your strength lies in your use of shock, you've just increased its threat.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_information_00009223_Oblivion_RES: Even I know that some from your guild have defected to join him. I believe you can be trusted, as you have been attacked once already.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_INFOGENERAL_0006032f_Oblivion_RES: Even Sheogorath knows it's not safe here. Probably afraid of the buildings falling in on him.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GREETING_0018d287_Oblivion_RESP1: Even a small bit of good news is refreshing in these grim times. I salute your courage, Savior of Cheydinhal!
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_DEAkDisappearances_00014e21_Altar: Even as we speak, people are disappearing near Anvil and I foresee a terrible threat. One even the gods should fear.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GREETING_00031eb3_Oblivion_RESP1: Even if Farwil doesn't say it, we appreciate that you're here.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_ND06CurseTopic_00002b1c_Knights_R: Even if I am doomed, I still hold out hope that Stendarr will have mercy on me.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_NelsTheNaughtyTopic_00028179_Obli: Even if I do think Nels is the killer, I wouldn't share my thoughts with the likes of you.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_DarMaTopic_000280a5_Oblivion_RESP: Even if I had, why would I know anything about her goin' missing?  Not that I'm saying I ever seen her.  Cause I haven't.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_Creatures_0002b8df_Oblivion_RESP2: Even if it was true, it's out in the forest somewhere. We need to keep what's inside the town walls safe, not go running around outside them.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_INFOGENERAL_0004350d_Oblivion_RES: Even if the Resonator of Judgment is working again, I bet it won't deter Them. I'm still not safe.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_INFOGENERAL_000441cc_Oblivion_RES: Even if you don't agree with the method, you have to respect the hard work it takes to replace a Duchess.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_INFOGENERAL_0005ed59_Oblivion_RES: Even if you don't agree with the method, you have to respect the hard work it takes to replace a Duke.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_HELLO_000a9345_Oblivion_RESP1: Even in its ruined state, it is magnificent, isn't it? In the days of its power, Nenalata must have been glorious indeed.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_SE39Cindanwe_00072c97_Oblivion_RE: Even still, if I don't get my work done... I need to harvest at least five pod pits before the day is done.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_INFOGENERAL_00060539_Oblivion_RES: Even the great Lord Sheogorath forsakes us. The bones are getting louder.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_SE08CommanderGreeting3a_00018c7e_: Even though I have served with these Aureals for centuries, as the Duke of Mania, it is your right to command the troops.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_SE08CommanderGreeting3a_000186fc_: Even though I have served with these Mazken for decades, as the Duke of Dementia, it is your right to command the troops.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_SE34WhyNeed_0008f7b9_Oblivion_RES: Even though I never intend to be a Knight again, that Medallion represents an important part of my past.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_FawilTopic_00059090_Oblivion_RESP: Even though he may be a bit misguided, I'm still proud to call him my son.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GREETING_0003ab33_Oblivion_RESP1: Even though you are the Gray Fox, I'm going to look the other way this time.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_MS27UmbacanoC1_000a6582_Oblivion_: Even to gaze upon it would have been death to anyone of the lesser races in the old days...
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_MS27UmbacanoC2_000a6584_Oblivion_: Even to gaze upon it would have been death to anyone of the lesser races in the old days...
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_INFOGENERAL_00032e5b_Oblivion_RES: Even with the Blackwood Company gone, we still need to work hard to restore the reputation of the guild.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GREETING_0000566f_Oblivion_RESP6: Even worse, you killed the Listener! The Black Hand without a Listener is like a hand with no thumb. Even the Listener's successor is dead!
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_Question_00049945_Oblivion_RESP1: Ever bought enchanting supplies from Calindil?
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_contract_00023e72_Oblivion_RESP1: Ever broken out of jail? How do you feel about breaking into one? The Imperial Prison, to be exact. We need a prisoner... silenced. Can you do it?
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_Question_00049930_Oblivion_RESP1: Ever needed cash in a hurry? You should try Jensine's.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_Fines_0003c29a_Oblivion_RESP1: Ever since Ulrich Leland took over the Captain of the Guard post, this city's gone downhill. It's getting almost scary to walk the streets.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_INFOGENERAL_000a3844_Oblivion_RES: Ever since that gate appeared, the city guards have been on alert. I hope they can protect us.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_SE03ATellMeMore_00018df7_Oblivion: Ever since that wretched Gatekeeper was made, Xedilian became redundant. It fell into disrepair and was eventually all but forgotten.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_AldosOthranTopic_0003c2c2_Oblivio: Ever since then, he's been drunk. Sure, he gets rowdy sometimes, but he's never hurt anyone.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_Question_000498dd_Oblivion_RESP1: Ever spent a night in the Tiber Septim?
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GREETING_0003b970_Oblivion_RESP1: Ever vigilant. That's my motto. They'll sneak up on you. Because they're sneaky. Sneaky fur. Sneaky whiskers.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_SE04ObelisksTopic_0009102d_Oblivi: Ever wonder why flies like both? Best not to ask.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_SE11Dyus1a_0001a815_Oblivion_RESP: Every birth. Every death. The rise of Tiber Septim. The Numidium. Everything. All predicted with the formulae found within Jyggalag's library.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_SE11Dyus1a_000807ae_Oblivion_RESP: Every birth. Every death. The rise of Tiber Septim. The Numidium. Everything. All predicted with the formulae found within Jyggalag's library.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_HELLO_00072e01_Oblivion_RESP1: Every day is like being born. So new and so alive!
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_SQ05RaelynntheGravefinder_0018abd: Every day, it seems the number of undead increase. If someone can get into the cave and kill Raelynn, maybe we can stem the tide.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_TG06PaleLady_0000bd59_Oblivion_RE: Every few days she comes for one of us. Some return, some don't. Those that are taken three times never return.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_SE30ForgeBoots_0001f3cb_Oblivion_: Every girl needs a good pair of shoes.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_MS46OtherOptions_0000ab73_Oblivio: Every goblin tribe is led by a shaman, but she mostly stays hidden in the heart of the lair. Well protected.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GREETING_0009db2c_Oblivion_RESP1: Every last Dark Elf in Bleaker's Way is dead. Such madness... how did it ever start?
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_tasks_00034ea9_Oblivion_RESP2: Every mage carries a staff. It is crafted and enchanted by the guild, and is a symbol of status. You need such a staff.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GREETING_000253b8_Oblivion_RESP1: Every moment that Baenlin draws breath is an affront to Sithis and the Night Mother. Fulfill the contract and honor the Brotherhood as you should.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_NelsTheNaughtyTopic_00028231_Obli: Every now and then he looks over at me and smiles. I think he's sweet on me. If Nels finds the gold, maybe he'll want some company.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_INFOGENERAL_00082608_Oblivion_RES: Every person in Split has been divided into their Manic and Demented halves.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_INFOGENERAL_00082607_Oblivion_RES: Every resident of Split has a double living in the town.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_SE08SheldenGreeting1_00018e6c_Obl: Every time I look for a way out, I get twisted around and end up back here. But I'm too smart for them.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_RosentiaGallenusTopic_0004b7b3_Ob: Every time I pass by that woman's house, I hear odd animal noises and smell a foul odor. Maybe she's caring for some sick pet or something.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GREETING_0008e655_Oblivion_RESP1: Every time I see the Torch shining with the flame of Dementia, I blame you.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_ImperialCityTopic_000b0704_Oblivi: Every time I walk past the Temple, I'll remember that terrible day and how you and Martin delivered us from destruction.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GREETING_0001ebe0_Oblivion_RESP1: Every time it gets quiet, they come back stronger and in greater numbers.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_HELLO_0006dc2c_Oblivion_RESP1: Everybody needs a copy of the Black Horse Courier!
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GREETING_0006dc24_Oblivion_RESP1: Everybody needs a copy of the Black Horse Courier. Imperial Watch raids the waterfront.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GREETING_0018d288_Oblivion_RESP1: Everybody's talking about how you and Captain Burd closed that Oblivion Gate outside town. You're a real hero around here!
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_INFOGENERAL_0018b1ff_Oblivion_RES: Everybody's talking about the Hero of Kvatch! They say he actually went into an Oblivion Gate and destroyed it.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_INFOGENERAL_0018b200_Oblivion_RES: Everybody's talking about the Hero of Kvatch! They say she actually went into an Oblivion Gate and destroyed it.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_INFOGENERAL_00002a26_Knights_RESP: Everybody's talking about the Prophet. After the attack on the Chapel, people are inclined to believe almost anything.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GREETING_0003e08d_Oblivion_RESP1: Everyone calls me Sten the Ugly. I got tired of beating people up for it. So go ahead. Live it up.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_ImperialCityTopic_00047665_Oblivi: Everyone comes to the Big City to buy and sell. Why not? More stores, better selection, better prices.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_INFOGENERAL_00032e2c_Oblivion_RES: Everyone feels sorry for the Fighters Guild, but they can't function without leadership.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_MQ15SavageGarden_00047365_Oblivio: Everyone here died in the Master's service. As the Master promised, we are now immortal, like the daedra.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_MS47WhatHappened_00030038_Oblivio: Everyone in Aleswell suddenly became invisible several weeks ago. It was sort of fun at first, but the novelty has definitely worn off now.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_INFOGENERAL_0003406f_Oblivion_RES: Everyone in Summitmist Manor is dead! There was some kind of party that went horribly awry, or so I hear.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_LeyawiinTopic_00051dcb_Oblivion_R: Everyone in town knows about my hobby... collecting unusual examples of the arcane crafts. My husband left me quite comfortable, bless his cinders.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_TG01JoinThievesGuild_0004f9ed_Obl: Everyone is here. Let's begin. Each of you is seeking membership in the Thieves Guild.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_INFOGENERAL_0004350a_Oblivion_RES: Everyone is talking about that damned Resonator of Judgment -- talking instead of working.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_Idle_0018b5b1_Oblivion_RESP1: Everyone is talking, but no one has anything to say.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_INFOGENERAL_000825e7_Oblivion_RES: Everyone is tired of Brithaur's antics.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_CheydinhalNQDResponses_0003e980_O: Everyone is very fond of Ohtesse. And her healing skills are simply excellent.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_CheydinhalTopic_0018d2fe_Oblivion: Everyone is waiting to see if Farwil and his knights return from inside that dreadful Oblivion Gate. Such brave lads!
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_TG09FathisAren_00015f0d_Oblivion_: Everyone knows he's the court wizard. But I reckon you want to know more. Is it worth a few coins?
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_Announcer_00046666_Oblivion_RESP1: Everyone loves an advancement match, so let's watch as these two brave Myrmidons face off in a battle to the death! Combatants, to arms!
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_INFOGENERAL_00032e6f_Oblivion_RES: Everyone needs to buckle down and get the work done. And Vilena needs to get out and push guild contracts.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GOODBYE_00013343_Oblivion_RESP1: Everyone wants my weapons. But they're my weapons. Mine!
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_TGGrayFox_00015f11_Oblivion_RESP1: Everyone wants to know about the Gray Fox. Gray Fox this, Gray Fox that. He's just a man, not a Daedric lord.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_INFOGENERAL_000af069_Oblivion_RES: Everyone wants to know what really happened in the Temple. What happened to Martin? Was the fiery dragon really Akatosh?
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_Gang_0003d4a1_Oblivion_RESP1: Everyone's making fun of me because I fell for the siren's charms. Well, now I have the last laugh!
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_INFOGENERAL_0018b1fc_Oblivion_RES: Everyone's saying there's trouble in Kvatch. The whole town destroyed. Only a few survivors.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_INFOGENERAL_00043ed1_Oblivion_RES: Everyone's talking about Duke Thadon and his Chalice. How tedious. Don't people understand I have important work to finish?
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_INFOGENERAL_0018b1f5_Oblivion_RES: Everyone's talking about the assassination, of course. Here. Take my copy of the new Black Horse Courier. Go ahead. Keep it.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_INFOGENERAL_000af060_Oblivion_RES: Everyone's talking about the victory over Mehrunes Dagon! I can hardly believe that the great Oblivion Crisis is over.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_DarkSancTalk2_00034049_Oblivion_R: Everyone's talking about your latest exploits. Not only did you eliminate the target, but his six Imperial Legion escorts as well! Most impressive.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_MQWhatNext_0002711f_Oblivion_RESP: Everything else is just buying time for us to get the Amulet of Kings back from Mankar Camoran.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_TG08MothPriestNote_0001474a_Obliv: Everything in that document is true. My identity cannot be known. In fact I just told you my true name twice, but I bet you don't remember it.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GREETING_00060ed5_Oblivion_RESP1: Everything is gone. What a shame.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GREETING_00060ed3_Oblivion_RESP1: Everything is just so... desolate. My inn is ruined and... oh, it's terrible...
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_HELLO_0004d0b0_Oblivion_RESP1: Everything is ready for Martin's arrival, don't worry.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_MS46Goblins_00033efd_Oblivion_RES: Everything was going well. We had set up camp at Cropsford, and it looked like a beautiful spot. Then the goblins attacked.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GREETING_00072dac_Oblivion_RESP1: Ew. You smell worse than that cat, Bhisha. Get away from me!
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_FollowupPositive_00028d8a_Oblivio: Exactly.  Sometimes I think he's following me.  I've tried to talk to him but he always hurries off when he sees me coming.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GREETING_0001bb23_Oblivion_RESP1: Excellent work my friend! All we need is the Brush, and we can leave this place.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GREETING_00003a64_Oblivion_RESP1: Excellent work, my friend. May the manor give you many years of happiness. I'm now off to the Imperial City once more. Farewell!
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_NecromancersMoon_00002dc3_Oblivio: Excellent work. I believe this will be of use to the Council. I shall make sure they're made aware of its contents.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_MQ07ProgressAllDead_00020081_Obli: Excellent work. I knew I could count on you. The gods did not idly choose you as their agent, whatever you may think.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_MQ07ProgressPlans_00020085_Oblivi: Excellent work. I knew I could count on you. The gods did not idly choose you as their agent, whatever you may think.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_DAClavicusSpeech_000243b8_Oblivio: Excellent! A pitiful sword with a pitiful soul in exchange for a Masque fit for a god. You've gotten the better of this bargain, mortal.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_VampireTopic_0001e0cc_Oblivion_RE: Excellent! Another vampire has been slain. Here's your reward.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_MS39Yes_0004e945_Oblivion_RESP1: Excellent! But before you go, you're going to need to learn a bit more about Nirnroot. Otherwise you may walk in circles and never find any.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_HorseBuyBravil_0004d82a_Oblivion_: Excellent! Go out to the corral. Antione will have your new Bay saddled and ready for you.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_MS02ManorBuyChoice1_00003a6e_Obli: Excellent! Here's the key to the front door and the deed of ownership. I hope you enjoy your new home.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_weaponsshipment_000288b1_Oblivion: Excellent! I long to sink a blade into some goblin flesh.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_weaponsshipment_000288b3_Oblivion: Excellent! I long to sink a blade into some goblin flesh.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_weaponsshipment_00028a8f_Oblivion: Excellent! I long to sink a blade into some goblin flesh.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_weaponsshipment_0018abfa_Oblivion: Excellent! I long to sink a blade into some goblin flesh.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_SE39MissionChoice2_00078204_Obliv: Excellent! Let me see that.... A-ha! It's right here. Written in her own hand. She is planning to murder us all. I knew it!
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_Dark01Choice4A_00022ba5_Oblivion_: Excellent! Now please, accept this token from the Dark Brotherhood. It is a virgin blade, and thirsts for blood. May it serve your endeavors well.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_TGPayExpelFine_0001e865_Oblivion_: Excellent! The guild accepts your... apology and welcomes you back into the fold.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_MageTalk3_0006a869_Oblivion_RESP1: Excellent! This is exciting news indeed, magister! Just think of the possible advances in Restoration and Alteration!
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GREETING_00003921_Oblivion_RESP1: Excellent. A fine example of a Daedric shrine. Sorry for the trouble getting here. Let's keep moving.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_TG03accept_00034e9b_Oblivion_RESP: Excellent. Bring it back to me once you have it.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_MS16Choice5A_00028ac8_Oblivion_RE: Excellent. Curiosity should never be denied, is it not so? And who knows, my story may prove profitable to both of us once it has come to its end.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_Dark01FinChoice1A_00023e4b_Oblivi: Excellent. Here is what you must do. Go to the Waterfront District of the Imperial City. There you will find a ship named the Marie Elena.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_SE42YesSell_00073234_Oblivion_RES: Excellent. Here's your money. I should have paid you last week. I'm dreadfully sorry about the delay.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_FGD02Choice6_000b1677_Oblivion_RE: Excellent. Here's your payment. Come back if you find more.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_MS21Interested_0002af2f_Oblivion_: Excellent. Here, take a look at this sketch. The ancient texts refer to this site only as "The High Fane." Do you know it?
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_MG01Choice1A_0002d414_Oblivion_RE: Excellent. I just don't have the time to search for him again, but I do need to consult him about some notes he borrowed.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_MS23RolandDead_0001da70_Oblivion_: Excellent. I knew you wouldn't disappoint the Order. Here's the reward that was promised. However, I must ask that you reveal nothing about us.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_SE14Rez1_0004dcbc_Oblivion_RESP1: Excellent. I'm sure things will go better this time. Good seeing you, Milord.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_BedYes_0003b348_Oblivion_RESP1: Excellent. I'm sure you'll be quite satisfied.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_MG05Choice1A_0001e854_Oblivion_RE: Excellent. It's a simple task, really - all you need to do is fetch a book for me.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_MG05Choice1A_000224e4_Oblivion_RE: Excellent. It's a simple task, really - all you need to do is fetch a book for me.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_BedYes_000b1297_Oblivion_RESP1: Excellent. It's just down the stairs there. The door is impossible to miss. I'm sure you'll sleep very well.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_BedYes_000b1255_Oblivion_RESP1: Excellent. It's up the stairs there, and then directly across the hallway. Center room, wonderful view of the city. Sleep well!
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_MQ05TarMeenaYesBooks_00024e81_Obl: Excellent. Let's see ... yes! The first letter of each paragraph spells out a message!
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_Dark06FinChoice1A_0003005d_Oblivi: Excellent. Now listen closely. Nestled in the mountains to the west lies Fort Sutch. It is the home of the warlord Roderick and his mercenaries.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_BedYes_000b9848_Oblivion_RESP1: Excellent. The room is on the floor upstairs, at the west end of the hall. I do hope you rest well.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_FGJoin1_0002427b_Oblivion_RESP1: Excellent. You are now an Associate in the Fighters Guild. You should report to either Azzan in Anvil or Burz gro-Khash in Cheydinhal for contracts.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_MG11Choice1A_00002dcb_Oblivion_RE: Excellent. You have become most reliable, and I assure you that the Council appreciates it. Now, to the matter at hand.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_TG05Yes_0000a233_Oblivion_RESP1: Excellent. Yours is the last item on the list. Now we just wait for the powers that be to pull the plug on Hieronymus Lex's seige.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_MQ07Spies_0002008d_Oblivion_RESP2: Except for Jearl coming back from a trip down south, things are pretty quiet. Not much travel right now with the Oblivion Crisis.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_SE06GreatTorchTopic_000910a0_Obli: Except it doesn't! It's gone out. Happens every time the Greymarch begins. Which it has.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_SE07SheoIntro3_00082466_Oblivion_: Except where the backbone is an actual backbone. Ever been to Malacath's realm...? Nasty stuff. But, back to the business at hand.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_NDJoinOrderAccept_00002b37_Knight: Excuse me while I gather the equipment I need.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_NDJoinOrderAccept_00002b3b_Knight: Excuse me while I go the armory and attire myself as befits a Knight of the Nine.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_HELLO_0003402c_Oblivion_RESP1: Excuse me, Brother. Can you spare a moment?
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GOODBYE_0007ac79_Oblivion_RESP1: Excuse me, I have important things to do.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GREETING_00073025_Oblivion_RESP1: Excuse me, I must have nodded off there.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_HELLO_0003402d_Oblivion_RESP1: Excuse me, Sister. Can you spare a moment?
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_TimeToGo_0002a51d_Oblivion_RESP1: Excuse me, but you have to leave now. I need to lock up.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_HELLO_0006a84a_Oblivion_RESP1: Excuse me, fellow magister. Is now a good time to talk?
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_HELLO_00089932_Oblivion_RESP1: Excuse me, may I have a moment of your time?
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_HELLO_0008152c_Oblivion_RESP1: Excuse me, my lord. I need to clean right where you're standing.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GREETING_000adc4a_Oblivion_RESP1: Excuse me, the Empire doesn't run itself, you know. Submit a complaint to the usual department and I'm sure someone will take care of it.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GREETING_000aa08d_Oblivion_RESP1: Excuse me. Can I help you? Are you looking for Prior Maborel? Or Jauffre?
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_HELLO_000410a1_Oblivion_RESP1: Excuse me. I need to sweep right where you're standing.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GREETING_00028861_Oblivion_RESP1: Excuse me. I need to take these people to the encampment.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GOODBYE_00071fad_Oblivion_RESP1: Excuse me. I see something I need to clean.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_BravilTopic_0004891e_Oblivion_RES: Excuse me. I stay to myself. I have always found the wrong sort of friends. Now I do without.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GREETING_0004763a_Oblivion_RESP1: Excuse me. I'm Irlav Jarol, a researcher for Arcane University. Ayleids are my specialty.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_HELLO_00068340_Oblivion_RESP1: Excuse me. If you have a moment, I would speak with you.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_PakseechTopic_000479cc_Oblivion_R: Excuse me. In the Imperial tongue, it means, roughly, 'clan chair' -- the seat of the clan patriarch.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GREETING_00024c7a_Oblivion_RESP1: Excuse me. My name is Angalmo. Can I help you?
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GREETING_00047767_Oblivion_RESP1: Excuse me. Perhaps you're an adventurer? Could you assist me in acquiring something for my crystal collection?
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GREETING_00030032_Oblivion_RESP1: Excuse me. We have a small problem that we hope you can help us with.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_MatildePetitTopic_00028c2b_Oblivi: Excuse me? You want to question me about Matilde? Two people have been murdered, you fool! Get your priorities straight!
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_BlackSoulGemMG17_000151f9_Oblivio: Exercise caution when approaching the ruins; the Necromancers control that area and you may inadvertently expose your allies' position.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GREETING_00073021_Oblivion_RESP1: Exercise your mind and body through working hard, each and every moment.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GOODBYE_00189cfa_Oblivion_RESP1: Exhausted Mine is not far to the southeast. Be careful, its many twists and turns hide the Goblin hordes.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_BlackBrugoTopic_00090b6a_Oblivion: Expect Brugo and his boys in Telepe, Middas, after midnight.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_MQ03MartinA1_00082dc6_Oblivion_RE: Explain yourself or leave me alone. There are many others here who actually need your help.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_EyeofNocturnalTOPIC_00026ab5_Obli: Eye of Nocturnal? Doesn't sound familiar to me.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_SE07BThadonDeathSpeech04_0007b37c: Eyes as blue as a cerulean sea...uhh...what...
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_TestToddHappy_00027fa2_Oblivion_R: Fabulous! That's great. Good for you!
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_INFOGENERAL_0003c22c_Oblivion_RES: Fadus Calidius sure can use a shield. I've never seen him take a hit!
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_SkingradTopic_00038ad6_Oblivion_R: Fadus Calidus at the Fighters Guild also teaches Block, but he'd be the first to admit I'm his superior in every way.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_FaelianTopic_0002ff10_Oblivion_RE: Faelian used to have money... used to be quite a gentleman, too. But that was before he took a fancy to the... you know. The skooma.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_FaelianTopic_0004cf8a_Oblivion_RE: Faelian, you say? Why yes, I know who he is. Rather distasteful fellow, actually. I believe he lives at the Tiber Septim Hotel.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_FaelianTopic_0004cf8b_Oblivion_RE: Faelian, you say? Why yes, I know who he is. Rather distasteful fellow, actually. I believe he lives at the Tiber Septim Hotel.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_FaelianTopic_0002ff0b_Oblivion_RE: Faelian, you say? Why yes, I know who he is. Rather distasteful fellow, actually. I believe he lives right here, at the Tiber Septim Hotel.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_FaelianTopic_0002ff12_Oblivion_RE: Faelian? He... he's my sweet. My true love. But I don't know why I'm telling this to you. I mean, we hardly know each other and all...
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_FaelianTopic_00003887_Oblivion_RE: Faelian? Hey, that's my name! Yeah. I'm Faelian.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_FaelianTopic_0002ff10_Oblivion_RE: Faelian? Oh, I know him all right! A waste of life, that one. He lives here you know, with his sweetheart, Atraena.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_FaelianTopic_0002ff0c_Oblivion_RE: Faelian? Yes, I know who he is. But I'm really not in the habit of discussing such things with strangers...
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_TG09BribeBeggar_00015f1f_Oblivion: Fair enough. Fathis is also the wizard in the tower southeast of town. He keeps his most treasured items there, not in the castle.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_TG04NoBribeBeggar_000092e4_Oblivi: Fair enough. He left town yesterday. I heard he was going to... uh, Anvil. Yeah, that's right. No need to go lookin' for him. He's gone.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_Dark07MercConvo_00045f8d_Oblivion: Faith? Are you telling me we're supposed to rely on the good graces of the Divines to keep Roderick alive? Even he would laugh at such nonsense!
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_Recommendation_000175b6_Oblivion_: Falcar always has been pretty harsh, even when it comes to basic lessons. He seems to have gotten worse lately, though.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_INFOGENERAL_0004872f_Oblivion_RES: Falcar at the Mages Guild seems to be angry all the time. I avoid him when I can.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_ShadeoftheRevenant_0000357d_Obliv: Falcar did leave this behind; I think it fell from his notes as he left. I didn't pay it much attention, but perhaps it will be of use to you.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_Recommendation_0002d2e4_Oblivion_: Falcar gives out the strangest assignments sometimes. It's as if he doesn't really care about them.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_VidkunTopic_0002e998_Oblivion_RES: Falcar must have known, and yet he said nothing. How could he allow this to happen?
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_ShadeoftheRevenant_0000357d_Obliv: Falcar was here some time ago, asking about just such a thing. Said it was for research. He had a large sheaf of notes with him about it.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_Flee_0005c014_Oblivion_RESP1: Fall back to the city before it's too late!
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_SE08CommanderBattle01_0005249b_Ob: Fall back! Mazken! Retreat! Fall back to the town center! Now! Now! MOVE!
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_SE34Yes_00066ef4_Oblivion_RESP1: Fantastic! I will mark Fetid Grove on your map. Good luck to you, friend!
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_ElixirofExploration_0004e92c_Obli: Fantastic! You actually found 10 of the Nirnroot. I'll begin making the Elixir of Exploration right away.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_SE38OddityDonate_00079f56_Oblivio: Fantastic. I can't tell you what it means to me to have this in my collection. You are a good soul.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_BravilTopic_00048903_Oblivion_RES: Far be it from me to criticize my patron and sovereign. Bravil obviously flourishes under his wise and beneficent rule.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_MS27HerminiaB1_000a5601_Oblivion_: Far from it. His interest in the Ayleids is not that of a mere scholar. He hopes to unlock the secrets of their magical power.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_contract_0003005c_Oblivion_RESP1: Far to the west there lives a fierce warlord and his company of loyal mercenaries. Your target is the warlord. Do you accept this contract?
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_NDPelinalVisionSpeech_00002ab8_Kn: Fare thee well, sir knight. May the gods grant you to destroy Umaril utterly, as I failed to do.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GOODBYE_00002db0_Oblivion_RESP1: Farewell! And tell your friends! The Inn of Ill Omen is open for business, as always!
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GOODBYE_00022a0c_Oblivion_RESP1: Farewell, and be careful, Kurdan is not to be trusted.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_MS13StaffofIndarys_00031c97_Obliv: Farewell, and may Arkay guide you.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_MS13ThornbladeTopic_00031c96_Obli: Farewell, and may Arkay guide you.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GOODBYE_0004f9bf_Oblivion_RESP1: Farewell, and may you find your way home safely each night to a warm fire.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GOODBYE_0006a84c_Oblivion_RESP1: Farewell, magister. May your spells never falter.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GOODBYE_000236ee_Oblivion_RESP1: Farewell, my friend. May your blade always strike true. And first. He he.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_MQ15RitualReady_00027e44_Oblivion: Farewell, my friend. Our fate is in your hands. Bring back the Amulet of Kings.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GOODBYE_0001e7d3_Oblivion_RESP1: Farewell. May the roads carry you safely in your journeys.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GOODBYE_0008f10d_Oblivion_RESP1: Farewell. So much to bake, so little time!
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GREETING_0008e11f_Oblivion_RESP3: Farewell. You've been a good friend, in the short time that I've known you.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_INFOGENERAL_00066cd0_Oblivion_RES: Farwil Indarys almost got himself killed in Cheydinhal. Here. Take my Black Horse Courier. It's all in there.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_FawilTopic_00031844_Oblivion_RESP: Farwil is a Dunmer, and he's wearing steel plate armor. His shield should bear the crest of the Knights. Nothing but the best for the Count's son.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_ValusOdiilTopic_000b6c10_Oblivion: Father will be so proud of us... but I wish he'd been here.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_MS18Convo_0002b1c9_Oblivion_RESP1: Father's not scared - don't you dare say that! You'll see when he gets here. I'll ask him, and then you'll see!
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_PickpocketNoCrime_00098389_Oblivi: Fathis Aren's pockets are not for you, thief!
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GREETING_000476b4_Oblivion_RESP1: Fathis Ules. I've got a nice house. I have a little income... quite comfortable. Time is light on my hands.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GOODBYE_00084b3e_Oblivion_RESP1: Fear not, our paths may cross again.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_INFOGENERAL_0008db86_Oblivion_RES: Fear the woody Gnarl, the tree that walks and creeps. If you strike them with a spell, the magic it will keep.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_SECreatureResponses_0008e10f_Obli: Fear the woody Gnarl, the tree that walks and creeps. If you strike them with a spell, the magic it will keep.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_SE09BodyParts_0001357a_Oblivion_R: Fearing one day someone might manage to kill my child, I have been preparing a new body.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_SEDerveninSpeech03_000898f3_Obliv: Feast until your belly is full, then fill the wine goblets once more and toast our fortune.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GREETING_000bf16b_Oblivion_RESP1: Feeding time is over, vampire! Go back to the grave that spawned you!
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GREETING_0001671c_Oblivion_RESP1: Feel free to browse, friend. It's nice to see a new shopper. I was afraid I lost any hope of new business ever since Thoronir opened up.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GOODBYE_00038f25_Oblivion_RESP1: Feel free to question anyone in town, they shouldn't give you too much trouble.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GREETING_0007cfdf_Oblivion_RESP1: Feel free to take what you need. The fruits of the conservatory are for all to enjoy.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_MQ05Gwinas_00022b46_Oblivion_RESP: Feel free to wait for him if you want to speak to him yourself.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_PowerAttack_00098388_Oblivion_RES: Feel the wrath of my ancestors!
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_INFOGENERAL_000c47de_Oblivion_RES: Feet are for walking. Hands are for hitting. Or shaking. Or waving. Sometimes for clapping.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GREETING_000181bb_Oblivion_RESP3: Felas and I slipped down here thinking that we'd be safe. But, no! We landed right in the middle of them!
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GREETING_000181bb_Oblivion_RESP4: Felas ran off with them and left me to die! Me! That ingrate! Disloyal cur! Imagine, leaving me here all alone!
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_SEFelldew_000206f8_Oblivion_RESP2: Felldew is a poison, little one. A very dangerous drug. You'll feel good at first, but that wears off, and if you go long without it, you'll suffer.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_SEChaliceofReversal_00018b7b_Obli: Felldew is a poison. It kills. And yet Thadon uses the Chalice he created to twist Felldew into a drug he takes for his own amusement. How sick.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_SE14Attacks_0004681e_Oblivion_RES: Fellmoor can still use your assistance, assuming you can find time in your schedule.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_INFOGENERAL_0008dc2a_Oblivion_RES: Fellmoor must be a lovely place to live. You should visit there, right away.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_INFOGENERAL_000825f4_Oblivion_RES: Fellmoor must be a terrible place to live.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_HELLO_00033586_Oblivion_RESP1: Fellow Knight! I bid you welcome.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_HELLO_00069477_Oblivion_RESP1: Fellow magister, may I speak with you?
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GREETING_00066eb9_Oblivion_RESP1: Fetid Grove is a dangerous place... please be cautious.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_SE06ArctusGreetA_00040144_Oblivio: Few know that the Hero who lights the Torch for Dementia is granted the Raiment of Intrigue, a boon for those who would gain access to hidden knowledge.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_SE04GreymarchTopic_00091020_Obliv: Few of the citizens can remember the last Greymarch. Or they choose not to.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_ArcaneULecture5_00071960_Oblivion: Few records survive from the Dark Ages of the Potentates. Thus might the secrets of the runestones be lost... in wickedness, vainglory, and neglect.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_ImperialCityTopic_00047685_Oblivi: Fighters Guild has no accommodations in town. Mages Guild members have their own quarters at the Arcane University.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_INFOGENERAL_00032e48_Oblivion_RES: Fighters Guild is still better for sensitive jobs, and you know it.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_INFOGENERAL_0003e24d_Oblivion_RES: Fighters Guild members have been going to Sherina to learn blade skills. She's good, and she'll be the first to tell you so.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_jointheBlackwoodCompany_000a5652_: Fighters Guild, aren't you? Done many jobs for them recently. Yes. What makes you want to join us?
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GREETING_0004e88a_Oblivion_RESP3: Fighting is fine with me, too, only the Guard objects, and they'll fine you or lock you up. Not my call.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_INFOGENERAL_000624c5_Oblivion_RES: Fighting's easy. Just lead them out on the water and shoot them full of holes. If you've got a bow, of course, and can walk on water.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_FGD02Insults_0002cfd3_Oblivion_RE: Filthy Orc! I smell you from here!
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_goblins_000288b7_Oblivion_RESP1: Filthy animals. Some of my kinsmen are partial to them, but I find them reprehensible.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_Dark04DrethConvo_00045f82_Oblivio: Filthy cur! I told you I was going to get out of here! My time's almost up, and there's nothing you can do about it.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_Pickpocket_00062273_Oblivion_RESP: Filthy pickpocket! What did you take?
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_TG06PaleLady_00015321_Oblivion_RE: Filthy vampire! She took my cellmate Theranis a few days ago. If it hadn't been for you, I would have been next.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GOODBYE_00071fa7_Oblivion_RESP1: Fimmion gone. Bye bye. Go find pumpkin.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GREETING_00071f2f_Oblivion_RESP1: Fimmion hungry. Got food? Sweetcakes? Sausages?
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_SE44FimmionChoice3_0007877d_Obliv: Fimmion hungry. Sweetroll for Fimmion. Pants for you.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_SE44PantsFimmion_0007877a_Oblivio: Fimmion hungry. Want sweetroll. Fimmion like pants. Love sweetroll.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_SE44FimmionChoice2_0007877c_Obliv: Fimmion sad. Want sweetroll. No pants for you. Fimmion hungry.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_SE46DoublesTopic_0008fa83_Oblivio: Finally killed him, huh? Thanks. It would have been a lot of effort to find someone else to do it. You've got more to get rid of, though.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_DAClavicusChoice4_00026b17_Oblivi: Finally signed on with some mercenaries, but I hear that ended, too. We haven't seen her in years.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_DAClavicusChoice6_00026b19_Oblivi: Finally signed on with some mercenaries, but I hear that ended, too. We haven't seen her in years.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GREETING_00016720_Oblivion_RESP1: Finally! A new customer! Please... look around. Just promise me you won't buy from that fetcher, Thoronir.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_NDTalk3_00002bb8_Knights_RESP1: Finally! A purpose worth fighting for! In truth, I long for righteous battle!  When do we set out? What's our strategy?
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_CastleResidents_000038ba_Oblivion: Finally, I would try speaking to Orok gro-Ghoth who is my Steward. He resides in the Private Quarters section as well.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_HELLO_00068853_Oblivion_RESP1: Finally, I'll be able to retire.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GREETING_00018c6b_Oblivion_RESP1: Finally, Lord Sheogorath has sent someone to assist me!
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_INFOGENERAL_000607b7_Oblivion_RES: Finally, all this mess is sorted out. I can get back to my work. Oh, I've lost so much time.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_ND07LathonGreetA2_00002b86_Knight: Finally, he found what he was looking for. We went to Underpall Cave, and there... he fell.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GOODBYE_0003160f_Oblivion_RESP1: Finally, no need to sleep with an eye open.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_INFOGENERAL_0006094f_Oblivion_RES: Finally, some peace and quiet around here... now I can get some serious work done.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_MG05Choice2A_0001e852_Oblivion_RE: Finally. I shall see to it that the book is kept safe until the Council decides what should be done with it.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GOODBYE_0003c9d4_Oblivion_RESP1: Finally... back to the real world.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_BlackBrugoTopic_000908d9_Oblivion: Find Black Brugo, and execute him for his crimes, and I will make both you and your friend Mazoga Knights-Errant of the White Stallion.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_TrainingQuestTopic_000613a6_Obliv: Find Marana Rian in the Imperial City. She can teach you what you wish to know.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_TrainingQuestTopic_0018d88c_Obliv: Find Olyn Seran. Look for him at a Daedric Shrine; that's where he probably is.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_TrainingQuestTopic_00062452_Obliv: Find Tandilwe at the Temple of the One in the Imperial City. She can train you further.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GREETING_00054824_Oblivion_RESP4: Find him, and close shut the jaws of Oblivion.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_jobs_0002c7b9_Oblivion_RESP1: Find ingredients for Margarte, huh? Works for me. I'll let the other men know. Appreciate your help, friend. And Oreyn should be happy.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_SE02BoneArrowsChoice_0003ea9c_Obl: Find me in a few hours. We'll kill the Gatekeeper.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_SE30Matrices_0001e696_Oblivion_RE: Find me one of these matrices and enough Amber, and I will craft you a magical item.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_MG14Choice1A_0000a0fd_Oblivion_RE: Find out if Jeanne is all right, and let me know if she needs anything.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_TG10HelpGF_0001530d_Oblivion_RESP: Find out where Springheel Jak is buried and bring me back those boots. Will you do this for me? It pays well.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_ServicetoLeyawiinTopic_000860b5_O: Find out why she is here, and report to me, and you will earn a reward suitable for those who serve Leyawiin.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GOODBYE_000175bf_Oblivion_RESP1: Find someone else to bother, won't you?
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_SE45ForkTopic_00078782_Oblivion_R: Find the Fork! Bring it to Big-Head! Sing it to Big-Head!
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GREETING_00002975_Knights_RESP1: Find the Priestesses of Kynareth. Only they can guide you to the boots. All I can do is set you on the path.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GREETING_00089938_Oblivion_RESP3: Find the Sigil Stone. Remove it, and the Gate will close! Hurry! The Keeper has the key-- you must get the key!
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GOODBYE_000327b6_Oblivion_RESP1: Find the fugitives. Make yourself useful.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GREETING_0001e6fd_Oblivion_RESP4: Find the last of my blood, and close shut the marble jaws of Oblivion.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_MQ05TarMeenaB_00022b42_Oblivion_R: Find them, eh? I won't poke my nose any further. Official business and all that. I'm used to working with the Blades, don't worry. Say no more.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_DAMeridiaSpeech_000579ba_Oblivion: Find these necromancers. Destroy them and their abominations. Do this, and earn the gratitude of Meridia.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_DANocturnalSpeech_00084a4d_Oblivi: Find these thieves in the city that spans the waters. Learn where they hide my Eye.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_ArenaAgronakChoice3_00038ed3_Obli: Find this proof and return it to me, and I'll share with you some of my finest combat techniques. Trust me, you can't learn these moves in a book!
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_ArenaAgronakChoice4_00038ed7_Obli: Find this proof and return it to me, and I'll share with you some of my finest combat techniques. Trust me, you can't learn these moves in a book!
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_SE05Conspiracy_000895e7_Oblivion_: Find those who plot against me. Bring them to me so I might make an example of them.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GOODBYE_0002c308_Oblivion_RESP1: Finding that book should be your top priority, Associate.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_JeanneFrasoricTopic_000836cb_Obli: Finding ways to confuse her just never gets old for me. It's good practice of our skills too. But it's mostly just funny.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_FGJoin2_00024285_Oblivion_RESP1: Fine by me. No great loss. Let me know if you change your mind, though. We can always use fresh meat.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_SQ09Leave_00066f2e_Oblivion_RESP1: Fine then. I'll find someone else. Someone who isn't too busy to help a desperate old man.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_MS45Wait_00028695_Oblivion_RESP1: Fine, but don't be gone too long.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_SE44NothingMore_0007876f_Oblivion: Fine, but hurry back when you do! It's coming soon. I can tell!
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_FGD07Choice1_000356e1_Oblivion_RE: Fine, fine. I'll come with you. My guards are dead. You win, for now.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_INFOGENERAL_000607ef_Oblivion_RES: Fine, fine. So the Realm still stands. That doesn't mean there are any fewer Scalons in the Isles.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_MS04Here2_0003d30b_Oblivion_RESP1: Fine, then best be on your way.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_MS08KurdanBoatNo_0001f42f_Oblivio: Fine. But you better not take too long. I want that axe, and I want it now.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_FGD02Choice4_000b1674_Oblivion_RE: Fine. Here's your money. Let me know if you find more.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_MS08KurdanBoatYes_0001f430_Oblivi: Fine. I have it waitin' for you at the dock next to the magic shop. Now get outta my sight.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_SE01HaskillChoice9_0005e371_Obliv: Fine. I'm sure my Lord will be most pleased, assuming you ever manage to see Him.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_SE09AssistanceCommand_0001356e_Ob: Fine. If it be my Lord's will, then it is also my own. But, I am too distraught over the death of my child to return to his womb. This, you must do.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_SE08SheldenEnd_00043f71_Oblivion_: Fine. Just leave me here to die. Not like anyone will miss me.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_BedNo_0005dac2_Oblivion_RESP1: Fine. One less thing for me to clean up afterwards.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_MS38DionneWarnChoice2_0001dcc3_Ob: Fine. Play it that way. Let me give you some friendly advice. Glarthir is crazy. Maybe harmless crazy, maybe not.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_BedYes_0009ea94_Oblivion_RESP1: Fine. Take the stairs up to the right, the room on the left. No visitors allowed. And no pets.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_FGJoin1_0002427c_Oblivion_RESP1: Fine. You are now an Associate in the Fighters Guild. For contracts, speak either with me or with Burz gro-Khash in Cheydinhal. Good luck to you.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_FGD07Choice5_0009819e_Oblivion_RE: Fine. You don't scare me. Beat me, torture me. I'll never talk to you.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_duties_0002c7c0_Oblivion_RESP1: Fine. You know what's wrong. How about you go and fix it? NOW!!!
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_MS29ShadyDeal_0001e7ee_Oblivion_R: Fine. You made your point. Contact me when you have the items, and we'll meet again.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_FGC01Choice2_0003663d_Oblivion_RE: Fine. You've got me. I figured if I left some rotten meat outside, the nasty little things would come out, and the guards would take care of them.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_MG06Choice1B_000302d4_Oblivion_RE: Fine. Your loss though, isn't it? Can't get that recommendation you need.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_MS43ScampsNo_0004f78d_Oblivion_RE: Fine... just get out... I can take care of myself!
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GOODBYE_00018c8f_Oblivion_RESP1: Finish what you've started, friend. It'll do wonders for you.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GREETING_0007ac6e_Oblivion_RESP1: Firm arms. A strong back. Yes. You'd do nicely. It's a shame. Time will ravage you, destroy you. Whither you. But there are... alternatives.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_Attack_000363db_Oblivion_RESP1: First I'll kill you. Then I'll get Ruslan and Luronk. You'll all pay for what you did to me.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GREETING_00025e14_Oblivion_RESP1: First a theft, and now a murder. Your crimes are escalating. You have one final chance. Go out and collect the horns of twenty minotaurs.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_MS29StopAgarmir_0001d047_Oblivion: First and foremost, I will never meet with him again. I can promise you that. Secondly, I remember him mentioning a place he had to be this very day.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_Idle_0018b587_Oblivion_RESP1: First the vision. Then the conjuration. This is unsettling.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_CharGenTaunt2_0003333f_Oblivion_R: First they starve you. Then they beat you. Then, if you're lucky, they kill you. That's right. You're going to die in here!
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_NDTalk4_00002bbf_Knights_RESP1: First things first, fellow knight. We prepare a feast! To celebrate our divine duty, and say farewell to those we would leave behind.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GREETING_00025e18_Oblivion_RESP1: First you murder, now you steal? Have you gone mad? You're a disgrace. I will offer you one final chance.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_CGBaurusD_0001e8e9_Oblivion_RESP1: First you need to get out of here. Through that door must be the entrance to the sewers, past the locked gate. That's where we were heading.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_ArcaneULecture1_00071940_Oblivion: First, all rune-marked ancient stones are called runestones, though there are, in fact, two very different classes of runestones.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_TGRules_0001c154_Oblivion_RESP1: First, never steal from another member of the guild.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_SE09CeremonyStart_00014aec_Oblivi: First, place the Gatekeeper's body into the Cistern of Substantiation.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_SE09Ceremony_0007b152_Oblivion_RE: First, place the Gatekeeper's body into the Cistern of Substantiation.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_MazogaTalk03_0008656f_Oblivion_RE: Fisherman's Rock is north of Leyawiin, about six hours walk, on a point of land on the eastern shore of the Niben.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_MG12FithragaerWho_00095025_Oblivi: Fithragaer. Battlemage. Sent by the Council to find this traitor....
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GREETING_00023e0f_Oblivion_RESP1: Five of the afternoon watch, and all's well. No problems, ma'am.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GREETING_00023eb3_Oblivion_RESP1: Five of the afternoon watch, and all's well. No problems, sir.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GREETING_00023e1e_Oblivion_RESP1: Five of the night watch, and all's well. You're out late, ma'am.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GREETING_00023ee7_Oblivion_RESP1: Five of the night watch, and all's well. You're out late, sir.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GREETING_0003c98e_Oblivion_RESP1: Fjotreid. You need armor or weapons, new or repair, come to Hammer and Axe.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_SE11SheogorathChoice1_00014b69_Ob: Flee while you can, mortal. When we next meet I will not know you, and I will slay you like the others.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_INFOGENERAL_00077c41_Oblivion_RES: Flesh Atronachs are dangerous. Some are smart enough to heal themselves when they're hurt.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_HELLO_0003c342_Oblivion_RESP1: Flyyyin'... flyyin' in the skyyyy.... cliff racer flys so high.... flyinnn'...
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_INFOGENERAL_000ace65_Oblivion_RES: Folks think we're all evil? What do they know? Do I look evil?
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GREETING_00091881_Oblivion_RESP2: Follow Wide-Eye. I think she mentioned an errand she runs? That would be your best bet.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_Attack_0006b828_Oblivion_RESP1: Follow me! The Temple is our only hope!
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GREETING_00019fc4_Oblivion_RESP1: Follow me! You are deserving to bear witness to Ciirta's destruction!
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GREETING_00002936_Knights_RESP1: Follow me, if you also seek the divine wisdom of Julianos. His Wayshrine is this way.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_DovesiDranTopic_00028d34_Oblivion: Follow me, my friend, and watch my back. Dovesi must be brought to justice, and I'm the one to do it! Let's go!
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GOODBYE_00095890_Oblivion_RESP1: Follow me. I know how to get to the part of the sewers where we need to meet the Sponsor.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GREETING_00002993_Knights_RESP1: Follow me. Lord Vlindrel's tomb is just through here. Be careful... the wraith may be upon us at any moment.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_CropsfordTopic_00033ef8_Oblivion_: Follow the Yellow Road northwest from here. You'll see the supplies they had to abandon when the goblins attacked.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_NDPilgrimageTopic_00002a9a_Knight: Follow the map I gave you. Visit the Wayshrines of the Nine, pray, and wait for a sign.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_NDPilgrimageTopic_00002a9b_Knight: Follow the map I gave you. Visit the Wayshrines of the Nine, pray, and wait for a sign.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GREETING_00035672_Oblivion_RESP5: Follow the road west out of Skingrad, through the High Pasture. The mine entrance is north of the road. The Count will meet you just outside it.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_SE11KnifePointHollow_00014b5f_Obl: Follow the setting sun to the border of Mania. Climb the cliff there to the top. At the peak, you will find Knifepoint Hollow.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_SE11Dyus1b_0001a816_Oblivion_RESP: Following each cycle of the Greymarch, Sheogorath has cast out or killed every aspect of Order found in the Shivering Isles.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_SE11Dyus1b_000807ad_Oblivion_RESP: Following each cycle of the Greymarch, Sheogorath has cast out or killed every aspect of Order found in the Shivering Isles.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_HELLO_000206b7_Oblivion_RESP1: Fool! Did you wish to have us both put to death?
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_Attack_0003faf1_Oblivion_RESP1: Fool! I am no effete noble!
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_TG03LexMyvryna_000352a7_Oblivion_: Fool! You've just exposed me to the Thieves Guild. That "citizen" is actually the guild member that was hired to do the theft!
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_Seen_0001a7fd_Oblivion_RESP1: Fool. Order cannot be stopped. Already the heart of this realm flows with my Lord's power.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_SE07BSylLeaves_0003b822_Oblivion_: Fool? Visionary! Change is in the air, Syl. Breathe it deep! Bathe in its scent! Bottle it up. Save some for later.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_SE07AThadonLeaves_000206c2_Oblivi: Fool? Visionary! Change is in the air, Thadon. Breathe it deep! Bathe in its scent! Bottle it up. Save some for later.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_INFOGENERAL_0004351c_Oblivion_RES: Foolish adventurers are being pulled into the Resonator of Judgment.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_Dark18NightConvo_000096e2_Oblivio: Foolish little girl. Lucien Lachance served Sithis til his dying breath. The Black Hand remains tainted by betrayal. Restoration is impossible.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GREETING_0005d509_Oblivion_RESP1: Fools must be separated from their illusions before they will come to Him.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GREETING_000b97df_Oblivion_RESP2: For 150 gold and a roof over my head, I'm yours.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_INFOGENERAL_00032eb6_Oblivion_RES: For a really good sword, try 'A Fighting Chance' in the Imperial City.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_TrainingQuestTopic_000613be_Obliv: For advanced training, seek out Oleta. She serves Akatosh at his temple in Kvatch. She can teach you all you need to know.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_ArenaBettingTopic_0002ada1_Oblivi: For each fight, you can bet 25, 50 or 100 gold pieces. You can bet as many times as you want per day, within the hours of 9:00 AM and 9:00 PM.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GOODBYE_00002db5_Oblivion_RESP1: For everyone's sake, would you just leave? Now?
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_contract_00003460_Oblivion_RESP3: For example, this one time, I had a contract to kill a little Nord girl at her birthday party. She asked me if I was the jester!
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_MG11ChoiceExplain_00033540_Oblivi: For example, why was Falcar -- who we know now to be part of this cult of Necromancers -- in possession of Black Soul Gems?
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_contract_000253e3_Oblivion_RESP1: For giving you this contract, Ocheeva is wise beyond her years. You will fail in your task, and die in the process.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GREETING_0008e4c0_Oblivion_RESP3: For instance, you can only really see the bones when you take them out.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_SE09Gardens_00013570_Oblivion_RES: For many years, I labored painstakingly in those Gardens, until my back bent and my soul became crooked.
