ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_BlackheartsRing_0002c674_Oblivion: Get the ring for me. We'll need it as proof.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_weaponsshipment_00027f8f_Oblivion: Get the weapons to the other men. Then we'll take care of the goblins.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_MG18Choice1A_00016482_Oblivion_RE: Get to him any way you can. It is your only hope for defeating him.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_HELLO_0006dc2b_Oblivion_RESP1: Get yer Black Horse Courier here!
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_FGD02Insults_0002cfcb_Oblivion_RE: Get your men out of here!
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GREETING_00035f40_Oblivion_RESP1: Get yourself to Vahtacen, and see if you can help Skaleel with whatever is holding up her progress.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GuardTalk1_0006fdd0_Oblivion_RESP: Getting hungry, and could do with a drink. But I'm still sharp, don't you worry.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GREETING_000488c1_Oblivion_RESP1: Gilgondorin. Silverhome-on-the-Water has beds and food. What's your pleasure?
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_INFOGENERAL_00046594_Oblivion_RES: Gilgondrin inherited Silverhome from his parents. I understand he only runs it out of a sense of duty.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GREETING_0003e967_Oblivion_RESP1: Gimme the skooma! Don't hold out on me. I know you have it!
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_SECaldanaMonriusSkoomaYes_0008f78: Give it here! Give it here!
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_ND07LathonGreetF1_00002b75_Knight: Give me a moment to arm myself and I will accompany you to Underpall Cave to destroy the foul wraith.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_CureforVampirism_000977d7_Oblivio: Give me twenty-four hours. I shall have the potion ready for you then.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GREETING_0001f146_Oblivion_RESP4: Give me your possessions, and put on this initiate's robe.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GOODBYE_000343f4_Oblivion_RESP1: Give my warm regards to Baurus. Tell him he should not blame himself for the Emperor's death. He did well to send you to me.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_SECreatureResponses_0008e7ae_Obli: Give them gargen to emeet with.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_TG11WhatNow_00022e1e_Oblivion_RES: Give this ring to Countess Umbranox in Anvil. Say nothing about me to her. I need to know how she reacts to it. It may provoke anger or tears.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GREETING_00028874_Oblivion_RESP1: Give those weapons to the men, and let's get moving.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GREETING_0003e080_Oblivion_RESP1: Give yourself to love, pilgrim. I'm Trevaia, priestess of Dibella, and this is Anvil's Chapel of Dibella.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_SE11Dyus_00014b53_Oblivion_RESP6: Given our unusual circumstances, I have asked you to seek out his aid. He is all that remains of Jyggalag's great library.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_SE10LetsGo_00016bb9_Oblivion_RESP: Given the need for swift action, the normal customs shall need to be overlooked for now. We shall be right behind you, Your Grace.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_SE10LetsGo_00017d12_Oblivion_RESP: Given the need for swift action, the normal customs shall need to be overlooked for now. We shall be right behind you, Your Grace.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_SE10LetsGo_00017d13_Oblivion_RESP: Given the need for swift action, the normal customs shall need to be overlooked for now. We shall be right behind you, Your Grace.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_SE10LetsGo_00017d14_Oblivion_RESP: Given the need for swift action, the normal customs shall need to be overlooked for now. We shall be right behind you, Your Grace.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_UlrichLelandTopic_0003c351_Oblivi: Given the opportunity, I think Ulrich would have had me killed. I'm not sorry for what I've done, but I don't wish to be revered as a hero either.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_RewardTopic_000a3df4_Oblivion_RES: Given your present condition, the main gift I would offer is useless. I can, however, offer you a monetary reward for your troubles.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GlarthirTopic_00028d69_Oblivion_R: Gives me the strangest looks, now that you mention it.  Almost like he hates me, although I have no idea why.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_INFOGENERAL_00043511_Oblivion_RES: Glad they got the Resonator of Judgment turned back on. Was getting less done with all the hubbub about adventurers running amok.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GREETING_0008fa78_Oblivion_RESP1: Glad things are settled here. I can finally get some rest.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_HELLO_0001e7a2_Oblivion_RESP1: Glad to see you are well.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GREETING_0000be78_Oblivion_RESP1: Glad you killed those things. I'd have done it myself, but apparently, that's not "ladylike." Hmmph. Let's get back to my father.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GREETING_00017666_Oblivion_RESP1: Gladiator. It's not very often I get to call somebody that. You're doing the Blue Team proud, kid. Now go kill somebody before I get all weepy!
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_Question_00028d89_Oblivion_RESP1: Glarthir is acting even stranger than usual, don't you think?
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GlarthirTopic_00028d86_Oblivion_R: Glarthir?  Total nutcase, if you ask me.  But he's never done anything -- yet -- that we could arrest him for.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_ChorrolTopic_00024fea_Oblivion_RE: Glistel and me, we keep an eye on things here in Chorrol for certain interested parties... as a public service, like.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_TG09FathisAren_00015f1e_Oblivion_: Gloomy fellow. I've heard he consorts with daedra. I'd steer clear of him if I were you.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GREETING_000c456a_Oblivion_RESP1: Go Blue Team! Yeah, Blue Team! I always bet on the Blue Team! They never hold back! It's always crush, kill, maim, murder! Ha ha ha ha ha!
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_SE05Conspiracy_00081368_Oblivion_: Go ahead, do what you will. Nothing matters now.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_CharGenTaunt2_00033354_Oblivion_R: Go ahead, try your magicka in here. Let's see you make those bars disappear. No? What's the matter? Not so powerful now, are you Breton?
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GOODBYE_0000a232_Oblivion_RESP1: Go ahead. Leave me to rot in here.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GREETING_00081b6b_Oblivion_RESP1: Go ahead. Summon him. He loves it.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_SECylarneTopic_000910d3_Oblivion_: Go and fetch the Flame. Bring it to the Sacellum. Light the Great Torch. How are you going to be Me if you can't even do what Me tells you?
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GOODBYE_0003664c_Oblivion_RESP1: Go and prepare yourself. The Master will have need of all of us soon.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_MS48HirtelB_00032d42_Oblivion_RES: Go and see for yourself! Kvatch is a smoking ruin! We're all that's left, do you understand me? Everyone else is dead!
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GREETING_0002fd72_Oblivion_RESP3: Go and speak with Christophe. Rent a room for the night. Once you have your room, I will meet you there.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GREETING_0003002e_Oblivion_RESP1: Go away! I don't want whatever you're selling!
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GREETING_0001d4ad_Oblivion_RESP1: Go away! I know what you're here for! Just leave me alone!
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GREETING_0018b198_Oblivion_RESP1: Go away, stranger. You frighten the animals, and make my work more difficult.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_HELLO_00062ceb_Oblivion_RESP1: Go away. Do not come back.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_MS49Whatnow_00031d28_Oblivion_RES: Go back to the Chapel, and talk to Berich Inian. Ask him for the key to the North Tower, and he'll tell you what you need to do.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_FGD02Insults_0002cfb7_Oblivion_RE: Go back to your sty, pig man.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_SE09AssistanceCommand_0001356e_Ob: Go fetch me Blood Liqueur, Osseous Marrow, Dermis Membrane, and Essence of Breath.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_SE09AssistanceRequest_0001356f_Ob: Go fetch me Blood Liqueur, Osseous Marrow, Dermis Membrane, and Essence of Breath.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GOODBYE_00031610_Oblivion_RESP1: Go go! There's no time to waste!
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GOODBYE_000514c1_Oblivion_RESP1: Go help Lord Rugdumph. And wipe that smile off your face!
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GREETING_000545ce_Oblivion_RESP1: Go inside and talk to Petrine if you want to buy a horse. I can't help you.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GOODBYE_00073039_Oblivion_RESP1: Go kill something, so I can count its corpse.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_KvatchTopic_000039d7_Oblivion_RES: Go look for yourself. The town is gone. And most of its people.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GOODBYE_000029ec_Knights_RESP1: Go now and fulfill your destiny. You are ready, and the Nine walk with you.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GREETING_000008d2_Oblivion_RESP5: Go now and rest, and may the Night Mother haunt your dreams.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GREETING_0003489e_Oblivion_RESP6: Go now and rest, and may the Night Mother haunt your dreams.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GOODBYE_0000917e_Oblivion_RESP1: Go now! Learn the identity of the betrayer so we can end this madness, and restore the authority of the Black Hand.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GOODBYE_00053871_Oblivion_RESP1: Go now, Child of Sithis. Walk in the shadow of fear, and bring glory to our Dread Father.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_MG12TravenWhat_000835fb_Oblivion_: Go now, and bring word to me as soon as he has been escorted to safety.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GOODBYE_00036317_Oblivion_RESP1: Go now, dear family member, and may the Night Mother wrap you in her cold, loving embrace.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_ND09ProphetSermon03_00002ccf_Knig: Go now, knights. Face the beast. Fear not death, for the Nine shall be your shield, and they shall bring you to rest should you fall.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GREETING_00035e00_Oblivion_RESP4: Go now. Get some rest. Sithis knows you've earned it. When you're ready for another contract, you need only ask.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_SQ09Ask_00066f2b_Oblivion_RESP1: Go on and lau... Wait. Help? Oh. Well, then... I'm a fisherman. Or at least, I was. Until one of those slaughterfish damn near took my leg off.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GOODBYE_00002db2_Oblivion_RESP1: Go on now, get out of my inn! I don't need your kind hanging about!
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_MQ02PrivateBusiness_000aa090_Obli: Go on. I think you'll find what you're looking for upstairs.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_INFOGENERAL_00032eb2_Oblivion_RES: Go out, kick some robber knight's ass, take his stuff, and get the smith to fix it. That's the way to get armor or weapons.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GOODBYE_0004f3e8_Oblivion_RESP1: Go protect Elante. She's doing important research.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_FGD02Insults_0002cf4b_Oblivion_RE: Go root in the mud, pig man!
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_MS26DirectionsLex_000363c4_Oblivi: Go see Hieronymus Lex. He's a pompous fool, just like you. He might listen to your complaint.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_MS26DirectionsServatius_000363c6_: Go see Servatius Quintilius. He's new and might be stupid enough to try and do something about it.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GOODBYE_0004f3ef_Oblivion_RESP1: Go take care of the rats. Then talk to me.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_TGCastOutTopic_0001efc3_Oblivion_: Go talk to Armand or S'krivva. Pay the fine and you'll be reinstated.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_SE09RebuildGatekeeper_00014ae8_Ob: Go talk to Relmyna in Xaselm. Tell her you're working for me. She'd do anything for me, that little minx.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_SE40SleepOutside_000790af_Oblivio: Go talk to Uungor. He's always talking about leaving, anyway. Your friend can sleep where Uungor does now.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_AldosOthranTopic_0003c2b5_Oblivio: Go tell Ulrich that I have some information that incriminates him. Tell him to come alone, or he won't get it.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GREETING_0008606f_Oblivion_RESP1: Go tell Weebam-Na I want to see him. I'll wait right here.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_WeebamNaYes_000860cc_Oblivion_RES: Go tell him I want to see him right now. I'll meet him here.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_WeebamNaTopic_000860cb_Oblivion_R: Go tell him I want to see him. Here. Right now.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_SE06HelpAttackA5_00012cd2_Oblivio: Go then. I will hold off on my attack to give you a chance to reconsider. But I will not wait forever.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_SE11DyusChoice2_00014b5a_Oblivion: Go there and bring me a branch of this tree, but be warned -- the tree will not surrender its secrets to one who has not earned them.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_SEDunrootBurrowTopic_00013387_Obl: Go there. Take the Felldew from the Elytra, eat it, and your journey begins. You will be thankful to Thadon when this has passed.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_NDProphetTopic_00002a85_Knights_R: Go to Anvil. Speak to the Prophet. You, too, may find yourself taking up his holy quest, despite yourself.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GREETING_000a9481_Oblivion_RESP1: Go to his shrine. See what lies ahead.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_ShadeoftheRevenant_0000357b_Obliv: Go to the Dark Fissure the next time this "shade" occurs. Search for any connection to what we've learned, and report back.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_TrainingQuestTopic_0018d889_Obliv: Go to the Leyawiin Guild hall, and speak with Dagail. She can train you further.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_SE02Gatekeeper_0008e54e_Oblivion_: Go up there now. The Gatekeeper is about to turn some adventurers into bones. I'll collect those later.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GREETING_00017684_Oblivion_RESP2: Go up to that Arena and make sure the people of Cyrodiil never forget that it was you who brought the Yellow Team to its knees!
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_BedYes_0003b348_Oblivion_RESP2: Go upstairs, and look for the door on the right at the end of the hall. Sleep well!
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_MQPriorMaborelA1_0005d2ca_Oblivio: Go with Talos's blessings. Do not fail.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_MQPriorMaborelA2_0005d2cb_Oblivio: Go with Talos's blessings. Do not fail.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GOODBYE_00045f79_Oblivion_RESP1: Go with the grace of the Nine.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GOODBYE_000837eb_Oblivion_RESP1: Go, go! Socialize! Talk to those fine people, and then plunge your knife into their throats when they ain't lookin'! Ha ha ha ha ha ha ha!
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GREETING_0001544d_Oblivion_RESP1: Go. Find Thalfin, and the other Battlemages. Stop the gem from reaching Mannimarco.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GOODBYE_00041058_Oblivion_RESP1: Go. Sink your blade deep into the flesh of your enemies.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_Dark18Choice3A_00090795_Oblivion_: Go. Take a few moments to collect yourself. Meditate upon all that has transpired. Help yourself to any treasures this crypt may offer.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GOODBYE_0003c361_Oblivion_RESP1: Go. Tell Garrus what I've done. I've nothing to hide.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_MazogaSayNothing2_000860c7_Oblivi: Go. You're not worth the trouble.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_Idle_0018b5aa_Oblivion_RESP1: Goblins and rats. Seems like they're everywhere. I'm just waiting for the giant spiders to show up.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_SkingradNQDResponses_0003c1aa_Obl: Goblins are filth. More power to him.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_MS46GoblinWar_0000ab72_Oblivion_R: Goblins have their own reasons for doing things. Don't make sense to us, usually, but I've learned a lot about their ways over the years.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_CreatureResponses_0002b1c5_Oblivi: Goblins. Ugh. Evil, foul-smelling little brutes.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_MQ07BurdB_00038bc6_Oblivion_RESP1: God's blood! So she was the spy? It seems there's no one you can trust these days.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_BlackBrugo07_00090b7a_Oblivion_RE: God's goolies! Not just a Knight, but a... Knight-Errant! That's a real special kind of Knight, right?
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_SQ10Husband_0006141d_Oblivion_RES: Goddess! You have Rockshatter already? And what's become of Bjalfi?
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_LeyawiinTopic_000479d7_Oblivion_R: Gods are my witness! I give that man the simplest list of things to do, and somehow he forgets half of it and gets the rest wrong.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GREETING_00033df3_Oblivion_RESP1: Gods blood! They came out of nowhere. Have you seen Grandmaster Jauffre?
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GREETING_000b1216_Oblivion_RESP1: Gods protect us! What is happening here?
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_HELLO_00073b62_Oblivion_RESP1: Gods! Pox and rot! Get away from me!
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_MS48HirtelA_00032d41_Oblivion_RES: Gods' blood, you don't know, do you?
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GoodbyeKvatch07_0018ad6a_Oblivion: Gods. I don't even notice any more. I guess you can get used to anything.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_Gang_0003d4af_Oblivion_RESP1: Gogan and I are really members of the Anvil City Watch. I suppose you could say we work undercover.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_Gang_0003d307_Oblivion_RESP2: Gogan may be able to give you more information beyond that.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GREETING_0018d28b_Oblivion_RESP1: Going into that Oblivion Gate was an impressive feat of derring-do. I salute you!
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GOODBYE_00041057_Oblivion_RESP1: Going so soon? Come back when your blades need sharpening.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_SE03LewinCrazyChatter_0008efac_Ob: Going to g-get us... kill us all...
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_TGSpecialJobs_0000a1b5_Oblivion_R: Gold is the blood of the Thieves Guild. Keep the fences busy and rich. Then come to see me.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_TrainingQuestTopic_000613a0_Obliv: Gold, that's what! Septims, and lots of them! Show me that you've got the starting capital, at least ten thousand in liquid assets.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_SE03SyndelCrazyChatter_0008efaf_O: Gold... gems... keys... all mine... find keys...
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_ArenaFanChoice1B_000aed46_Oblivio: Golly, you're the best! I'm going to follow you and watch you and worship the ground you walk on! Let's go!
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_FGC07Choice1_000091f8_Oblivion_RE: Gone. Dragged from our house in the night. To pay the debt, I'd like to sell the sword and armor of my grandfather, or I might be next!
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_FGC07Choice1_000146b3_Oblivion_RE: Gone. Dragged from our house in the night. To pay the debt, I'd like to sell the sword and armor of my grandfather, or I might be next!
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_SEDementiaRumorResponses_00061c73: Gone? I can't imagine Him leaving us now.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_HELLO_0003b827_Oblivion_RESP1: Good cheer and jubilant welcome, lady.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_HELLO_0003b828_Oblivion_RESP1: Good cheer and jubilant welcome, lord.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_SE01Choice3_0008c0e3_Oblivion_RES: Good choice. I mean, look at the thing! No sane person would go through there. And none have come out, that's for certain.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_HELLO_000688fa_Oblivion_RESP1: Good day to you, my lord.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GREETING_0002a6a6_Oblivion_RESP1: Good day, ma'am, and welcome to Chorrol. You're under the watchful eye of the Chorrol Guard, so don't you worry. We keep the peace, and keep it nice.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GREETING_00023e00_Oblivion_RESP1: Good day, sir, and welcome to Chorrol. You're under the watchful eye of the Chorrol Guard. We keep the peace, and keep it nice and pretty.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GREETING_000476e1_Oblivion_RESP1: Good day, stranger. Soris Arenim is my name.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GREETING_0001c496_Oblivion_RESP1: Good day. I'm Tolgan, herald to Countess Narina Carvain here in Bruma. She requests your company at your earliest convenience.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GREETING_000980cf_Oblivion_RESP1: Good day. I'm Tolgan, herald to Countess Narina Carvain.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GREETING_00047715_Oblivion_RESP1: Good day. My name is Seridur. I don't believe we've met.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GOODBYE_0008da98_Oblivion_RESP1: Good deeds and moral fiber. Bah!
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GOODBYE_00143f0e_Oblivion_RESP1: Good deeds and moral fiber. Bah!
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_Barter_0005de84_Oblivion_RESP1: Good food helps keep you healthy. For most people, anyway. Doesn't seem to work for me.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_SEWildernessRumorResponses_000615: Good for Thadon. Doesn't help us any.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_HELLO_00062c9b_Oblivion_RESP1: Good friend. This is an honor.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_DAMalacathSpeech_000579d4_Oblivio: Good job! No one owns ogres but ME!
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_TrainingQuestTopic_0018b18f_Obliv: Good luck finding her, though. The latest I heard was that she had wandered off into the wilderness, looking for a shrine to Kynareth.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GOODBYE_000029f4_Knights_RESP1: Good luck on your quest. I'm sure we'll meet again.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_Nirnroot_0004f12a_Oblivion_RESP1: Good luck with your field work for Sinderion.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GOODBYE_00036329_Oblivion_RESP1: Good luck, Brother! I hope you don't get killed! I mean, um... well, you know!
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GOODBYE_00036328_Oblivion_RESP1: Good luck, Sister! I hope you don't get killed! I mean, um... well, you know!
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_SE08CommanderPlan3_00018c89_Obliv: Good luck, Your Grace. May the truth light your way through the darkness.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_SE08CommanderPlan3_00018c88_Obliv: Good luck, Your Grace. May the voice of the hidden guide you to the way.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_ElixirofExploration_0004e946_Obli: Good luck, and hurry back with more of the Nirnroot!
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GOODBYE_00038fc4_Oblivion_RESP1: Good luck, my friend. Don't take any unnecessary risks.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GOODBYE_00017791_Oblivion_RESP1: Good luck, stranger. You get that girl out of this terrible place.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GOODBYE_00033ef5_Oblivion_RESP1: Good luck. And don't underestimate the goblins. They're more dangerous than they look.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GOODBYE_0017c461_Oblivion_RESP1: Good luck. It's a brave thing you're doing.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_DarMaTopic_0001778d_Oblivion_RESP: Good luck. You will save her won't you? I gotta go now.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_DAClavicusSpeech_000243ae_Oblivio: Good move, kid. Some things are better left alone. Let's get back to the Shrine. I'll smooth things over with the big guy. I'm sure he'll understand.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_INFOGENERAL_0018b202_Oblivion_RES: Good news from Kvatch for a change. The last of the daedra have been driven out.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_NDTalkRelics2_00002c70_Knights_RE: Good news! The Gauntlets are ours! Stendarr smiled upon our Commander, as he has not done to any knight for 300 years.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_ICAnnouncer_0004835f_Oblivion_RES: Good people of Cyrodiil, welcome to the Imperial City Arena! Believe it or not, someone has actually challenged the unbeatable Arena Grand Champion!
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_Announcer_00046654_Oblivion_RESP1: Good people of the Imperial City, welcome to the Arena!
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_ICMonsterAnnounce_00093cd9_Oblivi: Good people of the Imperial City, welcome to the Arena! You've come to watch the Grand Champion battle some of Cyrodiil's fiercest creatures!
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_ICAnnouncer_00048361_Oblivion_RES: Good people, I give you the Blue Team's latest Champion, a warrior of skill, strength, and determination!
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_ICMonsterAnnounce_00093cdb_Oblivi: Good people, the Grand Champion is victorious! Esteemed Grand Champion, leave the Arena now and rest! You've earned it once again!
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_Announcer_0004667b_Oblivion_RESP1: Good people, we have a winner! All hail the combatant from the Blue Team! Victor from the Blue Team, leave the Arena now and rest! You've earned it!
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_ICAnnouncer_00048377_Oblivion_RES: Good people, you have just witnessed the impossible! Agronak gro-Malog has been defeated! I say again, the Gray Prince has been defeated!
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_MS12Stipend_00018232_Oblivion_RES: Good point. Allow me to formally introduce myself. I'm Countess Narina Carvain. I assume you've noticed all of the Akaviri relics I'm displaying.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_TG05WhatNow_00015f22_Oblivion_RES: Good question. I want you to spy on Hieronymus Lex. Make sure you stay close enough to overhear any conversations.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_FGD05Choice1_0002c5bb_Oblivion_RE: Good question. I've heard stories, but nothing I can prove is true. Maybe they've got a mage working with them. Maybe they're just well trained.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_INFOGENERAL_00032e21_Oblivion_RES: Good riddance to the Blackwood Company, and good luck to the Fighters Guild.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_MQ08ArtifactL_00038fb8_Oblivion_R: Good riddance to this tool of mischief.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GOODBYE_00081dc7_Oblivion_RESP1: Good seeing you, Lord Sheogorath. Could have bought a round, though....
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_INFOGENERAL_00043e96_Oblivion_RES: Good that Thadon got his Chalice back. I'd hate if someone took mine. Or anything else, for that matter.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_SEManiaRumorResponses_00061790_Ob: Good that it is only the Fringe that has been attacked.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GREETING_0008fa72_Oblivion_RESP1: Good that things are settled. We can get back to work.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_INFOGENERAL_000465c0_Oblivion_RES: Good that we have a healer in town. Cirroc can fix most anything that ails you. After all these years, he almost seems like a Nord himself.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GREETING_0002888b_Oblivion_RESP1: Good that you made it. You should talk to Rienna.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_duties_0002e581_Oblivion_RESP1: Good that you took care of it. This whole Blackwood Company business is starting to chafe.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_Training_00066a5e_Oblivion_RESP1: Good that you want to get better.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GREETING_000146c7_Oblivion_RESP2: Good that you've finally seen the light. The cause will benefit from your assistance.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_INFOGENERAL_000241d5_Oblivion_RES: Good thing I joined the Mages Guild when I did. There's nothing better than enchanting your own clothes.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_INFOGENERAL_00049966_Oblivion_RES: Good thing we have the Black Horse Courier. I don't know how we'd get our news without it.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_DAMalacathChoice2_0001ec3e_Oblivi: Good thinking. You want to keep your good looks, go talk to some nice pretty gods.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_DASheogorathSpeech_000897bb_Obliv: Good times. Good times. I hope you had as much fun as I did. Here, take this. It's a fun little toy. Now, go away. Before I kill you.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_DASheogorathSpeech_0009760b_Obliv: Good times. Good times. I hope you had as much fun as I did. Here, take this. It's a fun little toy. Now, go away. Before I kill you.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_SECreatureResponses_00077c62_Obli: Good to know. I try to steer clear of the big bugs.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_contract_00003942_Oblivion_RESP1: Good to see that you're looking for more work. There's certainly more to be done. I need you to help Elante of Alinor.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_INFOGENERAL_0005f3e8_Oblivion_RES: Good to see the armies back. Did you know that the average Saint is exactly six feet tall?
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GREETING_000039da_Oblivion_RESP1: Good to see you again, friend. I don't suppose you've noticed anything out of the ordinary around here?
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GREETING_0004d0ac_Oblivion_RESP1: Good to see you again, ma'am. Martin was worried, but I knew you would bring back the Amulet of Kings for him.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GREETING_0002b521_Oblivion_RESP1: Good to see you again, ma'am. Shall I escort you upstairs to see my master?
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GREETING_0004d0ab_Oblivion_RESP1: Good to see you again, sir. Martin was worried, but I knew you would bring back the Amulet of Kings for him.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GREETING_0002adad_Oblivion_RESP1: Good to see you again, sir. Shall I escort you upstairs to see my master?
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GREETING_00053732_Oblivion_RESP1: Good to see you again. Do you have the Soul Gems I requested?
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_HELLO_00081d63_Oblivion_RESP1: Good to see you again. Do you need me to sharpen your blades?
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GREETING_0003565d_Oblivion_RESP1: Good to see you again. Have you reconsidered your decision to undertake the investigation?
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GREETING_0004d0aa_Oblivion_RESP1: Good to see you again. I told Martin that Mankar Camoran was no match for you.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GREETING_00028a26_Oblivion_RESP1: Good to see you again. What can I do for you?
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_contract_00002e59_Oblivion_RESP1: Good to see you're working hard. I've got some more thieves for you to deal with in Anvil.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GREETING_00146846_Oblivion_RESP1: Good to see you, Brawler. Your training's going well, I hope?
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_HELLO_0003c14d_Oblivion_RESP1: Good to see you, ma'am. We won't forget how you helped Anvil.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_HELLO_0003c14c_Oblivion_RESP1: Good to see you, sir. We won't forget how you helped Anvil.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GREETING_00072dfa_Oblivion_RESP1: Good to see you. We should have a drink sometime.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GREETING_00002dc9_Oblivion_RESP1: Good work at Vahtacen. Jarol is quite pleased with the information now coming in about the site.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GREETING_00032dfb_Oblivion_RESP1: Good work closing the Oblivion Gate, you've made my job much easier and safer. Thanks!
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GREETING_0003359e_Oblivion_RESP2: Good work closing the Oblivion Gate, you've made my job much easier and safer. Thanks!
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_MS46GoblinWar_0002f521_Oblivion_R: Good work ending the goblin war. The settlers are very pleased. I'm pretty impressed as well.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_VahtacenTopic_0003353e_Oblivion_R: Good work getting that straightened out. I'm glad someone finally came along that was able to make progress with it.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GREETING_0002006c_Oblivion_RESP1: Good work locating the Shrine of Dagon. If you can retrieve the Amulet of Kings, we may yet prevail.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_HELLO_00038bb8_Oblivion_RESP1: Good work tracking down the Mythic Dawn's secret shrine. We finally took the fight to the enemy.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GREETING_0001bb21_Oblivion_RESP1: Good work! Now I can paint the portal home. After it's complete, you must go first or else you'd be stuck in here forever.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GREETING_0001769c_Oblivion_RESP1: Good work, Bloodletter. Or should I say Myrmidon? That's right, you've risen in rank. You know how it works. More blood, more gold. Here.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GREETING_00033dd1_Oblivion_RESP1: Good work, good pay. Want to join the Guild?
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_SE46DoublesTopic_00081ef7_Oblivio: Good work, you fuzzy little rascal! We don't need another Urul around. Do we? Do we?
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_MQ07ProgressTwoDead_00039301_Obli: Good work. But you must locate their base and make sure you've eliminated all of them.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GREETING_00026ea8_Oblivion_RESP1: Good work. Captain Burd and his guardsmen should be able to handle any additional Gates, at least for now.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_DASheogorathSpeech_0009554a_Obliv: Good work. Good times! Here's a little reward for your efforts. One of my toys. Now, back to business. Before I forget myself.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GREETING_00022b1d_Oblivion_RESP1: Good work. I am glad to see you, by the way. You just caught me at a bad time.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_TG04AhdarjisStolenRing_00007de8_O: Good work. You are truly an asset to the guild. I will make sure the Gray Fox himself hears about this.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_FGJoin1_0002427d_Oblivion_RESP1: Good, I guess. You're now an Associate in the Fighters Guild. Report to me or Azzan in Anvil for contracts. And don't screw up.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_MatildePetitTopic_0002826f_Oblivi: Good, I'm glad she's dead. I can tell you that because we're friends. Matilde didn't like me just because I'm a Dunmer. She got what she deserved.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GREETING_00081b68_Oblivion_RESP1: Good, good! You'll need all the help you can get if you're going to defeat Jyggalag and stop the Greymarch.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_MageTalk3_0006a86a_Oblivion_RESP1: Good, good. But let's not be too hasty. We must be sure of our findings. If there's any doubt, any doubt at all, it will weaken our position.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_NDTalk5_00002bc3_Knights_RESP1: Good, good. Make any arrangements we need, and I'll follow your lead. We'll talk again soon.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_ThoronirTopic_0001d041_Oblivion_R: Good, you have found his source. Now, you must find where his source gets the materials if we are to truly bring this crime to justice.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GOODBYE_0003d4da_Oblivion_RESP1: Good-for-nothing louse of a husband. He's lucky I still love him.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_SE46Choice3_0008fabe_Oblivion_RES: Good. A little hard work will do you some good. Just get rid of those Demented freaks, and we'll all be happier.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_MQ07ProgressDead_00020082_Oblivio: Good. But there may still be more spies out there. You should continue to search for their base of operations in Bruma.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_TG02accept_00034873_Oblivion_RESP: Good. Find out where he's keeping the taxes and bring them to me. I'll also need the tax records of what each citizen paid so we can return it.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_MQ15EldamilD3_0003fbe3_Oblivion_R: Good. Follow me, and don't worry. You can trust me.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_SE11RakheranGreeting3c_00019fcd_O: Good. Good. Bring to me the daggers. Then kill Ciirta, we will.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_SE11RakheranGreeting1a_00019cd2_O: Good. Good. Your face is known to me. One so famous as you cannot expect to walk around the Isles unrecognized, can you?
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_SE11RakheranGreeting1a_0007eaf4_O: Good. Good. Your face is known to me. One so famous as you cannot expect to walk around the Isles unrecognized, can you?
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_DAClavicusSpeech_000243b4_Oblivio: Good. Got your attention. I'm Barbas, the Hound of Clavicus Vile. Not that I've always been a hound, or always been called Barbas.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_MQ13InformCountess_00027103_Obliv: Good. Have her meet me in the Chapel of Talos for a council of war. That seems a fitting place to make such desperate plans.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_weaponsshipment_00028876_Oblivion: Good. I need a weapon. But it doesn't look like you have any! Go get them. And quick.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_weaponsshipment_00028879_Oblivion: Good. I need a weapon. I'm looking forward to bashing some skulls in.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_weaponsshipment_0002887a_Oblivion: Good. I need a weapon. I'm looking forward to bashing some skulls in.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_weaponsshipment_00028a8e_Oblivion: Good. I need a weapon. I'm looking forward to bashing some skulls in.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_weaponsshipment_0018abf5_Oblivion: Good. I need a weapon. I'm looking forward to bashing some skulls in.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_SE05Eavesdrop_00081179_Oblivion_R: Good. I shall expect a progress report soon. And keep your head down; the Inquisitor must not become involved.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_MS02VelwynEscChoice1_0000a0da_Obl: Good. I want to get this over with as soon as possible.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_SEWildernessRumorResponses_000614: Good. It's always the settlements that adventurers get to first.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_SE46Choice3_0008faba_Oblivion_RES: Good. Just get rid of all those Manics in town, and we'll all be happier. Don't kill any Demented, though, or no reward for you.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_CharGenMain_00032b10_Oblivion_RES: Good. Let's go. We're not out of this yet.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_weaponsshipment_000289ef_Oblivion: Good. Now everyone is armed. We're going to have to clear the goblins out of this place before the miners can return. Let's go.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_SE03NoneTaken_00067709_Oblivion_R: Good. Now, on to your responsibilities.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_MG14Choice1A_0000a0fd_Oblivion_RE: Good. Please go to Bruma; I have not heard from Jeanne Frasoric for a few days now, which is unusual for her.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_MQ05BaurusC_00022b16_Oblivion_RES: Good. Remember, wait for him to follow me. I want to see what he'll do.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_MQ05PlanB_00022cf3_Oblivion_RESP1: Good. Remember, we must not leave here without the book. It's our best chance of finding the Amulet.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_TG01Accept_0001c151_Oblivion_RESP: Good. Remember, you may not kill anyone while doing this. If you need any lock picks, I can sell you some.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_CGBaurusG_0001e90b_Oblivion_RESP1: Good. The Emperor's trust was well-placed.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_BedYes_0006215f_Oblivion_RESP1: Good. The room is on the second floor, right across from the stairs. Sleep soundly.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GREETING_000356ad_Oblivion_RESP1: Good. You're finally awake. I was beginning to get a bit concerned about you.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GREETING_000146a1_Oblivion_RESP1: Good. You're here. We've got duties to attend to.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_INFOGENERAL_00032e24_Oblivion_RES: Goodbye, Blackwood Company. The Fighters Guild has a new master, and Oreyn is back.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_StolenGold_0005375f_Oblivion_RESP: Goodbye, I don't expect to be seeing you anytime soon. If I were you, I'd get out of Bruma fast before the guards catch on that she's dead.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_StolenGold_000a04dc_Oblivion_RESP: Goodbye, I don't expect to be seeing you anytime soon. If I were you, I'd get out of Bruma fast before the guards catch on that she's dead.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GOODBYE_0003358a_Oblivion_RESP1: Goodbye, Knight. Remember to carry our symbol proudly as a beacon of hope for all Cyrodiil!
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GOODBYE_00002db1_Oblivion_RESP1: Goodbye, my friend! And remember, you're always welcome here!
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GOODBYE_0001e7cc_Oblivion_RESP1: Goodbye. Hope to see you again very soon.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GOODBYE_00072df1_Oblivion_RESP1: Goodbye. If you find any interesting things, let me know.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GOODBYE_00072df0_Oblivion_RESP1: Goodbye. So long. See you soon. Or not. Whichever it might be.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_HappyReceive_0002a394_Oblivion_RE: Goodness. Well, I hope you don't say that to all the girls.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_SECreatureResponses_0008e826_Obli: Gorble. Can't you hear them gorbling?
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GREETING_0003e0a6_Oblivion_RESP1: Gorgo gro-Shura. Soldier of fortune. Which means, more-or-less, unemployed and thoroughly pauperized.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_HELLO_0003d4dc_Oblivion_RESP1: Got a lot to do here. We can talk later in Anvil.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_BieneAmelionTOPIC_000091cf_Oblivi: Got a sword and armor for her, huh? Not bad work, meat. Here's your payment for the contract.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_Dark05Choice2A_0004cacf_Oblivion_: Got all that? Good! Hides-His-Heart will be here any moment. Get ready! Oh, I do hope this works...
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_Dark05Choice2B_0004cad0_Oblivion_: Got all that? Good! Hides-His-Heart will be here any moment. Get ready! Oh, I do hope this works...
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_Dark05Choice2C_0004cad1_Oblivion_: Got all that? Good! Hides-His-Heart will be here any moment. Get ready! Oh, I do hope this works...
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GREETING_00073029_Oblivion_RESP1: Got any stories? I love stories.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GuardTalk1_0006fdd3_Oblivion_RESP: Got called in on a murder. There's been some talk. Some of the men think it was... You know... the Dark Brotherhood!
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GREETING_0002ee5d_Oblivion_RESP1: Got nothing else to say to you. Get out of here before I get angry.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_SE46DoublesTopic_0008fa71_Oblivio: Got them all, did you? Good work! I promised you a reward, and here it is. Now, go find some other work to do, you layabout!
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_SE46DoublesTopic_0008fa7f_Oblivio: Got them all? Makes me tired just thinking about it. Good work, though. Here's the reward I promised.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GOODBYE_0008f10c_Oblivion_RESP1: Got to go. Have things to see and people to do.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_MS48StartCombatShouts_00082c8e_Ob: Grab the Sigil Stone and let's get out of here!
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GREETING_000476f6_Oblivion_RESP1: Graman gro-Marad. I'm a bouncer for the Bloated Float. My wife, Umog, is a night guard for Master Umbacano.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GREETING_00047741_Oblivion_RESP1: Graman gro-Marad. I'm the night man on the Bloated Float.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_MQ13MartinA1_00027101_Oblivion_RE: Great Sigil Stones are the anchors of Great Gates. The kind of gate the Mythic Dawn opened at Kvatch.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GREETING_0003cc0d_Oblivion_RESP1: Great show, great show! You really brought down the house! Here's your gold. Now get some rest, and I'll see you next week!
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GREETING_000c5539_Oblivion_RESP1: Great show, great show! You really brought down the house! Here's your gold. Now get some rest, and I'll see you next week!
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GREETING_000c553a_Oblivion_RESP1: Great show, great show! You really brought down the house! Here's your gold. Now get some rest, and I'll see you next week!
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_Recommendation_0005323f_Oblivion_: Great things will befall you. There will be trials, but you will prevail. You must, for the good of the guild.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_SE36Choice1LootYes_00061c42_Obliv: Great! There's a... a simple task. Yes, a simple task that you must perform.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_MS05Money_00027f38_Oblivion_RESP1: Great. Whatever suits you and gets me Henantier back suits me just fine.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GREETING_00090867_Oblivion_RESP1: Great... nice work. Now that he's dead, we'll never find the treasure. Just get away from me.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_TG05Reward_00015f24_Oblivion_RESP: Greedy bastard, aren't you. I like that in a thief. You'll have to see S'krivva about that. I'm just running the scam.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_SE07BGreenmote_000167e3_Oblivion_: Greenmote is the refined version of the spores that are harvested from the spore trees that dot Mania.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_ChallengeRedguard_0009f9b7_Oblivi: Greet the war-hardened Redguard! Fight for my glory, Chosen One!
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GREETING_00035df0_Oblivion_RESP1: Greetings once more, assassin. When you're ready, I have a most important contract. One that has been sanctioned by the Black Hand itself.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GREETING_00023e44_Oblivion_RESP1: Greetings once more. I know you must be eager to get to work. I think you'll find the task Vicente has available to be quite intriguing.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GREETING_000224f6_Oblivion_RESP1: Greetings! Greetings! I am Ocheeva, mistress of this Sanctuary. Lucien has told me all about you. Let me welcome you to the Dark Brotherhood!
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_EronorDEMO1_0002ae3a_Oblivion_RES: Greetings! How are you on this fine morning?
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GREETING_00002e47_Oblivion_RESP1: Greetings! Looking for some more work, are you?
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GREETING_00072ded_Oblivion_RESP1: Greetings! Salutations! Welcome! Now go away. Leave. Run. Or die.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GREETING_00071098_Oblivion_RESP1: Greetings! Seeing you just makes me feel safer!
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GREETING_000356a9_Oblivion_RESP1: Greetings! Welcome to Lelles' Quality Merchandise. We have a wide range of goods to suit your needs.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GREETING_000251e3_Oblivion_RESP1: Greetings, Brother. I do hope you are well.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GREETING_0007b7db_Oblivion_RESP1: Greetings, Champion! I'm at your service.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GREETING_00012cc6_Oblivion_RESP1: Greetings, Emissary. We await your command.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_Dark19StatueTalk1_00086710_Oblivi: Greetings, Listener. Come close, and I will share with you the information I have garnered. For someone has prayed to the Night Mother yet again.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GREETING_00081d85_Oblivion_RESP1: Greetings, Madgod. I normally don't stop to chit-chat, but it's truly an honor. What can I do for you?
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GREETING_0006c5c0_Oblivion_RESP1: Greetings, Magister. I trust you are serving the guild well.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_HELLO_0008d324_Oblivion_RESP1: Greetings, My Lord. I am at your service.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GREETING_000251e4_Oblivion_RESP1: Greetings, Sister. I do hope you are well.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GREETING_000224f5_Oblivion_RESP1: Greetings, brother! Greetings! I am Ocheeva, mistress of this Sanctuary. Lucien has told me all about you. I welcome you to the Dark Brotherhood!
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GREETING_00016b5a_Oblivion_RESP1: Greetings, brother. How does the light find you this day?
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_HELLO_0002b5dd_Oblivion_RESP1: Greetings, child of the Ra Gada.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GREETING_0002edf5_Oblivion_RESP1: Greetings, child. The Mages Guild has a future for you, I believe. I have seen it. You should consider joining.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GREETING_0007028a_Oblivion_RESP1: Greetings, citizen. How can this Legion horseman be of service?
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GREETING_0002d28a_Oblivion_RESP1: Greetings, citizen. Is there something I can do for you? Are you perhaps interested in joining the Mages Guild?
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GREETING_0001ebbc_Oblivion_RESP1: Greetings, favored of the Webspinner, Champion of Mephala.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GREETING_0001a810_Oblivion_RESP1: Greetings, friend. Have you come seeking the light?
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GREETING_0002e582_Oblivion_RESP1: Greetings, guildmate. What can I do for you?
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GREETING_0006a844_Oblivion_RESP1: Greetings, magister! How can I be of service?
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GREETING_0000a09e_Oblivion_RESP1: Greetings, most honorable Listener. The time has come for you to hear the whispers of death. Go to Bravil, and listen to the Night Mother.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GREETING_00003924_Oblivion_RESP1: Greetings, my friend. You must be from the Fighters Guild. We appreciate your help.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GREETING_00016b5b_Oblivion_RESP1: Greetings, sister. How does the light find you this day?
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GREETING_000192e4_Oblivion_RESP1: Greetings, stranger. Are you here to help us drive the Mazken out of Cylarne?
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GREETING_000613bf_Oblivion_RESP1: Greetings, traveler. What do you seek?
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GREETING_0001ebca_Oblivion_RESP1: Greetings, traveller. What is your business here?
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GREETING_0001f36d_Oblivion_RESP1: Greetings. Did you know that I slept for exactly 237 minutes last night? I find that fascinating.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GREETING_0003e94d_Oblivion_RESP1: Greetings. Do you have business at Castle Skingrad?
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GREETING_00027f88_Oblivion_RESP1: Greetings. How may I help you? Are you perhaps interested in joining the Fighters Guild?
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GREETING_0006e603_Oblivion_RESP1: Greetings. I am Raminus Polus, Consul for the Mages Guild. Welcome to the Arcane University.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GREETING_0002a2ac_Oblivion_RESP1: Greetings. I see you've been keeping yourself busy. This is good. I believe it's time for you to perform some duties for your Guild.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GREETING_0000bee4_Oblivion_RESP1: Greetings. It is high time that we meet face to face, don't you think?
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_HELLO_00062caa_Oblivion_RESP1: Greetings. What exactly do you require of me?
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GREETING_000272bc_Oblivion_RESP1: Greetings. What news from Cloud Ruler Temple?
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GREETING_000008d1_Oblivion_RESP1: Greetings... greetings fellow stalker of the damned! Enjoy your new gift. And don't forget to speak with Ocheeva! She has a contract waiting for you.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_SE03SyndelChamberTwoStart_0007325: Grommok, be careful! This looks too good to be true.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_INFOGENERAL_0003dfbd_Oblivion_RES: Gruiand Garrana can talk her way out of anything. Of course, all she usually talks about is herself.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_CheydinhalNQDResponses_0003e97b_O: Gruiand is a bit high and mighty. She does have a way with words, though.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_SEObeliskResponses_0008e494_Obliv: Grundy obelisks! Always tetterating knights and festars. Use the dookas to fix them.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_LeyawiinTopic_0018d306_Oblivion_R: Guard stays inside the city walls for the duration of the crisis. Count Caro's orders. We're not going to risk another Kvatch here.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_Pickpocket_000624fa_Oblivion_RESP: Guards! Guards! We've got a pickpocket here!
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_SE07BSheoShout03_0008f57e_Oblivio: Guards, I think Syl forgot how to use the door. Kindly show her out. Before I forget myself.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_SE07ASheoShout03_0008f534_Oblivio: Guards, I think Thadon forgot how to use the door. Kindly show him out. Before I forget myself.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_Idle_0018b5b6_Oblivion_RESP1: Guess I won't be visiting Kvatch.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GREETING_0008961c_Oblivion_RESP1: Guess what? I found another dead rat. Here, take this.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_NevilleTopic_0002879b_Oblivion_RE: Guests are dropping like flies around here, but not Neville, he's still in one piece. That tells me he's either very lucky, or a cold-blooded killer.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_JemaneFamily_00028c7c_Oblivion_RE: Guilbert and Reynald know nothing of their father's past deeds. If you want to tell them about it, suit yourself.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GREETING_00084b3c_Oblivion_RESP1: Guilbert should be able to help you with anything you need... for now, I'm going to celebrate!
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GOODBYE_0008da81_Oblivion_RESP1: Guilbert was always the brains, but I've got the brawn! If you need anything, he can help you!
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_MagesGuildTopic_00062bc4_Oblivion: Guild members who have access to the University can craft their own spells, not to mention chat with the most important people in the guild.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GREETING_000475ae_Oblivion_RESP1: Gundalas guarantees! Everything... almost free! At Best Goods and Guarantees, retail service at warehouse prices!
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_EyjaTopic_000b97e5_Oblivion_RESP3: Gunder took me in when I was but a teen, and I've lived there ever since. We've... shared a bed... but were never married.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GOODBYE_0003d4d6_Oblivion_RESP1: Gweden isn't far; they're taking quite a risk committing these crimes so close to Anvil.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_MQ05PhintiasA_00022b45_Oblivion_R: Gwinas will be terribly disappointed when he learns it is gone.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_MQ05VolumeThree_00022cee_Oblivion: Gwinas will be terribly disappointed when he learns it is gone.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_MQ05PhintiasA_00022b44_Oblivion_R: Gwinas would be terribly disappointed if it was gone when he came to pick it up. So sorry I can't help you.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_MS31Selene04aPositive_00015262_Ob: H-how did you know about that? No matter. Once I've taken care of you, we'll scuttle the ship and be off to our safe house.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_contract_0000bcb3_Oblivion_RESP1: Ha ha ha ha ha ha ha! By Sithis, you are an idiot! Ocheeva has sent you on a suicide mission! Phillida's men are going to cut you to pieces!
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_Dark08NelsNevConvo_000852c6_Obliv: Ha ha ha ha ha! "My kind," as you like to call us, are plenty happy serving our own needs while your useless Empire crumbles down around you!
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_BladesTalk2_00068356_Oblivion_RES: Ha ha ha ha ha! Well, no one could ever accuse you Blades of being lax, I'll give you that. No, there's no need for alarm. I just wanted to talk.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_Dark08FinChoice2B_00032bea_Oblivi: Ha ha ha ha ha! Yes! Yes! The Black Hand has sanctioned the Rose of Sithis. It is an enchanted arrow that will kill Phillida... instantly!
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_Attack_000242f2_Oblivion_RESP1: Ha ha ha! You move like a pregnant cow!
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_MageTalk3_0006a867_Oblivion_RESP1: Ha ha! Magister, do you realize what this means? Do you have any idea how this could impact the study of magic?
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_ReadyForAMatch_0000c0e6_Oblivion_: Ha ha! Now that's the spirit! You give the people of Cyrodiil a good show, and I'll make sure you get a decent burial! Ha ha ha ha ha!
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_SE39MissionChoice1a_00078202_Obli: Ha ha! That should keep her occupied. She'll spend months putting everything back in place!
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GREETING_0003d62b_Oblivion_RESP1: Ha ha! There's the new Arena Grand Champion!  Now listen, I bet you're wondering what's next huh? Well I've been thinking...
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GREETING_0003b1d8_Oblivion_RESP1: Ha ha! There's the new Arena Grand Champion! By Shinji, you look good in that Raiment! The way it accentuates your physique... Spectacular!
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GREETING_0002443c_Oblivion_RESP1: Ha ha! We beat them! We slaughtered them all! Did you see? Did you see how well I fought?
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GREETING_0002443d_Oblivion_RESP1: Ha ha! We beat them! We slaughtered them all! Did you see? Did you see how well I fought?
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GREETING_00092d75_Oblivion_RESP1: Ha ha! We did it, my friend! The killer is dead, and this nightmare is just about over. All we have to do now is find a way out of here!
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GREETING_00024851_Oblivion_RESP1: Ha ha! We wiped the bastards out!
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_SE05Interrogate3_0001585c_Oblivio: Ha ha! Weren't expecting this, were you? You'll get no more enjoyment from me today, Herdir. All I know about is the note.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_NDTalk5_00002bc5_Knights_RESP1: Ha ha! Yes, yes! Well, it's settled then! Let us part now, and prepare ourselves, hmm? Finally, a worthy ambition...
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_MS49Choice1A_0002ad7d_Oblivion_RE: Ha ha, I knew you'd be up to it!
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_NDTalk3_00002bb5_Knights_RESP1: Ha! Finally! Well, as you can see, I'm in complete agreement. What's our next step?
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_MSShadowscaleChoice2B_0003559f_Ob: Ha! I expected as much from a Dark Brotherhood lapdog! I may not survive this fight, but I'll not make it easy for you!
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_Creatures_000b6c0f_Oblivion_RESP1: Ha! I knew they couldn't stand up to us!
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_SE01Choice2_000133da_Oblivion_RES: Ha! It's your funeral. I'm just here to warn people, not keep them out. Go ahead in. I'll be here to clean up the mess when you come out.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_SE03GrommokChamberTwoDem01_000671: Ha! Let's see them stop me after I rip this gate from its hinges!

ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_BravilTopic_00048919_Oblivion_RES: Ha! Members of the Thieves Guild in our fair town? What makes you think that? Never! Absurd! Such fine law-abiding citizens are we all!
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_UlrichLelandTopic_0003c2a6_Oblivi: Ha! That stupid s'wit! Throw me out of my home, will he? I'll show him a thing or two about messing with an Othran!
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_contract_000251be_Oblivion_RESP1: Ha! The great assassin needs help fulfilling a contract. You'll get no aid from me.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_EmfridDEMOchoice3_00028a30_Oblivi: Ha! They parade around in their fancy clothes and their expensive perfumes. What do they know? All fluff and no fiber. That's what I say.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GREETING_000164c4_Oblivion_RESP1: Ha! Those girls didn't stand a chance! Good job, Brawler. Here's your take. One more match and you'll advance again.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_MS31Selene01Negative_0000c1eb_Obl: Ha! Those will be the last words that leave your lips!
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GREETING_00035599_Oblivion_RESP1: Ha! Yes! That is an Argonian heart, of that I am sure! You have slain Scar-Tail! Well done! Please, take these boots as payment for your services!
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_Attack_0018d2b6_Oblivion_RESP1: Ha! You'll never take me down!
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_SE07AReplace_00013ffc_Oblivion_RE: Ha! You're mad! Syl has yet to be bested in any combat!
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_BarterFail_000981b7_Oblivion_RESP: Ha! You've got to be kidding me.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GuardTalk1_0006fdcd_Oblivion_RESP: Had something of a false alarm earlier. Some Khajiit, acting suspicious. Turns out he was just grooming his tail.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_SE07Arden_0001f3bb_Oblivion_RESP4: Had we been blessed with his constant presence, the Isles would be a Maniac's paradise.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_MS13Gate_000329e9_Oblivion_RESP6: Had we brought a City Watch contingent, we might have taken the sigil stone with minimal losses. Instead, Farwil wanted to prove his point.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_MS49DukeDeadMean_00091c58_Oblivio: Had you not been instrumental in getting this far, I'd put you down where you stand.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GlarthirTopic_0002365d_Oblivion_R: Hadn't you heard? He went crazy and killed Bernadette Peneles, poor girl.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_INFOGENERAL_00046590_Oblivion_RES: Hafid Hollowleg says that Jerall View has been doing good business.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_BrumaNQDResponses_0004659c_Oblivi: Hafid has a nice inn. I wonder if he doesn't drink away most of his profits, though.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_BrumaNQDQuestionResponses_0004659: Hafid takes care of his customers. It's a bit expensive, though.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_TG01MethredhelBrag_000521c7_Obliv: Hah! I'll have it before sunrise!
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_TG01TauntPlayer_0003566c_Oblivion: Hah! You are too late. I have the diary!
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_SE39Notebook_00078201_Oblivion_RE: Haha! Cindanwe lose her head looking for that. Show to Ranarr-Jo. He hate Cindanwe.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_StolenGold_00093552_Oblivion_RESP: Haha! She fooled you but good. This isn't her real amulet, but a clever fake. The true amulet has a red stone.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_LeyawiinTopic_000479ea_Oblivion_R: Hahaha! Isn't that rich? They think the things are stolen, but no! They are right there! They just don't know!
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GREETING_000479e9_Oblivion_RESP2: Hahaha! No! Really! It wasn't me! Never!
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_Dark08Choice1C_000275c6_Oblivion_: Hahaha! Oh, you're a funny one! Good, I'm glad one of us has a sense of humor about all of this. It will make our time here that much more enjoyable.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GREETING_000479af_Oblivion_RESP2: Hahaha! That one never gets old!
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_MS31Selene02Positive_0000c1ed_Obl: Hahaha! We made a solemn pact not to let anyone else join the gang. I can remember it clearly even though it was...
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GOODBYE_00081d96_Oblivion_RESP1: Hahahaha! You're so funny My Lord! I mean, your presence is intoxicating!
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_HELLO_000688f0_Oblivion_RESP1: Hail Blade. Do you have a moment to talk?
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_Dark10SancChoice1A_00032bf0_Obliv: Hail Sithis indeed, my child! Now listen closely. No longer will you receive your orders directly. Instead, you will visit secret dead drops.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_NDPelinalVisionSpeech_00002aaf_Kn: Hail knight! You seek my Relics with a worthy heart!
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_ND10KnightsHail_00002ca8_Knights_: Hail the glory of the Nine!
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_HELLO_00033541_Oblivion_RESP1: Hail! This area is extremely dangerous. I'd recommend leaving quickly.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GREETING_00002e4a_Oblivion_RESP1: Hail! What can Newheim the Portly do for you?
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_MQ04Conv_00037c3a_Oblivion_RESP1: Hail, Dragon Born! Hail, Martin Septim! Hail!
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_MQVoice_00037c37_Oblivion_RESP1: Hail, Dragon Born! Hail, Martin Septim! Hail!
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GREETING_0006a845_Oblivion_RESP1: Hail, Good Mage! Welcome to the Arcane University! Is there anything I can help you with?
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GREETING_0000294c_Knights_RESP1: Hail, Sir Knight! My brother and I have heard that you are founding a holy order of knights, and we would like to offer you our swords.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GREETING_00002951_Knights_RESP1: Hail, brave Knight. You do not know me, but you have saved me.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_NDTalkUmaril1_00002c5a_Knights_RE: Hail, brother. Do you find this waiting as hard to bear as I do? Why must we sit back and wait for Umaril to strike again?
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GREETING_00070289_Oblivion_RESP1: Hail, citizen! It's not often I see another rider out here on the roads. Times being what they are.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GREETING_0018bc1e_Oblivion_RESP1: Hail, citizen. I speak for the Emperor. Or... at least I did...
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_HELLO_0007028c_Oblivion_RESP1: Hail, fellow horseman! All's quiet in your stretch of the wild, I hope.

ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GREETING_0003a900_Oblivion_RESP1: Hail, friend! Good to see you again. So tell me, what brings you back to the Imperial City?
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GREETING_000224c8_Oblivion_RESP1: Hail, friend. Good to see you again. What can old Manheim help you with?
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GREETING_00038b35_Oblivion_RESP1: Hail, friend. I don't believe I've ever seen you down here in the Bloodworks before. Allow me to introduce myself. My name is Agronak gro-Malog.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GREETING_0003a8fd_Oblivion_RESP1: Hail, friend. I don't believe I've ever seen you down here in the Bloodworks before. Allow me to introduce myself. My name is Agronak gro-Malog.

ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_HELLO_0018baa6_Oblivion_RESP1: Hail, good citizen! How can I be of service?

ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_NDTalkDeadKnight1_00002ce9_Knight: Hail, sir knight. You seem more serious than usual. Is there something the matter?
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GREETING_0009f991_Oblivion_RESP1: Hail, traveler. You are welcome in Bleaker's Way.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GREETING_00025071_Oblivion_RESP1: Hail. We got plenty of rooms if you want one.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_Idle_0018b5bc_Oblivion_RESP1: Hairballs attacking me. They were everywhere. It was the strangest dream.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_SE14Attacks_0004681f_Oblivion_RES: Hale is still under attack. Or had you forgotten? No matter. I'm certain they can hold out a bit longer.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_INFOGENERAL_0006c297_Oblivion_RES: Half of the Council of Mages resigned when Traven took over the position of Arch-Mage.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_AngaTOPIC_0001ce9d_Oblivion_RESP1: Hallowed ground, home of the Forgotten Ones. A deep hole of shadow and despair. A truly wondrous place.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GREETING_00045750_Oblivion_RESP1: Halt, lawbreaker! Lord Sheogorath's justice demands reparations or it's the dungeon for you. Any stolen goods will be confiscated.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GREETING_00045753_Oblivion_RESP1: Halt, scofflaw! You can't afford to pay reparations for your crimes, so it's off to the dungeon for you. Your stolen goods are now forfeit.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GREETING_00018dc2_Oblivion_RESP1: Halt. Mortals are not permitted within the walls of holy Cylarne.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_INFOGENERAL_0003c1dc_Oblivion_RES: Hammer and Tongs is a good place to get your armor repaired. Just don't go early in the morning. Agnete usually isn't feeling so well then.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_MS22Refuse_0002c51c_Oblivion_RESP: Hand it over, and some day we will both laugh about this over drinks at the Tiber Septim. I will give you one last chance.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GREETING_00045755_Oblivion_RESP1: Hand over your stolen property, lawbreaker! If only you could afford to pay reparations... too bad, it's the dungeon for you.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_BRIBE_0018b2c4_Oblivion_RESP1: Handsomely done. A pleasure doing business with you.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_SQ08Wine_0018d92b_Oblivion_RESP2: Hang onto it for now. I must have six before I'll be truly satisfied. Then I'll have more than anyone else in Cyrodiil!
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GREETING_00047638_Oblivion_RESP1: Hannibal Traven, Arch-Mage of the Mages Guild. Welcome to the Arcane University.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GREETING_000488cd_Oblivion_RESP1: Hans Black-Nail, Castle Smith. It's a comfortable post. Gives me plenty of time to offer services to the public.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_SE10SheoJygglag_000913d4_Oblivion: Happens every time. The Greymarch starts, Order appears, and I become Jyggalag and wipe out My whole Realm.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GOODBYE_00081dc4_Oblivion_RESP1: Happy Big Head for having spoken to Lord Sheogorath!
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GREETING_0007ec66_Oblivion_RESP1: Happy times and happy days, my lady!
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GREETING_0007ec62_Oblivion_RESP1: Happy times and happy days, my lord!
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_MS47Counterspell_00030130_Oblivio: Hard to believe that anyone could find that too complicated. Lucky for you, I made a backup scroll. Here. But I don't want to see you again.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_INFOGENERAL_000241d6_Oblivion_RES: Hard to complain about living in Chorrol. We've got everything you need.

ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GREETING_0001fb2f_Oblivion_RESP1: Harrow awaits within. You should not linger here.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_SE07GreenmoteTopic_000139ae_Obliv: Harvested from the spore trees that dot Bliss, the Greenmote is refined and kept in storage for use by all.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_Question_0003e075_Oblivion_RESP1: Has Margarte ever talked to you about running a business?
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_Question_000465b6_Oblivion_RESP1: Has Tadrose Helas ever fixed a weapon for you?
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GREETING_00002dc8_Oblivion_RESP1: Has Tar-Meena been of use in gathering information about the Necromancers?
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_NDPelinalVisionSpeech_00002ab3_Kn: Has Umaril the Accursed found a way back? The foulest of a foul race. A thousand curses upon his unholy name!
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_SE09HaskillXaselm_0004036c_Oblivi: Has Your Grace no interest in exploration and discovery?
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GREETING_00035673_Oblivion_RESP1: Has a day passed yet? No?
