ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_Question_0003e257_Oblivion_RESP1: Have you seen Eitar making trouble again with the Khajiits and Argonians?
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_Question_0002d920_Oblivion_RESP1: Have you seen Erthor around town lately?
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_Question_00029682_Oblivion_RESP1: Have you seen Glistel and Malintus Ancrus together? Isn't it awful?
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_Question_0003e98a_Oblivion_RESP1: Have you seen Orintur and Eilonwy recently? They're always together.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_Question_000498c8_Oblivion_RESP1: Have you seen Othrelos moving around? It's like he sometimes just disappears.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_INFOGENERAL_0003c1c0_Oblivion_RES: Have you seen Rhano at the Fighters Guild use his sword? Impressive. He could teach us all a thing or two.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_Question_000465da_Oblivion_RESP1: Have you seen Right-Wind practicing with his sword? Very impressive.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_INFOGENERAL_000241c5_Oblivion_RES: Have you seen Valus Odiil recently? Spends all day in the tavern since his boys left.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_Question_00046623_Oblivion_RESP1: Have you seen Varon Vamori recently?
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_INFOGENERAL_0018bcc1_Oblivion_RES: Have you seen a land dreugh? We call them "Billies." Don't know why. Steer clear of them, though.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_HELLO_00081d61_Oblivion_RESP1: Have you seen anything cuter than that?!
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_Question_0003dfa3_Oblivion_RESP1: Have you seen how upset Tsrava gets by all the dogs near her house?
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GREETING_00026aaf_Oblivion_RESP1: Have you seen it? Have you seen the light? The bright, shining light? I know it. It waits for you. Speak with Ravel. He knows the way.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GREETING_0008faa1_Oblivion_RESP1: Have you seen my double, you cute little monkey? Have you?
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GREETING_000363c1_Oblivion_RESP1: Have you seen my friend Luronk? I'm worried about him.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_MS45Convo_000a2e58_Oblivion_RESP1: Have you seen my horse? I can't leave her here!
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_HELLO_0008152e_Oblivion_RESP1: Have you seen my sanity? It went by here just a moment ago.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_Question_0003403c_Oblivion_RESP1: Have you seen that new galleon down at the docks?
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_INFOGENERAL_00002a03_Knights_RESP: Have you seen that poor man staying in the Chapel Hall? I heard he's under some sort of curse.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_Question_00029686_Oblivion_RESP1: Have you seen the Bruiants and their dogs?
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_Question_0003dfc1_Oblivion_RESP1: Have you seen the Derics recently? They're always bickering with one another.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_SkingradTopic_0018d304_Oblivion_R: Have you seen the Oblivion Gate? I haven't dared leave the city since I heard about it.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_Question_00049965_Oblivion_RESP1: Have you seen the latest Black Horse Courier? Quite a story, don't you think?
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_INFOGENERAL_0005f219_Oblivion_RES: Have you seen the new Gatekeeper? I hear they built him with four arms and no head! Or was it four heads and no arms?
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_Question_00049925_Oblivion_RESP1: Have you seen the selection at Stonewall Shields?
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_LeyawiinTopicDecentius03_000479f3: Have you seen the statue? It's in the southwest corner of the town. That's the High Elf explorer, Torval the Pilot.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_Question_0003e990_Oblivion_RESP1: Have you seen the way that Voranil treats his servants? What a lout.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_SE36Choice5KillSelf_00061c4d_Obli: Have you seen those miserable souls on the Hill of Suicides? Do you think that kind of existence is any better than this?
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_Question_00049955_Oblivion_RESP1: Have you shopped at the Guilded Carafe?
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_Question_00049920_Oblivion_RESP1: Have you shopped for a shield at Stonewall?
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_HELLO_00038bba_Oblivion_RESP1: Have you spoken to Martin yet? The plans you found make it clear that time is short.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GREETING_00026baf_Oblivion_RESP1: Have you spoken to S'drassa yet? I hear she eagerly awaits your return.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_EronorDEMO1_0002ae26_Oblivion_RES: Have you spoken to Valus Odiil recently?
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_INFOGENERAL_0003c1b2_Oblivion_RES: Have you spoken to Wilbur at the Count's Arms? He knows a lot about fine wines.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GREETING_0002797f_Oblivion_RESP1: Have you spoken to the other guests yet? I suggest you get to know everyone. Who knows how long we'll be stuck in this house together?
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_Question_00047463_Oblivion_RESP1: Have you spoken with Adrienne today?
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GREETING_00072c92_Oblivion_RESP1: Have you spoken with Kishashi? Until she sends word you are a friend, I will not speak to you. Not another word.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_EmfridDEMOBittneldTOPIC_00028a32_: Have you spoken with him already? Please, say you have.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GREETING_0008fa7b_Oblivion_RESP1: Have you taken care of business yet? It's exhausing just waiting for you.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_Accuse_0003565b_Oblivion_RESP1: Have you taken leave of your senses? We already covered this! Now go away!
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_Nirnroot_0004e931_Oblivion_RESP1: Have you taken this to Sinderion in Skingrad yet? As far as alchemists go, you couldn't ask for a more knowledgeable source.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GREETING_0003013b_Oblivion_RESP1: Have you talked to Ancotar yet? Can he make us visible again?
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GREETING_00002998_Knights_RESP1: Have you talked to Areldur? What news is there of lifting this curse?
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GREETING_00022497_Oblivion_RESP1: Have you talked to my sons yet? I don't want them leaving on their own.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_MagesGuildTopic_00062bb4_Oblivion: Have you thought of joining? There's a free place to rest in every town for you. That's got to be worth something.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GREETING_00023675_Oblivion_RESP1: Have you... done... what I asked?
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_SEMiscQuestResponses_0008e4ae_Obl: Have zickle to it. Nobody does rebby zickles any more.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_SEThadonWaitingShort_000131db_Obl: Haven't I? Hmm, perhaps not. It felt like rather a long time, but then long times get longer when you're standing around thinking about them.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_MG04Choice2A_000300a1_Oblivion_RE: Haven't seen as many lately, what with the... well, you know. The murders.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_MS13GateHeardNot_00031c7c_Oblivio: Haven't seen it myself, and don't intend to. Being this close to one makes me nervous. The good news is nothing's come out since Farwil entered.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GREETING_000356e9_Oblivion_RESP1: Haven't written me off yet, huh? Good. If you're willing, there's more work to be done.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_SE05Conspiracy_00089531_Oblivion_: Haven't you got what you need? Shouldn't you be running off to tattle like a good little servant?
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_MS13Gate_00031c75_Oblivion_RESP1: Haven't you heard about these gates to Oblivion opening up all over Tamriel?
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_BlackwoodCompany_0002c7c8_Oblivio: Haven't you heard of 'em? Former soldiers, sent down into the swamps to take some territory back from the lizards. Talk to Vantus.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_INFOGENERAL_0007c0a8_Oblivion_RES: Haven't you heard? Baenlin's been killed! The Black Horse Courier has a special edition with the story. Here, take my copy.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_EaranaTopic_000253d2_Oblivion_RES: Haven't you seen her around town? She's either at the Grey Mare, or she's skulking around the Mages Guild, it seems.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GREETING_0002886b_Oblivion_RESP1: Haven't you taken care of that weapons shipment yet? Those weapons won't deliver themselves!
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_TG03BribeBeggar_000092b0_Oblivion: He also posted a guard so that her tomb wouldn't be disturbed. Used to be anyone could visit her, but now it's off limits to the public.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_TG03ElvenBust_00048979_Oblivion_R: He also posted a guard so that her tomb wouldn't be disturbed. Used to be anyone could visit her, but now it's off limits to the public.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_ReadyForAMatch_0002b1e3_Oblivion_: He also uses an enchanted shield called the Gray Aegis, which gives him some serious magic resistances. Your best bet is to just charge straight in!
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_OcatoTopic_000add3f_Oblivion_RESP: He and the rest of the Elder Council care nothing for Cyrodiil. They focus obsessively on the provinces, leaving us to fend for ourselves.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_MS27LastAyleidKing_000a6576_Obliv: He appears to have ruled for centuries past the fall of all the other Ayleid kingdoms, if the ancient chronicles are to be believed.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GREETING_0002ab50_Oblivion_RESP2: He asked me to deliver this note. I believe it is an invitation to visit him at his manor in the Imperial City.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_LorgrenBenirus_00003a71_Oblivion_: He became obsessed and decided that by using necromancy, he could prolong his own life.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_MS23RolandSad_0001d4c6_Oblivion_R: He became startled for a moment and tossed Relfina aside. She fell to the ground and I heard a sickening crack as her head struck a stone.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_SE07GreymarchTopic_00091015_Obliv: He believes that by you ruling either Mania or Dementia, you'll be able to effectively inspire his people and lead His forces. I hope He's right.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_SE07GreymarchTopic_0009127f_Obliv: He believes that by you ruling either Mania or Dementia, you'll be able to effectively inspire his people and lead His forces. I hope He's right.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_ND06KellenRumors_00002bd0_Knights: He came here all the way from Hammerfell, didn't he? He must be very ill.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_ND06KellenQuestion_00002b09_Knigh: He came here from Hammerfell seeking a cure, but, ahh... well, there's really nothing that can be done for him, I think.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GREETING_00025033_Oblivion_RESP3: He can be found at the Arcane University in the Imperial City. I'm very disappointed in you.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_CharGenMain_0005319a_Oblivion_RES: He can help us. He must help us.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_ICAllNQDQuestionResponses_000498a: He can teach you a lot about using light armor.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_ICAllNQDQuestionResponses_000498e: He can teach you how to steal the boot right off a lich.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_MG10Choice2A_00035f50_Oblivion_RE: He can't be bothered to come check on his own project, so he sends someone who knows nothing about it. And this is supposed to help?
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_PrimoAntoniusTopic_00028254_Obliv: He can't be the killer! He can't! I won't believe it! Get away from me!
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_SEManiaRumorResponses_00061c6d_Ob: He can't leave! Bliss must be protected!
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_SEWildernessRumorResponses_00061c: He can't leave. He still has work to do.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_FaelianTopic_0002ff10_Oblivion_RE: He comes back every night to be with Atraena, but only for a few hours. I swear, that High Elf is going to wind up dead if he keeps living like this.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_SEDyusTormentTopic_000807af_Obliv: He could not bring himself to destroy the knowledge that I represent, which is to say, precise predictions of all that is, has been, and will be.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_MQ06MythicDawnAlarm_0001fb3a_Obli: He dares to touch the sacred Xarxes! Kill him!
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_SE46Choice1_0008fabc_Oblivion_RES: He decided to test the theory. Cast a spell. Split us all in two. Do we get twice the work done? No! Ridiculous.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_SEMiscQuestResponses_0008dc9c_Obl: He definitely doesn't live with Zoe Malene.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_ND07LathonGreetB2_00002b84_Knight: He did. I owe him my life. He faced the evil wraith of Lord Vlindrel, and told me to run.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_ChorrolNQDQuestionResponses_00023: He did? Excellent. I wonder if he got "The Lusty Argonian Maid" in. I've been dying to read that.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_defaulted_0002428f_Oblivion_RESP1: He didn't finish out a contract in Skingrad. Suppose I shouldn't be surprised. He's raw, like you. Go and find out what's wrong with him.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_FGDefault1_00024294_Oblivion_RESP: He didn't? Hmph. This doesn't sit well with me. Not well at all. Still, the job got done. Let's hope your friend Maglir has learned a lesson here.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_TG06WhereIsShum_0000bf93_Oblivion: He doesn't leave Castle Skingrad often. At ten he heads over to the West Weald Inn. Then at noon he goes to the Colovian Trader.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_BravilNQDResponses_00046589_Obliv: He doesn't seem particularly happy. I think he'd rather spend his time painting.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_VaronVamoriTopic_0002f177_Oblivio: He even stole her Mages' Staff!
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GREETING_00035586_Oblivion_RESP4: He failed, of course. His body's around here somewhere. But he got in a pretty good hit. If I don't get some rest I'm probably dead anyway.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_MS16Choice5A_00028ac8_Oblivion_RE: He fled from Chorrol with his family, and was never heard from again. Only his small son Reynald was found, wandering alone in the wilderness.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_Recommendation_000174f3_Oblivion_: He flew into a rage! I didn't even understand some of his ranting, but he said that our days are numbered, and then he stormed out!
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_Recommendation_0002e5e5_Oblivion_: He gave poor Vidkun the same task, and we never saw him again. I'm reasonably sure there's a connection, but I can't prove it.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_CheydinhalNQDResponses_0003e994_O: He goes on and on about the guild. He's very proud of it. I understand he teaches Illusion there now, as well.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_LeyawiinNQDQuestionResponses_0003: He goes on and on. I'm not sure he's ever said anything useful, though.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_TGHieronymusLex_00064463_Oblivion: He got reassigned, to Anvil I think. Without him around, all this hustle and bustle about the Gray Fox will go away.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_SE02Gatekeeper_0008e54f_Oblivion_: He guards the Gates of Madness. Don't get too close to him. He'll kill you, and it will leave a mess in my town.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_SE02Gatekeeper_0008e4cf_Oblivion_: He guards the Gates of Madness. See for yourself. He's about to destroy a party of adventurers.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_ND07LathonGreetB3_00002b82_Knight: He had learned that Sir Berich had once been a questing knight, like us. He had found the Greaves and Sword of the Crusader, but then turned to evil.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_ICAllNQDResponses_00049941_Oblivi: He has a good selection of soul gems and other things.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_TG02WhoIsLex_0003fd46_Oblivion_RE: He has a grudge against the Thieves Guild and the Gray Fox in particular. Lex has made it his personal mission to capture him.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_SE43Ushnar_00072dbf_Oblivion_RESP: He has a nice dog. I like dogs.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_BravilNQDResponses_00046627_Obliv: He has a way with words, that's for sure. You could learn a lot from him.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_LeyawiinNQDResponses_0003dfaf_Obl: He has a wonderful collection of books. I don't know why he needs to act so tough all the time.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_MG09Choice5B_00022bd8_Oblivion_RE: He has disguised his nature from most, but cannot hide it from the Council of Mages. So, he approached us with an accord.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_SE06HelpAttackA1_00012cca_Oblivio: He has failed to consider the risks of his plan. If the Mazken have prepared an ambush along that route, we would be slaughtered.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_ND04CarodusGreeting2_00002ad1_Kni: He has found a use for me, however. The priests have asked me to stay to protect the chapel. After what happened in Anvil, they are afraid.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_MG13Choice1A_0000399e_Oblivion_RE: He has requested that you personally travel to Skingrad to obtain this information.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_DAMolagBalSpeech_00037844_Oblivio: He has sworn an oath: never to raise a weapon against another man again. I want him to break that oath, and damn himself forever.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GatherClues_000038c9_Oblivion_RES: He has taken to asking for money from others to purchase spirits. A porter's wage does not befit his habit.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_defaulted_0002ee69_Oblivion_RESP2: He hasn't reported to the client at all. Get yourself down to Bravil and find Maglir. Make sure that contract of his gets done. And send him to me.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_ErthorTopic_0001c1b2_Oblivion_RES: He hasn't shown up here in a while. I assumed he was still out at Bleak Flats Cave, where he usually stays.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_DarkSancTalk4_00034055_Oblivion_R: He he. Remember, Dear Brother, I can't always be there to get you out of trouble!
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_DarkSancTalk4_00034056_Oblivion_R: He he. Remember, Dear Sister, I can't always be there to get you out of trouble!
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_SkingradNQDResponses_0003c257_Obl: He is a bit nutty. Probably just a harmless old fool, though.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_TG02WhoIsLex_0003fd46_Oblivion_RE: He is a fool of a Captain in the Imperial Watch. He's a real law and order type.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_TrainingQuestTopic_0018bc62_Obliv: He is a guest of the Legion, at the Legion Headquarters in Cyrodiil. Seek him there.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GREETING_0005d504_Oblivion_RESP1: He is a hard master, but he delivers. I gave my word, and an Orc honors his word.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_MartinTopic_0003406c_Oblivion_RES: He is a priest in the Chapel of Akatosh in Kvatch. He never knew that he was Uriel Septim's son.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_TG06Theranis_000104de_Oblivion_RE: He is a skillful thief. I seem to remember something about him. Something recent. Something important. Something is missing in my hand...
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_TG10FindJakben_0009ded9_Oblivion_: He is a very private man and does not leave his home often. He has a rare skin condition that forces him to sleep during the day.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_TG10BribeBeggar_00016254_Oblivion: He is an odd one. Keeps to himself mostly. Only goes out after dark. A real night owl.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_TG10FindJakben_00048977_Oblivion_: He is an odd one. Keeps to himself mostly. Only goes out after dark. A real night owl.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_MannimarcoTopic_00009225_Oblivion: He is an old and powerful Necromancer. Traven will recognize the name, even if you do not.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_SEThadonTopic_0004301f_Oblivion_R: He is aware you are here, and should be waiting for you. See him at once.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_TGHieronymusLex_00007e04_Oblivion: He is captain of the Imperial Watch. He is pursuing a personal vendetta against the Thieves Guild and the Gray Fox.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_MQ15MankarRant_0008c240_Oblivion_: He is daedroth! TAMRIEL AE DAEDROTH!
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_ThoronirTopic_0000bc97_Oblivion_R: He is dirty. Plain and simple. I don't trust him at all. Won't even come to merchant meetings and sets his prices so low, he undercuts everyone.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GREETING_00014b4e_Oblivion_RESP1: He is gone, but hope is not lost. We have a rare opportunity here, but I hesitate to do what must be done.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_TG03WhereArmand_00034e9d_Oblivion: He is in hiding. Armand is accused of stealing the bust of Llathasa Indarys from Cheyhindal. They say Count Indarys himself filed the charges.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_SE11Dyus_00014b53_Oblivion_RESP5: He is kept locked away to prevent curious beings from using his knowledge to subvert the personal choices of other creatures.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_LordDradTOPIC_0001ec52_Oblivion_R: He is my husband, a kind and gentle man. He has given me everything I might ever desire.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_ValusOdiilTopic_000224ac_Oblivion: He is not coming with us? I think I understand, and it is better that he remain safe. Though I wonder why he has asked you to take his place.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_SE05Conspiracy_000895e0_Oblivion_: He is not known for his ability to remain hidden.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_TG10FindJakben_0009ded7_Oblivion_: He is somewhere in the house. Flee thief, while you still have the chance!
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_TGGrayFox_00000a1b_Oblivion_RESP2: He is the King of Thieves in Cyrodiil. You could think of him as our guildmaster, although he would deny that title.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_TGGrayFox_00000a42_Oblivion_RESP1: He is the King of Thieves in Cyrodiil. You could think of him as our guildmaster, although he would deny that title.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_SESheogorathTopic_00091019_Oblivi: He is the Prince of Madness. The ruler of the Shivering Isles.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_SESheogorathTopic_00078ca3_Oblivi: He is the Prince of Madness. The ruler of the Shivering Isles. It is by His will that we exist in this place. He is our Lord and Master.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_TGFence05_000165ec_Oblivion_RESP1: He is the best fence in the Thieves Guild. He operates from the Elven Gardens in the Imperial City.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_TGFence05_00073b88_Oblivion_RESP1: He is the best fence in the Thieves Guild. He spends time in the guild hall, and in the Elven Gardens.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_SE07Arden_0001f3ba_Oblivion_RESP3: He is the bringer of pain and pleasure; the blade that cuts through our sins like a scythe through wheat.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_NDUmarilTopic_00002bf9_Knights_RE: He is the enemy of all who walk free on Tamriel today. A survivor of the ancient race of Ayleid slavemasters who once ruled Cyrodiil.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_TGGrayFox_0000a255_Oblivion_RESP1: He is the greatest of all thieves. I have heard it said that he stole his gray cowl from Nocturnal herself.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_NivanDalviluTOPIC_0001ece2_Oblivi: He is the head of our family. He works powerful magic, but his true gift is compromise. He is a wise, wise leader.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_NDSirRodericTopic_00002a7b_Knight: He is too modest to tell you himself, but he was a hero of the War of the Bend'r-Mahk.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_NDLathonGreetB_00002a77_Knights_R: He is! I've been his squire for almost two years now.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_SE11CiirtaGreeting2_00016b6f_Obli: He is? Then the Greymarch has begun again? If that is so, then why are you here?
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_RaynilDralasTopic_0003842e_Oblivi: He isn't in right now, so you should be clear to check it out. Just don't tell anyone I gave the key to you.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_MS09ImIn_00053724_Oblivion_RESP6: He just threatened to... hurt me if I got in his way. I think the gold changed him. I really do. He wasn't the man I met seven years ago.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_BrumaNQDResponses_000465be_Oblivi: He keeps busy. Repairing weapons, training light armor techniques, keeping track of Skjorta....
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GREETING_0000a0f6_Oblivion_RESP3: He killed them all. Just... slaughtered them.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_NevilleTopic_00028264_Oblivion_RE: He killed them! All of those people! We... we have to get him before he gets us! We have to kill that murdering swine!
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_KingofWormsTopic_0000a0fe_Oblivio: He killed them, one by one. Volanaro was last, I think. He was trying to run away, but he didn't make it, did he?
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_ICAllNQDResponses_0004989c_Oblivi: He knows a lot about it. Plus, he'll teach others how to use heavy armor.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_CheydinhalNQDResponses_0003e96a_O: He knows a lot about running his store. Of course, he's not the easiest person to talk to.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GREETING_0002d928_Oblivion_RESP2: He knows to tell Adrienne that you're the one who rescued him. You should be able to tell her you've completed her little task.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_NivanDalviluTOPIC_0001ebdb_Oblivi: He leads the Dalvilu family. He is a wise man, and a powerful wizard.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_HrolUlfgarTOPIC_0001ece1_Oblivion: He leads the Ulfgar clan. He is slow to anger, but fierce with his axe. All the clan values his leadership and judgement.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_MS38Next_0001dc33_Oblivion_RESP3: He leaves his house early each morning. Watch him and report back to me here, at midnight as usual. Make sure he doesn't notice you!
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_VenaPetilius_00026b49_Oblivion_RE: He lives alone now. Moved into a cabin not far outside of town. It's near where he buried Vena. I understand he visits her grave every day.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_TrainingQuestTopic_00062450_Obliv: He lives in Bruma. You should look for him there.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_SorisArenimTopic_0002f1f8_Oblivio: He lives in the Talos Plaza district of the Imperial City. He's the one who has Ardaline's staff now.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_ToutiusSextiusTopic_0001dc47_Obli: He lives in the large house between the Low Gate and the East Bridge. Alone -- suspicious, don't you think?
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_SE43Bhisha_00072dbc_Oblivion_RESP: He loves dogs. Dogs like sticks. Dogs like meat. I wonder if they like meat on a stick?
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_BrumaNQDResponses_0004664f_Oblivi: He loves the place. I've also heard he's quite an accomplished alchemist.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_TGHieronymusLex_0000c051_Oblivion: He made things very difficult for the Thieves Guild for a while.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_RogueMage_0002fd69_Oblivion_RESP2: He may have more tricks up his sleeve.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_SEWildernessRumorResponses_000617: He may help protect us. We can only hope.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_ND06KellenQuestion_00002b09_Knigh: He may know more of the story than I. Perhaps you should speak with him, if he's feeling well enough.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GREETING_000541d0_Oblivion_RESP1: He may look slow... okay, he is slow. But what do you expect for this price?
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_DASheogorathChoice1_00026ae0_Obli: He might appear. Because it's raining. He loves the rain. Because it's wet. Or because it's rainy. Not so sure.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_KingofWormsTopic_0000a0f9_Oblivio: He might come back if he knows I'm still here. I'm not staying here!
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_SE46Choice4_0008fabb_Oblivion_RES: He might offer you the same deal. But that guy is crazy. Trust me.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GaltusPreviaTOPIC_0002d711_Oblivi: He must be in Nonwyll somewhere. Let's get there quickly.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_SE02Gatekeeper_0007eaf7_Oblivion_: He must die. It's the only way.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_CGBaurusA_0001e8e6_Oblivion_RESP5: He must have given it to you for a reason. Did he say why?
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_JorundrTopic_0005379a_Oblivion_RE: He must have moved the loot when I left our campsite to get us supplies. Brave of him to bury it so close to town.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_KnightsofThorn_00031ebe_Oblivion_: He must realize he'll be ruling Cheydinhal one day. That's a responsibility I aim to make him ready for.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_BrumaNQDQuestionResponses_0004665: He must really know all the fighters by now. And, from what I've heard, he knows a good bit about alchemy as well.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_MG12FithragaerWho_00095025_Oblivi: He must've told them we were coming! We've got to get our hands on him, before he tells them anything else!
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_MankarCamoranTopic_00015882_Obliv: He never comes here. He stays in Carac Agaialor with Ruma and Raven. But these caves eventually lead to the Terrace of Dawn in front of his palace.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_MundaneAmulet_00038b02_Oblivion_R: He never really trusted anyone else in the group, and before he secured the treasure in that cave, he had a special enchantment placed upon it.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_ClaudeMaricTopic_0002c525_Oblivio: He never tells us anything, though. Just between the two of us, this one thinks Maric is cheating him. In fact, this one is sure of it.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_MQ02JauffreD3_0001e74c_Oblivion_R: He never told me anything else about the baby, but I knew it was his son. From time to time he would ask about the child's progress.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_BravilNQDResponses_0004657a_Obliv: He obviously takes great pride in the lodge.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_MS29ThoronirBad_0000bca2_Oblivion: He outright refuses to join the Society or even discuss the matter. We are convinced he is up to no good.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_LeyawiinNQDQuestionResponses_0003: He pays his debts, but his love of dogs is just odd. I've heard he leaves meat in his backyard to attract them.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_CheydinhalTopic_0004e8d1_Oblivion: He pays peanuts. And thinks it entitles him to chew us out 18 hours a day? Sometimes I wonder if I made a mistake coming here.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_NDProphetTopic_00002a96_Knights_R: He preaches every day outside the Chapel. Go and listen. You'll see.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_NDProphetTopic_00002a8b_Knights_R: He preaches in Anvil. Appeared right after the attack on the Chapel there. Sounds like the usual doom-saying nonsense.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_NDProphetTopic_00002a87_Knights_R: He preaches most of the day across the street from the Chapel.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_NDProphetTopic_00002a85_Knights_R: He preaches outside the Chapel of Dibella in Anvil. No one knows where he comes from, but he speaks the holy word like I've never heard before.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_TG03HowToHelp_000092b7_Oblivion_R: He probably won't believe you, so you may have to persuade him. Hopefully he will at least go and check it out.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_SE02Gatekeeper_0008e4ee_Oblivion_: He protects the Gates of Madness. He'll kill anyone who gets near. He's about to destroy some adventurers up there now.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_SE02Gatekeeper_0008e551_Oblivion_: He protects the Gates of Madness. He'll kill anyone who gets near... anyone except Relmyna Verenim. She's staying upstairs right now.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_LeyawiinTopicDecentius03_000479f3: He purchased the Eight Islands... the site of White Gold Tower and the Imperial City... from the beastfolk natives for the secret of literacy.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_MS43Staff_0004f8b6_Oblivion_RESP2: He ran off with someone else, so now the ring belongs to you. The owner of the shop called it the Ring of Eidolon's Edge. I think you'll like it.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_MS46FatherInLaw_00033efe_Oblivion: He read something about cheap land being offered by the government. Of course nobody said anything about the swarming goblins.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_NevilleTopic_000286f8_Oblivion_RE: He reminds me of the guards under my father's employ. Strict, no-nonsense, and ready to fight at a moment's notice.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_NelsTheNaughtyTopic_00028178_Obli: He reminds me of you. Uncultured, unwashed and generally uninteresting.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_MS27LastAyleidKing_0002e5cf_Obliv: He ruled the last Ayleid city in Cyrodiil during the First Era, three centuries after the Fall of White Gold Tower.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_NorbertLellesTOPIC_0003572b_Obliv: He runs Lelles' Quality "Mercandise." Ha! Not a bad sort. You can usually find him in his store.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_NorbertLellesTOPIC_000356bc_Obliv: He runs Lelles' Quality Merchandise here in Anvil. He's been having problems with break-ins, though, and he's hired us to put a stop to it.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_CheydinhalNQDQuestionResponses_00: He runs a nice store, but Mach-Na is a grouchy old man.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GREETING_000479dc_Oblivion_RESP2: He said any Argonian can kick any Khajiit's butt to breakfast any day of the week. You believe that?
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GREETING_000479dd_Oblivion_RESP2: He said any Khajiit can kick any Argonian's butt to breakfast any day of the week. You believe that?
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_SE41Aquanostrum_0006ea4d_Oblivion: He said if I let him stay for free, he'd tell me how to cure my sickness! How fortuitous!
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_KingofWormsTopic_0000a0fe_Oblivio: He said something about Echo Cave, and destroying the Mages Guild. Then he looked right at me, and grinned!
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_ND07LathonGreetB3_00002b82_Knight: He said that Sir Berich's tomb was in Underpall Cave -- which is no cave, but some kind of buried keep.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_MS23RalsaGreet_0001db1f_Oblivion_: He said to tell you that the matter he needs help with is of the utmost importance to the citizens of the Imperial City.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_RaynilDralasTopic_00032679_Oblivi: He seemed to be such a likeable fellow.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GREETING_00002978_Knights_RESP2: He seemed to know you were coming... told me to wait for you. And here you are!
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_BrumaNQDQuestionResponses_000465e: He seems gifted with a blade. Can't blame the Fighters Guild for having him train others.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_NevilleTopic_000286fb_Oblivion_RE: He seems on edge, doesn't he? I guess you can take the man out of the Legion, but you can never take the Legion out of the man.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_NDProphetTopic_00002a88_Knights_R: He seems to be different than your usual self-proclaimed holy man.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_SE39Relan_000781f0_Oblivion_RESP2: He seldom kills things right away. It takes awhile. Sometimes he talks to them while cutting them open. But still, he gets the job done.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_OcatoTopic_000add41_Oblivion_RESP: He served Emperor Uriel for many years, and so far he has done well in an impossible situation.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_BaurusTopic_0006b83c_Oblivion_RES: He served with honor. No Blade could ask for higher praise.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_FawilTopic_000c4530_Oblivion_RESP: He should be around somewhere. If he's not in the lodge, I'd try looking for him in Cheydinhal.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_MartinTopic_0001e8a9_Oblivion_RES: He should be around the camp somewhere. He was with the survivors we rescued from the Chapel of Akatosh.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_SkingradNQDResponses_0003c1cb_Obl: He should be kicked out of town before one of his experiments turns this place into a wasteland.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_TG04GivePick_00035fb7_Oblivion_RE: He showed me an inscription on the inside, 'To Alessia.' That had to be the Countess of Leyawiin. The damn ring was stolen property!
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_JauffreTopic_000223ca_Oblivion_RE: He sleeps here in the Priory House.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_JauffreTopic_000223cd_Oblivion_RE: He sleeps with us here in the Priory House.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_VaronVamoriTopic_0002c6a9_Oblivio: He sold it, eh? Well, this just keeps getting worse.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_ND04Mace_00002acc_Knights_RESP2: He stayed in the Chapel of Leyawiin for months, attempting the test over and over. He hardly ate. Hardly slept.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_ICAllNQDResponses_000498bc_Oblivi: He still teaches others, though. Of course, you have to try to avoid all the Old Man Dust.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_ICAllNQDQuestionResponses_000498b: He still teaches, though he lost his passion for it after the Levitation Act was passed. Can't say I blame him.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_ICAllNQDResponses_00049944_Oblivi: He supports all of your enchanting needs.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_Nd05Julianos_00002ae9_Knights_RES: He teaches us: "Know the truth. Observe the law. When in doubt, seek wisdom from the wise."
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_SE39Notebook_00078201_Oblivion_RE: He think she keep our secrets in it. Look. Look! It nothing but gibberish. My neighbors, they weird. Now, I must go bite something's head off. Bye.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_SEMiscQuestResponses_00082620_Obl: He thinks his house will collapse on him. Can't even sleep because of it.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_OcatoTopic_000add3c_Oblivion_RESP: He thinks to use his position as head of the Elder Council to make himself Emperor. He will not succeed.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_RolandJensericTopic_0001d24c_Obli: He threw his lover to the ground and turned his attention on me. Luckily, I managed to run back into the street and escape his grasp.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_ThoronirTopic_0001d03d_Oblivion_R: He told me of his intentions to donate all of the money and inventory to the local temple. He also agreed to buy and sell merchandise at fair prices.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_SE32SiegeVitharn_00078fd8_Oblivio: He told me that the spirits of my people would remain bound here, replaying our cowardice, as a lesson to those that thwarted his will.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_SE43Ushnar_00072dc0_Oblivion_RESP: He told me the dog can smell its food on anyone. Ushnar let that dog tear that poor Khajiit apart.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_TG06BookLostHistories_0000bf83_Ob: He told me to give this message to any member of the Thieves Guild that asked about him or a book.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_NDSirRodericTopic_00002a7d_Knight: He told me to run, but I shouldn't have listened. I should have stayed and helped him. Maybe together we could have defeated this wraith.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_HELLO_00053755_Oblivion_RESP1: He told you where it is?
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_RaynilDralasTopic_0003843c_Oblivi: He tracked the vampire to this house. When he entered the place around noon, Bradon was sleeping. He was able to slay him at that point.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_ND04Mace_00002acb_Knights_RESP2: He tried to reach the mace again and again, failing each time. He became obsessed with it, refusing food or drink for days.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_MartinTopic_0006bed9_Oblivion_RES: He truly was the Dragonborn... the last, and perhaps the greatest of all the Septims.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GlarthirTopic_0002a86e_Oblivion_R: He turned up dead. I guess someone finally got tired of his crazy behavior.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_MS08Hunt_0001fdbb_Oblivion_RESP3: He uses the dungeons under Fort Grief as the hunting grounds. I was placed here because he knew someone would go looking for me.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_MS14TivelaHeard_0001c1c5_Oblivion: He usually comes out to eat dinner and sleep, but two days ago, he didn't come out at all. At first, I wasn't worried. He does that occasionally.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_SEDunrootBurrowTopic_0001338b_Obl: He wants you to learn for yourself. Learn, grow, experience. It's his way. I shouldn't say more. But the Burrow, it's northeast of New Sheoth.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_NelsTheNaughtyTopic_00028182_Obli: He was a buffoon, but I didn't wish him dead, you cold-hearted villain!
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_SQ10BjalfiDead_00061422_Oblivion_: He was a good man when I married him, but greed took a hold of his heart. While I'm not happy he's dead, I'm glad he's at peace.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_MS16Choice6A_00028ac9_Oblivion_RE: He was a thief, not a farmer. The only reason to establish such a place would be to stay out of the Chorrol Guard's sight.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_SeridurTopic_0001da5b_Oblivion_RE: He was a traitor. Thanks to you, the Order lives on. Long live the Order!
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_HaderusGoldwineTopic_0002ad7e_Obl: He was a valiant warrior in his day, and inspired us all to be our best. I heard he personally led one of the first retaliations to the attack.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_PrimoAntoniusTopic_0002948d_Obliv: He was a young man and now he's dead, slaughtered like a lamb. I've got my eyes on you, stranger. Don't you forget that.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_VidkunTopic_0002e5e8_Oblivion_RES: He was an Associate, just like yourself. Perhaps not the brightest, but very eager. He was given his assignment from Falcar, and disappeared.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_MS16Choice5A_00028ac8_Oblivion_RE: He was assigned to obtain a very valuable item for me. He succeeded, but decided to keep this item for himself. An unfortunate decision.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_Gang_0003d30e_Oblivion_RESP2: He was carrying a precious family heirloom with him when he was lured out to their lair. It was a small ring given to him on our wedding day.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_NDProphetStartA1_00002c80_Knights: He was cast down by Pelinal Whitestrake. But Umaril's spirit survived, and now he has returned to seek vengeance upon the gods.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_NDUmarilTopic_00002bf8_Knights_RE: He was defeated, but not destroyed, by Pelinal the Crusader. Now he has returned to seek vengeance against the gods.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_Recommendation_000174f3_Oblivion_: He was furious when I told him I'd helped you, and then when I threatened to report him to the Council of Mages, I thought he was going to kill me!
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_JorundrTopic_00053279_Oblivion_RE: He was going to skip town on Arnora, but got arrested before making good on his escape. Now she has no money left at all. Poor thing.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_Unseen_00025345_Oblivion_RESP1: He was here a second ago...
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_MehrunesDagonTopic_00092e8b_Obliv: He was involved with Jagar Tharn's plot against the empire years ago. It doesn't surprise me to find his hand in the current calamity.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_StolenPainting_00031508_Oblivion_: He was kind and noble, which is difficult to convey on canvas. I am afraid other than that, I cannot offer much more information.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_LorgrenBenirus_00003a71_Oblivion_: He was mostly harmless, until the fateful day he came across a tome bearing the evil magic of necromancy.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_SE07TheFringeTopic_0009130c_Obliv: He was right about that. I can feel it. In My bones. The little ones.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_PrimoAntoniusTopic_00028191_Obliv: He was so young... so innocent. That boy was destined for greatness. Who could have done such a thing?
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_NDUmarilTopic_00002bf9_Knights_RE: He was struck down by Pelinal, but by his art Umaril had bound himself to the realm of his mistress, the Daedra Lord Meridia.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_JskarTopic_0000a100_Oblivion_RESP: He was the only one left?
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_SE07Arden_0001f3bb_Oblivion_RESP2: He was the sovereign of thought and a regnant artist. To call him a simple craftsman would not suffice; know him as the Artificer Superior.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_MS16Choice5A_00028ac8_Oblivion_RE: He was very good at obtaining things from people who did not want to part with. A professional thief, to put it bluntly.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_MQ05Gwinas_00094c3b_Oblivion_RESP: He was very upset when he found out I didn't have his book for him. I doubt he'll be in any mood to talk to you about it.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_ND07LathonGreetD2A_00002c0b_Knigh: He was worried that the Sword may have been turned to evil. That it may have to be reconsecrated on the altar of its creator, the divine Arkay.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_ND07LathonGreetD2B_00002c09_Knigh: He was worried that the Sword may have been turned to evil. That it may have to be reconsecrated on the altar of its creator, the divine Arkay.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_NDCrusadersRelicsTopic_00002a80_K: He went alone into the White Gold Tower, challenged the Ayleid sorceror-king Umaril to single combat, and slew him.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_BaurusTopic_0006b838_Oblivion_RES: He will not be forgotten. He goes to Aetherius to join the other fallen heroes of the Blades.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GREETING_0002e71e_Oblivion_RESP3: He will reward you greatly for escorting me home and closing the Oblivion Gate.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GREETING_00031eba_Oblivion_RESP3: He will reward you greatly for escorting me home and closing the Oblivion Gate.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_SEThadonTopic_0008f178_Oblivion_R: He will suffer greatly at the hands of Lord Sheogorath.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_NDUmarilTopic_00002bfc_Knights_RE: He will trouble us no more, thanks to you.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GREETING_00035672_Oblivion_RESP3: He wishes to meet with you south of the Cursed Mine outside of town, after 2 AM.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_SE07GreymarchTopic_0009112b_Obliv: He wishes you to gain the respect of the people, to be a leader once He is gone. It is an interesting concept.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_AldosOthranTopic_0003c2b1_Oblivio: He won't be hard to find, just follow the smell of stale mead.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_SE02Gatekeeper_0008e553_Oblivion_: He won't bother those blessed by Lord Sheogorath. You, however, will die trying to get the keys from my child.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_MS11ErlineOpinion_00038444_Oblivi: He works at night, and has to sleep during the day. Why does that make him a vampire?
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_OgreSlaves_00026b66_Oblivion_RESP: He works them in Bleak Mine. It's terrible. The guards beat the creatures mercilessly. That's all I can tell you. Now please, go.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_TG08GiveStone_00014705_Oblivion_R: He would have had it destroyed or taken it from them and kept it under lock and key in the palace.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_TG08GiveStone_0001cf35_Oblivion_R: He would have had it destroyed or taken it from them and kept it under lock and key in the palace.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_SE07JyggalagTopic_0009100f_Oblivi: He'll be here soon, and I'll be gone. Can't say I like the sound of that. I like the sound of other things, though. Like birds. And bones cracking.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_SE07JyggalagTopic_00091017_Oblivi: He'll be here soon, and I'll be gone. Can't say I like the sound of that. I like the sound of other things, though. Like birds. And bones cracking.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_MQ06JauffreB_0008b617_Oblivion_RE: He'll be in the Great Hall, reading. He's hardly taken time to sleep since you left.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_JauffreTopic_000223d0_Oblivion_RE: He'll be sleeping, like anyone with a lick of sense... in the Priory House.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_TrainingQuestTopic_0018d2ab_Obliv: He'll be truly famous one day. Word already spreads about his skill... I think someone saw him at Faregyl Inn not too long ago. You should try there.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_RolandJensericTopic_0001da6c_Obli: He'll make a fine replacement for Seridur. It's the least we can do.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_ICAllNQDResponses_00049899_Oblivi: He'll train you in how to use heavy armor, if you can pay for his time.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_SE46Choice4_0008fb62_Oblivion_RES: He'll try to offer you the same kind of deal, that handsome devil, but he can't be trusted! Make the right decision.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_MS08UrsanneAvenged_0001fdbe_Obliv: He'll... not be needing it any longer, and I want you to have it. I'll not take no for an answer.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_BittneldTopic_0002ba45_Oblivion_R: He's Captain of the Chorrol Guard. During the day, you can usually find him on patrol with us around the city.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_SE02Gatekeeper_0008e552_Oblivion_: He's Relmyna's crowning achievement. The Gatekeeper keeps out people who don't belong in the Shivering Isles.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_TGHieronymusLex_00017c46_Oblivion: He's a Captain of the Imperial Watch. He is pursuing a personal vendetta against the Thieves Guild and the Gray Fox.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_NelsTheNaughtyTopic_000286db_Obli: He's a Nord. Even a complete idiot could see that. So what does that say about you?
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_NelsTheNaughtyTopic_00028177_Obli: He's a Nord. Mead-swilling barbarians, all of them.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_LeyawiinNQDQuestionResponses_0003: He's a bit crazy for dogs, from what I hear. He pays bets on time, though.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_NDProphetTopic_00002a96_Knights_R: He's a blessing on this town. The only one to have made any sense out of the terrible tragedy at the Chapel.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_MS38Next_00023669_Oblivion_RESP2: He's a clever one, no doubt about it. Eyes in the back of his head, always seems to know when I'm watching.  But that's where you come in.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_TGGrayFox_00035dca_Oblivion_RESP1: He's a fairy tale. The Imperial Watch pretends there is a thief king named the Gray Fox who controls all the thieves in Cyrodiil.
