ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GREETING_000314f5_Oblivion_RESP1: Hello again. I'm sorry, but I have little time to chat. I am quite busy with affairs of state and all that.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GREETING_0001f36a_Oblivion_RESP1: Hello again. You don't happen to recall how many steps you took in getting here, do you? I was just wondering.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GREETING_0000bc90_Oblivion_RESP1: Hello again. You're more than welcome here! I have everything for the budding alchemist under one roof.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GREETING_0006d603_Oblivion_RESP1: Hello again... talk to me while you can. I don't think I've got too long.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GREETING_000301d6_Oblivion_RESP1: Hello friend. Stay a while and watch the sheep with me!
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GREETING_00023e7f_Oblivion_RESP1: Hello love. I'll have another bottle of wine if you please. And do hurry - the last 5 barmaids I've talked to never came back...
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GREETING_00028737_Oblivion_RESP1: Hello my friend.  I will never forget your daring rescue.  What can I do for you?
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GREETING_000319cb_Oblivion_RESP1: Hello my friend. A word of advice. Watch for goblins if you're heading north.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GREETING_000224ea_Oblivion_RESP1: Hello stranger. We don't get many visitors around here. Makes things pretty lonely for me, if you know what I mean.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GREETING_0002edee_Oblivion_RESP1: Hello there! Are you here to join the Mages Guild?
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_HELLO_00081d62_Oblivion_RESP1: Hello there! Can I cut you a deal?
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GREETING_0004f21f_Oblivion_RESP1: Hello there! I must say, I'm quite surprised to see anyone else here.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GREETING_00028273_Oblivion_RESP1: Hello there! Welcome to the Arena! I don't think I've ever seen you around here before. I know all the regulars, believe me.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GREETING_00042ff3_Oblivion_RESP1: Hello there! You're a cute little thing, aren't you? A little baby bear. Did you get lost?
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GREETING_0002f1f3_Oblivion_RESP1: Hello there, Associate. You're here for a recommendation, I presume. Are you prepared to earn it?
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GREETING_0003e961_Oblivion_RESP1: Hello there, hello indeed! I'm Caldana Monrius. Well met!
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GREETING_0001f36e_Oblivion_RESP1: Hello there. Have I mentioned that my left arm is actually one inch longer than my right? Never know when that might be important.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GREETING_0003e706_Oblivion_RESP1: Hello there. Have you reconsidered my offer?
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GREETING_000277ab_Oblivion_RESP1: Hello there. Hmm... you might do nicely. Are you interested in some work? I have a small task that needs accomplishing. You may be up to it.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GREETING_00031036_Oblivion_RESP1: Hello there. I hear you've been looking for me.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GREETING_0001f367_Oblivion_RESP1: Hello there. I just finished a lovely conversation with Uncle Leo; it seems he's not feeling well today. Lost an arm.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GREETING_0004300b_Oblivion_RESP1: Hello there. I suppose I should make the effort to introduce myself. I'm Horkvir Bear-Arm. I hope there isn't anything I can do for you.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GREETING_0003ea30_Oblivion_RESP1: Hello there. I'm Hirrus Clutumnus, not that it should matter to you, or anyone else for that matter. I'm worthless. I should die. Will you kill me?
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GREETING_0000357a_Oblivion_RESP1: Hello there. Is there something I can do for you?
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GREETING_0002edda_Oblivion_RESP1: Hello there. Is there something with which I can assist you? Perhaps you're curious about joining the Mages Guild?
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GREETING_000613bb_Oblivion_RESP1: Hello there. Welcome to Aerin's Camp.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GREETING_0001f366_Oblivion_RESP1: Hello there. You don't have any experience building boats, do you? I'm rather stuck, what without any instructions and all. Confusing stuff.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_HELLO_0008f106_Oblivion_RESP1: Hello there. You'd look great in my newest work.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GREETING_0001e442_Oblivion_RESP1: Hello! I'm Dumag gro-Bonk. Best and prettiest smith in town. I know the secret art of forging Amber. Here. Take this list. It explains what I need.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GREETING_0001accf_Oblivion_RESP1: Hello! It's always a pleasure to speak with you.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GREETING_000091f2_Oblivion_RESP1: Hello! You must be from the Fighters Guild. I'm glad you're here. I need your help to repay a debt.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GREETING_0008e4bb_Oblivion_RESP1: Hello! You'll need to speak up.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GREETING_0002d58f_Oblivion_RESP1: Hello, Associate. If you need anything, just let me know.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GREETING_00034eaa_Oblivion_RESP1: Hello, Associate. It seems you've obtained the final recommendation you required.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GREETING_0002ee3f_Oblivion_RESP1: Hello, Associate. To earn a recommendation from me, you need simply prove you are able-bodied and prepared to learn something in the process.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GREETING_000251e0_Oblivion_RESP1: Hello, Brother. How can I help you?
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GREETING_000251de_Oblivion_RESP1: Hello, Brother. It's good to see you again. The Night Mother has been smiling upon you, I hope.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GREETING_00003a6a_Oblivion_RESP1: Hello, I am Velwyn Benirus. If you're in the market, I'm selling a manor house right now for a very good price.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GREETING_0002809c_Oblivion_RESP1: Hello, I don't think we've met.  Are you new in town?
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GREETING_000b97df_Oblivion_RESP1: Hello, I heard you purchased the Servants Quarters for Rosethorn Hall, and I was wondering if you had anyone in mind to fill that position?
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GREETING_0002821f_Oblivion_RESP1: Hello, I'm Dovesi. I'm very pleased to meet you. Now that you're here, we can really start looking for that chest of gold.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GREETING_0008e4c7_Oblivion_RESP1: Hello, I'm Dredhwen. No one was running this place when I got here. They left plenty of things behind, though. What do you need?
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GREETING_0008e4ba_Oblivion_RESP1: Hello, I'm Nanette Don. I wasn't sure why I came here, until she showed up. Now I know. I'm going to be a powerful sorceress. Just like Relmyna!
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GREETING_0008e4bd_Oblivion_RESP1: Hello, I'm Shelden. I've been here the longest. That's why I'm mayor of Passwall. That, and because I'm the best at being in charge.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GREETING_000412c8_Oblivion_RESP1: Hello, I'm Una Armina. Perhaps you've heard of my Museum of Oddities?
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GREETING_000251e1_Oblivion_RESP1: Hello, Sister. Can I help you with something?
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_SE05Interrogate1_00013a5f_Oblivio: Hello, Steward. Welcome to my little corner of the castle.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GREETING_0018bb01_Oblivion_RESP1: Hello, citizen. I hope you're faring well in these difficult times.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GREETING_00027981_Oblivion_RESP1: Hello, dear! Listen, I've been thinking. Why don't we form a kind of alliance? If either one of us finds the chest of gold, we split it, 50/50!
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GREETING_00023e3e_Oblivion_RESP1: Hello, dearest Sister. Is there something I can help you with?
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GREETING_00005674_Oblivion_RESP1: Hello, fellow Speaker. Welcome to the Black Hand. So nice to see you're in one piece.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GREETING_0002c0ce_Oblivion_RESP1: Hello, friend! What can I do for you?
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GREETING_0008605a_Oblivion_RESP1: Hello, friend. Thank you again for your help.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GREETING_0008605e_Oblivion_RESP1: Hello, friend. Thank you again for your help.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GREETING_0008e4bc_Oblivion_RESP1: Hello, is there something I can do for you?
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GREETING_00042fef_Oblivion_RESP1: Hello, little one! I'm Urul gro-Agamph. All kinds of cute animals come to visit me. Just like you did! You're a pretty butterfly, aren't you?
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_HELLO_00091b49_Oblivion_RESP1: Hello, my darling. Are you having a good day?
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GREETING_0002b7a8_Oblivion_RESP1: Hello, my friend! What can this grizzled old Blademaster do for you?
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GREETING_00022509_Oblivion_RESP1: Hello, my little friend. I have something that might interest you...
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GREETING_0001f365_Oblivion_RESP1: Hello, my name is Tove. "The Unrestful," they call me. So much to do, and so little time. There's only one of me to go around, you know!
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GREETING_000488df_Oblivion_RESP1: Hello, stranger. Luciana Galena. I'm Bravil's Advanced Trainer for the Light Armor discipline.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GREETING_0002fd72_Oblivion_RESP1: Hello, stranger. What can I do for you?
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GREETING_000251df_Oblivion_RESP1: Hello, sweet Sister. It warms my heart to see you again. The Night Mother has been smiling upon you, I hope.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GREETING_0000365c_Oblivion_RESP1: Hello. Are you searching for something?
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GREETING_000038d1_Oblivion_RESP1: Hello. I am Laythe Wavrick, the Chief Herald and Countess Valga's attendant. Welcome to Chorrol.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GREETING_0015974b_Oblivion_RESP1: Hello. I am Laythe Wavrick, the Chief Herald and Countess Valga's attendant. Welcome to Chorrol.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GREETING_00033ee2_Oblivion_RESP1: Hello. I hope the goblins along the Yellow Road didn't give you any trouble.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GREETING_0004300f_Oblivion_RESP1: Hello. I'm Atrabhi! People think I'm not friendly because I'm always reading. I enjoy a good conversation, though.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GREETING_0001dc44_Oblivion_RESP1: Hello. I'm Brother Jauffre. Can I help you?
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GREETING_00024f11_Oblivion_RESP1: Hello. I'm Casta Scribonia. The writer. Author of 'Woman Gone Wild'.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GREETING_000238e3_Oblivion_RESP1: Hello. I'm Rasheda -- the smith -- and this is Fire and Steel. Quality armor and weapons, repairs, too. What can I do for you?
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GREETING_000488e3_Oblivion_RESP1: Hello. I'm Roxanne Brigette. I help the boys. They get a little squirrelly sometimes, find it hard to cope. So I help out.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GREETING_000314f4_Oblivion_RESP1: Hello. I'm not really in the mood to chat right now.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GREETING_00043013_Oblivion_RESP1: Hello. My name isn't Atrabhi, I don't know why everyone calls me that. And I don't know where I get this reputation for being a liar, either.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GREETING_00038aaa_Oblivion_RESP1: Hello. We haven't met, have we? I'm Sister Marie Palielle, the chapel healer, and trainer in the Restoration Arts.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GREETING_000251db_Oblivion_RESP1: Hello. What is it I can do for you?
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_HELLO_0002ad89_Oblivion_RESP1: Hello. You haven't seen my sons, have you? They went off into the forest to fight those monsters, and I'm worried about them.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GREETING_0000be68_Oblivion_RESP1: Hello. You're from the Fighters Guild, I presume. It's good that you've arrived. We need your help with some disappearances.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GREETING_000790a5_Oblivion_RESP1: Hello... don't mind me... I'm a little tired. Can't sleep at home, you know. The walls. They aren't safe.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_Dark11Choice4C_00002ddb_Oblivion_: Hello? Did you hear me? I asked if you needed anything. Well then, I've got duties to tend to, so if you'll excuse me.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_DAClavicusSpeech_000243b5_Oblivio: Hello? Hey! Pay attention! In your pack. The dog. I swear, you heroes aren't particularly quick on the uptake....
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_TGSpecialJobs_0001fb50_Oblivion_R: Help Theranis bring back this book. If Theranis is unwilling or unable, bring back the book yourself. Are you agreeable?
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_SQ09Scales_00066f2c_Oblivion_RESP: Help an old fisherman out, won't you?
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_NecromancersAmuletTopic_0000c08a_: Help her to see that she should not use the weapons of the enemy, especially out of fear.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GREETING_0008e121_Oblivion_RESP1: Help me get past Dagon and into the Temple of the One! I'll do the rest!
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GREETING_0003e961_Oblivion_RESP2: Help me out,friend. I need some skooma. Real bad. The good stuff. You know? Been dry for days. Got some skooma for me? I pay well.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GREETING_00054fa0_Oblivion_RESP1: Help us hold the Altar against the Mazken's counterattack!
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_Trespass_0002a368_Oblivion_RESP1: Help! Guards! I have a trespasser!
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GREETING_0001ee23_Oblivion_RESP1: Help! You must help! They're killing everyone at Weynon Priory!
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_HELLO_0000bf35_Oblivion_RESP1: Help, help! You've got to do something!
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_CharGenMain_000164b6_Oblivion_RES: Help? What makes you think help will get here before more of those bastards? We need to get the Emperor out of here.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GREETING_0003c9bc_Oblivion_RESP1: Helvius Cecia. I do a little of this, a little of that. And I serve the Nine. Praise their Names!
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GREETING_000476c6_Oblivion_RESP1: Helvo Atius. Sevarius says I have to stay out of sight. So I'm stuck here until things blow over.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_MS05DreamworldTopic_0002c6dd_Obli: Henantier constructed a magical device he called the Dreamworld Amulet. With this device, one can enter his own mind and experience dreams.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_MS05Dreams_0002c6de_Oblivion_RESP: Henantier created the amulet to see if he could use his dreams as a training ground to help better himself.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_MS05PleaseExplain_0002c6dc_Oblivi: Henantier isn't a prisoner in any physical sense. He's a prisoner of his own mind. He's trapped in his Dreamworld.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_MS05WhatGives_0002c6db_Oblivion_R: Henantier isn't a prisoner in any physical sense. He's a prisoner of his own mind. He's trapped in his Dreamworld.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_HenantierTopic_00027f37_Oblivion_: Henantier isn't missing. On the contrary, I know exactly where he is. The problem is he's trapped and there's no way I can free him.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_MS05PreparedYes_0002c6ea_Oblivion: Henantier once told me that if he's killed in his dreams, anyone that's in there with him will die as well. So, do be careful.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_INFOGENERAL_0003cd29_Oblivion_RES: Henantier was slain in his sleep. How awful. They should find the one who did it and send him straight to prison.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_MS05WhyLie_00027f39_Oblivion_RESP: Henantier's never been one for rules, and so he's continued to perform his latest experiments in secret. If word gets out, he'll be dismissed.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_SE02Gatekeeper_0008e4f0_Oblivion_: Her Gatekeeper is flawed! Her tears hurt him!
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_AnvilTopic_0003cf89_Oblivion_RESP: Her Ladyship has no intention of remarrying. Liked her first Count well-enough, I guess, and doesn't fancy a replacement.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_SE05HaskillSyl_0001ac61_Oblivion_: Her Ladyship is rather suspicious of all around her. Best for you to not question it, and merely do what she requires of you.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_BradonLirrianTopic_0003843a_Obliv: Her accusations that Raynil is lying is not surprising. At this point, she's so upset that she'll say anything to deny what really happened.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_MG07DagailConv_0001fbb7_Oblivion_: Her condition remains unchanged. I appreciate you inquiring about her.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_SQ05RaelynntheGravefinder_0018abd: Her death pays a handsome bounty. I hope you'll take advantage of the opportunity.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_TarMeenaTopic_00002dcd_Oblivion_R: Her expertise in arcane knowledge and lore could be invaluable to us, if we can make proper use of it.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_BernadettePenelesTopic_0001dcba_O: Her house is almost directly across the street from mine, southwest of the Great Chapel. Coincidence? I don't think so.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_CheydinhalNQDResponses_0003e970_O: Her knowledge of armor is really impressive.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GOODBYE_0008264a_Oblivion_RESP1: Her light shall show you the way.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GREETING_0003be7f_Oblivion_RESP2: Her majesty cannot tolerate a liar. It is I who makes the rules here. If you need anything, you come to me.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_MS27QuestStart_0002e5ce_Oblivion_: Her name is Herminia Cinna. She lives here in the Imperial City, in the Elven Gardens district.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_Prank_000302d5_Oblivion_RESP3: Her room is upstairs; make sure no one sees you. You do that for me, and I'll make sure you can find J'skar.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_Prank_0001ceea_Oblivion_RESP2: Her room should be easy to find. It's the only one upstairs that has a door. Just one more privilege she doesn't deserve.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_BravilNQDQuestionResponses_000465: Her skills with Destruction spells are supposedly impressive. I understand Kud-Ei has her teaching them at the Mages Guild.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_AkaviriArtifacts_000980f5_Oblivio: Her steward, Tolgan, occasionally approaches individuals the Countess feels is worthy enough to seek her prize.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_SE02GatekeeperChoiceHowTears_0008: Her tears somehow agitate the daedra bound to the Gatekeeper's body. Her tears make it really restless. It strains harder against the warding magic.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_TG03LlathasaIndarys_00045f76_Obli: Her tomb is in the northern croft. It's a pity about her highness. She died so young, at least for an elf.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_SkingradNQDResponses_0003c260_Obl: Her wines are excellent, and she's a fine person as well.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_SE11CiirtaTopic_0001a398_Oblivion: Her... her light has gone out. What will we do now? Are we damned to walk in darkness forever? Who will lead us?
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_SE05Conspiracy_000895e6_Oblivion_: Herdir has a great affinity for his work, and can be a very useful ally to you. Do not hesitate to make use of his talents.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_SE05Interrogate1_00013a5c_Oblivio: Herdir, you filth. You don't dare touch me. Syl will have your head!
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_LeyawiinTopic_000479d3_Oblivion_R: Here I train our skirmishing specialists. You know, perhaps, that Argonians may be gifted spellcasters.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_MS51Choice1_0003152c_Oblivion_RES: Here are some keys. They should allow you access to many of the restricted areas in Castle Chorrol.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GREETING_0000395e_Oblivion_RESP1: Here for more work, are you? I've got one last contract for you. First, though, a bit of bad news. Oreyn spoke with Vilena about your last mission.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GREETING_0000be62_Oblivion_RESP1: Here for more work? I've got one more contract for you.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_SE11Dyus_00014b53_Oblivion_RESP1: Here in this Realm where secrets are power, Dyus is a being of great might. He has knowledge of events beyond even that of the Daedric Princes.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_SE38TalkItem2_00081eb1_Oblivion_R: Here in this case is a disgustingly deformed Swamp Tentacle. Such a freak of nature has never been seen before, and hopefully not since either!
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_MS27QuestStart_0002e5ce_Oblivion_: Here is more than enough gold to buy it at any reasonable price. You may keep whatever you do not use as your fee.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GREETING_00038b08_Oblivion_RESP1: Here is the amulet back. It's as beautiful as it was the day I remember seeing it long ago. I want you to keep it, as I have no use for this anymore.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_TG07PayForger_00015f12_Oblivion_R: Here is the new List of Candidates. Hieronymus Lex has a glowing recommendation.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GREETING_00034e9a_Oblivion_RESP3: Here is the reward you were promised. Even though the bust is gone, you've earned it.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GREETING_00009c7c_Oblivion_RESP4: Here is what I believe we should do next. I will stay here and attempt to reestablish this Sanctuary. I will begin recruiting new members.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_Dark16Choice2A_000262d8_Oblivion_: Here is what you must do. Go now to your next dead drop, lie in wait, and confront whomever drops off the false contract!
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_Dark16Choice2B_000262d9_Oblivion_: Here is what you must do. Go now to your next dead drop, lie in wait, and confront whomever drops off the false contract!
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_Dark16Choice2C_000262da_Oblivion_: Here is what you must do. Go now to your next dead drop, lie in wait, and confront whomever drops off the false contract!
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_HouseBuyChorrol_0004f219_Oblivion: Here is your key. The house is on the main plaza, between the statue and the Chapel.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GREETING_0002ff08_Oblivion_RESP3: Here is your reward and bonus. Both have been well earned. Go now and rest, and may the Night Mother guard your dreams.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GREETING_000008d2_Oblivion_RESP3: Here is your reward and bonus. Both have been well earned. In addition, you have been advanced to the rank of Eliminator.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GREETING_00034896_Oblivion_RESP3: Here is your reward, minus any bonus. It would seem you and Gogron share a similar... style. Now go, and do be more careful in the future.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_BlackBows03_000908e2_Oblivion_RES: Here is your reward. And this other Black Bow? Would you like to turn it in as well?
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_TG09GiveArrowHead_0001482a_Oblivi: Here is your reward. I am also promoting you to Master Thief in the Thieves Guild. Fathis Ules of the Imperial City will be your new fence.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_BlackBows02_000908e1_Oblivion_RES: Here is your reward. Well done, and thank you.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_SE38TalkItem1_00081eb5_Oblivion_R: Here is... well, I think there used to be something very Odd here, but it seems to be missing now. Let's move on.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_ElixirofExploration_0004e918_Obli: Here it is... my pride and joy. A Grand Elixir of Exploration. Use it in good health, my friend.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_MS27Voice_000a934b_Oblivion_RESP1: Here it is... the throne of the last king of the Ayleids. And so it falls to me to begin the restoration of our ancient glory...
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GREETING_0004e923_Oblivion_RESP1: Here to sell me more Nirnroot?
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GREETING_00068aec_Oblivion_RESP1: Here to sell me more Nirnroot?
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GREETING_00068bca_Oblivion_RESP1: Here we are, safe indoors. Nothing to harm us here, is there?
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_magickaloria_000c9ba3_Oblivion_RE: Here we are: "Magicka Darkens." Hmm, that's an odd one. Perhaps it's not a literal translation, then... is there another inscription like it?
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_SE38TalkItem5_00081ec6_Oblivion_R: Here we have the mortal remains of a fellow named Din, who as I understand was driven mad and killed himself, a truly Demented act.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_ShrineofClavicusVileTOPIC_00026b0: Here we worship Lord Clavicus. Do you have business with the Daedra?
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_ShrineofVaerminaTOPIC_0001ec17_Ob: Here we worship Vaermina, praying for her to grant us true visions. What is your business here?
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GREETING_000a656a_Oblivion_RESP1: Here you are at last. I know exactly where the Throne Room lies. Your job is simply to get me there safely.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_DEHorseArmorTopicAkatosh_00014e60: Here you are, just like I promised! Thanks again for all the help!
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_DEHorseArmorTopicMehrunes_00014e6: Here you are, just like I promised! Thanks again for all the help!
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_DLCHorseArmorTopicElven_00002613_: Here you are, just like I promised! Thanks again for all the help!
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_DLCHorseArmorTopicSteel_00002614_: Here you are, just like I promised! Thanks again for all the help!
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_SE11RakheranGiveDaggers2_0001a7bb: Here you are, my brothers! At last, we will be rid of Ciirta!
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_ChallengeBreton_0009f9b0_Oblivion: Here you face the swift and subtle Breton. Go through the gate, Chosen, and test your fate.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GREETING_00045652_Oblivion_RESP1: Here you go, bounty hunter. I can't wait to begin playing with my living tree.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_MS38Reward_00023665_Oblivion_RESP: Here you go, my friend. Trust me, you've earned it. There is one last person that needs looking into, though.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GREETING_0000c1bd_Oblivion_RESP3: Here you go. Don't spend it all in one place... unless it's here of course!
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_SE30ForgeGreaves_000400b9_Oblivio: Here you go. I shaped these to your exact measurements. Need some help getting them on?
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_CheydinhalTopic_0004e88b_Oblivion: Here you have your Chapel-going Imperials, and your Chapel-dodging Dark Elves, and never shall the twain meet.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GREETING_00025df0_Oblivion_RESP2: Here you must find your own path.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_SE38TalkItem1_00081eb0_Oblivion_R: Here you see the Blind Watcher's Eye. A most unusual specimen collected at great peril by... some intrepid adventurer!
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_MaleneTopic_0018bc38_Oblivion_RES: Here's 50 gold to cover the costs; that should be more than enough. Come see me when you've got everything, and we'll talk more.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_ElixirofExploration_0004e929_Obli: Here's a Weak Elixir of Exploration. Not bad, eh? If you want more, you can buy them from me. I've discounted them for you, of course.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GREETING_0006dc29_Oblivion_RESP1: Here's a copy of the Black Horse Courier. Identity of the Gray Fox revealed.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_SE38TalkItem10_0008242a_Oblivion_: Here's a new addtion to the Museum, one of my favorites. A dagger that heals whomever it cuts! Isn't that deliciously Odd?
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_SE38TalkItemB_00082434_Oblivion_R: Here's a real Oddity for you -- an arm of one of the Gatekeepers! This one was killed by... oh, I forget now. A lovely specimen in any case.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_MS12AcceptMission_00018239_Oblivi: Here's a translation of the passages we could still read. It was quite damaged. I've also included a rough map that was drawn in the diary as well.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GREETING_0003d48b_Oblivion_RESP2: Here's how it works. We case The Flowing Bowl for a likely subject. Namely, we look for a married guy who drinks a lot.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GREETING_0001dc28_Oblivion_RESP3: Here's my problem. I'm being followed. Watched. Marukhati Selectives, maybe. Not sure. I'm a threat, you see? To their plans. I know too much.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_INFOGENERAL_00043ed6_Oblivion_RES: Here's one you haven't heard, I bet. The Duke's got his Chalice back. Hmm? See what I mean? Now, what can you do for me?
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_SE38TalkItem7_00082430_Oblivion_R: Here's something truly Odd -- a Soul Tomato! A tomato that can act like a soul gem! No one has yet been able to explain it.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_SE38TalkItemC_00082437_Oblivion_R: Here's the Ring of... well now, where did it go? Things have a way of disappearing around here that's enough to drive a person insane!
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_MS38Reward_0002585c_Oblivion_RESP: Here's the gold, as promised. I always pay my debts, and then some. Do the last .. task ... in that note, and I will pay you much, much more.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_Recommendation_0002e5e5_Oblivion_: Here's the key, and something extra. I don't know if it will be of use to you, but from what I've heard of Falcar's ring, it may come in handy.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_SE37Errand_000452f8_Oblivion_RESP: Here's the list of things I need. Get me everything on it. Try to remember where you found it so you can tell me. It's important.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_PayGoldforCrime_00027fc8_Oblivion: Here's the procedure. We go to the castle. First we search you, confiscate any stolen goods. Then you pay your fine, and we release you.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_MS43Accept_0004f8c5_Oblivion_RESP: Here's the staff. As soon as you leave, the scamps will thankfully follow. Do be careful, I don't wish your death on my hands as well.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_TG06Theranis_0004896e_Oblivion_RE: Here's what I know. Theranis was drinking in the Two Sisters Lodge. He was bragging about stealing something from the castle.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GREETING_0006dc23_Oblivion_RESP1: Here's your copy of the Black Horse Courier. New Imperial Watch captain.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_DEAkBladeClaymore_00014d8d_AltarD: Here's your item, Paladin. Anything else?
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_DEAkBladeDagger_00014d8f_AltarDel: Here's your item, Paladin. Anything else?
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_DEAkBladeLongsword_00014d91_Altar: Here's your item, Paladin. Anything else?
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_DEAkBladeShortsword_00014d93_Alta: Here's your item, Paladin. Anything else?
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_DEAkBluntBattleAxe_00014d97_Altar: Here's your item, Paladin. Anything else?
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_DEAkBluntMace_00014d99_AltarDelux: Here's your item, Paladin. Anything else?
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_DEAkBluntWarAxe_00014d9b_AltarDel: Here's your item, Paladin. Anything else?
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_DEAkBluntWarhammer_00014d9d_Altar: Here's your item, Paladin. Anything else?
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_DEAkBow_00014d9f_AltarDeluxe_RESP: Here's your item, Paladin. Anything else?
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_DEAkHeavyBoots_00014da1_AltarDelu: Here's your item, Paladin. Anything else?
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_DEAkHeavyCuirass_00014da3_AltarDe: Here's your item, Paladin. Anything else?
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_DEAkHeavyGauntlets_00014da7_Altar: Here's your item, Paladin. Anything else?
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_DEAkHeavyGreaves_00014da9_AltarDe: Here's your item, Paladin. Anything else?
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_DEAkHeavyHelmet_00014dab_AltarDel: Here's your item, Paladin. Anything else?
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_DEAkHeavyShield_00014dad_AltarDel: Here's your item, Paladin. Anything else?
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_DEAkLightBoots_00014db1_AltarDelu: Here's your item, Paladin. Anything else?
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_DEAkLightCuirass_00014e99_AltarDe: Here's your item, Paladin. Anything else?
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_DEAkLightGauntlets_00014e9b_Altar: Here's your item, Paladin. Anything else?
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_DEAkLightGreaves_00014db3_AltarDe: Here's your item, Paladin. Anything else?
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_DEAkLightHelmet_00014db5_AltarDel: Here's your item, Paladin. Anything else?
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_DEAkLightShield_00014db7_AltarDel: Here's your item, Paladin. Anything else?
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_MaglirTOPIC2_0002e59e_Oblivion_RE: Here's your payment for completion of the contract. I think it's time for us to discuss the Blackwood Company a bit.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_MageConvWait_0006bd94_Oblivion_RE: Here, Arch-Mage? Very well, I shall wait.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GREETING_0004767e_Oblivion_RESP2: Here, have a copy. It's free! Always free! We're funded by the Elder Council, so I don't mind, really. He he he he.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GREETING_00027668_Oblivion_RESP2: Here, kid, this is your payout for the victory. There's more where that came from if you can keep on winning. Now go unwind before your next fight.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_MQ15EldamilD1_00047229_Oblivion_R: Here, let me remove them for you ... there. You are no longer a prisoner of the Forbidden Grotto.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_WeatherleahTopic_00088b2f_Oblivio: Here, let me show you where it is on your map.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GREETING_0001bb1f_Oblivion_RESP2: Here, please take this apron as a token of our friendship. It's not much, but perhaps it will help you in the future.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_DarMaTopic_0001778d_Oblivion_RESP: Here, take this key. It'll open any of the trapdoors down to the caves. Every house in town has one.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_MQ05GwinasC2_0009532e_Oblivion_RE: Here, take this note they gave me. It tells you where to go. I don't want anything else to do with the Mythic Dawn.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_Message_0018bc66_Oblivion_RESP3: Here, take this to him. It is not my fault. The job will be finished, I swear it.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_SE39MissionChoice1b_00078203_Obli: Here, take this. I don't need it's protection against her mind control anymore. Go now! Pretend we don't know each other.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_MS49RingYes_00091c5a_Oblivion_RES: Here, take this. I have no use for it; I'm tired of fighting. It may serve you well in days to come.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GREETING_0000ca29_DLCBattlehornCa: Here, take this. It'll tell you all you need to know.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GREETING_0000ca2a_DLCBattlehornCa: Here, take this. It'll tell you all you need to know.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GREETING_00013416_DLCBattlehornCa: Here, take this. It'll tell you all you need to know.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_SE39MissionChoice2_00078204_Obliv: Here, this book might be of use to you.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_MQ09JauffreA_00036668_Oblivion_RE: Here, this is the key to Sancre Tor's outer door. I fear I am sending you to your death, but we have no other choice. You must succeed.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_ShrineofHircineTOPIC_0001ec53_Obl: Here, we make sacrifice to the Lord Hircine. We pray for a True Hunt. We beg to be Honored Prey.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_MQ05TarMeenaC_00022b43_Oblivion_R: Here, you can have the library's copy of Volume 2. Treat it gently, if you please!
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_SECaldanaMonriusSkoomaYes_0008f7a: Here, you take this. It's all I got.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_MS27HerminiaF1_000a5608_Oblivion_: Here. I happen to have the key you'll need to enter the royal burial chamber in Lindai. I hope you'll make the right choice.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_MQJauffreHelp_0005dccb_Oblivion_R: Here. Perhaps you will find this useful. One of the books I saved from my Blades training.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_SE02JayredLead_0008e4f5_Oblivion_: Here. Take this lockpick. Careful, it's the only one I've got. You open the door. I'll kill things. Let's go!
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GREETING_0004013d_Oblivion_RESP2: Here. Take this. The reward you have earned. Quickly now. It's best if no one knows you wear this.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_MQ05GwinasC1_0009532d_Oblivion_RE: Here. Volume 3 is yours. What you do with it is your business.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_ArenaChoice2A_0000c1b7_Oblivion_R: Here. Wear it proudly. And keep it in good condition, would you? That way I can give it to some other suicidal idiot after you're dead.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_Dark04FinChoice1A_000253d7_Oblivi: Here. You will use this specially poisoned knife to stage Motierre's death, in the enforcer's presence. Motierre himself will provide more details.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_CGBaurusD_0001e8e9_Oblivion_RESP3: Here. You'll need this key for the last door into the sewers.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_ArenaFanChoiceHold_000aed4e_Obliv: Here? Right here? What about, say... over there? No? Right here? All right then, you're the Grand Champion! Whatever you say!
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_INFOGENERAL_00077c50_Oblivion_RES: Heretics are misguided worshippers of Arden-Sul.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GREETING_000476a2_Oblivion_RESP1: Herminia Cinna. Amateur scholar of the ancient Elves, dabbler in the arcane arts. How can I help you?
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GREETING_0018d289_Oblivion_RESP1: Hero of Kvatch? How about the Hero of Bravil! No need to be modest, my friend!
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_ArcaneULecture3_0007194c_Oblivion: Hestra Runestones are marked with green runes, appear as solitary monuments, and are believed to be named for the late First Era Empress Hestra.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GREETING_00035c8f_Oblivion_RESP1: Hey stranger, can you spare a few coins? I've just been shaken down by that bastard watchman and he took my last septim.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_HELLO_00051791_Oblivion_RESP1: Hey there, pal! Need a room?
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GREETING_00043000_Oblivion_RESP1: Hey there. I'm Horkvir Bear-Arm. They call me that because I once wrestled a bear, not because I work all day out in my garden without a shirt on.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GREETING_00043003_Oblivion_RESP1: Hey there. I'm really busy. Got lots to do. So if you don't mind, make it quick.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GREETING_0004e927_Oblivion_RESP1: Hey! Good to see you again!
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_HELLO_0000345d_Oblivion_RESP1: Hey! I've been looking for you.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_PickpocketNoCrime_000626bc_Oblivi: Hey! Keep your thieving paws to yourself!
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GREETING_0004e9b0_Oblivion_RESP1: Hey! My friend! You made it, huh? That's... That's great. Did... Did you want to just relax, or... Did you want something... something else?
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GREETING_000488e2_Oblivion_RESP1: Hey! That's me you're talking to! Reistr the Rotted! Hear me? Reistr! Wow! I got this a-MAZ-ing itch right on my thigh! Can't touch it! It's rough!
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GREETING_00062458_Oblivion_RESP1: Hey! What did I tell you about weapons! That's it; we're done.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_AssaultNoCrime_00066334_Oblivion_: Hey! What did you do that for? You some kind of maniac?
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_AssaultNoCrime_00066337_Oblivion_: Hey! What'd I ever do to you?
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GREETING_000151e5_Oblivion_RESP1: Hey! Who in Oblivion are you? You don't look like one of the Blackwater Brigands!
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_HELLO_0004de88_Oblivion_RESP1: Hey! Whoa! You shouldn't sneak up on people like that!
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_CharGenTaunt2_0003335f_Oblivion_R: Hey! Wood Elf! You're a little far from the forest, huh? Looks like your days of woodland frolicking have come to a tragic end.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GREETING_001778bf_Oblivion_RESP1: Hey! You aren't Celia Camoran! There's an intruder in the library! Protect the scrolls!
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_SEHereticAlarm_00052f4f_Oblivion_: Hey! You aren't one of us!
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_MS02ManorBuyChoice1_0000a1c5_Obli: Hey! You don't even have enough money! Stop wasting my time and come back when you do.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_StealNoCrime_000626be_Oblivion_RE: Hey! You don't see me stealing your things!
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_HELLO_0008547e_Oblivion_RESP1: Hey! You said you would unlock the door!
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_INFOGENERAL_000624f3_Oblivion_RES: Hey, I don't like to tell stories, but Telaendril and me... you know. Don't believe me? I've got her undergarments to prove it! Ha ha ha ha ha!
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_TG00MysteriousNoteTopic_00035652_: Hey, I don't read them. I just deliver them.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GREETING_00033ee4_Oblivion_RESP1: Hey, I was up in Cropsford the other day. It looks like they're really making a go of it. You did a good thing there, you know.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GREETING_000477fd_Oblivion_RESP1: Hey, baby? You fancy some training? Sherina's the name, and blades are the game.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GREETING_0003ea31_Oblivion_RESP1: Hey, can you help me? Suicide is bad. I'll just end up on the Hill. But, perhaps you can kill me? Stick me in the heart with something sharp?
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_Assault_000624fb_Oblivion_RESP1: Hey, come on now! There's no need to get violent!
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_INFOGENERAL_00034077_Oblivion_RES: Hey, did you hear about that murder in the Talos Plaza District? I think the man's name was Draconis. Yeah, cut down in the prime of his life.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GOODBYE_0006fdad_Oblivion_RESP1: Hey, did you hear that? Thought I heard someone calling for a guard. I guess that's our cue.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_INFOGENERAL_00043500_Oblivion_RES: Hey, did you hear the Gatekeeper is dead? That's valuable information, don't you think? Worth a few coins?
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GREETING_000301d3_Oblivion_RESP1: Hey, do you mind not trampling on my crops? What do you want?
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_SE08RudeComment_00079bdb_Oblivion: Hey, don't you walk away from me!
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GREETING_000411fa_Oblivion_RESP2: Hey, friend, do you think you could help me out? I'm caught a bit short at the moment... anything at all would be much appreciated.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GREETING_000411fc_Oblivion_RESP1: Hey, got any apples? Or carrots? Anything at all crunchy and yummy to eat?
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_Question_0003403d_Oblivion_RESP1: Hey, have you heard about that pirate captain, the one who was murdered in his ship?
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_Question_00034071_Oblivion_RESP1: Hey, have you heard about that strange party at Summitmist Manor?
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_Question_00034079_Oblivion_RESP1: Hey, if I paid you twenty gold to spend a night in the Abandoned House, would you do it?
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_FGC03Choice1_00033572_Oblivion_RE: Hey, if you say so. You do all the work.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_SE08CutoffTopic_00079bdd_Oblivion: Hey, is that you? I hear something over there....
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GREETING_0002c7af_Oblivion_RESP1: Hey, it's you. The one who found jobs. Whadda you need?
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_CharGenTaunt2_00033339_Oblivion_R: Hey, lizard! It must break your heart, huh? Being so close to the water, knowing you'll never get to swim again...
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GREETING_000c454d_Oblivion_RESP1: Hey, something wrong? They're waiting for you up in the Arena!
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_StealNoCrime_0006250c_Oblivion_RE: Hey, take whatever you want. It's none of my business.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_CharGenTaunt2_00033357_Oblivion_R: Hey, there! You! Kinsman! I haven't seen another Dunmer in here in I don't know how long. Where you from, huh? Vvardenfell?
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GREETING_00092d7a_Oblivion_RESP1: Hey, there's my new pal! So what can I do for you? Need some items? Or maybe you're ready to unload something? Whatever you need!
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GREETING_00146845_Oblivion_RESP1: Hey, there, Pit Dog! How's life treatin' ya?
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GREETING_0003cc1f_Oblivion_RESP1: Hey, what's wrong? Aren't they waiting for you up in the Arena?
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_CharGenTaunt2_0004f235_Oblivion_R: Hey, you hear that? The guards are coming... for you!  He he he he he.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GREETING_0018d2a1_Oblivion_RESP1: Hey, you look just like your statue! What can I do for you?
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GREETING_00035f34_Oblivion_RESP1: Hey, you're not supposed to be here.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GREETING_000301d4_Oblivion_RESP1: Hey, you're the one made us visible again, right? Good show!
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GREETING_0018d29b_Oblivion_RESP1: Hey, you're the one that helped Captain Burd destroy that damned Oblivion Gate! Well done, friend, well done!
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_INFOGENERAL_0018b201_Oblivion_RES: Hey, you're the one they call the Hero of Kvatch, aren't you? The one that closed the Oblivion Gate and saved the city?
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_SE36HeyYou_00061c3f_Oblivion_RESP: Hey, you. Come over here. I got to ask you something. Something important. Shhhh. Just come over here.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_SE36HeyYou_00061c40_Oblivion_RESP: Hey, you. Yeah, you! Come over here.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_INFOGENERAL_00032e1f_Oblivion_RES: Hey. Check out the new associate. Not bad, if you know what I mean.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GREETING_0004e9ac_Oblivion_RESP1: Hey... Hey! How... What are... What are you... doing here? You're not my... Not my friend. What... You know, what do you... want?
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_Dark06Choice1A_0002fbb0_Oblivion_: Hey... Now that we're... we're friends... You want to come with me? To my... my special place? It's not... you know... very far...
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GREETING_00043016_Oblivion_RESP1: Hi there. Not to be rude or anything, but I'm anxious to get back to my book.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GREETING_00043015_Oblivion_RESP1: Hi there. You remind me of one of the characters from a story I've been reading. What can I do for you?
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GREETING_0003e0a3_Oblivion_RESP1: Hi, I'm Gogan. How's it going?
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_SE09Ceremony_00014abe_Oblivion_RE: Hidden away, by virtue of its own self-awareness, was the sixth, containing within it the five which birthed it. Flesh!
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_DAMeridiaSpeech_000579bb_Oblivion: Hidden behind a door, deep in Howling Cave, are necromancers. They rob graves for the materials to raise their undead armies.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_HELLO_0002f258_Oblivion_RESP1: Hides-His-Heart will be here any moment!
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_MSShadowscaleChoice1A_00035592_Ob: Hiding in that swamp you will find an Argonian Shadowscale named Scar-Tail. Kill this renegade, and bring me his heart as proof of the deed.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_TGSpecialJobs_0001ee44_Oblivion_R: Hieronymus Lex actually collected taxes from everyone living here on the Waterfront! Your job is to recover those taxes. Are you up for it?
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_TG07LexReassigned_0001cf43_Oblivi: Hieronymus Lex has indeed been reassigned. However, you have slain needlessly to accomplish that goal.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_TGHieronymusLex_0001c4e2_Oblivion: Hieronymus Lex has left the Waterfront? Well done! Methredhel's report tells me that you have done well. You have earned your reward.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_TG05HowBad_0000c05c_Oblivion_RESP: Hieronymus Lex has vowed not to leave until the Gray Fox is in custody. The Fox is safe, but the Thieves Guild cannot do business like this.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_TGHieronymusLex_00015f25_Oblivion: Hieronymus Lex is no longer searching on the Waterfront? This is good. It's too bad you slew innocents to make it happen.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_TG07LexReassigned_00015f16_Oblivi: Hieronymus Lex is still in the Imperial City. Do not speak to me of this again until the letter is properly replaced.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_TGSpecialJobs_0000c011_Oblivion_R: Hieronymus Lex must be eliminated once and for all. The Gray Fox has asked that you do this personally. It is a most delicate matter.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GREETING_0004762e_Oblivion_RESP1: Hieronymus Lex, Officer of the Watch. Every hand is needed to build an honest city, and it begins with you.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_INFOGENERAL_0018bc91_Oblivion_RES: High mountain ranges rise to the borders in the north and east, and marshes and rainforests extend to the southeast borders.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_Unicorn_0001ec61_Oblivion_RESP2: Hircine has deigned to speak with you, and he has provided you with glorious prey. You have been greatly honored. Do not fail him.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_ND09ProphetGreeting03_00002c11_Kn: His Daedric nature allows his spirit to escape into Oblivion after death. This is what Pelinal learned upon defeating Umaril the first time.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_MS12Reman_000980f6_Oblivion_RESP5: His alliance with Lord Vivec during the Akaviri invasion is just one example of his cunning and ingenuity.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_SE09JyggalagTopic_000913cf_Oblivi: His appearance seems imminent. His hatred for this land, for what it represents, is unimaginable.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_MSShadowscaleChoice2A_0003559e_Ob: His body is around here somewhere. Present the Agent's heart to Teinaava as proof, and he'll be none the wiser.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_SE43Ushnar_00072dc0_Oblivion_RESP: His dog can be a terror. I once saw him sic it on a guy who tried to steal the dog's food.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_NDProphetSpeechUmaril2_00002d0d_K: His golden-wickedness will hold fast against all arms except those of his ancient foe, the Whitestrake!
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_RolandJensericTopic_0001d246_Obli: His home is located in the Temple District. Right across the garden from my home in fact. Ironic, isn't it?
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_Inventory_0000bca3_Oblivion_RESP1: His inventory must be stolen. It has to be. He prices less than it costs to make some of those things. Go see for yourself.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_MQ02JauffreD2_00092d86_Oblivion_R: His meaning is unclear to me as well. The Emperor seemed to perceive some threat from the demonic world of Oblivion.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_confidence_0002d721_Oblivion_RESP: His mother's been holding him back, protecting him. You'll go to Nonwyll Cavern with him. Galtus Previa was lost there, and you're to find him.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_TG10accept_00015309_Oblivion_RESP: His name is Jakben, and he lives somewhere in the Imperial City. There might be a clue in the Earl's house.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_MQ02JauffreE1_0001e74d_Oblivion_R: His name is Martin. He is a priest in the Chapel of Akatosh in Kvatch. Yes, Kvatch.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_MQ02JauffreE1_0001e74e_Oblivion_R: His name is Martin. He serves Akatosh in the Chapel in the city of Kvatch, south of here.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_SE43Ushnar_00072dc1_Oblivion_RESP: His new dog though, it can be mean. He's trained it to attack cats and anyone that tries to take its food.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GREETING_0002c58d_Oblivion_RESP1: His ring. Have you pried it from the coward's corpse?
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_RufioTopic_00023dd3_Oblivion_RESP: His room is downstairs, in what I like to call the Private Quarters. Use that hatch in the floor over there. But don't expect a warm reception.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_MQ16OcatoE_000add1e_Oblivion_RESP: His sacrifice was necessary, but it leaves the Empire without an emperor.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_MS14ChoiceHeard_0001b947_Oblivion: His speciality is setting the Great Forest to canvas. The paintings look so amazingly real that some say they can see the trees sway in the breeze.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_SE01HaskillChoice4_000133e3_Obliv: His will is His own; His reality follows suit. You are here because you chose to enter; you were not summoned.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_Nd05Julianos_00002ae9_Knights_RES: History and knowledge are his domain. He is the God of Wisdom and Logic.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_Hit_00051dc6_Oblivion_RESP1: Hit me once more, and I'll kill you!
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_SE32HlovalsMagicka_000135cf_Obliv: Hloval dances a little too close to Sheogorath, if you know what I mean. Those born with stunted magicka shouldn't become priests and healers.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_SE32HlovalsMagicka_00012d1e_Obliv: Hloval healed my betrothed once. Then he ran out of magic. He said he needed to find someone to lend him some before he could help her more.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_SE32HlovalsMagicka_0008efd0_Obliv: Hloval's treachery is second only to my cowardice. My curse will not allow me to help you with his need.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_Recommendation_000175b6_Oblivion_: Hmm, I can't remember. Deetsan would know, though.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GREETING_000131d3_Oblivion_RESP2: Hmm, could you, in fact, imagine just how long I've been waiting? I don't think you could, but I might be wrong. I might also not care. Which is it?
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GREETING_0002eddc_Oblivion_RESP1: Hmm, what? I'm rather busy right now.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_MageTalk4_0006a86e_Oblivion_RESP1: Hmm-hmm. Exactly. But now what? Do I continue with that line of study, or shall I delve into something more archaic? Say... ancient Ayleid curses?
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_SE38Oddity8_00081e8f_Oblivion_RES: Hmm. A bowl that you mix potions in. Doesn't seem all that Odd to me... well, I can see you're trying, so I'll find somewhere to put it.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_TrainingQuestTopic_0006244d_Obliv: Hmm. A trade is in order, don't you think? My services in exchange for... oh, let's say ten Welkynd Stones. I'd say that's fair.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_Dark11Choice3C_00002dd7_Oblivion_: Hmm. All right, then. You're not one for talking. I can respect that. Well, if you need anything, you just let me know.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_Corpse_00062512_Oblivion_RESP1: Hmm. Body's still warm. Looks like there's a killer about.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_contract_000039e2_Oblivion_RESP1: Hmm. Don't get me wrong, that magic arrow sounds nice and all, but it seems to me like you don't even need to use it to get the bonus.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_NecromancersMoon_00002dc3_Oblivio: Hmm. I have never heard of this "Shade of the Revenant." Some sort of celestial phenomenon?
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_Dark03FinChoice1B_00023e53_Oblivi: Hmm. I thought you'd jump at the opportunity to infiltrate the most heavily fortified prison in all of Cyrodiil. Maybe I overestimated you after all.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_Recommendation_0002d6e4_Oblivion_: Hmm. It's a pity you don't have the right sort of friends. Friends that would be willing to help out with a task like that.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_MG11ChoiceBlackSoulGems_00033635_: Hmm. Now that is a bit more specific. Finally, something I can respond to!
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GREETING_0004564e_Oblivion_RESP1: Hmm. This Scalon looks a bit mangy, but I suppose it will do. Your reward is in the house.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_Lost_00081a3c_Oblivion_RESP1: Hmm. This place will be more peaceful once Lord Jyggalag resumes his throne.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_TG07ForgeThisLetter_0000c01a_Obli: Hmm. Yes, it can be done. I can change it to give Lex the highest recommendation. I'll need a full day to properly forge this letter. Return then.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_HELLO_00035a31_Oblivion_RESP1: Hmm. You don't look like a vampire...
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_SE38TalkItemB_00082435_Oblivion_R: Hmm. You haven't seen a huge severed arm with an axe for a hand anywhere, have you? I seem to have misplaced mine. Ah, well.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_SE38TalkItem4_00081ec5_Oblivion_R: Hmm... I could have sworn that I used to keep something very Odd on this shelf. Oh well. Let's move on.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_Help_00098144_Oblivion_RESP2: Hmm... if you're serious, maybe I can put you to use. It'll likely mean your death, though.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_SERunsInCirclesGreetG_00041210_Ob: Hmm... not bad! Better than my old pair. Thanks, friend!
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_BookResponses_000277bd_Oblivion_R: Hmm... not my favorite work, but many enjoy it.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_SE37Beast_00045660_Oblivion_RESP1: Hmm? I suppose it is about time for me to add another creature. I have hopes for an Elytra. If you see one, could you bring it around for me?
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GREETING_0007327d_Oblivion_RESP1: Hmm? Oh, Caenlin's my name. Maybe you knew my uncle, Baenlin? He died recently. It was all very tragic. I'm heartbroken, of course. Well, goodbye.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GREETING_0007327c_Oblivion_RESP1: Hmm? Oh, Caenlin's my name. Maybe you knew my uncle, Baenlin? He died recently. Stuffed head fell on him. Very tragic. Well, goodbye.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_JskarTopic_0002d587_Oblivion_RESP: Hmm? Oh, Jeanne has you looking for him, does she?
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GOODBYE_000852c0_Oblivion_RESP1: Hmm? Oh, yes, maybe we'll speak again later.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_MageTalk1_0006a85c_Oblivion_RESP1: Hmm? Oh, yes, of course. What is it?
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GREETING_0006a842_Oblivion_RESP1: Hmm? Yes, yes, I'm sure you've got something exceedingly important to say. But the Apprentices do not teach themselves, now do they? Good day.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GOODBYE_000908e7_Oblivion_RESP1: Hmmm, wonder if it's too late to ask for less rat in tomorrow's dinner?
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_HELLO_000b121b_Oblivion_RESP1: Hmmm. Another comes to us. What is it?
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_MS23SeridurNotYet_0001d4ca_Oblivi: Hmmm. He must have known we'd look there. Search around town and see if you can find any more information.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_TG07NewCaptain_00098399_Oblivion_: Hmmm. Hieronymus Lex looks like the best choice. I was about to give the position to Dairihill's cousin.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_thieves_00002e5f_Oblivion_RESP1: Hmmm. I don't think I know you well enough to tell you that.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_TG09GiveArrowHead_0001482a_Oblivi: Hmmm. I had hoped for the whole arrow, but that is not your fault. I will have to have it repaired.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_TG09GiveArrowHead_0001cf36_Oblivi: Hmmm. I had hoped for the whole arrow, but that is not your fault. I will have to have it repaired.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_SE09MiscRelmynaExperiment_00046f6: Hmmm. Is this too much pain?
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_HELLO_0004798c_Oblivion_RESP1: Hmmm. Maybe he lives in the Elven Gardens district.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_Nirnroot_0004e93e_Oblivion_RESP1: Hmmm. No. Never seen one of those before. Strikingly beautiful.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_SE01HaskillChoice10_0005e372_Obli: Hmmm. Not surprising. Well, if you change your mind, and the position is still available, come speak with me again.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GREETING_0018917f_Oblivion_RESP1: Hmmm. Perhaps you'll be able to assist me. I'm after some skooma dealers.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_SE07AKithlanHelp_00014025_Oblivio: Hmmm. That may be difficult. Syl has been hidden from public sight lately. However, I can give you something that may help.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_SE37SellSpells_0007b221_Oblivion_: Hmmm. Unfortunately your pathetic Illusion skill makes that idea useless.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_BladesTalk3_0018d7f1_Oblivion_RES: Hmmm. Yes, yes, I see your point. And the others feel the same way?
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_HELLO_0003d4bd_Oblivion_RESP1: Hmmm. You may be just what we've been looking for.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_FGJoin1_00024280_Oblivion_RESP1: Hmmm... I don't think so. You're a wanted criminal. Don't know what you did, but I know the rules. Come back if you clear that up.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_jointheFightersGuild_00027f8d_Obl: Hmmm... I suppose there's always room for fresh meat. Of course, we like our meat to be clean -- good reputation, not wanted by the law. You in?
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_ChorrolNQDResponses_00029fb6_Obli: Hmmm... I've never had much interest in the Fighters Guild.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_NDTalk3_00002bb3_Knights_RESP1: Hmmm... You're right, of course. How do you propose we proceed?
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_DinnerParty_0001c108_Oblivion_RES: Hmmm... don't know that you're dressed for it, but you seem a really likeable sort. I'll let you in. I'd better not regret this.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_SQ06Bears_0018afd6_Oblivion_RESP2: Hmmm... good. This has to be from one of the beasts. Excellent. Soon, you'll have them on the run.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GREETING_00040bbf_Oblivion_RESP1: Hmmm... how do you do? I'd say, very well from the look of things.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_ChorrolNQDResponses_00029fde_Obli: Hmmm... maybe I should start betting with Hundolin as well.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_INFOGENERAL_0005edb5_Oblivion_RES: Hmmm... perhaps the new ruler of Mania will take care of the Scalons.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_Nirnroot_0004e942_Oblivion_RESP1: Hmmm... that gives me an idea. Since you already know what they look like, do you feel up to a bit of a collecting expedition?
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_ElixirofExploration_0004e92e_Obli: Hmmm... you don't seem to have enough samples on you. Remember, I need at least 10 to get started.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_HELLO_00084b44_Oblivion_RESP1: Hmmm... you look familiar. If only I could remember.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_HELLO_0001f3b7_Oblivion_RESP1: Hmmm? Oh, yes. The choice. Well, it's about time!
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GatherClues_00033954_Oblivion_RES: Hmmmm. I don't remember seeing Chanel or Orgnolf that entire evening.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_SE35TrustMe_00078676_Oblivion_RES: Hmmmm. Very well. I don't take you for a liar. Here is your reward, as promised.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_MageTalk3_0006a868_Oblivion_RESP1: Hmmmm... Yes... Yes... It's as I suspected after all. But I wonder... Will this affect the Destruction discipline as well, or merely Conjuration?
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_Nirnroot_0004e935_Oblivion_RESP1: Hmph. Ok, I'm stumped. If I had more time, I'd buy that off of you and bring it to Sinderion in Skingrad. He's the expert on strange plants.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_MageTalk3_0006a86c_Oblivion_RESP1: Hmph. That just goes to show you how little we really know about the arts magicka. Fireballs and frost bolts are one thing, but this? Incredible...
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_Lost_0002d407_Oblivion_RESP1: Hmph. Whatever it was, it's gone now.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_FGJoin1_00024282_Oblivion_RESP1: Hmph. Word on the street is that you've been into some bad business. That's not good for the Guild. Clean up your act and come back later.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_HELLO_000493fc_Oblivion_RESP1: Ho hey, sweet lady of Wayrest! Ho hey, sweet lady of mine! Oh I'll see you again,  yes I'll see you again, sweet lady of Wayrest so fine!
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GREETING_00015257_Oblivion_RESP1: Ho there! Where do you think you're going! Selene's not going to like this one bit... I wasn't to be disturbed!
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_Dark02PirateConvo_000493b1_Oblivi: Ho, there, laddie, now you're just bein' insultin'! She may be tougher than me, and meaner too, but a better sailor? It ain't even possible.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GREETING_000b1214_Oblivion_RESP1: Hold on there! There'll be no sneaking into the Countess' dinner party. Allow me to escort you out of here.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GREETING_0001c24d_Oblivion_RESP1: Hold on. There's a dinner party here tonight, and no one gets in the room until it's prepared.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_HELLO_0004109b_Oblivion_RESP1: Hold perfectly still! You're about to step on...
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_MS22Voice_000a3a57_Oblivion_RESP1: Hold there! Stop fighting! I surrender! I'll give you the carving!
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_NDProphetQuest_00002af4_Knights_R: Hold to your purpose, and you may yet fulfill the prophecy.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_CharGenVoice_0000bf0e_Oblivion_RE: Hold up. I don't like this. Let me take a look.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_SE07BSylLeaves_0003b826_Oblivion_: Hold your tongue, little Duchess, or I'll tear it from your mouth.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_SE07AThadonLeaves_000206cc_Oblivi: Hold your tongue, little Duke, or I'll tear it from your mouth.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GREETING_000027c2_Oblivion_RESP1: Honditar is the name. I'm a hunter and mountain man.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_SE38Oddity9_00081e90_Oblivion_RES: Honestly, I'd never seen one before until recently, and now to have two turn up! That's Odd in itself, isn't it? But I really can't use it, sorry.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_MS10WhatAboutLLev_0003c2c4_Oblivi: Honestly, she's never done anything to be fined or get in trouble... yet. The person I'd love to bring in as a witness is Aldos Othran.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_INFOGENERAL_00043ec3_Oblivion_RES: Honestly, who cares if that noble brat Thadon has his toy Chalice?
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_MatildePetitTopic_00028234_Oblivi: Honestly? I don't think she likes me. It's because I'm a Dunmer. I heard her say something to Neville, and it wasn't very nice.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GREETING_0003c9ac_Oblivion_RESP3: Honmund and I live together in the old Nord way. Good enough for my Fa and Ma, and good enough for me.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GREETING_0003c9ac_Oblivion_RESP2: Honmund is my live-in partner. No offense, but I don't want to hear about any 'Mara Mother Mild' and Chapel family business.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GOODBYE_0008da84_Oblivion_RESP1: Honor suits you well. May your journeys always be safe.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_MQ15KathutetC5_0003e8fb_Oblivion_: Honor, and pride, bids me tell you: none can escape the Forbidden Grotto. There you will be the charge of my kynsman, Orthe.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_FGD04Choice2_0002ee6e_Oblivion_RE: Honor, huh? I prefer feeding my family. I figure I owe you one for covering for me, so I'll let you leave. Get moving, before I forget myself.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_SE09Ceremony_00014acd_Oblivion_RE: Honored Daedra, fear not thy abasement! Thou shalt be the Holy in this Temple.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GREETING_00009c7c_Oblivion_RESP1: Honored Listener! I offer myself as your humble servant and guide. Please, allow me to mentor you in your new role.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_DEAkHope_000037da_AltarDeluxe_RES: Hope is gone. The Enemy has won. In the west, people are even starting to disappear... The gods have forsaken us.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GREETING_0002d77a_Oblivion_RESP1: Hope is gone. The Imperial line is dead.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GOODBYE_00038f12_Oblivion_RESP1: Hope to see you again soon.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GOODBYE_00132a9e_Oblivion_RESP1: Hope to see you again soon.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_NightofFun_0003d4a6_Oblivion_RESP: Hope you're not planning to get much sleep.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_ogres_0000be81_Oblivion_RESP1: Horrible creatures! Replete with horror and evil. They roam freely eastward of the estate. I look forward to you exterminizing them.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_goblins_000289f3_Oblivion_RESP1: Horrible creatures, and they've made this mine too dangerous for the workers. We're going to have to get rid of them.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_ChorrolNQDQuestionResponses_00023: Horrible things, those Arena matches. Simply bloodshed for the sake of bloodshed. Barbaric, I tell you.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_CreatureResponses_0002b1c6_Oblivi: Horrible things. I hear that the High Elves train them. I can't imagine it.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_disappearances_0006b31c_Oblivion_: Horrible, just horrible. Those poor people.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_CreatureResponses_0002919d_Oblivi: Horrid beasts. I hate the things.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_VampireTopic_0001e0b9_Oblivion_RE: Horrid creatures. I hope we never see one in the Imperial City again.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_INFOGENERAL_0005edfb_Oblivion_RES: Horsey! Did you hear about the new ruler in Bliss? Did you? Good horsey.

ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_SQ01Yes_001885de_Oblivion_RESP1: Hot out of the oven! Enjoy! Come back if you want more.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GREETING_000807a6_Oblivion_RESP2: How I loathe the idea of personal choice. It makes things so... imprecise.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GOODBYE_0001acd1_Oblivion_RESP1: How I look forward to our goodbyes.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_HELLO_000c4597_Oblivion_RESP1: How about mixing up some potions? You look like quite the alchemist.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GREETING_0006c29d_Oblivion_RESP1: How about you just keep walking?

ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_HELLO_0009837c_Oblivion_RESP1: How are we supposed to live under this curfew?
