ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_MS23RolandCalm_0001d4c5_Oblivion_: I - I'm sorry. I've been hiding up here in this cabin and I've forgotten my manners. Try and understand. I loved her, I'd never harm her!
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_NDProphetSpeechMain_00002a6a_Knig: I AM CYRODIIL COME, he said, Old Reman, born from the earth that IS Al-Esh, and yet he would scorn this country now! Repent! I say again, REPENT!
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_HELLO_000165ba_Oblivion_RESP1: I abhor killing, but you did the right thing.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_BarterBuyItem_0003d07f_Oblivion_R: I accept such low prices only for guild members.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_ArenaAgronakChalYes_0003a917_Obli: I accept the challenge, of course. Speak with Ysabel, tell her you're ready. Then we'll meet in the Arena and prove our mettle as warriors.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_TGPayBloodPrice_0001cf3b_Oblivion: I accept this blood price and welcome you back into the Thieves Guild. I oughta break your neck though. Don't make this a habit.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_AcceptYield_00023f44_Oblivion_RES: I accept your surrender, my friend.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_COERCELOVE_00062324_Oblivion_RESP: I accept. I have no choice.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_ServicetoLeyawiinTopic08_000860ba: I address my offer to you and your friend. Would you like to become knights-errant?
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GREETING_000206b1_Oblivion_RESP2: I admit I had my doubts about you, but something told me I was doing the right thing. Many thanks.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_INFOGENERAL_000624ad_Oblivion_RES: I admit to sharing the common enthusiasm for the Arena. It is barbaric, but the stakes of life or death make the drama irresistably compelling.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GREETING_0004e8c3_Oblivion_RESP4: I admit... I still have strong prejudices against necromancy, summoning, and illusion.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_ImperialCityTopic_000476c5_Oblivi: I agree with the Watch Captain. This Atius-Sintav feud has gone on long enough. I can control my people. I hope Iniel can control his.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_HouseTooMuchImperialCity_000531bd: I agree, but someone will be foolish enough to buy it.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_MS38Topic_00028d88_Oblivion_RESP1: I agree.  He's always writing in that little notebook.  Sometimes I think he's watching me!
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_ImperialCityTopic_00047631_Oblivi: I aim to keep an eye on things here in the city. Take it slow, get to know the people. Try not to get off on the wrong foot.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_MatildePetitTopic_00028729_Oblivi: I ain't got much to say about the old lady, and even if I did, I wouldn't say it to you.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GREETING_000493fb_Oblivion_RESP1: I ain't got nothin' to say to you, fancy pants. So why don't you mind your own business, huh?
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_TG06Theranis_00010501_Oblivion_RE: I ain't tellin' the likes of you!
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_SE11Dyus1b_000807ad_Oblivion_RESP: I alone have survived. Sheogorath cannot bring Himself to destroy the knowledge that I possess.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_SE11Dyus1b_0001a816_Oblivion_RESP: I alone have survived. Sheogorath cannot bring himself to destroy the knowledge that I possess.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_SE38Oddity6_00081e88_Oblivion_RES: I already have one of... wait a moment, no, that's the one I can't find now. If only I had the money to buy it off you....
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_DarMaTopic_000280a7_Oblivion_RESP: I already told you, she never showed up.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_Necromancers_000038b7_Oblivion_RE: I also fear their numbers may be greater than we believed.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_NevilleTopic_000286f9_Oblivion_RE: I also get the sense that he's very eager to find the gold. I can't imagine his life of servitude to the Empire left him with much to retire on.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_MS43Staff_0004f8bc_Oblivion_RESP6: I also learned that the staff makes the owner move much slower than normal. I suppose it's another way the creator upped the annoyance factor.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_MS29StopYes_0001e840_Oblivion_RES: I also want you to know that I had a long discussion with Jensine, and I have decided to join the Society.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GREETING_0002c51a_Oblivion_RESP2: I always enjoy meeting my rival treasure hunters. What, did you think you were the only one? Ha ha ha! Come, let us have a drink together.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_BravilNQDQuestionResponses_000465: I always enjoy speaking with Nahsi. His views on the world are different than most.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_RaynilDralasTopic_0003842b_Oblivi: I always liked Bradon and Erline. They were a nice couple. I hope you get to the bottom of this, cause I don't believe he was a vampire either.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_BernadettePenelesTopic_0002587b_O: I always suspected she was watching me. Thank you for finally confirming it.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GREETING_00058e01_Oblivion_RESP1: I always wanted to see the Jerall Mountains. Beautiful, aren't they? Almost makes you forget why we're here.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GREETING_00024bb3_Oblivion_RESP1: I am Alberic Litte of the Mages Guild. I am pleased to make your acquaintance.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GREETING_00038ad5_Oblivion_RESP1: I am Ambroise Canne, grape-grower for Surilie Brothers. I'm also an advanced trainer for weapon and shield parries.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GREETING_0004e8ac_Oblivion_RESP1: I am Andel Indarys, Count Cheydinhal. There is no more generous or just ruler in Cyrodiil, if I say so myself.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GREETING_0000566f_Oblivion_RESP2: I am Arquen, Speaker for the Black Hand. As you can see, we have dealt with the betrayer, Lucien Lachance! No longer will you serve as his puppet!
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GREETING_000238c9_Oblivion_RESP1: I am Arriana Valga, Countess of Chorrol.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GREETING_0001333a_Oblivion_RESP1: I am Bat gro-Orkul, warden of the armory. If you need weapons or armor, I've got them.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GREETING_0008151d_Oblivion_RESP1: I am Count Cirion, and you have violated the inner sanctum of Vitharn. What say you in your defense?
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GREETING_000120ff_Oblivion_RESP1: I am Count Cirion. What does the mighty Lord Sheogorath need here among the shades of Vitharn? Have you come to mock us?
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GREETING_000c4283_Oblivion_RESP1: I am Countess Alessia Caro, wife to Count Marius.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GREETING_000479d2_Oblivion_RESP1: I am Geel. Sergeant-of-Sharpshooters, Blackwood Company.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GREETING_000476b8_Oblivion_RESP1: I am Geem Jasaiin. We come from Black Marsh to the city to work the water ways and water trades.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GREETING_000476f0_Oblivion_RESP1: I am Gemellus Axius, Earl Jakben's manservant. He did not inform me of your visit.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_TG10FindJakben_0009ded9_Oblivion_: I am Gemellus Axius, his servant. Master Imbel has his home facing the central plaza of the Talos Plaza district.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GREETING_0004e8ab_Oblivion_RESP1: I am Gruiand Garrana, Primate of Arkay, and spiritual leader of the Cheydinhal Chapel.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GREETING_0001f146_Oblivion_RESP1: I am Harrow, Warden of the Shrine of Dagon.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_SE01HaskillChoice1_000133e0_Obliv: I am Haskill, Chamberlain to the Lord Sheogorath.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GREETING_00047752_Oblivion_RESP1: I am Hlidara Mothril, Lady Leyawiin's chaplain and chief advisor.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GREETING_00047686_Oblivion_RESP1: I am Iniel Sintav, head of the Sintav clan.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GREETING_00051dca_Oblivion_RESP1: I am Janonia Aurunceia, chief maid-servant of Castle Leyawiin.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GREETING_00051dc4_Oblivion_RESP1: I am Januarius Aurunceia, the Count's footman and boot-puller.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GREETING_0003be7f_Oblivion_RESP1: I am Kishashi and Fellmoor is my domain. A queen, some would call me. But others will say that Cindanwe is in charge. Pah! Liars!
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GREETING_0003be80_Oblivion_RESP1: I am Kishashi, great hero of the northlands. I once single handedly held off an entire horde of Grummites.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GREETING_0001f372_Oblivion_RESP1: I am Kithlan, Steward of Lady Syl. Unless you have reason to be here, your presence is unwelcome.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GREETING_00002932_Knights_RESP1: I am Lathon, squire to Sir Roderic of Wayrest. We are on a holy quest for the Crusader's Relics!
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_LordRugdumphTOPIC_0000be82_Oblivi: I am Lord Rugdumph gro-Shurgak. How may I persist you?
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_LorgrenSpeech_0006e7f0_Oblivion_R: I am Lorgren Benirus, and I desire the chance to atone for my sins.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_Dark01Choice2A_00022b9f_Oblivion_: I am Lucien Lachance, a Speaker for the Dark Brotherhood. And you, you are a killer. A taker of life. A harvester of souls.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GREETING_000479d8_Oblivion_RESP1: I am Mahei... that poor fellow who is chased everywhere by that nagging fishwife, Numeen.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GREETING_000488c8_Oblivion_RESP1: I am Mara's Primate, Chana Mona. I  take care of the Chapel's affairs in Bravil Parish, and speak for Mara in the Council of the Nine.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_MelusPetiliusTOPIC_000b167b_Obliv: I am Melus Petilius. Leave me in peace to mourn my wife, Vena.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GREETING_0003e085_Oblivion_RESP1: I am Millona Umbranox, Countess of Anvil. I hope you enjoy your visit. I trust you will give us no cause to regret our hospitality to strangers.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GREETING_0004e8ae_Oblivion_RESP1: I am Naspia Cosma, Cheydinhal's Steward. I offer introductory training with Blades, and may condescend to accept you as a student.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_NewheimthePortlyTOPIC_00002e8f_Ob: I am Newheim the Portly. What can I do for you?
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_NorbertLellesTOPIC_0003572a_Obliv: I am Norbert Lelles. How may I help you?
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GREETING_000488c9_Oblivion_RESP1: I am Olava the Fair, Mara's Living Saint. It is my responsibility not to preach, but to live Mara's commands as an example to others.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GREETING_00023fb0_Oblivion_RESP1: I am Orok gro-Ghoth, steward to Countess Arriana Valga, Countess of Chorrol. I manage her affairs, and the castle is in my keeping.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_RiBassaTOPIC_00026b0d_Oblivion_RE: I am Ri'Bassa, shaman of the Khajiit of Border Watch.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GREETING_000479ca_Oblivion_RESP1: I am Ri'zakar, Pakseech of the Blackwood Company. The Company provides expert jihatt for selected customers. Very discreet.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_LeyawiinTopic_000475c5_Oblivion_R: I am SICK of Orcs coming in here and giving me the business. 'Ooh. Bugak got a book store. Ooh. Bugak's a sissy scroll-scribbler!'
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_ND05ThedretWho_00002af8_Knights_R: I am Sir Thedret. I came here seeking the Shield of the Crusader, and was ambushed by these... these cowards. They've held me here since.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GREETING_000ace07_Oblivion_RESP1: I am Sister Angrond of Gottlesfont Priory. We gather and prepare healing herbs and mushrooms.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_TGWhoAreYou_00064467_Oblivion_RES: I am The Stranger. That is all you need to know. That, and I am no-one to be trifled with.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GREETING_000545d0_Oblivion_RESP1: I am Ugak, owner of the Grateful Pass Stables.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_WeebumNaTOPIC_00026abf_Oblivion_R: I am Weebam-Na. What do you want?
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GREETING_0001f374_Oblivion_RESP1: I am Wide-Eye, Steward to His Grace, the greatest Duke of Mania in all of history, Thadon. He is my reason for being. My purpose in life.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GREETING_000476b6_Oblivion_RESP1: I am Wumeek. Gods commend you.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_TheGrayPrince_00038b46_Oblivion_R: I am a Lord's son, yet I've been denied the noble privilege to which I am entitled. So I have become the Gray Prince, noble in my own right.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GREETING_0003640d_Oblivion_RESP2: I am a priest in the Temple of the One in the Imperial City. Perhaps our paths will cross again one day.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_Attack_0003faf2_Oblivion_RESP1: I am a vampire, a Lord of Blood!
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GREETING_00055405_Oblivion_RESP1: I am all that is left. The others were struck down by Order. How did this happen?
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GREETING_00055b04_Oblivion_RESP1: I am all that is left. The others were struck down by Order. How did this happen?
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_SE11Dyus1a_0001a815_Oblivion_RESP: I am all that remains of the knowledge contained within the great library of Jyggalag.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_SE11Dyus1a_000807ae_Oblivion_RESP: I am all that remains of the knowledge contained within the great library of Jyggalag.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_TG11TalkToMillona05_00022e80_Obli: I am also your missing husband, Corvus.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_HELLO_0002c2f8_Oblivion_RESP1: I am anxious to hear news of the book.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_MS51AccuseChanel1_00031506_Oblivi: I am ashamed of my crime, but ready to face what fate has in store for me.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_StolenPainting_0001bcca_Oblivion_: I am ashamed that I took the painting, but my love for the Count was greater than you could imagine.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GREETING_0004d0af_Oblivion_RESP2: I am at the Emperor Martin's command.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GREETING_0006bdaa_Oblivion_RESP1: I am at your command, Arch-Mage.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_MageConvFollow_0006bd9a_Oblivion_: I am at your command, Arch-Mage.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_HELLO_00071e0f_Oblivion_RESP1: I am at your mercy for now, scum.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GREETING_0006bda2_Oblivion_RESP1: I am at your service, Arch-Mage.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_HELLO_0001bac9_Oblivion_RESP1: I am at your service, Arch-Mage.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GREETING_0000296e_Knights_RESP1: I am at your service, Commander.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GREETING_00002970_Knights_RESP1: I am at your service, Lord Crusader.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GREETING_0000295b_Knights_RESP1: I am at your service, a humble vessel of the gods.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_TrainingQuestTopic_000c45a5_Obliv: I am at your service. If you need Alteration training, I am here for you.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GREETING_00098196_Oblivion_RESP1: I am beaten. Leave me alone.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_SE05Interrogate4_0001562c_Oblivio: I am being honest, that is all. The only strange reports I have received are of a robed figure seen leaving the palace late at night.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_TG07NewCaptain_0009839e_Oblivion_: I am bound by duty and honor to obey this order. After all these years, he has finally won.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GREETING_0000295d_Knights_RESP1: I am busy with the gods' work. Are you?
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_HELLO_00062cd7_Oblivion_RESP1: I am busy, so, if you will excuse me.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GREETING_0018a806_Oblivion_RESP1: I am busy. Get out. When I am ready to conduct guild business, I'll leave the door unlocked.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GREETING_00041094_Oblivion_RESP2: I am compiling a taxonomy of every living thing in the Shivering Isles, the weather, changes in the moon and stars, and their interrelationships.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_AnvilTopic_0003e0d2_Oblivion_RESP: I am currently employed at the Count's Arms, but I'm working on a piece I hope will gain me the patronage of a certain countess.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_TG10GiveBoots_00015310_Oblivion_R: I am deeply disappointed that a Master Thief had to resort to murder. I hearby revoke your Thieves Guild membership until the blood price is paid.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_TG07reject_0000c018_Oblivion_RESP: I am disappointed. When you are better prepared, return to me.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GREETING_00022505_Oblivion_RESP1: I am done with you for now. Go to the Dark Brotherhood sanctuary in Cheydinhal and speak with Ocheeva. She will provide further instruction.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_Barter_0003e452_DLCThievesDen_RES: I am eager to peruse your haul.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_SE37Beast_00045661_Oblivion_RESP1: I am getting weary of the same two beasts. All they do is scream when I experiment on them. Do you suppose you could get me a Gnarl?
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_BaurusTopic_0006b83d_Oblivion_RES: I am glad to hear that he survived, but I fear he will take the Emperor's death particularly hard.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_BaurusTopic_0001e749_Oblivion_RES: I am glad to hear that he survived. A small bit of good news in these dark times. But he will take the Emperor's death very hard.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_NDBootsoftheCrusader_00002a47_Kni: I am glad to see you were successful. It shows you as a true believer in Kynareth.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GREETING_00036305_Oblivion_RESP2: I am here to end your miserable life, to... But... I can see the confusion in your eyes. You... You have no idea what I'm talking about, do you?
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GREETING_0006bd93_Oblivion_RESP1: I am here to serve you, Arch-Mage.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GREETING_0008d31d_Oblivion_RESP1: I am here to serve, Lord. May I assist in Your great works?
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GREETING_00002950_Knights_RESP2: I am here, and ready to serve. I will join your order, and together we will fight this new threat against the Nine.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_HELLO_0002528f_Oblivion_RESP1: I am honored by your presence. How can Ocheeva be of assistance?
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GREETING_000131c2_Oblivion_RESP1: I am honored to assist Lord Sheogorath's emissary.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GREETING_00014823_Oblivion_RESP1: I am honored to be entrusted by the Gray Fox himself to run these errands.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_NDJoinOrderAccept_00002b3b_Knight: I am honored to join the Order under your illustrious command.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GREETING_00062beb_Oblivion_RESP1: I am honored to speak to the hero of the Battle of Bruma. What can I do for you?
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_MS21StatueGive_0002b5e9_Oblivion_: I am impressed. Only three more statues to complete the set. Keep up the good work, my friend.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_NineDivinesTopic_0002b6f4_Oblivio: I am in Nine Divines....I wish I had quests to give...sigh...
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_DarkBrotherhoodTopic_0002b6f2_Obl: I am in the Dark Brotherhood.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_MagesGuildTopic_0002b6f1_Oblivion: I am in the Mage's Guild.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_TGThievesGuildTopic_0002b6f3_Obli: I am in the Thieves Guild.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_MS21StatueShow_00085991_Oblivion_: I am interested in obtaining the complete set of these statues. If you bring them to me when you find them, I will pay you double for each one.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_MS21AyleidStatueTopic_0002b43e_Ob: I am looking for the complete set of ten for my collection. They were once part of the Temple of the Ancestors in the ancient Ayleid capital.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_MS21AyleidStatueTopic_00085992_Ob: I am looking for the complete set of ten for my collection. They were once part of the Temple of the Ancestors in the ancient Ayleid capital.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_DEAkDisappearances_00014e21_Altar: I am more than a humble priest and represent an Order that stood for Akatosh for centuries.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_HELLO_00062c89_Oblivion_RESP1: I am never too busy for good talk.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_MQ15EldamilHelp_000473c7_Oblivion: I am no match for Mankar Camoran, but perhaps together we can find a way to defeat him. Lead on.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_SE08CommanderPlan1_00018c82_Obliv: I am not certain. But do not lose heart, I have an idea.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_SE08CommanderPlan1_00018c83_Obliv: I am not certain. But do not lose heart, I have an idea.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_Hit_0003b1e3_Oblivion_RESP1: I am nothing but a vile spawn of evil! Kill me!
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_TGPayBloodPrice_0001cf3a_Oblivion: I am now allowed to grant you a promotion to Master Thief. Congratulations, I suppose. Be ready if the Gray Fox should need you again.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GREETING_0000293b_Knights_RESP1: I am on my way to the Wayshrine of Zenithar. Come with me and we shall seek Zenithar's blessing together, if you will.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_TGDoyen_0001d4d3_Oblivion_RESP2: I am one Doyen and S'krivva is the other.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_UmbacanoTopic_000a984a_Oblivion_R: I am one of his guard dogs, no more, no less. He pays us well to guard his many treasures. This is enough for me.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_MQ02JauffreD3_0001e74c_Oblivion_R: I am one of the few who know of his existence. Many years ago, I served as captain of Uriel's bodyguards, the Blades.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GREETING_000981f3_Oblivion_RESP1: I am only a supplicant. Speak to the Dark Elf wearing the robes.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GREETING_000314fb_Oblivion_RESP1: I am overjoyed at your return. What may I assist you with?
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_Inventory_0001d03a_Oblivion_RESP1: I am pleased that Thoronir has decided to donate his inventory to the temple. At least he is trying to make amends.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_CureforVampirism_0003e94c_Oblivio: I am pleased that you would ask. There is a way, though it is not known to me.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_NDBootsoftheCrusader_00002a42_Kni: I am pleased to see that you have them.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GREETING_00081792_Oblivion_RESP2: I am pleased with your work, Inquisitor. As a token of my appreciation, I shall spare your life, and make you a Courtier of Dementia.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_SE32AcolyteWarning_0008fb71_Obliv: I am powerless without more magicka.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_TGHieronymusLex_0001c4e2_Oblivion: I am promoting you to Cat Burglar, which means you can use Luciana Galena of Bravil as your fence. Congratulations on your new rank.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_TG04AhdarjisStolenRing_00007de8_O: I am promoting you to Prowler. Congratulations.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_LeyawiinTopic_000475ce_Oblivion_R: I am proud of my family's tradition of service to Leyawiin and its people. We face many challenges, but Gods willing, we shall prevail.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GREETING_0008d31b_Oblivion_RESP1: I am quite busy, but there is always time for you, Lord Sheogorath. What may I do for you?
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_DAMalacathChoice4_0001ec3a_Oblivi: I am quite pleased with the ogre slaves in my Bleak Mine. No issues of slavery with brute beasts. Profitable. And legal.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GREETING_000276a6_Oblivion_RESP1: I am ready for battle when you are, champion. What say you?
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_INFOGENERAL_000a80a4_Oblivion_RES: I am resident to encounter the minotaur. Its horny protuberants cause me great conflagrations.

ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GREETING_0001b92e_Oblivion_RESP2: I am sorry to be so forward, but I desperately need your help. It seems that my husband, Rythe, has gone missing, and I just don't know what to do.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GREETING_0006a840_Oblivion_RESP1: I am sorry, fellow magister, but I don't have time to talk right now. My studies keep me very busy, as you can well imagine!
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GatherClues_00031525_Oblivion_RES: I am sorry. I don't really feel comfortable talking with you about that night. I barely know you.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GOODBYE_0001e7e0_Oblivion_RESP1: I am still aghast. To think that someone would stoop so low...
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GREETING_0000292d_Knights_RESP1: I am still eager to join the Order. Have you reconsidered?
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GREETING_0008ebfc_Oblivion_RESP1: I am sure Lord Sheogorath will be thrilled to hear whatever pressing matter you have to discuss with Him.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_MQ15KathutetC4_0003e8fa_Oblivion_: I am tasked with keeping order here in the Savage Garden where Mankar Camoran's chattel challenge themselves in unceasing combat.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_TG11TalkToMillona03_00022e7e_Obli: I am the Gray Fox, but you have not been betrayed.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GREETING_0001e447_Oblivion_RESP1: I am the Master Smith of New Sheoth. Why bother with that other smith?
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_LeyawiinTopic_00047903_Oblivion_R: I am the best alchemist in Leyawiin. But if you need Advanced Training, you'll need Brotch Calus in Bruma or Ardaline in Bravil.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_CheydinhalTopic_0004e8bc_Oblivion: I am the chapter head of the Cheydinhal Mages Guild. It is quite an honor... but they had no choice, since I'm the only semi-competent one here.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GREETING_000412c7_Oblivion_RESP2: I am the curator of the Museum of Oddities, Una Armina. Have we met? You look familiar...
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GREETING_000488c7_Oblivion_RESP1: I am the healer, Marz of Black Marsh. By the grace of Mara, I am available as an Advanced Trainer in Restoration.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_SE32FanaticYell_0001b70b_Oblivion: I am the wrath of the righteous!
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_TG10GiveBoots_0001cf37_Oblivion_R: I am truly indebted to you. If all goes well, I may call upon you for one last task. The danger will be great, but the reward will be greater.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GREETING_0000a0fb_Oblivion_RESP4: I am unable to look into something that has been brought to my attention. Are you capable of going on my behalf?
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_NecromancersMoon_00002dcf_Oblivio: I am unfamiliar with the "Shade of the Revenant" described within the book, but I was never one to dabble in the more, shall we say, amoral arts.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_JanusHassildorTopic_0000399c_Obli: I am unsure as to why he has requested that you, of all people, should be the one to visit him. I have no wish to put you in harm's way.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GREETING_00026d90_Oblivion_RESP1: I am very disappointed. I had hoped we would not meet again under these circumstances.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GREETING_00026d92_Oblivion_RESP1: I am very disappointed. I had hoped we would not meet again under these circumstances.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_CGEmperor02_0002ad13_Oblivion_RES: I am your emperor, Uriel Septim. By the grace of the Gods, I serve Tamriel as her ruler.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GOODBYE_00081dcd_Oblivion_RESP1: I am your servant, Lord Sheogorath.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_MS16Brothers_00084a9d_Oblivion_RE: I am your twin brother. When we were very small, our farm was attacked by ogres. My ... our father and I escaped.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GREETING_00017cfc_Oblivion_RESP1: I am yours to command, Your Grace.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GREETING_0008f044_Oblivion_RESP1: I am yours to command, Your Grace.

ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_HELLO_00086751_Oblivion_RESP1: I am yours to command, oh great Listener!
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GREETING_00017973_Oblivion_RESP2: I apologize for doubting you, Your Grace. You are a most worthy leader, perhaps the greatest warrior to ever hold the Seat of Mania.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_NDProphetGreetA4_00002aa7_Knights: I apologize for even asking the question, most esteemed Master. Please, do not allow me to interrupt your quest for the Relics.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_Daedricshrine_00003938_Oblivion_R: I appreciate all of your help. Thank you.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GREETING_000276a4_Oblivion_RESP1: I appreciate the help that you have brought to Bruma. I begin to think we have a chance.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GREETING_0003c2be_Oblivion_RESP1: I appreciate the interest you're taking in helping us with our situation.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_FGJoin1_00024283_Oblivion_RESP1: I appreciate your enthusiasm, but you've got a bit of a bad reputation. Make a better name for yourself, and perhaps we can accept your application.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GlarthirTopic_0002365f_Oblivion_R: I appreciate your warning. I'll be on the lookout for him. But please tell the guards so they can arrest him before he attacks me!
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_Mg12TravenGoOn_000835fa_Oblivion_: I argued against it, but eventually agreed to maintain order in the Council. I regret that decision, and that is why I wish to send you there.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_TG11P5HowIsThat_0001fb72_Oblivion: I arranged for the notable Celia Camoran to want to read a particular Elder Scroll. Don't ask how. However, she will be... unavoidably detained.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_InfoRefusal_000245a1_Oblivion_RES: I ask myself... Do I like you enough to tell you about this?
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_MQ06NoGive_0001f169_Oblivion_RESP: I ask you one last time: give me your possessions. The Master requires it of all initiates.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GREETING_00047752_Oblivion_RESP2: I assist Her Ladyship so that her enlightened policies might achieve the greatest  possible influence upon the affairs of County Leyawiin.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_SE03AWhatShould_00018df6_Oblivion: I assume Sheogorath gave you the Manual of Xedilian. You can consult it for more information, or I can provide instructions.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_MQ03MartinA1_00092267_Oblivion_RE: I assume you didn't risk your own life to come here to tell me something I already know. Who are you and what do you want?
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GREETING_000a04de_Oblivion_RESP1: I assume you found Springheel Jak's tomb.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GREETING_0018abcf_Oblivion_RESP1: I assume you've dealt with Raelynn appropriately.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GREETING_0007b7a8_Oblivion_RESP1: I assume you've made your choice. Umbra hungers. What shall it be?
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_duties_0002ae27_Oblivion_RESP1: I assume you've taken care of this issue. So, tell me what happened. Why were our men causing trouble? And what did you do?
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_MG13CavernChoiceWhy_000039b4_Obli: I assure you, I am not responsible for them. I would never be so careless. Where there are mindless animals, predators are never far behind.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GOODBYE_00026bab_Oblivion_RESP1: I assure you, the gold is well worth the risk.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_ND06CasimirStory1_00002b2c_Knight: I attempted to return to the service of the Nine, but the war had changed me. I no longer had sympathy for the weak, or pity for the suffering.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_CreatureResponses_0002919f_Oblivi: I avoid those things whenever I can. Horrible creatures.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GREETING_00002930_Knights_RESP1: I await your permission to join the Order.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GOODBYE_000165b1_Oblivion_RESP1: I await your return... if you return.

ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_MS12Boring_000980f7_Oblivion_RESP: I beg to differ, history can be quite enriching. Hmph. I figured you to have more brains than brawn, but so be it.

ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_Recommendation_0002e5a3_Oblivion_: I believe I explained your task very clearly. Find the ring, which is somewhere down in the well behind the guild hall. Bring it to me.

ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_BravilNQDQuestionResponses_000466: I believe he's always looking for new members, but I don't think it's for me.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_TrainingQuestTopic_0018d156_Obliv: I believe he's currently residing somewhere north of Bravil. Spends most of his time in Niben Bay, I understand. And I do mean IN Niben Bay.

ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_MS21AyleidStatueTopic_00085992_Ob: I believe they were hidden in various Ayleid settlements across Cyrodiil, although I do not know the exact location of any of them.

ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_SQ05RaelynntheGravefinder_0018abd: I believe we had a contract. Here's my part.

ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_SEDunrootBurrowTopic_0004301e_Obl: I believe you've already been instructed as to how to proceed. You'll need to ingest Felldew to enter the Burrow.

ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GREETING_00040bc2_Oblivion_RESP1: I bid you greetings and cheer, with the grace of a noble stallion. You seem to be of fine temper and wit, says the poet known as Halion.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_SE09Ceremony_00014ad1_Oblivion_RE: I bind thee Atronach to this body, henceforth Gatekeeper of the Shivering Isles.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GREETING_000253b6_Oblivion_RESP2: I borrowed quite a bit of gold from some underworld types.  I... I missed a payment. Now they don't even want the money. They say I insulted them!
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_ChorrolNQDQuestionResponses_00023: I bought a fine mare from him once. A fine, fine animal.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_INFOGENERAL_0003c258_Oblivion_RES: I bought some wine from Davide Surilie. Excellent body. He's a fine vintner.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_INFOGENERAL_0003c25b_Oblivion_RES: I bought some wine from Gaston Surilie a few days ago. I was very impressed by it.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GREETING_0000294e_Knights_RESP4: I bring nothing but my skill with the blade, which is not inconsiderable, and my devotion to the Lord Auri-El.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_SE09RelmynaVerenim_00014ae7_Obliv: I brought her to my Realm so she could continue to study her "sixth element." Honestly, I didn't know there were five already.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_CheydinhalTopic_0004e8a5_Oblivion: I came here because I love nature. And because I didn't want to serve as a boot wizard in a mountain legion in Skyrim.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_ND04CarodusGreeting1_00002ad3_Kni: I came here seeking his mace. However, I could not pass the test. I'm just...  I'm no crusader. But that doesn't mean that I cannot serve Zenithar.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_MS11TellMe_00038443_Oblivion_RESP: I came home only just a few hours ago. I found the door open, and my Bradon dead. Standing over him was a Dunmer.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_MS47MageShopTalk_00030132_Oblivio: I came out here to get some privacy for my research. Instead, I was constantly bothered by the local peasantry!
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_BravilTopic_000488fe_Oblivion_RES: I came to Bravil because Mara called me. Bravil is not my home. I miss Black Marsh. But I shall serve here, so long as Mara needs me.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_LeyawiinTopic_0004761a_Oblivion_R: I came to Leyawiin after a tour in the Legions. Poor Mother. She hoped I'd choose the chapel or civil service, or perhaps even marry well.

ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_SE11StaffOfSheogorath_00014b54_Ob: I can create the physical shell of the Staff, but the divine essence must be gathered elsewhere.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_SE11StaffOfSheogorath_00016ef5_Ob: I can create the physical shell of the Staff, but the divine essence must be gathered elsewhere.

ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_HELLO_0008e4dd_Oblivion_RESP1: I can hear the bones talking.

ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_TG10FindJakben_00048977_Oblivion_: I can help. The Earl of Imbel has a home in the Talos Plaza, on the inner wall.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_BrumaNQDResponses_000465ee_Oblivi: I can imagine he's a good teacher. The Fighters Guild should be proud of him.

ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_LeyawiinNQDResponses_0003e2a6_Obl: I don't understand the fascination with sheep. Certainly seems to know everything about Mysticism, though.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_INFOGENERAL_000255c3_Oblivion_RES: I don't understand what Glistel is doing with Malintus Ancrus. I mean, have you seen her? And have you seen him? I just don't get it.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_TG08BlindMonks_000983ad_Oblivion_: I don't understand what you mean. We can see just fine.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GREETING_00041f1a_Oblivion_RESP1: I don't understand... the world was supposed to end.... Order was supposed to destroy everything. It has always happened that way.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_RaynilDralasTopic_00038430_Oblivi: I don't usually give out that kind of information. Especially to people I don't know.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_BribeGuard_0003ab3d_Oblivion_RESP: I don't usually take bribes, but I'll look the other way just this once. If I see you again though, I'll have to arrest you.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_INFOGENERAL_000825ef_Oblivion_RES: I don't visit the Museum of Oddities, but Una Armina is always looking for new items to display.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_TGSpecialJobs_00035fbe_Oblivion_R: I don't want that ring! It's too hot to sell. You are supposed to take it to Ahdarji. I swear, the new recruits are getting worse.

ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GREETING_0007cc4f_Oblivion_RESP1: I don't want to see it coming. Take me unaware. And, for your own good, it should probably look like an accident.

ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GREETING_000356b0_Oblivion_RESP1: I don't want to talk to you, traitor.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_SE05PostTortureGreet_00081af0_Obl: I don't want trouble! I keep to myself, but I see Ma'zaddha and that Dark Seducer, Nelrene, meeting behind the buildings late at night sometimes.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GREETING_0000c1c0_Oblivion_RESP1: I don't wish to get underway until Selene is safely locked in a room on the inn deck.

ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_SeridurTopic_0001d4c2_Oblivion_RE: I doubt that he's told Gilen and Grey-Throat anything, but you could always try.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_ADMIREDISLIKE_00062310_Oblivion_R: I doubt you really mean that.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_Nirnroot_0004e91e_Oblivion_RESP1: I dunno. Never seen that sort of root before. Head over to the West Weald Inn and talk to Sinderion. He could identify it for you I'm sure.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_DAVaerminaSpeech_0008ade5_Oblivio: I dwell in your dreams; I savor your nightmares. Now, you will serve me.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_MS43Staff_0004f8bf_Oblivion_RESP2: I eagerly bought it, knowing the value of Daedric relics. In fact, I was a bit suspicious when he sold it so cheap. His loss, my gain I figured.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_AnvilNQDResponses_0003c1c1_Oblivi: I enjoy a good bottle of wine, and Wilbur always has a nice selection.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_INFOGENERAL_000241d1_Oblivion_RES: I enjoy being in the Fighters Guild, though there haven't been quite as many contracts lately.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_INFOGENERAL_0003c25f_Oblivion_RES: I enjoy the wines that Tamika makes at her vineyard. And they're reasonably priced, as well.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_NDTalkGarlas2_00002c43_Knights_RE: I envy you, I freely admit it! To have stood shoulder-to-shoulder with the Divine Crusader on the day that Umaril fell...

ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_breakins_000356b5_Oblivion_RESP2: I even trusted them to open up the shop in the mornings. I can't imagine what turned them to a life of crime. Sad. Well, here's your payment.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GREETING_0008f046_Oblivion_RESP1: I exist to serve, Your Grace.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GREETING_0008f048_Oblivion_RESP1: I exist to serve, Your Grace.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GOODBYE_00019da1_Oblivion_RESP1: I expect results, Inquisitor, and I expect them soon.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_SE13CaptainGreetA1_0001a79d_Obliv: I expect that this is the beginning of the final assault. The cursed usurper Jyggalag himself may even take the field before the end.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_SE13CaptainGreetA3_0005e37c_Obliv: I expect that this is the beginning of the final assault. The cursed usurper Jyggalag himself may even take the field before the end.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_MG00JoinA_0002d287_Oblivion_RESP1: I expect this will end in disaster, but nonetheless, I will grant your request.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_SE46DoublesTopic_00081ecd_Oblivio: I expect you to be taking care of the problem. I'm too tired to do it.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_SE06DSWardenGreet2_00018e89_Obliv: I expected better from you. Are you the one witless Khajiit in all the world?
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_MS11Peaceful_0003858b_Oblivion_RE: I expected to lay low here for a while and then be on my way. So again, I underestimated you.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_MQ13MartinD2_0009ce84_Oblivion_RE: I explain myself to you so you understand me. And so you can explain to the Countess.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_ND06WhatTalking_00002afe_Knights_: I fail Kellen every time I speak to him, and I fail Stendarr every time I pray to him and do not ask for the power to lift the curse.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_ND04Mace_00002acb_Knights_RESP4: I failed my friend and I failed Zenithar. Perhaps you can succeed where Sir Ralvas could not and redeem us both.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_ND06CasimirHurryUp_00002b26_Knigh: I failed to show mercy, and Stendarr cursed me for it. Right my wrongs, show mercy where it is needed, and Stendarr may grant you the Gauntlets.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_BlackwaterBrigands_0000c1ce_Obliv: I fashioned a tale about a "Golden Galleon" that the previous owner hid within this very vessel. It was to be a statuette made completely of gold.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_LeyawiinTopic_00047602_Oblivion_R: I fear Lady Leyawiin and Hlidara Mothril plan to push the minorities aside and establish a bland, Imperial-dominated culture here in Leyawiin.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_MS08UrsanneTell_0001f42b_Oblivion: I fear for his life. Kurdan isn't known for his patience. Please, I'm not wealthy, but I'd give anything to see Aleron again.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_MS27AyleidCrown_000a656c_Oblivion: I fear for what Umbacano may unleash using that Crown. He is blind to the true nature of the Ayleids.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_SE07JyggalagTopic_0009120d_Oblivi: I fear it won't be long until he makes his presence known. Without Sheogorath on His throne, the Realm is likely doomed. Again.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_BorderWatchTOPIC_0003e1fc_Oblivio: I fear it won't survive this day! The K'Sharra has come!
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_Manor_00003a5d_Oblivion_RESP4: I fear my own greed got the better of my judgment. I hope you weren't hurt badly in that horrible place.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_NecromancersAmuletTopic_0000c08a_: I fear she is not safe from the minions of the King of Worms. She is at Fort Ontus; please, go there and return with the Amulet.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_NDTalkUmaril1_00002c59_Knights_RE: I fear that Umaril will strike again before we are ready. This waiting... it grates on my nerves.

ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GREETING_0001796c_Oblivion_RESP3: I fear that our work is not yet done. The area is still overrun with Knights that were not destroyed in the spire.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_AmuletofKingsTopic_00034067_Obliv: I fear that the Amulet was the target of this attack. Go and see if it is safe!

ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_HELLO_000343e5_Oblivion_RESP1: I fear the enemy came here for the Amulet of Kings.

ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_UmbacanoTopic_000a9843_Oblivion_R: I fear the worst, but Umbacano Manor remains in my charge, and I will keep it in readiness for his return.

ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_INFOGENERAL_0003c1b7_Oblivion_RES: I feel sorry for Norbert Lelles. He's a good man, but he gets taken in so easily.

ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_AlbertJemaneTopic_0008b076_Oblivi: I find the fact that my father was a "notorious master criminal" absurd. He was a peaceful farmer, nothing more.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_ImperialCityTopic_0004770f_Oblivi: I find things to do. I manage the house, make sure Amantius doesn't starve or run out of ink.

ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GREETING_000251e2_Oblivion_RESP1: I find your very presence foul. Say what you will and then leave my sight!
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_NDTalk5_00002bc1_Knights_RESP1: I find your words truly inspiring, my friend. Let me go now, and think upon all you've said. We'll speak again later.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GREETING_0001b659_Oblivion_RESP1: I follow Adeo, your Grace. If she follows you, then so do I.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GREETING_0001cce7_Oblivion_RESP1: I follow Issmi, your Grace. If she follows you, then so do I.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_HELLO_000227b2_Oblivion_RESP1: I follow the Emperor's orders, but that doesn't mean I trust you.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_NDEightAndOneTopic_00002c8d_Knigh: I follow the old way, of honoring the Eight while also giving due to Talos, the One who ascended.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_FaelianTopic_0002ff13_Oblivion_RE: I followed him a few times, to see where he goes. He walks around the city looking for skooma, and then goes to Lorkmir's house for several hours.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_SE02Passwall_0008e502_Oblivion_RE: I followed the bones. They lead me here. I just moved in when I got here. No one seemed to mind. Everyone here seems to be waiting for something.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_BookResponses_000285af_Oblivion_R: I found "Istunondë's Cosmology" at the bookseller's. Haven't had a chance to read much, though.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_INFOGENERAL_000241cc_Oblivion_RES: I found some good pauldrons at the armorer.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_SE11CiirtaGreeting1b_00016b70_Obl: I gathered those who could see the light and I led a revolt against him. We were... slaughtered by his Dark Seducers. I alone was spared.

ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_INFOGENERAL_000241d3_Oblivion_RES: I get paid to kill things. That's why I like the Fighters Guild.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GREETING_00002966_Knights_RESP1: I give praise to the Nine. I owe them much.

ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_Announcer_0004666f_Oblivion_RESP1: I give you... the Blue Team's Hero! Can this brave combatant defeat three opponents and become the next Champion? Let's find out!

ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_CGEmperor18_00032482_Oblivion_RES: I go to my grave. A tongue shriller than all the music calls me.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GREETING_00002935_Knights_RESP1: I go to offer prayers to blessed Dibella, and to swear vengeance on those who profaned her Chapel and cruelly slew her acolytes.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GREETING_0008961f_Oblivion_RESP1: I got it from a dead Hunger. Those things are mean. Glad I didn't have to kill it. Here take it. It's his tongue!
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_ImperialCityTopic_000476e0_Oblivi: I got no beds here. You need a bed in the Imperial City, you got four choices. The King and Queens and Luther Broads are in the Gardens.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_UmbacanoTopic_000a9849_Oblivion_R: I got no complaints. Kind of an arrogant bastard if you get right down to it, but he pays us well enough.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_HackdirtTopic_000286a1_Oblivion_R: I got nothing to say to you, stranger.  Outsiders have always tried to destroy us, but we've always survived.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GREETING_0004e8b8_Oblivion_RESP2: I got out while I still had the original set of legs, arms, and eyes. Fighters Guild is a perfect place for me now.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GREETING_000237cb_Oblivion_RESP1: I got stuff to do. Don't bother me.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_Manor_0000bcd7_Oblivion_RESP1: I got the door open. The rest is up to you.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_KvatchTopic_0002d930_Oblivion_RES: I got through the gate, and kept running through the woods by the light of the fires.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_DABoethiaSpeech_00051ed9_Oblivion: I greet you, Chosen One! A victory in my Tournament of Ten Bloods brings great honor.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GREETING_0003e091_Oblivion_RESP1: I greet you. Thaurron, Journeyman of the Mages Guild.
