ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_INFOGENERAL_000825e8_Oblivion_RES: I understand the merchants of Crucible are having problems with Brithaur.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_INFOGENERAL_000825e3_Oblivion_RES: I understand there's a Knight of the Thorn in Hale.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_INFOGENERAL_0005f1e7_Oblivion_RES: I understand there's a new Gatekeeper. Rebuilt much faster this time around, unless I'm mistaken. And I never am.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_INFOGENERAL_00077d01_Oblivion_RES: I understand there's been strange activity near the obelisks around the Isles.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_SEObeliskResponses_00077d0b_Obliv: I understand they're coming from the obelisks.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_LeyawiinNQDQuestionResponses_0003: I understand they've been taking a lot of the contracts that used to go to the Fighters Guild.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_tasks_00035678_Oblivion_RESP3: I understand this may not seem the most important of tasks, but still... it needs doing, and you are one of the few available to do it.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_EaranaTopic_0002a689_Oblivion_RES: I understand you have spoken with her. As you are new to the guild, I will not hold this against you, but I warn you to be wary of her.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GREETING_0003e94b_Oblivion_RESP1: I understand you're looking for a cure for vampirism.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_MS40RewardGold_000a3df6_Oblivion_: I understand. Accept this knowing that you have my thanks. And farewell.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_NDJoinOrderReject_00002b34_Knight: I understand. I can only hope that one day, you will judge me to be worthy.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_TG11Reject_0001fb63_Oblivion_RESP: I understand. I don't want anyone taking on this job unless they feel up to it. Return to me when you are more confident.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_NDJoinOrderReject_00002b30_Knight: I understand. I'm not ready yet. But I won't give up.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_MS43Decline_0004f8c4_Oblivion_RES: I understand. No need to jump headlong into a dangerous situation. But do hurry. I can only keep it a secret for so long.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_HorseTooMuchCheydinhal_0004f011_O: I understand. The Cheydinhal Black horse is only for the most discriminating of customers.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_MS04HelpNo_0003d30f_Oblivion_RESP: I understand. Well, if it's all the same to you, please don't tell anyone about Gogan's indiscretion.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_MQ15EldamilD2_0003fbe4_Oblivion_R: I understand. Why would you trust me? But you have no choice. I am the only one who can help you escape this place.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GREETING_0008efc8_Oblivion_RESP1: I used my piety to avoid joining the defense. Thus I earned my doom.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GREETING_0000297c_Knights_RESP1: I used to admire you. But it turns out you're just a sinner like all the rest of us.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GREETING_00026add_Oblivion_RESP1: I used to be a dog. I got better. Not a better dog, though. I'm a terrible dog now. Tomorrow...who knows? Ravel may know. Talk to him.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_AnvilTopic_0003e0dc_Oblivion_RESP: I used to be a knacker. That's how I fancy my horses. Ripe, stiff and silent. Hate it when they stare at me. Dumb beasts.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_LeyawiinTopic_000475c7_Oblivion_R: I used to be a priest of the Tribunal Temple in Kragenmoor. After the collapse, I drifted for a while, until I joined the Chapel.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_INFOGENERAL_000441e5_Oblivion_RES: I used to have a Great Torch. Where did I put it? That one is relit, which is a good thing. Mine's still missing.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_NDProphetTopic_00002a87_Knights_R: I used to think he was crazy, but now he seems to be making some kind of sense. I hope that doesn't mean I'm going crazy now.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GREETING_0000297b_Knights_RESP1: I used to think you were a hero. A holy knight and all that. I guess I should have known better.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_SECreatureResponses_0008dc38_Obli: I walk right past them. They're slow creatures.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_NDPilgrimageTopic_00002a9d_Knight: I walk the Pilgrim's Way, as did the questing knights of old. I would be glad of your company on the road, if your way lies with mine.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_SE02Gatekeeper_0008e4c8_Oblivion_: I want him dead. I need him dead! His bones are calling to me. Rumor has it you want him dead, too.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_SE09RebuildGatekeeper_00014ae8_Ob: I want him there guarding those Gates. If any of Jyggalag's forces show up, he should be ready for them.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_MazogaTalk02_0008656e_Oblivion_RE: I want to go to Fisherman's Rock. Where's that?
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_INFOGENERAL_00032ea4_Oblivion_RES: I want to train my armoring skill, I go to Bravil. Right?
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_MS37SdrassaHelp_00022e5f_Oblivion: I want you to bring to me as many of Garridan's Tears as you can find. If you do, I will pay you a fair bounty in gold for each one.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GREETING_000356ab_Oblivion_RESP1: I want you to get back to Water's Edge. Make sure the Blackwood Company hasn't forced those residents out.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_infiltrate_000356eb_Oblivion_RESP: I want you to get to Leyawiin and join the Blackwood Company. Find the secret of their success.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_HistSapTopic_000a3453_Oblivion_RE: I want you to go back there. Make sure the Company hasn't ousted the residents. Lay low. I don't want them finding you there.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_ViranusDontonTOPIC_0002f9e9_Obliv: I want you to go check it out. I don't need to tell you how sensitive a matter this is. Get moving, and report back to me as soon as possible.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_BlackwoodCompany_000356df_Oblivio: I want you to go there and capture Ajum-Kajin, one of their leaders. Bring him back to me. I'd like to spend some time... talking to him.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_ViranusDontonTOPIC_00003932_Obliv: I want you to lay low for a while. Talk to Azzan or gro-Khash. Let me deal with Vilena. You've still got a career ahead of you.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_ViranusDontonTOPIC_0002f9e2_Obliv: I want you to lay low for a while. Talk to Azzan or gro-Khash. Let me deal with Vilena. You've still got a career ahead of you.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_ViranusDontonTOPIC_0002f9e3_Obliv: I want you to lay low for a while. Talk to Azzan or gro-Khash. Let me deal with Vilena. You've still got a career ahead of you.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_DASanguineSpeech_000b121e_Oblivio: I want you to liven it up. Use this spell on the Countess and her guests. I think it will make the party much more interesting.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_HistTreeTopic_00035701_Oblivion_R: I want you to take this. May it serve you well. Now, you should tell Vilena Donton what has happened.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_INFOGENERAL_000255b2_Oblivion_RES: I wanted to get a little practice in with my sword, so I headed to the Fighters Guild. Turns out you have to be a member to train there.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_ND03GroveofTrials_00002be6_Knight: I warn you that it is unwise to take anyone with you. You should go there alone.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GREETING_00028865_Oblivion_RESP4: I warn you though, what we've seen so far is nothing compared to the battle that likely awaits us.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GOODBYE_0005376f_Oblivion_RESP1: I warn you... don't cross me.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_Trespass_000175c3_Oblivion_RESP1: I warned you to leave, and you didn't listen. Brethren! Help me!
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_CharGenRenote_0000b227_Oblivion_R: I warned you to stay out of our way.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GREETING_0002a360_Oblivion_RESP1: I warned you! I'll call the guard if you don't leave!
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GREETING_0002a34c_Oblivion_RESP1: I warned you! Now the guards will arrest you for trespassing!
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GREETING_00029204_Oblivion_RESP1: I warned you! You'll be arrested for trespassing!
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_MQ09GhostA_00036665_Oblivion_RESP: I was Alain, loyal Blade of Emperor Tiber Septim. I do not know how long I have been dead. It feels like an eternity.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_MQ09GhostA_00036663_Oblivion_RESP: I was Casnar, loyal Blade of Emperor Tiber Septim. I do not know how long I have been dead. It feels like an eternity.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_MQ09GhostA_00036662_Oblivion_RESP: I was Rielus, loyal Blade of Emperor Tiber Septim. I do not know how long I have been dead. It feels like an eternity.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_MQ09GhostA_00036664_Oblivion_RESP: I was Valdemar, loyal Blade of Emperor Tiber Septim. I do not know how long I have been dead. It feels like an eternity.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_SE34Crisis_00066edd_Oblivion_RESP: I was a Knight of the Thorn from Cyrodiil. As soon as I heard the gates to the Shivering Isles opened, I knew a threat was lurking inside.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_MagesStaff_0002f1ef_Oblivion_RESP: I was a little ashamed afterwards, but didn't know how to apologize or give it back. I wish I could...
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_MS43StaffTalk_0004f8c2_Oblivion_R: I was able to get a message to her earlier, but I've yet to get a reply. If I go, then the scamps will follow and my secret will be revealed to all.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GREETING_0005a02a_Oblivion_RESP2: I was afraid we were gonna be ordered in there. Legion always ends up doing everybody's dirty work.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GREETING_0004f8bb_Oblivion_RESP1: I was afraid you wouldn't come back.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_INFOGENERAL_0005dd10_Oblivion_RES: I was always perfectly loyal to the old Duchess. As I am to the new Duke, whoever it may be.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_ND04SirRalvasGreeting01_00002ad9_: I was arrogant and foolhardy. I sought personal glory. I placed my own will and my own lust for fame over the will of the Nine.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_INFOGENERAL_00037ce4_Oblivion_RES: I was at Olav's earlier and I ran into this Dunmer named Raynil Dralas. After a round or two, he told me he was an honest-to-goodness vampire hunter!
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_MQ15EldamilC2_0003fbe0_Oblivion_R: I was at the sack of Kvatch. They had no chance. We took them by surprise, and we carried the walls in the first assault.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GatherClues_0001bcc8_Oblivion_RES: I was careless to leave my art supplies around the castle like I did. I suppose I was easy to discover.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GREETING_0001796c_Oblivion_RESP2: I was certain that no one could survive the spire's collapse, but here you are! By the Staff, you are more than worthy to lead us.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_SQ09Ask_00066f2b_Oblivion_RESP2: I was collecting their scales, see. I had a contract with this young alchemist. You wouldn't believe what he was paying for those scales!
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_SQ04Notes_0018a95c_Oblivion_RESP1: I was doing some research in Bramblepoint Cave, and suddenly I was attacked. I grabbed everything I could and ran, but I fear I dropped my notes.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GatherClues_00031522_Oblivion_RES: I was elsewhere at the time of the robbery, and the chamber was locked.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_BookResponses_000285b2_Oblivion_R: I was given "The Legendary Scourge." I don't know what to think about it yet.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GREETING_00003a66_Oblivion_RESP1: I was half expecting you not to show up. Are you ready to go to the manor?
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_NDKnightStopFollow_00002c2a_Knigh: I was honored to be of assistance.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_NDKnightStopFollow_00002c2d_Knigh: I was honored to be of assistance.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_NDKnightStopFollow_00002c32_Knigh: I was honored to be of assistance.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GREETING_0003c148_Oblivion_RESP1: I was honored to fight by your side again.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_contract_000251d2_Oblivion_RESP1: I was hoping Vicente would give you this contract. When you are captured and killed, the assignment will go to someone more competent.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_SQ04Notes_0018a958_Oblivion_RESP2: I was hoping if someone came across my notes in that cave, they'd take the time to read them and trace me back to the Imperial Bridge Inn.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_ResistArrest_00045767_Oblivion_RE: I was hoping you'd say that.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GREETING_00002951_Knights_RESP2: I was imprisoned within Fort Bulwark. When you cleansed the fort of those who sought to steal the Shield, I was able to escape.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_INFOGENERAL_0003827f_Oblivion_RES: I was in Cheydinhal last week, and I'm sure I saw Reynald Jemane. He acted like he didn't know me, though.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_KvatchTopic_0002d930_Oblivion_RES: I was in my basement. Suddenly there was a lot of noise and heat.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_MS14Thief_0001bb32_Oblivion_RESP1: I was in my studio, when a Bosmer wearing dark clothing accosted me. Before I could call for help, he knocked me unconscious.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_DovesiDranTopic_00028d38_Oblivion: I was in the Legion for a great many years, my friend. I saw a lot of horrible things, including the murders of children.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_ImperialCityTopic_00047695_Oblivi: I was in the Thieves Guild. But I'm out now. I retired. Too old for that foolishness. I don't keep up contacts. You get out? You stay out.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_MQ04WeynonAttack_0001ee28_Oblivio: I was in the sheepfold when they attacked. I heard the Prior talking to someone.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_ChorrolNQDQuestionResponses_00023: I was in there just a few days ago. Rasheda's prices are very reasonable.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GREETING_00028268_Oblivion_RESP1: I was just beginning to think I had something in common with the other guests. And then you showed up.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_WeynonPrioryTopic_000aa08c_Oblivi: I was just here reading the Black Horse Courier about the assassination, and looking through 'A Short Life'.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_NDTalkDeadAvita1_00002cf5_Knights: I was just thinking about Sir Avita. Sometimes I forget she's gone, and wait to hear her laugh from across the Priory... then I remember.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_NDTalkDeadGukimir1_00002cf2_Knigh: I was just thinking about my brother...Gukimir...  sometimes I still can't believe he's dead. I miss him. He was my brother, and my best friend.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_WeynonPrioryTopic_000aa08b_Oblivi: I was just writing a letter to my mother. She's quite upset by the assassinations.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_MQWait_0006b1b8_Oblivion_RESP1: I was looking forward to reaching Cloud Ruler Temple. Don't be long.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_KvatchTopic_000039d6_Oblivion_RES: I was lucky. I survived. My friends weren't so lucky.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_MS09PleaseGoOn_00053725_Oblivion_: I was mortified. We snatched up the gold and holed up in the mountains. He said if I breathed a word of the murder to anyone, he'd kill me.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GOODBYE_0008f10b_Oblivion_RESP1: I was never good at saying goodbye.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_MS23RolandSad_0001d4c6_Oblivion_R: I was no equal to Seridur. He knocked me down in one quick movement. As I lost consciousness, I saw him laugh and then run away.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_MS09PleaseGoOn_00053725_Oblivion_: I was off gathering food, but Jorundr was captured. Served him right. When I went back to the site later, the gold was gone! He'd moved it!
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_INFOGENERAL_00043ee8_Oblivion_RES: I was once in Syl's interrogation cell. I counted 35 dead rats in there. Of course, I had to kill a couple to get the count that high.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GREETING_00035d8d_Oblivion_RESP1: I was once the man known as Grantham Blakeley. Look for me in the mouth of the panther. Please... release me.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_MQ15EldamilC1_0003fbde_Oblivion_R: I was one of Mankar Camoran's chief lieutenants. I helped plan the Emperor's assassination. I opened the Great Gate at Kvatch.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_HackdirtTopic_00017789_Oblivion_R: I was only a boy when the soldiers came. We hid, vowed revenge. But the Deep Ones never came back.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_EyjaTopic_000b97e5_Oblivion_RESP2: I was orphaned when I was young, and don't even remember who my parents were. I'm not really sad about it; it was so long ago.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_NelsTheNaughtyTopic_00028cd6_Obli: I was positive he was the killer until you opened your mouth. Now I'm not so sure.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_HELLO_00038f27_Oblivion_RESP1: I was praying for your swift return.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_HELLO_00038f29_Oblivion_RESP1: I was praying for your swift return.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_ChorrolTopic_000239e0_Oblivion_RE: I was quite irritated, and haven't spoken to him since.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_NelsTheNaughtyTopic_000286f4_Obli: I was right about him! He's been doing it, he's the killer! My friend... you and I have to end this. We must kill Nels before he kills us!
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GREETING_00081b6e_Oblivion_RESP1: I was right there. You could have just walked over to me.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_Gang_0003d4a7_Oblivion_RESP3: I was sitting in The Flowing Bowl, when the most fetching Nord woman you've ever seen walked in with an equally attractive Imperial woman following.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_MQ15EldamilC2_0003fbe0_Oblivion_R: I was slain after the battle was over. Three townsfolk hiding in a cellar attacked me when I entered their house, hunting down survivors.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_VampireVicente_000251fd_Oblivion_: I was stricken with vampirism three-hundred years ago, while on an expedition deep into the Ashlands of Vvardenfell.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_ToutiusSextiusTopic_00025b38_Obli: I was sure he was part of the conspiracy. Sure of it. I guess it just goes to show ... well, we'll see what it goes to show, won't we?
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_MS09PleaseGoOn_00053725_Oblivion_: I was terrified of him at this point. Two days later, the Bruma City Guard traced us to our makeshift campsite.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_NelsTheNaughtyTopic_00028715_Obli: I was thinking, maybe Nels found the chest of gold, and one of the others killed him for it! We've got to be careful, my friend, or we could be next!
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_ReynaldJemaneTopic_00023e83_Obliv: I was told that my mother and brother never survived! This is amazing!
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GREETING_0000a0f6_Oblivion_RESP2: I was too afraid. I just couldn't move. I could hear the screaming, but I just couldn't move!
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_MagesStaff_0002f1ef_Oblivion_RESP: I was trying to tell her how I feel.... again... and she wouldn't even stop to talk to me. I just got so angry!
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_INFOGENERAL_0004b7b2_Oblivion_RES: I was walking past Rosentia Gallenus' home the other day, and I heard these strange animal noises or something from inside... very odd.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_BravilTopic_00048904_Oblivion_RES: I was with the Count when he was young, and a shining star on the tournament path. I only wish he'd straighten his son out.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GatherClues_00034821_Oblivion_RES: I was with the Countess all evening. Didn't see a thing.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GREETING_00028bf1_Oblivion_RESP1: I was wondering when you'd get to me. I have to give you some credit. You had me fooled. You made me trust you, which is not an easy thing.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_NevilleTopic_00028702_Oblivion_RE: I was wrong! Don't you see? I thought Neville was trying to catch the killer! But he IS the killer! We need to find a way out of here!
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_RolandJensericTopic_0001d4c1_Obli: I wasn't aware he had a cabin outside of the city. Perhaps that's where he lures his victims. Be careful, he may have others with him.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GREETING_00006924_Oblivion_RESP1: I wasn't far off. In any case, rats and goblins won't give you any trouble.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GREETING_0018bafd_Oblivion_RESP1: I welcome a friendly face in these dark times. How can I be of assistance?
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GREETING_00026b65_Oblivion_RESP1: I welcome you to my humble home, stranger. What brings you to this place?
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GREETING_000251d8_Oblivion_RESP1: I welcome you to our family, and this Sanctuary. May you find yourself at home here, in the loving embrace of our Lady the Night Mother.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_MQ15MankarRant_0008c247_Oblivion_: I welcome you, if you truly are the agent of Fate.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GREETING_0008efc7_Oblivion_RESP1: I went about my business while others fought. Thus I earned my doom.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_AzaniBlackheartTOPIC_0002c615_Obl: I went in there with twenty men. I left with five. Vitellus wasn't one of them. He died covering our retreat.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_INFOGENERAL_0003c1de_Oblivion_RES: I went to the Chapel to get rid of a rash I'd picked up. Tumindil healed me right away.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_TG04AmuseiStory_0000c05a_Oblivion: I went to the Imperial City in hopes of joining the Thieves Guild. Now I am forced to live as a freelance thief.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_INFOGENERAL_0003c1ee_Oblivion_RES: I went to the chapel yesterday, but Valandrus was the only one there. I figured I'd come back another time.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_DEM0CraftingBack_00014e5b_AltarDe: I will allow you to ask for more items later.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_LucienLachanceTopic_000253db_Obli: I will always think of Lucien Lachance as my savior. When he found me, I was living in a gutter, an inch away from death. I owe him everything.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_Attack_0018bd65_Oblivion_RESP1: I will bathe in your blood!
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_SE03AChamber_00018e5d_Oblivion_RE: I will be happy to describe each chamber and explain the event that unfolds as we proceed through Xedilian.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GREETING_000272bd_Oblivion_RESP1: I will call out my militia if necessary, but must we truly stand alone? I don't think we can survive the daedric onslaught.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_Attack_0008d9f8_Oblivion_RESP1: I will cast you into the darkness!
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_SE11CiirtaStartCombat_0008264f_Ob: I will cast you into the darkness!
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_NevilleTopic_00028793_Oblivion_RE: I will confide something in you, my friend. I despise Neville and all his Imperial Legion ilk! They are useless, uncaring tools of corruption!
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_SeersStone_00033793_Oblivion_RESP: I will continue to tend to Dagail. Can you speak with the other mages, and find out if any of them have seen the stone?
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_MQ11BrumaAllies_00026ea3_Oblivion: I will do as you ask. Let no one say Leyawiin did not do its part to uphold the Empire.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_MG17TravenDestroy_000366ec_Oblivi: I will explain once you have returned with it. Until then, discussion is useless.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_Attack_0004b773_Oblivion_RESP1: I will feed the mistress your blood!
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_SE10WhatWellspring_00017d17_Obliv: I will follow your lead. The Wellspring is at the heart of Brellach; follow the waters to reach it. I am yours to command, Your Grace.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_SE10WhatWellspring_00017471_Obliv: I will follow your lead. The Wellspring is at the heart of Pinnacle Rock; follow the waters to reach it. I am yours to command, Your Grace.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_DEAkTimeWound_00014e28_AltarDelux: I will give you the Order's blessing. This should allow you to breach the barrier but the rest is up to you.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_MG18Choice2A_00070485_Oblivion_RE: I will make you another in a long tradition of Worm Thralls, and take my time in studying you. Your very soul will be forfeit to me.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_TG08accept_000146ff_Oblivion_RESP: I will mark the location on your map. Look for it in the far northeast of Cyrodiil, beyond Cheydinhal.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_MQ13MeetMartin_0002777a_Oblivion_: I will meet Martin at the Chapel. When all is ready, I will order my men to stop closing the Gates and prepare for battle.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GREETING_0001648c_Oblivion_RESP4: I will mourn for him during my own, private time. For now, I cannot help but rejoice. You have brought safety to the guild, and I thank you.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_MS27HerminiaA1_000a55ff_Oblivion_: I will never allow the Crown to fall into Umbacano's hands. He is far more dangerous than you realize.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_MS27HerminiaA2_000a5600_Oblivion_: I will never allow the Crown to fall into Umbacano's hands. He is far more dangerous than you realize.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GREETING_00028735_Oblivion_RESP1: I will never forget your brave rescue of my daughter.  What can I do for you today?
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GOODBYE_0001e7cb_Oblivion_RESP1: I will not accept your accusations without evidence.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_MS14Troll_0001bb35_Oblivion_RESP2: I will not be able to help you; I am not a warrior. But take these bottles of turpentine, they might help. Do be careful.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GREETING_00026f90_Oblivion_RESP1: I will not fight you, friend. I have taken a vow. My gods will protect me.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_MQ11BrumaAllies_00058b35_Oblivion: I will not forget your service to Cheydinhal. Closing the Oblivion Gate outside the city was a daring feat.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_MQ11BrumaAllies_00026ea0_Oblivion: I will not forget your service to me and to Cheydinhal. Rescuing my son from the Oblivion Gate was a daring feat.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GREETING_000131a8_Oblivion_RESP2: I will now claim the honor of victory for myself here on the Altar of Despair.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_MQ11BrumaAllies_000270fb_Oblivion: I will now gladly send soldiers to aid in the defense of Bruma. Consider it done.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_SE08Orders_0001ec1f_Oblivion_RESP: I will obey your orders, but know that I do not trust the tactics of any male. Men are meant to fight, not to lead.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_HouseBuySkingrad_0004f217_Oblivio: I will order the deed drawn up. Take this key. The house is just inside the gate, by the bridge to the chapel.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_Attack_00074a13_Oblivion_RESP1: I will present your soul to my father as a mighty gift!
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_MS14ReturnHome_0001c1cc_Oblivion_: I will rest, but I must take care of our guest first.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_MS11JournalGive_00038587_Oblivion: I will rouse the guard, and begin a search for him in the city. Meet me at Olav's Tap and Tack in one hour.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GREETING_0000a09f_Oblivion_RESP2: I will see you next week, most honorable Listener.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_MQ11BrumaAllies_00026ea9_Oblivion: I will send what aid I can. Bruma must not share the fate of our city!
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GOODBYE_00038bbf_Oblivion_RESP1: I will send word to the Countess at once of the danger to Bruma. You should speak to Martin about his progress with the Xarxes.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GREETING_0001443e_Oblivion_RESP1: I will serve you well, Lord.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_SE11RakheranGreetingEnd_00019cd3_: I will show you the void!
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_TG01BribeBeggar_00007e02_Oblivion: I will sing of your charity. She runs the Fighting Chance armory on the far east side of the Market District.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_HELLO_0004735c_Oblivion_RESP1: I will soon earn the Master's favor and be granted entry into the Forbidden Grotto.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_SE13JyggalagSpeech_00063574_Obliv: I will take my leave, and you will remain here, mortal. Mortal...? King? God? It seems uncertain.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_ThreeSigns_00026af9_Oblivion_RESP: I will tell you nothing of the three signs. You are an unbeliever and a fool.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_RonaHassildorTopic_0003ed38_Obliv: I will tell you what I can. What would you know of her?
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_DAPeryiteSpeech_0008dd60_Oblivion: I will transport you to the plane of Oblivion in which they are trapped. Find their souls. When all are collected, I will return you here.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_DarkVampChoice1_000008de_Oblivion: I will wrap you in vampirism's dark embrace. You'll never even know I was there. But when you awaken, we will be of the same blood.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_DarkVampChoice1_0004ce45_Oblivion: I will wrap you in vampirism's dark embrace. You'll never even know I was there. But when you awaken, we will be of the same blood.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_SE05Eavesdrop_0008117b_Oblivion_R: I will, I will! I want to see Syl dead just as much as you do. She cannot be allowed to survive, after what she's done. It's despicable.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GREETING_0018afd8_Oblivion_RESP1: I wish I could be more hospitable, but I'm a bit distracted. It seems I'm having a bear problem and I just don't know what to do.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_HELLO_000790aa_Oblivion_RESP1: I wish I could find a spot to sleep where the walls won't collapse on me. Can't have that.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GREETING_0003c149_Oblivion_RESP1: I wish I could have been at the battle. It sounds like you taught Mehrunes Dagon's boys a lesson they won't soon forget.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_HELLO_000adc5a_Oblivion_RESP1: I wish I could have helped you deal with the rest of those Mythic Dawn bastards. But it seems you did all right on your own.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_NDKellenTopic_00002b05_Knights_RE: I wish I could help him, truly I do, but I cannot muster the strength to damn myself on his behalf!
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_MS08AleronHunt_0001fdbc_Oblivion_: I wish I could help more, but I can't fight. I've never held a weapon before in my life. Please... get us out of here!
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_MQ11BrumaAllies_00026e9b_Oblivion: I wish I could help. I understand the need to help defend the heir to the throne. It is a duty we all share.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_BOASTLIKE_0018b2b9_Oblivion_RESP1: I wish I could say that.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GarridansTears_00022e54_Oblivion_: I wish I could tell you more about them, but that's all I remember from speaking to my colleagues here at the University.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_INFOGENERAL_000605f3_Oblivion_RES: I wish I could vanish like Sheogorath, right about now. Please don't hurt me.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GOODBYE_00081535_Oblivion_RESP1: I wish I had a stick like that.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GREETING_0003be7d_Oblivion_RESP3: I wish I had more teeth -- great big fangs on my arms and legs to eat them before they eat us.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_MQ05VolumeFour_00022b50_Oblivion_: I wish I had one, but I've never even seen a copy.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_INFOGENERAL_00061388_Oblivion_RES: I wish I had witnessed the avatar of divine Akatosh myself. Imagine! Upon the very altar of the Temple of the One!
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_FGD08Choice6_000a345d_Oblivion_RE: I wish I knew. They're all dead. All of them. Even my poor, sweet Biene. You... you're the one who helped her, aren't you?
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_MagesGuildTopic_0002d065_Oblivion: I wish I were qualified to have access to the Arcane University. Enchanting items whenever I want... ah, well. Maybe someday.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_INFOGENERAL_0005f22b_Oblivion_RES: I wish I'd been able to help construct the new Gatekeeper.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_MG12TravenWhat_000835fb_Oblivion_: I wish for you to find Mucianus, and ensure his safe return to the Arcane University. I do not want anything to go wrong.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_SE35Brithaur_0007866e_Oblivion_RE: I wish he'd simply disappear from the streets of New Sheoth forever! Oh look, just talking about it has given me another gray hair!
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_WeatherleahTopic_00028ac2_Oblivio: I wish my father had given me a better description of its location, but for some reason all he told me was "South of Chorrol, north of Fort Carmala."
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GOODBYE_00031620_Oblivion_RESP1: I wish something would happen already. There is so much else I could be doing.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GREETING_00026ade_Oblivion_RESP1: I wish there were children here. Scrumptious, darling children. I haven't eaten in so long. Ravel will tell me what to do. You, too.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_SEWildernessRumorResponses_000607: I wish these adventurers would stay out.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_INFOGENERAL_0005efa7_Oblivion_RES: I wish those Knights of Order would come here and wipe everyone out. I'd finally get some piece and quiet!
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_MS05DreamworldTopic_0003cd5f_Obli: I wish to never speak of the Dreamworld again. Henantier's free of its grip, and I can't bear a reminder he was ever a prisoner in that dark place.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GREETING_00002976_Knights_RESP1: I wish to see you succeed where I failed. I was on the path to the Boots of the Crusader, but died before I reached them.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_MS40Vamp2_0003e954_Oblivion_RESP1: I wish to tell you a story, so that you might understand why I would trust you with my secrets. Would you hear it?
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_HELLO_0002527b_Oblivion_RESP1: I wish to welcome you to this Sanctuary, my newest Brother.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_HELLO_0002527c_Oblivion_RESP1: I wish to welcome you to this Sanctuary, my newest Sister.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_INFOGENERAL_00043508_Oblivion_RES: I wish we had a Resonator of something-or-other. We're certainly not safe as it is.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GREETING_0003d7f9_Oblivion_RESP1: I wish we had more real soldiers.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GOODBYE_0002441c_Oblivion_RESP1: I wish you luck. I fear you'll need it.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_ND09ProphetQuestionsEnd_00002c18_: I wish you well on your quest, Crusader. We are depending on you.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_KvatchTopic_000039d6_Oblivion_RES: I woke to screaming and fire. I ran.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_MQ08ArtifactTopic_00026d6d_Oblivi: I won't ask what you went through to obtain this, my friend. I know all too well the depravity of the princes of Oblivion.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_MQ05GwinasA4_00022b59_Oblivion_RE: I won't be bullied! I'm not some pathetic book-worm you can just push around! I have friends, you know!
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_MS18Choice2B_00027532_Oblivion_RE: I won't beg you, but I ask that you please reconsider. My boys need another steady hand at their side, else they may not survive.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_CropsfordTopic_00033ee5_Oblivion_: I won't forget your service to our new settlement. Who knows? One day Cropsford may be a thriving town, and all because of you.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GOODBYE_0001a11d_Oblivion_RESP1: I won't go back! You can't make me go back!
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_SE01BelmyneRant_0005589d_Oblivion: I won't go back. I won't go back! You can't make me go back! I'll kill you all! You're all going to die!
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_AnvilTopic_00061416_Oblivion_RESP: I won't risk my Guard attacking that infernal Oblivion Gate. We'll hold the walls and hope for the best.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_BravilTopic_0018d2a6_Oblivion_RES: I won't risk my Guard attacking that infernal Oblivion Gate. We'll hold the walls and hope for the best.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_MS13SignetYes_000335ad_Oblivion_R: I won't take no for an answer. I want you to keep it.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_MageTalk2_0006a863_Oblivion_RESP1: I won't take up much of your time. But I felt you should know, I've had a breakthrough!
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GREETING_000356a1_Oblivion_RESP1: I won't talk to you! Never! Do your worst.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GREETING_000a9444_Oblivion_RESP1: I won, you lost. There's nothing else to talk about right now.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_UmbacanoTopic_0002b0a0_Oblivion_R: I wonder how he could have miscalculated so badly. Those old Elves didn't seem as glad to see him as he expected, eh?
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_HELLO_00088b36_Oblivion_RESP1: I wonder how long we've been here? There's no way to keep track of time.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_INFOGENERAL_000607fe_Oblivion_RES: I wonder how many corpses line the palace grounds. Perhaps I should count them.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_MQ08ArtifactO_00038fcd_Oblivion_R: I wonder if Mephala herself knows how many lives this foul blade has taken over the years? I will be glad to give the world a respite from it.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_HELLO_000029c9_Knights_RESP1: I wonder if Umaril will dare face us?
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_INFOGENERAL_00043ec4_Oblivion_RES: I wonder if people dream when they take Felldew. Hmmm.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_Idle_0018b5c4_Oblivion_RESP1: I wonder if she heard me say that?
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_INFOGENERAL_000441dc_Oblivion_RES: I wonder if the Great Torch being lit will stop the unrest. I was getting excited about the prospect of more bloodshed. Oh, well.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_INFOGENERAL_000434df_Oblivion_RES: I wonder if the Resonator of Judgment hurts those inside?
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_INFOGENERAL_000441c8_Oblivion_RES: I wonder if the new Duke of Dementia is a patron of the arts. Perhaps he will be more appreciative of my act than Lady Syl.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_SE43PayOff_00072dc3_Oblivion_RESP: I wonder if there are nice dogs in Bliss. I think I'll go see.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_SE02GatesOfMadness_0007eae7_Obliv: I wonder if you are a fast bleeder, or a slow bleeder.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_NelsTheNaughtyTopic_00028230_Obli: I wonder what makes him so "Naughty"? He seems nice enough to me.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GREETING_0000292a_Knights_RESP1: I wonder what new devilry Umaril has prepared for us?
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GREETING_00081d77_Oblivion_RESP1: I wonder. Do gods have bones? What wonderful things those must be!
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_INFOGENERAL_000434c1_Oblivion_RES: I wonder...  now that the Gatekeeper is dead, perhaps my fame will finally spread far beyond the Shivering Isles!
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GREETING_00019acc_Oblivion_RESP1: I wondered how long it would take before you needed my help. And here I am, at your service.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GREETING_00082dc4_Oblivion_RESP1: I wondered if you'd come back. I admit, I've had my doubts about your story.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GREETING_000476e7_Oblivion_RESP1: I work as a guard at Umbacano Manor. My name is Usheeja.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_BrumaTopic_0003c98f_Oblivion_RESP: I work hard. Folks like Skjorta and Olfand give us Nords a bad name, drinking and carrying on until all hours.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_CheydinhalTopic_0004e8b9_Oblivion: I worked the Arena in the Imperial City for a while. Got up to Gladiator, then took a powder. A guy could get hurt, you know.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_PrimoAntoniusTopic_00028189_Obliv: I worry about the boy. What if the killer is after money? Primo is quite wealthy. He could be the next victim!
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_AnvilTopic_0003e0b8_Oblivion_RESP: I worry sometimes I'll go soft here, training mostly, and living easy. So now and then I go out along the coast on my own, just to stay in shape.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GREETING_00026aaa_Oblivion_RESP1: I would ask that you not bother me, especially in this place.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_BravilNQDQuestionResponses_000465: I would assume she's travelled extensively. Must have been some time ago, though, since she never seems to leave the guild hall now.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_SE05AnyaWhat_00080d7a_Oblivion_RE: I would be far too afraid to turn on Syl. But I couldn't turn them in, either, because they might come after me. Please, you must do something!
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_MS21StatueShow_00085991_Oblivion_: I would be happy to take this statue off your hands right now. I assume that's why you came to see me?
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_INFOGENERAL_000441de_Oblivion_RES: I would bet my life that the Great Torch isn't nearly as hot as I can get any man.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GREETING_00040cb5_Oblivion_RESP3: I would congratulate you, but perhaps that should wait until after you've prevented Order from storming the Palace.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_Invest_000aa28c_Oblivion_RESP1: I would gladly let you invest in my shop! The extra coin will allow me to purchase more goods from adventurers such as yourself.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_CheydinhalNQDResponses_0003e98e_O: I would hate to be on his bad side. He's really good with his fists.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_Gang_0003d4a0_Oblivion_RESP2: I would have done it myself, but well, ok... I fell for their trick. Thought I'd get lucky, turns out that they don't do anything. They just rob you.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_NDTalkGarlas2_00002c42_Knights_RE: I would have liked to see the Lord Crusader in his full fury. It must have been magnificent.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_DovesiDranTopic_00028d35_Oblivion: I would have sworn with my life that Nels was the killer, but now he's dead as well! Dovesi is now my top suspect.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_FingersoftheMountain_000236e5_Obl: I would hope that any responsible citizen, if given the chance, would acquire the book and deliver it here, so that it may be properly looked after.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_BloodwormHelmTopic_0000c08c_Obliv: I would like the Helm returned, so that it may be kept safe here in the University. I fear Irlav has made himself a target for the Necromancers.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_MQ11BrumaAllies_00026e9f_Oblivion: I would like to send help to Bruma, but I cannot risk weakening Anvil's defenses with that Oblivion Gate open outside the city.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_MQ11BrumaAllies_00026e95_Oblivion: I would like to send help, but unfortunately my guard is short-handed with the death of Captain Lerus. I need all my soldiers at home right now.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_duties_0000344b_Oblivion_RESP4: I would like you to speak with Modryn Oreyn. He will assign you any duties that are currently pending. Good luck to you.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_INFOGENERAL_000434c9_Oblivion_RES: I would love to get a piece of the old Gatekeeper for my Museum. His head maybe, or an arm... he certainly was a unique specimen.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_Barter_000091c6_Oblivion_RESP1: I would love to put you in some of my fine garments.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_NDTalkRelics3_00002c67_Knights_RE: I would never doubt her. The gods have clearly chosen her for a high purpose.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_NDTalkRelics3_00002c66_Knights_RE: I would never doubt him. The gods have clearly chosen him for a high purpose.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_SE32WelkyndStones_00012d1d_Oblivi: I would never have allowed myself to do that. However, now that they are befouled, I can use them. You may grovel in gratitude at my feet later.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GREETING_00041099_Oblivion_RESP1: I would prefer that you didn't disturb me at home. My research is exhausting and I don't like to be bothered here.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GREETING_00026fc2_Oblivion_RESP1: I would prefer you leave, friend. Please.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_MS23HowFind_0001d24d_Oblivion_RES: I would start by searching his home. He hasn't been there for days, so it should be safe. Return to us here if you have questions. We meet at night.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_INFOGENERAL_0007816a_Oblivion_RES: I wouldn't be caught dead at Sickly Bernice's... though I imagine her customers might.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GREETING_0004300a_Oblivion_RESP1: I wouldn't be caught dead with a necrophiliac.  Ahaha!
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_BrumaNQDQuestionResponses_0004662: I wouldn't call him a friend. Still, if I wanted to learn more about illusions, he's the one I'd ask.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_BrumaNQDResponses_0004660e_Oblivi: I wouldn't cross him. I've heard he's very skilled.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GREETING_0000291e_Knights_RESP1: I wouldn't go in there unless you have a strong stomach.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_MagesGuildTopic_00062bc0_Oblivion: I wouldn't have any friends if it weren't for the guild. I'm very grateful. If you want to join, you should talk to Adrienne.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_SE32Arrows_00013345_Oblivion_RESP: I wouldn't have any, that's what. So these arrows are staying right here in case someone needs them.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GREETING_0009f910_Oblivion_RESP1: I wouldn't keep him waiting if I were you.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_BarterBuyItem_000091cb_Oblivion_R: I wouldn't make that deal with just anybody.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_SkingradNQDResponses_0003c1ba_Obl: I wouldn't mind learning a bit about Mysticism. Seems like a useful skill.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_AnvilNQDResponses_0003c1e0_Oblivi: I wouldn't mind learning something, but I don't want to join the Fighters Guild to do it.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_SkingradNQDResponses_0003c18f_Obl: I wouldn't mind making a few bets, but I'm not sure about Graklak. He seems a bit slick to me.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_INFOGENERAL_00028bb7_Oblivion_RES: I wouldn't miss it.  This time the sacrifice may finally be acceptable to the Brethren.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_MS46Response_000343bc_Oblivion_RE: I wouldn't recommend it, sir. You don't want to put yourselves in the middle of a goblin war.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_MS09ImIn_00053724_Oblivion_RESP3: I wouldn't say we're thieves. I mean, we've stolen things... sure. But we've never stolen that much at one time. Just enough to keep us going.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_INFOGENERAL_0003c214_Oblivion_RES: I wouldn't want an Orc butler, but apparently the Count doesn't mind. Shum gro-Yarug has been there for years.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_AnvilNQDResponses_0003c1e9_Oblivi: I wouldn't want to mix it up with him.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_Idle_0018b5a2_Oblivion_RESP1: I wouldn't. Not even with yours.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GREETING_00030574_Oblivion_RESP1: I'd advise you to keep your distance from that accursed portal.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_SQ04Notes_0018a957_Oblivion_RESP2: I'd almost feared that you'd never return. I'm glad to see I was incorrect.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_SQ10Husband_0006141c_Oblivion_RES: I'd already convinced myself I'd never see Rockshatter again, but I was wrong.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_SE30ForgeWeapon_0001f3c5_Oblivion: I'd be happy to craft you Amber weapons, but you need to bring me Amber. Consult the information I have posted in the store for details.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_SE30ForgeArmor_0005f926_Oblivion_: I'd be happy to forge Amber armor for you, but you don't have enough Amber. Consult the information I have posted.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_INFOGENERAL_0005f22a_Oblivion_RES: I'd be very interested in taking a look at this new Gatekeeper. An entirely new form of life!
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_MageTalk2_0006a865_Oblivion_RESP1: I'd been thinking about our conversation yesterday, and decided to consult some of the ancient texts. You were right! About everything!
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GOODBYE_0008ef36_Oblivion_RESP1: I'd better get back to practicing.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GOODBYE_0008ef68_Oblivion_RESP1: I'd better get back to practicing.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_MS49ChoiceExplain_00031d33_Oblivi: I'd better go with you. We'll have to go through the Chapel Undercroft, and then through what's left of the city.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_INFOGENERAL_00032eb3_Oblivion_RES: I'd buy my armor at "The Best Defense" if I could afford it. You know... in the Market District... the Imperial City?
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_INFOGENERAL_00078163_Oblivion_RES: I'd buy my weapons at Cutter's. She has... a way with blades.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_SE07ASyl_00013a68_Oblivion_RESP2: I'd check with Anya Herrick, her Courtier, and Kithlan, her Steward. Maybe they can help you.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_ND06CurseTopic_00002b21_Knights_R: I'd come here, to the place it all happened, in the hopes that something could be done. I fear I haven't much time left, otherwise.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_MageTalk5_0006a872_Oblivion_RESP1: I'd consider it a personal favor if you'd give this matter top priority. When you learn more, let me know. Keep up the excellent work, magister.

ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_MQWait_00037836_Oblivion_RESP1: I'll stay here until you're ready to continue to the Elder Council Chambers. Don't be long.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_NDWait_00002b56_Knights_RESP1: I'll stay on guard until you return.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_Attack_0004848a_Oblivion_RESP1: I'll take Llathasa's statue off of your cold, dead body!
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GREETING_00038a85_Oblivion_RESP1: I'll take good care of your horses when you're in Skingrad. I'm Ugak gra-Mogakh, ostler of Grateful Pass Stables.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_MS26AudensThreat_00093cd5_Oblivio: I'll take my chances in prison rather than fight you. Someday I'll get out and the weasel that turned me in will pay!
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GOODBYE_0006a84e_Oblivion_RESP1: I'll take my leave of you then, fellow magister.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_Dark08Choice4B_00085861_Oblivion_: I'll take refuge in my room until Nels has been dealt with. Thank you my friend! And good luck!
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_BRIBE_0018b2c0_Oblivion_RESP1: I'll take that, and thank you very much.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_PrimoAntoniusTopic_00028f49_Obliv: I'll talk to Primo, give him a bit of encouragement. If he and I are vigilant, we may prevent the killer from claiming another victim.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GOODBYE_0007322c_Oblivion_RESP1: I'll talk to you some more yesterday.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_Prank_000302d5_Oblivion_RESP2: I'll teach you a spell to unlock things. What you need to do is get into Jeanne's desk, and bring me her Manual of Spellcraft, okay?
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_Attack_0004b775_Oblivion_RESP1: I'll teach you to steal from the Arcane University!
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_Attack_0004848b_Oblivion_RESP1: I'll teach you to steal from the Countess of Leyawiin!
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_SQ03Continue_00189d08_Oblivion_RE: I'll tell you how you can help.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_SE35Hate_0007866f_Oblivion_RESP4: I'll tell you what I tell anyone else who asks. Get rid of him for me and I'll make it worth your while. Do hurry... time's wasting!
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_SQ08Wine_0018d924_Oblivion_RESP4: I'll tell you what else I'll do since you seem so resourceful. If you find any more bottles of the wine, I'll gladly pay you well for them.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_Recommendation_0002e5e7_Oblivion_: I'll tell you what. Find me when Falcar's not around, and then we'll talk. After we've spoken, you can have the key. Believe me, this is important.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_AyleidReference_0003353a_Oblivion: I'll tell you what. I'll take the book, and then if you can read me the inscriptions, I'll see if I can find translations for them.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_SQ06Bears_0018afe0_Oblivion_RESP4: I'll tell you what. Kill six of the things, bring me their fangs as proof, and I'll reward you well. Please, you're my only hope.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GREETING_0003d491_Oblivion_RESP4: I'll tell you what. We have a cozy farmhouse not far from here where we could... well... get to know each other much, much better.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_MagesStaff_0002c0cb_Oblivion_RESP: I'll tell you what. You give me at least a portion of what I paid for it, say two hundred gold, and I'll give you the staff.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_MS09MetoDO_0005377a_Oblivion_RESP: I'll tell you. I want Arnora dead. That's right, I said dead. She took my life away, now I want hers taken as well.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GREETING_0008e4bf_Oblivion_RESP1: I'll try to speak in fewer syllables.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_SeleneTopic_00015715_Oblivion_RES: I'll turn over her body and the bodies of her compatriots when we arrive at the Imperial City. Don't let it trouble you, friend.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_Dark16Choice2A_000262d8_Oblivion_: I'll wait for you at Applewatch, the farm where you killed the old Draconis woman. It should be empty, and safe. Now go! And may Sithis help us all!
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_Dark16Choice2B_000262d9_Oblivion_: I'll wait for you at Applewatch, the farm where you killed the old Draconis woman. It should be empty, and safe. Now go! And may Sithis help us all!
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_Dark16Choice2C_000262da_Oblivion_: I'll wait for you at Applewatch, the farm where you killed the old Draconis woman. It should be empty, and safe. Now go! And may Sithis help us all!
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_NDWait_00002b58_Knights_RESP1: I'll wait for you to return.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_NDWait_00002b5b_Knights_RESP1: I'll wait for you to return.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_NDWait_00002b5e_Knights_RESP1: I'll wait for you to return.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_NDWait_00002b60_Knights_RESP1: I'll wait for you to return.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_MG17ChoiceNM_00015456_Oblivion_RE: I'll wait here then. Let me know when you've made up your mind.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GREETING_0000c1de_Oblivion_RESP1: I'll wait here until the tavern deck is clear.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_MS02VelwynEscChoice2_0000a0db_Obl: I'll wait here until you're ready.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GREETING_0000c1c9_Oblivion_RESP1: I'll wait on the tavern deck until you clear the top deck. That's where the ship's wheel is located.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_RaynilDralasTopic_00038438_Oblivi: I'll warn you about one thing. I understand you wanting to help Erline by checking up on Raynil.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GREETING_0004762c_Oblivion_RESP1: I'm Adamus Phillida, prison administrator and commander of the Imperial Legion forces here in the Imperial City. Have we met? You look familiar.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GREETING_000476d2_Oblivion_RESP1: I'm Agarmir. And I'm a very busy man. Are you just fishing around, or do you have business with me?
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GREETING_0003c9ac_Oblivion_RESP1: I'm Alga. I'm a bard and a Speechcraft trainer.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GREETING_0004770c_Oblivion_RESP1: I'm Amantius Allectus, the writer. I'm working on a new edition of 'Lives of the Saints'.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GREETING_0003e91c_Oblivion_RESP1: I'm Amiable Fanriene. Sorry, can't talk. Got to move on.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GREETING_00068bc0_Oblivion_RESP1: I'm Anya Herrick. I serve Lady Syl, and she allows me to remain protected within the House of Dementia. I'm so grateful to her.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GREETING_000488d4_Oblivion_RESP1: I'm Ardaline. I'm the guild's Advanced Trainer in Alchemy here in Bravil.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GREETING_0003e0a1_Oblivion_RESP1: I'm Arvena Thelas. They call me 'the rat lady', on account of all my pet rats.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GREETING_000479fa_Oblivion_RESP1: I'm Atahba. But if you want a horse, you got to talk to Cat-Face.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GREETING_000475b1_Oblivion_RESP1: I'm Avrus Adas. I'm the priest of Zenithar at the Leyawiin Chapel.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GREETING_0003e089_Oblivion_RESP1: I'm Azzan, head of the Anvil Fighters Guild chapter, and Advanced Blunt Weapons trainer.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GREETING_0003e087_Oblivion_RESP1: I'm Baeralorn, Anvil's castle mage. Perhaps you've heard of my work on magical resistances.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GREETING_0001f368_Oblivion_RESP1: I'm Beelei. You... you came from out there? And you survived? Then how do I know you're not one of THEM?
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GREETING_000479e2_Oblivion_RESP1: I'm Bejeen. I'm a hunter, and Weebam-Na's partner. I hope he didn't bother you about the rat thing. He's gone totally rat-cuckoo, I'm afraid.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GREETING_000476ac_Oblivion_RESP1: I'm Beran. Kastus, Vontan, and me, we take care of gardens and trees and grass. Hard work, but it pays.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GREETING_00038add_Oblivion_RESP1: I'm Bernadette Peneles. I work for Tamika. I grow grapes. For her wines.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GREETING_00023cc0_Oblivion_RESP1: I'm Bittneld the Curse-Bringer, captain of the Chorrol Guard. What can I do for you?
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GREETING_000488c0_Oblivion_RESP1: I'm Bogrum Gro-Galash, your host at the Lonely Suitor Lodge. It may not look like much outside, but that's just the weathered Bravil look.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GREETING_0007be9a_Oblivion_RESP1: I'm Brielus Gawey. And no, we don't sell horses. But we do eat well. The stables are owned by an Orc. And you know... Orcs and horses.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GREETING_000488e9_Oblivion_RESP1: I'm Bronsila Kvinchal. And I'm so sick of that Vlanarus, I could scream.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GREETING_0001dc8a_Oblivion_RESP1: I'm Brother Jauffre. What do you want?
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GREETING_000475af_Oblivion_RESP2: I'm Bugak gro-Bol, and I say you better buy a goddam book. And right away, dammit!
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GREETING_0004e8b4_Oblivion_RESP1: I'm Burz gro-Khash, and I'm in charge of this St. Jiub's Fair. All I need is clowns, monkeys, and jugglers. No. Wait... just need jugglers....
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GREETING_000477ea_Oblivion_RESP1: I'm Caelia Draconis, Captain of the Leyawiin Guard. I hope we will not meet in my official capacity... ha-ha.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GREETING_0003c99a_Oblivion_RESP1: I'm Captain Burd, commander of the Bruma Guard.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GREETING_0004763c_Oblivion_RESP1: I'm Caranya, master wizard, and far too important to be talking to you. So go about your business, please?
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GREETING_0004768e_Oblivion_RESP1: I'm Carmana Sintav. Cyronin is my husband. Excuse him, please. He's a little irritable.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GREETING_00024f80_Oblivion_RESP1: I'm Carmen Litte. Perhaps you know my husband? Alberic Litte, the Mages Guild sorcerer? What can I do for you?
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GREETING_0004770e_Oblivion_RESP1: I'm Caula Allectus. My job is making sure my husband Amantius doesn't go out with his clothes on backwards.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GREETING_00023c5c_Oblivion_RESP1: I'm Chanel, Chorrol Castle Mage. You'll tell me what you're here for. Right?
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GREETING_000479e4_Oblivion_RESP1: I'm Cingor. I'm the Captain of the Leyawiin Neighborhood Watch.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GREETING_0003e0a8_Oblivion_RESP1: I'm Clesa. My husband and I run the Horse Whisperer, the finest stables in Anvil County.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GREETING_00024b8a_Oblivion_RESP1: I'm Contumeliorus Florius. I'm in charge of enchanted item recharge in the Mages Guild here in Chorrol. Get it? "In charge!"
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GREETING_0007504b_Oblivion_RESP1: I'm Cylben Dolovas, assistant and bodyguard to Seridur. Let's leave it at that.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GREETING_000947bd_Oblivion_RESP1: I'm Cylben Dolovas, assistant and bodyguard to Seridur. Let's leave it at that.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GREETING_0003e086_Oblivion_RESP1: I'm Dairihill, steward of Castle Anvil. We do things differently in Anvil. And the difference shows in the comfort and trust of its people.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GREETING_000479af_Oblivion_RESP1: I'm Dar Jee. I'm a Khajiit in disguise. Want to see me lick my butt?
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GREETING_00038ae1_Oblivion_RESP1: I'm Davide, of Surilie Brothers Vineyard. Gaston is my brother. From our vineyards come the finest wines in Tamriel.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GREETING_0004e8bd_Oblivion_RESP1: I'm Deetsan. Magician. Mages Guild, that is.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GREETING_00038ab4_Oblivion_RESP1: I'm Dion, captain of the Skingrad Guard.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GREETING_0004e8c1_Oblivion_RESP1: I'm Eilonwy. I'm only a conjurer, but Orintur is a full Magician. Isn't he wonderful?
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GREETING_000479dc_Oblivion_RESP1: I'm Eitar. Say. Did you hear what that Argonian said? What's-his-name? You know who I'm talking about...
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GREETING_000479dd_Oblivion_RESP1: I'm Eitar. Say. Did you hear what that Khajiit said? What's-his-name? You know who I'm talking about...
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GREETING_000476a8_Oblivion_RESP1: I'm Elisa Pierrane. Father bought us this lovely house in the City.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GREETING_00038a9a_Oblivion_RESP1: I'm Else God-Hater. Yes. I hate the gods. All gods. They can all bite my garters. And if you don't like it, YOU can bite my garters, too.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GREETING_000476e3_Oblivion_RESP1: I'm Erissare Arenim. Soris is my husband.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GREETING_0003e0dd_Oblivion_RESP1: I'm Ernest. This is the Horse Whisperer, Anvil's only stable. Park your nag here, or leave him for the wolves. Your choice.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GREETING_0004e8a8_Oblivion_RESP1: I'm Errandil, Living Saint of Arkay, and the Chapel's chief crusader against the wicked practice of necromancy.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GREETING_000488cc_Oblivion_RESP1: I'm Fathis Aren, Count Bravil's staff wizard. I can teach you Conjuration... anything to relieve the tedium of castle patronage.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GREETING_0008e4c4_Oblivion_RESP1: I'm Felas Sarandas. Don't breathe on me.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GREETING_0003e092_Oblivion_RESP1: I'm Felen Relas of the Mages Guild. I handle Alchemy training for the Anvil chapter.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GREETING_0003c99e_Oblivion_RESP1: I'm Gan Luseph, Castle Mage and Healer.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GREETING_00038ae4_Oblivion_RESP1: I'm Gaston Surilie. Perhaps you've met my brother, Davide? Together, we are the Surilie Brothers Winery.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GREETING_00047662_Oblivion_RESP1: I'm Gelephor, the watchman. I keep an eye on things.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GREETING_00047678_Oblivion_RESP1: I'm Gin-Wulm. I just work here. You want to buy, talk to Varnado or Maro Rufus.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GREETING_00024ed8_Oblivion_RESP1: I'm Glistel. What do you need?
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GREETING_00038ab0_Oblivion_RESP1: I'm Hal-Liurz, Count Skingrad's steward. The Count does not accept unsolicited visitors, I'm afraid. I apologize for the inconvenience.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GREETING_0003c9aa_Oblivion_RESP1: I'm Honmund. I'm a prospector. Alga's my woman, Nord-style. None of that Chapel wedding nonsense.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GREETING_0004768a_Oblivion_RESP1: I'm Irene Metrick. If you needed to know more, you'd already know.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GREETING_0003e097_Oblivion_RESP1: I'm Isolde, mate... not that it's any of your business.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GREETING_00042ff9_Oblivion_RESP1: I'm J'zidzo. What has four legs, a tail, and is red in Cyrodiil?
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GREETING_000488e0_Oblivion_RESP1: I'm J'zin-Dar. I tell you, so you can tell everyone who kicked the crap out of you. J'zin-Dar. Get it right.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GREETING_0003c9ae_Oblivion_RESP1: I'm Jantus Brolus. I'm the Illusion Trainer.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GREETING_0008e4c0_Oblivion_RESP1: I'm Jayred Ice-Veins. Do you ever wonder why things look better without their skin on?
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GREETING_0003c9b2_Oblivion_RESP1: I'm Jearl. I spend most of my time down south, but I keep a house in Bruma for the mountain air.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GREETING_000488ed_Oblivion_RESP1: I'm Kastav Kvinchal. And, if you listen to that witch of a sister of mine, Bronsila, I'm also a dog and a pig.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GREETING_0003e095_Oblivion_RESP1: I'm Krognak gro-Brok, landsman, and I don't much care who you are.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GREETING_0003c984_Oblivion_RESP1: I'm Logvaar. Hafid pays me to stand around and keep things quiet.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GREETING_00024d4f_Oblivion_RESP1: I'm Lum gro-Baroth. The cheerful one. My brother, Kurz? He's not so cheerful.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GREETING_0003cf88_Oblivion_RESP1: I'm Maenlorn. I'm the twin in brown, remember?
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GREETING_0004e8bf_Oblivion_RESP1: I'm Magician Orintur of the Mages Guild. I divide my time between the Cheydinhal Guild and my own private studies at Willow Bank.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_MaglirTOPIC_0002a573_Oblivion_RES: I'm Maglir. What do you want?
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GREETING_0004e8d6_Oblivion_RESP1: I'm Maknok gro-Coblug, the Riverside groundskeeper. Rogmesh, my wife, is the cook at the Big House.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GREETING_00024eed_Oblivion_RESP1: I'm Malintus Ancrus. How are you doing?
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GREETING_0004769c_Oblivion_RESP1: I'm Mandil. I'm a lady of leisure, but I do some Advanced Training in Security. Just a hobby, of course.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_MogensTalk02_00086575_Oblivion_RE: I'm Mazoga. You killed my friend, Ra'vindra.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GREETING_0003e094_Oblivion_RESP1: I'm Mirabelle Monet. I run the Fo'c's'le, a boarding house for sailors. Sorry. I reserve my beds for seamen.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GREETING_00038a84_Oblivion_RESP1: I'm Mog gra-Mogakh, proprietor of Two Sisters Lodge. My sister and I own the place... 'Two Sisters', see? Need a bed? Good food?
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GREETING_00086058_Oblivion_RESP1: I'm Mogens Wind-Shifter. I'm having a look around. You mind?
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GREETING_0001f364_Oblivion_RESP1: I'm Muurine. If you have any secrets, I'm the one to tell. I won't share them with anyone but my family. Unless they're good ones, that is.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GREETING_0004774e_Oblivion_RESP1: I'm Myvryna Arano. I... persuade people.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GREETING_0003e0a0_Oblivion_RESP1: I'm Newheim, Anvil harbormaster. I'm responsible for all harbor traffic, docks, duties and fees in Anvil harbor.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GREETING_0003e07c_Oblivion_RESP1: I'm Norbert Lelles. I let my merchandise speak for itself. Look around. If you see something you like, we'll talk about a price.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GREETING_0003c98c_Oblivion_RESP1: I'm Olfand, the Light Armor trainer. Skjorta and I run North Winds. Please excuse us. We had a little drink-up last night. Still a little muzzy.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GREETING_000238d1_Oblivion_RESP1: I'm Otius Loran, Primate of Stendarr. You stand before Gods' servant, in the house of the Nine. Be humble, and show respect.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GREETING_000479e9_Oblivion_RESP1: I'm Otumeel. But I didn't do anything. Really. It wasn't me.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GREETING_00038ac0_Oblivion_RESP1: I'm Parwen of the Fighters Guild. I'm not a great archer, but I seem to have a knack for teaching. And I've bagged my share of goblins.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GREETING_0003c977_Oblivion_RESP1: I'm Petrine. This is Wildeye Stables. I look after folk's horses while they're here in Bruma.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GREETING_000ace28_Oblivion_RESP1: I'm Phebe Jeanard, a charity sister of Gottlesfont Priory. Are you looking for alchemical ingredients?
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GREETING_00047656_Oblivion_RESP1: I'm Phintias, owner and proprietor of the First Edition. Look around. If I don't have it, maybe I can get it.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GREETING_0004773d_Oblivion_RESP1: I'm Praxedes Afranius. My brothers and I share a house in the Temple District.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GREETING_0001dca2_Oblivion_RESP2: I'm Prior Maborel, head of our community, and responsible for all our religious and secular affairs.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GREETING_0003c9b8_Oblivion_RESP1: I'm Regner. You want anything? Talk to Edla. She's in charge.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GREETING_00024b56_Oblivion_RESP1: I'm Rena Bruiant. I love dogs. Doesn't everyone?
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GREETING_00074a88_Oblivion_RESP1: I'm Rimalus Bruiant. Perhaps you've met my wife, Rena? And our dogs, Bailey and Kezu?
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GREETING_0003e08c_Oblivion_RESP1: I'm Rufrius Vinicius, Fighters Guild Hand-to-Hand trainer.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GREETING_0003e09f_Oblivion_RESP1: I'm Rusia Bradus. My husband is General Silgor Bradus, one of County Anvil's commanders in the field.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GREETING_00047733_Oblivion_RESP1: I'm Ruslan. Not that it's any of your business.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GREETING_000475ac_Oblivion_RESP1: I'm Shamada, hostess of the Three Sister Inn. Speak to Shuravi if you need beds or meals.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GREETING_00035708_Oblivion_RESP2: I'm Shuravi, the sister-that-works-and-worries. Shamada is sweet and decorative. Shomara is dumb as a post. But she can cook, at least.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GREETING_0003c986_Oblivion_RESP1: I'm Snar the Cook. We've got genuine Skyrim cuisine... fresh, simple, big helpings... just like Mom used to make.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GREETING_00040bbf_Oblivion_RESP2: I'm Sontaire, spend one night with me and I'll remind you why they say "love hurts."
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GREETING_00038ac5_Oblivion_RESP1: I'm Sulinus Vassinus of the Mages Guild, and I'm so pleased to make your acquaintance.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GREETING_0003c988_Oblivion_RESP1: I'm Suurootan, proud owner of Novaroma, a little piece of Heartland Empire here in the lofty Jeralls.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GREETING_00038ae6_Oblivion_RESP1: I'm Tamika. We grow our own grapes, and make fine wines.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GREETING_0003e099_Oblivion_RESP1: I'm Thurindil, son of Julianos and Mohi-Titona, Queen of Akavir. These slugs climbing my spine itch something fierce. Like to dance?
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GREETING_0001b92e_Oblivion_RESP1: I'm Tivela Lythandas. I apologize that I can't give you the respect a guest in my home would normally receive, but I am at my wit's end.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GREETING_0004e8d0_Oblivion_RESP1: I'm Tolisi Girith. I'm a maid at Riverview. And it's no picnic, I'll tell you.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GREETING_0004e8c3_Oblivion_RESP1: I'm Trayvond the Redguard, Mages Guild Evoker. Surprised? Yes, you don't see many Redguards in the Mages Guild.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GREETING_000479c6_Oblivion_RESP1: I'm Tsrava. I'm an Advanced Trainer in Acrobatics. Did I mention I hate dogs?
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GREETING_0004e8b0_Oblivion_RESP1: I'm Ulene Hlervu, Castle Mage. Perhaps you've been warned off me as a scandalous, blasphemous scoffer and cynic.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GREETING_000488c6_Oblivion_RESP1: I'm Uravasa Othrelas, priest of Mara. I'm also a Speechcraft trainer. I can help you make... different mistakes, at least.
