ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_BravilNQDQuestionResponses_000466: It should be burned to the ground. All those skooma-muddled Khajiit laying around all day... it's disgraceful.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_Dark03FinChoice1A_00023e54_Oblivi: It should be easy enough to locate Dreth in his small cell. Besides, I think you know the way, hmmm. He he he he he.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_ND03AltarofKynareth_00002a4e_Knig: It simply wouldn't be right to build over Kynareth's works simply so we could worship her. So our Altar is here, in the Chapel she has created.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_INFOGENERAL_00062685_Oblivion_RES: It sounds like the Council of Mages has been holding extra meetings recently. I'm not sure what that means.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_INFOGENERAL_000029f7_Knights_RESP: It sounds like the Knights of the Nine are on a real Crusade. They're collecting holy relics for something.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_INFOGENERAL_0006266d_Oblivion_RES: It sounds like there are an awful lot of problems at the Bruma guild hall. Jeanne does a poor job of running that place.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GOODBYE_00034246_Oblivion_RESP1: It sounds like those books may be an important lead. Get back to me as soon as you turn up anything new.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_HELLO_000343f2_Oblivion_RESP1: It sounds like you and Baurus are making progress in your hunt for the Amulet of Kings. Good work.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_Recommendation_0002d2a1_Oblivion_: It sure sounds like Falcar has it in for you. What a bizarre thing to ask you to do!
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_INFOGENERAL_00032e31_Oblivion_RES: It sure sounds like the Blackwood Company double-crossed Argoth and helped Azani Blackheart murder him. Hard to prove it, though.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_BrumaNQDResponses_000465fe_Oblivi: It takes a skilled fighter to move well in armor that heavy.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_INFOGENERAL_00043ea6_Oblivion_RES: It takes an average of three attempts to inflict pain before someone will give up useful information, you know.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_TG01ThievesTest_0001c14e_Oblivion: It took two tries, but you finally made it. You have earned the right to join the Thieves Guild.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_magickasila_000c9ba4_Oblivion_RES: It translates directly to "Magicka Shines." That doesn't seem right. Perhaps it makes more sense in context; you should look at the others.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_INFOGENERAL_000029fa_Knights_RESP: It turns out the Shield of the Crusader had been locked away all this time, kept safe by the people who originally found it.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_MS51AccuseChanel1_00031506_Oblivi: It was I that painted that portrait. When the Count was lost, the Countess spent so much time with it that I became jealous.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_SE05AnyaWho_00080d7b_Oblivion_RES: It was Ma'zaddha. He said he was working on behalf of someone else. He told me I needed to help him, or there would be repercussions.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_SE05Interrogate2_0001447d_Oblivio: It was Muurine. She said she found a note from Thadon, that she would tell people it was written to me unless I paid her. It's not mine, I tell you!
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_MS48HirtelC_0005d2cc_Oblivion_RES: It was Savlian Matius... some of the other guards... helped some of us escape... they cut their way out, right through the city gates.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_Prank_0001ef7d_Oblivion_RESP1: It was a good idea, wasn't it? I wonder how long she'll spend trying to figure out where she put it down.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GOODBYE_0007311f_Oblivion_RESP1: It was a pleasure talking to you. No lie.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GREETING_0005a027_Oblivion_RESP2: It was a privilege to fight by your side.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_KvatchTopic_001778ce_Oblivion_RES: It was a terrible night. I don't know how any of us survived. The whole city was burning.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_SE32HlovalsMagicka_0005a754_Obliv: It was an honor for me to help Prior Dreth. The pain of the stab wound was a small sacrifice to restore his magicka.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GREETING_00026eeb_Oblivion_RESP1: It was an honor to serve with you, ma'am. Now that I've seen how it's done, I think my guardsmen and I can handle any new Gates that open near Bruma.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GREETING_00026eec_Oblivion_RESP1: It was an honor to serve with you, sir. Now that I've seen how it's done, I think my guardsmen and I can handle any new Gates that open near Bruma.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GOODBYE_000af06a_Oblivion_RESP1: It was an honor to speak with you, Champion.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_MS21TempleOfAncestors_0002b460_Ob: It was brutally sacked thousands of years ago by humans led by Alessia. The Imperial City is built over the ruins of that ancient city.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GREETING_000be43c_Oblivion_RESP1: It was even easier than Maric promised. Push off.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_SE11HowlingHalls_00016b7f_Oblivio: It was in this temple that Emperor Pelagius was taken during his madness. After his death in these very halls, the temple was destroyed.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GREETING_0001f85f_Oblivion_RESP2: It was just a harmless little prank, that's all. Why did you have to go and ruin it?
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_RosentiaGallenusTopic_00094ec7_Ob: It was kind of you to accept such a noble task.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_JemaneFamily_00028ac5_Oblivion_RE: It was kind of you to escort the Jemanes back to Weatherleah. However, the original owner of Weatherleah left them an even greater legacy.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_BloodwormHelmTopic_0000c08b_Obliv: It was last seen in the possession of Irlav Jarol. He was taking it to Fort Teleman; I can only assume he is still there.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GREETING_0002fd92_Oblivion_RESP5: It was learned that the traitor has been active for quite some time, since before you joined the Brotherhood. That absolves you of any suspicion.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_CropsfordTopic_00033efa_Oblivion_: It was my father's dream, for us all to start a new life there. He spent everything he had to buy the land. Now it all seems to be ruined.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_SE13JyggalagSpeech_000636f7_Obliv: It was not always so. Once, I ruled this Realm, a world of perfect Order. My dominion expanded across the seas of Oblivion with each passing era.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GREETING_00037ce5_Oblivion_RESP3: It was only a matter of time before you or Carius figured it out. No matter. After I've killed you, I won't need my vampire hunter ruse any longer.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_INFOGENERAL_00032e6a_Oblivion_RES: It was our people who got Azani Blackheart, but I can't talk about who. I promised.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_SE04Who_0001330b_Oblivion_RESP2: It was passion, it was... forbidden. Oh, the things that would be said if word got out. That made it all the more delicious.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_ShadowbanishWine_0018d92e_Oblivio: It was perfect for keeping lookouts warm on cold nights and helping them see better in the dark. Clever, eh?
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_ND06CurseTopic_00002b22_Knights_R: It was placed on me for defying the teachings of Stendarr in his very Chapel. My entire lineage was ruined by this curse.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_BearclawHelmTOPIC_0003570d_Oblivi: It was returned to me by a stranger from my homeland, Morrowind. Wear it proudly. Perhaps you can help restore the glory of my family's name.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GOODBYE_000343eb_Oblivion_RESP1: It was so nice chatting with you. Be sure to let me know how your hunt for the Mythic Dawn turns out.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_NDAnvilChapel_00002a98_Knights_RE: It was terrible. I've fought in many battles, but this...
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GuttedMineTOPIC_0001ebea_Oblivion: It was then that Azura, may She bless our days, sealed the cavern, protecting the world from the monstrosities within. It has been sealed ever since.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_MS48SalvianWhatHappened_00098142_: It was too much, too fast. We were overwhelmed. Couldn't even get everyone out. There are still people trapped in there.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_INFOGENERAL_0005f428_Oblivion_RES: It was truly shocking. The guards just dropped dead, all across the city! I'm glad it's over, but it makes you wonder, doesn't it?
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_SEThaedilResponses_00041212_Obliv: It was wonderful! Your show was amazing!
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GREETING_0018d29a_Oblivion_RESP1: It was you that closed that Oblivion Gate, wasn't it? That was a brave thing to do!
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GREETING_00017967_Oblivion_RESP3: It wasn't long after that the Knights came.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_ImperialCityTopic_000476c7_Oblivi: It wasn't my fault. Cyronin Sintav started it. But I'm the one who got caught, so I'm the one who has to cool his heels.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_FGD08Choice6_000a345d_Oblivion_RE: It wasn't the goblins. It had to have been bandits. But, why? We have nothing! Please go. I must bury our dead.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_SE45Choice1_00078788_Oblivion_RES: It went away. But it will come back! It always comes back! It is close. Big-Head can hear it! The Fork of Horripilation!
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_ND09ProphetGreeting03_00002c11_Kn: It will allow you to follow Umaril into the spirit realm upon his death. It will allow you to destroy him, body and soul, utterly and for all time.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_SE06HelpAttack_00012cc9_Oblivion_: It will be difficult. The Mazken have fortified their position. But I am confident that with your help, we can defeat them.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_TGPayFines_000983a7_Oblivion_RESP: It will be done. I will shred all of the hunter's criminal warrants.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_MQ06ShrineTalkInvasion_0003641f_O: It will be glorious when the smoke of the burning cities rises to blind the eyes of the false gods! Their reign over Tamriel is almost over.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_SE13CaptainGreetB2_0001a79f_Obliv: It will be our great honor to fight by your side, My Lord!
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_AmuletofKingsTopic_00033fc1_Obliv: It will be safest here with me. When you return with Martin, we will figure out our next move.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GREETING_00034861_Oblivion_RESP4: It will be up to you to decide the fate of many. Life and death are strange things, easily manipulated, and both will be altered by your hands.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_SE11StaffOfSheogorath_00019cce_Ob: It will draw its power from the waters of the Font of Madness in the Palace.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GOODBYE_00088b3b_Oblivion_RESP1: It won't matter. Lord Dagon will soon be able to cross over. The Master's plan will have succeeded.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_contract_0002798c_Oblivion_RESP2: It would be a good idea to talk to each guest and appeal to their good disposition. Remember, if they really like you, they may open up to you.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_MageConvFollow_0006bd99_Oblivion_: It would be a privilege, Arch-Mage.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GREETING_000400dc_Oblivion_RESP1: It would be a truly Demented act to light the Great Torch with a Flame purchased with the blood of the Golden Saints.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GREETING_0004e928_Oblivion_RESP1: It would be much easier to make the Elixir if you weren't interrupting me.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_ImperialCityTopic_0004766b_Oblivi: It would be perfect... if the Watch could just get rid of the damn Thieves Guild. You don't have this problem in Anvil or Bruma.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GREETING_00035672_Oblivion_RESP4: It would be wise of you to be on time.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_SE05HerdirInvestigateCurrentTask_: It would seem that Anya Herrick may know something. It could be nothing, but it's certainly worth following up on, don't you think?
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_SE05Conspiracy_000895e1_Oblivion_: It would seem that direct torture may not always yield the results you seek. You may need to try a different approach, Inquisitor.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GREETING_00081e44_Oblivion_RESP1: It would seem that the Fringe has come under attack. The longer you wait to investigate, the harder it will be for you to do as you are told.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GREETING_00081e45_Oblivion_RESP1: It would seem that the forces of Order have moved very quickly.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_SE05Conspiracy_00089605_Oblivion_: It would seem that your only course of action now is to extract information from Nelrene, Inquisitor.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_SE09RebuildGatekeeper_00014ae8_Ob: It wouldn't do to just let them in if more show up. And more always show up. Still and all, I think things are going well, considering!
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GREETING_00002913_Knights_RESP2: It'd be an honor to provide what service I can. So you need anything repaired, you come see me.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_SE07GreymarchTopic_00091016_Obliv: It'll be in full swing soon! Excited?
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_SE07GreymarchTopic_00091273_Obliv: It'll be in full swing soon! Excited?
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_SE04GreymarchTopic_00091021_Obliv: It's Jyggalag's time, and not a good time at all. You're going to help me stop it. First, though, you need to get your feet wet.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_BladesTalk2_0018d7ea_Oblivion_RES: It's Martin. His security, I mean. I'm just not sure we're doing enough. He is the last of the Septim line. His death would spell our doom.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_NelsTheNaughtyTopic_00028248_Obli: It's Nels! He's the murderer! We have to get him before he gets us! Do you understand what I'm saying? We have to kill Nels!
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_NDTalkDeadCarodus1_00002cf8_Knigh: It's Sir Carodus, actually... I still think about him, sometimes. He was one of the best of us.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_NDTalkDeadGeimund1_00002cec_Knigh: It's Sir Geimund, that's all. Sometimes I still can't believe he's gone. I don't understand how he, of all of us, should have been the one to fall...
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_NDTalkDeadLathon1_00002d01_Knight: It's Sir Lathon's death... it still bothers me. I know it could happen to any of us at any time, but... I'm sorry. I shouldn't bother you with this.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_NDRumorsUmaril_00002bcd_Knights_R: It's Umaril the Unfeathered, the evil king from the old stories about Alessia and Pelinal and Morihaus. At least that's what the prophet says.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_ImperialCityTopic_00047667_Oblivi: It's a beautiful city. But stay away from the Waterfront. It's not dangerous, but it's dirty, and the beggars are a nuisance.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_AnvilTopic_0003e0c5_Oblivion_RESP: It's a big town. Hell, it's a big county. You stick to your part, I stick to mine, all right?
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_SkingradNQDResponses_0003c1a5_Obl: It's a bit strange, but Castle Skingrad is an odd place.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GREETING_00035f42_Oblivion_RESP2: It's a damned shame. I haven't been giving the project the attention it deserves.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_CharGenMain_000227d6_Oblivion_RES: It's a dead end. What's your call, sir?
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_HouseInquiry_0004f20f_Oblivion_RE: It's a fairly typical Cheydinhal home. It's in decent shape, although largely unfurnished.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_KilltheGrandChampion_0003a911_Obl: It's a fight to the death, so if you progress that far and want a shot at the Grand Championship, you'll have to try and kill me.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_ChorrolNQDResponses_00029fcd_Obli: It's a fine chapel. And a fine group of healers, as well.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GREETING_0008b071_Oblivion_RESP1: It's a fine day is it not?
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_BrumaNQDResponses_00046586_Oblivi: It's a fine place, and Olav treats people well.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_ICAllNQDResponses_00049904_Oblivi: It's a fine place, but I miss the personal attention I got at the smaller bookstores.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_BrumaNQDResponses_0004659e_Oblivi: It's a good place to stay. Hafid is quite a good proprietor.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_SE32SiegeVitharn_0005a756_Oblivio: It's a good thing I've kept all the weapons and armor in good condition. If I let those soldiers use them, they'd be all dented by now.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_CheydinhalTopic_0004e8d7_Oblivion: It's a grand house, Riverside, and they have grand parties there. All the rich swongs and swells of the town come in. Leave a right mess, they do.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_MS13Gate_000314e8_Oblivion_RESP1: It's a great relief that the gate is gone. Now the people of Cheydinhal can breathe easier.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_InnofIllOmen_00023e25_Oblivion_RE: It's a horrible name for an inn, I know. But I just can't bring myself to change it. Besides, I like the sign.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_ND06CurseTopic_00002b20_Knights_R: It's a horrible thing, truly. One cannot help but pity those such as Kellen, who have such a burden placed on them through no fault of their own.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_BrumaTopic_0003c9a7_Oblivion_RESP: It's a little too rugged up here for me. Add a couple hairs to a Nord and you've got a bear.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_InfoRefusal_0002459c_Oblivion_RES: It's a matter of trust. And I don't trust you enough yet.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_HouseBuyLeyawiin_0004ed8d_Oblivio: It's a might devoid of furnishings, so you may want to pay a visit to Gundalas at Best Goods and Guarantees. He can fix you up.
It's a modest home in the center of town.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_SE02Passwall_0008e4fe_Oblivion_RE: It's a nice enough place. Less dirty than others. I feel like I belong. That old man, in the room made out of butterflies, he said to wait here.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_ICAllNQDResponses_00049954_Oblivi: It's a nice store, at least for alchemists.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GREETING_000479da_Oblivion_RESP3: It's a pity my busy consulting and training schedule leaves me little time for gathering ingredients...
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_SeleneTopic_0000c1cb_Oblivion_RES: It's a pity she wouldn't surrender. Such a waste of a young life.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_HorseBuySkingrad_000545db_Oblivio: It's a pleasure doing business with you. Tilmo has your horse waiting outside.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_TestToddNeutral_00028307_Oblivion: It's a pleasure to be here with you.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_HouseBuyChorrol_0004f219_Oblivion: It's a pleasure to have you become a citizen of Chorrol. I'll take care of the deed.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_HELLO_0001c4cd_Oblivion_RESP1: It's a pleasure to see you.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_SEFelldew_00018b7e_Oblivion_RESP1: It's a poison, plain and simple. It'll make you wish you were dead. And given enough time, you will be.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_DAClavicusChoice3_00026b16_Oblivi: It's a powerful sword, no doubt about that. Jet black. Got a wicked edge on it, and they say it can steal a man's soul.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_DAClavicusChoice5_00026b18_Oblivi: It's a powerful sword, no doubt about that. Jet black. Got a wicked edge on it, and they say it can steal a man's soul.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_LeyawiinTopic_000475c1_Oblivion_R: It's a pretty town, and everyone is really friendly, except maybe some Khajiit and Argonians who are upset about the Trans-Niben.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_SE46DoublesTopic_0008fa84_Oblivio: It's a problem, all these doubles walking around. And it's tiresome. Didn't used to be like this.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_HouseInquiry_0004ed8b_Oblivion_RE: It's a quaint building, small but tidy.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_HouseInquiry_0004f210_Oblivion_RE: It's a quaint little house conveniently located just off the main gate.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_PrimoAntoniusTopic_000289f4_Obliv: It's a regal name, from a rather regal family. Indeed, my father owns more property than the East Empire Company!
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_MerchantTopic_0002fd6c_Oblivion_R: It's a sad thing, to think that a mage would kill helpless merchants for the wares they carry.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_CheydinhalTopic_0004e8a9_Oblivion: It's a scandal that the Mages Guild has tolerated practice of the Black Arts among its members for so long.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_CGBaurusD_0001e8e9_Oblivion_RESP2: It's a secret way out of the Imperial City. Or it was supposed to be secret.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_FawilTopic_00143eb3_Oblivion_RESP: It's a shame Farwil is gone. Although he was boastful and aloof, at least he treated me as an equal. I shall miss him.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_INFOGENERAL_000441f8_Oblivion_RES: It's a shame Syl's gone. She didn't pay a lot of attention to what was going on.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_ICAllNQDResponses_00049901_Oblivi: It's a shame all the smaller bookstores are gone. I guess they just couldn't compete.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_JeanneFrasoricTopic_0001ceeb_Obli: It's a shame she doesn't know more about her craft, though.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_KnightsofThorn_000335a5_Oblivion_: It's a shame so many of the Knights fell. I suppose their intentions were good, even if they were a bit self-serving.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_SkingradNQDResponses_0003c197_Obl: It's a shame such a good smith wastes her life in the bottle.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_MagesGuildTopic_00062610_Oblivion: It's a shame that Selena doesn't join in our fun, but she takes her role as an Alchemist very seriously. If you need supplies, she's the one to see.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GREETING_00060ed4_Oblivion_RESP1: It's a shame that you had all the fun before I could get here. Now, there's nothing left to do but rebuild.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_INFOGENERAL_000434b8_Oblivion_RES: It's a shame, really. The Gatekeeper was a beautiful specimen. Now he'll just rot and fade like everything else.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_INFOGENERAL_00032e44_Oblivion_RES: It's a simple job. Go get a journal from Fallen Rock Cave. Shouldn't that be a cinch for a Fighter Guild contract?
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_TG09HelpGF_00014825_Oblivion_RESP: It's a small item in the possession of a powerful court wizard. Will you do this for me? I will pay you well.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_SE34Medallion_00066fee_Oblivion_R: It's a small, round, gold medallion. On the back is the inscription "To Pyke, from Farwil."
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_SE30MadnessOre_0001650d_Oblivion_: It's a supple and flexible ore.  Yet it holds a good edge. I can shape the sharpest of blades from it. I can also create magical items.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_SkingradTopic_00038ac8_Oblivion_R: It's a town, like any other. Well, go outside, and there's the mountains and wines and sheep. Here in town, though, nothing special.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_FingersoftheMountain_000224e5_Obl: It's a very old text, written in a language I'm sure you wouldn't understand. Don't worry about it -- just bring me the book.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_bed_0003b345_Oblivion_RESP1: It's a wonderful room, isn't it?
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GREETING_0002c7a4_Oblivion_RESP1: It's about time someone did something. These guys are killing my business!
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GREETING_0002ee5c_Oblivion_RESP1: It's about time someone from the Fighters Guild showed up. I've got work for you to do. I need imp gall for my research.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GREETING_0002e723_Oblivion_RESP1: It's about time someone got here. What took you so long?
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GREETING_000a3840_Oblivion_RESP1: It's about time someone got here. What took you so long?
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_INFOGENERAL_0005f420_Oblivion_RES: It's about time someone restores some order around here.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_HELLO_0008676f_Oblivion_RESP1: It's about time you got here.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_TGPayBloodPrice_0001cf3a_Oblivion: It's about time. I guess I have to reinstate you now. Try not to repeat this mistake in the future.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GREETING_000c456d_Oblivion_RESP1: It's all about the Yellow Team! Go Yellow Team! Yeah! Woo! Wait, you didn't bet on the Blue Team, did you? 'Cause that would just be plain stupid!

ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_VampireTopic_0001d4be_Oblivion_RE: It's said that the bite of a vampire has the chance of infecting the victim. If this occurs, they'll become a vampire in a few days. Be cautious.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_StoneofStAlessiaTOPIC_00003936_Ob: It's said the Stone was blessed by Alessia herself, and while it remains in our possession, no harm may come to our church.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GREETING_0002c6d7_Oblivion_RESP1: It's so difficult to be here and watch him not knowing how much he may be suffering.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_HELLO_00062c99_Oblivion_RESP1: It's so good to meet you.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GREETING_0001da4d_Oblivion_RESP1: It's so good to see you again. I've spent a good deal of time speaking with Gilen and Grey-Throat. They agree that the Order should live on.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_HELLO_0008e4d9_Oblivion_RESP1: It's so hard to concentrate with all that noise!
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_ImperialCityTopic_00047713_Oblivi: It's so sad. Salomon was to compose a symphony for Uriel Septim, to be performed for the whole city in the Arena.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GREETING_00038afd_Oblivion_RESP1: It's so very nice to see you again.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_TG01Armand5_0005143e_Oblivion_RES: It's somewhere in the Imperial City. The beggars will help you locate it, for a price. I can sell you lockpicks if you need them.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_HouseBuyBravil_0004ed83_Oblivion_: It's squalid little shack, I'm sorry to say.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_INFOGENERAL_000624bf_Oblivion_RES: It's still pretty wild east of the Niben. Few people, except for bandits, but at least it hasn't been picked clean by treasure-hunters.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_SkingradTopicElse02_00038a9d_Obli: It's stupid. And chapels and priests and folks groveling on their knees, they're stupid, too.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_VidkunTopic_0002e997_Oblivion_RES: It's such a shame. He didn't deserve to die like that.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_INFOGENERAL_00032e69_Oblivion_RES: It's supposed to be a secret. I'm not talking. But everyone knows who's responsible.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_SE08GreymarchTopic_0009130e_Obliv: It's swept the Fringe. That's not good. See if you can't hold them off there. Because, if you can't, everyone is going to die.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_NDChapelAttackTopic_00002b9b_Knig: It's terrible. But I have the feeling that worse is yet to come. I may go to Anvil to hear that prophet preach, before it's too late.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_ImperialCityTopic_00047736_Oblivi: It's terrible. I just can't walk past a bookstore. The First Edition, in the Market District, is the worst.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_SE32Arrows_00013346_Oblivion_RESP: It's that fool Bat gro-Orkul. He thinks his armory is more important than the town or our lives. He's first on the list. Oh, yes! First.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GREETING_0002d759_Oblivion_RESP1: It's the Chapel of Akatosh. Four walls standing, and no fire. Can you think of a safer place?
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_HELLO_0003ab37_Oblivion_RESP1: It's the Gray Fox! I can't believe it's really you!
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_Attack_0003c8b7_Oblivion_RESP1: It's the Gray Fox! You're under arrest!
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_BladesTalk2_0018d7e9_Oblivion_RES: It's the Great Hall. Those high windows -- they're not nearly as secure as they should be. If an assassin or spy should gain entrance...
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GREETING_00081d84_Oblivion_RESP1: It's the Madgod Himself! My Lord! I've been keeping track of all the dead things for you. There's lots of dead things. I've counted them all!
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_ICAllNQDQuestionResponses_000498f: It's the best place in the city for alchemical ingredients.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GREETING_00095a64_Oblivion_RESP2: It's the captain's enchanted cutlass. I managed to grab it when I was in his cabin, before his spirit chased me out! Oh, thank you so very much!
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_ImperialCityTopic_000476db_Oblivi: It's the city of Tiber Septim, youngest of the gods. Go to the Palace and the Temple of the One. Stand on the stones where Talos stood.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_MQLastItem_00026ef7_Oblivion_RESP: It's the counterpart to the Great Welkynd Stone, just as the first two were the opposed powers of the daedra and the divines.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_ICAllNQDResponses_00049959_Oblivi: It's the finest light armor selection in the city.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_ICAllNQDQuestionResponses_000498d: It's the finest place in the city. Simply an excellent inn.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_MS29StopYes_0001e840_Oblivion_RES: It's the least I can do to say thank you. Now, don't be a stranger! The Copious Coinpurse is still in business.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_SE34WhyNeed_0008f7b9_Oblivion_RES: It's the only piece of my history that validates who I am.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_ICAllNQDQuestionResponses_0004990: It's the only place to go for books.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_ArcaneUniversityTopic_000473ef_Ob: It's the only place worth visiting in the Imperial City, if you ask me. I only make the trip if I can't find a specific book here.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_HELLO_0018ad69_Oblivion_RESP1: It's the smell, really. Smoke and fire. And something worse. In the ruins.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GREETING_0003c142_Oblivion_RESP1: It's the waiting that gets to me. Why don't they just attack and get it over with?
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_TimeToGo_0002a4b8_Oblivion_RESP1: It's time for you to go.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_Trespass_00025309_Oblivion_RESP1: It's time for you to leave, my friend.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GOODBYE_0008f10f_Oblivion_RESP1: It's time to say goodbye, I'm sorry I must fly.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_MS13KnightsWhy_00031c84_Oblivion_: It's tolerated because Farwil is the Count's son. Plain and simple. He has the power and the coin to put it all together.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GlarthirTopic_00029a71_Oblivion_R: It's too bad nobody stopped Glarthir before he went on his killing spree. I guess no one knew how crazy he really was.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_ICAllNQDResponses_000498e4_Oblivi: It's true that he's settled down. Still, he can teach you the basics of lockpicking.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_INFOGENERAL_0018b2f7_Oblivion_RES: It's true what everyone's saying -- Kvatch is lost. The Daedra, they swarmed in.... The Town Guard never had a chance.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_ChorrolNQDResponses_00029fbd_Obli: It's true. Chorrol has almost everything you could need.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_ChorrolNQDResponses_00029fc5_Obli: It's true. Some fine horses he has.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GlarthirTopic_00029aa4_Oblivion_R: It's unbelievable. Glarthir went after Toutius Sextius with an axe. Killed him before the guards could do anything. No one even knows why.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_NDChapelAttackTopic_00002b94_Knig: It's unbelievable. Right in the center of the city, nobody saw anything? Makes you wonder about the competence of the Guard, if you ask me.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_contract_0000c081_Oblivion_RESP1: It's uncertain exactly what illness Roderick has contracted. But don't worry, it's probably not contagious. He he he he he.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_TG01Armand2_0005143b_Oblivion_RES: It's unusual for us to have three potential recruits at the same time. Rather than the normal test of skill, I'm going to make this a contest.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_DovesiDranTopic_0002819d_Oblivion: It's up to us now, don't you see? Dovesi did it! She murdered everyone! And now she wants to murder us too! We have to get her first!
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_BedYes_000b124b_Oblivion_RESP1: It's upstairs on the top floor. Only room I've got. I think both beds should be clean enough, so use whichever you prefer.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_BedYes_000bb9b8_Oblivion_RESP1: It's upstairs, second door on the left. Don't say I didn't warn you.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GREETING_00038b01_Oblivion_RESP1: It's very good to see you again.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GREETING_000549bc_Oblivion_RESP2: It's well hidden, so don't even think about trying to steal it back from me!
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_SEFlameofAgnonTopic_0009109f_Obli: It's what's used to light the Great Torch. Haven't we covered this? You'll find it in Cylarne, guarded by my Saints and Seducers.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_SEHillofSuicidesTopic_0008e55e_Ob: It's where you end up if you don't die according to His plan. They will drive you to it. Like They did poor Gadeneri.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_HELLO_0001c4c9_Oblivion_RESP1: It's wonderful to see you again.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_INFOGENERAL_0005ef76_Oblivion_RES: It's worse than my nightmares! In fact, it's like my worst nightmares come true!
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GREETING_0008e614_Oblivion_RESP1: It's you again! I'm so pleased to see you!
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GREETING_0003e704_Oblivion_RESP1: It's you again! I'm so pleased to see you! Look at what you have! Is this new? Let me get a closer look! Exquisite!
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GREETING_00002917_Knights_RESP1: It's you! I've heard of you! You're the one restoring the Knights of the Nine, aren't you?
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_FGJoin2_00024286_Oblivion_RESP1: It's your choice, of course. If you should change your mind, feel free to speak to me again about it.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_HorseDecline_0004f00e_Oblivion_RE: It's your loss. There is no finer horse in Cyrodiil than the Black horses of Cheydinhal.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_AleswellTopic_00000887_Oblivion_R: It's your own fault. You had two chances to help them. I'm sure they'll get used to being invisible eventually.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_DLC06FenceTopic03_000088a1_DLCThi: It's your prison sentence, not mine.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_TGNoPayFines_000983a8_Oblivion_RE: It's your prison sentence, not mine.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GREETING_00092d77_Oblivion_RESP1: It's... It's finally over. The killer is dead. We just... We just need to get out of here...
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GREETING_0011e154_DLCOrrery_RESP1: It's... It's nice to see you too, but you're a bit empty-handed, aren't you? Remember those items we talked about? Please, I'm still waiting...
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_HELLO_0018baa5_Oblivion_RESP1: It's... It's you! The Hero of Kvatch! This is truly an honor!
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GREETING_000181bb_Oblivion_RESP1: It's... it's you! I remember you. What are you doing down here? How did you get past the Knights?
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_HELLO_000852bd_Oblivion_RESP1: It's... it's you... you're the only one left. You did it! You killed them all!
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_INFOGENERAL_000607e8_Oblivion_RES: It's... unbelievable. Order was defeated? All the old tales say that's impossible.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_KvatchTopic_00028555_Oblivion_RES: It... it all happened so fast. It was all we could do to round up the survivors and try and get them to safety. We've failed them miserably.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_INFOGENERAL_00046605_Oblivion_RES: Ita Rienus knows more about the geography of Tamriel than anyone I've ever met. Apparently, she knows quite a bit about Mysticism as well.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GREETING_000488d5_Oblivion_RESP1: Ita Rienus, Spells, Recharging and Training in Mysticism. And idle chatter. At your service.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GREETING_000476ba_Oblivion_RESP1: Itius Hayn, Guard Captain. You don't want to know me. Stay on the right side of the law, and we can stay perfect strangers.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GREETING_0008605b_Oblivion_RESP1: J'Baasha's an adventurer... just like you.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_Dark16Choice1A_000262d5_Oblivion_: J'Ghasta, Shaleez, Alval Uvani, Havilstein Hoar-Blood -- Speakers and Silencers all. And Ungolim... the Listener himself!
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_Dark16Choice1B_000262d6_Oblivion_: J'Ghasta, Shaleez, Alval Uvani, Havilstein Hoar-Blood -- Speakers and Silencers all. And Ungolim... the Listener himself!
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_Dark16Choice1C_000262d7_Oblivion_: J'Ghasta, Shaleez, Alval Uvani, Havilstein Hoar-Blood -- Speakers and Silencers all. And Ungolim... the Listener himself!
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GREETING_0004770a_Oblivion_RESP1: J'mhad keeps the grounds of the Temple nice and neat. Other things, J'mhad does, when they ask.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GREETING_000476ee_Oblivion_RESP1: Jakben, Earl of Imbel. We do not know one another. And, given your modest social standing, I doubt we ever shall.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_INFOGENERAL_00046620_Oblivion_RES: Jantus Brolus is apparently an excellent mage.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_LeyawiinTopic_00051dc9_Oblivion_R: Januarius and I have been in service to three generations of Caros. We're very proud of Count Marius and his lovely new bride.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_OblivionGateTopic_00033fc9_Oblivi: Jauffre believes that the death of the Emperor and the darkening of the Dragonfires is the key.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_CGBaurusH_0001e90d_Oblivion_RESP5: Jauffre should know how to find the heir that the Emperor spoke of. The Amulet must reach Emperor Uriel's heir so a new emperor can be crowned!
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_SE02Gatekeeper_0008e54f_Oblivion_: Jayred Ice-Veins wants to kill the Gatekeeper. Sounds like suicide to me.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GREETING_000476b2_Oblivion_RESP1: Jena Sintav. I have a house with Jastia, my sister.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_ThoronirTopic_0000bc9c_Oblivion_R: Jensine is running the show. She will get him but good.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_ThoronirTopic_0000bc96_Oblivion_R: Jensine is the lady you want to speak with about Thoronir.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_ICAllNQDQuestionResponses_0004993: Jensine's isn't bad, especially if you need to make a quick couple of septims.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_INFOGENERAL_0004658b_Oblivion_RES: Jerall View is a nice place for visitors to stay. Hafid makes everyone feel welcome.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GREETING_0003e0a5_Oblivion_RESP1: Jesan Sextius, singer, composer, and storyteller extraordinaire. Glad to meet you.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_jobs_0002c7aa_Oblivion_RESP1: Jobs are good. I need more money. So I need more jobs. For money.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_jobs_0002c7a3_Oblivion_RESP1: Jobs around here? Don't know that I trust you enough to recommend you to anyone.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_jobs_0002c7a1_Oblivion_RESP1: Jobs for the Fighters Guild? Hmmm... try Margarte. If she's not at home or at the Five Claws, she's probably out looking for alchemical ingredients.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_jobs_0002c7e1_Oblivion_RESP1: Jobs would be great. Too bad no one is giving us any these days. If you can find some work for us, we'll do it.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_TGThievesGuildJobs_000165e5_Obliv: Jobs? We're thieves, not masons or scribes.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GREETING_00033dce_Oblivion_RESP1: Join the Fighters Guild? Fight, and get paid for it.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_HELLO_00033ddb_Oblivion_RESP1: Join the Guild, and fight for gold.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GOODBYE_00033d14_Oblivion_RESP1: Join the Guild. You won't regret it.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_DarkBrotherhoodTopic_000bba98_Obl: Join us, and you'll find the Dark Brotherhood to be all that, and so much more. We are, more than anything, a union of like-minded individuals.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GREETING_0004762a_Oblivion_RESP1: Jollring, the butler. I've served Master Umbacano for many years.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_MS09ImIn_00053724_Oblivion_RESP2: Jorundr and I have had a rocky relationship at best. Against my will, I've been dragged all over Cyrodiil helping him commit petty crimes.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_MQ15MankarRant_0008c22f_Oblivion_: Julianos and Dibella and Stendarr are all Lorkhan's betrayers, posing as divinities in a principality that has lost its guiding light.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_NDTombSpeech_00002d07_Knights_RES: Julianos blesses you with his wisdom and his guidance. Trust in your knowledge for it is the whole of who you are.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_MS38GuardWarnChoice1_00023686_Obl: Julianos preserve us! I can't believe it ... why me?! Please, show this to the guards right away!
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_IngredientCollection_000279e1_Obl: Julienne Fanis has long served Arch-Mage Traven in collecting alchemical ingredients for his personal research.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GREETING_0004763e_Oblivion_RESP1: Julienne Fanis. I'm the Alchemy Expert. At least, the best the Mages Guild has.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_Attack_00023c0c_Oblivion_RESP1: Jump on my sword while you can!
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_Lost_00081a39_Oblivion_RESP1: Just a Gnarl, I suppose. Let them drink their fill of Order, ha ha ha!
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_MQ15EldamilD1_0003fbe2_Oblivion_R: Just act like a prisoner, and do as I say. Once Orthe leaves, we can find a quiet spot to remove those Bands.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_MS38DSNo_00023670_Oblivion_RESP1: Just as I suspected!! They've gotten to you too! Not one of them involved in the conspiracy, and you expect me to believe that?!
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_MG02Choice1B_0002e5a9_Oblivion_RE: Just as I suspected. If you ever believe yourself to be ready, perhaps we'll have reason to speak.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_MS38BPYes_0001dc31_Oblivion_RESP1: Just as I thought, just as I thought. Excellent work. There will be a bonus in this for you, don't worry.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_ScarTailTopic_00035593_Oblivion_R: Just as a member of the Dark Brotherhood cannot kill a fellow family member, a Shadowscale is forbidden from slaying another Shadowscale.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_SE02OrcConversation_0007ead0_Obli: Just as long as we don't catch any of their diseases. Adventurers always get strange diseases.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_NDEightAndOneTopic_00002c8c_Knigh: Just as the Eight aided Pelinal of old, now the ascended One, Talos who was Tiber Septim, provides his Blessing to you, the new Crusader.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_MS43HowDid_000be560_Oblivion_RESP: Just be sure and keep this quiet. If the other mages even knew that I was involved with Rosentia's new guests...
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_INFOGENERAL_000607d1_Oblivion_RES: Just because the Isles didn't come crashing down around our heads doesn't mean everything is fine.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_MS10LlevanaTalk_0003c375_Oblivion: Just because you run the law in this town doesn't put you above it. You're going to pay for what happened to Aldos.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GREETING_00038580_Oblivion_RESP1: Just before I arrived here, I received a report from one of our scouts watching the roads.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_ChorrolTopic_00074a16_Oblivion_RE: Just between the two of us, I wish the Countess would worry a bit more about the security of the city and a bit less about her damned painting.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_SE02OrcConversation_0007ead2_Obli: Just don't get any blood on me!
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_SE02GatekeeperChoiceHowTears_0008: Just don't tell her I said anything. I might get another lesson in the nature of Pain. I don't like those lessons very much.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GOODBYE_00053766_Oblivion_RESP1: Just exit the city through the North Gate. It isn't far from there.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GREETING_0002871b_Oblivion_RESP1: Just follow Savlian's orders, and everything will be fine.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_Gift_0018bc31_Oblivion_RESP1: Just give them to her; say they're from a friend. She doesn't need to know I'm the one responsible.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_SECreatureResponses_0008dc3d_Obli: Just go right up to them and introduce yourself. They love meeting new people.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_Prank_0001ceea_Oblivion_RESP1: Just go unlock Jeanne's desk with that spell I taught you.. Find her Manual of Spellcraft, and bring it here to me.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GOODBYE_0003632a_Oblivion_RESP1: Just go! I can't stand the sight of you!
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_INFOGENERAL_00032e95_Oblivion_RES: Just got a look at the new Maglir guy. Another 'eight-pint hero', if you ask me.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_MS38Topic_00083065_Oblivion_RESP1: Just have to take matters into my own hands. The only way now.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_ArenaCombatantTopic_0002ada0_Obli: Just head through the door here on my right and take the stairs down. Be on your best behavior, though. Owyn is a bit... cranky by nature.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_HELLO_0000bcc6_Oblivion_RESP1: Just hold the ghosts off while I figure out how to open this damn door.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GREETING_0003d498_Oblivion_RESP1: Just hurry back with that ring... please.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_MS47Counterspell_0003012e_Oblivio: Just in case, it might be best if you wore this ring while you were casting the spell. I make them myself. Very useful for this kind of research.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GREETING_00035a13_Oblivion_RESP1: Just in time, Mage. We've been waiting for you.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GOODBYE_0007302d_Oblivion_RESP1: Just keep going. Nothing to eat here.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GuardTalk2_0006fdd7_Oblivion_RESP: Just keep one hand on your hilt and both eyes on the crowd. There's something sinister lurking out there. I can feel it.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_Barter_00062156_Oblivion_RESP1: Just keep your eyes on the menu, and off of Sheer Meedish.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_BladesTalk4_00067dc6_Oblivion_RES: Just know, that whatever you need, we will give gladly. Our hearts, our blades, our lives if need be. Long live the Septim bloodline!
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GREETING_0007eab0_Oblivion_RESP2: Just leave me alone -- go away!
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GREETING_00081da7_Oblivion_RESP2: Just leave me alone -- go away!
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_HELLO_0004735a_Oblivion_RESP1: Just leave us alone. We have enough troubles here in the Savage Garden without you adding to them.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_ArenaChoice2A_0000c1b7_Oblivion_R: Just let me know when you're ready for a match and we can get this over with.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_INFOGENERAL_0006052c_Oblivion_RES: Just like Sheogorath to abandon us in our time of need. He has been ever fickle.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_BrumaTopic_0003c98d_Oblivion_RESP: Just like Skyrim, except for all the tight-ass Heartlanders around. All work and chapel... no wonder they're so sour.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_MS29InvGet_0001d044_Oblivion_RESP: Just like a baker not revealing his best recipes, I must keep my sources anonymous or every merchant in town would use them.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_CheydinhalTopic_0004e8ad_Oblivion: Just look around. Is not Cheydinhal the model of civic rule? No... don't bow! I am just a humble servant of the people.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_Announcer_00046663_Oblivion_RESP1: Just look at the Yellow Team's Dark Elf! You can see the murder in his eyes! Can the Blue Team's Bloodletter even hope to survive? Let's find out!
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GOODBYE_00038f14_Oblivion_RESP1: Just look for me if you need anything else.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GOODBYE_00132aa0_Oblivion_RESP1: Just look for me if you need anything else.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_SE02RelmynaVisit_0001a127_Oblivio: Just looking at you reminds me of... Him. Why has He forsaken us?
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GREETING_00037ff6_Oblivion_RESP5: Just make sure you understand our rules of competition for this match. Fighting the Grand Champion, well... The rules are a bit different.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GREETING_00037ff7_Oblivion_RESP4: Just make sure you understand our rules of competition for this match. Fighting the Grand Champion, well... The rules are a bit different.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GREETING_00081b6a_Oblivion_RESP1: Just one more time. At least. He's a sport.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GREETING_0001da54_Oblivion_RESP1: Just out for a brisk walk. Helps clear the head. Any other information I can help with?
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_Dark03FinChoice1A_00023e54_Oblivi: Just outside the Imperial Prison is a grating that leads to the sewers. It has recently been tightly locked, but I will provide a key.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_Recommendation_000175b0_Oblivion_: Just perform the task you've been given. We'll talk more once you're done.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_Gang_0003d4a7_Oblivion_RESP6: Just please, help me get that ring back. I want to save what's left of my marriage.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GREETING_000206ad_Oblivion_RESP2: Just remember it was I that assisted you. I expect that will carry some favor under your rule.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_SE07Ritual_0007893f_Oblivion_RESP: Just remember not to deviate from the Ritual's guidelines. One would hope you can do that.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GOODBYE_0006fdca_Oblivion_RESP1: Just remember, my sword's here if you need it. You run into any trouble, just holler.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GOODBYE_00068343_Oblivion_RESP1: Just remember, we're in this together. You must learn to rely on me as I rely on you. But I've rambled on long enough. Akatosh be with you.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GOODBYE_000980d2_Oblivion_RESP1: Just speak to Tolgan... you'll see.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_BarterExit_000981ba_Oblivion_RESP: Just take your trinkets and go!
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_JoinUs_0003d4a5_Oblivion_RESP1: Just to be perfectly clear, we're not prostitutes. We do everything on our own terms, and the men never, ever lay one hand on us.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_TG06Rescue_00014739_Oblivion_RESP: Just unlock the door. A couple of hours after you're gone, it will be quiet again and I can sneak out.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_JskarTopic_000c47d1_Oblivion_RESP: Just wait. He'll be here shortly.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_BarterExit_0003d08a_Oblivion_RESP: Just walk away like you don't know me.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_SE35HereYouGo_00078674_Oblivion_R: Just what are you trying to pull?
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_INFOGENERAL_0004351f_Oblivion_RES: Just when I look forward to company, they activate the Resonator. Tall-Trees-Falling is so alone.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_INFOGENERAL_0006051a_Oblivion_RES: Just when I thought I was making some progress, I hear that Sheogorath himself has gone missing. Is this the end?
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GOODBYE_0006c67b_Oblivion_RESP1: Just... just leave me alone, all right? I don't want no trouble!
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_BlackBrugo03_0006fde1_Oblivion_RE: Justice has been done. And henceforth, Mazoga and you shall be known as Knights of the White Stallion.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_BlackBrugo03_000908dd_Oblivion_RE: Justice has been done. And henceforth, you shall be known as Knight of the White Stallion.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_UlrichLelandTopic_0003c37d_Oblivi: Justice has been done. Go tell Garrus what's transpired here. I await my fate.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_Dark02Choice1A_00023f36_Oblivion_: Justice? Hahahahaha! I been avoidin' that all my life, mate! Let me show you how!
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_SE12TraitorTaunts_0008f7c4_Oblivi: Jyggalag is coming. He cannot be stopped. He will rule this land, and all our delusions will be stripped away.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_SE12TraitorTaunts_0008f7ce_Oblivi: Jyggalag is coming. He cannot be stopped. He will rule this land, and all our delusions will be stripped away.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_INFOGENERAL_000607f4_Oblivion_RES: Jyggalag is gone, but I bet he brought a ton of diseases with him. We still aren't safe.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_Attack_0008f589_Oblivion_RESP1: Jyggalag will reward me well for your death!
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_INFOGENERAL_00060918_Oblivion_RES: Jyggalag's defeated. Took them long enough to get rid of him.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_INFOGENERAL_00060887_Oblivion_RES: Jyggalag's forces have been defeated. Perhaps Order is simply an inferior element.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_SE12FontofMadness_00017272_Oblivi: Jyggalag's minions must have introduced Order into the very wellspring of Madness. You must cleanse the Pools, or Order has won the war.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_INFOGENERAL_0006266c_Oblivion_RES: Kalthar tried to ruin the Leyawiin guild. Just goes to show you can't trust a Necromancer, even if he claims to be "reformed."
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_SeersStone_0001e06a_Oblivion_RESP: Kalthar was talking about it recently. He seemed very agitated about it. Almost... happy. Strange, isn't that?
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GREETING_000475b3_Oblivion_RESP1: Kantav Cheynoslin. I am the Primate of Leywiin, and Zenithar's Advocate.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_ImperialCityTopic_000488ec_Oblivi: Kastav says he works. Ha! Flies land on him, he's too lazy to brush them off. I'm sick of taking abuse for him, even if he is my brother.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GREETING_000476aa_Oblivion_RESP1: Kastus Sintav. Uncle Iniel got us good jobs gardening. We're very grateful.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GREETING_0018a960_Oblivion_RESP1: Kayleen's grave is outside if you wish to pay your respects.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GOODBYE_00070405_Oblivion_RESP1: Keep an eye out for my things, won't you?
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GOODBYE_00072f11_Oblivion_RESP1: Keep an eye out for them.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_INFOGENERAL_0008db8b_Oblivion_RES: Keep far from the Grummite with skin a greenish-jet. If your paths should accidentally cross, don't ever get it wet.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_SECreatureResponses_0008e130_Obli: Keep far from the Grummite with skin a greenish-jet. If your paths should accidentally cross, don't ever get it wet.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_SE05Conspiracy_000895e4_Oblivion_: Keep in mind that Anya is cowardly, and may require persuasion to tell you what she knows.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_TG03SearchForArmand_0003362d_Obli: Keep looking boys. Armand Christophe has to be here somewhere.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GOODBYE_0018d926_Oblivion_RESP1: Keep looking for that wine! Farewell!
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GREETING_0001da55_Oblivion_RESP1: Keep me informed. I'm very interested to hear where he is hiding.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_HELLO_00027326_Oblivion_RESP1: Keep quiet, and stay out of the way.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GOODBYE_0008da95_Oblivion_RESP1: Keep to it, I have faith in you.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GOODBYE_00038f24_Oblivion_RESP1: Keep up the... ummm... good work, I suppose.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_MQWhatNext_0002711f_Oblivion_RESP: Keep working on obtaining the items Martin needs for the ritual.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_INFOGENERAL_00046644_Oblivion_RES: Keep your eyes on City-Swimmer. I don't know where she goes when she's not in the canals.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_Pickpocket_00062275_Oblivion_RESP: Keep your fingers to yourself, thief!
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_SE30ForgeHelmetMagic_0001f3e3_Obl: Keep your hair from getting tangled in melee.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GOODBYE_0018d7e0_Oblivion_RESP1: Keep your heart true... and your eyes open.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GREETING_0004e8b6_Oblivion_RESP1: Keld of the Isles. Guardian of the Fighters Guild. And how did I achieve that high rank, you ask?
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_HELLO_00062cd4_Oblivion_RESP1: Khajiit has no words for you.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GREETING_000176c4_Oblivion_RESP4: Kid, you've got more guts. And skill. I think you can take the Gray Prince! Go over and talk to Ysabel if you think I'm right!
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GREETING_00027e38_Oblivion_RESP5: Kill Mankar Camoran, and you will unmake his Paradise.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_Dark08FinChoice2A_00032be9_Oblivi: Kill Phillida in any way, Rose or not, and the contract is complete. But to receive a bonus, you must go beyond murder. You must send a message!
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_Dark08FinChoice2B_00032bea_Oblivi: Kill Phillida in any way, Rose or not, and the contract is complete. But to receive a bonus, you must go beyond murder. You must send a message!
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_Dark08FinChoice2C_00032beb_Oblivi: Kill Phillida in any way, Rose or not, and the contract is complete. But to receive a bonus, you must go beyond murder. You must send a message!
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_Attack_00073005_Oblivion_RESP1: Kill every last one of them!
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_Dark11Choice3A_00002dd5_Oblivion_: Kill me? What is this? Who are you? I don't know who sent you, but you won't take me down without a fight! So go ahead, make your move!
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GREETING_000192e6_Oblivion_RESP1: Kill the Aureals. Don't stop until every last one of them is dead.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_DAMephalaSpeech_000579d9_Oblivion: Kill the leaders of the two families. Plant evidence to implicate the other family as the killer.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_SE06PriestsOrderTopic_000910f7_Ob: Kill them when you see them. But don't touch the corpse until they're really dead. Which they aren't, until you deactivate the obelisk.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_MG13hunterChoiceHow_00033f57_Obli: Kill them, run them out of town - do what you will. I simply want them gone.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_SQ03Continue_00189d08_Oblivion_RE: Kill those things. Every last one of them! They destroyed everything I hold dear!
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GREETING_00072dab_Oblivion_RESP2: Kill! Kill the cat! Good dog.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_ShrineofSheogorathTOPIC_00026adf_: Killed and ate a Bosmer there. But it made me sick. Saw Lord Sheogorath in the vomitus, so that's all right. Here to sacrifice? A limb would be nice.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_MelusPetiliusTOPIC_00026b47_Obliv: Killed off hordes of goblins when they attacked the town. Killed off a nest of minotaurs singlehandedly. That's all in the past now, though.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_SE46DoublesTopic_00081ed4_Oblivio: Killed the other one, huh? You're annoying, but you do good work.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_INFOGENERAL_00146009_Oblivion_RES: Killing their chief should weaken the Black Bow Bandits, but they're still going to be a menace to travelers.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_MatildePetitTopic_0002872a_Oblivi: Kind of stuck-up, that one. Right before you got here I told the funniest joke about an Argonian maid, and she didn't even crack a smile.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GREETING_00091885_Oblivion_RESP1: Kithlan seems eager to help you. When you become sovereign of Dementia, I'd keep him around.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_SE13JyggalagVoice_00096045_Oblivi: Kneel before the might of Jyggalag!
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_SEMiscQuestResponses_00082619_Obl: Knick-knacks and bric-a-brac, once you go you're sure to go back.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_SE11KnifePointHollow_00016efc_Obl: Knifepoint Hollow is my prison. As the Great Library, it once contained all the knowledge in creation.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_SE11KnifePointHollow_000807ab_Obl: Knifepoint Hollow is my prison. Hewn from the stone by Sheogorath for the sole purpose of containing my knowledge.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_SE11KnifePointHollow_00014b5f_Obl: Knifepoint Hollow is near the core of the Shivering Isles.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_INFOGENERAL_00077d04_Oblivion_RES: Knights of Order have appeared in the Isles. I hear they come from the obelisks.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_INFOGENERAL_00077d05_Oblivion_RES: Knights of Order have come to destroy the Realm!
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_INFOGENERAL_0005ef70_Oblivion_RES: Knights of Order? These aren't the valiant knights from the epic tales!
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_ND10LaunchAttackYes_00002c36_Knig: Knights of the Nine! Umaril and his Aurorans must be destroyed!
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_NDKnightsStartCombat_00002b4b_Kni: Knights of the Nine, follow me!
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_ND10SirThedretSpeech01_00002c97_K: Knights of the Nine, hear me! Today we have witnessed undeniable proof of the strength and the might of the gods we serve!
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_INFOGENERAL_0014600a_Oblivion_RES: Knights-Errant? That's just a poor knight without a castle. But I hear they got a nice lodge right on the banks of the Niben.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_INFOGENERAL_0006053b_Oblivion_RES: Knock, knock. Who's there? Not Sheogorath.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_NDSirBerichTopic_00002c7d_Knights: Know that I was the one who drew weapon first against Sir Berich. He merely defended himself, and proved the better swordsman.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_RufioTopic_000272ac_Oblivion_RESP: Know that Rufio is old and weak, and sleeps his days away. You could kill him before he even has a chance to wake. If you so choose.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_MG17GoOn_000366ed_Oblivion_RESP4: Know that you have my complete confidence. I would not entrust this job to you if I did not feel you were prepared for it. Now, go.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GREETING_0002241c_Oblivion_RESP2: Know this -- if you truly wish to become a Champion, you'll have to go through me. If we meet in that Arena, I will make you beg for death.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_CovenantTopic_000272af_Oblivion_R: Know this. Every Dark Brother and Sister is a child of Sithis. He whom we call Sithis has many other names. Chaos. Doom. Discord. Sithis is the Void.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_MGExpelYes_00026d8d_Oblivion_RESP: Know this: there will be no further leniency. Any more violations, and you will be permanently expelled from the guild.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_MGExpelYes_00026d8e_Oblivion_RESP: Know this: there will be no further leniency. Any more violations, and you will be permanently expelled from the guild.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_NelsTheNaughtyTopic_00028c37_Obli: Know what I think? I think that barbarian will do anything to get his hands on the chest of gold. His kind are greedy and vicious, all of them.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_contract_0000bcb6_Oblivion_RESP1: Know what I'd do? Talk to Faelian, learn who he is. Maybe then you can lead him to a secluded place. Then, when you're alone... you know! He he he!
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GREETING_0008fa8c_Oblivion_RESP1: Know what's funny about having a double? Nothing!
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_MGExpelYes_0002502d_Oblivion_RESP: Know, however, that you have only one more such chance available to you. The guild does not take these infractions lightly.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_MGExpelYes_0002502e_Oblivion_RESP: Know, however, that you have only one more such chance available to you. The guild does not take these infractions lightly.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_LeyawiinNQDResponses_0003dfcd_Obl: Knowing how to use heavy armor isn't a bad idea. Kind of odd to learn it from a Bosmer, though.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_BravilNQDResponses_00046649_Obliv: Knowing how to use your armor can save your life. Perhaps I should talk to her.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_DAAzuraSpeech_0002c6c3_Oblivion_R: Knowing their fate, they sealed themselves up in the vampire's lair. Their suffering weighs heavily on me.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_Training_000389a2_Oblivion_RESP1: Knowledge is the key to success in any endeavor.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_KudEiTopic_0003ca91_Oblivion_RESP: Kud-Ei has always watched over me, and it's good to know she cared enough to seek help when I was in trouble.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_KudEiTopic_00027f35_Oblivion_RESP: Kud-Ei is a member of Bravil's Mages Guild. She put the word out that a good friend of hers went missing.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_INFOGENERAL_000465e5_Oblivion_RES: Kud-Ei is very protective of her sisters in the Mages Guild. And she's quite skilled at creating illusions.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_INFOGENERAL_00062673_Oblivion_RES: Kud-Ei runs a tight ship in Bruma. She may not always play by the rules, but I wouldn't want her on my bad side.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_INFOGENERAL_0003cd26_Oblivion_RES: Kud-Ei seems to be in good spirits again after Henantier's return. I heard she enlisted a stranger's help in the search. Good show I say!
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_INFOGENERAL_0004f223_Oblivion_RES: Kud-Ei seems upset about something lately. I'd stay away from the Mages Guild if I were you.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_INFOGENERAL_00062672_Oblivion_RES: Kud-Ei will do anything to help her girls out. She recently got Ardaline out of a bind, and I hear it wasn't completely within guild rules.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_MagesGuildTopic_0006260c_Oblivion: Kud-Ei would be the one to talk to, if you wish to join. Otherwise, just find one of the other local guild heads.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GREETING_000488d3_Oblivion_RESP1: Kud-Ei. I'm in charge here, and an Advanced Trainer in Illusion to boot, so I don't have a lot of time to stand around and chat.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_MS08Hunt_0001fdbb_Oblivion_RESP1: Kurdan doesn't make most of his money being a simple usurer. He also invented what he calls the Hunter's Run.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GOODBYE_00022a10_Oblivion_RESP1: Kurdan is treacherous... be wary, friend.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_HELLO_0018ad63_Oblivion_RESP1: Kvatch is finished. There's nothing left.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GREETING_00014d5b_Oblivion_RESP1: Kvatch was rebuilt from ruins once before and she'll do it again. You have my thanks.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_INFOGENERAL_0018bab0_Oblivion_RES: Kvatch? Kvatch was just the beginning! Those damned Gates have opened up everywhere! Cheydinhal, Chorrol, Leyawiin -- no city is safe.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_KvatchTopic_00028554_Oblivion_RES: Kvatch? You've seen it. Kvatch doesn't exist any more.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_INFOGENERAL_000029fd_Knights_RESP: Kynareth bestowed the Boots of the Crusader on a worthy knight. Good to hear that someone is taking up the cause again.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_NDBootsoftheCrusader_00002a4b_Kni: Kynareth's creations guard her relic, and you must pass the test before you may be granted the boots.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_NDTombSpeech_00002d08_Knights_RES: Kyraneth grants you the swiftness of the wild.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_HELLO_000514b1_Oblivion_RESP1: La la la, la la la la...
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_contract_0006145e_Oblivion_RESP1: Lachance gave me a special assignment once. Had to go all the way to Sumerset Isle for that one, killed me about thirty Elves. Ah, good times....
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_contract_0006145c_Oblivion_RESP1: Lachance has given you a... a secret assignment? But I've been asking for this chance for so long.... Surely he doesn't doubt my abilities!
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_contract_0006145a_Oblivion_RESP1: Lachance would not have selected you for a contract unless he had the utmost confidence in your abilities. Best not let him down.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_TG04AlessiasRing_0003b3fa_Oblivio: Lady Alessia frowns on her staff talking about her personal life. You understand, I'm sure.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_LeyawiinTopic_00047769_Oblivion_R: Lady Alessia is uncomfortable with Khajiit ways. And Argonian ways. And Dunmer ways. She is only comfortable with pure white-bread Nibeneans.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_ArenaAgronakChoice2_00038b48_Obli: Lady Lovidicus was a shrew of a woman. The Lord and my mother grew close, and ultimately fell in love. I was the result of their union.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_ArenaChampName9f_00038b43_Oblivio: Lady Luck, huh? I like it! Yeah, that'll do nicely. All right, it's time to see if you're crazy good or just plain crazy.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GREETING_0003c996_Oblivion_RESP1: Lady Narina Carvain, Countess Bruma. Welcome. You'll excuse me if I keep this brief, but affairs of the county await me.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_SE05Conspiracy_00089610_Oblivion_: Lady Syl will be quite pleased to hear that her concerns have been proven valid. You shouldn't keep her waiting.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_SE05Interrogate1_00013a5b_Oblivio: Lady Syl, you mean. And you know I have her full authority to do what is necessary. Your innocence must be proven.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_INFOGENERAL_00064455_Oblivion_RES: Lady Umbranox has hired a new Captain of the guard.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GottlesfontPrioryTopic_000ace83_O: Lady's Mantle Leaves are helpful in healing wounds, whether applied directly or compounded in potions. We have plenty. Help yourself.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GREETING_0003e088_Oblivion_RESP1: Langley, captain of the Anvil guard.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_TG05BribeBeggar_00015f28_Oblivion: Last I heard he was in the slums by the north end of the docks, overseeing the operation.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_TrainingQuestTopic_000613a4_Obliv: Last I heard, she'd set up camp in the mountains, somewhere in the northeast corner of the province. You should look for her there.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_ThoronirTopic_0001d03d_Oblivion_R: Last but not least, he's officially joined the Society.  I am taken aback by his honest intentions.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_HELLO_0007e961_Oblivion_RESP1: Last chamber... this should be entertaining.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_Question_0003407a_Oblivion_RESP1: Last night I... I heard screaming coming from the Abandoned House! Do you think it's haunted, like they say?
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GREETING_00017967_Oblivion_RESP2: Last night, as dusk fell, the spire at the center of town became active. Soon after, the area around it began to crystallize and change.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_LorgrenLichSpeech_0006e7f7_Oblivi: Last time I clashed with mortals, I underestimated their power. I shall not repeat that mistake twice.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_TrainingQuestTopic_0018b191_Obliv: Last time I saw Alawen, she was out in the forest east of Anvil, and south of Kvatch. If you look carefully, you might find her there.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_KvatchTopic_000039d4_Oblivion_RES: Late at night, while we were all asleep, a door to Oblivion opened.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_MQFollow_00026ef1_Oblivion_RESP1: Lead on. I hope we're almost there.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GREETING_0002e71f_Oblivion_RESP1: Lead on... to victory for the Knights of the Thorn! Oh, and you too of course.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GREETING_0007944b_Oblivion_RESP1: Lead the way. I'm right behind you.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_MG18Choice1A_00016482_Oblivion_RE: Lead your fellow mages, and lead them well. The future rests on your shoulders. Farewell, my friend.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_AnvilNQDResponses_0003c200_Oblivi: Learning a bit about alchemy would be handy, but you have to be in the Mages Guild for Felen to train you.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_DAMephalaChoice1_00026b6a_Oblivio: Leave Mephala an offering of nightshade at the shrine between midnight and dawn, and the Webspinner may grant you an audience.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_ShrineofMeridiaTOPIC_0001ebfc_Obl: Leave an offering at this shrine. Meridia demands tribute in the form of the remains of her enemies, the undead.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_DAHircineChoice1_0001ec5f_Oblivio: Leave an offering of the pelt of a bear, or the pelt of a wolf at the shrine, and Hircine may find you worthy.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_DAAzuraChoice1_0001ebe4_Oblivion_: Leave her an offering of glow dust, and perhaps she will deign to speak with you.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_SE05SylExcuseMe_0007fe1f_Oblivion: Leave here at once. You've no business being here!
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GREETING_00000927_Oblivion_RESP1: Leave me alone!  I can't talk right now!
