ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GREETING_00032469_Oblivion_RESP3: Listen. You know the Nine? How They guide our fates with an invisible hand?
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GREETING_0008675b_Oblivion_RESP1: Listener! I am a new initiate to the Dark Brotherhood, just a lowly Murderer, but if there's any way I can serve you, any way at all, I am yours!
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GREETING_0003d494_Oblivion_RESP1: Little busy right now. Got your mess to clean up.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GREETING_0003e08e_Oblivion_RESP1: Llensi Llaram. Fighters Guild, through and through.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_UlrichLelandTopic_0003c2a7_Oblivi: Llevana has always been quick tempered. You must reconsider her plan. It can only lead to prison for her... and for you.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GREETING_00028b82_Oblivion_RESP1: Locked inside a house with five strangers. It sounded like  a trap when I read the invitation. Looks like I was right!
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_MundaneAmulet_00038b02_Oblivion_R: Long ago I made a promise to Bradon. I promised to never reveal to anyone what I'm about to reveal to you now.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_TrainingQuestTopic_0018bc36_Obliv: Long ago, I learned much of what I know from a man named Pranal. An excellent teacher, he was. You should consider learning from him.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_Sithis_000251ed_Oblivion_RESP1: Long ago, in an age now forgotten, Sithis came to the Night Mother and begat her five sons. So you see, his love gave birth to the Dark Brotherhood.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_SEThadonWaitingShort_000131db_Obl: Long, short -- it all ends up the same. Dust and tears. Usually tears first, then the dust. Dust can't cry, you see. That would be... well, amusing.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_ImperialCityTopic_00047705_Oblivi: Look around. Count the true believers. How many of these people really have faith? It's easy to have faith when everything's fine.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_MQ03MartinB2_00082dca_Oblivion_RE: Look around. What good is a priest?
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_SE02RelmynaVisit_0001a125_Oblivio: Look at all the bones around you! You have been a busy little boy, haven't you?
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_HELLO_0018bc96_Oblivion_RESP1: Look at the muscles on you!
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GREETING_00089628_Oblivion_RESP1: Look at this. I got it from a dead bug. A really big one! This oozed out of his body -- here take it!
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_INFOGENERAL_0006094e_Oblivion_RES: Look at you wag your tail! You're happy Jyggalag is gone too, aren't you? Yes you are! Yes you are!
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_HELLO_00072dff_Oblivion_RESP1: Look at you! Still alive! For now.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GREETING_0001765b_Oblivion_RESP1: Look at you! You keep coming back for more! All right, Warrior, you ready for a match?
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_SE04SheoWhatNow_00044f53_Oblivion: Look at you. No concept of what you've stumbled into. No sense of place. You don't even really know where you are, do you?
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_SE38TalkItemA_00081eb6_Oblivion_R: Look closely and you'll see a tiny skull. These pygmys used to live in the Shivering Isles until they were all eaten by Grummites, poor dears!
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_TrainingQuestTopic_00062331_Obliv: Look for Andragil. You can find her living in Bravil.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_TrainingQuestTopic_0006143a_Obliv: Look for Irene Metrick in the Imperial City. She can do some amazing things with a weapon in her hand.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_ThoronirTopic_0001d040_Oblivion_R: Look for something in his possession that can be linked to his crimes, and we will have him.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_SE01Choice1_000133d9_Oblivion_RES: Look for yourself! Their brains are addled. Got no sense! Perfectly normal people went in there. And this is what's come out.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_TG06BribeBeggar2_00084478_Oblivio: Look in the Lonely Suitor Lodge.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GREETING_00035f42_Oblivion_RESP5: Look into it for me, will you? You can find Skaleel at the site. Access is restricted, so you'll need this key.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_Accuse_00035660_Oblivion_RESP1: Look me in the eye when you answer this. You dare accuse me?
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_TGFences_0001eb68_Oblivion_RESP1: Look no further. I'll buy your hot goods.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_MQ15MankarRant_0008c21d_Oblivion_: Look now upon my Paradise. Gaiar Alata, in the old tongue. A vision of the past... and the future.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_SE13ObeliskCShout_0001acaf_Oblivi: Look out! The northern Obelisk has been reactivated!
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_ND05FortBulwarkTopic_00002aeb_Kni: Look to the southeast of Cyrodiil to find it. I cannot say for certain what is inside, but be prepared for anything.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_NDProphetSpeechMain_00002a67_Knig: Look well upon the Chapel of Dibella. Look at the faces of the dead. This is your future. Evil has returned, and the Nine need a champion!
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_HELLO_000029d7_Knights_RESP1: Look well upon the faces of the dead in the Chapel! This is only the start of Umaril's revenge upon the gods!
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GREETING_00078fd7_Oblivion_RESP1: Look what has been done to Passwall. This is what Order brings. I gladly bend my knee to Sheogorath.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GREETING_00000856_Oblivion_RESP1: Look what you've done! Spoiled my invisibility! This is my reward for trying to help the wretched villagers?
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_NDProphetSpeechLoremasters_00002d: Look you to blood for truth? There is truth in blood, but it is not the truth that you seek!
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_SE03GrommokChamberTwoStartD_00067: Look! Haha! I told you! Treasure! Let's have at it, Syndelius.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_SE03SyndelChamberTwoManEnd01_0007: Look! Keys! One of them must open the gate! We're rich!
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_SE13AllyShoutReinforcements_0004d: Look! More Aureals join the battle! Now we shall drive them back!
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_MS23FollowSeridurNo_000947b8_Obli: Look, I assure you, this is of the utmost importance. Together, we may be able to save the lives of many innocents. I implore you to follow.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_MagesStaff_0002c0cb_Oblivion_RESP: Look, I can't just give it to you. I paid good money for it, after all.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_advancementFG_0003355d_Oblivion_R: Look, I can't promote you. Not now. You'll need to get some contracts completed, and then I can do it.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_NevilleTopic_000286fd_Oblivion_RE: Look, I don't know what kind of information you're after, but I won't help you. Just go away.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_NelsTheNaughtyTopic_00028243_Obli: Look, I don't know who is responsible for this madness, so stop trying to taint my opinion of Nels.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_JskarTopic_0002d58a_Oblivion_RESP: Look, I don't know you very well. Why would I help you?
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_FGD04Choice1_0002ee6c_Oblivion_RE: Look, I know that you covered for me before, so I'll give you this one. Talk to Aryarie at the Mages Guild for the job. After this, we're done.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_MS09YourAmulet_0005377c_Oblivion_: Look, I know you could just kill me where I stand, but what if I gave you the amulet and you bring it to him. Then he'd say where the gold's stashed.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_JskarTopic_0002d58b_Oblivion_RESP: Look, I like you and all, but I really don't want to get in the middle of this.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_InfoRefusal_0002459a_Oblivion_RES: Look, I like you, but not enough to tell you that.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GREETING_0008b07b_Oblivion_RESP1: Look, I told you everything you need to know. Go to the cave, kill the ogres, get a reward. How hard is that?
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GREETING_00061c39_Oblivion_RESP1: Look, I'll find someone else to help me. Leave me alone.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_Dark17Choice3C_00054035_Oblivion_: Look, I've got things to do, and I don't need crazies like you getting in my way. Take a walk.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GREETING_000541d2_Oblivion_RESP1: Look, I... I got nothing else to say to you. Just leave me be!
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_BedYes_00037cfe_Oblivion_RESP1: Look, friend, I'm not running a flophouse here. No gold, no room. No exceptions.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_DinnerParty_0001c24e_Oblivion_RES: Look, it's a fancy party. You seem a fine enough sort, but not so nice as I'm going to just let you in there. At least not dressed like that.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GREETING_00033790_Oblivion_RESP1: Look, j-just stop right there, all right?
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_DAClavicusSpeech_000243ac_Oblivio: Look, keep the sword if you want. That's your decision. But don't give it back to Clavicus. He doesn't know what's good for him sometimes.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_Seen_0001a7e7_Oblivion_RESP1: Look, one more of the Madgod's deluded followers.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_MS11ErlineOpinion_00038444_Oblivi: Look, there isn't much more to say. Please... help me clear my husband's name.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_MS12DontCare_000980f8_Oblivion_RE: Look, there's no need to be rude. I just thought it might have been interesting to you.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_RulesOfCompetition_0003d7b4_Obliv: Look, these aren't your average Arena matches. They're shows! You fighting some savage beasts! People come to see you kill things. It's simple.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_MS09TyrelliusTalk_000908eb_Oblivi: Look, you horse's ass. I've never trusted city guardsmen. Never. So I'm definitely not going to start trusting you, Tyrellius.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_SE08SheldenGreeting3_00018e6e_Obl: Look, you may be a scamp's ass, but I'm offering you the chance to be the hero of Passwall.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_TGThievesGuildJobs_000165e5_Obliv: Look, you're on your own as a thief. Go find a likely looking house. Case the joint to see when the owner is gone.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_CheydinhalTopic_0004e8ca_Oblivion: Look. A fly. Buzz, buzz. Hey. Look everybody! I'm talking to a fly! Buzz, buzz, buzz!
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GREETING_00042ff8_Oblivion_RESP1: Look. I don't know you. I don't really want to know you. If you insist on talking to me, go right ahead. But I won't promise to be nice.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_INFOGENERAL_00043eeb_Oblivion_RES: Look. I don't like you. Why are you bothering me? Maybe I'll ask Syl to round you up for questioning. Would you like that? Go away.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GREETING_000237b1_Oblivion_RESP1: Look. I don't want to talk. So leave me alone.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_ImperialCityTopic_00047661_Oblivi: Look. It's big, see. REALLY big. Only way to learn it is to walk it. Look at everything, talk to everyone.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_MQ04WeynonAttack_0001ee28_Oblivio: Looked around the corner to see who it was. They looked like travellers, ordinary.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_RaminusTopic_0006a87a_Oblivion_RE: Looking for Raminus, are you? Well, you'll find him in the lobby of the Arch-Mage's Tower, in the center of the University.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_Barter_00062121_Oblivion_RESP1: Looking for a good book? I bet I have just what you need.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_HELLO_00033ddd_Oblivion_RESP1: Looking for action? Think about the Fighters Guild.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GREETING_00033dd2_Oblivion_RESP1: Looking for adventure? The Fighters Guild is a good place to start.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_INFOGENERAL_0004994e_Oblivion_RES: Looking for an axe or a mace? Head to Slash 'N Smash. The name says it all.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GREETING_000be5e7_Oblivion_RESP1: Looking for anything to purchase today?
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_contract_00035729_Oblivion_RESP1: Looking for more work, eh? Good. I've got a contract for you. I'd like you to go talk to Norbert Lelles, here in Anvil.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_contract_00071e96_Oblivion_RESP1: Looking for more work, eh? Good. I've got a contract for you. I'd like you to go talk to Norbert Lelles, here in Anvil.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_HELLO_000b166c_Oblivion_RESP1: Looking for other jobs? Don't look at me.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_Barter_000091c3_Oblivion_RESP1: Looking for some reading material? You've come to the right place.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_TG07DairihillOffice_00098398_Obli: Looking for the steward, are you? Her office is in the private chambers. But she's not there much.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_Barter_000091ce_Oblivion_RESP1: Looking to buy a horse? I have some fine animals for sale.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_Barter_00038994_Oblivion_RESP1: Looking to lighten your load, but fill up your coin purse?
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_HELLO_00070404_Oblivion_RESP1: Looking, looking. Always looking, I am.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_CharGenVoice_0000bf0d_Oblivion_RE: Looks clear. Come on. We're almost through to the sewers.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_advancementFG_00033565_Oblivion_R: Looks like it is time for a promotion. Due to your performance, I name you Journeyman of the Fighters Guild.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_HELLO_000029c8_Knights_RESP1: Looks like it opens up into a huge room up ahead.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_CharGenVoice_00032b13_Oblivion_RE: Looks like this is your lucky day. Just stay out of our way.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_goblins_00027f84_Oblivion_RESP1: Looks like we got them all. Good work, soldier. The miners will be able to get back to work. You should head back to Burz and find another contract.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_Steal_000624f7_Oblivion_RESP1: Looks like we've got a thief in our midst!
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GREETING_000281b9_Oblivion_RESP1: Looks like you are in some trouble. Since we are friends, don't worry. I'll look the other way and take care of that fine for you.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_jobs_0002c7a5_Oblivion_RESP1: Looks like you found work for us. Good. Need some money.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_HELLO_0018bcb9_Oblivion_RESP1: Looks like you're handy with a blade.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_ReadyForAMatch_0002c35b_Oblivion_: Looks like you've reached your peak. Tell you what, from here on in, you can fight one, two or three Minotaur Lords. So what's it going to be?
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_SE46DoublesTopic_0008fa70_Oblivio: Looks like you've taken care of it. Good work. Now, go find something else to do.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_jointheMagesGuild_0002d062_Oblivi: Looks to me like you're in trouble with the law. Clear that matter up, and then perhaps we'll discuss the guild.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_Dark02FinChoice1A_00023e48_Oblivi: Loosen those fastenings any night between 8:00pm and 11:00pm, and the head will surely fall on Baenlin as he relaxes in his chair, as is his custom.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_NDTombSpeech_00002d03_Knights_RES: Lord Akatosh lends you his might. When your own strength fails you, trust in the Nine.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GREETING_0000290d_Knights_RESP1: Lord Crusader! How can this be? You... you're alive! It's a miracle! I heard voices in the undercroft and I came to investigate...
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GREETING_00002978_Knights_RESP1: Lord Crusader! The Prophet is here -- he's just arrived!
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_MQ15MankarRant_0008c22a_Oblivion_: Lord Dagon cannot invade Tamriel, his birthright! He comes to liberate the Occupied Lands!
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_Enemy_0002d77c_Oblivion_RESP1: Lord Dagon is the Enemy. He is the Prince of Destruction, and the Daedra are his servants.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_MQ15MankarSpeech_0008b0a3_Oblivio: Lord Dagon shall walk Tamriel again. The world shall be remade. The new age shall rise from the ashes of the old.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_MQ06RumaYes_00024e9b_Oblivion_RES: Lord Dagon thirsts for red-drink. Sate him.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_Hit_0008c21a_Oblivion_RESP1: Lord Dagon will walk Tamriel again!
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_Attack_00074a11_Oblivion_RESP1: Lord Dagon will walk the earth again!
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_Attack_0001eee3_Oblivion_RESP1: Lord Dagon will welcome your soul in Oblivion!
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_MysteriumXarxes_00097cc0_Oblivion: Lord Dagon wrote it with his own hand, and gave it to the Master as a sign of His favor. None but the Master may touch it or read from it.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_Hit_00074a09_Oblivion_RESP1: Lord Dagon's victory is at hand, fool.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_DAMalacathSpeech_000579cd_Oblivio: Lord Drad put my little brothers in chains, working in the mines. I don't like that.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_DAMalacathSpeech_000579d1_Oblivio: Lord Drad took my ogres. Poxy white-skin says he owns them. Lying maggot! They're MY ogres!
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_DAMalacathSpeech_000579cc_Oblivio: Lord Drad took my ogres. Says he owns them. Lying maggot! They're MY ogres!
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_Unicorn_0001ec61_Oblivion_RESP1: Lord Hircine has sent you to hunt the Unicorn? Count yourself doubly blessed.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_OgreSlaves_0001ec4f_Oblivion_RESP: Lord Malacath doesn't want the little brothers locked up, working like donkeys so men don't get their pretty pink hands all dirty. Makes Him mad.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_INFOGENERAL_00032e84_Oblivion_RES: Lord Rugdumph was going with the Blackwood Company, then thought better of it. We have to do something about them.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_SE11StaffOfSheogorath_00014b5e_Ob: Lord Sheogorath chose you to sit on His throne. With the Staff, you may be able to do just that.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GREETING_00091628_Oblivion_RESP2: Lord Sheogorath doesn't like to be kept waiting.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_SE08HaskillKnightsTopic3_00043f6a: Lord Sheogorath has never succeeded in doing so. They continue to grow in numbers until Jyggalag himself arrives.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_SE43GoAway_00072dc2_Oblivion_RESP: Lord Sheogorath wants me to leave? Okay, for you I will. I know a nice spot in Bliss where I can stay.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_SE10WellspringofAureal_00082634_O: Lord Sheogorath will, I'm sure, be quite interested to hear of your success. Return to Him once you've checked with the commander here.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_SE10WellspringofMazken_00082635_O: Lord Sheogorath will, I'm sure, be quite interested to hear of your success. Return to him once you've checked with the commander here.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_INFOGENERAL_000434f6_Oblivion_RES: Lord Sheogorath would do well to stop bothering with the Resonator, and just send everyone away.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GREETING_00081519_Oblivion_RESP1: Lord Sheogorath! Have you found any yet?
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_SE10MessengerGreeting_0008f4ea_Ob: Lord Sheogorath! I apologize for the intrusion, but you must help us! Order has attacked Brellach and routed us!
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_SE10MessengerGreeting_00095359_Ob: Lord Sheogorath! I apologize for the intrusion, but you must help us! Order has attacked Pinnacle Rock and routed us!
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GREETING_00081525_Oblivion_RESP1: Lord Sheogorath! I would love to put on a show for you some time.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_INFOGENERAL_0005f3df_Oblivion_RES: Lord Sheogorath's armies are back! Maybe they'll fix some of these buildings so they don't collapse on people.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_INFOGENERAL_0005f3e6_Oblivion_RES: Lord Sheogorath's mood seems improved now that he has an army at his back.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_Trespass_0007dfe3_Oblivion_RESP1: Lord Sheogorath, I believe You should leave this place.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GREETING_0008151f_Oblivion_RESP1: Lord Sheogorath, I trust you'll protect us from the impending apocalypse.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GREETING_0008d31f_Oblivion_RESP1: Lord Sheogorath, here in Deepwallow? May Scalon blood flow at your feet, Lord!
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_SE06GreatTorchTopic_000910a9_Obli: Lord Sheogorath, in His wisdom, wishes for you to relight the Torch, to help ease the worries of the populace.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GREETING_00081d74_Oblivion_RESP1: Lord Sheogorath, up off his throne and slumming it with us little folk, eh? Well, it's good to see you. What can I possibly do for you, My Lord?
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GREETING_00081dc9_Oblivion_RESP1: Lord Sheogorath, your presence alone makes me feel more healthy.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GREETING_00081522_Oblivion_RESP1: Lord Sheogorath. I'll bet your palace is always neat and tidy.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GREETING_0007a01b_Oblivion_RESP1: Lord Sheogorath. Your Aureal stand true.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GREETING_000807a8_Oblivion_RESP1: Lord Sheogorath... as I expected. I will hear you and then ask for peace from your prattle.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GREETING_00081d8a_Oblivion_RESP1: Lord! How may I serve You? Do You require a sharp blade to bleed your enemies?
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_Trespass_0007dfe7_Oblivion_RESP1: Lord, it is best You leave this place.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GREETING_00082570_Oblivion_RESP1: Lord, you know that Brellach is ours and ours alone. You may not enter.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GREETING_0008256e_Oblivion_RESP1: Lord, you know that Pinnacle Rock is ours and ours alone. You may not enter.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_ICAnnouncer_00048376_Oblivion_RES: Lords and ladies, citizens of the Empire, I give you the battle of the ages! Combatants, steel yourselves! Lower the gates!
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_LorgrenBenirus_00003a71_Oblivion_: Lorgren Benirus was a strange old man, always dabbling and experimenting with magic.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_Dark06Choice1A_0002fbb0_Oblivion_: Lorkmir ain't... he ain't around no more. He he he... I use his house. Here's a key! For... for you! You come whenever you... you want! Okay then...
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_INFOGENERAL_000498d6_Oblivion_RES: Lose the key to your house? Find Mandil. He can get in, I'll bet.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_ICAllNQDResponses_0004994c_Oblivi: Lots of big weapons there. Urbul always has some in stock.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_INFOGENERAL_000241db_Oblivion_RES: Lots of dogs in this town. Lots of sheep, too. Of course, I prefer the taste of sheep.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_goblins_00028882_Oblivion_RESP1: Lots of them dead, just like it should be.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_CheydinhalTopic_0004e8d3_Oblivion: Lots of us Dark Elves came to Cyrodiil to get away from the Temple. We're sick of living under the thumb of the priests, and scraping by on the dole.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_ImperialCityTopic_0004774b_Oblivi: Lots of us on the Waterfront are down. We can't do that dungeon stuff like you adventurers. We got no money, and no skills. Nobody wants us.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_NDProphetSpeechMain_00002a6c_Knig: Love and Mercy! Do you still think me mad? Who shall next fall to Umaril's bloody revenge?
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_TGFence03_000165ea_Oblivion_RESP1: Luciana lives in Bravil. She is a decent fence. Better than Ongar and Dar Jee at least.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_contract_00061459_Oblivion_RESP1: Lucien Lachance's word is law. Whatever contract he has given you must be carried out, without question.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_LucienLachanceTopic_000253d9_Obli: Lucien isn't here very often. His duties with the Black Hand keep him very busy, so he trusts me to keep the Sanctuary in order.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_RaynilDralasTopic_0003843c_Oblivi: Luckily for us, Raynil arrived in town. He said he was a vampire hunter, so we asked for his help.
Luckily, Bradon's wife wasn't home. Poor thing, she didn't even know her husband was infected.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_ChorrolNQDResponses_00029fcc_Obli: Luckily, I haven't had to make use of their services. Still, it's good to know the Chapel is there.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GOODBYE_00022a05_Oblivion_RESP1: Lucky I'm not makin' ya swim.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_INFOGENERAL_00032ea7_Oblivion_RES: Lum gro-Baroth in Chorrol can train me in shield work, right?
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GREETING_00053ff1_Oblivion_RESP1: Luronk and I have both testified against the Watch Captain, Hayn. Thank you for helping us find the courage to stand up for ourselves.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_MS26CorruptGuard_00035c98_Oblivio: Luronk and I were shopping at Jensine's when he accused us of stealing. Even Jensine said we were innocent, but he didn't care.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GREETING_00047690_Oblivion_RESP1: Luther Broad's Boarding House. I'm Luther. You want beds or food, see me.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_MS31Minx01Positive_00015259_Obliv: Lynch sent you up here? Why? Did he send you to talk to Selene?
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_BrumaTopic_0003c97f_Oblivion_RESP: Lyra Rosentia collects Akaviri artifacts. She might have a project in mind. Her house is west of the chapel.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_INFOGENERAL_000c47da_Oblivion_RES: M'aiq believes the children are our future. But he doesn't want them ruining all of our fun.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_INFOGENERAL_000c47e3_Oblivion_RES: M'aiq is glad he has a compass. Makes it easy to find things. Much better than wandering around like a fool.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GREETING_000c47ee_Oblivion_RESP1: M'aiq knows much, tells some. M'aiq knows many things others do not.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_INFOGENERAL_000c47d9_Oblivion_RES: M'aiq longs for a Colovian Fur Helm. Practical, yet stylish. M'aiq is very sad he does not have one.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_INFOGENERAL_000c47df_Oblivion_RES: M'aiq prefers to adventure alone. Others just get in the way. And they talk, talk, talk.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_INFOGENERAL_000c47dc_Oblivion_RES: M'aiq thinks his people are beautiful. The Argonian people are beautiful as well. They look better than ever before.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_INFOGENERAL_000c526e_Oblivion_RES: M'aiq wishes he had a stick made out of fishies to give to you. Sadly, he does not.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_SE08PlaceGuardsNo_00017d84_Oblivi: MAZKEN! Form up! For the sake of your sorry male hides, move! MOVE!
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_SE05PostTortureGreet_00089614_Obl: Ma'zaddha and Nelrene... They meet in the street during the night. No one knows what they talk about.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_SE05HerdirInvestigateWho_0008e513: Ma'zaddha has been most helpful! We'll have to see what he comes back with. In the meantime, you might consider speaking with Nelrene.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_SE05HerdirInvestigateWho_00083f49: Ma'zaddha is clearly withholding something. It would seem that direct pressure has no effect, so we'll have to try another route.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_SE05HerdirInvestigateCurrentTask_: Ma'zaddha is meeting Nelrene at night. How illicit!
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_SE05Conspiracy_000895e2_Oblivion_: Ma'zaddha is particularly reclusive, and may not respond well to questioning. Again, you may find Herdir's assistance necessary.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_SE05HerdirInvestigateCurrentTask_: Ma'zaddha is reluctant to speak to you, and I assume there's good reason. It would be worth finding another way to get him to talk.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_SE05Conspiracy_000895dd_Oblivion_: Ma'zaddha may have returned with more information by now.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_SE05HerdirInvestigateCurrentTask_: Ma'zaddha was able to provide some useful evidence, even if he did not survive to see it put to use. It's time to confront Nelrene again.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_INFOGENERAL_0003dfa8_Oblivion_RES: Mach-Na runs a good business. He's a grumpy old man, though.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GREETING_0008fa75_Oblivion_RESP1: Made up your mind yet? There's work to be done.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GREETING_00081d71_Oblivion_RESP1: Madgod! I've been collecting jokes for you. I have thousands for you to listen to. Did you hear the one about the Grummite and the Heretic?
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_Attack_0001a367_Oblivion_RESP1: Madness always yields to the march of Order!
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GREETING_0008ef2e_Oblivion_RESP1: Madness always yields to the march of Order!
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_Attack_0001a374_Oblivion_RESP1: Madness shall be purged from this realm!
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_INFOGENERAL_0003c1ae_Oblivion_RES: Maenlorn and his brother run a nice establishment at the Flowing Bowl.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_INFOGENERAL_000465f4_Oblivion_RES: Mages Guild members have said that Kud-Ei is an excellent teacher, as well as a very loyal guildmember.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_Recharge_00066a51_Oblivion_RESP1: Magic items are no good without a charge.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_HELLO_0006a849_Oblivion_RESP1: Magister! We must talk! Please... It's rather urgent.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_INFOGENERAL_00032e9b_Oblivion_RES: Maglir? He's the OTHER bottom boot, right? Not the rat guy?
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_MaglirTOPIC2_000366c4_Oblivion_RE: Maglir? I think I've seen him. Try in the Lonely Suitor Lodge.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_ShrineofClavicusVileTOPIC_000b97c: Make a bargain or do not. You must choose.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_SEPinnacleRockTopic_00043023_Obli: Make all possible haste in reaching Dylora. She will be able to better inform you as to what happened, and what is required to secure Pinnacle Rock.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_SEBrellachTopic_00043024_Oblivion: Make all possible haste in reaching Staada. She will be able to better inform you as to what happened, and what is required to secure Brellach.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_SE05HerdirInvestigateCurrentTask_: Make every effort to be present for this conversation. It may give us something to hold over Ma'zaddha and get him to talk.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_AldosOthranTopic_0003c2ab_Oblivio: Make haste! Find him quickly... no telling what mischief he may get himself into and we need him as a witness!
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GOODBYE_00053870_Oblivion_RESP1: Make haste! The Sanctuary must be Purified, if this treachery is to be undone!
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GOODBYE_0002c2fe_Oblivion_RESP1: Make haste. I wish to be rid of Earana as soon as possible.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GOODBYE_0005d8ef_Oblivion_RESP1: Make haste. Mucianus is in danger.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GREETING_0018baff_Oblivion_RESP1: Make it fast, dreg! What little patience I have is wearing thin....
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GREETING_00072c93_Oblivion_RESP1: Make it quick. I've work to do. I need five pod pits.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GOODBYE_000a31ba_Oblivion_RESP1: Make it quick. The longer we spend down here, the more chance we have of being discovered.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_TeekeeusTopic_0002acc1_Oblivion_R: Make no mention of the book to him. It's just the sort of thing he'd want to get his scaly little hands on.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GOODBYE_0004cfa9_Oblivion_RESP1: Make sure Varon hands over that staff.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_INFOGENERAL_000624cf_Oblivion_RES: Make sure not to eat nightshade. It's very poisonous.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_JeanneFrasoricTopic_00086749_Obli: Make sure she's all right, will you? It's not like her to avoid contact with the University for so long.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GOODBYE_0003358d_Oblivion_RESP1: Make sure you address the Count properly.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GOODBYE_0001e7e1_Oblivion_RESP1: Make sure you have proof before you accuse anyone of a terrible crime like grave robbing.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GOODBYE_0001e7d7_Oblivion_RESP1: Make sure you show that shovel to Thoronir. It is the final bit of proof we need to possibly clear his name.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GREETING_00040b9b_Oblivion_RESP1: Make this brief, I have a pot of Grummite Gumbo simmering on my fire at home.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_SE36Choice7NowWhat_00061c4f_Obliv: Make your move when you wish. But, please, do it soon.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_SE46DoublesTopic_0008fa91_Oblivio: Make yourself useful. Talk with Horkvir. The proper Horkvir. He runs this place.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_SE06GreatTorchTopic_000910a0_Obli: Makes all of my subjects uneasy. Tense. Homicidal. Some of them, at least. We need to get that Torch relit, before the place falls apart.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_ShrineofMalacathTOPIC_0001ec2e_Ob: Malacath likes Orcs... when He likes anything. So you can approach the shrine. He won't hurt you. Really. Go ahead.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GREETING_0001ebb7_Oblivion_RESP1: Malacath likes you. You don't look very foul or ugly... but just keep doing ugly stuff, and you'll be fine.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GREETING_00026967_Oblivion_RESP1: Malacath must think you're okay. Congratulations. You must be as ugly and disgusting as the rest of us.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_MS22KnowHighFane_0002af32_Oblivio: Malada? Really? I confess, I had never made the connection. But, yes... it makes sense...
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_SE30ForgeSword_000400b6_Oblivion_: Mama always said, "You can tell a lot about a man by the sword he carries."
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_INFOGENERAL_000434d2_Oblivion_RES: Mama always said, "You catch more flies with honey than salt." Like that thing that sucks in the adventurers.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_SE30ForgeAmberMaceMagic_0001f3eb_: Mama used to say, "If sweet-talking doesn't work, try hitting him with a big stick!"
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_ArenaChampName9_00038b3a_Oblivion: Man o' War, huh? I like it! Yeah, that'll do nicely. All right, it's time to see if you're crazy good or just plain crazy.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_INFOGENERAL_0005ec7a_Oblivion_RES: Mania has a new ruler! Perhaps Big Head will hear songs of good fortune as well.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_MysteriumXarxes_000221f6_Oblivion: Mankar Camoran bound himself to the Xarxes when he created his Paradise, using dark rituals which I will not speak of further.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_MythicDawnTopic_00024e6b_Oblivion: Mankar Camoran certainly is a fascinating writer. Undoubtedly insane, but fascinating.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_HELLO_00088b39_Oblivion_RESP1: Mankar Camoran has a lot to answer for. No wonder he never comes down to the Eternal Garden.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_MankarCamoranTopic_00015882_Obliv: Mankar Camoran lives in his palace, Carac Agaialor, which overlooks the Savage Garden from the top of the mountain.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_MQ15EldamilC1_0003fbde_Oblivion_R: Mankar Camoran was our leader, our teacher, our Master. He had the secret knowledge. He dealt with Mehrunes Dagon as an equal.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_MQ15Anaxes_0003c80d_Oblivion_RESP: Mankar Camoran's chattels trapped the Xivilai Anaxes in a cave. He is their Lord, and thus they mock him and me.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_MQ15KathutetD_0003e8fe_Oblivion_R: Mankar Camoran's chattels, the unmortals that swarm here in the Savage Garden, their proper role is to test themselves in unceasing combat.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_MQ05GwinasB4_0009532b_Oblivion_RE: Mankar Camoran's views on Mehrunes Dagon are fascinating, revolutionary even...
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GREETING_0001648c_Oblivion_RESP2: Mannimarco has been defeated? I can hardly believe it! The King of Worms is no more!
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_INFOGENERAL_00062bca_Oblivion_RES: Mannimarco himself is in Cyrodiil, hunting us down. None of us are safe!
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_INFOGENERAL_0006267e_Oblivion_RES: Mannimarco is no more! The guild is saved, and we have a new Arch-Mage to lead us.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_MG18Choice1A_00016482_Oblivion_RE: Mannimarco will have what he seeks, but it will be his undoing at your hands.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_CurrentEventsResponses_00024eac_O: Many Argonians say they have been "called back" to Black Marsh. They disappear into the swamps and are never seen again.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_TamrielGateResponses_00025019_Obl: Many are dead in the land of the Dunmer. Even St. Jiub, who drove the cliffracers from Vvardenfell, has fallen to the daedra hordes.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_BorderWatchTOPIC_000b122c_Oblivio: Many are the evenings we spend around the cooking fire, sharing stories of Elsweyr. The smell of our food travels for miles!
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_MQ15MankarRant_0008c226_Oblivion_: Many are their names and the names of their masters: the Coldharbour of Meridia, Peryrite's Quagmire, the ten Moonshadows of Mephala, and...
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GREETING_0003c34a_Oblivion_RESP2: Many guards are coming forward with more evidence of his greed, so it's safe to say he'll been spending quite a bit of time in the city dungeons.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_TG05HowBad_0000c05c_Oblivion_RESP: Many guild members could be jailed. Find Methredhel in the Imperial City. She is co-ordinating the guild's response.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_AnvilTopic_0003e0aa_Oblivion_RESP: Many of Anvil's folk are directly or indirectly associated with ships and sailing...
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_SE06JyggalagTopic_000910f8_Oblivi: Many of our citizens are... delicate. They can't cope with the prospect, and they defect to the forces of Jyggalag, becoming Priests of Order.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_SE14Benefits_0004b831_Oblivion_RE: Many of these abilities, Lord, are rooted in the magicks of the Isles. Should you choose to leave this Realm, they will not likely function.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_ThoronirTopic_0001d03d_Oblivion_R: Many thanks, on behalf of all of us.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_HELLO_000165a9_Oblivion_RESP1: Many thanks. I'm preparing the ship for her return.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_KnightsofThorn_00031842_Oblivion_: Many wish to join our ranks, as we are of the highest echelon. Only a select few may join the finest force ever to grace the lands of Cyrodiil.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_KnightsofThorn_000c452c_Oblivion_: Many wish to join our ranks, as we are of the highest echelon. Only a select few may join the finest force ever to grace the lands of Cyrodiil.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_SE07RitualYesM_000139af_Oblivion_: Many years ago he decided to hold a night of absolute indulgence, resplendent with dance, wine, and sex to celebrate his fondness for his brethren.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_DAAzuraSpeech_0002c6c2_Oblivion_R: Many years ago, five followers slew the vampire Dratik and its kin, but all were infected by the foul creature.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_BleakersWayTopic_0001ebdf_Oblivio: Many years ago, this town was settled by Ulf the Bleaker. Soon after, Rayno Dalvilu and his family arrived.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_MS16BStolenItem_00028ac7_Oblivion: Many years ago, when the Count was still alive, a daring thief stole the ancient Honorblade of Chorrol from out of this castle. Why?
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_BravilTopic_000488fd_Oblivion_RES: Mara guides and protects Bravil, like she protects any good family. Like any good family, we have our problems.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_ImperialCityTopic_00047701_Oblivi: Mara's blessing on you, and on all her children. Speak to her at the Temple of the One. Ask Mother Mara; she will shower your heart with love.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GREETING_00047737_Oblivion_RESP1: Marana Rian. I am very fond of nice things. How fortunate that I can afford them.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_INFOGENERAL_0003c1ef_Oblivion_RES: Marc Gulitte knows more about how to cast a fireball than anyone in Anvil. I try to stay on his good side.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GREETING_0003e093_Oblivion_RESP1: Marc Gulitte, Mages Guild Evoker, Advanced Instructor in the Arts of Destruction.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_INFOGENERAL_0003c1f2_Oblivion_RES: March Gulitte is a dangerous one. He teaches mages about the Destruction school of magic.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GREETING_0004e890_Oblivion_RESP1: Mariana Ancharia, hostess of Cheydinhal Bridge Inn. We provide beds and food to persons of quality in the Cheydinhal community.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_INFOGENERAL_0003c1e6_Oblivion_RES: Marie Palielle is quite a hard worker. She's in the chapel day and night, tending to the sick and injured.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_INFOGENERAL_0003c1ec_Oblivion_RES: Marie Palielle seems very happy working at the chapel. She's always working, but she's always got a smile on her face.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GREETING_00047698_Oblivion_RESP1: Marinus Catiotus. Ida Vlinorman and me, we're associates. Same interests, same styles.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_INFOGENERAL_000624a6_Oblivion_RES: Marius Caro and Alessia Valga...now Alessia Caro. That's a fine match, two best families in Cyrodiil. They'll be on the Elder Council, just you wait.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GREETING_000475b4_Oblivion_RESP1: Marius Caro, by grace of the Nine, Count Leyawiin. You are a stranger to me, but well-met.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GREETING_00086061_Oblivion_RESP1: Marius Caro, by grace of the Nine, Count Leyawiin. You are a stranger to me, but well-met.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_INFOGENERAL_0006234d_Oblivion_RES: Martin Septim will soon claim his rightful place at the head of the Empire, and the Blades will stand beside him.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_HELLO_00049812_Oblivion_RESP1: Martin Septim, on behalf of the Elder Council, I accept your claim to the Imperial Throne. We should arrange the coronation ceremony as soon as ...
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_MQ04FoundMartin_0001ee2d_Oblivion: Martin cannot stay here. We have driven them off, but they will be back once they learn of Martin's survival. Which they will.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GREETING_0006bed7_Oblivion_RESP1: Martin couldn't have done it without you. I count you among the greatest heroes of the Blades.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_MQ13BattlePlans_00097a6d_Oblivion: Martin has made his decision. The Blades stand beside him.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_MQ16OcatoD_000add46_Oblivion_RESP: Martin is dead. But he died an emperor, and a hero to rival Tiber Septim.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_ElderCouncilTopic_00037833_Oblivi: Martin is right. Declaring oneself Emperor is a delicate matter. In this case, however, I do not think there should be any dispute.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_BladesTalk2_0018d7ef_Oblivion_RES: Martin is safe, and the Temple is secure. But there's a storm brewing. I can feel it... feel it in my bones. The worst is yet to come, mark my words.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_MQWhatNext_0002711b_Oblivion_RESP: Martin made some progress on the Mysterium Xarxes while you were gone. You should speak to him about it.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_INFOGENERAL_00061381_Oblivion_RES: Martin showed himself a true son of the Dragon Blood. But where does that leave us, with no Emperor to serve?
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_MS48BerichMartin_0008dfda_Oblivio: Martin? He was with the rest of the survivors. They were taken back to the encampment, where it's safer for them.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_MS48BerichMartin_0008dfdb_Oblivio: Martin? He's back there, looking after the other survivors.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_TrainingQuestTopic_00062455_Obliv: Martina Floria at the Arcane University has a much better mastery of Illusion spells than I. You should travel there and speak with her.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_TrainingQuestTopic_0006245f_Obliv: Martina Floria at the Arcane University has truly mastered Illusion spells. You should speak with her about training further.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GREETING_00047649_Oblivion_RESP1: Martina Floria, Master Enchanter for the Mages Guild. Welcome to the Chironasium. Enchanting, isn't it?
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GREETING_0003e639_Oblivion_RESP1: Marvellous, marvellous! Self-immolation is a wonderful thing, isn't it? But now that we've had our fun, off to the Sacellum with you.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_BravilNQDResponses_000465a7_Obliv: Marz is a gifted healer, and teacher. I know that she longs to return to the swamps, though.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_INFOGENERAL_000465a5_Oblivion_RES: Marz is an excellent healer, but I understand she longs to return to the swamps of Black Marsh.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_Question_00046588_Oblivion_RESP1: Marz is an excellent healer, but doesn't she seem sad to be here?
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GREETING_00047642_Oblivion_RESP1: Master Spellmaker Gaspar Stegine, at your service. New spells. Old spells. Good spells. Bad spells. They're all fun for me.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_INFOGENERAL_00043e9a_Oblivion_RES: Master Thadon has his Chalice again. Happy days for us all.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_ImperialCityTopic_000476cf_Oblivi: Master Umbacano is a fine gentleman. Mad for old Ayleid stuff, true, but he's got the dosh, so it's all right, ain't it?
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_HELLO_00071e75_Oblivion_RESP1: Master... I'll never get used to saying that. What can I do for you?
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_MatildePetitTopic_000286e4_Oblivi: Matilde claims to be from one of High Rock's most distinguished noble families, but I have a feeling their fortune has long been squandered.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_MatildePetitTopic_00028c2c_Oblivi: Matilde is old, and frail. The shock of two people being murdered is surely too much for the poor woman.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_MatildePetitTopic_00028c24_Oblivi: Matilde seems like an upstanding citizen of the Empire. She respects the law and recognizes the Legion as Tamriel's greatest defense against evil.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_MatildePetitTopic_00028c33_Oblivi: Matilde's murder saddens me friend, but not for the reason you may think. Ten years ago, when I was in my prime, this never would have happened.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GOODBYE_0003b83a_Oblivion_RESP1: May Arden-Sul enrich your mind and guide your heart.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GREETING_0001bb29_Oblivion_RESP1: May I answer any questions for you?
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GREETING_0006bda5_Oblivion_RESP1: May I be of some assistance, Arch-Mage?
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_HELLO_00081531_Oblivion_RESP1: May I have a snippet of your hair for my museum?
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GREETING_00026bc3_Oblivion_RESP1: May I help with any last minute preparations?
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_Barter_000091bf_Oblivion_RESP1: May I interest you in some of my fine wares?
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_BlackBrugo03_0006fde1_Oblivion_RE: May I present you with the perquisites of your rank... a key to White Stallion Lodge and a shield bearing the arms of County Leyawiin.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_BlackBrugo03_000908dd_Oblivion_RE: May I present you with the perquisites of your rank... a key to White Stallion Lodge and a shield bearing the arms of County Leyawiin.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GOODBYE_0009f999_Oblivion_RESP1: May Malacath forgive us for what we've done.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GOODBYE_00022a09_Oblivion_RESP1: May Mara guide you in your travels.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_Attack_00002a38_Knights_RESP1: May Stendarr grant you mercy, for I shall not!
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_UrielSeptimTopic_0001e8e1_Oblivio: May Talos guide his soul to Aetherius. Rest in peace, my Lord.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GOODBYE_00038fce_Oblivion_RESP1: May Talos guide you, my friend.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GOODBYE_0018d7e1_Oblivion_RESP1: May Uriel's spirit guide us in these troubled times.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GREETING_0008d31a_Oblivion_RESP1: May all my children serve you well, Lord Sheogorath.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GOODBYE_0006a8a5_Oblivion_RESP1: May all your days be filled with enlightenment and mirth!
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GOODBYE_0006a8b6_Oblivion_RESP1: May all your days be filled with enlightenment and mirth!
