ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GOODBYE_0005179a_Oblivion_RESP1: Move faster, if you value your life.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GREETING_0009816f_Oblivion_RESP1: Move to the training area, downstairs. We will speak more there.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_BrumaNQDResponses_0004661c_Oblivi: Much as I dislike bards, I wouldn't mind learning a thing or two from her.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_TrainingQuestTopic_0018d14d_Obliv: Much as I hate to admit it, Gin-Wulm knows more about smithing than I do. Says it's in his blood.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_INFOGENERAL_000608e3_Oblivion_RES: Much blood has come and gone. Relan is sad. Relan was stuck in Fellmoor for all the war... no blood... no war... poor Relan.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_Idle_0018b5bb_Oblivion_RESP1: Much to see. Much to learn.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_MG12TravenWhoInformant_000835f8_O: Mucianus Allias. He is not a Council member, but has long served the guild here at the Arcane University.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_MG12TravenWhere_000835fc_Oblivion: Mucianus last reported being sent to the ruins of Nenyond Twyll, south of the Imperial City. That is where the Battlemages went.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_INFOGENERAL_0018bcc4_Oblivion_RES: Mudcrabs. What's the point? Annoying buggers, though the meat isn't bad.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_MaladaTopic_0002b09f_Oblivion_RES: Must I hold your hand? I begin to wonder what Umbacano sees in you. It is an Ayleid ruin in the far west of this province, up in the Valus Mountains.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GREETING_000479f4_Oblivion_RESP3: Must be a joke. Don't get the joke, either... but the customer is always right.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_INFOGENERAL_0003c235_Oblivion_RES: Must be nice being in the Mages Guild. If they need something recharged, they just talk to Vigge the Cautious, and poof! All done.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_INFOGENERAL_00043ec6_Oblivion_RES: Must be nice to be Duke of Mania, and have your biggest problem surround some missing cup.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_SE03SyndelCrazyChatter_0008efae_O: Must find the key! Must find the key!
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_ThurindilTopic_0003e0d9_Oblivion_: Must have been knocked on the head. Talks all sorts of rot. Meek as a sheep, though.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_ChorrolNQDResponses_00029fb7_Obli: Must we talk about the Fighters Guild now?
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_SE32Betrothed_000948b0_Oblivion_R: My Beloved! I'll carry her away to safety. Should the fanatics get her, I...I...I would have to kill them all.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_CGEmperor01_00053261_Oblivion_RES: My Blades are leading me out of the city along a secret escape route.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_TestMike_0004897d_Oblivion_RESP1: My Disp to you is now over 70.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_DANocturnalSpeech_00084a4f_Oblivi: My Eye is returned, and I once again see into the darkness that is your world.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_ChallengeKhajiit_0009f9b4_Oblivio: My Khajiit is quick and cunning! Go! Seek him out! See whose blood is quicker.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_MS12TolganGreet_0001c497_Oblivion: My Lady holds court from 8 in the morning until 6 in the evening each day. That would be the best time to see her.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_SE10DuchessofDementia_00017d0b_Ob: My Lady! I am sorry, I did not realize...
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_SE10DuchessofMania_0001746b_Obliv: My Lady! I am sorry, I did not realize...
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_Attack_0008f588_Oblivion_RESP1: My Lord Jyggalag will never be turned aside by the likes of you, fool!
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GREETING_00081d87_Oblivion_RESP1: My Lord Sheogorath! Please kill me!
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GREETING_0008d32c_Oblivion_RESP1: My Lord comes to Deepwallow to make it safe?
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_HELLO_0008d325_Oblivion_RESP1: My Lord comes to rid us of the Scalon menace?
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GOODBYE_00081da0_Oblivion_RESP1: My Lord has a real edge I'd like to cut myself on.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_SE12HaskillGreetA1_00016cfe_Obliv: My Lord of course noticed the Font when you arrived in the Palace. The Font of Madness, in the middle of the throne room.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GOODBYE_00081d9b_Oblivion_RESP1: My Lord rules strongly and without exhaustion.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GREETING_0005e376_Oblivion_RESP1: My Lord! Aurmazl Zudeh sent me to find you. She requests your immediate assistance.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GREETING_0001a77f_Oblivion_RESP1: My Lord! Autkendo Jansa sent me to find you. She requests your immediate assistance.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_HELLO_00081d68_Oblivion_RESP1: My Lord! I've been waiting so long for you to return!
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_HELLO_0008d321_Oblivion_RESP1: My Lord! To what do I owe the honor?
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_HELLO_00081530_Oblivion_RESP1: My Lord! What brings you to my humble museum?
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GREETING_00081d70_Oblivion_RESP1: My Lord! What can I do for you?
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_SE06KanehFinalC_000400de_Oblivion: My Lord's choice of emissaries is strange. But He tolerates the Mazken in His service as well, so who can fathom His ways?
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_Trespass_0007dfe8_Oblivion_RESP1: My Lord, You seem to have lost Your way.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GREETING_000459b4_Oblivion_RESP1: My Lord, it seems there has been some misunderstanding.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GREETING_00081d8e_Oblivion_RESP1: My Lord, there aren't enough pages in all the books in the world to hold your glory!
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GREETING_00081dca_Oblivion_RESP1: My Lord, what is mine is yours.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_SEResistArrest_000459c7_Oblivion_: My Lord, you do me too much honor! It will be glorious to fall in battle at Your hand!
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GREETING_00081dc0_Oblivion_RESP1: My Lord, you honor me with your presence.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GREETING_00081d6e_Oblivion_RESP1: My Lord. I didn't realize how powerful your presence would be. I will try to embody that majesty in my daily life. People respect me, you know.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GREETING_00081d6f_Oblivion_RESP1: My Lord. I have waited for your return. Why have you forsaken me? I am your most... adoring subject! I am yours to command, body and soul!
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GREETING_0001a79b_Oblivion_RESP1: My Lord. I'm glad to see you. We have a developing situation that requires your attention.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GREETING_00081d8d_Oblivion_RESP1: My Lord? Are you aware we are suffering a Skooma shortage?
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_SE34Medallion_00066eaa_Oblivion_R: My Medallion! I don't know how to thank you!
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_DAVaerminaSpeech_0008ade8_Oblivio: My Orb is returned, and Arkved will live out the rest of his days in nightmare. It is fitting.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GREETING_000164f4_Oblivion_RESP1: My Red Room got its paint job from fighters like you! After you disembowel the next idiot, I want you to smear his blood all over the walls! Ha ha!
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_ImperialCityTopic_00047659_Oblivi: My advice is take your time, walk around the Market District, see what's on offer. Don't buy until you've seen it all. Take your time.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_Goblinhunting_00038ac2_Oblivion_R: My advice is to close quick with the skirmishers... the petty spellcasters... but the shamans are real trouble.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_SE08Ally03Tactic1_00017d58_Oblivi: My arrows will cut them down.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_SE08Ally03Tactic1_000181d3_Oblivi: My arrows will cut them down.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GREETING_001778f6_Oblivion_RESP1: My attention is focused on the Council right now. I will need you soon enough; I need more time.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GOODBYE_00081534_Oblivion_RESP1: My belly is rumbling, so I must leave. It has been an honor to talk to you, Lord Sheogorath.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_SE03FinKnightsofOrder_000807ba_Ob: My best advice is to destroy them on sight. They wouldn't hesitate to do the same to you.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_SE43GoAway_0008153a_Oblivion_RESP: My best friend wants me to leave? Okay, for you I will. I know a nice spot in Bliss I can use.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_SE37Beast_0004565f_Oblivion_RESP1: My bestiary? Oh, yes. I want to start one. I'd like a Baliwog to begin with. You just get it close to me and I'll take care of subduing it.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GREETING_0001b682_Oblivion_RESP1: My betrothed is gone! I cannot live without her. I only hope I can take a Fanatic with me.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GOODBYE_0001333d_Oblivion_RESP1: My betrothed must be worried sick about me.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GREETING_00012d08_Oblivion_RESP1: My betrothed! I must save her!
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_ND06CasimirStoryCurse_00002b28_Kn: My blow landed harder than I had intended, and he fell to the floor, dead. Killed in the very Chapel of the God of Mercy.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GREETING_00073229_Oblivion_RESP1: My boat is coming along swimmingly.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_sons_0002573b_Oblivion_RESP1: My boys are safe! Oh, thank you!
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_Creatures_000224b4_Oblivion_RESP2: My boys will take up the fight even if the guards won't. Doesn't matter if it's outside the town walls - it still affects us all.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_INFOGENERAL_00002a15_Knights_RESP: My broodmate was traveling in Leyawiin. She told me of an artifact hidden in the Chapel there, but said that no one has ever been able to claim it.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GREETING_0000294d_Knights_RESP1: My brother and I still hope to serve the gods as Knights of the Nine. Have you changed your mind? Will you induct us into the Order?
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_MS16Brothers_00084a9a_Oblivion_RE: My brother! It is wonderful to see you again. We will have much to talk about in the next days.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_INFOGENERAL_000432cf_Oblivion_RES: My child will smash to a bloody pulp any adventurer who tries to get into the realm.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_SE09Ceremony_00014ad2_Oblivion_RE: My child. It is time to fulfill your destiny. Stand guard in this land against all those who seek entry not bearing the mark of Sheogorath's favor.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_Dark11Choice1A_00002db8_Oblivion_: My children? Whatever for? Oh! Oh, dear, excuse an old woman's stupidity! You're here to pick up my gift list!
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_SE35Brithaur_00078663_Oblivion_RE: My collection is almost complete. All I need are five Flawless Pearls and I'm done. How hard could that be?
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GREETING_0007ac74_Oblivion_RESP1: My collection is complete! My collection is complete! Glory days! Wheeeeee.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GREETING_00045651_Oblivion_RESP2: My collection is complete. Thankfully, you won't be interrupting me anymore.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_INFOGENERAL_00002a1e_Knights_RESP: My cousin in Skingrad said that a pair of brothers stopped there looking for the Priory of the Nine. They wanted to be Knights! Can you believe it?
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_INFOGENERAL_00064448_Oblivion_RES: My cousin says the beggars all work for the Gray Fox. It's rather frightening.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_MS27HerminiaF1_000a5608_Oblivion_: My crown, the one Umbacano covets, belonged to the ruler of Nenalata.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_DovesiDranTopic_00028a07_Oblivion: My daughter was killed, you see. A few years back, by bandits. I'm sorry, please forgive a father's heavy heart.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_DarkOrcElfConvo_00026e76_Oblivion: My dear Gogron, you are a life-taker for the Dark Brotherhood! Our very existence relies on shadow and deception. Do you not value our secrets?
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_DarkGiftTopic_0004cf46_Oblivion_R: My dear friend, the Dark Gift is yours! You are now a vampire! A creature of the night! We are now kin!
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_HELLO_000029af_Knights_RESP1: My dear sir knight, may we speak a moment?
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_NevilleTopic_00028793_Oblivion_RE: My dear, sweet daughter Olga was killed that day. She was murdered, and the Legion would do nothing to help her. Neville and his kind are scum.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_MS40MelisandeRumor_0003f290_Obliv: My dear, you shouldn't trust rumors. They can get you into horrible trouble.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_SE02RelmynaVisit_0001a122_Oblivio: My dearest, how are you feeling tonight, child?
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GREETING_0000294f_Knights_RESP1: My devotion to Auri-El will not flag, nor will my desire to become a Knight of the Nine. Will you have me?
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_SE43Bhisha_0008f134_Oblivion_RESP: My dog died, so that Khajiit isn't following me right now. However, I'll be getting a new dog soon, and I just know he'll be back.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GREETING_0008fa7d_Oblivion_RESP1: My double is always working. It takes all my energy just watching him work. It's got to stop.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_SE46DoublesTopic_0008fb69_Oblivio: My double is out to get me. And eat me. You wouldn't do that, would you? Something has to be done.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_CGEmperor15_0003247f_Oblivion_RES: My dreams grant me no opinions of success. Their compass ventures not beyond the doors of death.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_LeyawiinTopic_000479d1_Oblivion_R: My duties are primarily... administrative. They keep me busy here in the Leyawiin barracks.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GatherClues_000038c9_Oblivion_RES: My duties rely on watching no more than the throne and attending to visitors.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_SE11HaskillChoice1_00014b66_Obliv: My duty now is to the Realm. By serving you, I serve Lord Sheogorath.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_MS38Topic_0008306c_Oblivion_RESP1: My enemies think I'm weak. That I'll never act.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_SE11CiirtaGreeting2a_00016b71_Obl: My eye? You seek to remove the light from me? Why?
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_MS46Goblins_000319ce_Oblivion_RES: My family and I are still trying to figure out what to do. We spent everything we had to buy the land and supplies, so we can hardly go back.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GREETING_0004e8c3_Oblivion_RESP3: My family didn't approve of my vocation, so I had to come to Cyrodiil for my education.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_Manor_00003a5d_Oblivion_RESP3: My family said I could move here to the Imperial City once all our loose ends were tied down. The manor was one of those loose ends.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GuilbertJemaneTopic_00023e88_Obli: My family was killed long, long ago. At least, that's what I'd been told... perhaps it's time for me to stop drinking.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_HELLO_0003574b_Oblivion_RESP1: My fate is in your hands.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_WeatherleahTopic_000242ae_Oblivio: My father carried me to safety. He later returned and believed Reynald and my mother had perished.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_AlbertJemaneTopic_0008b074_Oblivi: My father had told us that he had hidden something away for us... something to provide for our future, but I never imagined it was this.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_MirisaTopic_00033ef7_Oblivion_RES: My father hired her as a guide at an inn south of here. Good thing, too. She saved our lives, and led us safely back here after the goblin attack.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_AlbertJemaneTopic_0008b07c_Oblivi: My father was a great man! I'll not hear your lies!!
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_Attack_00074a0d_Oblivion_RESP1: My father will never be beaten by the likes of you.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_ImperialCityTopic_000476e4_Oblivi: My favorite thing is fresh slaughterfish, caught fresh from the docks on the Waterfront.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_INFOGENERAL_000624bc_Oblivion_RES: My favorite town? Anvil. Lovely old stone buildings, and the harbor at sunset is beautiful.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_NelsTheNaughtyTopic_0002817f_Obli: My feelings about the Nord are my own business! Leave me be!
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_DovesiDranTopic_00028705_Oblivion: My feelings toward her are really none of your business.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GREETING_000411fd_Oblivion_RESP1: My feet hurt so bad. I could sure use a new pair of shoes. Can you help me out? Please?
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_MQ11BrumaAllies_00026ea2_Oblivion: My first responsibility is to the people of Cheydinhal. They look to me for protection in these dark times.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_DAPeryiteSpeech_0008c25f_Oblivion: My followers are trapped between worlds; their bodies here on this plane, their souls in Oblivion. I would have you reunite the bodies and the souls.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_DAHermaeusSpeech_000a9484_Oblivio: My followers seek to perform a divination. For this, they need souls, one of each of the sentient races. You will provide these.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GREETING_00073925_Oblivion_RESP1: My friend! It is good to see you again. You risked your life to save me, a stranger. You are truly among the blessed of Arkay's children.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GREETING_000b1672_Oblivion_RESP1: My friend! What can I do for you?
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_NevilleTopic_00028714_Oblivion_RE: My friend, I am truly worried! Neville was a strong and capable man, a soldier of twenty years! The rest of us will be easy prey for the killer now!
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_NelsTheNaughtyTopic_00028cd4_Obli: My friend, in talking to you, it's become clear what must be done. I have no doubts in my mind that Nels is the killer. We must take him down!
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GREETING_000176c4_Oblivion_RESP2: My friend, it is with great honor that I advance you to the rank of Champion! You've done it! You've shown them all you're the best!
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GREETING_00028724_Oblivion_RESP1: My friend, please stay safe! Three of us have been murdered! Besides you and me, there's only one guest left, if you know what I'm saying.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_ArenaAgronakChoice4_00038ed7_Obli: My friend, you must travel to Crowhaven and use the key to unlock whatever it is that holds the proof of my birthright!
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_NDPelinalVisionSpeech_00002ab6_Kn: My friends built a shrine upon the site of my death, where the Elves tormented me in a final act of revenge.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_Announcer_00047c63_Oblivion_RESP1: My friends, we have a winner! Behold, the combatant from the Blue Team! If you bet on the Blue Team, see the Gatekeeper to collect your winnings!
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_Announcer_00047c64_Oblivion_RESP1: My friends, we have a winner! Behold, the combatant from the Yellow Team! If you bet on the Yellow Team, see the Gatekeeper to collect your winnings!
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GREETING_0002b72f_Oblivion_RESP1: My good friend! Let me drink to your health! For saving my brother ... no, for finding him ... or was it for finding me? Anyway, bottoms up!
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_SEDerveninSpeech01_000898f1_Obliv: My good friends, a most jubilant time is once again at hand. The Flame of the Maniacs burns bright, and we must celebrate!
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GREETING_00028161_Oblivion_RESP1: My goodness, two of us are now dead! What's going on in this place?
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_HackdirtTopic_0002869d_Oblivion_R: My grandfather built this place, not that it's any of your business.  We been down, but we got plans to bring back the good old days.  You'll see.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_DASheogorathChoice3_00026af3_Obli: My great-great-great grandfather, K'Sharra, foretold of a time when we would receive three signs from the gods, signalling the end of the world.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GREETING_0001e6fd_Oblivion_RESP1: My guards are strong and true, but even the might of the Blades cannot stand against the Power that rises to destroy us.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_StolenGold_00053776_Oblivion_RESP: My guess is he buried it somewhere close to town or even in town itself. Believe me, I've looked. No luck so far.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_NelsTheNaughtyTopic_00028cd7_Obli: My gut instincts tell me Nels is the killer, but still I lack the proof I need to confront him. Maybe you can convince me I'm right.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_SE04WhatHappened_00019524_Oblivio: My head is positively throbbing now... can you see it? I need to lie down. Find someone to tell you the rest of the story. Get the Chalice.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_HELLO_000343f5_Oblivion_RESP1: My head is still spinning from everything that has happened. I'll need some time to adjust.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_INFOGENERAL_00043e83_Oblivion_RES: My heart fills with joy that Lord Thadon has finally recovered from his doldrums.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GOODBYE_00068344_Oblivion_RESP1: My heart is lighter thanks to your words. You've given me kinship, and that is worth more than a thousand swords. Until later, friend.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_KvatchTopic_0002855b_Oblivion_RES: My home.... my goddamn home, in flames. It kills me that I can't get in there and DO something.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_SE32FanaticYell_0001b708_Oblivion: My horde will swallow this keep!
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GREETING_0001bb20_Oblivion_RESP1: My house is yours, friend. Please, come back to visit us anytime.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_ChorrolTopic_00024fec_Oblivion_RE: My housemate, Malintus Ancus, and I are well-known in certain circles here. But, you don't travel in those circles, do you?
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_ImperialCityTopic_0004773a_Oblivi: My housemates and I were lucky to find this house in the Temple District. It costs a little more, but it's a very good address.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_AnvilTopic_0003e0cc_Oblivion_RESP: My husband is down south in Anvil County, working the Valenwood line, hunting down bandits and smugglers.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_TG11GiveRing_00022e71_Oblivion_RE: My husband's wedding ring! I never thought to see it again. What I wouldn't give to see him once more.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_MS08KurdanJar_0001f42d_Oblivion_R: My informant tells me it's hidden in the main keep at the center. Dunno what's guardin' it, but I'm sure you can handle it.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_MS22HighFane_0002c819_Oblivion_RE: My interest was in recovering the carving from Malada, and Maric has already delivered it to me.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_UrielSeptimTopic_000178c9_Oblivio: My job is to make sure the Emperor gets out of here alive, and I intend to do it.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_CharGenMain_00032b08_Oblivion_RES: My job right now is to get you to safety.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GREETING_0001d4ba_Oblivion_RESP1: My knowledge is at your disposal.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_BOASTLOVE_0018b2bc_Oblivion_RESP1: My life is drab and wretched by comparison.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_MQ15MankarSpeech_0008b0a5_Oblivio: My long duel with the Septims is over, and I have the mastery.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GREETING_0008f7d1_Oblivion_RESP4: My lord Jyggalag has given me clarity, and purpose.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_MQ04Conv_00037b50_Oblivion_RESP1: My lord! Welcome to Cloud Ruler Temple! We have not had the honor of an Emperor's visit in many years!
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_HELLO_00068341_Oblivion_RESP1: My lord, I was wondering if I could speak with you. I understand that you have many more pressing concerns...
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_HELLO_00067dc1_Oblivion_RESP1: My lord, please excuse my presumption, but I would speak with you.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_HELLO_00067dbd_Oblivion_RESP1: My lord... I would speak with you.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_RytheLythandasTopic_0001c1cb_Obli: My love is home again. I'll never leave his side.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_UmbacanoTopic_000a9843_Oblivion_R: My master has not returned from his expedition to Nenalata.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_INFOGENERAL_0005ed49_Oblivion_RES: My master has partaken of the Greenmote and passed his post onto another. Now a new rule begins in the House of Mania.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_MS21JollringChoice1_0002ab53_Obli: My master is a collector of Ayleid antiquities. It has come to his attention that you recently sold an item that interests him.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_UmbacanoTopic_000a9844_Oblivion_R: My master is not available at the moment. Perhaps you can call again another day.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_JollringChoice2C_00085942_Oblivio: My master trusts me to decide what to show him, I'm afraid.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_UmbacanoTopic_0002b633_Oblivion_R: My master, Umbacano, is known across Cyrodiil as a collector of Ayleid antiquities. He is always interested in rare artifacts from that era.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_UmbacanoTopic_0002ab51_Oblivion_R: My master, Umbacano, lives in the Talos Plaza District of the Imperial City. He is known across Cyrodiil as a collector of Ayleid antiquities.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_ND07LathonGreetA1_00002b88_Knight: My master. We met you on the Pilgrim's Way. Back then I thought for sure the gods had chosen him for a holy purpose.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_TG01NoBribeBeggar_00007e03_Oblivi: My memory is playing tricks on me. I can't seem to remember where she lives.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_MQ16Talk_0004bf9e_Oblivion_RESP1: My men and I are at your disposal. What are your orders?
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_jobs_0002c7b5_Oblivion_RESP1: My men and I should be able to keep busy for now. Thank you for your help.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_ClaudeMaricTopic_0002c814_Oblivio: My methods were vindicated. Apparently Maric was more capable than you. I'm sure you will try harder the next time.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GREETING_00023e80_Oblivion_RESP2: My mistake - shouldn't you be on the other side of Cyrodiil by now?
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_ArenaAgronakChoice4_00038ed7_Obli: My mother died recently. Before she passed, she gave me this key, and told me it would "unlock the truth," at the place of my birth, Crowhaven.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_MS45Mother_0002869b_Oblivion_RESP: My mother owns Northern Goods and Trade in Chorrol.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_MS45Mother_0002869a_Oblivion_RESP: My mother owns this shop.  She would be glad of your business.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_Dark11Choice3B_00002dd6_Oblivion_: My mother? No! What have you done to her! I'll kill you! Agghh!
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_Dark11Choice4B_00002dda_Oblivion_: My mother? Oh, do you know her? She's such a sweet woman. I've been a terrible daughter I'm afraid. I simply must visit more often!
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GREETING_0001dc51_Oblivion_RESP1: My my my, look at the Myrmidon. Who are you fighting against up there, cripples and skooma addicts? Maybe some day they'll give you a real challenge.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GREETING_000479ad_Oblivion_RESP1: My name is Agata. I'm responsible for enchanted item recharge for the Guild here in Leyawiin.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GREETING_000476fe_Oblivion_RESP1: My name is Alessia Ottus, and I'd like to talk about the Nine Divines.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GREETING_0004773b_Oblivion_RESP1: My name is Ancus Afranius. I do whatever comes to hand. Or nothing, when I can afford it.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GREETING_000476c2_Oblivion_RESP1: My name is Atraena. How do you do?
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_ND04CarodusGreeting1_00002ad3_Kni: My name is Carodus Oholin. Like you, I am a servant of the Nine. Specifically, of Zenithar.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GREETING_0004774c_Oblivion_RESP1: My name is Carwen. Remember. I'll be rich and famous one day.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GREETING_000476de_Oblivion_RESP1: My name is Elragail. I look after Thamriel. He's a little strange. 'Touched by the Gods', they say.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GREETING_00024f2e_Oblivion_RESP1: My name is Eugal Belette. I'm pretty new here -- don't know a soul.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_MS13WhoAreYou_000a3847_Oblivion_R: My name is Farwil Indarys, son of Count Andel Indarys of Cheydinhal. The wounded one is Bremman Senyan. We are members of the Knights of the Thorn.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GREETING_00047735_Oblivion_RESP1: My name is Hagaer. I don't get out much. Too many books to read.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GREETING_000476fc_Oblivion_RESP1: My name is Hastrel Ottus, and I'd like to talk about Akatosh.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GREETING_00047700_Oblivion_RESP1: My name is Ida Ottus, and I'd like to talk about Mother Mara.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GREETING_000476d0_Oblivion_RESP1: My name is Lurio Maenius. I share a house with Matthias Draconis. I'm between jobs as a private guard.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GREETING_000479da_Oblivion_RESP1: My name is Margarte. Professionally, I'm a trade consultant... I offer Advanced Mercantile training, by the way...
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GREETING_00047747_Oblivion_RESP1: My name is Methredhel. I've come to the Imperial City to make my fortunes.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GREETING_000479d6_Oblivion_RESP1: My name is Numeen.  Have you seen that no-good rascal husband of mine, Mahei? Gods know what he is up to this time...
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GREETING_0003c9a8_Oblivion_RESP1: My name is Selena Orania. I'm a Mages Guild Journeyman.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GREETING_000476f8_Oblivion_RESP1: My name is Umog gra-Marad. I'm employed by Master Umbacano as a night guard.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GREETING_00002855_Oblivion_RESP1: My name's Bongond. I can see you know horses. So do I, and I know I have just what you need.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GREETING_0003e0a2_Oblivion_RESP1: My name's Quill-Weave. I've had some success selling stories about the lives of the lower and criminal classes.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_BravilTopic_000488bd_Oblivion_RES: My neighbor, Dro'shanji, is worried. He's seen creatures around the house lately. Why don't you talk to Dro'shanji, see if you can help?
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_LeyawiinTopic_000479c9_Oblivion_R: My neighbors grumble a lot, but what can they do? No law against practicing my skills.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_Lost_00081a3e_Oblivion_RESP1: My nerves are on edge, I guess. This land could do with the peace of Order.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_INFOGENERAL_0005f231_Oblivion_RES: My new Gatekeeper is a miracle. He's perfect.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_NDGauntletsoftheCrusader_00002b18: My only real involvement with them these days is keeping the youngsters from hurting themselves trying to pick the gauntlets up.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_BladesTopic_0001e8e2_Oblivion_RES: My order is dedicated to the service of the Septim Emperors. We have failed in our duty to protect him.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_OblivionGateConv_0005a023_Oblivio: My orders didn't include leading my men into Oblivion. We'll hold here for now.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_TG08MothPriestNote_0001474a_Obliv: My own family doesn't even know me. I would give much to be rid of the Gray Cowl and its curse.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_MS27HerminiaE1_000a5607_Oblivion_: My own research into the Late Ayleid Period suggests that there was not a single Ayleid ruler, but many.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_SE06KanehGreetA_000131ab_Oblivion: My pardon, Emissary. I am at your service.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_Trespass_0007dfe4_Oblivion_RESP1: My pardon, Lord. Are You lost?
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GREETING_000459b7_Oblivion_RESP1: My pardon, Your Grace, but Lord Sheogorath's justice applies to all within His Realm.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_SE06GSWardenGreet1_00018dc3_Obliv: My pardon, lord. Receive this key, and with it free passage throughout the Shrine of the Flame of Agnon.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_HELLO_0001b689_Oblivion_RESP1: My people long to be laid to rest. Please help them.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GREETING_0003d7f3_Oblivion_RESP1: My place is on the battlefield. The time for hiding in Cloud Ruler Temple is over. Come, let us go down to battle together.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_TG04AlessiasRing_00009331_Oblivio: My pockets are a little light at the moment... if you know what I mean.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GREETING_000a3452_Oblivion_RESP3: My poor Biene. Poor, sweet Biene. What monsters would do this? How can this have happened?
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GOODBYE_0003cafa_Oblivion_RESP1: My poor Henantier. Help will be with you soon.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_HenantierTopic_0002c6e9_Oblivion_: My poor Henantier. I shudder to think what's happened to him in there.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_ReynaldJemaneTopic_000242a9_Obliv: My poor brother. I can't help but feel responsible. If he'd never known about me, he'd still be alive.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GREETING_0003fd3b_Oblivion_RESP1: My poor husband is getting no sleep. He's awake all night taking care of those stupid plants.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_SQ01Potatoes_0018885e_Oblivion_RE: My potatoes are like my children. I care for and nurture each one individually. That way, they grow up to be big and strong.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_SilencerTopic_0002fdb6_Oblivion_R: My previous Silencer perished while fulfilling a contract. That emptiness has now been filled by you. It is an honor without equal.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GREETING_00027119_Oblivion_RESP1: My progress on the Mysterium Xarxes is slow, I'm afraid. How goes your search for the Armor of Tiber Septim?
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_CheydinhalTopic_0004e8c4_Oblivion: My progress through the ranks here will be slow. My prejudices against certain types of magic limit my chances for advancement.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GREETING_0006edec_Oblivion_RESP1: My rats are all dead! It's too late to do any more. I won't be needing your services any longer.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GREETING_00026d5e_Oblivion_RESP1: My research is moving forward again. It's only a matter of time before I decipher the third and fourth ingredients for the ritual.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_Daedricshrine_00002e57_Oblivion_R: My research shows there is likely a shrine in these caves. I'll need you to accompany me to the shrine, handle any... difficulties.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_TG04GiveRing_00035fc0_Oblivion_RE: My ring! All thanks to the claws of the Clan Mother. You have recovered it.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_HELLO_00025280_Oblivion_RESP1: My scales grow cold whenever you approach.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_SE06SidePassage_00012cbd_Oblivion: My scouts recently discovered another way through the ruins to the Altar of Despair.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_SE06KanehMirel_00012102_Oblivion_: My scouts reported no signs of the Mazken in the Underdeep. It's our best chance to take them unawares.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_TG11P3Specifics_0001fb70_Oblivion: My scrying with Savilla's Stone has provided clues, but not the details. I know the tools you will need there, but not the obstacles themselves.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_ServiceRefusal_0003d802_Oblivion_: My services are not for such as you. Go peddle your paltry wares to Ongar in Bruma, or one of the other lesser fences.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_ServiceRefusal_000614cb_Oblivion_: My services are only for Fighters Guild members. Nothing personal.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_ServiceRefusal_0003d800_Oblivion_: My services are reserved for more important members of the Thieves Guild. You can always use Ongar in Bruma.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_UgakgraMogakhTopic_00038a93_Obliv: My sister, Ugak gra-Mogakh, runs the Grateful Pass Stables. She's the quiet one. I'm the talker.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GREETING_0003013c_Oblivion_RESP2: My sisters, on the other hand ... I wouldn't mind if they had stayed invisible! Ha ha ha!
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_MQ11BrumaAllies_00026ea1_Oblivion: My soldiers are brave and capable. They will do their duty.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_MS13Gate_000579e1_Oblivion_RESP2: My son, Farwil, has taken some knights and entered the gate bravely in hopes of meeting the enemy head-on.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_ViranusDontonTOPIC_0002d714_Obliv: My son? He's at home, I would imagine.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_CharGenMain_00032b05_Oblivion_RES: My sons ... they're dead, aren't they?
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GREETING_0002249c_Oblivion_RESP1: My sons! Have you seen my sons?
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_TG08SavillasStoneTopic_00014704_O: My sources tell me that Savilla's Stone has gone missing. Do you have it with you?
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_HouseBuyCheydinhal_0004f213_Obliv: My steward will draw up the papers for me to sign. Here is the key to your new home. You can find it in the southwest corner of the city.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_MS16Choice5A_00028ac8_Oblivion_RE: My tale actually begins with the father, Albert Jemane. He was once in my employ, or should I say the employ of my organization.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_BravilTopic_00048900_Oblivion_RES: My task is to know and love the people of Bravil as if they were my own children. If you have ever been a parent, you know what a challenge that is.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_MQ09GhostB_00036666_Oblivion_RESP: My three companions and I were sent here by the Emperor Tiber Septim to discover what evil had defiled the holy catacombs of Sancre Tor.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_MS40Allright_0003e955_Oblivion_RE: My trusted servants have cared for her all this time, but I wish for her to at last find peace. The cure is for her.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_MQ15MankarSpeech_0008b0a4_Oblivio: My vision shall be realized. Weakness will be purged from the world, and mortal and immortal alike purified in the refiner's fire.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_Hit_0008c218_Oblivion_RESP1: My vision will yet be realized!
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_HELLO_00081d76_Oblivion_RESP1: My weapons and armor are fashionable and deadly. For the sophisticated warrior.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_INFOGENERAL_000441e8_Oblivion_RES: My whole family is happy about the Torch being lit. Unless it's all part of some bit plot.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_Attack_00090cb6_Oblivion_RESP1: My whole life I have waited for this moment! Die!
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GREETING_0003a906_Oblivion_RESP2: My whole life has been nothing but a lie! I'm no "Gray Prince." I'm a vile, wretched spawn of evil! Please, leave me. I can't.... I...
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GREETING_0003a907_Oblivion_RESP2: My whole life has been nothing but a lie! I'm no "Gray Prince." I'm a vile, wretched spawn of evil! Please, leave me. I can't.... I...
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_HELLO_0003ca92_Oblivion_RESP1: My word! You startled me! Are you real?
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_SE37Errand_000452fb_Oblivion_RESP: My work is far too important to trust to you.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_TG09HelpGF_00014825_Oblivion_RESP: My work with Savilla's Stone has revealed that I need something special for my plans.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_INFOGENERAL_00043eb3_Oblivion_RES: My, but it has been busy here lately. I do so enjoy a good conspiracy.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_INFOGENERAL_00043eb1_Oblivion_RES: My, my, my. Seems we're all anxious to know something, even if we already know it. Or, Syl knows it. Or not.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_SE30ForgeGauntletsMagic_000400ba_: My, my, my... what big hands you have!
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_CharGenTaunt2_00033341_Oblivion_R: My, my, you're a big one. A Nord, I'd guess, right? So strong... But you can't bend steel, can you boy? You can't do anything to get out of here.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_Dark06Choice2A_0004e9ad_Oblivion_: My... my soul? Whoah. Wow. Yeah, okay... Yeah! That sounds... great! You can have my soul! Can I... Can I have your soul too? Ha ha ha ha. Oh... Wow.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_ReynaldJemaneTopic_00084a98_Obliv: Mystery solved, eh? Reynald had a twin brother. Well, he had all of us fooled.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_SkingradNQDResponses_0003c1be_Obl: Mysticism? Seems interesting, but not particularly useful.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_TG03WhoIsInformant_000092b6_Obliv: Myvryna Arano. Now Armand needs your help to neutralize her. You are going to pin the theft of the bust on Myvryna. She lives in the Waterfront.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_INFOGENERAL_000465c5_Oblivion_RES: Nahsi at the Fighters Guild seems very at peace with himself. He says that's what allows him to be such an amazing martial artist.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_BravilNQDQuestionResponses_000465: Nahsi is quite a character, and quite an impressive fighter.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GREETING_000488d1_Oblivion_RESP1: Nahsi, your humble servant, and humble servant of the Nine. I offer training in the marital arts of Hand-to-Hand fighting.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GREETING_0001ce92_Oblivion_RESP1: Namira is pleased, foul one. May your days be filled with the hurtful stares of others. Dwell joyously in filth and squalor.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_SE05Conspiracy_0007d465_Oblivion_: Naryan that! I'll balitoe before I krayble.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_INFOGENERAL_0003e98b_Oblivion_RES: Naspia Cosma is really skilled with her blade. It's a shame she doesn't compete in the Arena.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_CreatureResponses_0002b1c2_Oblivi: Nasty creatures, but I hear their meat is rather tasty.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_MS16Choice5A_00028ac8_Oblivion_RE: Naturally, my associates and I believed he had perished. The wilderness is, after all, a dangerous place. No place to take your family.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_TG06BribeGuard_0000c209_Oblivion_: Naw. But it will earn ya two years in Skingrad's dungeon. Now get lost before I decide ta report ya.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_DAMolagBalSpeech_00037845_Oblivio: Near Brindle Home you will find Melus Petilius. A good man. An honorable man. He disgusts me.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_information_00009224_Oblivion_RES: Nearly invincible, he has established himself somewhere in the north of Cyrodiil. This is all that I know.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_INFOGENERAL_00062bcd_Oblivion_RES: Necromancers have attacked our very homes. What could be next?
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_INFOGENERAL_0006c29a_Oblivion_RES: Necromancy may be legal in Cyrodiil, but few will openly admit to practicing it now that the Mages Guild has banned it.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_HELLO_0004e958_Oblivion_RESP1: Need I remind you once more?
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_Barter_00038996_Oblivion_RESP1: Need a bite to eat? Maybe something to wash it down with?
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_Barter_000091c2_Oblivion_RESP1: Need a book? You've come to the right place.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_Barter_000091c9_Oblivion_RESP1: Need a new mount? I have fine horses for sale here.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_bed_000b983f_Oblivion_RESP1: Need a place to rest? I have a room available, if you'd care to rent it for a night.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_Barter_000091c4_Oblivion_RESP1: Need new clothing? I have a fantastic selection.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_Barter_0005e079_Oblivion_RESP1: Need something sharp? Stabbing, cutting, that sort of thing? I can accommodate you, I assure you.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_MS46GoblinWar_0002f477_Oblivion_R: Neither one sounds like a picnic to me.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_SE05Conspiracy_000895dd_Oblivion_: Nelrene admits to being involved, but more evidence may be required.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_SE05HerdirInvestigateCurrentTask_: Nelrene caved in, finally, but we'll need something more to get to the bottom of this. Let's see if Ma'zaddha provides us with more evidence.
Nelrene is clearly withholding information. Persuasion might be in order, or perhaps Ma'zaddha will have something that will help.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_SE05HerdirInvestigateWho_0008e504: Nelrene is lying to you, Inquisitor. She knows more than she tells. You should address that as soon as possible.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_NelsTheNaughtyTopic_00028c36_Obli: Nels is a Nord, and like all Nords he's a lawless barbarian with no respect for authority.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_NelsTheNaughtyTopic_000286dd_Obli: Nels is a drunk. He's doesn't even try to hide that fact. But what else is he? When the liquor has dried, what remains of the man?
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_NelsTheNaughtyTopic_00028cd8_Obli: Nels is dead. You know what that means? You've just shot to the top of my suspect list. You make one wrong move and I'll break you!
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_NelsTheNaughtyTopic_00028cd3_Obli: Nels killed those people and pretty soon he'll come for the rest of it. Don't you worry, when I gather more evidence, I'll take that scum down!
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_NelsTheNaughtyTopic_000286ed_Obli: Nels seems just as unnerved as the rest of us that someone has been killed, but he seems to find solace in a bottle.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_tasks_0000bee2_Oblivion_RESP1: Nenyond Twyll awaits you. Return with Mucianus as quickly as possible, so I may settle the Council's fears.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_ImperialCityTopic_0004762f_Oblivi: Never compromise. Never blink. Never wink at injustice. Never quit trying to make this a better city for everyone.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_DAClavicusChoice4_00026b17_Oblivi: Never did say where it came from. She just showed up with it one day. Said it was called Umbra. But she was different.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_DAClavicusChoice6_00026b19_Oblivi: Never did say where it came from. She just showed up with it one day. Said it was called Umbra. But she was different.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_EyeofNocturnalTOPIC_00026ac7_Obli: Never heard of the thing. And neither has Bejeen. You ask too many questions.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_ForlornWatchman_000365fe_Oblivion: Never heard the name Grantham Blakeley before. Means nothing to me, sorry.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_FGD02Insults_0002cfc2_Oblivion_RE: Never liked you, Redguard. Never will.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_Lost_00081a3a_Oblivion_RESP1: Never mind. A trick of the wind, perhaps.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_CharGenMain_00032b0d_Oblivion_RES: Never mind. Get that gate open.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_Lost_00081a3d_Oblivion_RESP1: Never mind. I must continue to channel Lord Jyggalag's power into the pool.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_SE37EndConversation_000452f4_Obli: Never mind. I'll find someone else to help me with my research.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_causingtrouble_0002ae34_Oblivion_: Never mind. You've done your job. Here's your payment for it.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_MQ07Strangers_00020072_Oblivion_R: Never seen 'em, but I've heard her talking to someone, and I've seen somebody at the window when Jearl wasn't home.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_SE03AReward_0007f3cf_Oblivion_RES: Never seen anything like it, but perhaps his journal can give you some useful information.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GOODBYE_0008ea20_Oblivion_RESP1: Never trust what anyone tells you.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_FGD07Choice4_0009819c_Oblivion_RE: Never! I would rather die! I will tell you nothing!
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_FGD07Choice4_0009819d_Oblivion_RE: Never! I would rather die! I will tell you nothing!
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GREETING_00035676_Oblivion_RESP4: Nevertheless, I shall endeavor to change his mind on the subject. Return tomorrow - perhaps he will see you then.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_Dark08NelsNevConvo_000852c9_Obliv: Nevertheless, I still serve the Empire in my heart and will not abide such talk! Walk away from me now, barbarian, or you'll regret your arrogance.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_Message_0018bc5a_Oblivion_RESP3: Nevertheless, you have done your part. Now, if you wish to learn from me, I have much I can teach you.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_NevilleTopic_0002816d_Oblivion_RE: Neville has a strong sense of justice, I can tell. If we find out who the killer is, he'll take care of things, if you know what I mean.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_NevilleTopic_00028261_Oblivion_RE: Neville is a trained killer! That fascist pig killed those people, I just know it!
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_NevilleTopic_0002825b_Oblivion_RE: Neville may not be in the Legion anymore, but who knows what atrocities he committed.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_NevilleTopic_000286fc_Oblivion_RE: Neville seems different now that someone has been killed. More alert, more aware. Something tells me he's not going to take all of this lying down.
