ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_SE07GreymarchTopic_000910fc_Obliv: Once I'm gone, things usually get bad quickly. Lots of defections. Lots of carnage. But with you at the helm, things will be different!
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GREETING_00041202_Oblivion_RESP1: Once I've perfected my act, I'll be the toast of the Realm!
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_DragonfiresTopic_00037834_Oblivio: Once Martin uses the Amulet of Kings to light the Dragonfires, the barriers between Oblivion and Tamriel will be restored.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_Dark08FinChoice2B_00032bea_Oblivi: Once Phillida is dead, sever his finger, the one that bears an Imperial Legion signet ring!
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_Dark08FinChoice2C_00032beb_Oblivi: Once Phillida is dead, sever his finger, the one that bears an Imperial Legion signet ring!
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_Dark08FinChoice2A_00032be9_Oblivi: Once Phillida is dead, take the very finger from his corpse, the one that bears an Imperial Legion signet ring!
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_IngredientCollection_000aef8d_Obl: Once a week, place a single ingredient in the chest. After twenty-four hours, you'll find a sizable quantity of the ingredient available for use.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GREETING_00009c7c_Oblivion_RESP6: Once a week, you must visit the statue. Talk to it. You will be presented with a list of names and locations.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GREETING_00014440_Oblivion_RESP1: Once again has the Ritual of Accession come full circle!
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GREETING_00016ea6_Oblivion_RESP1: Once again has the Ritual of Accession come full circle!
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GREETING_0007dbfe_Oblivion_RESP1: Once again has the Ritual of Accession come full circle!
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GREETING_0007dbff_Oblivion_RESP1: Once again has the Ritual of Accession come full circle!
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_INFOGENERAL_00043ef1_Oblivion_RES: Once again, Syl uses pain to get what she wants. How long before every one of us is forced to visit Herdir's chamber?
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_INFOGENERAL_000441d5_Oblivion_RES: Once again, the Great Torch burns bright as Arden-Sul foretold.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_INFOGENERAL_00043ee5_Oblivion_RES: Once again, the Lady Syl strikes hard among her own. Her paranoia hasn't faded, in fact it's greatly grown.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_NevilleTopic_00028792_Oblivion_RE: Once an Imperial Legion bulldog, always an Imperial Legion bulldog. I've seen his kind before. He cares about laws and regulations... not people.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_SE13JyggalagSpeech_000635c9_Obliv: Once each era, I was allowed my true form, conquering this world anew. And each time I did, the curse was renewed, damning me to exist as Sheogorath.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_ND09ProphetQuestions02_00002c14_K: Once his spirit is destroyed, he will be completely obliterated -- erased from all realms of existence.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_DarkVampChoice1_000008de_Oblivion: Once infected with vampirism, you must wait three days and then sleep once more. Then the Dark Gift will truly take hold. Sleep now, and awake anew!
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_DarkVampChoice1_0004ce45_Oblivion: Once infected with vampirism, you must wait three days and then sleep once more. Then the Dark Gift will truly take hold. Sleep now, and awake anew!
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_SE08CommanderPlan3_00018c88_Obliv: Once inside, search for the source of the Spire's power. It must be underground somewhere. Once you find it, destroy it.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_SE08CommanderPlan3_00018c89_Obliv: Once inside, search for the source of the Spire's power. It must be underground somewhere. Once you find it, destroy it.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_INFOGENERAL_000434d6_Oblivion_RES: Once more the Isles are protected by the will of Arden-Sul.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_MG07ChoiceKaltharWhy_0003378f_Obl: Once she helped me advance out of that place, and stepped down, then she could have it back! Why did you have to get in the way?
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_SE06HelpDefend_000131b5_Oblivion_: Once the Aureals are destroyed, I will light the Flame of Agnon for you. Will you help us defend the Altar of Despair?
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_SE06FlameAgnon_0003e6a5_Oblivion_: Once the Aureals are routed from the Altar of Rapture, I will be most pleased to command my soldiers to light the Flame for Sheogorath's glory.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GREETING_00030207_Oblivion_RESP5: Once the mage has revealed himself, we will step in and settle the matter quickly. Now, get yourself some sleep. You'll need to be well-rested.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GREETING_0004f220_Oblivion_RESP5: Once the mage has revealed himself, we will step in and settle the matter quickly. Now, get yourself some sleep. You'll need to be well-rested.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_SE12HaskillGreetB1_00016d01_Obliv: Once the source of Madness becomes the Font of Order, Jyggalag has won.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_SE06UlfriGreetA2_000131b3_Oblivio: Once the strength of the Aureals is shattered, I will be honored to light the Flame as my Lord Sheogorath commands.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_SE06FlameAgnon_000131b4_Oblivion_: Once their main force is destroyed, with your help, we can easily take Rapture from the few survivors. Then, I will gladly kindle the Flame for you.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_NDEightAndOneTopic_00002c8d_Knigh: Once there were Eight Divines. Then Tiber Septim became Talos and the Eight became Nine.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_ArcaneULecture5_0007195d_Oblivion: Once these ancient monuments might have been powerful bulwarks of the Cyrodilic emperors, battlemages, and priests.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_SE06UlfriGreetA1_000131b2_Oblivio: Once they break themselves on our defenses, Cylarne will be ours, a gift for our Lord Sheogorath.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GREETING_00026ea7_Oblivion_RESP4: Once they've seen how it's done, they should be able to handle any new gates on their own.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_SE07RitualNoD_0001365f_Oblivion_R: Once this is done, I can pronounce the heart-bearer a Duke or Duchess. Then, all that is required is the blessing of our lord, Sheogorath.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_SE07RitualNoM_00013661_Oblivion_R: Once this is done, I will proclaim the successor a Duke or Duchess. Then, Sheogorath gives His blessing, and the cycle is completed.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_SE06FlameAgnon_00012cc8_Oblivion_: Once we capture the Altar of Despair from the Mazken, it will be my great honor to light the Flame for Lord Sheogorath.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_VahtacenTopic_00035f3c_Oblivion_R: Once we figured out the pillar reacted to spells, we tried out a few. I think I was only unconscious for an hour or so, but that was enough for me.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_AmuletofKingsTopic_0001efe4_Obliv: Once we have it back, Martin can use it to light the Dragonfires in the Temple of the One, and reseal the barriers between Oblivion and our world.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_TG11P4IsThatAll_0001fb71_Oblivion: Once you are inside the palace itself, you need to find the reading room. The blind priests will deliver a scroll to you there.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_Manor_00003a6c_Oblivion_RESP3: Once you buy, you get the key to the front door and the deed of ownership. That's the deal. Would you like to buy it now?
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_SE07Decision_0001e3ec_Oblivion_RE: Once you have decided which Duke to replace, there's no turning back. One choice. No more, no less. Try not to do something stupid.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_MG17GoOn_000366ed_Oblivion_RESP3: Once you have it safely in your possession, return here immediately.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_MS40RewardVampire_000a3df7_Oblivi: Once you have the disease for several days, rest and let the effects take hold. And please, be careful. Good luck.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_HELLO_000343f3_Oblivion_RESP1: Once you locate the Mythic Dawn's shrine to Mehrunes Dagon, we may have a chance to recover the Amulet!
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_SE04SheoLearnWhat_00044f54_Oblivi: Once you understand what My Realm is, you might understand why it's important to keep it intact.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GREETING_0003c13b_Oblivion_RESP1: Once you're rested and equipped, you should have Martin open the portal to Camoran's Paradise immediately.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_CastleGateTopic_00090ab5_Oblivion: Once you've got it, get to the Guard House, find the passage, and open that gate. Then we can get inside the castle and secure it.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_MG05Choice1A_000224e4_Oblivion_RE: Once you've got the book, return it to me immediately. I assure you, it will be worth your time.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GREETING_00030207_Oblivion_RESP2: Once you've rested here, you need to continue along the Gold Road, heading east towards Kvatch.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_HELLO_0004ed62_Oblivion_RESP1: One Moderate Elixir of Exploration, coming right up!
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_ElixirofExploration_0004e91b_Obli: One Strong Elixir of Exploration for you... and many more for sale if you wish to buy.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GREETING_0000296c_Knights_RESP1: One can never be too proficient with a blade, wouldn't you say?
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GREETING_0006dc25_Oblivion_RESP1: One copy of the Black Horse Courier coming up. Gray Fox steals taxes.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_MS45BrethrenTopic_00028214_Oblivi: One day, you'll find out who the Brethren are, and you'll be sorry.  Oh yes.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_SE03AInstExplainChoices_00018dfd_: One is physically harmful... usually lethal traps or creatures... something relished by the residents of Dementia.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_SE02GatesOfMadness_0007eae7_Obliv: One leads to Mania, one to Dementia. Two shades of madness.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_SE02GatesOfMadness_0008e4ce_Obliv: One leads to the lands of Mania, and one to Dementia. The Gatekeeper makes sure no one gets in who isn't supposed to.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GREETING_00081ddf_Oblivion_RESP2: One leads to the lands of Mania. The other to Dementia. Enter through either one. The lands are quite distinct, but both are Sheogorath's domain.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_DovesiDranTopic_000281a0_Oblivion: One less Dark Elf in the world. And now there's one less person to find the gold, as well. It's a good day, don't you think?
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_NelsTheNaughtyTopic_00028cdb_Obli: One less Nord in the world is something I'd normally cheer about, but the fact that he was murdered by a fellow guest does put a damper on things.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_ICAllNQDQuestionResponses_0004993: One man's trash soon becomes another man's trash, I suppose.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GREETING_00015df9_Oblivion_RESP1: One more coin and I can git a pair of shoes.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GREETING_00017660_Oblivion_RESP1: One more match is all you need to advance again, up to Gladiator rank. Most combatants never make it that far. But you are the exception, aren't you?
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_TG01Armand6_0005143f_Oblivion_RES: One more thing. You cannot kill each other during this trial. We may be thieves, but we're not murderers.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_ImperialCityTopic_00047716_Oblivi: One must be very careful in the Imperial City. There are things... dangerous things... that cannot abide the light.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_MQ02JauffreD3_0001e74c_Oblivion_R: One night Uriel called me in to his private chambers. A baby boy lay sleeping in a basket. Uriel told me to deliver him somewhere safe.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_contract_000039e1_Oblivion_RESP1: One of my dear friends was killed while trying to kill Phillida, several years ago. He was twice the assassin you are! Your are doomed to failure.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_SpeakerTopic_000bba99_Oblivion_RE: One of my duties is to find exceptional individuals, such as yourself, and offer a place within our family.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_SE04ChaliceNo_00013309_Oblivion_R: One of my favorite toys. Does wonders for creativity. Well, not by itself, but it helps. Those Elytra, clever little bugs that they are.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_SE08CommanderPlan1_00018c82_Obliv: One of my scouts reported that the ruins have been opened recently and a number of these Knights are now guarding the entrance.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_SE08CommanderPlan1_00018c83_Obliv: One of my scouts reported that the ruins have been opened recently and a number of these Knights are now guarding the entrance.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_FathisUlesTopic_0002ba53_Oblivion: One of the Gray Fox's top bosses, they say. Spends all day drinking at the Oak and Crosier, but he's been asking questions about the Jemanes.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GREETING_00023e15_Oblivion_RESP1: One of the afternoon watch, and all's well. I hope I see you well, ma'am.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GREETING_00023ec2_Oblivion_RESP1: One of the afternoon watch, and all's well. I hope I see you well, sir.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_INFOGENERAL_00064450_Oblivion_RES: One of the castle staff was murdered trying to stop a thief.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_CharGenTaunt2_0003335c_Oblivion_R: One of the guards owes me a favor, you know. I could get us put in the same cell. Would you like that? You should have some fun before the end.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_NDSirBerichTopic_00002c7b_Knights: One of the mightiest knights of my day. It was a great boost to the Order's prestige when he joined.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GREETING_00023e42_Oblivion_RESP1: One of the night watch, and all's well. Take care, ma'am.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GREETING_00023fa2_Oblivion_RESP1: One of the night watch, and all's well. Take care, sir.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_SE11DyusChoice2_00014b5a_Oblivion: One of the oldest trees, named the Tree of Shades, lies in the halls of Milchar. Milchar is a place of ruin, root, and mania.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_BaurusTopic_0006b83d_Oblivion_RES: One of the youngest Blades ever to serve in the Emperor's personal guard.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_MS08AleronHunt_0001fdbc_Oblivion_: One of them will have the key to the door. That's Kurdan's rules. It's the only way we can win.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GREETING_00040cb1_Oblivion_RESP1: One of your military minions was looking for you. It sounded urgent, but I'm afraid I don't know the details.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_BrumaTopic_0003c9bb_Oblivion_RESP: One place is pretty much like another. Regner hates it, but Regner hates everything.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_ArcaneULecture1_00071945_Oblivion: One theory is that the stones were once magical, but they have lost their magic, either through age and disuse, or because of sin or neglect.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GREETING_00028beb_Oblivion_RESP2: One thing I do know is that the killer won't just stop with two. They never do. You and I, we need to watch each other's backs.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_SE11Tree_0008f12b_Oblivion_RESP5: One thing that is not in dispute is that the Tree has survived for eons and its branches are highly valued as components of magical artifacts.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_TGFence01_000165e8_Oblivion_RESP1: Ongar lives in Bruma. He doesn't have much money, but he's the only place you can sell hot property if you are new to the Thieves Guild.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GREETING_0003c9b0_Oblivion_RESP1: Ongar the World-Weary, they call me. I've been everywhere, and done everything. Now I'm settled down for a good long rest.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_TG09BribeBeggar_00015f1f_Oblivion: Only Fathis can open the door to the tower, but there is supposed to be a secret passage somewhere in the castle that leads him to his tower.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_TG09FathisAren_00048972_Oblivion_: Only Fathis can open the door to the tower, but there is supposed to be a secret passage somewhere in the castle that takes him to his tower.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_SE06FlameAgnon_000131b4_Oblivion_: Only Sheogorath's immortal servants can kindle the Altars, and I am at my Lord's command. But I only hold Despair... for the moment.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_BladesTalk5_0006834b_Oblivion_RES: Only a fool would doubt the valor of the Blades, but I must ask the same of you. Do not doubt my valor, do not doubt my resolve. I will not fail you.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_SE30ForgeAmberHammerMagic_000400c: Only a real man can swing this hammer around.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_SE07BGreenmote_000167e3_Oblivion_: Only a select few, such as myself, know the Silo's location. However, we are sworn to secrecy.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_SE07Arden_0001f3ba_Oblivion_RESP4: Only a true Demented can appreciate what it means to render his name.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_NDCrusadersRelicsTopic_00002a81_K: Only a true knight can find them -- or even wield them. Sir Roderic will surely succeed, if anyone can.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_NDPilgrimageTopic_00002a9d_Knight: Only a true knight wielding the Crusader's Relics can stop the evil that now threatens us.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_NDCrusadersRelicsTopic_00002a80_K: Only a true knight, wielding the holy Relics of the Divine Crusader, has a chance to defeat Umaril.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_NDUmarilTopic_00002bf8_Knights_RE: Only a true knight, wielding the holy Relics of the Divine Crusader, has a chance to defeat Umaril.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GREETING_0001ebf3_Oblivion_RESP1: Only a true warrior could have accomplished this task. The Aureals shall sing your story for eons to come.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_SE11Tree_00014b5c_Oblivion_RESP3: Only after facing the truth will the Tree of Shades give up its branches to you.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_goblins_00028887_Oblivion_RESP1: Only good goblin is a dead goblin. I like dead goblins.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_MagesGuildTopic_00062616_Oblivion: Only mages who have gotten recommendations from all the local guild halls can enter the Arcane University. It's a good policy, I think.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_SE03GrommokC3Idle01_0008ea84_Obli: Only me left... fine. I'll show 'em.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_MQ11BrumaAllies_000be327_Oblivion: Only one city has sent aid. My guardsmen are the best in Cyrodiil, but they were never meant to be an army.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_SE46Choice2_0008fab9_Oblivion_RES: Only one group can stick around. Either we Demented or those blasted Manics. It's the only way we'll find any peace.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_TrainingQuestTopic_0018bc61_Obliv: Only one has a better mastery of locks than I. You need to speak to J'baana. You can find him imprisoned at the Imperial Legion headquarters.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_Barter_000091bd_Oblivion_RESP1: Only quality goods for sale here. What can I interest you in?
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_Attack_0001eee6_Oblivion_RESP1: Only the Chosen will survive the Cleansing.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_INFOGENERAL_00077c48_Oblivion_RES: Only the Demented can truly appreciate the Hunger.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_TG10JakBuried_0009deda_Oblivion_R: Only the Earl has a key. I have been warned never to enter it, on pain of death.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GREETING_000237cf_Oblivion_RESP1: Only the finest wares to buy and barter at Northern Goods and Trades. I'm Seed-Neeus, the proprietor. How can I help you?
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_SE06FlameAgnon_0003e6a5_Oblivion_: Only the immortal servants of Sheogorath can kindle the Altars of Despair and Rapture, which in turn feed the holy Flame of Agnon.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_SE06FlameAgnon_000131ac_Oblivion_: Only the servants of Sheogorath can light the Flame, by kindling the Altars of Despair and Rapture which feed the Flame.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_lightthedragonfires_000223e4_Obli: Only the true heir can light the dragonfires, and if he has the Amulet of Kings.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_INFOGENERAL_0018bcc5_Oblivion_RES: Only thing worse than an ogre is two ogres. Tough bastards, and spells seem to bounce right off of 'em.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_DEAkTimeWound_00014e28_AltarDelux: Only this relic would be powerful enough to pervert the Laws of Mundus to this extent.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_MQ15ForbiddenGrotto_0003c80f_Obli: Only those few wearing the Bands of the Chosen are allowed to leave the Garden.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_MQ15MartinB_0003782f_Oblivion_RES: Only those of the Septim blood can wear the Amulet of Kings.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_MQ15BandsOfChosen_00047363_Oblivi: Only those wearing the Bands can enter the Forbidden Grotto. No one who enters the Grotto ever returns.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_MQ15ForbiddenGrotto_00047361_Obli: Only those wearing the Bands of the Chosen may enter the Forbidden Grotto. But they never return, so we don't know what fate awaits them.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_MS26ItiusAccuses_00093cd6_Oblivio: Only those who break the law.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_DovesiDranTopic_00028a0e_Oblivion: Only three of us left, and one of us is a murderer. Do you expect me to believe it's that sweet girl? You murdering scum! I'll kill you!
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GREETING_0002822b_Oblivion_RESP1: Only three of us left. I'm certainly no murderer, and I know it's not you. That leaves one person! We must protect ourselves... find weapons!
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GREETING_0002822a_Oblivion_RESP1: Only three of us left... only three...
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_HELLO_0008152a_Oblivion_RESP1: Only you can eat the fruit of madness.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GREETING_000476d4_Oblivion_RESP1: Ontus Vanin, retired. Sleep late, and read trashy books. I don't keep up with Mages Guild affairs any more.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GREETING_0008961d_Oblivion_RESP1: Ooh! I found a dead Gnarl, don't get to count those every day. Here, take this.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_HELLO_0008152b_Oblivion_RESP1: Ooh! You have a nice stick!
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_contract_0006145d_Oblivion_RESP1: Ooh, a secret assignment, you say? Come on, can't you give your old pal Mraaj-Dar a hint? Who do you have to kill? Anyone I know? Ha ha ha ha!
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_Dark08Choice3B_0002798f_Oblivion_: Ooh, good idea! Maybe the chest is hidden under the floorboards! All right, I'll head down there and start looking.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_contract_0000c0a6_Oblivion_RESP1: Ooh, using poision is so deliciously evil! I once poisioned my aunt's stew, and she fell over dead with her face right in the bowl! Ha ha ha ha ha!
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_AssaultNoCrime_00062505_Oblivion_: Oooh, I hope you know what you're doing...
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_CharGenTaunt2_00033345_Oblivion_R: Oooh, aren't you a fair lass. Your skin is so pale, so pure. And your body is so... strong. Let me guess. A Nord, right?
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_PickpocketNoCrime_00062509_Oblivi: Oooh, you're good! He he he he he.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_HELLO_000029a7_Knights_RESP1: Open the gate, please. I must get out of here.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_SE32FanaticYell_0001b707_Oblivion: Open the gates! Let in the horde!
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_Manor_00003a5a_Oblivion_RESP1: Opening the door seems to have stopped the ghost attacks. Perhaps I'll leave you to the rest of this mission since my part is done.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_SE04WhatHappened_00019524_Oblivio: Opposites repel, strangely enough. All that pleasure and pain locked away now, as if it never happened.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_SE11SheogorathChoice2_00014b68_Ob: Optimism! How adorable! I love it! Even at the end, you make me laugh. I'm lying. That wasn't funny at all.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GREETING_0003630f_Oblivion_RESP3: Or he did, anyway. He told me he was leaving Anvil. I'm sorry, but that's all I know!
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GREETING_0007ac76_Oblivion_RESP3: Or is there something else I can take from -- I mean, help you with?
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GREETING_00023e81_Oblivion_RESP2: Or rather, you did. Yes, that's it. *hic* Aren't you doing a job for me? You should be off, then.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_HouseBuyBravil_0004ed83_Oblivion_: Or you could always eat off the floor... doesn't matter to me.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_SE03AChamber_00018e5e_Oblivion_RE: Or, if you're feeling merciful, we can have the group terrorized by a seemingly lowly Gnarl that instantly grows to twice their size!
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_DAHircineChoice1_0001ec5f_Oblivio: Or, perhaps you will learn what it is to be the hunted.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_duties_000474fb_Oblivion_RESP2: Or, perhaps you're ready for advancement.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_SE03AChamber_00019847_Oblivion_RE: Or, we can create the illusion of the adventurer dying and his spirit rising from his corpse. Good fun to be had for all!
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_SE03AChamber_00018ff1_Oblivion_RE: Or, you can fill the chamber with hundreds of keys and watch them frantically search for the correct one. Always a crowd pleaser.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_SE39CindanweChoice_000781fc_Obliv: Or, you could make her life so miserable that she leaves us alone. She needs everything "just so."  So, sneak into her house and wreck the place!
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_SE01HaskillChoice7_000133e6_Obliv: Or, you may continue onward, through the door behind me. If you can pass the Gates of Madness, perhaps the Lord Sheogorath will find a use for you.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_LeyawiinTopic_00091b41_Oblivion_R: Orc named Mazoga says she's a knight. I doubt it. The Count wants it looked into. Why don't you talk to him?
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_DAMalacathChoice1_0001ec3d_Oblivi: Orcs are always welcome. But Malacath wants a present. Like Troll fat. And only Troll fat.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_DAMalacathSpeech_000579d0_Oblivio: Orcs are smart. They know, you want something, you do what the Boss tells you. So listen good...
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_INFOGENERAL_000624ca_Oblivion_RES: Orcs don't ride horses. They eat horses. And sometimes I think they're the smart ones. Wait, maybe it's Dunmer who eat horses.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_SE07AThadonLeaves_000206c1_Oblivi: Order approaches! It's taken the Fringe already! With Order clothes and Order hats! And you speak of "change"?
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_Attack_0008f585_Oblivion_RESP1: Order has always proved the stronger.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_INFOGENERAL_0005ef56_Oblivion_RES: Order has attacked Passwall. Probably brought horrible disease with them, as well.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_INFOGENERAL_000607a6_Oblivion_RES: Order has been defeated. I'm glad that's over. Mama always said, "The end of the world only happens once."
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_INFOGENERAL_000607a5_Oblivion_RES: Order has been destroyed and we still stand! Joy and tidings to all!
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_SE10DyloraTopic_00017d0d_Oblivion: Order has kept her hostage so that she cannot return to us and lead us. If we can free her, she may know how best to defeat them.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_SE10StaadaTopic_00016b39_Oblivion: Order has kept her hostage so that she cannot return to us and lead us. If we can free her, she may know how best to defeat them.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_DASheogorathSpeech_00095785_Obliv: Order is at our doorstep, yet you felt it necessary to offer some yarn to... yourself. An interesting choice, to be sure.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_INFOGENERAL_000607d4_Oblivion_RES: Order is defeated! I think I actually feel a little better. No... I don't.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_INFOGENERAL_000607a3_Oblivion_RES: Order is defeated! Triumph for us all! Songs of gladness!
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_INFOGENERAL_000607a9_Oblivion_RES: Order is defeated, and Sheer-Meedish is safe. Praise Sheogorath!
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_INFOGENERAL_000607df_Oblivion_RES: Order is defeated, but the cats still prey on us all.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_INFOGENERAL_000607b5_Oblivion_RES: Order is gone! They didn't leave anything interesting behind, though.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_SE13JyggalagVoice_000949e6_Oblivi: Order shall rule this world once more!
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_SE07BSylLeaves_0003b821_Oblivion_: Order stands at our door. They've taken the Fringe! Did you even know? Do you care? And you speak of "change"?
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_Attack_0001a7f7_Oblivion_RESP1: Order will rule this Realm! It is foreordained!
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GREETING_0008ef2d_Oblivion_RESP1: Order will rule this realm. It is foreordained.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GREETING_00081bf7_Oblivion_RESP4: Order's time has come. The Greymarch is upon you.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GREETING_0008f7d1_Oblivion_RESP5: Order's time has come. The Greymarch is upon you.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_SE13CaptainGreetA3_0005e37c_Obliv: Order. An obelisk has activated just outside the Palace. I've ordered my Aureals to engage the enemy.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_SE13CaptainGreetA1_0001a79d_Obliv: Order. An obelisk has activated just outside the Palace. I've ordered my Mazken to engage the enemy.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_SE12HaskillGreetA2_00016cff_Obliv: Order. The taint appeared only a short time ago, but it has spread quickly. I fear that soon we will all be serving a new master.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_MS31Wrath01Positive_0001525e_Obli: Orders? Selene didn't tell me about this, and I don't remember her taking on someone else to help us find the Golden Galleon.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GREETING_000459b4_Oblivion_RESP2: Ordinarily, we could clear this up with a token payment, but under the circumstances, the peace of the Realm requires that I escort you away.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_INFOGENERAL_00032e5c_Oblivion_RES: Oreyn and the new master have saved the guild, sure enough. But we can't let it go to their heads.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_INFOGENERAL_00032e64_Oblivion_RES: Oreyn has a plan. Just keep your mouth shut, and stay away from Vilena.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_INFOGENERAL_00032e6c_Oblivion_RES: Oreyn is in a foul mood lately. I think he's just about out of patience with Vilena and the whole Blackwood Company situation.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_INFOGENERAL_00032e80_Oblivion_RES: Oreyn is pretty steamed up about Maglir. He can get expelled for that, can't he?
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_INFOGENERAL_00032e78_Oblivion_RES: Oreyn is trying to get Viranus out in the field, but Vilena keeps interfering.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_INFOGENERAL_00032e7b_Oblivion_RES: Oreyn says the new guy went down and sorted out the problem in Leyawiin. Trouble like that is just making things worse.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GREETING_0001f369_Oblivion_RESP1: Orinthal, retired Assassin. Now I live here. Only Redguard here, incidentally. An interesting fact, isn't it? I do enjoy facts.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_MagesGuildTopic_00062614_Oblivion: Orintur doesn't like to brag, but no one can match the Reflect spells he can cast. He might teach you one, if you're skilled enough.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_TGFence04_000165eb_Oblivion_RESP1: Orrin is a respectable fence, if there is such a thing. He's got a decent amount of gold, but is a tough negotiator. Go to him instead of Luciana.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_BravilTopic_0004891f_Oblivion_RES: Other Bravil trainers? City-Swimmer teaches Sneak. Dro'shanji teaches Security. Varon Vamori teaches Speechcraft.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_ImperialCityTopic_00047646_Oblivi: Other arcane trainers in the City? Just one. Dovyn Aren. In the Market District. Basic instructor in Alteration.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_ArcaneULecture2_00071925_Oblivion: Others assign the runestones to the Merethic or Early First Era, primarily on the basis of their simple, even crude design and craft.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GREETING_0000c08d_Oblivion_RESP3: Others felt it appropriate to fight fire with fire, as it were. The Council has shattered, and artifacts have been lost.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_AncotarTopic_000301e9_Oblivion_RE: Others in the village are not so forgiving, though. I don't blame him for keeping to himself.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_INFOGENERAL_000498ce_Oblivion_RES: Othrelos is a sneaky one. Kind of makes you wonder what he's up to.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GREETING_0004769a_Oblivion_RESP1: Othrelos. I'm a Sneak... Advanced Sneak, in fact. And I train Sneaks. No law against it.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_HorseInquiry_000545dd_Oblivion_RE: Our Bay horses are faster than the Paint horses and tougher than the Chestnut. You'll be proud to own one.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_ChorrolTopic_0018d2f9_Oblivion_RE: Our Countess will never let Chorrol fall to the daedra! Oblivion Gates be damned!
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_CheydinhalTopic_0004e89e_Oblivion: Our Dark Elves left Morrowind to get away from the Church and State, and they don't like it when Imperials get all holy and patriotic with them.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_Dark18Choice2C_00090794_Oblivion_: Our Dread Father foresaw your defeat of the traitor, here in this very crypt! You have been chosen! You are to be my new Listener!
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_AnvilTopic_0003e0b6_Oblivion_RESP: Our Fighters Guild chapter here is big, primarily because we're a training center, which earns us each a good living.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GREETING_0001ebc3_Oblivion_RESP1: Our Lady has given you a task. The blessings of the Webspinner be upon you.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_NightMother_000251f3_Oblivion_RES: Our Lady is surely an ancient and powerful elf. Someday, when I am Listener of the Black Hand, I will look upon her beautiful and unholy form!
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_HELLO_00081dcf_Oblivion_RESP1: Our Lord comes singing! Songs for Sheogorath!
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_INFOGENERAL_0005f3fb_Oblivion_RES: Our Lord has His armies restored. They carry such wonderfully sharp blades.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_SEWildernessRumorResponses_00061c: Our Lord has protected us once again.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_SE09HaskillXaselmNo_0004036d_Obli: Our Lord is always acquainted with Sorceress Verenim's current whereabouts. Her affections have caused Him unnecessary annoyance in the past.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_INFOGENERAL_000603a0_Oblivion_RES: Our Lord is missing? Perhaps I should get his things. To keep them safe.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_INFOGENERAL_000605eb_Oblivion_RES: Our Lord is too scared to face the Greymarch, is he? Coward! Good riddance.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_SE09HaskillRelmynaVerenim_0004036: Our Lord took interest and brought her here, so Relmyna might continue her work, free of those provincial notions of decency and morality.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_INFOGENERAL_0005f3eb_Oblivion_RES: Our Lord's armies are at full strength. A toast to Our Lord!
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_SEDementiaRumorResponses_00061c68: Our Lord's armies will destroy these Knights.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_OrderOfTalosTopic_00033dfd_Oblivi: Our Order works to spread the teachings and worship of the divine Talos.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_JorundrTopic_00053278_Oblivion_RE: Our affairs are none of your business. I don't know who you are, and you think I'm going to talk to you about my ex-lover?
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_NDProphetSpeechMQ_00002a63_Knight: Our ancient enemy has returned, from the deeps of time, to exact his revenge upon the gods.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_MS22HighFane_0002c819_Oblivion_RE: Our arrangement was clear. I would pay you for delivering me the carving. Since Maric delivered the carving, he earned the reward.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GREETING_0001da4c_Oblivion_RESP1: Our brother returns to the fold!
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_HELLO_0008119b_Oblivion_RESP1: Our child stands guard once again.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_MQ15KathutetA_0003c80c_Oblivion_R: Our clan sacked your city of Kvatch... a trifling task fit for scamps.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_HELLO_0005374b_Oblivion_RESP1: Our conversations are done. There's nothing else to say.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_NDTalk4_00002bba_Knights_RESP1: Our first step is informing the others, of course. The Knights of the Nine must be one, in both voice and action.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_SEPinnacleRockTopic_00080d92_Obli: Our fortress and sanctuary here in the Shivering Isles.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_MS49Choice1A_0002ad7d_Oblivion_RE: Our goal is the Castle gate. We should be able to use this door to get out to the plaza in front of the Castle gatehouse.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_VampireTopic_0001d24b_Oblivion_RE: Our goal is to root out the vampires that live in our fair city. So far, we've been unsuccessful finding one until now.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_AnvilTopic_0003e0b4_Oblivion_RESP: Our gracious Countess funds my research. I ward tame rats with resistance spells, then shower them with elemental attacks.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_NDKnightsTopic_00002bdb_Knights_R: Our greed for the relics overshadowed our faith in the Nine. I can only hope that you are stronger than we were.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_MagesGuildTopic_00062612_Oblivion: Our hall doesn't offer much in the way of training. I can teach some basic Alteration skills, but that's about it.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_SEBrellachTopic_00018dc5_Oblivion: Our home and sanctuary here in the Shivering Isles.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_MSMiscKotT_000c453c_Oblivion_RESP: Our job is to protect Cheydinhal from any aggressor. We are sworn to this duty and would die before letting any harm befall her.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_MS09PleaseGoOn_00053725_Oblivion_: Our last score was a tax shipment being delivered to the Imperial City. We robbed it, and in the midst of the chaos, Jorundr killed a guard.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_CropsfordTopic_00023f56_Oblivion_: Our little farm is thriving. We couldn't have done it without your help. Come back and visit us anytime.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_JskarTopic_000579dd_Oblivion_RESP: Our little transaction has been concluded. You may return victorious to Jeanne. Lucky you.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_HELLO_00091b29_Oblivion_RESP1: Our love has made me the happiest woman in the Isles.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_CheydinhalTopic_0004e891_Oblivion: Our most celebrated citizen is Rythe Lythandas, the famous painter. Speak to his wife, and she might let you take a peek into his studio.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_UmbacanoTopic_000a944e_Oblivion_R: Our mutual employer rarely tells us the whole story, but he pays very well! Not that I should be giving advice to one of my rivals, ha ha ha!
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GlarthirTopic_00023662_Oblivion_R: Our neighbor. A bit eccentric. Why, is there something I should know?
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_INFOGENERAL_00032e7d_Oblivion_RES: Our new recruit says Maglir completed the Fallen Rock Cave contract. Oreyn refuses to talk about it.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_MS14TruepaintTopicNo_0018bc29_Obl: Our only hope is to defeat the Painted Trolls.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_OblivionGateTopic_00085716_Oblivi: Our only hope is to recover the Amulet of Kings from Mankar Camoran.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_LeyawiinTopic_0018d305_Oblivion_R: Our only hope to weather this Oblivion invasion is to defend our walls and be damned to what happens outside them.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_SESylTopic_0008f177_Oblivion_RESP: Our own Duchess, aligned with the forces of Order? An infuriating thought!
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_SEThadonTopic_0008f178_Oblivion_R: Our own Duke, aligned with the forces of Order? An infuriating thought!
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_SEAureals_00012cc2_Oblivion_RESP1: Our rivals. The so-called Golden Saints. One day, Sheogorath will finally recognize their bull-headed stupidity and expel them from the Realm.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GREETING_000980c4_Oblivion_RESP1: Our sister returns to the fold!
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GREETING_00072c91_Oblivion_RESP2: Our situation is desperate, she controls our minds... but wait, I've said too much.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_SE10Trouble_00016812_Oblivion_RES: Our stronghold at Brellach is under attack! The forces of Order broke in and routed us! You must go to Issmi at once and aid her!
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_SE10Trouble_00017d15_Oblivion_RES: Our stronghold at Pinnacle Rock is under attack! The forces of Order broke in and routed us! You must go to Adeo at once and aid her!
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GREETING_0003d48d_Oblivion_RESP4: Our targets? Weak willed men who are easily fooled into believing they will have their way with us. Hahaha... men are so gullible.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_SEArctusSpeech08_00089890_Oblivio: Our time has come, brethren. The die has been cast, and the Flame of the Demented blazes like the fire in our hearts!
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GREETING_0001ebba_Oblivion_RESP1: Our time must now be spent in prayer. Perfect order must be achieved.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GOODBYE_0008da94_Oblivion_RESP1: Our transaction is complete. I trust you'll keep this between us, yes?
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GOODBYE_00143f0d_Oblivion_RESP1: Our transaction is complete. I trust you'll keep this between us, yes?
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GREETING_00005672_Oblivion_RESP1: Our troubles are almost at an end, Brother. Soon we will visit the Night Mother, and she will surely guide us.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GREETING_00005673_Oblivion_RESP1: Our troubles are almost at an end, Sister. Soon we will visit the Night Mother, and she will surely guide us.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_HELLO_000029cb_Knights_RESP1: Our valor is useless against this daedric devilry!
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_SE10WhatNow_00044303_Oblivion_RES: Our warriors will scour the halls of Brellach, removing any last elements of opposition. Then, we will immediately return to our duties.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_SE10WhatNow_0001b6b9_Oblivion_RES: Our warriors will scour the halls of Pinnacle Rock, removing any last elements of opposition. Then, we will immediately return to our duties.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_CureforVampirism_000977d5_Oblivio: Our work here is done. You should be on your way.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_Sanctuary_000251f5_Oblivion_RESP1: Ours is not the only Dark Brotherhood Sanctuary. There are others, hidden throughout Cyrodiil, each one overseen by a Speaker of the Black Hand.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_SE09VictimChoice2b_00082092_Obliv: Out of deference to my Lord Sheogorath, I will allow this outburst. In fact, I will acquiesce to your request.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_HELLO_00090990_Oblivion_RESP1: Out of the frying pan into the fire, eh?
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_HELLO_00085919_Oblivion_RESP1: Out of the way slop drudge.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_MQ05GwinasA7_00035c5c_Oblivion_RE: Outrageous! And you have the nerve to brag about it to my face? I have half a mind to call the guards and have you arrested!
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_SEWildernessRumorResponses_000607: Outsiders are always up to no good.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_HackdirtTopic_0002869e_Oblivion_R: Outsiders came and burned our town, years ago.  Ruined us.  But we'll get ours back, one day soon.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_SEManiaRumorResponses_000607dc_Ob: Outsiders should stay out of our home.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_SE38TalkItem4_00081ec4_Oblivion_R: Over here is the Pelvis of Pelagius, the greatest Emperor that Tamriel has ever seen, as well as being completely mad.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_NDCrusadersRelicsTopic_00002a83_K: Over the ages, knights have quested for the Relics, and sometimes one or another of them have been found, but never for long.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_TG10JaksDiarySays_00015313_Oblivi: Over the centuries there have been dozens of Gray Foxes. To the rest of the world he seems immortal and unchanging. I am hoping to be the last.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_MQ09GhostC_00036667_Oblivion_RESP: Over the uncounted years of our slavery here, we have brooded over our defeat. I believe that we can undo the Underking's evil magic.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_SE30Matrices_0001e697_Oblivion_RE: Over time they soak in magical energies from the world around them. Like you suck blood from a cut.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_Idle_0018b5d3_Oblivion_RESP1: Oviparous. Ovovivparous. What's the difference? We are born and we die.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_SE37EndConversation_000452e1_Obli: Ow! These holes in my shoes are killing me. Well, gotta run!
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_BlademasterTopic_00146855_Oblivio: Owyn likes to think he's the boss, but without me, this place would fall apart. Who orders the ointment? Who mops up the blood? Me, that's who!
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_BieneAmelionTOPIC_000091ee_Oblivi: Paid her debt off yourself, did you? Not gonna get rich that way, meat. Still, the job's done. Here's your payment.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_CharGenTaunt2_00033352_Oblivion_R: Pale skin, snotty expression. You're a Breton! The masters of magicka, right? Hmph. Nothing but a bunch of stuck-up snobs with cheap parlor tricks.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_CharGenTaunt2_00033353_Oblivion_R: Pale skin, snotty expression. You're a Breton! The masters of magicka, right? Hmph. You're nothing but a stuck-up harlot with cheap parlor tricks.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_TrainingQuestTopic_000613a9_Obliv: Palonirya is one of the wealthiest traders in Cyrodiil. Her shop in the Imperial City is so successful. If anyone can teach you more, she can.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_SE05Conspiracy_000895e1_Oblivion_: Paranoia is the order of the day in Crucible. Many keep their eyes open constantly, and some of those eyes may have seen something useful.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GREETING_00030187_Oblivion_RESP1: Pardon me, but did I hear you say that you're a traveling merchant?
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_HELLO_0006a829_Oblivion_RESP1: Pardon me, noble Scholar, but... Could I speak with you a minute?
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GREETING_0001db1e_Oblivion_RESP1: Pardon me. I'm sorry to trouble you, but I was sent to ask for your help.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_INFOGENERAL_0003c22e_Oblivion_RES: Parwen has really got a thing for goblins. I think she and Ah-Malz keep a running tally of who has killed more.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_INFOGENERAL_0003c22d_Oblivion_RES: Parwen is another one of those goblin hunters at the Fighters Guild. She's always talking about her "goblin killing tactics."
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_INFOGENERAL_0005eeca_Oblivion_RES: Passwall attacked by Order. In all the destruction, no sign of the Fork.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_INFOGENERAL_0005eeff_Oblivion_RES: Passwall has been destroyed. Can the rest of the Isles be far behind?
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_SE08PasswallTopic_000415db_Oblivi: Passwall has served as an outpost for our defense of the Realm for millennia.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_SE08PasswallTopic_000415dc_Oblivi: Passwall has served as an outpost for our defense of the Realm for millennia.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_INFOGENERAL_0005ef14_Oblivion_RES: Passwall is in ruins. I should see what they left behind.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_SEWildernessRumorResponses_000617: Passwall is only the first, I'm sure. Where are the armies to protect us?
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GREETING_00017974_Oblivion_RESP1: Passwall must have a new dawn. The struggle will be great, but I have no doubt that we shall overcome this dark time.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_MS18Convo_0001cb76_Oblivion_RESP1: Patience, Antus. He'll be here as soon as he can. Don't be so anxious to go rushing into battle.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_NDTalkUmaril2_00002c54_Knights_RE: Patience, brother. The Commander must gather the Relics first, if we are to have any chance at defeating Umaril.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GREETING_0004e8b6_Oblivion_RESP2: Patience. Caution. Slow and steady wins the race, my father always said. Careless fighters get one last white shirt and a box. Not me.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_MQ06ShrineTalkPatience_0003641c_O: Patience. We will see Lord Dagon walk the earth with our own eyes. Nothing can stop us now.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_Training_00066a5f_Oblivion_RESP1: Pay attention, and you can learn a lot.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_SE36OnDeath_0007cc51_Oblivion_RES: Peace at last. Thank you! Thank you...
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_NDProphetSpeechMain_00002a6e_Knig: Pelinal Whitestrake once struck down the enemies of man and god. Who will now reclaim his Relics and fight again for the true faith?
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_ND10UmarilVoice_00002c39_Knights_: Pelinal na vasha. Sa yando tye.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_NDCrusadersRelicsTopic_00002a83_K: Pelinal was taken by the Ayleids after his battle with Umaril, and his body cut into eight parts and scattered across their realm.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_NDProphetStartA2_00002c82_Knights: Pelinal, with the aid of the gods, fought the Ayleid sorceror-king Umaril and slew him. But Umaril's spirit survived, and he has now returned!
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GREETING_0004773f_Oblivion_RESP1: Pennus Mallius, adventurer-at-large. Just between adventures at present, I'm afraid.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_INFOGENERAL_00060563_Oblivion_RES: People act like Sheogorath's disappearance is of some grave significance. But the Shivering Isles are the same as ever, I assure you.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_INFOGENERAL_000c47e0_Oblivion_RES: People always enjoy a good fable. M'aiq has yet to find one, though. Perhaps one day.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_INFOGENERAL_00044216_Oblivion_RES: People are all excited about the Great Torch being relit. Personally, I don't pay any attention to politics.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_LeyawiinTopic_00159762_Oblivion_R: People are beginning to have second thoughts about the Blackwood Company after the Azani Blackheart hoax.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GOODBYE_0008656c_Oblivion_RESP1: People are just ignorant around here...
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_INFOGENERAL_0018b1f8_Oblivion_RES: People are subdued. Troubled. A crisis like this tests the people's faith.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_INFOGENERAL_0004351b_Oblivion_RES: People are talking about a Resonator. Unless it makes more pests to kill, Relan does not care.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_INFOGENERAL_00042d99_Oblivion_RES: People are talking about a new adventurer who is seeking to get into the Isles. Mama warned me, "Only go where you've been invited."

ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_ImperialCityTopic_0004774f_Oblivi: People in the city, they get stuff and forget to pay. So I help 'em remember. You talk to 'em, lean on 'em a bit, and they remember right away.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_INFOGENERAL_000434fd_Oblivion_RES: People keep saying that the Gatekeeper is dead. I have no idea what that means. Do you know?
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_INFOGENERAL_0005f4c5_Oblivion_RES: People keep telling me that the armies of Sheogorath are reassembled... as if this is something that we should be happy about.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_MS08Hunt_0001fdbb_Oblivion_RESP2: People pay him a great deal of money to hunt and kill living human prey. No questions asked, and he takes care of the bodies.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_ChorrolNQDResponses_00029fc7_Obli: People say he's very familiar with the area.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_MS29ThoronirBad_0000bca2_Oblivion: People who buy tend to want to spend their money there. That leaves none for us. It's getting so bad, a few of us may have to close up shop.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_KvatchTopic_000039d7_Oblivion_RES: People who fought, died. People who ran... they at least had a chance.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GREETING_0004e8d8_Oblivion_RESP2: People, I teach them Advanced Acrobatics. Up and jump. Dogs, I teach them to bite people.

ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_MGExpelAccept_00026d94_Oblivion_R: Perhaps, while you spend time collecting these ingredients, you can consider the ramifications of your actions.
