ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GREETING_00012d0a_Oblivion_RESP1: Please! I must find my betrothed!
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GREETING_000b0719_Oblivion_RESP1: Please! I've got to get to work! All we have left is the farm!
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GREETING_0001ebd4_Oblivion_RESP1: Please! I've got to get to work. If I don't... who knows what those ogres will do to me!
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_BladesTalk1_00067dca_Oblivion_RES: Please, Blade, say what you will, but let us forgo these absurd formalities. I am no "lord" yet. I would remain plain Martin for a while.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_VenaPetilius_00026b4a_Oblivion_RE: Please, I do not wish to speak of her. My wife is buried here, and I only wish to visit her grave in peace. It is a sacred place to me.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_HELLO_000093c2_Oblivion_RESP1: Please, I don't know where to turn.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_SQ10Husband_00061420_Oblivion_RES: Please, I don't think he's ever coming back, and I'd hate to lose such a precious heirloom to a gang of thugs.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GREETING_00013ffe_Oblivion_RESP1: Please, I have done all I can. There is nothing more to say. Just be cautious.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GOODBYE_000432b6_Oblivion_RESP1: Please, I have much to tell you. Don't go.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GREETING_0008f11f_Oblivion_RESP2: Please, I mean you no violence. Perhaps you can help me.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GREETING_0008b070_Oblivion_RESP1: Please, I no longer have a desire to speak with you. I appreciate what you've done in the past, but that's just what it is... the past.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GREETING_000907a1_Oblivion_RESP1: Please, I wish to be alone with my thoughts.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GREETING_000919c5_Oblivion_RESP1: Please, I'd like to be left alone.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GOODBYE_00002db6_Oblivion_RESP1: Please, I'm an old man! Just leave me be!
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GOODBYE_0003cd67_Oblivion_RESP1: Please, I'm in desperate need of help, and I think you're the only one that I can turn to!
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GREETING_0001da4e_Oblivion_RESP1: Please, I've much to do. We'll speak again soon at the meeting place of the Order.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_FaelianTopic_0002ff13_Oblivion_RE: Please, I... I don't mean to get emotional but... I feel I can trust you. I just don't know what to do about Faelian!
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GREETING_0001da68_Oblivion_RESP1: Please, Seridur is anxious for your report.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_SE10NotReady_00081cad_Oblivion_RE: Please, Your Grace. Hurry; we haven't much time.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_SE10NotReady_00081cae_Oblivion_RE: Please, Your Grace. Hurry; we haven't much time.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_SE41Cure_0006ea71_Oblivion_RESP2: Please, accept this as a gesture of thanks. It's the least I can do for you... after all, you saved my life!
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GREETING_00017ca3_Oblivion_RESP3: Please, allow me to teach you this spell, so that you may summon our kind to you in times of need.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GREETING_00017cf9_Oblivion_RESP3: Please, allow me to teach you this spell, so that you may summon our kind to you in times of need.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_ShadeoftheRevenant_0000357b_Obliv: Please, be careful. Anything you find is of no use to us if you do not survive. I believe we are dealing with powerful forces here.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_MS43Staff_0004f8bc_Oblivion_RESP4: Please, bring Rosentia this information at once. And if you can, help her. I think she's about to crack under the pressure, poor thing.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GOODBYE_0007ac70_Oblivion_RESP1: Please, come back soon. No telling what oddities I may have for you next time.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GOODBYE_0004f9c3_Oblivion_RESP1: Please, consider my proposal. The reward will be worth the risk.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GREETING_00022500_Oblivion_RESP2: Please, do not let my appearance... unnerve you. The needs and Tenets of the Dark Brotherhood come before my own needs as a vampire.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_HELLO_000c42c6_Oblivion_RESP1: Please, do what you can to protect Antus. He's just a kid.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GREETING_00031036_Oblivion_RESP2: Please, don't be mad. We were just having some fun.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_HELLO_000206c9_Oblivion_RESP1: Please, don't continue speaking with me... time is of the essence.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GREETING_0004f8c1_Oblivion_RESP1: Please, don't dawdle here... get to the Mages Guild! Hurry!
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GOODBYE_00189d0a_Oblivion_RESP1: Please, don't go. You may be my only hope.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_HELLO_00047359_Oblivion_RESP1: Please, don't let Anaxes loose! He torments us night and day!
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_MS23SeridurHeSays_000947c1_Oblivi: Please, don't let him deceive you. You must return there and put an end to his masquerade. Quickly, before he has a chance to get away!
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GREETING_00036618_Oblivion_RESP1: Please, don't tell her what I've done. I can make it worth your while....
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_HELLO_000c42d4_Oblivion_RESP1: Please, don't waste time speaking to an old man. Go and help my sons.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_HELLO_00088b34_Oblivion_RESP1: Please, end this nightmare if you can.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_SEPayGoldforCrime_000459c8_Oblivi: Please, follow me, and we'll have this matter cleared up in no time.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GREETING_0003a902_Oblivion_RESP2: Please, friend. Make haste! This waiting about is torture! I know in my heart who I am, but with evidence I can prove my claim to all of Tamriel!
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GREETING_0003a903_Oblivion_RESP2: Please, friend. Make haste! This waiting about is torture! I know in my heart who I am, but with evidence I can prove my claim to all of Tamriel!
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GOODBYE_00094ebf_Oblivion_RESP1: Please, get those things out of here.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_AlbertJemaneTopic_0008b073_Oblivi: Please, go away before I lose my temper. I know I'm no match for you in combat, but I don't have to talk to you.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GOODBYE_0004f548_Oblivion_RESP1: Please, go find Pinarus, and those mountain lions!
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_HELLO_0003c36a_Oblivion_RESP1: Please, go get Ulrich and convince him to follow you here. I'll do the rest.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GOODBYE_0003ca4b_Oblivion_RESP1: Please, help me find what I've lost.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_Creatures_000224ad_Oblivion_RESP1: Please, hurry so you can accompany my sons. They're probably waiting at Weynon Priory by now.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GOODBYE_00048733_Oblivion_RESP1: Please, hurry! Get rid of those things!
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_MG12TravenWhat_000835fb_Oblivion_: Please, hurry. The Battlemages will arrive there soon, if they have not already, and time is of the essence.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_MG14Choice1B_0000a0fc_Oblivion_RE: Please, hurry. The division in the Council will be difficult, if not impossible, to reconcile.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GREETING_0003b1db_Oblivion_RESP1: Please, just kill me! Can't you see? It's what I want! I can't live like this, knowing I'm something filthy, something evil! Kill me!
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_NelsTheNaughtyTopic_00028247_Obli: Please, just leave me alone! Either you or Nels is a murderer. I just don't know who to trust anymore!
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GREETING_0002f4da_Oblivion_RESP1: Please, just take what you want and leave! I won't call the guards, I swear!
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_MS16Choice2C_000242b1_Oblivion_RE: Please, keep looking. I know it's out there somewhere. You'll find it eventually.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GREETING_0000299b_Knights_RESP1: Please, leave me be. I need rest...
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GREETING_0000292e_Knights_RESP1: Please, leave me be. I need time to think on what I've seen and done.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GREETING_00002911_Knights_RESP1: Please, leave me be. I've no interest in visitors. I'm far too weak.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GREETING_0009811e_Oblivion_RESP2: Please, leave me to my grief.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GREETING_0002809b_Oblivion_RESP1: Please, let me out of here! You must help me escape. I think these creatures plan to do something horrible to me tonight!
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GREETING_0004e930_Oblivion_RESP1: Please, listen to what I have to say; it could be lucrative for the both of us.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_Barter_0005e00d_Oblivion_RESP1: Please, look. Buy. Something here might save you when the end comes.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GREETING_00078cad_Oblivion_RESP1: Please, meet me in the reception chamber.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_MQ13MartinD2_0009ce84_Oblivion_RE: Please, my friend. I need your judgement, not your obedience.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GREETING_000852dc_Oblivion_RESP1: Please, not now. I just want to be by myself for a bit.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_MG13Choice1B_000039a1_Oblivion_RE: Please, prepare yourself as quickly as possible.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_LadyRogbutTOPIC_0000be77_Oblivion: Please, rescue my daughter from those brutes! I fear for her safe return!
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GOODBYE_0001e7a1_Oblivion_RESP1: Please, return soon. It's always a pleasure to see you.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_BloodwormHelmTopic_0000c08b_Obliv: Please, return the helm here before any harm comes to it, or those who are using it.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GREETING_0000be66_Oblivion_RESP1: Please, see if you can't find our friends who have disappeared.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GREETING_0001bb28_Oblivion_RESP1: Please, share the hospitality of our home.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_CharGenMain_0004d84c_Oblivion_RES: Please, sire, we must keep moving.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_CharGenMain_0004f77a_Oblivion_RES: Please, sire. We can't stay here. We have to go.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_SE05MazaddhaSawYou_00081186_Obliv: Please, spare me! I'll do anything!
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GREETING_0002815f_Oblivion_RESP1: Please, sweetie, stay close to me.  The killer might strike again, whoever he... or she... is.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_HELLO_0006ea95_Oblivion_RESP1: Please, tell me you have my remedy... I can't hold out much longer!
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_BladesTalk4_00067dc5_Oblivion_RES: Please, there's no need to apologize. If anyone should be sorry, it's me. You're busy, and I'm distracting you from your work.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_SkingradTopic_0000399f_Oblivion_R: Please, travel there as soon as possible. The Count is waiting for you.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_MS05PreparedYes_0002c6ea_Oblivion: Please, use the extra bed here. If you sleep too far from Henantier, it may not work. I'll watch over you both to make sure you're safe.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GOODBYE_00081dc5_Oblivion_RESP1: Please, visit any time, My Lord.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GOODBYE_00026bc0_Oblivion_RESP1: Please, visit me again anytime. I'm glad to help. Give S'drassa my regards.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GREETING_00098120_Oblivion_RESP1: Please, wait here. I shall let the Count know you are waiting for him.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_SQ01Potatoes_001885db_Oblivion_RE: Please, you must help me find them! If I don't have them for the next batch of my Famous Potato Bread, I don't know what I'll do!
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_MS38GuardWarnChoice1_00023687_Obl: Please, you must show this to the guards at once. My life is in your hands!
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GOODBYE_0003ca59_Oblivion_RESP1: Please, you must speak with Henantier. He has the reward I offered.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GOODBYE_0001680e_Oblivion_RESP1: Please, your Grace. Hurry to Brellach while there's still time.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GOODBYE_0001680d_Oblivion_RESP1: Please, your Grace. Hurry to Pinnacle Rock while there's still time.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GREETING_00032dfa_Oblivion_RESP1: Please. Although I'm concerned about the safe return of my son and the closing of the gate, please see Amminus Gregori for all of the details.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_SeleneTopic_0000c1d2_Oblivion_RES: Please. Get her below like I asked so we can get underway.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_SE05PostTortureGreet_00080d79_Obl: Please. I am not involved... I didn't do anything! They wanted me to get them close to Syl, but I wouldn't abide them!
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GREETING_0001fdae_Oblivion_RESP1: Please. I wish to be alone with my thoughts.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_ADMIRELOVE_0018b2ae_Oblivion_RESP: Please. I'm embarrassed. But thank you.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GREETING_000479d8_Oblivion_RESP2: Please. Just don't mention me to her, or she will burst into one of her tirades...
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GREETING_0002822d_Oblivion_RESP1: Please. Please help me. I don't want to die. I just want to go home. Go home...
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GREETING_00189d00_Oblivion_RESP1: Please... I implore you, help me avenge my wife's death!
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_PrimoAntoniusTopic_00028255_Obliv: Please... No... Primo can't be the killer. But it's either him... or you...
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GOODBYE_000165c0_Oblivion_RESP1: Please... get her from my sight.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GOODBYE_001885d3_Oblivion_RESP1: Please... give them to me! I must have them!
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_HELLO_0003ca86_Oblivion_RESP1: Please... help me, I can't remember anything.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_FromTheDead_0001d036_Oblivion_RES: Please... if you don't want to buy something, then just leave. Your wild accusations are upsetting me.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GREETING_00038435_Oblivion_RESP2: Please... please. I need your help. My husband was no vampire! It's ridiculous! No one will listen to me!
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GREETING_0004e924_Oblivion_RESP1: Please... please. The Grand Elixir of Exploration takes incredible concentration to create. So, shhhhhh.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GOODBYE_0001f3b8_Oblivion_RESP1: Pleasure and pain be with you.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GOODBYE_000206ca_Oblivion_RESP1: Pleasure and pain be with you.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GOODBYE_0003b83c_Oblivion_RESP1: Pleasure and pain be with you.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GOODBYE_0007ec63_Oblivion_RESP1: Pleasure and pain be with you.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GOODBYE_0008d793_Oblivion_RESP1: Pleasure and pain be with you.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_HELLO_0003b82f_Oblivion_RESP1: Pleasure and pain be with you.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_MG01Choice2A_0002d6ea_Oblivion_RE: Pleasure doing business with you, friend!
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_AnvilTopic_0003e0ca_Oblivion_RESP: Plenty of deer, wolf, boar, mountain lion, bear in the county. Just need to know where to look for 'em.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_BrumaTopic_0003c9ab_Oblivion_RESP: Plenty of mineral desposits in the Jerall Mountains. I'm out for weeks at a time by myself, but I don't mind it.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_FGDPost1_0006e2dd_Oblivion_RESP2: Plus, members often find items in their travels they can't use, and they leave them here for other members to use. Sometimes there's nice stuff.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_INFOGENERAL_00052228_Oblivion_RES: Poor Arnora. Seems her boyfriend, Jorundr, has stolen some gold from her and left her penniless. Now he's in jail, and she's destitute.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_INFOGENERAL_00082604_Oblivion_RES: Poor Big Head will never find the Fork of Horripilation.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_INFOGENERAL_00034037_Oblivion_RES: Poor Gromm. I wonder what he'll do now that Baenlin is dead. Serving that old man was the joy of his life, or so I've heard.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_INFOGENERAL_000465b0_Oblivion_RES: Poor Olfand. I don't know how he manages to live with Skjorta.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GREETING_00033df4_Oblivion_RESP1: Poor Prior Maborel. He was dead when I came outside. Who could have done this?
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GREETING_00094ec9_Oblivion_RESP1: Poor Rosentia, she's been trapped in her house for days.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_INFOGENERAL_0005ed52_Oblivion_RES: Poor Thadon, he was such a handsome man... I enjoyed our midnight meetings. I hope the new ruler of Mania is ready for me.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_INFOGENERAL_000093c7_Oblivion_RES: Poor Tivela. I hear she is turning Cheydinhal inside out looking for her husband, Rythe. I hope nothing bad has happened to him.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_AldosOthranTopic_0003c2c2_Oblivio: Poor fellow. You may be able to find him roaming the streets of Cheydinhal, probably drunk. Only a month ago, he lost his wife.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_INFOGENERAL_00044225_Oblivion_RES: Power changes hands in Crucible, which means even less stability for the Realm. Just what we needed.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GREETING_00012d11_Oblivion_RESP1: Power! I need power! Unless you can give me the magicka to help these soldiers, get out of my way.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_MG18Choice3A_00070487_Oblivion_RE: Power, my dear friend. I seek power, and so I acquire and study those who have some degree of it.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GREETING_0000296b_Knights_RESP1: Practice keeps the muscles loose, ready for combat. I intend to be at my best if you need me, Sir Knight.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GREETING_0003c994_Oblivion_RESP1: Praise Akatosh! Praise the Nine! I'm Arentus Falvius, primate of Talos, High Priest of Bruma Chapel.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_SEManiaRumorResponses_000614e5_Ob: Praise Arden-Sul the Chalice has been returned.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GREETING_0004e8a4_Oblivion_RESP1: Praise Arkay, and all her little woodland creatures! I'm Hil the Tall, Priest of Arkay.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GOODBYE_000579be_Oblivion_RESP1: Praise be to the Lord Molag Bal.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_MQ06MankarSpeech_0001f876_Oblivio: Praise be to your Brothers and Sisters! Great shall be their reward in Paradise!
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_DASheogorathSpeech_00095789_Obliv: Praying to yourself, my Lord? That's not a good sign. Or perhaps it is. Prince of Madness, and all that.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_TG08reject_000146fe_Oblivion_RESP: Preparation is the key to success. Come back to me when you are better prepared.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_ReadyForAMatch_0002b1e3_Oblivion_: Press the attack, and don't give him a chance to let off a spell! I don't want to have to sweep your ashes out of the Arena!
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_PickpocketNoCrime_0006250a_Oblivi: Pretty quick fingers you've got there, friend.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_SE02Gatekeeper_0008e550_Oblivion_: Pretty scary, isn't he? Jayred's planning on killing him. I don't know how... the Gatekeeper looks indestructible to me.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_CharGenTaunt2_00033363_Oblivion_R: Pretty soon you'll go mad, and the guards will cut your throat just to stop the ranting. That's right. You're going to die in here, Wood Elf! Die!
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_LeyawiinTopicDecentius03_000479f3: Pretty soon, the beastfolk all knew how to read and write... which was handy, since it made them better slaves for the Ayleids, hahaha.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_AnvilTopic_0003e0b5_Oblivion_RESP: Pretty, isn't it? And quiet. Not much work for us.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GREETING_0003b972_Oblivion_RESP1: Pretty, pretty forks. Singing sad, sad songs. Do you hear them?
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_DANamiraSpeech_0005c01b_Oblivion_: Priests of Arkay have intruded upon their squalor. I want you to help my Forgotten kill these priests of the Light.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_PrimoAntoniusTopic_00028a03_Obliv: Primo being here made no sense. Whoever our host is, why would he invite someone who didn't even need the money?
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_PrimoAntoniusTopic_00028188_Obliv: Primo is a young man of refinement. This murder must be quite a shock for him.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_PrimoAntoniusTopic_000289f7_Obliv: Primo is young and rich. I can sense a good, decent person in there somewhere. He just has to get his priorities straight.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_PrimoAntoniusTopic_00028f49_Obliv: Primo may be young, but he looks strong, and I'm sure he could handle himself in a fight. I think I'm going to enlist his help.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_PrimoAntoniusTopic_00028f48_Obliv: Primo may be young, but he's no fool. He knows that the murder of two innocent people doesn't bode well for his own safety.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_PrimoAntoniusTopic_0002824f_Obliv: Primo seems kind of nice. I just can't imagine him killing anyone.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_PrimoAntoniusTopic_0002948f_Obliv: Primo was a young man, strong and full of life. Surely he would have been able to defend himself against an attacker.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_PrimoAntoniusTopic_0002826c_Obliv: Primo was my chance, do you understand me? He was wealthy! He could take me away someplace! Whoever did this will pay!
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_PrimoAntoniusTopic_00028d2f_Obliv: Primo's a blue blood, a noble through-and-through. He thinks he's better than most people, and in most cases he's right.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GREETING_0005a752_Oblivion_RESP1: Prior Dreth has tasked me to pray for Vitharn's safety.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_SE32SiegeVitharn_0005a755_Oblivio: Prior Dreth met with the Fanatics to turn them away. They did not see the wisdom of his words.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_MQJauffreHelp_0005d2c9_Oblivion_R: Prior Maborel and Brother Piner may also be able to help. You should speak to them about it if you haven't already.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_CharGenVoice_00033334_Oblivion_RE: Prisoner! Get over by the window, now!
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_CharGenVoice_00024de6_Oblivion_RE: Prisoner! Stand away from the door! Over by the window, now!
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_CharGenRenote_0000b226_Oblivion_R: Prisoner, I don't have time for your games. Do that again and die.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_SE32HlovalsMagicka_00012d20_Obliv: Problem? I supose you think that everyone with stunted magicka has a "problem." You're nothing but a bigot. You're on the list now.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GREETING_0004e8c3_Oblivion_RESP5: Profaning the remains or souls of the dead is just wrong. And I'm uneasy about tampering with other's minds and trafficking with Daedra.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GOODBYE_00086561_Oblivion_RESP1: Prompt attention to this matter will be rewarded.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_SE30ForgeShield_00016537_Oblivion: Properly timed, blocking can stagger your foe. That is the time to caress him with your blade.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GREETING_0018bca9_Oblivion_RESP1: Protect and serve. It's what we do.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_SEMiscQuestResponses_0008e133_Obl: Protection does this woman seek in items of magic both strong or weak.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_SE35Brithaur_0007866b_Oblivion_RE: Prove to me he's gone, and the reward is as good as yours. Now please, get a move on... I feel my bones getting more brittle as we speak.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_DANamiraSpeech_0005c01d_Oblivion_: Prove to me that you deserve my favor. In Anga, my Forgotten have lived in peace for many years.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_SE08StartBattleNo_00082653_Oblivi: Provide what aid you can, but I beg you to make haste. The enemy does not wait long between attacks.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_SE08StartBattleNo_00082654_Oblivi: Provide what aid you can, but I beg you to make haste. The enemy does not wait long between attacks.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_SE36HeyYou_00061c41_Oblivion_RESP: Psssst. Over here. I need to talk to you. It's important.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GREETING_00043019_Oblivion_RESP1: Pssst. Buddy. Gimme the skooma already. Quit playing around!
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_HELLO_00004b9e_DLCVileLair_RESP1: Psst! Hey you! Yeah, you! Come here! I got what you need...
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_HELLO_000c45bc_Oblivion_RESP1: Psst! Hey you! Yeah, you! Come here! I got what you need...
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_Attack_0018bd82_Oblivion_RESP1: Puny Elf! I'll pick my teeth with your spine!
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GREETING_00090b66_Oblivion_RESP1: Push off, scroat! We got nothing to talk about.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GREETING_00047660_Oblivion_RESP1: Put on The Feed Bag! I'm Delos Fandas. We got food and drink, and lots of it.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_Steal_000624f9_Oblivion_RESP1: Put that back, you worthless thief!
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_ArenaChoice2B_0000c220_Oblivion_R: Put that on, see if it fits okay. When you're ready for a match, I'll be waiting. You want to fight, you talk to me. All right then.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GREETING_00061c3d_Oblivion_RESP1: Put that torch away. Do you want people to see us talking?
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_Announcer_0004666e_Oblivion_RESP1: Put your hands and your voices together for the two brave Heroes who have come to rock the very foundations of this Arena! Lower the gates!
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_SEMiscQuestResponses_0008e101_Obl: Pyke has a new love in Hale, a woman named Zoe Malene. Will they ever find true happiness and, if so, until when?
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_INFOGENERAL_000825e4_Oblivion_RES: Pyke, the Knight of the Thorn, lives in Hale.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_SE02Passwall_0007eae9_Oblivion_RE: Quaint, isn't it? Passwall sits in the Fringe of the Shivering Isles. It's where the supplicants wait while the Blessing of Sheogorath takes hold.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_MQ04PinerA2_00090995_Oblivion_RES: Quick! He may need our help!
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GOODBYE_00086783_Oblivion_RESP1: Quickly, hurry to Silorn while there's still time.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_TGGrayFox_00003458_Oblivion_RESP1: Quiet, you fool. The Garden of Dareloth, on the Waterfront. Midnight. Be there.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_INFOGENERAL_0003c229_Oblivion_RES: Quill-Weave does a lot of traveling to research her books. She must have a lot of experience to share.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_SECaldanaMonriusSkooma_0008f5f9_O: Quit playing around. Hand it over!
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_SEDementiaRumorResponses_000613e7: Quite a feat to get past the Gatekeeper.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GREETING_0001da53_Oblivion_RESP5: Quite a list of things to do, wouldn't you say? Well, enough of my monologue. Time to feed!
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_INFOGENERAL_0005f203_Oblivion_RES: Quite a shame that there's a new Gatekeeper. I'd been hoping to meet a few more friendly faces.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_Dark05FinChoice2B_0004ce4a_Oblivi: Quite. Then you know he has dedicated his life to eradicating the Dark Brotherhood, and doesn't appreciate when we operate within the Imperial City.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_BravilTopic_00048921_Oblivion_RES: R'vanni just wants to get along. No trouble. Anything you want. R'vanni's know-nothing, good-for-nothing. Ask anyone. Just don't hurt R'vanni.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GREETING_0004767c_Oblivion_RESP1: Ra'Jiradh greets you. His brothers are Hassiri and Urjabhi. The Black Horse Courier is our Imperial news service, chartered by the Elder Council.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GREETING_000476a4_Oblivion_RESP1: Ra'jhan has a fine house in Elven Gardens. Yes? It costs Ra'jhan many golds. But it is very fine, yes?
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_ImperialCityTopic_000476a5_Oblivi: Ra'jhan used to share a house, but not now. Ra'jhan is very proud, work so hard, now has house all his own.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_SE11RakheranConfrontCiirta01_0001: Ra'kheran! You come to me with blades drawn? What is the meaning of this?
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_CheydinhalTopic_0004e8b3_Oblivion: Ra'qanar is your friend, no? Your servant? Whatever you require? Ra'qanar knows nothing... less, even. But Ra'qanar wishes to please.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GOODBYE_0018abcd_Oblivion_RESP1: Raelynn will finally get what's coming to her.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_Announcer_00046667_Oblivion_RESP1: Raise your voices in cheer as we lower the gates and these two brave combatants face their destinies!
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GREETING_00022495_Oblivion_RESP1: Rallus and Antus need your help, whether they know it or not. There's no time to waste.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_Creatures_000224af_Oblivion_RESP1: Rallus knows why we have to be the ones to get rid of them. Antus... he's another story.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_Recommendation_0005323e_Oblivion_: Raminus Polus will want to speak with you. I must say, you will be a credit to the guild. Arch-Mage Traven will be lucky to have you there.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GREETING_0000bee4_Oblivion_RESP2: Raminus has told me good things about you. You have advanced quickly, and show great promise.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GREETING_000488de_Oblivion_RESP1: Ranaline. I cook at the Lonely Suitor.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GREETING_000807a1_Oblivion_RESP1: Ranarr-Jo is dead. What am I to do now?
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GREETING_0007f3a8_Oblivion_RESP2: Ranarr-Jo is in need of a hero, but I'm not certain you are to be that one. First, you must earn his trust.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_SE39RanarrJo_00072c95_Oblivion_RE: Ranarr-Jo sent you? Did you know that once he was king of the Shivering Isles? Before Sheogorath? In fact, I was his queen.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_SE39RanarrJo_00072c96_Oblivion_RE: Ranarr-Jo. He protects me, like a valiant knight. Always rooting out spies and ne'er-do-wells. He's so good at it, I've never seen one yet!
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_ChorrolNQDResponses_00029fcb_Obli: Rasheda does a good job keeping Fire and Steel stocked with good weapons. Maybe not the best in Tamriel, but good.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_LeyawiinTopic_000479e1_Oblivion_R: Rats in a Cream Sauce. Rat Flambe. Rat Necrom, with Bone Meal Gravy. Deep Fried Rat. Lemon Rat and Wild Rice. Rat Ragu, with Powdered Deer Penis!
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_ThreeSigns_00026af5_Oblivion_RESP: Rats, I would imagine. Horrible little things. I always keep a powerful rat poison around in case I see one of the little monsters.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_ThreeSigns_0006bf17_Oblivion_RESP: Rats, I would imagine. Horrible little things. I always keep a powerful rat poison around in case I see one of the little monsters.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GREETING_000479e0_Oblivion_RESP1: Rats. Hate them. HATE them. Every one. Gonna hunt them down and chop them all to tiny bits.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_INFOGENERAL_00032e5a_Oblivion_RES: Rats? They've got Fighters Guild people out killing rats? You're kidding, right?
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_INFOGENERAL_00077d0d_Oblivion_RES: Raven-Biter runs the Choosy Beggar. Not a bad place.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_RaynilDralasTopic_0003842b_Oblivi: Raynil is staying in the last room down the hall upstairs. Here's the key.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GREETING_00038580_Oblivion_RESP2: Raynil was spotted heading west out of Bruma. The scout tried to follow, but lost him in the mountains.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_Gelebourne_00038582_Oblivion_RESP: Raynil will pay for both crimes. Gelebourne was likely another innocent he's slain. I'll make sure Skingrad's city watch hears of this.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_MS22MaricHighFane_00086746_Oblivi: Read "The Cleansing of the Fane." You may be less eager to seek the High Fane then.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_DAHermaeusSpeech_000a9480_Oblivio: Read it, and gain knowledge of yourself. Go now. Learn, and remember.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_INFOGENERAL_0005f432_Oblivion_RES: Read your histories: a strong army guarantees a strong Realm. Good thing Sheogorath's armies are back to full strength.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GREETING_000281a3_Oblivion_RESP1: Ready to test dialogue? Great! This should be my first time speaking with you.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_ReadyForAMatch_00022d9f_Oblivion_: Ready? Ready for what? You're Grand Champion! You've already won it all! The whole damn thing! Ha ha ha ha ha!
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_ReadyForAMatch_00022da0_Oblivion_: Ready? Ready for what? You're a champion now! The Grand Championship is the only thing left!
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_ReadyForAMatch_0000c1e6_Oblivion_: Ready? You call that ready? You're not even wearing your Battle Raiment! Don't talk to me again until you're suited up, you disrespectful maggot!
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_SE05HerdirInvestigateCurrentTask_: Really, Inquisitor. Are you not supposed to be the one in charge here? I can't do all your work for you.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_SE01GateSpeech_0005a760_Oblivion_: Really, do come in. It's lovely in the Isles right now. Perfect time for a visit.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GREETING_00019ace_Oblivion_RESP1: Really, ma'am, you'll need to start thinking for yourself. It is one of the basic requirements of godhood.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_SE03GreymarchTopic_0009101d_Obliv: Really, no need to trouble yourself with the details of that now. It would just cloud your little mind.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_ADMIRELOVE_0018b2b0_Oblivion_RESP: Really, now. You're such a charmer.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GREETING_00019acd_Oblivion_RESP1: Really, sir, you'll need to start thinking for yourself. It is one of the basic requirements of godhood.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_SE05HerdirBeginChoice2_000805ee_O: Really, we should be going. Her Ladyship expects results!
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_SE40SleepOutsideChoice1a_000790be: Really? And it's a safe place? Not at the bottom of a tall wall? That's a great idea! That sounds perfect.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_SE05Interrogate4_0001562b_Oblivio: Really? And whom might this figure be?
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_SE38Oddity5_00081e84_Oblivion_RES: Really? But I already have Din's Ashes. I'm afraid someone must have taken advantage of your gullibility.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_SE38OddityDonate_00081ea0_Oblivio: Really? For free? That's so generous of you. I'll put this tomato right back where it belongs in a place of honor!
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_MS38GuardChoice2_00023681_Oblivio: Really? He's getting worse, then. Thanks for letting me know. If you think he's becoming dangerous, you come straight to me and I'll handle it.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_MS38DeadYes2_00023679_Oblivion_RE: Really? He's really dead?! Thank you, thank you, thank you! I'm free, I'm finally FREE!
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_MS47NeedAntidote_0003003f_Oblivio: Really? I find being invisible quite refreshing.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GREETING_00006925_Oblivion_RESP1: Really? I would never have guessed. Still, I don't think you'll have any trouble with rats and goblins.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_HouseInquiry_0004ed81_Oblivion_RE: Really? It just so happens there is a modest shack overlooking the canal.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_JollringChoice1C_000844bf_Oblivio: Really? May I see it, please?
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_SE37Response_000452df_Oblivion_RE: Really? She wanted help? I could use some help. Actually I could use some food. Do you have any? I'm not picky. Anything at all.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_MS38DeadYes2_00023678_Oblivion_RE: Really? She's really dead?! Thank you, thank you, thank you! I'm free, I'm finally FREE!
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_MQ07BurdA_0002008f_Oblivion_RESP1: Really? That is odd. I know for certain that she returned alone. I don't like it.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_MS38BPNo_0001dc30_Oblivion_RESP1: Really? That is surprising. I was SURE she was watching me.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_BlackBrugo05_00090b78_Oblivion_RE: Really? That's not what I heard. I heard you got made into a knight.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_HouseDecline_0004f20b_Oblivion_RE: Really? Then you shouldn't have brought up the subject.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_HouseBuyImperialCity_000531bc_Obl: Really? Then you've just become a homeowner. Here is your house key.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_MS38DeadYes_00023677_Oblivion_RES: Really? They're really dead?! Thank you, thank you, thank you! I'm free, I'm finally FREE!
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_ISawIt_0002a399_Oblivion_RESP1: Really? With your own eyes? Damn. So we've got real trouble. And no emperor. That's real bad.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_MS27UmbacanoA3_000a657b_Oblivion_: Really? You astonish me! May I see it?
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GREETING_0003ea3a_Oblivion_RESP1: Really? You want to talk to me? Is this some kind of a joke? If you want to help, just end my life. Kill me. Here, now!
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_MS38TSNo_0002366b_Oblivion_RESP1: Really?! So you're saying that neither Bernadette Peneles or Toutius Sextius is part of the conspiracy against me? Hard to believe.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_INFOGENERAL_0005f208_Oblivion_RES: Rebuilding the Gatekeeper is one of the few things that has gone right lately.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_MG00JoinA_0002d288_Oblivion_RESP2: Recommendations you need, from all guild halls in Cyrodiil. None will be easy to acquire. Too many motives, too much noise.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_INFOGENERAL_00032ebe_Oblivion_RES: Recruitment is down. Way down. That's a problem.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_FrostSaltsTopic_00022f16_Oblivion: Refined frost salts sounds like something that Julienne would specialize in. You may want to go back to the University and speak to her.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_SE08CommanderBattle02_00018e68_Ob: Reform! Back to your ranks! More are coming!
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_SE08CommanderBattle02_000415df_Ob: Reform! Back to your ranks! More are coming!
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_TG03LexMyvryna_000355d2_Oblivion_: Regrettably I've no further use for you. If what I heard is true, you're the thief. If what you say is true, the Gray Fox knows you are my informant.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GREETING_000488ca_Oblivion_RESP1: Regulus Terentius, Count Bravil. Good of you to introduce yourself, stranger, but no point, really.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GREETING_000748a1_Oblivion_RESP1: Regulus Terentius, Count Bravil. I'm really rather busy, and I doubt that you have anything to say that I need to hear.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_SE13AllyShoutReinforcements_0004d: Reinforcements! There, by the doors to Bliss!
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_INFOGENERAL_00043ef2_Oblivion_RES: Relan hears of Syl's torture. Relan likes what he hears. Syl is good.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_INFOGENERAL_00043ed4_Oblivion_RES: Relan hears of this Reversal Chalice. It makes blood special, yes? Relan would like special blood.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_INFOGENERAL_0005edf0_Oblivion_RES: Relan hears there's a new ruler in Bliss. Relan finds this interesting.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_INFOGENERAL_00044238_Oblivion_RES: Relan hears there's a new ruler in Crucible. Relan finds this interesting.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_INFOGENERAL_0005f22d_Oblivion_RES: Relan is jealous of the Gatekeeper. Relan wishes that he had swords for arms.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_SEFellmoorTopic_0003be78_Oblivion: Relan is the only one around here worth a damn. And that's only because he loves to kill his pests.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_INFOGENERAL_00044219_Oblivion_RES: Relan understands the Great Torch burns again. Relan thinks this is a good sign.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GREETING_0003be7d_Oblivion_RESP1: Relan. It is I who kills. It is I who hunts. It is I who keeps the fields and farms clean for Cindanwe.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_PickpocketNoCrime_000626ba_Oblivi: Relax. I didn't see a damn thing.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GREETING_00038ede_Oblivion_RESP1: Release! Sweet Release! After all these years, these decades, I am finally free! And you! So... so fresh! I must feed! I must feed! Agghhhhh!
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_MS23RolandCalm_0001d4c5_Oblivion_: Relfina was the love of my life. For the first time, I had a positive outlook. Then I saw Seridur looking at her with those coveting eyes.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_ElixirofExploration_0004e916_Obli: Reliable as usual. Here's your gold.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_SkingradNQDResponses_0003c192_Obl: Religion is definitely not a topic to bring up around Else. Swords, on the other hand, she'll talk about.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_SE09HaskillXaselm_00081a4c_Oblivi: Relmyna prefers to conduct her experiments in privacy. You will have to deal with her guardians to reach her.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GOODBYE_0001e0e7_Oblivion_RESP1: Remain leery of Seridur, he's much more cunning than you may suspect.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_INFOGENERAL_0003c249_Oblivion_RES: Reman Broder is great with a bow. I think he could shoot the grapes off the vines, which is handy, since he works at the vineyard.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GREETING_00038ad7_Oblivion_RESP1: Reman Broder, retired Archer, presently a grape-grower for the Surilies, at your service. Are you looking for advanced training?
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_SkingradTopic_00038ae0_Oblivion_R: Reman Broder... he works Surilie's vineyard, I work Tamika's vineyard... Reman spent 20 years in the legion, and he's an advanced Marksman trainer.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_MS12Reman_000980f6_Oblivion_RESP2: Reman Cyrodiil not only was the conqueror of the Akaviri forces, but he actually convinced them to help build the Empire as it is today.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_ArcaneULecture3_0007194d_Oblivion: Reman Runestones are solitary monuments marked with green runes, almost certainly named for Reman Cyrodiil, the First Era emperor.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GREETING_00058e04_Oblivion_RESP1: Remember Kvatch, that's our watchword. We won't let that happen here, don't worry.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GOODBYE_0018d937_Oblivion_RESP1: Remember me if you find more Shadowbanish Wine!
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_CGEmperor23_00032685_Oblivion_RES: Remember me, and remember my words. This burden is now yours alone. You hold our future in your hands.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_MQ00BladesResponse_00061389_Obliv: Remember our history. The Blades were here waiting for Tiber Septim, and we will be here still when the next Dragonborn appears.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GuardTalk1_0006fdce_Oblivion_RESP: Remember that Argonian? The one from yesterday? Little bugger pulled a knife on me earlier. I had to put him down.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_contract_0002798c_Oblivion_RESP1: Remember the pretenses under which the guests are there. They will be suspicious. You must be as effective an actor as you are a killer.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_HELLO_0014c719_Oblivion_RESP1: Remember to keep the blindfold on. Your eyes must only be used to read the scrolls.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_INFOGENERAL_00032e5d_Oblivion_RES: Remember when our new master was just a rookie? Who would have thought that a bottom boot would save the whole guild from the Blackwood Company?
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_MQ13MartinD1_0009ce83_Oblivion_RE: Remember when we first met in Kvatch? I told you that I didn't want any part of the gods' plan.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GOODBYE_0003d4c2_Oblivion_RESP1: Remember, 11 in the evening. Don't disappoint me.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GOODBYE_000a9346_Oblivion_RESP1: Remember, I will be expecting you at Nenalata in three days time.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_BarterExit_0003d08c_Oblivion_RESP: Remember, act casual, like we haven't done anything illegal.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GOODBYE_0004e950_Oblivion_RESP1: Remember, always look near water. That's the best place to find Nirnroot.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GOODBYE_0001e68f_Oblivion_RESP1: Remember, come to me for all your crafting needs.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_TG08accept_000146ff_Oblivion_RESP: Remember, do not shed innocent blood. However, there is no bloodprice for slaying the stone's guardians, human or inhuman.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GOODBYE_0002c2f5_Oblivion_RESP1: Remember, not a word to Teekeeus!
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_DeadDropTopic_00066a09_Oblivion_R: Remember, secrecy is our greatest ally. We of the Black Hand avoid direct communication whenever possible.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_MQ08ArtifactTopic_00026efa_Oblivi: Remember, the Mysterium Xarxes ritual will consume the physical form of the artifact in order to release its daedric power.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_MS43Staff_00094ec8_Oblivion_RESP1: Remember, the only way to get rid of the staff is to leave it in that cave.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GREETING_0003d7ed_Oblivion_RESP4: Remember, the portal closes behind you. Anything you need, carry it with you.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_MysteriumXarxes_0003c268_Oblivion: Remember, the portal will close behind you, so you will need to take everything you need.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_contract_000253e5_Oblivion_RESP1: Remember, timing is everything. You need to slash Motierre with the blade in Hides-His-Heart's presence, and then flee before the enforcer can react.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_HELLO_0018ae79_Oblivion_RESP1: Remember, trespassing in the Imperial Palace is a serious crime. Do not venture beyond the first and second floors.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GOODBYE_00073123_Oblivion_RESP1: Remember, walk lightly, and always look up.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_contract_0002798a_Oblivion_RESP1: Remember, you must make the other guests feel comfortable. Make them like you. Make them TRUST you. Then bathe in their blood! Hehehehe!
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GOODBYE_000908e5_Oblivion_RESP1: Remember. A knight's title shall be your reward.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GOODBYE_00060331_Oblivion_RESP1: Remember. Bernadette Peneles. 6 am. Don't let her see you watching!
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GOODBYE_00086024_Oblivion_RESP1: Remember. Read "The Cleansing of the Fane" before deciding whether to seek for Umbacano's treasure.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_SE37Errand_00045653_Oblivion_RESP: Remind me to ask you about my bestiary. In the meantime, what have you found for me?
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_ChorrolTopic_00024e1c_Oblivion_RE: Rena and I moved to Chorrol so we could have a nice, comfortable home for our dogs. It's a lovely town. And our dogs are so happy here.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GREETING_0004764b_Oblivion_RESP1: Renald Viernis. I'm the Practice Room Proctor. No horseplay or foolishness. This is for serious exercises.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GREETING_00040bbe_Oblivion_RESP1: Rendil Drarara, chef extraordinaire at your service.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GREETING_00047712_Oblivion_RESP1: Renee Geonette. My husband, Salomon, has a court commission to compose a symphony.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_SE07BSylLeaves_0003b825_Oblivion_: Replacing Thadon with this... outsider? This is how it ends. I should have seen this coming.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GOODBYE_00095a83_Oblivion_RESP1: Report back as soon as you can.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_Recommendation_0005323c_Oblivion_: Report to the Arcane University, and speak with Raminus Polus. He will provide further instructions for you.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_FGD02Choice3_0002c7cb_Oblivion_RE: Report us? Oh, no. Why, we might never get work from the guild again! And that would be different how, exactly?
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_MS27AyleidCrown_000a6581_Oblivion: Reputedly the crown worn by the last king of the Ayleids. It deserves to be part of my collection.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_ErthorTopic_0002d926_Oblivion_RES: Rescued him yourself, did you? Well, good for you.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_HELLO_0004e955_Oblivion_RESP1: Researching the Elixir has been exhausting, but well worth the time.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_SE14Attacks_00046824_Oblivion_RES: Residents of Fellmoor have complained of creatures encroaching on their lands. Perhaps you might be of some help, time permitting.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_INFOGENERAL_0004350c_Oblivion_RES: Resonator of Judgment is working again. Big deal; if it doesn't work on Scalons, doesn't do us a lick of good.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GREETING_0004f220_Oblivion_RESP2: Rest here for the night, and then continue along the Gold Road, heading east towards Kvatch.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_AnvilTopic_0003e0b0_Oblivion_RESP: Restless folks like you don't much like town life. Too slow and easy. For you, the life of the rover... gold and glory, blood and treasure.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_SE08CommanderBattle01_0005249c_Ob: Retreat! Retreat! Fall back to the town center! Now! Now! MOVE!
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_DANocturnalSpeech_00084a4e_Oblivi: Retrieve the Eye of Nocturnal, mortal, and return it to me, and I shall look favorably upon you.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_SE06HelpAttackA4_00012cd1_Oblivio: Return at once when you have their deployments. This could make all the difference.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GREETING_0001d4aa_Oblivion_RESP1: Return here when you've made your discovery. You'll find that Seridur is the liar, not I.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_MG05Choice1A_0001e854_Oblivion_RE: Return it to me immediately when you have it. Make no mention of it to Teekeeus or anyone else in your guild. I will make it well worth your effort.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_MGExpelYes_00026d96_Oblivion_RESP: Return only when you have the ingredients. You waste my time otherwise.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_MGExpelYes_00026d97_Oblivion_RESP: Return only when you have the ingredients. You waste my time otherwise.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GREETING_000314fc_Oblivion_RESP2: Return to me in three weeks, and I'll have a special painting for you. It is the least I can do for you.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_DAPeryiteSpeech_0008dd5e_Oblivion: Return to me when you are prepared.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_VampireTopic_0001e0cd_Oblivion_RE: Return to me when you have slain another vampire, and the Order will gladly reward you.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_TrainingQuestTopic_0006244b_Obliv: Return to me when you have spoken with all of them. Then we shall talk of training.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GOODBYE_0005d8ee_Oblivion_RESP1: Return to your guild, and prepare yourself accordingly.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GOODBYE_0001c4d1_Oblivion_RESP1: Return when you have the Madstone.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_MS40Choice3A_0009813a_Oblivion_RE: Return when you possess a cure. Then I shall take you to the Count.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GREETING_00025e18_Oblivion_RESP2: Return with 20 minotaur horns if you wish to rejoin the Fighters Guild. Perhaps you'll find redemption; perhaps you'll die trying. Go now.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_ShadeoftheRevenant_0000357d_Obliv: Revenant, you say? And it represents something in the Heavens? It sounds familiar. Let me think...
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_INFOGENERAL_0003827b_Oblivion_RES: Reynald Jemane has a terrible memory. We've met many times, but when I saw him in Cheydinhal, he walked right past me like we were strangers.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_ReynaldJemaneTopic_00094075_Obliv: Reynald Jemane? No, don't know anyone by that name. There's a Guilbert Jemane in town however. Maybe he can help you.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_INFOGENERAL_0003c1c3_Oblivion_RES: Rhano is quite the swordsman. I've heard he'll train you for the right amount of money.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GREETING_0003e08b_Oblivion_RESP1: Rhano. I'm Anvil's Advanced Trainer in Blade Weapons.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_RiBassaTOPIC_00026b9a_Oblivion_RE: Ri'Bassa is our shaman. You will find him in his house most of the time.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_SE07AThadonLeaves_000206c3_Oblivi: Ridiculous! You can't do this! Although... you're omnipotent. Or just tall. It's one of the two, I'm sure. And a fool!
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_TGFences_0001eb64_Oblivion_RESP1: Right here. I'm the best in the business. You've gained quite a reputation in the guild. Let's see what you've got to sell me.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_NevilleTopic_00028794_Oblivion_RE: Right now I'm more concerned with the person who's been left for dead in this very house, not with that Legion dog.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_DovesiDranTopic_00028ce1_Oblivion: Right now my main concern is figuring out who the killer is. She may be young, but Dovesi is a suspect just like everyone else.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_BedYes_000b12a0_Oblivion_RESP1: Right then. Head up the stairs, and it's the first door on your right. Remember, I didn't say it was clean. I said it was cheap.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_MG04Choice3A_000300a4_Oblivion_RE: Right then. The bed is just upstairs, at the back of the inn. Sleep well.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_BedYes_000b9842_Oblivion_RESP1: Right then. Up the stairs in the back, and it's the last door at the end of the hall, straight ahead of you after turning that corner.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_SE08SheldenEnd_00043f70_Oblivion_: Right then. You lead the way -- just try not to get us killed. Well, try not to get ME killed.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_ArenaICRaiment1_0003b1dd_Oblivion: Right! Okay... It is with great honor that I present to you this gold, and the esteemed Raiment of Valor, and name you the new Arena Grand Champion!
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_ArenaICRaiment2_0003b1de_Oblivion: Right! Okay... It is with great honor that I present to you this gold, and the esteemed Raiment of Valor, and name you the new Arena Grand Champion!
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GreetingCaenlorn01_0003cf90_Obliv: Right! The one in blue! You remembered.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_BedYes_000b124a_Oblivion_RESP1: Right! You'll have to go upstairs to the second floor. Your room is the second door on the right before the staircase. Thank you for your patronage.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GREETING_00023dff_Oblivion_RESP1: Right, mister. We know who's been naughty and nice. And you've been naughty. So watch yourself.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GREETING_0002c7f0_Oblivion_RESP1: Right, mister. We know who's been naughty and nice. And you've been naughty. So watch yourself.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_MG01SulinusConv_0002d91b_Oblivion: Right, okay. Listen, when you go back to Skingrad, don't tell Adrienne I was the one who saved you, okay?
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GREETING_0002b730_Oblivion_RESP2: Right, right. You were finding that fellow who's stolen my name. Have you had any luck?
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GREETING_00023dfe_Oblivion_RESP1: Right, sister. We know who's been naughty and nice. And you've been naughty. So watch yourself.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GREETING_0002c7ef_Oblivion_RESP1: Right, sister. We know who's been naughty and nice. And you've been naughty. So watch yourself.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_DarkSancTalk5_00034059_Oblivion_R: Right, then. We should probably get back to our duties, eh?
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_HELLO_00051793_Oblivion_RESP1: Right, what can I do for you, citizen.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_BrumaNQDQuestionResponses_000465e: Right-Wind certainly can handle a blade. No wonder he trains other Fighters Guild members.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_DinnerParty_0001c109_Oblivion_RES: Right. A big, fancy dinner party. You seem likeable, but not so much that I'd just let you in there. And not dressed like that.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_Dark04DrethConvo_00045f87_Oblivio: Right. And you'll be rich, too. Oh, and you'll become a king! You know what I think, Dreth? I think you'll be back. You lot always come back...
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_MG08ChoiceFinalYes_00035625_Obliv: Right. I'll get to work. You come see me tomorrow, and I'll have your staff ready.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_TG08NoBribeBeggar_00015f1c_Oblivi: Right. I'm told it's a place where old priests care for moths that spin silk.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GREETING_0002887b_Oblivion_RESP1: Right. Let's get to bashing some goblin skulls.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_DarkSancTalk5_0006a856_Oblivion_R: Right. Well, my contracts await. Maybe we can talk some more later.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_BladesTalk5_0018d7fb_Oblivion_RES: Right. Well, we'll all have to remain extra vigilant. But enough chatter. Back to our duties, eh?
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_ICAllNQDResponses_0004990c_Oblivi: Rindir always keeps a fine selection on hand. It's almost as if he knows my skill level perfectly.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_INFOGENERAL_0004990e_Oblivion_RES: Rindir's Staffs is the best place in the city to buy a magical staff. Or is it Rindir's Staves....
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GREETING_000476cc_Oblivion_RESP1: Rochelle Bantien. Samuel's wife. I'm glad he's settled down to training and the quiet life.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_ImperialCityTopic_000476a9_Oblivi: Roderic is looking around for a business to invest in. I know he'll find something soon.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_Dark06FinChoice1A_0003005d_Oblivi: Roderick has recently taken ill. He now lies in eternal slumber, kept alive only by the daily administration of a powerful medicine.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_contract_0000c0a5_Oblivion_RESP1: Roderick is a mercenary leader, and his people are fanatically loyal. They will cut you to ribbons if they see you. And they will see you.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GREETING_00034896_Oblivion_RESP1: Roderick is dead, and Sithis is appeased. Unfortunately, the same is not true of the client who arranged this contract.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GREETING_00034894_Oblivion_RESP1: Roderick may lie near death, but dead he is not. Until his soul has passed, our client -- and Sithis -- will not be satisfied.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_Dark07MercConvo_00045f8c_Oblivion: Roderick's fever is in check, unlike your tongue! How can you think such things, after all he has done for us? For you? Have a little faith.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_INFOGENERAL_00049889_Oblivion_RES: Rohssan is a talented smith. One of the best around, if you ask me.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_RolandJensericTopic_0001d4b5_Obli: Roland was always a quiet man. It was only recently he'd met that young lady. Poor girl. We must avenge her death.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_RolandJensericTopic_0001d4b9_Obli: Roland was very much the loner. He never married, and was rarely seen outside his house. I'm surprised his secret wasn't discovered sooner.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_MG17ThalfinWhy_000366ef_Oblivion_: Rolis tried to make it through the door - he's the one that realized this wasn't going to work. One of their patrols spotted us, and Rolis went down.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_MS40Conversation_00098141_Oblivio: Rona, my dear, it's time to wake up.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_HELLO_00094ebb_Oblivion_RESP1: Rosentia sent word ahead that she has you to thank for freeing her of those accursed little beasts.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_RufioTopic_000251e8_Oblivion_RESP: Rufio is dead. He was murdered. It looks like he was hiding out from somebody after all.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_RufioTopic_000272ad_Oblivion_RESP: Rufio lies dead. Well done. The family will now welcome you with open arms.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_RufioTopic_000251e7_Oblivion_RESP: Rufio? He was killed! Murdered! Right here in my inn! And I thought business was bad before. When this gets out, I'll never rent another room!
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_RufioTopic_00023dd3_Oblivion_RESP: Rufio? He's an old codger. Been living here for a couple weeks now. If you ask me, he's hiding from something. But what do I care? He pays his tab.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_INFOGENERAL_0003c1c7_Oblivion_RES: Rufrius Vinicius is good with his fists. I've seen him in action, and it's impressive.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_CheydinhalNQDQuestionResponses_00: Rumor has it he joined the priesthood to avoid military service. What a coward.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_INFOGENERAL_00046629_Oblivion_RES: Rumor has it that Edla Dark-Heart left Skyrim with the law right behind her.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_advancementFG_0003355a_Oblivion_R: Rumor has it that Oreyn's looking for you. You didn't hear it from me, though. Good work, and good luck.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_ICAllNQDQuestionResponses_000498d: Rumor has it that he'll teach others to pick locks.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_INFOGENERAL_0002c5a2_Oblivion_RES: Rumor has it that the Fighters Guild is losing members to the Blackwood Company.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_TG03LlathasaIndarys_00045f76_Obli: Rumor has it that there were strange circumstances with her death, if you know what I mean.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_CurrentEventsResponses_00024e77_O: Rumor has it the Nerevarine has left Morrowind on an expedition to Akavir, and has not been heard from since.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_INFOGENERAL_00042da9_Oblivion_RES: Rumor has it there's another adventurer trying to get into the Realm. One more person to take up arms against me!
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_MS12Lost_00018237_Oblivion_RESP2: Rumors placed it in a snowy vale called Pale Pass. That's where Reman focused his attention.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_INFOGENERAL_0006a852_Oblivion_RES: Rumors? Oh! Well... Um... I... I heard you're the one who killed Adamus Phillida! The skill you must possess!
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_MagesStaff_0002ba61_Oblivion_RESP: Run along and let him know I haven't changed my mind, will you?
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GOODBYE_00081197_Oblivion_RESP1: Run along back to Lord Sheogorath.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GOODBYE_00081d91_Oblivion_RESP1: Run along now, little one. Go and play with the other godlings.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GOODBYE_0001ad51_Oblivion_RESP1: Run along now, see you later.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_INFOGENERAL_0008db91_Oblivion_RES: Run for your life and hide your head, the Knights of Order have returned. These soulless beings know naught else but death and now we all shall burn.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_INFOGENERAL_0008dc25_Oblivion_RES: Run headlong into the ruined city of Vitharn. There's nothing dangerous about that place at all.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_SE40SleepOutside_000790bf_Oblivio: Run him through -- or, run him out, I mean. Yeah, get rid of him. Then, your friend can sleep outside in Uungor's bed.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_VidkunTopic_0002e5ae_Oblivion_RES: Run into him, have you? As I said, he was incompetent. Couldn't pass a simple lesson.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_INFOGENERAL_0008dc17_Oblivion_RES: Run into the water to escape a Scalon. They won't follow you.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_Attack_0004eda4_Oblivion_RESP1: Run while you can, guild rat!
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_ArcaneULecture2_00071929_Oblivion: Runestones found in forts like Sancre Tor support a First Era date, though the stones could have been moved to the forts from earlier sites.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_INFOGENERAL_0005edbc_Oblivion_RES: Running Bliss must take a lot of energy. I'd rather just sit here. No reason to do anything else.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_INFOGENERAL_0004422d_Oblivion_RES: Running Crucible must take a lot of energy. I'd rather just sit here. No reason to do anything else.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_MS26CorruptGuard_000363b8_Oblivio: Ruslan and I were shopping at Jensine's when he accused us of stealing. We turned out our pockets to prove we were innocent, but he didn't care.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_HELLO_000363bb_Oblivion_RESP1: Ruslan and Luronk are going around saying that some of the Imperial Watch are corrupt.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_MS26FromCustomers_00035ca1_Oblivi: Ruslan and Luronk. Those idiots don't know when to stay quiet. Look, I'm not telling you anything, stranger. I don't trust you.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_RytheLythandasTopic_0003267a_Obli: Rythe Lythandas is one of the greatest painters in all Cyrodiil. Sadly, he's gone missing. His wife, Tivela, is beside herself with grief.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_INFOGENERAL_00143f0a_Oblivion_RES: Rythe Lythandas seems to be back in town. Wonder where he was off to?
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_MS14ReturnHome_0001c1cf_Oblivion_: Rythe! Oh my love! You are home safe... I was so afraid...
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GREETING_00022e5c_Oblivion_RESP2: S'Drassa of the Mages Guild, Evoker and Alchemist. And also, in his scant free time, a Trainer in Alchemy.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GREETING_000478a7_Oblivion_RESP1: S'Drassa of the Mages Guild, Evoker and Alchemist. And also, in his scant free time, a Trainer in Alchemy.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GREETING_0014c730_Oblivion_RESP1: S'Drassa of the Mages Guild, Evoker and Alchemist. And also, in his scant free time, a Trainer in Alchemy.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_ImperialCityTopic_000476e8_Oblivi: S'rathad learns the city by walking, talking, seeing it all. S'rathad thinks this is the best way for you, too.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_MS22SrazirrNotEnough_0002c81f_Obl: S'razirr will not be cheated again. The question is asked again: will you pay what was promised?
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GREETING_0003da54_Oblivion_RESP1: S'shani. The old sea captain and rover... now a shipowner and fatcat. Pleased to meet you.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_Sithis_00086764_Oblivion_RESP1: S...  Sithis? Well... I am just a lowly Murderer, but... But I know Sithis is our Dread Father. When we kill, we send him souls! Is that right?
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_INFOGENERAL_000434c2_Oblivion_RES: Sad about the Gatekeeper. I wonder if he had anything worth keeping?
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GlarthirTopic_0001dc27_Oblivion_R: Sad story. But at least we stopped him in time, thanks to you.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_RaynilDralasTopic_00038f0f_Oblivi: Sad that Raynil slipped away like that.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GREETING_000541cf_Oblivion_RESP2: Sadly I don't have any horses to sell. You bought our last Paint horse.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_TGSpecialJobs_00035dd8_Oblivion_R: Sadly, I don't have anything for you. I only work with the less experienced guild members. You should go see S'krivva in Bravil from now on.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GREETING_00035e01_Oblivion_RESP3: Sadly, you chose not to leave Phillida's severed finger as a warning to his successor. Your laziness has cost you your bonus, I'm afraid.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_TGSpecialJobs_00035dd9_Oblivion_R: Sadly, you must demonstrate more skill before I can allow a commission job.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_NDProphetStartA2_00002c82_Knights: Saint Pelinal, the Divine Crusader of legend -- Alessia's companion when she overthrew the rule of the Ayleids 3,000 years ago.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_SkingradNQDResponses_0003c1ed_Obl: Salmo's baking is fantastic. And her sweetrolls are unbeatable.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GREETING_00047710_Oblivion_RESP1: Salomon Geonette. I'm a musician. I had a commission from the Emperor to compose a symphony...
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_HELLO_00062c9c_Oblivion_RESP1: Salute! Welcome! Please say your piece.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_MS29ShadyDeal_0001e7f5_Oblivion_R: Same assortment of things? I mean, I have enough clothing for now.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_INFOGENERAL_000498df_Oblivion_RES: Samuel Bantien used to be a wild one. They say he used to be quite the "locksmith."
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_INFOGENERAL_000498e6_Oblivion_RES: Samuel Bantien used to be able to pick any lock in the city. He's settled down now, though.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GREETING_000476ca_Oblivion_RESP1: Samuel Bantien. You want to learn a few tricks about Security, I'm your man.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_ImperialCityTopic_000476cd_Oblivi: Samuel was a bit wild as a young man. The City will do that to you. Bad company, bad influences.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GREETING_0002697a_Oblivion_RESP1: Sanguine has set you to a task. Do what you must, so we may drink to your success.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GREETING_00026901_Oblivion_RESP1: Sanguine is pleased. It is reason to celebrate.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_MS27HerminiaA1_000a55ff_Oblivion_: Save your breath. He's the only one who knows I have it. He's tried to get it from me for years.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_JanusHassildorTopic_00035e5a_Obli: Saved you, did he? Well, that's a good sign.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_MS48HirtelC_0005d2cc_Oblivion_RES: Savlian says they can hold the road. No... no, I don't believe him. Nothing can stop them. If you'd seen it, you'd know...
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GREETING_0002855a_Oblivion_RESP1: Savlian's not really the captain, you know. We're just following him because he's the highest ranking officer left alive.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_DAMephalaSpeech_000579dc_Oblivion: Savor the divine essence of a well-spun plot. And here's a little needle to help you stitch your own tangled tapestries.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GREETING_000807a9_Oblivion_RESP1: Say what you will, receive your answers, and leave me to my solitude.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_PERSUASIONENTER_00062300_Oblivion: Say what you're going to say.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_HELLO_00062cd3_Oblivion_RESP1: Say your piece or stand aside.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GOODBYE_00084b46_Oblivion_RESP1: Say, could you pour me another? I seem to have run dry...
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_MS46Goblins_000319ce_Oblivion_RES: Say, do you think you could help us? We need to get the goblins off our land so we can start building our new settlement.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_SQ08Wine_0018d92d_Oblivion_RESP3: Say, that gives me an idea. You look like the adventuring type. If you can retrieve six bottles of Shadowbanish Wine, I'll gladly pay you well.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GREETING_0001671f_Oblivion_RESP1: Say, you look like someone that could help us out. Having a bit of trouble with another merchant in town who goes by the name Thoronir.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GOODBYE_0001ad50_Oblivion_RESP1: Saying goodbye is like ripping out a little piece of yourself. Ahhh.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GOODBYE_0008e524_Oblivion_RESP1: Saying goodbye is my favorite part of talking to you.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_INFOGENERAL_00077c39_Oblivion_RES: Scalons carry diseases. Lots of them.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_ScarTailTopic_00035593_Oblivion_R: Scar-Tail has fled Black Marsh and refuses to fulfill his duties as royal assassin! This is an act of treason! This treachery must be punished!
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_ScarTailTopic_00035594_Oblivion_R: Scar-Tail is a traitor to Argonia, and a blight upon Tamriel! Kill him, as my brother requests, and we will be forever in your debt.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_ScarTailTopic_00035595_Oblivion_R: Scar-Tail now lies with the worms of Bogwater, thanks to you. I am forever indebted to you, Brother.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_ScarTailTopic_0003559a_Oblivion_R: Scar-Tail now lies with the worms of Bogwater, thanks to you. I am forever indebted to you, Sister.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_ScarTailTopic_0003559b_Oblivion_R: Scar-Tail was once as a brother to me and Ocheeva. But his act of treason destroyed any vestige of that relationship. His death was well-deserved!
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GREETING_00022b1a_Oblivion_RESP1: Search his body. I'll keep an eye out, in case any of his friends are nearby.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_VampireAshTopic_000977d9_Oblivion: Search near the North Panther River for Hindaril. If you can vanquish him, his ashes will be more than adequate for my needs.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_TrainingQuestTopic_0006139a_Obliv: Search the mountains in the northeast of Cyrodiil for Aerin's Camp. Aerin can teach you all that you need to know.

ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GREETING_00073927_Oblivion_RESP4: See, when they swing at you sidearm, you twist your wrist like this... exactly! You're a natural at this. Let me show you another one...
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_MS45MissingDaughter_0009f8bd_Obli: Seed-Neeus is worried sick about her daughter Dar-Ma. If you think you can help, you'll find her at her shop, Northern Goods and Trade.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_HELLO_00025282_Oblivion_RESP1: Seeing you again is like a blessing from the Night Mother herself!

ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_SE02RelmynaVisit_0001a129_Oblivio: Seeing you warms my cold heart. Why has He forsaken us?
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_TrainingQuestTopic_00062462_Obliv: Seek her out at the Temple of the One in the Imperial City.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_MS40JanusAccept_0003ed37_Oblivion: Seek her out, and learn whether she can help. She lives somewhere along the river, east of the Imperial City and south of Cheydinhal.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_TGSpecialJobs_00002de1_Oblivion_R: Seek more loot. Keep the fences busy with your profits. Then we can talk.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_tasks_000f5837_Oblivion_RESP1: Seek out Arch-Mage Traven. He has personally requested that you see him for your next assignment.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GarridansTears_00022e60_Oblivion_: Seek out Julienne Fanis at the Arcane University in the Imperial City. She oversees the Alchemy Headquaters there.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GREETING_00025035_Oblivion_RESP2: Seek out Raminus Polus at the Arcane University. He alone can open the guild to you again.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_Nirnroot_0004e921_Oblivion_RESP2: Seek out Sinderion, a resident alchemist of Skingrad. Strange plants are his specialty.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_TrainingQuestTopic_0018d152_Obliv: Seek out Tooth-in-the-Sea. He can train you further.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_ND06CasimirHurryUp_00002b26_Knigh: Seek out the Chapel of Stendarr in Chorrol. The priests there can assist you.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GREETING_0000299e_Knights_RESP1: Seek out the priests in the Chapel of Stendarr. They may be able to help you retrieve the Gauntlets I lost so many years ago.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_BarterSellItem_00061c5d_Oblivion_: Seems a fair bargain to me.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_SE38Oddity8_00081e8e_Oblivion_RES: Seems like I've seen one of those before. But I guess it is Odd enough for the Museum... but I certainly can't justify buying it from you.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_PrimoAntoniusTopic_000289f6_Obliv: Seems like a nice enough kid. A little too rich for his own good, maybe, but I've met worse.
