ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_BrumaNQDResponses_000465de_Oblivi: Seems odd, given his vocation. Still, I suppose there's no harm.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_JorundrTopic_0005371f_Oblivion_RE: Seems the only way he's going to tell us anything is if you end up in jail with him.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_SEWildernessRumorResponses_000617: Seems things are a mess in New Sheoth.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_INFOGENERAL_00046604_Oblivion_RES: Seems to me that Ardaline has an admirer in Varon Vamori.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_ICAllNQDResponses_00049914_Oblivi: Seems to me, some things are worth paying full price for.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_HELLO_0018bcb5_Oblivion_RESP1: Seems you've bloodied your knuckles a few times.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GREETING_0003c36f_Oblivion_RESP1: Seems you've made your choice. I suppose we'll have to do it your way. I don't know what else to say.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_HELLO_00073038_Oblivion_RESP1: Seen any dead things laying around?
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_SE04ObelisksTopic_0009102d_Oblivi: Seen them about, have you? Odd things. They've always been here, but they're not OF here, if you take my meaning.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_SE07Ritual_00013660_Oblivion_RESP: Seldom is the subject ever bro-... wait a moment, did you want to hear the history of the Ritual?
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_SE09BodyParts_0001357b_Oblivion_R: Select one pair of legs, one left arm, right arm, torso, head, and heart. See me when you have finished your selections.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_SeleneTopic_00015716_Oblivion_RES: Selene no longer holds the Bloated Float. Once we get to the Imperial City, I intend to make sure she is prosecuted to the fullest extent of the law.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_HELLO_000165bb_Oblivion_RESP1: Selene'll get what's coming to her when we arrive home.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_TGSpecialJobs_00035dd9_Oblivion_R: Sell more stolen treasures to the fences. They will let me know when you have proven skillful enough.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_MS29ThoronirBad_0000bca2_Oblivion: Selling all sorts of merchandise, he undercuts prices like you wouldn't believe. He doesn't always sell what we sell, but it is still a problem.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GOODBYE_0008118f_Oblivion_RESP1: Send Relmyna my love. That'll get her going.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GOODBYE_00094ec6_Oblivion_RESP1: Send Rosentia my regards. If there's anything else I can do, please let me know!
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GOODBYE_000908f0_Oblivion_RESP1: Send a moron to do a man's job...
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_FGD02Insults_0002cfba_Oblivion_RE: Send me a drink, barkeep. And make it quick.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_FGD02Insults_0002cfc6_Oblivion_RE: Send over a drink. And make it quick!
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GREETING_0003d8c1_Oblivion_RESP1: Send them back to Oblivion! We'll hold the city in case any of them break through.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_SECreatureResponses_0008e80f_Obli: Sendockle the Klen. Do you understand? The Klen!
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GREETING_00035f35_Oblivion_RESP1: Sent you in to try your hand at the thing, have they?
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_SE08HaskillKnightsTopic1_00043f68: Separate the meat from bone, and they will die. When they do so, their crystalline hearts often remain intact.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GREETING_00002913_Knights_RESP1: Sergius Terrianus, at your service. Thedret and I go way back, and he said there was need of a Blacksmith here.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_SeridurTopic_0001db22_Oblivion_RE: Seridur is a nice enough fellow. For an Altmer, that is. I think he and Gilen, and that Argonian, Grey-Throat, have some kind of a club.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_SeridurTopic_0001da5c_Oblivion_RE: Seridur is an honorable man. Forming the Order shows just how much he cares about the Imperial City and protecting its people.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GREETING_0007504a_Oblivion_RESP1: Seridur is asleep right now. He's had a long night of study, and is exhausted. Do not disturb him. He'll be up at five this evening.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GREETING_000947b7_Oblivion_RESP1: Seridur is asleep right now. He's had a long night of study, and is exhausted. Do not disturb him. He'll be up at five this evening.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_SeridurTopic_0001e0b3_Oblivion_RE: Seridur said we should meet without him for a few days. He said something about doing field research? I'm sure he'll return soon.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_SeridurTopic_0001da5a_Oblivion_RE: Seridur? He comes in from time-to-time. Usually it's when he's out shopping. He always comes in with a large amount of travel food in his bag.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_SeridurTopic_0001da60_Oblivion_RE: Seridur? He founded this group a few years ago. I was impressed with his knowledge of vampires.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GREETING_00002974_Knights_RESP1: Serve the Nine with pride, Sir Knight.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_ServeSentence_000281b7_Oblivion_R: Serve your time peaceably, and pay your debt to society.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GREETING_000476c4_Oblivion_RESP1: Sevarius Atius. We will comply with the Watch's orders. The Atius family will stay clear of the Sintavs... if they stay clear of us.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GREETING_00023e0d_Oblivion_RESP1: Seven of the evening watch, and all's well. Everything's fine, ma'am.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GREETING_00023eb1_Oblivion_RESP1: Seven of the evening watch, and all's well. Everything's fine, sir.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GREETING_00023e1c_Oblivion_RESP1: Seven of the morning watch, and all's well. Top of the morning to you, ma'am.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GREETING_00023ee4_Oblivion_RESP1: Seven of the morning watch, and all's well. Top of the morning to you, sir.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_MagesStaff_000352b6_Oblivion_RESP: Several mages tend to the grove, and should be able to assist you. Speak with either Zahrasha or Elette when you arrive. And choose wisely.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_MQ11BrumaAllies_000be328_Oblivion: Several of the cities have sent aid. They're mustering on the plaza outside the castle, if you want to review the troops.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_MG04Choice1A_0002ee4f_Oblivion_RE: Several traveling merchants have been found dead along the Gold Road recently, with even more missing. The Council has asked that I put a stop to it.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_ArenaChampName3_00038b40_Oblivion: Shadowstep, huh? I like it! Yeah, that'll do nicely. All right, it's time to see if you're crazy good or just plain crazy.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GREETING_00063570_Oblivion_RESP1: Shall I continue with you, Lord?
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GREETING_00063571_Oblivion_RESP1: Shall I continue with you, Lord?
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GREETING_00027e38_Oblivion_RESP6: Shall I open the portal to Paradise? Are you ready?
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_SE05HerdirGreetChoice1_000805ea_O: Shall we get to work? There's much to be done. So many people to visit.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_Goblinhunting_00038ac2_Oblivion_R: Shamans have wicked magics... drains, paralyze... bad stuff. Stand off and shoot or spell shamans down if you can.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_MG13EridorWhere_0000979f_Oblivion: Shamar's up by the statue, Vontus is out in the High Pasture, and Carsten has the town exit near the Castle covered.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_HELLO_0008e65e_Oblivion_RESP1: Shame on you for polluting Crucible with the glaring light of Mania.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_NDProphetSpeechMQ4_00002d10_Knigh: Shame on you, people of Cyrodiil, and more shame for the children that you give freely to the mouth of Destruction!
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_SE39Kishashi_000781f1_Oblivion_RE: She a liar. Say she kill Minotaur with spoon. Ha. Ranarr-Jo, he trust nobody. Except he trust this liar. Why? They strange. Not good neighbors.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_BorderWatchTOPIC_000b122c_Oblivio: She also has the finest collection of cheeses in the Empire! Her prized cheese has such a powerful aroma, she keeps it sealed in a case!
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_EaranaTopic_000253c7_Oblivion_RES: She and I have an unpleasant history. She does not care for Guild regulations, and errantly believes I am mis-using my powers.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_MS21AnotherTask_000a657c_Oblivion: She and I have had our differences over the years, I admit. Now she is taking this opportunity to get her revenge.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_SE05MazaddhaWhy_00081187_Oblivion: She and Thadon... they've been meeting in secret. They've been doing things together. Consorting. You understand me?
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_SE11CiirtaTopic_00043f72_Oblivion: She believed it so strongly that she led a revolt against Sheogorath when He returned. She was imprisoned in the Howling Halls for her trouble.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_SkingradNQDResponses_0003c198_Obl: She can drink all she wants as long as she keeps doing such fine work.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_CharGenMain_0005319b_Oblivion_RES: She can help us. She must help us.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_TarMeenaTopic_00002dcd_Oblivion_R: She can likely be found in the Archives now, poring through materials on Necromancy. She stops only to sleep, at the Arch-Mage's request.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_SEMiscQuestResponses_000825de_Obl: She can make armor. And weapons. I've also heard she's found ways to make magical versions, as well.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_BrumaNQDResponses_0004661e_Oblivi: She can spin a yarn, that's for sure.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_LeyawiinNQDResponses_0003dfd2_Obl: She certainly can handle a blade. A bit of a show-off, if you ask me.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_CheydinhalNQDResponses_0003e2ce_O: She certainly does take pride in the Newlands.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_BravilNQDResponses_000465a2_Obliv: She certainly has a talent for speaking. Plus, she's willing to teach others this skill.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_SE06KanehTopic_00018dc4_Oblivion_: She commands the Aureals here at Cylarne. She has just arrived with reinforcements from Brellach to end this stalemate once and for all.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_JeanneFrasoricTopic_0001cef5_Obli: She couldn't cast her way out of a paper sack. It's insulting that we're here, working for her, when she knows nothing.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_MQ06MythicDawnAlarm_0001fb39_Obli: She dares to touch the sacred Xarxes! Kill her!
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_EaranaTopic_0002a689_Oblivion_RES: She deals in half-truths at best, outright lies at worse. If you have any information about her, or about her intentions, I expect you to inform me.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GREETING_0000395e_Oblivion_RESP2: She didn't take the news well. Oreyn has been expelled. And, I'm sorry to do this, but you've been demoted to Defender. You'll be fine, though.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_FGC01Choice4_0003663f_Oblivion_RE: She didn't, huh? Hmph. But, you've taken care of the problem, and I suppose that's what counts. Thanks for that. Here's your payment.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_LeyawiinNQDResponses_0003e218_Obl: She does love to show off her skill. I suppose you can learn a lot from her, though.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_INFOGENERAL_00046647_Oblivion_RES: She doesn't leave home much, but apparently Luciana Galena has a lot of experience fighting in light armor.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_SE37Errand_0008f558_Oblivion_RESP: She doesn't like it when I run through her plants. All she seems to care about is collecting plants and animals.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_SE05Interrogate1_00013fec_Oblivio: She doesn't tell me where she goes. It's not my place to know. Please, there's nothing else. There's nothing else to tell you.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_TG04BribeBeggar_0000932f_Oblivion: She eats dinner in the castle at the eighth bell. You may have to sweet talk her, but she knows all about Alessia Caro's habits and schedules.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_MS27QuestStart_0002e5ce_Oblivion_: She fancies herself a student of the Ayleids, although she sadly lacks any aesthetic instinct whatsover.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_ICAllNQDResponses_00049931_Oblivi: She gives good prices for your old equipment.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_SEServiceProviderResponses_000781: She has a gift for blades. No doubt about it.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_TrainingQuestTopic_000613b2_Obliv: She has a very successful shop in the Market District of the Imperial City.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GREETING_00016b87_Oblivion_RESP1: She has darkened... what will we do now?
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_SE11RakheranGreeting3b_00019fcb_O: She has forbidden me and those who support me from carrying weapons. And suspicious would it look if we were to wander around gathering them.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_SE10IssmiTopic_00016813_Oblivion_: She has taken up control of what little force we have left. She waits for you outside Brellach. Please hurry. There's not much time.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_Recommendation_0002db91_Oblivion_: She has visions, for lack of a better term. While they used to be helpful at times, they have lately become problematic.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_ArdalineTopic_0002d2e5_Oblivion_R: She hasn't been focused on her work recently. It's annoying, frankly.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_MS40Allright_0003e955_Oblivion_RE: She hated what she had become, and refused to feed to keep herself healthy. She eventually slipped into a coma from which she has not awoken.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_MS14TruepaintTopic_0001c1c6_Obliv: She heard his plea, and gifted him with the Brush. It's said the bristles of the Brush are woven from Dibella's own hair.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_NarinaCarvainTopic_0003b3f0_Obliv: She holds public audience in the Great Hall on weekday mornings. If you need to speak to her, that's the time to do it.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_SE09HaskillRelmynaVerenim_0004036: She is a powerful sorceress. She believes she has found a "sixth element," the element of Flesh.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_EaranaTopic_000253c9_Oblivion_RES: She is a scavenger, and has no respect for the power of the Arcane arts. She has no business here, and I will not aid her in any way.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_SE11CiirtaTopic_00043f72_Oblivion: She is an interesting character indeed. She is one of the very few individuals in the Shivering Isles that is party to the secret of Sheogorath.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_TG05FindMethredhel_00048978_Obliv: She is hiding in Dynari Amnis' house over in the Talos Plaza district. She's one of the few that escaped when Lex invaded the Waterfront.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_SE10AdeoTopic_00016816_Oblivion_R: She is leading what is left of our forces. She waits for you outside Pinnacle Rock. Please hurry to her before it is too late.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_MG07DagailConv_0001fbb6_Oblivion_: She is not well. I hope her amulet can be found soon.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_SE37Errand_0008f557_Oblivion_RESP: She is obsessed with collecting plants and animals. I'd steer clear of her. Now, do you mind moving? I need to sweep there.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_SE10DyloraTopic_00017d0d_Oblivion: She is our commander. She leads us. Without her, we are at a loss. I have done what I can to take her place, but I know I am insufficient.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_SE10StaadaTopic_00016b39_Oblivion: She is our commander. She leads us. Without her, we are at a loss. I have done what I can to take her place, but I know I am insufficient.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_MS40RonaWhere_0003ed3b_Oblivion_R: She is safe, hidden within the castle. That is all you need know for now.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_SE07ASyl_00013ffd_Oblivion_RESP1: She is staying well out of sight. No need to take unnecessary risks.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_SE06UlfriTopic_00018f8e_Oblivion_: She is the Grakedrig -- commander -- of the Mazken here at Cylarne. She has never yet been defeated by the Aureals, despite their strength.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_SE32Betrothed_00012d1f_Oblivion_R: She is the love of my life. I would do anything to save her.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_BravilNQDResponses_00046597_Obliv: She is very well-spoken. I understand she teaches those skills as well.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_ICAllNQDResponses_000498b1_Oblivi: She jumps like a toad. She'll also teach others how to do it.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_MatildePetitTopic_0002878d_Oblivi: She killed the others in cold blood, and she'll try to kill us next! I'm not about to stand around waiting to die! We need to kill Matilde!
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_LeyawiinNQDQuestionResponses_0003: She knows a lot about doing business. I don't like to bother her, though. She's a bit touchy when you do.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_SE39Cindanwe_000781f5_Oblivion_RE: She knows so much about us that she can read our minds! But she doesn't know about you yet. So, you must do it. Get rid of her. Get rid of Cindanwe!
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_ICAllNQDResponses_000498c1_Oblivi: She likes jumping off things. That's because she's an idiot.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_TG01BribeBeggar2_00016258_Oblivio: She lives on the Waterfront. She's a late sleeper though, in bed from sunrise 'til noon. She hangs out in the Bloated Float after sunset.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_TG04BribeBeggar2_0001625a_Oblivio: She lives on the west side of town. She is fond of the Three Sisters Lodge in the evening, but takes her midday meal at the Five Claws.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_TG04WhereAhdarji_00048975_Oblivio: She lives on the west side of town. She is fond of the Three Sisters Lodge in the evening, but takes her midday meal at the Five Claws.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_MatildePetitTopic_00028789_Oblivi: She looks pretty shaken, doesn't she? I can't tell if it's genuine fear or just really good acting. She's as much a suspect as anyone, don't forget.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_CheydinhalNQDQuestionResponses_00: She loves her dogs. No question about it.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_SE02Gatekeeper_0008e552_Oblivion_: She made him in the Gardens of Flesh and Bone. She's my teacher. She's going to teach me all her secrets.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_AgataTopic_00033799_Oblivion_RESP: She may be young, but her heart is old and wise. It guides her well through these troubled times.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_MatildePetitTopic_0002878a_Oblivi: She may look old and weak, but that's never stopped a murderer before, has it? Don't doubt for a second that she couldn't be the killer.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_SE02GatekeeperChoiceHowTears_0008: She may seem like a tough woman, but the Gatekeeper makes her all weepy. Go see for yourself. She visits him every night, around midnight.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_SE05Conspiracy_00080d40_Oblivion_: She might know something more than I do.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_BrumaNQDQuestionResponses_000465f: She moves really well in that armor, that's for sure.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_DovesiDranTopic_0007096d_Oblivion: She murdered all those innocent people, and I delivered justice, just like any Legion soldier would. I... I only did what I thought was right...
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_CharGenTaunt2_00033359_Oblivion_R: She must be so lonely. Don't you worry, eh? I'll take care of her long after you're dead. Oh, that's right. You're going to die in here!
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_ICAllNQDResponses_00049971_Oblivi: She must hate her job, people complaining to her all day.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_DarMaTopic_000280ba_Oblivion_RESP: She never showed up.  How am I supposed to run a shop without any merchandise?  You tell her I want half off on my next delivery.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_SE11CiirtaTopic_00043f72_Oblivion: She once made her way into the throne room during the Greymarch and saw that Sheogorath was nowhere to be found.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_BravilNQDResponses_000465e2_Obliv: She probably takes on more than she should. Between smithing and training, she's always hard at work.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_LeyawiinNQDResponses_0003dfa1_Obl: She really doesn't seem to like her sisters. Sad, really.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_BravilNQDQuestionResponses_000465: She really is a gifted orator. I wish she'd teach me how to do that.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_TG03LlathasaIndarys_000092b2_Obli: She remained young while he aged. Not too long ago she was found slain. It's all hush-hush. Nobody knows exactly what happened.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_CheydinhalNQDResponses_0003e95a_O: She runs a good inn, and she's proud of it.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_MS31Wrath02Positive_00015261_Obli: She said when we got back to the safe house in Bravil, we would divide the loot after she fenced the damn thing.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_SEMiscQuestResponses_0008e12d_Obl: She seeks a cure to calm her ills and will gladly reward gold to pay your bills.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_MS23RolandSad_0001d4c6_Oblivion_R: She seemed entranced as he wrapped his arms around her and sank his teeth into her neck. I burst from my hiding place and attacked Seridur.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_MatildePetitTopic_000286e6_Oblivi: She seems frightened, like the rest of us. I bet now she's regretting ever stepping foot in this house, gold or no.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_AnvilNQDResponses_0003c265_Oblivi: She seems like a good person to talk to. I imagine she could teach me a lot.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_BrumaNQDQuestionResponses_000465f: She seems skilled in its use. I can see why the Fighters Guild has her training others.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_LeyawiinNQDResponses_0003dfaa_Obl: She seems to have real issues with her sisters. I can't imagine why. Shamada is lovely, and Shomara is very sweet.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_DovesiDranTopic_00028709_Oblivion: She seems very upset by the murder. I do hope she'll be all right.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_MS51AccuseChoice1_00031510_Oblivi: She shall be banished from Castle Chorrol and stripped of her duties. However, I am not without pity, and therefore she shall not be jailed.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_MS51AccuseChoice1_0003151f_Oblivi: She shall be banished from Castle Chorrol and stripped of her duties. However, I am not without pity, and therefore she shall not be jailed.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_SeersStone_0001e067_Oblivion_RESP: She shouldn't even be here anymore. Hell, the only reason her father ever fit in anywhere is because he kept a low profile. And look what it got him!
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_ICAllNQDResponses_0004996d_Oblivi: She takes all the complaints, but nothing ever seems to happen.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_BravilNQDQuestionResponses_000466: She tends to keep to herself, that's for sure. That's too bad.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_QuillWeaveTOPIC_00036637_Oblivion: She thinks she's so smart. She and all the other women. I'll show her! I want you to keep an eye on her. Find out what she's up to.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_SE06MaikiChoiceA_00012cbe_Oblivio: She thinks the Underdeep is a trap. It's true, if the Mazken knew we were coming that way, we wouldn't stand a chance.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_AnvilNQDResponses_0003c264_Oblivi: She travels a lot to research her books. She's in great shape from all that travel. Maybe she'd teach me a bit about getting into shape.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_TG04AlessiaSchedule_0003b3fb_Obli: She travels to Chorrol on the Ides of every month. Don't even try to find her between the 15th and 17th.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_TG07NewCaptain_0009839c_Oblivion_: She wants me to tip you! You add insult to injury. You cost my cousin a chance at that job. Take your money and get out of my sight!
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_DovesiDranTopic_00028d36_Oblivion: She was a child, and some sick murdering dog struck her down in cold blood. I swear, if I find out you did this I'll kill you with my bare hands.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_VenaPetilius_00026b49_Oblivion_RE: She was a good woman, and Melus loved her as best he could. He was off fighting when she died. A sudden fever, and she was gone.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_SeleneTopic_0000c1ca_Oblivion_RES: She was a ruthless woman, and I'm glad she's behind bars where she belongs.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_SeleneTopic_000c7630_Oblivion_RES: She was a ruthless woman, and I'm glad she's behind bars where she belongs.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_SeleneTopic_0000c1c8_Oblivion_RES: She was a ruthless woman, and I'm glad she's gone. Such a waste...
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_SeleneTopic_000c762f_Oblivion_RES: She was a ruthless woman, and I'm glad she's gone. Such a waste...
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_DagailTopic_0003395d_Oblivion_RES: She was a very powerful mage once, from what I understand. Hard to imagine that, honestly.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GOODBYE_00053764_Oblivion_RESP1: She was an evil, evil woman.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_SE09HaskillRelmynaVerenim_0004036: She was expelled from the Mages Guild for this belief, and for the... extreme nature of her experiments.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_Unseen_000038a5_Oblivion_RESP1: She was here a second ago...
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_VenaPetilius_00026b4b_Oblivion_RE: She was my wife, and I would rather not speak of her now.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_SE07TheFringeTopic_000912a2_Obliv: She was right about that. I can feel it. In My bones. The little ones.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_DovesiDranTopic_00028712_Oblivion: She was so beautiful. And now she's gone...
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_EaranaTopic_00028c00_Oblivion_RES: She was unable to acquire the book, and that shall be enough for me. It would be beneath me to continue this petty squabble.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_BejeenTOPIC_00026ac6_Oblivion_RES: She wasn't a bad sort until she hooked up with that rascal Weebam-Na. That's where you're likely to find her... at Weebam-Na's house.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_SE06HelpDefendA3_00018f9a_Oblivio: She will reveal all her plans to you, Sheogorath's emissary! Beautifully devious. It embarrasses me not to have thought of it first.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_SESylTopic_0008f177_Oblivion_RESP: She will suffer greatly at the hands of Lord Sheogorath.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_JeanneFrasoricTopic_0001ceec_Obli: She won't figure this out for weeks!
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_LeyawiinTopic_000479d9_Oblivion_R: She wonders why she cannot find me? Doesn't it occur to her? That I am hiding from her?
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_TrainingQuestTopic_00000812_Altar: She worked in the Chapel of Akatosh in Kvatch. I haven't seen her in quite some time.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_TrainingQuestTopic_000613a8_Obliv: She worked in the Chapel of Akatosh in Kvatch. I haven't seen her in quite some time.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_SEMiscQuestResponses_0008261c_Obl: She works the other residents pretty hard. I hear they're not happy.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_SEMiscQuestResponses_0008261d_Obl: She works them too hard. I'm sure they're looking to do something about it.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GOODBYE_0001333c_Oblivion_RESP1: She would want me to die well.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_DAClavicusChoice4_00026b17_Oblivi: She'd always been fair with a sword, but she began looking for fights. Became bloodthirsty. Then started calling herself Umbra, after the sword.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_DAClavicusChoice6_00026b19_Oblivi: She'd always been fair with a sword, but she began looking for fights. Became bloodthirsty. Then started calling herself Umbra, after the sword.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_SE39Kishashi_000781f2_Oblivion_RE: She'll actually get something done. The problem with her is getting her motivated. You have to play mind games, with that one.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_ReadyForAMatch_00018290_Oblivion_: She'll come out of that gate with a warhammer the size of a child, and she'll swing it until your head explodes! Don't let that happen!
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_DovesiDranTopic_00028198_Oblivion: She's a Dark Elf and a harlot, and for all I know she's a murderer too! Now leave me be, you cretin!
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_DovesiDranTopic_00028cdc_Oblivion: She's a Dark Elf. What, you blind as well as dumb?
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_SE09RelmynaVerenim_00014ae7_Obliv: She's a bit obsessed with it. And with Me. Makes dealing with her difficult. You shouldn't have any problems, though. No one likes you that much.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_BravilNQDQuestionResponses_000466: She's a bit strange, but I've heard she's rather good at not being seen, if you know what I mean.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_BrumaNQDResponses_000465ae_Oblivi: She's a disgrace to our whole city. Poor Olfand.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_SkingradNQDResponses_0003c216_Obl: She's a hard worker, and they make some fine wine.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_AnvilNQDResponses_0003c256_Oblivi: She's a nut. Whatever's going on in that house, I don't want to know about it.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_BravilNQDResponses_00046642_Obliv: She's a sly one. I understand she's quite sneaky.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_LeyawiinNQDQuestionResponses_0003: She's a smart one. You could learn a lot from her.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_CheydinhalNQDResponses_0003e99d_O: She's a very demanding teacher. You can learn a lot from her, if you're willing to try.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_BravilNQDResponses_0004664b_Obliv: She's a very private person, but I've heard she has a lot of knowledge to share.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_MirisaTopic_000319d7_Oblivion_RES: She's a wilderness guide we hired to lead our expedition to Cropsford. Saved our lives when the goblins attacked.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_DovesiDranTopic_00028a0f_Oblivion: She's afraid for her life, as we should be! There's someone else in this house, my friend. Someone hiding somewhere, killing us off one by one!
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_MatildePetitTopic_00028c28_Oblivi: She's afraid, and for good reason. If the killer strikes again, they may very well pick an easy target, like Matilde. She needn't worry, though.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_MatildePetitTopic_00028232_Oblivi: She's all right, I guess. Not that it's any business of yours.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_BravilNQDResponses_000465d7_Obliv: She's always busy, that's for sure. I have heard she's a good teacher, though.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_SEMiscQuestResponses_0008261a_Obl: She's always looking for new items for the Museum of Oddities.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_BravilNQDQuestionResponses_000465: She's an excellent alchemist. I understand she teaches the trade for Mages Guild members.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_DovesiDranTopic_00028a05_Oblivion: She's an innocent young girl, and she doesn't need people like you asking questions about her.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_AgataTopic_0003395f_Oblivion_RESP: She's been a great help to all of us in the guild. Without her, I think Dagail would be lost at times.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_SEMiscQuestResponses_0008262d_Obl: She's been paying well for certain magic items that might protect her.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_Dark01Choice2C_00022ba1_Oblivion_: She's been watching you. Observing as you kill, admiring as you end life without pity or remorse. The Night Mother is most pleased...
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_ICAllNQDQuestionResponses_0004989: She's certainly good. I'm glad she's willing to teach others.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GOODBYE_0005144a_Oblivion_RESP1: She's dead. I'm sorry, sire, but we have to keep moving.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_MatildePetitTopic_0002878e_Oblivi: She's dead. You wouldn't happen to know anything about that, now would you?
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_SE39Cindanwe_000781f3_Oblivion_RE: She's dead? Very good. She was controlling our minds with evil magic. She's a vampire you know. Yep, sucked my blood when I was asleep, every night.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_contract_00002e54_Oblivion_RESP1: She's dead? What have you done? Of all the irresponsible.... I'm very disappointed in you. You've let me down and your Guild.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_SEMiscQuestResponses_0008dc9f_Obl: She's definitely not trying to catalogue all the living things in the Shivering Isles.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_MatildePetitTopic_0002878c_Oblivi: She's either a frightened old woman or a cold-blooded killer! I don't know whether I should comfort her or hit her over the head with a rock!
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GREETING_0003457e_Oblivion_RESP2: She's expelled Oreyn from the guild. Stripped him of all rank and privileges. And you, she's demoted you. You've been busted down to Protector.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_WeatherleahTopic_000878d6_Oblivio: She's explored the back country outside of Chorrol quite a bit.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_DovesiDranTopic_00028a0c_Oblivion: She's frightened, of course. No one that young should be exposed to such horrors.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_TarMeenaTopic_00002dc4_Oblivion_R: She's given you a book? I would know everything you have learned from it.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_INFOGENERAL_00032e92_Oblivion_RES: She's got no business poking around in Brittlerock Cave, but the customer is always right, eh?
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_MazogatheOrcTopic_00086069_Oblivi: She's got terrible manners. Being her friend may be a lot of work. But my sniffer says she might be worth it.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_TG05BribeBeggar2_00016250_Oblivio: She's hiding in Dynari Amnis' house in the Talos Plaza district. She's one of the few that escaped when Lex invaded the Waterfront.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_ICAllNQDQuestionResponses_000498b: She's impressive, and she'll train others.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_TG05WhereSkrivva_00090c55_Oblivio: She's in all the usual places. I'll need a donation to refresh my memory.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_TG05BribeBeggar4_00090c56_Oblivio: She's in the Lonely Suitor Lodge for her noon meal. That much I'm sure of.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_SE32Betrothed_00012d03_Oblivion_R: She's in the hands of the Fanatics! I must save her. Stand back, stranger. I need room to swing my sword.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_JearlTopic_000221f8_Oblivion_RESP: She's just back from a trip south, they say. Haven't seen hide nor hair of her myself though. Stays indoors all day long, I guess.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_DagailTopic_00033960_Oblivion_RES: She's led such a troubled life. I just do what I can to make it easier on her.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_SEMiscQuestResponses_0008dcb3_Obl: She's looking for certain magic items that might protect her, but she's not willing to pay for them.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GOODBYE_000165be_Oblivion_RESP1: She's lucky I didn't have her tossed overboard.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_JeanneFrasoricTopic_0001cef5_Obli: She's managed to butter up the right people just enough to keep her position, and there's little we can do about it.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_EaranaTopic_0002acc9_Oblivion_RES: She's nothing but trouble. She went to the University long ago, but was expelled from the guild. Caused all kinds of trouble while she was there.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_ICAllNQDQuestionResponses_000498c: She's nuts. Her hobby is falling from high places.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_KudEiTopic_00027f35_Oblivion_RESP: She's offered a reward, but as far as I know, nobody's taken her up on the offer. Not sure who's missing either, she's keeping quiet about it.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_ICAllNQDResponses_000498b4_Oblivi: She's pretty amazing. Plus, she teaches others how to do it.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_CheydinhalNQDResponses_0003e96e_O: She's pretty shy, unless you get her talking about armor.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_BrumaNQDResponses_000465fc_Oblivi: She's quite a warrior. It's amazing how well she moves in heavy armor.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_DovesiDranTopic_00028706_Oblivion: She's quite beautiful, isn't she? A little young, perhaps, and not exactly high-born, but she possesses a unique elegance.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_BloatedFloat_00015714_Oblivion_RE: She's ready to sail, don't worry about it. We'll get you back home in one piece.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_LeyawiinNQDQuestionResponses_0003: She's ridiculous. I don't know what her problem with Argonians is, but she's always trying to start something.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_BrumaNQDQuestionResponses_000465a: She's ridiculous. I suppose some may find it amusing, but not me.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_CheydinhalNQDResponses_0003e97c_O: She's silver-tongued, but I don't want to listen to her.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_ICAllNQDQuestionResponses_000498b: She's something else. I've heard she'll train others, as well.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_EaranaTopic_0002acba_Oblivion_RES: She's staying in one of the rooms upstairs, though she seems to spend most of her time down by the Mages Guild.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_ICAllNQDResponses_00049890_Oblivi: She's the best I know. Luckily, she'll teach you some of her tricks.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_BrumaNQDQuestionResponses_0004661: She's the best bard I've ever met. Of course, being a bard is almost as bad as being a pilgrim. There's no future in it.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_ICAllNQDQuestionResponses_0004989: She's the best in the city. And, she'll teach others. It'll cost you, though.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_SkaleelTopic_00035f4d_Oblivion_RE: She's the mage heading up the on-site research. She can tell you more about whatever it is that's impeding their progress.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_AgataTopic_00033791_Oblivion_RESP: She's the one you want to talk to if you actually need something to get done around here. I don't even know why Dagail is still around.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_QuillWeaveTOPIC_00036637_Oblivion: She's the one. She's never liked me or my sweet little pets. I know it's her. I've even seen her sneaking around in back of my house at night.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_DovesiDranTopic_0002870b_Oblivion: She's upset, you bufoon, just like the rest of us! Two people have been murdered! I hope you're not suggesting she could be the killer!
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_MatildePetitTopic_00028c26_Oblivi: She's upset, you idiot! Murder has that effect on people!
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_CheydinhalNQDQuestionResponses_00: She's very dedicated. We would be lucky to have more people like her around.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_SE13AllyShoutReinforcements_0004d: Sheogorath be praised! More Mazken have joined the fight!
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_MS43Scamps_0004f8ba_Oblivion_RESP: Sheogorath certainly has a sick sense of humor.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_INFOGENERAL_00060520_Oblivion_RES: Sheogorath gone, and me not far behind. I think this cold will finally be the death of me.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_INFOGENERAL_000605ec_Oblivion_RES: Sheogorath gone. The Duke gone. This whole thing is making me really, really nervous. I need to calm down.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_INFOGENERAL_0006039b_Oblivion_RES: Sheogorath gone? I'd check the bedchambers of every maiden in town... you'll find Him eventually.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_SE11CiirtaGreeting1a_00016b6e_Obl: Sheogorath had fled! Left us all to die! I hid as the doors to the throne room burst open.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_SEWildernessRumorResponses_00061c: Sheogorath has abandoned the Realm. We're doomed.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_SE09HaskillGatekeeper_0004036a_Ob: Sheogorath has asked that you create a new Gatekeeper to stand watch over the Fringe.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_INFOGENERAL_000605f6_Oblivion_RES: Sheogorath has disappeared! How can I be expected to paint at a time like this?
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_INFOGENERAL_0006052d_Oblivion_RES: Sheogorath has disappeared. This is worse than my nightmares.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GREETING_00014b6b_Oblivion_RESP2: Sheogorath has fallen and you seek the means to foil the machinations of the Prince of Order. You seek the Throne of Madness.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_INFOGENERAL_00060365_Oblivion_RES: Sheogorath has left us to think for ourselves and to turn to Arden-Sul's teachings for enlightenment.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_INFOGENERAL_00060529_Oblivion_RES: Sheogorath has left. Where did he go? It's a mystery! I love mystery stories. I wonder how this one will end.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_SEMiscQuestResponses_0008dcb4_Obl: Sheogorath has sent it away. It's definitely not back in the Isles.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_SE04ObelisksTopic_00091059_Oblivi: Sheogorath has tried to remove them, but they always return. While they cannot be destroyed, they can be rendered inert.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_INFOGENERAL_000605e9_Oblivion_RES: Sheogorath has vanished? Another already seeks his throne. One tyrant passes and another rises. To the void with them.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GREETING_0007fde5_Oblivion_RESP1: Sheogorath has vanished? He proves his cowardice! Leaving us here to die at the hands of Order.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_INFOGENERAL_00060391_Oblivion_RES: Sheogorath has vanished? I certainly hope it had nothing to do with the Greenmote Upsidedown Cake I sent to the Castle.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_INFOGENERAL_00060521_Oblivion_RES: Sheogorath hasn't disappeared. Did you know that he and Jyggalag are the same person? It's all very hard to understand.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GOODBYE_00081da2_Oblivion_RESP1: Sheogorath is even more handsome in real life!
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_INFOGENERAL_0006050a_Oblivion_RES: Sheogorath is gone. Better carry a blade, just in case. Use it on your enemies, if things get bad. Or on yourself, if things get worse.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_INFOGENERAL_00060512_Oblivion_RES: Sheogorath is gone. Maybe I kidnapped him. That would merit a death sentence!
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_INFOGENERAL_000603a2_Oblivion_RES: Sheogorath is gone. This can only mean the end is near.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_INFOGENERAL_00060508_Oblivion_RES: Sheogorath is gone? If he is gone, then who is watching us?
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_INFOGENERAL_00060399_Oblivion_RES: Sheogorath is missing. A drink in his order is in honor. Honor is in order. Whatever.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_SESheogorathTopic_00078c69_Oblivi: Sheogorath is our Lord, ruler of the Shivering Isles. It is by his whim that the Mazken walk, and we serve our Master to the death.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_INFOGENERAL_000605ed_Oblivion_RES: Sheogorath leaves in the middle of the Greymarch. Perhaps I should take over ruling the Realm.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_INFOGENERAL_0006036c_Oblivion_RES: Sheogorath may be gone, but I will still serve the House of Mania until my death.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_SE11CiirtaGreeting1_00016b6d_Obli: Sheogorath refuses to protect us. Madgod? Bah! The Greymarch brings darkness. We seek light for all.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_SESheogorathTopic_00078c68_Oblivi: Sheogorath rules the Shivering Isles. We, the Aureal, are His favored soldiers, the most perfect expression of His might.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GREETING_00016eaa_Oblivion_RESP1: Sheogorath sent for me and I have arrived. That's all I know.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_SE03AResonatorofJudgmentT_00018df: Sheogorath uses the Resonator to find the "cream of the crop" as he calls them; the best of the worst to populate the Isles.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_SEManiaRumorResponses_00061c70_Ob: Sheogorath will return. He must return!
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GREETING_00081d90_Oblivion_RESP1: Sheogorath's Duchess or not, you try my patience! Are you confused about your task?
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GREETING_00013562_Oblivion_RESP1: Sheogorath's Duke or not, you try my patience! Are you confused about your task?
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_INFOGENERAL_0005f3e9_Oblivion_RES: Sheogorath's armies again can protect sweet Sheer-Meedish.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_INFOGENERAL_0005f3ed_Oblivion_RES: Sheogorath's armies are at full strength once more. They will be needed in times ahead.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_INFOGENERAL_0005f3ef_Oblivion_RES: Sheogorath's armies have returned. They'll protect me while I protect my belongings.

ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GREETING_00036645_Oblivion_RESP1: So, Martin wants you to recover the Armor of Tiber Septim? I wish there was another way.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_MQ09ArmorTopic_000c4315_Oblivion_: So, Martin wants you to recover the Armor of Tiber Septim? I wish there was another way.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_NelsTheNaughtyTopic_00028184_Obli: So, Nels is dead. I don't condone murder, of course, but I can't say he'll be missed. As a rule, I find Nords rather... vulgar.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_Dark08NelsNevConvo_000852c1_Obliv: So, Nord, if you find the gold, what will you spend it on? Wait, let me guess -- a sleazy whore and a nice new battleaxe. Am I right?
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_ThoronirTopic_0000bc9e_Oblivion_R: So, Ogier sent you, eh? Well then, he usually sizes up people well, so you may be just what we're looking for.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_ThoronirTopic_0000bc9f_Oblivion_R: So, Tertullian sent you, eh? Well then, he usually sizes up people well, so you may be just what we're looking for.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_INFOGENERAL_00043e8d_Oblivion_RES: So, Thadon has the Chalice again? I wish I had time to loaf about and drink Felldew.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_MS27HerminiaA3_000a5602_Oblivion_: So, Umbacano has resorted to hired thugs now?
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_INFOGENERAL_00042da2_Oblivion_RES: So, a newcomer may arrive in the Isles? I hope it's a guy and I hope he's cute. It's slim pickings around here.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_ND09ProphetGreeting02a_00002c0f_K: So, although you wear the armor of the gods, it is incomplete -- a relic of the old ways and the old gods.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_ND09ProphetGreeting02b_00002cd5_K: So, although you wear the armor of the gods, it is incomplete -- a relic of the old ways and the old gods.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GREETING_0000290b_Knights_RESP1: So, another one who has come to listen to the madman's rantings.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GREETING_00038429_Oblivion_RESP1: So, any new revelations in your... errr.... investigation?
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GREETING_000275be_Oblivion_RESP1: So, are you ready to mingle with the doomed house guests? The contract is waiting.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GREETING_0002826a_Oblivion_RESP1: So, are you ready to search for the chest of gold? I'm confident I'll find it. Not that I need the money, of course. My family is quite wealthy.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GREETING_00009c7b_Oblivion_RESP1: So, at last we meet. I have been following your strange journey through the Dark Brotherhood, young one.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GREETING_0003661d_Oblivion_RESP1: So, did you follow her? She's behind it, isn't she? Tell me what you found out!
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GREETING_00013452_Oblivion_RESP2: So, do you feel any different? Now that you've been through this experience, I mean.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_Question_0003e99f_Oblivion_RESP1: So, have you bet on any Arena matches lately?
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_HELLO_000a9344_Oblivion_RESP1: So, have you managed to persuade Herminia Cinna to part with the Ayleid Crown?
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GREETING_00002e41_Oblivion_RESP1: So, have you taken care of those thieves yet?
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_StolenGold_00053777_Oblivion_RESP: So, he told you another one of his tall tales. I hope you didn't believe him. What's he got in store for me? He send you to kill me? Is that it?
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_HELLO_0002948a_Oblivion_RESP1: So, here we all are. It certainly is a nice house.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_Dark11Choice1A_00002db8_Oblivion_: So, here's the list of all my precious little ones, though I dare say they're not so little anymore! Ha ha ha ha ha! They grow up so fast, I swear!
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GREETING_00022cec_Oblivion_RESP1: So, here's the plan. I'll meet with the Sponsor, while you cover me from the upper gallery. What do you think?
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GREETING_0006245d_Oblivion_RESP1: So, how about it? Are you ready to fight now?
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GREETING_00040b9c_Oblivion_RESP1: So, how'd you like to get together later and leaf through my octavo?
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_SE11RakheranGreeting2b_00019fc9_O: So, if you will help me, I will help you. Ciirta will die and you will not need to lift a finger. Then you can take whatever you need and go.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GREETING_0002241c_Oblivion_RESP1: So, it's Hero now, is it? I suppose the little urchin wants to be a Champion. Bah! You will never join our ranks! We are gods among mortals!
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_contract_0006145b_Oblivion_RESP1: So, it's a secret contract then, is it? You must be moving up in the world. Congratulations.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_contract_00027988_Oblivion_RESP1: So, it's to be five against one, is it? The odds are against you. With any luck, you'll be dead within an hour.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GREETING_00058e02_Oblivion_RESP4: So, like I said, thanks. I'm glad I was able to come here and do my bit for our side, you know?
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GREETING_00025b3a_Oblivion_RESP1: So, ready for your next match?
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_StolenGold_0005375f_Oblivion_RESP: So, she's dead eh? Hahaha. Finally! Finally someone has wiped that stupid smug grin off her face. Good, good.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_StolenGold_000a04dc_Oblivion_RESP: So, she's dead eh? Hahaha. Finally! Finally someone has wiped that stupid smug grin off her face. Good, good.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_MS09AlreadyDead_00090869_Oblivion: So, she's dead, eh? Hahaha. Finally! Finally someone has wiped that stupid smug grin off her face. Good, good.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_BlackBrugo08_00090b7b_Oblivion_RE: So, thank you. You been good to me. And I won't ever forget it.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_BlackBrugo09_00090b7c_Oblivion_RE: So, thank you. You been good to me. And I won't ever forget it.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_BlackBrugo10_00090b7d_Oblivion_RE: So, thank you. You've been good to me. And I won't ever forget it.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_INFOGENERAL_00089935_Oblivion_RES: So, thanks to some hired help, the Jemanes recovered Weatherleah. Good thing... I never liked having ogres so close to Chorrol.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_Investigation_00031529_Oblivion_R: So, the Countess hired you to find the painting, eh? Well, you'll not find it by gawking at me.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_INFOGENERAL_0005f1e9_Oblivion_RES: So, the Gatekeeper is back at its post... good. Now we all may be able to get things done around here.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_INFOGENERAL_0004421a_Oblivion_RES: So, the Great Torch burns. I know something about burning. The human body makes a pretty good torch, especially the fattier parts.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GREETING_0000a09f_Oblivion_RESP1: So, the Night Mother has spoken! I will make sure this information reaches the appropriate family members. Ah yes, here are your weekly earnings.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_INFOGENERAL_000441dd_Oblivion_RES: So, the Torch is lit. Can a flame be captured in time? Would it still burn?
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GREETING_00023f7c_Oblivion_RESP1: So, the accident has been staged, and Baenlin lies dead. Well done! You have more than earned your reward and bonus.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_INFOGENERAL_0005f453_Oblivion_RES: So, the armies have been restored. They'd better not show up here looking to procure my crops.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_SE12TraitorTaunts_0008f7da_Oblivi: So, the bloody-handed Duchess comes to claim another victim!
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_SE12TraitorTaunts_0008f7c6_Oblivi: So, the bloody-handed Duke comes to claim another victim!
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GREETING_0003d48b_Oblivion_RESP6: So, the bottom line is, you show a little skin... just a tease. No one touches you. What do you say?
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_MQ15MankarRant_0008c21b_Oblivion_: So, the cat's-paw of the Septims arrives at last.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GREETING_000206ad_Oblivion_RESP1: So, the cycle begins anew and the Dutchess of Dementia has fallen.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GREETING_00022504_Oblivion_RESP1: So, the deed is done. How do I know this? You will find that the Dark Brotherhood knows a great many things. For you are now part of the family.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GREETING_0002ee2f_Oblivion_RESP1: So, the enforcer Hides-His-Heart has been killed. He was to bear witness to Motierre's death, and report back to his superiors.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GREETING_000711b8_Oblivion_RESP1: So, the infamous criminal surrenders? This calls for a celebration! So... pay the fine or serve your sentence. Your stolen goods are forfeit.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GREETING_000837e7_Oblivion_RESP1: So, the last guest finally arrives. I'll tell you what I told all the others. You go in, I lock the door. You don't come out 'til it's over.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_TG05LexToDremora_0000a235_Oblivio: So, the mages send a foul daedra to deliver a simple note when an honest footman would have done. How typical.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_INFOGENERAL_000441fb_Oblivion_RES: So, the mighty Syl has fallen. Well then, that's one less woman to worry about... more men for me!
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_INFOGENERAL_0003f14f_Oblivion_RES: So, the mighty Ulrich Leland has fallen. Apparently Llevana Nedaren snapped and killed him. Good riddance I say.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GREETING_00019132_Oblivion_RESP1: So, the pirate has been eliminated. Excellent. No one will mourn his passing, and Sithis has been appeased.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_INFOGENERAL_000607c1_Oblivion_RES: So, the story has been rewritten and the Greymarch is at a new ending. Arden-Sul's will be done.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_Dark12Choice1C_0005179d_Oblivion_: So, the thief opts for the stoic approach, hmm? Oh, my friend, I'm afraid you've broken into your last house. Ha ha ha ha ha!
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GREETING_00009180_Oblivion_RESP1: So, the work is complete. Now we can discuss the information I have for you.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GREETING_0003d4c5_Oblivion_RESP1: So, they're at Gweden, eh? Good to know. Keep on it.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_INFOGENERAL_000434b9_Oblivion_RES: So, this mystery adventurer has breached our defenses. I better prepare a special dish to commemorate this event.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_DovesiDranTopic_00028d33_Oblivion: So, three of us left -- you, Dovesi and myself. The list of suspects is certainly getting smaller. With Nels dead, my eye is on Dovesi.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_MS46GoblinWar_0000ab72_Oblivion_R: So, to stop the war, all you need to do is sneak into Timberscar Cave, find the stolen Tribal Head, and return it to the Cracked Wood Cave goblins.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GREETING_0000566f_Oblivion_RESP7: So, we have no choice but to invoke an ancient ritual. We must wake the Night Mother from her slumber, and seek her guidance!
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GREETING_00053760_Oblivion_RESP1: So, were you able to find out about the gold or not?
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_duties_0006e2e3_Oblivion_RESP5: So, what are your first orders, Guildmaster?
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_HELLO_0018d929_Oblivion_RESP1: So, what brings you here today?
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_ND06CurseTopic_00002b1e_Knights_R: So, what can be done for me? I know you've learned something. I can see it in your face.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GREETING_0002366d_Oblivion_RESP1: So, what did you discover about the upstanding Davide Surilie?
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_SE46Choice1_0008fab8_Oblivion_RES: So, what does he do? What else? Casts a spell. You can see how well that went. Two of each of us walking around this place.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GREETING_0002edd7_Oblivion_RESP1: So, what of the Rogue mage? Has he been found?
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_HELLO_0018917b_Oblivion_RESP1: So, what's the news from Greyland?
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_NDTalkUmaril1_00002c58_Knights_RE: So, when do you think we will be able to strike back at this foul Umaril creature?
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_SE07Decision_0001e3ec_Oblivion_RE: So, which is it? What will it be? Mania? Dementia? The suspense is killing me. Or you, if I have to keep waiting.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GREETING_00028b80_Oblivion_RESP3: So, why am I here? Greed, my friend. I need the gold. I served the Legion proudly for twenty-three years, but pride doesn't put food on my table.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GREETING_0002d3a3_Oblivion_RESP1: So, you are here to kill Motierre, eh? Well he's mine, and nothing will stand in my way!
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_StolenGold_0005375c_Oblivion_RESP: So, you both tricked me, and now you're here to mock me. Fine, fine. I hope you were happy working with that deceitful wench.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_contract_000251c8_Oblivion_RESP1: So, you come to me for assistance. How interesting. I think I'd much rather you die in the field.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GREETING_00036616_Oblivion_RESP1: So, you didn't sell me out. I appreciate that. Well, I said I'd make it worth your while, so let me teach you a little something.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GREETING_00028267_Oblivion_RESP1: So, you finally showed up. It's about time. People of my station are not accustomed to waiting.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GREETING_0007ac75_Oblivion_RESP1: So, you have the pearls? Or perhaps any other things of value I can have -- I mean, hold for you?
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GREETING_000251b9_Oblivion_RESP1: So, you infiltrated the Imperial Prison, eliminated Valen Dreth, and killed not one guard. Most excellent!
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_contract_0000bcaf_Oblivion_RESP1: So, you need to find this High Elf, hmm? Why don't you take a trip to Summerset Isle, ask around for him there. Idiot.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GREETING_0002c81e_Oblivion_RESP1: So, you remember S'razirr after all. This one was as good as his word. Are you?
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GREETING_0001dcc6_Oblivion_RESP1: So, you saw Bernadette Peneles, did you?  She WAS watching me and following me, wasn't she?
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_Necromancers_000038b7_Oblivion_RE: So, you saw them? The altars must be infused with some kind of power to change over the soul gems.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_MS10FollowMe_0003c379_Oblivion_RE: So, you say Llevana wishes to see me? Very well, lead on. This should prove amusing.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_NelsTheNaughtyTopic_00028240_Obli: So, you think Nels did it, do you? I would appreciate you keeping your opinions to yourself.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GREETING_00091885_Oblivion_RESP2: So, you want to find the secret escape route? Easy enough.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GREETING_00035a13_Oblivion_RESP4: So, you'll have to die. Don't worry. We'll put your body to good use, I assure you.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GREETING_00035a14_Oblivion_RESP4: So, you'll have to die. Don't worry. We'll put your body to good use, I assure you.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GREETING_00035a15_Oblivion_RESP4: So, you'll have to die. Don't worry. We'll put your body to good use, I assure you.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_SE36Choice2HelpNo_00061c45_Oblivi: So, you're a coward. Just my luck. Never mind. I'll find someone else to do it.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_SE03Xedilian_0006770c_Oblivion_RE: So, you're going to get Xedilian up and running. Here's a little book to tell you how, and the Attenuator of Judgement. You'll need that, too.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GREETING_0003c13e_Oblivion_RESP1: So, you're the famous Hero of Kvatch.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GREETING_00037ff7_Oblivion_RESP1: So, you've actually challenged the Gray Prince? Do you really know what you've gotten yourself into?
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GREETING_0004e941_Oblivion_RESP1: So, you've brought something for me to examine?
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GREETING_00025e1c_Oblivion_RESP1: So, you've collected the pelts. I trust you've learned a lesson. Your rank is restored, along with all rights and responsibilities.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_SE35Brithaur_00078666_Oblivion_RE: So, you've dealt with the problem, eh? I like the sound of that.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_SE35Brithaur_00078667_Oblivion_RE: So, you've dealt with the problem, eh? I like the sound of that.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GREETING_0008e615_Oblivion_RESP2: So, you've decided to light the Torch for Mania?
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GREETING_00081ddf_Oblivion_RESP1: So, you've managed to kill the Gatekeeper. Pity. Well, you'll now be able to enter the Realm proper. You'll notice there are two doors.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_contract_00003460_Oblivion_RESP1: So, your first contract. No chance for a bonus, huh? That's all right, you're better off! Who needs magic items when you've got raw skill?
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_INFOGENERAL_00032e33_Oblivion_RES: So. The Fighters Guild got Azani Blackheart. Blackwood Company said they did him, but apparently they were mistaken. Or stretching the truth, maybe?
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_DAMalacathSpeech_000579d3_Oblivio: So. You get over to Lord Drad's estate. Get my ogres loose, and get them out. Do it now, for me... the Boss.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_BlackBrugoTopic_00090b63_Oblivion: So. You killed Black Brugo. Well, the bastard had it coming, I guess. You get a reward?
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_MQ05RavenSpeech_00022cf6_Oblivion: So. You want to become one of the Chosen of Mehrunes Dagon.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_WeatherleahTopic_00088b30_Oblivio: So... the brothers have once again reclaimed Weatherleah, eh? Good for them!
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GREETING_0008daa4_Oblivion_RESP1: So... what have you brought me?
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_NorbertLellesTOPIC_000356b9_Obliv: So... you took care of the thieves. Excellent. You'll want to talk to Lelles to close out the contract. And get paid, of course.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_MazogatheOrcTopic_00086071_Oblivi: So? An Orc wants to see me? And this interests me how? Did I forget how much I like you so I should do this favor for you?
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_BlackBrugo07_00090b7a_Oblivion_RE: So? Go on... say it! Say... 'I greet you, Sir Mazoga.'
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_HELLO_0006fdb0_Oblivion_RESP1: So? What do you have to report?
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GREETING_000038a7_Oblivion_RESP1: So? You a living statue or are you gonna say something?
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GREETING_0003be7e_Oblivion_RESP1: Soft flesh... brittle bones... snap snap... Love how they crack.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_MQ13MartinBattleSpeech_0003d063_O: Soldiers of Cyrodiil! Do you stand with me?
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_MQ13MartinBattleSpeech_0003d05f_O: Soldiers of Cyrodiil! The Empire will stand or fall by what we do here today!
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_SEDunrootBurrowTopic_0001338b_Obl: Some Elytra there are... different. You'll need to get Felldew from them, and eat it. Can't get in without it. But once you do...
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_SE46Choice1_0008fab8_Oblivion_RES: Some blasted mage. Had a theory. They've always got theories. He thought there was a Manic and a Demented in each of us.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_MatildePetitTopic_00028790_Oblivi: Some bloodthirsty monster killed that woman in cold blood. It's obvious to me one of the other guests killed her to eliminate the competition.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_LeyawiinTopic_000479c7_Oblivion_R: Some clown keeps tossing meat out in my backyard, and it attracts dogs from Necrom to Daggerfall.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_BonusTopic_0002ff51_Oblivion_RESP: Some contracts are straightforward. Find the target, eliminate them, then return to the Sanctuary. No time limits or complications.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_INFOGENERAL_000432ba_Oblivion_RES: Some dashing new hero has stolen into the Realm!
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_SE34Crisis_00066edd_Oblivion_RESP: Some dastardly Grummites stole my most prized possession... my Medallion that signified my membership in the Knights.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_disappearances_0000bea5_Oblivion_: Some folks are missing in Harlun's Watch. We've been contracted to find out what's happened. Speak to Drarana Thelis for all the details. Get going.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_INFOGENERAL_0002c59d_Oblivion_RES: Some folks are saying that the Blackwood Company is taking over all of the Fighters Guild contracts. There's rumor they'll lose their charter.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_disappearances_0000be70_Oblivion_: Some folks reported seeing strange lights near the old Swampy Cave. We sent folks to investigate them, but haven't seen them since. We need help.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_INFOGENERAL_0004421c_Oblivion_RES: Some fool lit himself on fire in the city.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_StrangeLights_0000bed9_Oblivion_R: Some have said they're will-o-the-wisps, though I've never heard of one killing a full-grown man.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GREETING_000276a3_Oblivion_RESP1: Some help is better than nothing, but my militia are farmers and shopkeepers, not soldiers. I would recommend delaying until more help can arrive.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_INFOGENERAL_000434f3_Oblivion_RES: Some idiot killed the Gatekeeper. Now we'll be swamped with morons coming and bothering us. Present company not excluded.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_OblivionGateTopic_000091a0_Oblivi: Some kind of portal to Oblivion. The enemy used them to attack the city -- they appeared outside the walls and daedra poured out!
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_ND04CarodusGreetingZenithar_00002: Some legends say that Zenithar has close ties to Kynareth, an idea that is supported by the manner in which the two gods' realms interact.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_ND04Zenithar_00002ac2_Knights_RES: Some legends say that Zenithar has close ties to Kynareth, an idea that is supported by the manner in which the two gods' realms interact.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_ND04Zenithar_00002ac3_Knights_RES: Some legends say that Zenithar has close ties to Kynareth, an idea that is supported by the manner in which the two gods' realms interact.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_MS48SalvianWhatHappened_00098142_: Some made it into the Chapel, but others were just run down in the streets. The Count and his men are still holed up in the castle.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_RogueMage_0002ee53_Oblivion_RESP1: Some mages do not abide by the principles of the guild, and operate outside its boundaries. Many hold little value for the lives of others.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GREETING_0001ebb6_Oblivion_RESP1: Some mischief of yours in Bleaker's Way has interfered with Mephala's plans. You're wasting your time here.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_INFOGENERAL_000432c3_Oblivion_RES: Some new person has arrived. It'd be polite to introduce myself, but I'm feeling more tired than usual.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_INFOGENERAL_00032e7c_Oblivion_RES: Some of the Leyawiin boys are cutting up pretty bad. Oreyn is not happy.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GOODBYE_00088b44_Oblivion_RESP1: Some of the new ones say that the war is going badly. The attack on Bruma failed completely.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_FGD08Choice5_000a3456_Oblivion_RE: Some of your Guild brothers found you and brought you to me. Good to see some of them think like we do. Now, what happened out there?
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_causingtrouble_0002c7c4_Oblivion_: Some of your brothers have been getting rowdy at the local tavern. I've got no problem with cutting loose, but I don't like it when we all look bad.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GREETING_00041f18_Oblivion_RESP2: Some people are frightened by this, or they despair, or even try to deny the truth of what I say.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_INFOGENERAL_000c47e1_Oblivion_RES: Some people want special bows that take too long to load and need special arrows called bolts. M'aiq thinks they are idiots.

ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_ReadyForAMatch_00037fff_Oblivion_: Something catchy, something the people of Cyrodiil will remember when they tell stories about your inglorious defeat! So, what's it going to be?

ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_ArcaneULecture5_0007195b_Oblivion: Suppose, however, that the power of these stones had been hidden, but was revealed to certain holy men or prophets in the First Era.

ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_TG03ElvenBust_000092af_Oblivion_R: Sure. I've heard about it. What's it worth to ya?
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_INFOGENERAL_00032eab_Oblivion_RES: Sure. In the Arena, you can make a lot of money, real fast. And you can get dead, real fast, too.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_ImperialCityTopic_0007be9e_Oblivi: Sure. Some folks here think horses are for riding. Then again, some of us are Orcs. Snak gra-Bura, she prefers eating stew to riding horses.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_SE05Conspiracy_000895df_Oblivion_: Surely the Inquisitor has considered that with direct evidence, Ma'zaddha may now be more responsive to questioning.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_NDProphetGreetA4a_00002be8_Knight: Surely there can be no better preparation for becoming a holy knight than a career spent slaughtering for the public's entertainment.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_OrderOfTalosTopic_00033dfd_Oblivi: Surely you have heard of us? If not, I invite you to spend some time in our fine library. All are welcome here.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_SE06ArctusGreetA_00040144_Oblivio: Surely you will do what is right, won't you?
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_NDCrusadersRelicsTopic_00002a81_K: Surely you've heard the stories of the Quest for the Crusader's Relics?
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GREETING_00081b71_Oblivion_RESP1: Surely, you have something better to do.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GREETING_000488ce_Oblivion_RESP1: Surely... you must know who I am! The Count's son. Do you mind? I have no desire to be further acquainted with every visitor to Bravil.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GREETING_00047739_Oblivion_RESP1: Surius Afranius. I'm a guard for Umbacano.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_EronorTopic_000247e8_Oblivion_RES: Surprised by Eronor's uncanny way with sheep?
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_MGExpelAccept_00025037_Oblivion_R: Surprised? Annoyed? It is not unexpected. Nevertheless, that is your path to re-acceptance in the guild.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_MGExpelAccept_0002503b_Oblivion_R: Surprised? Annoyed? It is not unexpected. Nevertheless, that is your path to re-acceptance in the guild.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_information_000039a3_Oblivion_RES: Surprised? Nothing is for free, mage.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_BravilNQDResponses_00046607_Obliv: Surprising, don't you think, since she never seems to leave that guild hall.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_SE05SylFindYou_0007fe20_Oblivion_: Surrounded by traitors and spies, I am. Always, always. They watch and wait, eager to slip a knife into my spine when I'm not looking.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_DABoethiaSpeech_00051ed8_Oblivion: Survive, and you will be rewarded. Fail, and your soul belongs to me.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_SERunsInCirclesGreetE_0004120e_Ob: Sweet and juicy! I can always count on you, my best pal!
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_SERunsInCirclesGreetF_0004120f_Ob: Sweet and juicy! You're the best!
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_TGPayExpelFine_0001efc0_Oblivion_: Sweet! The hunter is restored. The pride welcomes the hunter once again.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_SECaldanaMonriusSkooma_0008f5f1_O: Sweet, sweet Skooma. Give it here. Give it here!
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_SE40SleepOutsideChoiceSweetroll_0: Sweetroll for Fimmion. Yummy in tummy. Answer for you. Problem solved.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_SE44FimmionChoice1_0007877b_Obliv: Sweetroll good. Fimmion give pants. Got pie? Apples? Fimmion hungry.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_SEManiaRumorResponses_00061610_Ob: Syl always thinks someone is out to get her.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_SE07Become_0007893e_Oblivion_RESP: Syl anticipates plots against her, so expect heavy resistance that may require a great deal of fighting and physical exertion.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_SEManiaRumorResponses_0006172b_Ob: Syl being killed is no surprise, but Thadon leaving, as well?
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_INFOGENERAL_00043ef3_Oblivion_RES: Syl enjoys having people tortured. She's a rank amateur. I could teach her a few things.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_SE10DyloraWhere_00017d0e_Oblivion: Syl had called her aside, separating her from the group. She meant to divide our numbers when Order entered, making us easier targets.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_INFOGENERAL_00043ead_Oblivion_RES: Syl had folks tortured again. So what? Real torture is my mug being empty.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_INFOGENERAL_00043ee4_Oblivion_RES: Syl has been known to round up people for "questioning" from time to time. Torture devices are known to spread disease.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_INFOGENERAL_000441f6_Oblivion_RES: Syl has been replaced. I should tell Sheer-Meedish.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GREETING_00091805_Oblivion_RESP2: Syl has been slain. You need Syl's heart. I'll let you figure out the rest.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_INFOGENERAL_00043eb2_Oblivion_RES: Syl has gone on another one of her rampages in Crucible. I'm certainly glad I live on the right side of the wall.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GREETING_00013ffa_Oblivion_RESP1: Syl has made her escape through the hidden tunnel in the gardens outside her quarters! She must not get away!
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_SEDementiaRumorResponses_00061436: Syl has spies everywhere. We are all at risk.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_INFOGENERAL_00043ea5_Oblivion_RES: Syl has tortured her courtiers again, I hear. Poor things.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_INFOGENERAL_00043eaf_Oblivion_RES: Syl is a paranoid fool. She could torture me as much as she'd like, though. Cut intricate patterns into my skin. I shiver just thinking about it.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_SE07ASyl_0006a890_Oblivion_RESP1: Syl is as crafty as she is beautiful. I'd watch my back if I were you. Oh, this is so much fun!
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_SEManiaRumorResponses_00061730_Ob: Syl is dead, but Thadon is missing! These are dark times.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_INFOGENERAL_00044203_Oblivion_RES: Syl is gone, and a new ruler presides over the House of Dementia. Perhaps they can cure my malady.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_INFOGENERAL_00044234_Oblivion_RES: Syl isn't dead. She's living on an island nearby.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_SE10Opposition_00017d11_Oblivion_: Syl let them in. More than I could count. It was all we could do to fall back and regroup out here.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_INFOGENERAL_00043ee6_Oblivion_RES: Syl likes torturing people, doesn't she? But, there's really no point in lying. I mean, it takes too much energy to keep it all straight.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_INFOGENERAL_00043eef_Oblivion_RES: Syl likes torturing people. She's got nothing on the methods of Sorceress Verenim, though. She's a genius with pain.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_INFOGENERAL_00043edc_Oblivion_RES: Syl never has anyone tortured. She's a gentle and kind leader. She trusts everyone, and is therefore trustworthy.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_INFOGENERAL_00043ea4_Oblivion_RES: Syl once again tortures her courtiers. Soon, we will all suffer.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_SE07Decision_0001e3ed_Oblivion_RE: Syl or Thadon? Which will it be?
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_INFOGENERAL_000441cb_Oblivion_RES: Syl replaced. I wouldn't have guessed I'd see it.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_SEWildernessRumorResponses_000616: Syl tends to jump at shadows.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_INFOGENERAL_00043eae_Oblivion_RES: Syl torturing her own staff? Kinky.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_SE07BSheoShout_0008f57c_Oblivion_: Syl! You dare interrupt Me? Only I interrupt Me. Like just then.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_SEWildernessRumorResponses_000617: Syl's finally dead. I'm not surprised.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_INFOGENERAL_00043ef5_Oblivion_RES: Syl's really suspicious of other people. I bet she's the one with something to hide.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_INFOGENERAL_00043eac_Oblivion_RES: Syl's rounding up people again. I better go stash my Skooma. Or... I would if I had some. You have any?
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_INFOGENERAL_00043e9d_Oblivion_RES: Syl's torturing people again? I'd hate to be locked up in a tiny cell. That'd be torture enough.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_INFOGENERAL_00043eb4_Oblivion_RES: Syl's torturing people? To death, I hope? It was me. I did it, whatever it was. Come take me away and kill me. I'm the culprit.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_SE07AThadonLeaves_000206cd_Oblivi: Syl... my... Syl is dead? This can't be right. Is this right? What have you done? Have you done this?
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_SE10WhatHappened_0001746f_Oblivio: Syl... the snake. She showed up, asked for a contingent of guards. Said there was trouble at the palace, and that we were needed.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_SE03LewinChamberOneGnarl01_000648: THIS is one of the "horrid guardians" of which the stories spoke?
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GOODBYE_00072dee_Oblivion_RESP1: Ta! Come visit again! Or I'll pluck out your eyes.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_INFOGENERAL_000465e4_Oblivion_RES: Tadrose Helas teaches smithing at the Fighters Guild. Well, when she has the time.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_BravilNQDQuestionResponses_000465: Tadrose is a fine smith, but I understand she only offers services to other Fighters Guild members.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_SE45Choice2_00083f5f_Oblivion_RES: Take Big Head's charm! Listen to Bolwing! His tongue is tied, but his mind is unraveled! He'll tell you the secret. Who has the Fork?
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_INFOGENERAL_000624cb_Oblivion_RES: Take Cheydinhal, for example. Pretty little town. But the Count's a Dark Elf, and it's crawling with Orc thugs and gangsters.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_DABoethiaSpeech_00051eda_Oblivion: Take Goldbrand, sheathe it in your enemies, and offer their souls as praise to me.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GREETING_000488c4_Oblivion_RESP1: Take a chance on the Warlock's Luck!
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GREETING_00028865_Oblivion_RESP5: Take a few moments to catch your breath and think it over. When you're ready, let me know, and we'll get underway.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_Recommendation_00034e12_Oblivion_: Take a moment to try it on, and then we shall speak of what comes next for you.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_HELLO_000029ad_Knights_RESP1: Take a moment, if you would, and tell me again about the battle of Garlas Malatar.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GREETING_0003e1d0_Oblivion_RESP2: Take a seat, or feel free to look around. We have a fine collection of cheeses here, some of the rarest in all Tamriel!
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GOODBYE_0004f3e4_Oblivion_RESP1: Take care of Lelles. He needs the help.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_duties_0002e584_Oblivion_RESP1: Take care of Maglir's contract. Then report back to me.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_MaglirTOPIC2_0002ee65_Oblivion_RE: Take care of his contract. We'll discuss him later.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_INFOGENERAL_000825e2_Oblivion_RES: Take care venturing into the ruined city of Vitharn.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GOODBYE_00083f55_Oblivion_RESP1: Take care! Come back for a chat whenever you have the chance.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GOODBYE_0002fa6d_Oblivion_RESP1: Take care, friend. Don't get yourself killed on our account.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_Trespass_0009f916_Oblivion_RESP1: Take everything, just don't hurt me!
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_MS04HeardNo_0003d30d_Oblivion_RES: Take for example that good-for-nothing husband of mine, Gogan. He cared more about their charms than my own.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GOODBYE_0003160d_Oblivion_RESP1: Take heed the knife that strikes from behind.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GOODBYE_0007ec6c_Oblivion_RESP1: Take heed the knife that strikes from behind.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_CGBaurusH_0001e90d_Oblivion_RESP1: Take it easy. You'll be fine. I know this is a lot to take in all at once.
