ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_MazogaTalk04_00086570_Oblivion_RE: Take me there. Now. I'm in a hurry.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GREETING_0008606d_Oblivion_RESP1: Take me to Fisherman's Rock. Now.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GREETING_0001e6fd_Oblivion_RESP3: Take my Amulet. Give it to Jauffre. I have a secret son, and Jauffre alone knows where to find him.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GOODBYE_000363b1_Oblivion_RESP1: Take my advice. Stay away from the Watchmen.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_MS09AlternateWay_0005377e_Oblivio: Take my amulet to him. Get the gold and bring half of it back here to me. If you don't come back, I'll let the guards in on our plan.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_Fines_0003c295_Oblivion_RESP3: Take my good friend Aldos Othran for example. In the last month, he's been fined six times! SIX! All for being drunk and disorderly.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_SE32NotSolved_000135d2_Oblivion_R: Take my helm. With it, you can take my place in the defense of the gate. Defeat the Devoted Fanatic in combat, and the curse will be lifted.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_DANamiraSpeech_0005c01a_Oblivion_: Take my ring. Let it bring pain to others who would wish it upon you. Namira blesses you.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_AnvilTopic_0003da55_Oblivion_RESP: Take some advice? Go down to the sea, stand a while. Watch the sun rise and set. Think on the distant lands across the water.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_Attack_0008ef6b_Oblivion_RESP1: Take that you sack of rotting meat!
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GREETING_00054824_Oblivion_RESP3: Take the Amulet. Give it to Jauffre. He alone knows where to find my last son.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GREETING_00089936_Oblivion_RESP1: Take the key. Get to the Sigil Keep, and find the Sigil Stone. It's the only way.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_MQ15KathutetC5_0003e8fb_Oblivion_: Take these Bands of the Chosen, then. Wear them, or you cannot enter the Forbidden Grotto, the only way out of the Eternal Garden.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_SE11RakheranGiveDaggers1_0001a7bc: Take these daggers! Slay her and at last, we can be on our path to true enlightenment!
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_SECaldanaMonriusSkoomaYes_0008f7b: Take this as a token of my thanks.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_MagesStaff_0002ba66_Oblivion_RESP: Take this charm scroll. With it, you should find Varon more receptive to questioning. Don't come back without that staff.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_SE11HaskillChoice6_00014b61_Obliv: Take this crystal. It contains the power to open the sealed door. Inside, you will find the final remnants of the library.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_SE07AKithlanHelp_00014025_Oblivio: Take this key. It should unlock any door in her wing of the palace. You still need to be wary of her Seducer guards, but it should help.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_TG05accept_0000a1b7_Oblivion_RESP: Take this note. Leave it in his nightstand. Bring me the staff when you get it.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GREETING_0001b6a6_Oblivion_RESP3: Take this trinket of mine. Perhaps it will serve you well. Or look lovely on your corpse.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GREETING_0003569f_Oblivion_RESP2: Take this. It will increase your skills in battle. We use it often. It is a good, good thing.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GREETING_00035648_Oblivion_RESP1: Take this. It's from a friend.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GREETING_00024e51_Oblivion_RESP3: Take up the dagger and offer Lord Dagon the sacrificial red-drink as pledge of your own life's blood, which shall be his in the end.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GREETING_00086065_Oblivion_RESP7: Take what you want from the dead. I came to keep my oath, and now I'm done.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_Flee_00098386_Oblivion_RESP1: Take what you will! Just spare me!
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_Flee_00023e56_Oblivion_RESP1: Take whatever you want! Just don't hurt me!
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_HELLO_00073b60_Oblivion_RESP1: Take your flies and your sores over there.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_contract_0002798e_Oblivion_RESP1: Take your time with this one. Observe the other guests. Learn their schedules and behaviors, and strike each one when they're alone.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GOODBYE_00018bfc_Oblivion_RESP1: Take your time, and hurry back. I might not be waiting for you when you return.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_HELLO_00062cc1_Oblivion_RESP1: Talk is free. What do you want?
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_MQ15KathutetB1_0003e8f2_Oblivion_: Talk or not as you choose. But you will listen.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GREETING_00028557_Oblivion_RESP1: Talk to Captain Matius if you need something. I'm just following his orders.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GOODBYE_0004f3ea_Oblivion_RESP1: Talk to Cirroc about that contract. Make me proud.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GREETING_000301e2_Oblivion_RESP1: Talk to Diram in the inn. I'm tired of this minstrel's freakshow our town has turned into.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GREETING_0003d493_Oblivion_RESP1: Talk to Faustina. She's got a proposition for you.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_SE03XedilianTopic_0008e94d_Oblivi: Talk to Haskill if you need more information. He's got more brains than a brain pie. Oh... Brain pie! Perfect!
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_TrainingQuestTopic_00062447_Obliv: Talk to Helvius Cecia in Bruma. He's your best bet for learning more about hand to hand combat.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GREETING_0001ce97_Oblivion_RESP1: Talk to Hjolfrodi. I can't help you.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_SE46DoublesTopic_0008fa9a_Oblivio: Talk to Horkvir. Our Horkvir. He's in charge. He'll know what to do.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_ThoronirTopic_0000bc94_Oblivion_R: Talk to Jensine. She can help you better than I can.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_Gang_0003d4ed_Oblivion_RESP1: Talk to Maelona. She runs the council. Judge, jury and executioner.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GOODBYE_0003d4d3_Oblivion_RESP1: Talk to her, she seems to have all the answers.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GREETING_00072c91_Oblivion_RESP3: Talk to my Kishashi. If she will trust you, I will trust you.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_FaelianTopic_0002ff0b_Oblivion_RE: Talk to the Publican, Augusta Calidia. I'm sure she can tell you more about him.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_SE45Choice2_00083f5f_Oblivion_RES: Talk to the beggar! Talk to Bolwing! He knows secrets, but no one can hear them. No one but Big Head.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_JskarTopic_0002d591_Oblivion_RESP: Talk to the mages here, and see what you can find out. If you can make J'skar re-appear, you'll have your recommendation.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_COERCEHATE_0018b2c9_Oblivion_RESP: Talk tough to me. I love tough guys.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_Dark17Choice2A_0005402e_Oblivion_: Talk... talk to Ulfgar. He's sure to have the key to the cellar. You know, if... if you want to get down there! Now please, just let me go!
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_Dark17Choice2B_0005402f_Oblivion_: Talk... talk to Ulfgar. He's sure to have the key to the cellar. You know, if... if you want to get down there! Now please, just let me go!
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_Dark17Choice2C_00054030_Oblivion_: Talk... talk to Ulfgar. He's sure to have the key to the cellar. You know, if... if you want to get down there! Now please, just let me go!
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_Idle_0018b598_Oblivion_RESP1: Talking to yourself is not a sign of mental illness. It's not.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GOODBYE_0001ad4e_Oblivion_RESP1: Talking with you leaves such a nasty taste in my mouth. And not the good kind.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_ND09ProphetGreeting02b_00002cd5_K: Talos and Tiber Septim are one and the same. Rather, Tiber Septim ascended to godhood upon his death, and became Talos.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GREETING_0000293a_Knights_RESP1: Talos, the Dragonborn, patron of questing knights, will surely look with favor upon us. Walk with me to his shrine, if you will.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_INFOGENERAL_0003c25e_Oblivion_RES: Tamika makes some truly fine wines at her winery. I think they're every bit as good as the Surilie Brothers wines.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_MQ15MankarRant_0008c229_Oblivion_: Tamriel is just one more Daedric realm of Oblivion, long since lost to its Prince when he was betrayed by those that served him.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_TrainingQuestTopic_00062462_Obliv: Tandilwe has a true mastery of the spoken word. She is the one you should speak with about more training.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GREETING_00047644_Oblivion_RESP1: Tar-Meena. This is my Mystic Archives. Keep it neat. Keep it quiet. No eating in the stacks.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_OblivionGateVoice_00085494_Oblivi: Teach you to mess with the Legion!
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_SE35HereYouGo_00078673_Oblivion_R: Tell everyone not to worry, I won't be bothering them any longer.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_HELLO_000029ac_Knights_RESP1: Tell me about Garlas Malatar, sir knight. These Aurorans -- what sort of foes were they?
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GREETING_0001dc29_Oblivion_RESP1: Tell me what you learned about Toutius Sextius.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_SE08Orders_0001ec1d_Oblivion_RESP: Tell me where you would have me serve, Your Grace.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_SE09MiscRelmynaExperiment_00046f6: Tell me, how does this feel?
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_ND10FinThedretGreeting01a_00002ca: Tell me... Umaril... what happened? Did you succeed in pursuing him into the spirit realm, as the Prophet said?
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_HELLO_0007d470_Oblivion_RESP1: Tell the daen! Tell the daen! Karn sky is relfing.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_MG09ChoiceGoOn_00022b65_Oblivion_: Tell your Council that the next time they want something from me, they come themselves. They don't send someone under false pretenses.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_jobs_00071096_Oblivion_RESP2: Tell your men I'll pay them for minotaur horns and ogre teeth. The Fighters Guild will be my sole supplier. I look forward to doing more business.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GREETING_00023e05_Oblivion_RESP1: Ten of the evening watch, and all's well. Everything okay, ma'am?
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GREETING_00023e8b_Oblivion_RESP1: Ten of the evening watch, and all's well. Everything okay, sir?
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GREETING_00023e18_Oblivion_RESP1: Ten of the morning watch, and all's well. How are you, ma'am?
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GREETING_00023edd_Oblivion_RESP1: Ten of the morning watch, and all's well. How are you, sir?
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_TG11TalkToMillona07_00022e83_Obli: Ten years ago I inherited this cowl from the former guildmaster of the Thieves Guild. I became the new guildmaster, but I also received it's curse.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_HELLO_0018a956_Oblivion_RESP1: Ten years of research down the drain...
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_TenetsTopic_000272ae_Oblivion_RES: Tenet 1: Never dishonor the Night Mother. To do so is to invoke the Wrath of Sithis.
Tenet 2: Never betray the Dark Brotherhood or its secrets. To do so is to invoke the Wrath of Sithis.
Tenet 3: Never disobey or refuse to carry out an order from a Dark Brotherhood superior. To do so is to invoke the Wrath of Sithis.
Tenet 4: Never steal the possessions of a Dark Brother or Dark Sister. To do so is to invoke the Wrath of Sithis.
Tenet 5: Never kill a Dark Brother or Dark Sister. To do so is to invoke the Wrath of Sithis.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_CreatureResponses_0002b1c7_Oblivi: Terrible creatures. They travel in packs, and they're always up to no good.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_SE46DoublesTopic_0008fa7a_Oblivio: Terrible drain on productivity. Never know who's who. It's been a problem for too long.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GREETING_0004769e_Oblivion_RESP1: Tertius Favonius. Romana and me have set up housekeeping. She's a real doll, isn't she?
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GREETING_0004766a_Oblivion_RESP1: Tertullian, Sergius, and Cicero... the Three Verus Brothers. I'm Cicero.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GREETING_00047668_Oblivion_RESP1: Tertullian, Sergius, and Cicero... the Three Verus Brothers. I'm Sergius.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GREETING_00047666_Oblivion_RESP1: Tertullian, Sergius, and Cicero... the Three Verus Brothers. I'm Tertullian.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_Attack_00074a14_Oblivion_RESP1: Test your strength against me, mortal!
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_MS26FileCharges_00035ca4_Oblivion: Testify against a Watch Captain and accuse him of corruption? I don't think I'm willing to risk doing that.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_SEWildernessRumorResponses_000617: Thadon and Syl gone. Strange times.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_INFOGENERAL_00043e9f_Oblivion_RES: Thadon and his Chalice can both rot in Hell, for all I care.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_INFOGENERAL_00043ec7_Oblivion_RES: Thadon better not drink out of that Chalice. Who knows how many people have used it while it was missing? Reusing cups is the best way to get sick.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_SEDementiaRumorResponses_0006177e: Thadon dead, and Syl gone. This isn't good.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_SEDementiaRumorResponses_0006176c: Thadon finally did himself in. Good riddance.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_INFOGENERAL_00043ed3_Oblivion_RES: Thadon finally has his precious Chalice. But, such things do not matter to those of us who work for a living.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_INFOGENERAL_0005ed50_Oblivion_RES: Thadon gone.... I wonder if his quarters are still guarded.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_INFOGENERAL_00043e8a_Oblivion_RES: Thadon got his Chalice back. I heard he uses it around women. Better steer clear of mine.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_SE10StaadaWhere_00016b3a_Oblivion: Thadon had her called aside, separating her from the group. He meant to divide our numbers when Order entered, making us easier targets.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_INFOGENERAL_00043e9b_Oblivion_RES: Thadon had outside help getting his Chalice back. Something sneaky going on there.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_INFOGENERAL_0005ed57_Oblivion_RES: Thadon has been replaced. It is a moment worth capturing forever.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_INFOGENERAL_0005ed58_Oblivion_RES: Thadon has died. I hope he didn't go quietly.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_INFOGENERAL_00043ed7_Oblivion_RES: Thadon has his Chalice back. Doesn't he know a good leader doesn't need any of that? Just his native intelligence. I would know.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_INFOGENERAL_00043e8b_Oblivion_RES: Thadon has his Chalice back. I wonder if he'll let me take a look at it....
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_INFOGENERAL_00043ec0_Oblivion_RES: Thadon has his Chalice back. In the stories, men are always off in search of some sword or a cup of some kind.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_INFOGENERAL_00043e98_Oblivion_RES: Thadon has his Chalice back. Why won't anyone help me replace what I've lost?
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_INFOGENERAL_00043e93_Oblivion_RES: Thadon has his Chalice. That'll anger Syl, I'm sure, which means more work for me.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_INFOGENERAL_00043e97_Oblivion_RES: Thadon has one less excuse for his sloppy rule over Bliss, now that he has his Chalice again.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_INFOGENERAL_0005ed77_Oblivion_RES: Thadon has passed the mantle. I heard he was in bad health, anyway, and I know how that is.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_SEThadonTopic_0004301c_Oblivion_R: Thadon has told you what he wants. Consider speaking with the others in his court, particularly his steward.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_SE07BRoutine_000167e2_Oblivion_RE: Thadon has too many enemies that may turn that knowledge against him. He depends on me quite dearly.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_INFOGENERAL_00043ed2_Oblivion_RES: Thadon is addicted to Felldew. I stay away from drugs. A sorceress needs a clear mind. Hey, do you hear those dogs barking? They're so loud!
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_INFOGENERAL_0005ed4d_Oblivion_RES: Thadon is dead, and a new ruler is in his place. Sheer-Meedish must be excited.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_INFOGENERAL_0005ed5c_Oblivion_RES: Thadon is dead. Bliss will be even more of a mess than before.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_INFOGENERAL_0005ed51_Oblivion_RES: Thadon is dead. I drink to his health. Or... whatever.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_INFOGENERAL_0005ed8a_Oblivion_RES: Thadon is dead. I wonder if he had anything interesting for the museum....
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_INFOGENERAL_0005ed9e_Oblivion_RES: Thadon is dead. Quite a tragedy. Perhaps someone will write about it.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_INFOGENERAL_0005edb3_Oblivion_RES: Thadon is dead? I had a nightmare about that once.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_INFOGENERAL_0005ed4b_Oblivion_RES: Thadon is gone! Perhaps things are looking up.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_INFOGENERAL_0005ed56_Oblivion_RES: Thadon is gone. I wonder if he left anything worth keeping...
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_INFOGENERAL_00043ed8_Oblivion_RES: Thadon is in high spirits now? I'm glad someone is.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_INFOGENERAL_00043e81_Oblivion_RES: Thadon is not so moody lately. Do you think that wall is about to fall on me? It seems awfully unstable.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_INFOGENERAL_0005ed90_Oblivion_RES: Thadon isn't dead. He's just hiding.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_INFOGENERAL_00043ebf_Oblivion_RES: Thadon isn't really addicted to Felldew. Felldew is perfectly safe. There's nothing magical about his special cup either.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_SE10Opposition_00016b38_Oblivion_: Thadon let them in. More than I could count. It was all we could do to fall back and regroup out here.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_SE07BThadon_0006a896_Oblivion_RES: Thadon may be in a constant state of euphoria, but I wouldn't underestimate his intelligence. Oh, this is so much fun!
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_INFOGENERAL_00043e8c_Oblivion_RES: Thadon must be back on the Felldew... he's never tried the skooma though. Say, you got any skooma you can spare, friend?
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_INFOGENERAL_00043e99_Oblivion_RES: Thadon seems upbeat again. I know how hard it is to get anything done when you're not feeling up to it.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_INFOGENERAL_00043e82_Oblivion_RES: Thadon with his Chalice. No Fork for Big Head. Songs of sadness.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_INFOGENERAL_00043ed5_Oblivion_RES: Thadon's a fool. Who cares about his precious Chalice?
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_INFOGENERAL_00043ecb_Oblivion_RES: Thadon's back to his old self, I hear. He gets moody when he's not on the Felldew. He had two people killed. I know. I counted them.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_INFOGENERAL_00043e8f_Oblivion_RES: Thadon's blood is so tainted. He needs to be cut open so he can let some of the toxin out.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_INFOGENERAL_0005edc1_Oblivion_RES: Thadon's dead? So what? He annoyed me as much as you do.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_INFOGENERAL_0005edf1_Oblivion_RES: Thadon's dead? They're all just bags of meat to me.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_INFOGENERAL_00043eca_Oblivion_RES: Thadon's got his cup back? Isn't that nice? I certainly can't lay around drifting on Felldew all day. I've got too many important things to do.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_INFOGENERAL_00043ece_Oblivion_RES: Thadon's got his cup. The world's back in order. I get it. So then why the hell are you still here bothering me? Get lost!
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_INFOGENERAL_00043e85_Oblivion_RES: Thadon's in a much better mood lately. If he weren't so in love with the Felldew, I might invite him over to inspect my "wares" some time.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_INFOGENERAL_00043edb_Oblivion_RES: Thadon's new mood after recovering his Chalice is quite nice.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_INFOGENERAL_0005edc4_Oblivion_RES: Thadon's not dead. He lives underground. In a house made of cheese.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_SE07ASheoShout_0008f531_Oblivion_: Thadon, how dare you interrupt me! Only I interrupt me. Like just then.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_SE07BSylLeaves_0003b83d_Oblivion_: Thadon... dead? You've done this. It was you all along!
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_SE10WhatHappened_00017d16_Oblivio: Thadon... the snake. He showed up, asked for a contingent of guards. Said there was trouble, and that we were needed.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GREETING_000836cd_Oblivion_RESP1: Thalfin's in charge. She's been waiting for you.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GREETING_000476dc_Oblivion_RESP1: Thamriel of Tamriel. What are all those strange creatures in the garden? Where are all the white birds?
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_ImperialCityTopic_000476dd_Oblivi: Thamriel says she hears voices. All the men and women who lived and died here for thousands of years... maybe they left ghosts behind.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_INFOGENERAL_00061383_Oblivion_RES: Thank Akatosh the Oblivion Crisis is over! Although with no Emperor and no heir, I wonder what will happen to the Empire?
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GREETING_000270eb_Oblivion_RESP1: Thank Akatosh you're here! I have deciphered the final item for the ritual to open a portal to Camoran's Paradise!
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_INFOGENERAL_0005ed4c_Oblivion_RES: Thank Sheogorath it was Thadon who was killed, not Syl.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_SEDementiaRumorResponses_00061788: Thank Sheogorath it was only a settlement, and not Crucible.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_INFOGENERAL_00025576_Oblivion_RES: Thank Stendarr for the chapel here in Chorrol. A lovely place, and the healers are excellent.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_MQ05BaurusB_00022b22_Oblivion_RES: Thank Talos he lives! Martin Septim, you say ... We will restore him to the throne! It is the sworn duty of all Blades.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_MS46Goblins_00033efd_Oblivion_RES: Thank Y'ffre that Mirisa was there! Without her, the goblins would have surely killed us all.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GREETING_00002deb_Oblivion_RESP1: Thank goodness I found you. I assume you know that Hieronymus Lex has issued an arrest warrant for Armand Christophe.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_HELLO_0018abd5_Oblivion_RESP1: Thank goodness someone that can help is here!
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_INFOGENERAL_000a3842_Oblivion_RES: Thank goodness the gate is gone. I couldn't get a good night's sleep knowing it was out there!
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GREETING_0000c1c1_Oblivion_RESP1: Thank goodness you arrived when you did! I feared that I'd be thrown to the slaughterfish.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GREETING_00002945_Knights_RESP1: Thank the Nine that those creatures were stopped before they could desecrate our Chapel!
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GREETING_0009811c_Oblivion_RESP1: Thank the Nine! I never thought I'd see another friendly face...
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GREETING_0003661e_Oblivion_RESP1: Thank the gods you killed that thing. This is ridiculous! Someone's out to get me, to get my poor babies! I'll bet it's that Quill-Weave next door.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GOODBYE_00067dbe_Oblivion_RESP1: Thank you again for your kind words. Now please, don't let me keep you. We'll speak again later.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_RewardTopic_000a3df2_Oblivion_RES: Thank you again. I shall rest easier now, knowing that Rona no longer suffers.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_RewardTopic_000a3df4_Oblivion_RES: Thank you again. I shall rest easier now, knowing that Rona no longer suffers.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GREETING_0006ede9_Oblivion_RESP1: Thank you for all your help. My rats appreciate it.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_ND06TellKellen_00002b8d_Knights_R: Thank you for being honest with me.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GREETING_0018d285_Oblivion_RESP1: Thank you for closing that Oblivion Gate. Despite what the Count may say, we're all in your debt.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_MQ11BrumaAllies_00026e96_Oblivion: Thank you for closing the Oblivion Gate that was threatening Bravil. I will send my guard captain, Viera Lerus, to Bruma's aid.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GREETING_0018d29c_Oblivion_RESP1: Thank you for closing the Oblivion Gate. We all took heart when we heard the news.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_MS26ItiusResponse_00036608_Oblivi: Thank you for coming forward, citizen.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GREETING_00016b37_Oblivion_RESP1: Thank you for coming. I apologize for summoning you. The blame is mine.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GREETING_00017d0a_Oblivion_RESP1: Thank you for coming. I apologize for summoning you. The blame is mine.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_MQ13NarinaMartin1_0002777d_Oblivi: Thank you for coming. I know I am asking for a great deal of trust. But this is the only way. I would not suggest it otherwise.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GREETING_0002b45e_Oblivion_RESP1: Thank you for coming. You may recognize that statue over there on the table. The very one that you recently sold -- for less than its true worth.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_HELLO_0007b473_Oblivion_RESP1: Thank you for convincing her to meet with me.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GREETING_0000c1dc_Oblivion_RESP1: Thank you for freeing me. I'm Graman gro-Marad, the Bloated Float's bouncer and helmsman. I've been locked in that storage room for hours.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GREETING_00031eb2_Oblivion_RESP1: Thank you for getting me out of that cursed place.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GREETING_00031e9f_Oblivion_RESP1: Thank you for getting me out of that cursed place. 'Tis ashame Farwil didn't make it. At least he died doing what he loved.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GREETING_000781eb_Oblivion_RESP1: Thank you for helping us overthrow the tyrant. But you must understand that as Queen, I'm very busy ruling over the Shivering Isles. Run along.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_Gift_0018bc30_Oblivion_RESP2: Thank you for indulging an old man's whims. Now, you wanted to learn something about Heavy Armor, didn't you? I think I can help.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_VidkunTopic_0002e998_Oblivion_RES: Thank you for letting me know. I'm sorry that you had to be a part of all of this.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_FaelianTopic_0002ff13_Oblivion_RE: Thank you for listening. You're a good friend. I just hope my sweet Faelian can clean himself up, or that awful skooma will be the death of him!
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_MS45DarMaGoHome_0002820d_Oblivion: Thank you for rescuing me!  My mother will be so pleased when we arrive back in Chorrol safe and sound.  Let's go!
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GREETING_000029a0_Knights_RESP1: Thank you for rescuing me. I've lost track of how long they've held me here.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_HenantierTopic_0003cd45_Oblivion_: Thank you for returning Henantier to me. I don't know what I would have done without him.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GREETING_0003640d_Oblivion_RESP1: Thank you for saving me, friend. I don't know who you are, but it is clear that Akatosh guides you.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GOODBYE_0018abd8_Oblivion_RESP1: Thank you for saving my business, I won't forget it.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GREETING_00002996_Knights_RESP1: Thank you for speaking to Areldur on my behalf.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_BarterExit_0005e07e_Oblivion_RESP: Thank you for stopping by. Stay healthy.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_NDTalkDeadKnight3_00002cd8_Knight: Thank you for taking the time to speak to me. Now, we must not spend our time in regrets. We are Knights of the Nine, with duties to attend to!
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GlarthirTopic_0002365e_Oblivion_R: Thank you for warning me about him. Please, hurry and tell the guards before it's too late!
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_SE09MiscRelmynaExperiment_00046f4: Thank you for your assistance in my research.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_ServeSentence_00045759_Oblivion_R: Thank you for your cooperation in this unfortunate matter, Your Grace.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_BladesTalk5_00067dc8_Oblivion_RES: Thank you for your courtesy, sir. If you ever need a friendly ear, I'm always available, night or day.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_MS45DarMaGoHome_0002820e_Oblivion: Thank you for your help!  If you are ever in Chorrol, please look me up. My mother owns the Northern Goods and Trade shop.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_SE39MissionChoice1a_00078202_Obli: Thank you for your help. Here, take this. I was using it to ward off Cindanwe's evil mind control magic. I don't need it now.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GREETING_0000be63_Oblivion_RESP1: Thank you for your help. You are always welcome here.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_BladesTalk3_00068353_Oblivion_RES: Thank you for your kind words. I never knew my father, but he must have been proud to call the Blades his protectors. I know I am.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_SEServeSentence_000459c5_Oblivion: Thank you for your understanding, My Lord. I am required by Your own command to ask You for any items You may have inadvertently borrowed.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_BlackBrugo08_00090b7b_Oblivion_RE: Thank you kindly! 'Knight of the White Stallion.' Sounds good. Damn good.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_BlackBrugo09_00090b7c_Oblivion_RE: Thank you kindly, Sir Knight. Sounds good. Damn good.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_SE41PostHere_0008f9c6_Oblivion_RE: Thank you so much again! Here is a small bit of change for your time.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GREETING_00002990_Knights_RESP2: Thank you so much! You have no idea what this means to me!
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GREETING_00002991_Knights_RESP2: Thank you so much! You have no idea what this means to me!
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_MS45DarMaUntie_0002820f_Oblivion_: Thank you!  Hurry, we need to get out of here, quick!
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_MS45DarMaUntie_00028751_Oblivion_: Thank you!  You're the first friendly face I've seen since I arrived in this hellhole.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_ND07LathonGreetF1_00002b75_Knight: Thank you! I mean, thank you, Sir Knight. I will not fail you.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GREETING_00002942_Knights_RESP1: Thank you! I was sure those creatures would be the end of all of us. You truly are the defender of the Faith!
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_SE38OddityDonate_00043438_Oblivio: Thank you! It is a truly odd Tentacle. I'm so glad to have one back on display.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_MS45Convo_000a2e57_Oblivion_RESP1: Thank you! Let's get out of here!
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_MS16Choice1A_00028150_Oblivion_RE: Thank you! Now, we're not quite sure where the estate is located. We'll offer up what we know, however.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_MageConvReturn_0006bdbe_Oblivion_: Thank you, Arch-Mage. It has been a pleasure to accompany you.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_NDJoinOrderAccept_00002b39_Knight: Thank you, Sir Knight! I will do my best to vindicate your faith in me.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_SE38OddityDonate_00081e9e_Oblivio: Thank you, dearie! My museum just wasn't the same without the ashes on display.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_DAAzuraSpeech_0002c6c5_Oblivion_R: Thank you, mortal. Their spirits are free, and henceforth, above my shrine, five bright candles shall burn forever in memory of their sacrifice.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_ND07LathonGreetE1_00002b79_Knight: Thank you, sir knight. I would ask a boon, if I could, although I know I do not deserve it.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_SQ09Scales_00067dd1_Oblivion_RESP: Thank you, stranger. You've shown me kindness and I will think of you in the long comfortable days ahead.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_MS45DarMaSafe_00028210_Oblivion_R: Thank you, thank you!  I can never repay you for your gift of my daughter's life, but you have my friendship and gratitude to the end of my days.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GREETING_0003013c_Oblivion_RESP1: Thank you, thank you! I can't tell you how good it feels to be able to see myself again.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_MQ05GwinasPhintiasB_00022b53_Obli: Thank you, thank you! I can't tell you how long I've been looking for this book!
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_SE05MazaddhaSpare2_0008118a_Obliv: Thank you, thank you! You are too kind. I shall bring you names, I promise.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_MS23RalsaGreet_0001db1f_Oblivion_: Thank you. Gilen always tends to exaggerate, but in this case he sounded earnest which worries me a bit...
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_MQ13BattleGetMoreAllies_00027785_: Thank you. I know that delay is dangerous, but it is all for naught if we lose the battle before you can recover the Great Sigil Stone.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_NDJoinOrderAccept_00002b38_Knight: Thank you. I shall serve the Order to the best of my ability.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_MS11GiveAmulet_00038b06_Oblivion_: Thank you. I will now speak the word.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_MS04HelpYes_0003d311_Oblivion_RES: Thank you. I'm afraid I can't offer you much help, but I'll do what I can.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_MS23KillNoRoland_0001d4c9_Oblivio: Thank you. I'm happy you gave me a chance to explain.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_MS23RalsaGreet2_0001db20_Oblivion: Thank you. I'm sure he'll be pleased. I must go now. Good day to you.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_NDJoinOrderAccept_00002b37_Knight: Thank you. It means a great deal to me.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_MG12TravenVeryWell_000835fd_Obliv: Thank you. Know that I would not ask such a thing of you if I did not feel it was urgent, or that it was beyond your capabilities.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_DEM02ImperialMaleVoice_00002A2D_A: Thank you. May the Nine Divines be with you.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_MQ07SpiesResponse_00020076_Oblivi: Thank you. Talk to Steffan. He can tell you where he has seen them.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_FGC07Choice5_00009213_Oblivion_RE: Thank you. Thank you so much. Hopefully, I'll be able to sell these for enough to pay my debt. You're a lifesaver.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_BarterBuyItem_0005e00e_Oblivion_R: Thank you. The funds go toward my home remedies.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_MS13SignetYes_000335ad_Oblivion_R: Thank you. You are truly worthy of all the praise being given to you. I salute you. I'll keep the ring as a reminder of... hmmm...
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_MS14NoMoreBrush_0001c1c7_Oblivion: Thank you. You're truly kind to help someone you've just met. The only thing standing in our way are the painted trolls.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_EmfridDEMOchoice4_00028a33_Oblivi: Thank you...thank you so much. I can't tell you how grateful I am. You always have a home here at the Grey Mare.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GREETING_0008f7b7_Oblivion_RESP1: Thanks again for bringing Pyke back his Medallion! I've never seen him so full of happiness.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GREETING_0000c1c4_Oblivion_RESP1: Thanks again for helping us. I'm sure Ormil will reward you appropriately.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GOODBYE_0001e7e2_Oblivion_RESP1: Thanks again for your help, we had no other place to turn.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GREETING_0002ee2e_Oblivion_RESP1: Thanks again, assassin. Your services have been invaluable. Soon I will find passage out of Cyrodiil, and be rid of those moneylenders forever!
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_AlbertJemaneTopic_0008b074_Oblivi: Thanks again, my friend. You are always welcome in our home.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GREETING_00026ee9_Oblivion_RESP1: Thanks for coming. Since we had the Hero of Kvatch available, I didn't think it made sense to try this on our own the first time.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_HELLO_0003a84c_Oblivion_RESP1: Thanks for coming. We could use your help.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GREETING_0009079e_Oblivion_RESP1: Thanks for doing my work for me. Nothing like having someone else do your dirty laundry. Thanks, you idiot!
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_SE08CutoffTopic_00079bdc_Oblivion: Thanks for the help, I suppose. Although you seem to be doing your best to get me killed.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GREETING_0005a027_Oblivion_RESP1: Thanks for the help, friend. I didn't recognize you at first, but you're the Hero of Kvatch, aren't you?
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GREETING_0000be6f_Oblivion_RESP1: Thanks for the help, not that I couldn't have taken care of it myself. If I were still allowed to carry an axe....
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GREETING_0005a028_Oblivion_RESP1: Thanks for the help. As soon as my lieutenant gets back, we'll be moving out.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GOODBYE_00086566_Oblivion_RESP1: Thanks for the help. You're okay.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GREETING_0001e8d0_Oblivion_RESP1: Thanks for the rescue. I didn't think we would make it out of the Chapel alive. Perhaps Akatosh guided you to us.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GREETING_00026eed_Oblivion_RESP1: Thanks for your help closing that Gate. Don't worry, we can handle anything else they throw at us.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GREETING_00033df5_Oblivion_RESP1: Thanks for your help. I didn't think any of us were going to survive the attack.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GREETING_0008dc3e_Oblivion_RESP1: Thanks so much for getting us here safely!
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_sons_0002573b_Oblivion_RESP4: Thanks so much for sticking with them and helping a foolish old man. Please, take this... I won't be needing it any longer. My battles are over.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_HELLO_0008ef52_Oblivion_RESP1: Thanks to me, things are going well here.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_HELLO_00033579_Oblivion_RESP1: Thanks to you, Cheydinhal is safe.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_ToutiusSextiusTopic_00025b37_Obli: Thanks to you, his sinister plans have now been revealed to me.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_NDSirCaiusTopic_00002d23_Knights_: Thanks to you, that all is behind me. Sir Caius and I will go to Aetherius side by side, as of old. The gods are truly merciful.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GREETING_00018f87_Oblivion_RESP1: Thanks to you, the Mazken have been utterly defeated!
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_FGD01Choice1_0002ae2f_Oblivion_RE: Thanks. I'm not trying to shirk my duty, but it used to be two or three men would be on this. I like the Guild, but I've got a family to consider.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GREETING_0002d764_Oblivion_RESP1: Thanks. Kvatch is safer for all of us, now you've closed the gate.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_EmfridHot_00023cd0_Oblivion_RESP4: Thanks. That's a very good suggestion. I think I'll stop by the Grey Mare, and perhaps pay my respects to this Emfrid woman.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GenericBanditA_000a31c8_Oblivion_: Thanks. Until next time, ha ha ha.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_INFOGENERAL_000434dc_Oblivion_RES: That Adventurer-Attractor-Thingy is working again. You know what's attracting me? The Skooma!
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_INFOGENERAL_000825f6_Oblivion_RES: That Amiable Fanriene is afraid of his own shadow.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_INFOGENERAL_00032e85_Oblivion_RES: That Bloodmane Cave gang had an assassin and a high-level mage? Our gold soldier is a regular hard horse.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_INFOGENERAL_0003c215_Oblivion_RES: That Danus Artellian is a little too full of himself. Sure, he's a Captain of the Guard, but I'm not impressed.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_INFOGENERAL_00046615_Oblivion_RES: That Delphine Jend seems dangerous to me. She's very skilled, but I think she's reckless.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_INFOGENERAL_0003aaab_Oblivion_RES: That Else God-Hater sure has a chip on her shoulder. Great with a blade, but she really holds a grudge against the church.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_INFOGENERAL_000434c6_Oblivion_RES: That Gatekeeper is tough. He's still alive. He killed that adventurer trying to get in. So, we're all still perfectly safe.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_TGGrayFox_0000c059_Oblivion_RESP2: That Gray Cowl he wears was stolen from Nocturnal herself. Can you imagine having the nerve to steal from a Daedric Lord?
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_INFOGENERAL_0003e97f_Oblivion_RES: That Gruiand Garrana is really full of herself. She'll talk your ear off, if you let her.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_Question_00029681_Oblivion_RESP1: That Honditar sure knows his way around this area. Have you spoken with him recently?
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_INFOGENERAL_00032e7f_Oblivion_RES: That Maglir is probably parked in some tavern. I never did like that eight-pint hero.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_INFOGENERAL_00025583_Oblivion_RES: That Modryn Oreyn has got no sense of humor. Hell of a warrior, though. No wonder he's done so well in the Fighters Guild.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_INFOGENERAL_00078164_Oblivion_RES: That Museum of Oddities is a joke, although I hear Una Armina will pay for certain items.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GREETING_0018d292_Oblivion_RESP1: That Oblivion Gate threatened us all, yet only you took action to destroy it. You have my thanks, Hero.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_INFOGENERAL_0003dfcb_Oblivion_RES: That Ra'qanar seems a bit shady to me. He does a good job on the horses at the castle, though.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GREETING_000152e5_Oblivion_RESP1: That Raiment's getting a little tight on you, Brawler! I think you need some exercise! What do you say? Ready for a match?
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_INFOGENERAL_0004350e_Oblivion_RES: That Resonator is up and running again. It traps adventurers like the disease-infected rats that they are.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_INFOGENERAL_00043514_Oblivion_RES: That Resonator keeps adventurers trapped until they die. Lots of bones in there.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_INFOGENERAL_000255b7_Oblivion_RES: That Rimalus Bruiant sure loves his dogs. A little too much, if you ask me.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_INFOGENERAL_000434f9_Oblivion_RES: That Xedilian place just sounds positively stuffed with Oddities. Surely something could be spared for my museum?
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_lightthedragonfires_000223e4_Obli: That a false heir might be crowned... that the test of the Great God might have failed... My heart fails me. It is unthinkable.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_MS23AccuseRoland_0001d4b1_Oblivio: That bastard! Seridur dares accuse me of being a vampire? Me?! Ha! He's the one who is the vampire!
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_FingersoftheMountain_000236e5_Obl: That book requires a great deal of care and security. I hope I am making myself clear.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_TGSpecialJobs_0001ee40_Oblivion_R: That buffoon, Hieronymus Lex, has invaded the Imperial City Waterfront. Imperial Watch guards from all over the city prowl the streets.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_MS16Brothers_00084a9e_Oblivion_RE: That can't be. I don't have a brother. I mean, I never knew my real family. Who did you say you were again?
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GREETING_0008151c_Oblivion_RESP1: That cat beggar is following me! He's going to eat me, I just know it. Don't look! He's standing right over there.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GREETING_00072dad_Oblivion_RESP1: That cat beggar is following me! He's going to eat me, Lord Sheogorath, I just know it. Don't look! He's standing right over there.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_SE09AuthorityMyOwnFemale_00081dac: That confirms it. You're the new Duchess. The stink of hubris surrounds you! My Lord allows you to lick his boot straps, does he?
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GREETING_00034511_Oblivion_RESP1: That could have gone smoother. Can't say I minded killing a few more of these bastards, though. Get the book and let's get out of here.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_ND06Story_00002b0d_Knights_RESP3: That curse still lingers on today, in fact. Poor Kellen.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GREETING_00086065_Oblivion_RESP4: That day, I became a knight, and swore a knight's oath.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_StolenGold_0005371d_Oblivion_RESP: That fetcher of a guard Tyrellius is always trying to be sneaky.  Well, you can forget it. Tell him it isn't going to work.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_MS09YourAmulet_0005377c_Oblivion_: That fetcher. He knows this is the only heirloom I have left from my family. Only he would stoop so low.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_TG04AlessiaCaro_00035fb8_Oblivion: That filthy Argonian actually had the temerity to try and ransom it to me!
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_INFOGENERAL_0005f202_Oblivion_RES: That flesh monstrosity that patrols the Fringe has been rebuilt. Better to let it stay dead if you ask me.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_INFOGENERAL_00082605_Oblivion_RES: That fool Big Head is always looking for the Fork of Horripilation.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_INFOGENERAL_000441ce_Oblivion_RES: That giant torch is on fire now. Great. The thing's likely to fall over and land on somebody. Me, probably. It's not safe walking around anymore.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_HELLO_0006155a_Oblivion_RESP1: That good-for-nothing husband's going to be very surprised if he crawls back here. Very surprised.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_Idle_0018b592_Oblivion_RESP1: That guy asks way too many questions.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_ThoronirTopic_0000bc95_Oblivion_R: That guy is going to run me out of business soon. His prices are so low, I don't know how he does it. I think he's up to something.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_TG11HistoryChanged_00022e8b_Obliv: That has been undone. If you go to the Imperial City, you will find that the Thieves Guild has a guild hall on the site of the ruins of Dareloth.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GREETING_000151f6_Oblivion_RESP3: That helps the odds, but not much. We're still going to be outnumbered. Follow me; I'll show you what we're up against.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_PrimoAntoniusTopic_00028f4c_Obliv: That high-born little worm won't get away with this! He'll pay with his life! Come on, you watch my back. I'm going to take Primo down!
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_MS14TruepaintTopic_0001c1c6_Obliv: That injured man was my father. He passed the Brush on to me, and I intend to pass it along to my kin one day. Did you want to know how it works?
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_MS38DSNo_000be418_Oblivion_RESP1: That is a relief... I was sure... but you have proved yourself... trustworthy. A friend indeed!
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_TG06Accept_00002de2_Oblivion_RESP: That is good. Go to Skingrad. The trail starts there.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_TG07accept_0000c019_Oblivion_RESP: That is good. Remember, this is a mission of stealth, not blood. Your payment will be higher than normal to cover the expense of the forgery.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_MS22SrazirrNotEnough_0002c81f_Obl: That is not the right answer. S'razirr knows you have been paid by Umbacano. Oh yes, this one has listened much since we met at Malada.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_CGEmperor03_0002ad14_Oblivion_RES: That is not what you will be remembered for.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_NDProphetGreetA1_00002aad_Knights: That is usually best left to the gods to judge.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_SE45ForkTopic_00078789_Oblivion_R: That is when Big-Head came here. Master brought me! Whispered shouts into my ear! Songs of Madgods! Songs of bad gods! Softly, Master. Softly.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GREETING_0002fd92_Oblivion_RESP2: That is why I have sent for you. I'm afraid there is a... situation. The time has come to test both your skill and your loyalty to Sithis.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_Dark01Choice2C_00022ba1_Oblivion_: That is why I stand here before you. I bear an offering. An opportunity... to join our rather unique family...
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_ScarTailTopic_00035593_Oblivion_R: That is why you must go to Bogwater and eliminate that treacherous snake! Please kill Scar-Tail, so Ocheeva and I can put this matter behind us.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_MS10WhatAboutLLev_0003c2c4_Oblivi: That is, if we could sober him up for five minutes.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_SE41Catch_0006d604_Oblivion_RESP2: That is, unless someone like yourself could help me find the cure. But no one has taken me up on my offer, even with the promise of a reward.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_MS09ImIn_00053724_Oblivion_RESP4: That is, until last year. Jorundr started to take risks and began robbing more dangerous targets. Not just lone merchants, mind you.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_VelwynBenirusTopic_00009273_Obliv: That layabout? You can find him wasting time at The Count's Arms.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_DovesiDranTopic_00028d34_Oblivion: That little Dark Elf urchin killed three people in cold blood, and now she's going to try to kill us! We can't let that happen!
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_DovesiDranTopic_00028197_Oblivion: That little tramp is as guilty as sin, you hear me? She's the killer, and if we don't keep our eyes on her she'll do it again!
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GREETING_00035f37_Oblivion_RESP2: That looks important, whatever it is. I think you've really found something!
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_SE38Oddity7_00081e8b_Oblivion_RES: That looks just like one I used to have. Or maybe I saw it in a book... in any case, I wish I could afford to buy it from you, but....
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_TrainingQuestTopic_00062444_Obliv: That looks like the armor I asked for. Well done. That wasn't so hard, was it?
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_SE35Brithaur_0007866e_Oblivion_RE: That lout? Yes, he's a thorn in my side that never seems to go away! I'd have his heart on a plate if I could!
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GREETING_00003a6b_Oblivion_RESP1: That manor is still for sale if you're interested.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_contract_000251c7_Oblivion_RESP1: That manservant is going to squash you like a bug! I can't wait to see what's left of you.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_TG10JaksDiarySays_00015313_Oblivi: That master thief died sometime shortly after stealing the Gray Cowl and receiving Nocturnal's curse.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_NDTalk2_00002bae_Knights_RESP1: That matter we discussed before. The lich lord? We need to act. Soon.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_NelsTheNaughtyTopic_00028cd5_Obli: That mead-swilling barbarian killed those two people, I'm sure of it! I don't have the proof just yet, but I'm watching him.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_FGD04Choice2_0002ee6f_Oblivion_RE: That means a lot, coming from you. You think I didn't hear about you ratting me out to Oreyn? Now get out of here before my friend and I get angry.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GREETING_0008585d_Oblivion_RESP2: That means the killer has been inside with us all along. You and I aren't murderers, so that leaves one person! It's Nels the Naughty!
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GREETING_00028bee_Oblivion_RESP2: That means the killer has been inside with us all along. You and I aren't murderers, so that leaves one person! We must prepare to defend ourselves!
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_AzaniBlackheartTOPIC_0002c615_Obl: That mission was the start of it. That was when Vitellus was killed. We were contracted by a wizard, Argoth, to recover an artifact from Blackheart.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_MS47AleswellInvisible_0003003d_Ob: That must have been what all the shouting was about a few weeks ago. I'm afraid I was engrossed in an experiment that required my full attention.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_TG05OntusVanin_0000a250_Oblivion_: That name sounds familiar. Something to do with the Arcane University. Most wizards live somewhere in the Imperial City.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_INFOGENERAL_00042dac_Oblivion_RES: That newcomer... I know I heard his name the other day, but I can't seem to remember....
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_PrimoAntoniusTopic_00028a02_Obliv: That poor boy didn't deserve to die. He was rich! He had no business even being here, looking for treasure that might not even exist.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_NDRumorsUmaril_00002bc8_Knights_R: That prophet in Anvil says that some evil Ayleid king is behind it. Umaril or somesuch. Seeking revenge from beyond the grave, he says!
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_PrimoAntoniusTopic_00028f4c_Obliv: That rich little bastard lured us all here by appealing to our greed! Don't you see? He considers us all low class, and wants us exterminated!
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_Nirnroot_0004e93c_Oblivion_RESP1: That root seems to have strange properties the likes of which I've yet to see duplicated in other flora of its ilk. Hmmmm...
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_BarterBuyItem_000620bd_Oblivion_R: That seems like a fair exchange.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_SE07AAnyaHelp_00014026_Oblivion_R: That should help you to get in there a bit easier.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_SEWildernessRumorResponses_000617: That should keep Passwall safer. But what about the rest of us?
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_CurrentEventsResponses_000c45a0_O: That skooma trade is bad business, and the Renrijra Krin are just a bunch of thugs.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_NevilleTopic_0002879c_Oblivion_RE: That sniveling Legion dog must die! Do you understand me? He's the murderer! He killed all those people! He must pay for what he's done!
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_BookResponses_000285b6_Oblivion_R: That sounds interesting. Perhaps I'll have to read it as well.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_Attack_0018d2ba_Oblivion_RESP1: That the best you can do?
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_SE03LewinC1Idle01_0008ea8d_Oblivi: That thing may be small but it looks mean. Let's get out of here.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_MagesStaff_0002c55b_Oblivion_RESP: That thing? Soris keeps it locked in a chest, down in the basement. I don't see why he's so careful with it.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_INFOGENERAL_0004420c_Oblivion_RES: That torch in New Sheoth is lit. Hopefully, that will burn off some of the airborne germs. It won't get all of them, though.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_NenalataTopic_000a944f_Oblivion_R: That was a bad fix and no mistake. One of the worst I've ever been in. You saved us both, my friend.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GREETING_00017690_Oblivion_RESP1: That was a good fight, Bloodletter. You really showed that Redguard who's boss! Here's your take. Now go clean yourself up.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_INFOGENERAL_000607fb_Oblivion_RES: That was close, but Sheogorath has won. I'd better get back to work.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GREETING_00062457_Oblivion_RESP1: That was disappointing at best. I was hoping for more from you.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_BrenusAstisJournal_00024292_Obliv: That was my job. They said it was in Fallen Rock Cave. You ever been in there? Didn't think so. I'm not going back. Not for that kind of money.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GREETING_000807b2_Oblivion_RESP1: That was quite a battle. I hope you are uninjured.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GREETING_00028878_Oblivion_RESP1: That was some good goblin bashing. What else you need?
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_NDSirBerichTopic_00002c7a_Knights: That was the end of the old Order. Many of Sir Berich's friends left with him. I tried to hold the rest together, but it was no use.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_Idle_0018b5b9_Oblivion_RESP1: That was the strangest book I've ever read.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_SE11HaskillChoice6_00014b61_Obliv: That which is lost can be found again. There is one being in the Shivering Isles who may be able to assist you in the construction of a new Staff.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_TG07BribeBeggar_00015f18_Oblivion: That will do. Look for a man known only as the Stranger. He lives here in Anvil, near the Mages Guild.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_SEDementiaRumorResponses_000613ee: That will take care of pesky adventurers.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_AnvilNQDResponses_0003c255_Oblivi: That woman is a bit off-kilter. I don't even want to know what she's got in her basement.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_Recommendation_0004a24b_Oblivion_: That would be Falcar's responsibility. Good luck.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_TG06AmuseiDoingHere_0001531f_Obli: That would be me. I am so glad you are here to save me from the vampire!
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_PrimoAntoniusTopic_00028185_Obliv: That young man has more nobility in his pinky finger than you have in your entire body, you uncultured swine.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_SEMiscQuestResponses_00082621_Obl: That's Amiable Fanriene. He can barely sleep because of it.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_Recommendation_000514b5_Oblivion_: That's Dagail's responsibility. Speak with her.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_Recommendation_0004a249_Oblivion_: That's Falcar's responsibility. He takes it very seriously.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_ArchMageTopic_0006a879_Oblivion_R: That's Hannibal Traven. You'll find him in the Arch-Mage's Tower, in the center of the University. For your sake, he'd better be expecting you...
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_SEMiscQuestResponses_00082616_Obl: That's Mirili Ulven. I know she's always looking for help.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_BlademasterTopic_00146853_Oblivio: That's Owyn. He is in charge of the Arena. Arranges the fights, trains combatants, that sort of thing. Been that way since Gaiden Shinji.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_BattleMatronTopic_0014685b_Oblivi: That's Ysabel Andronicus, crabby old woman who sits over there. She's dear to me, so if you wrong her in any way, I'll rip your damn liver out.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_BattleMatronTopic_00146859_Oblivi: That's Ysabel. She's sort of the Arena den mother. She handles the logistical stuff, as well as the training of the Grand Champion.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_SE30ForgeCuirass_000400bd_Oblivio: That's a big chest you've got there. You need any help getting this thing on?
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_ADMIREDISLIKE_0006230f_Oblivion_R: That's a bit excessive, don't you think?
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_MagesStaff_0002c0cb_Oblivion_RESP: That's a good deal, right? I wouldn't offer it to anyone else, just you. So what do you say?
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GREETING_000479f4_Oblivion_RESP8: That's a joke. I wouldn't eat one of these horses. Nothing wrong with them, of course...
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GREETING_00028273_Oblivion_RESP4: That's a lot of chances to fill your purse with coin. So what do you say: you want to bet on a match?

ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_ArcaneUniversityTopic_0006a85b_Ob: The Arcane University is the greatest repository of knowledge in all of Cyrodiil. The privilege of admission is a goal every mage strives for.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_ArcaneUniversityTopic_000473ec_Ob: The Arcane University is the seat of the Mages Guild in Cyrodiil. Located in the Imperial City, it houses the leaders of our guild.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_MG11ChoiceExplain_00033540_Oblivi: The Arch-Mage has other reports of these gems being associated with Necromancers, but we do not know why. We don't even know what they do.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GREETING_000488c5_Oblivion_RESP1: The Archer's Paradox. Because a perfect arrow flies forever, and that's impossible. I'm Daenlin, and I have no perfect arrows.

ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_INFOGENERAL_000624c6_Oblivion_RES: The Arena's faked. You think those guys are getting killed? Really? It's just berry syrup and ham-acting.

ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_INFOGENERAL_0008dc30_Oblivion_RES: The Argonian, Big Head, is always searching for the Spoon of Horripilation. Yeah, the Spoon of Horripilation. Certainly not a fork.

ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_MQ09ArmorTopic_000c4315_Oblivion_: The Armor is in the Shrine of Tiber Septim, in the catacombs beneath the ruins of Sancre Tor. A holy place, once.

ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GOODBYE_0007a01c_Oblivion_RESP1: The Aureal are yours to command.

ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_HELLO_00080d91_Oblivion_RESP1: The Aureals no longer defile holy Cylarne, thanks to you.

ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_HELLO_000826d6_Oblivion_RESP1: The Aureals will soon pay for their arrogance.

ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_INFOGENERAL_00077c4d_Oblivion_RES: The Baliwog is a dangerous little creature. Some say they grow up to be Scalons.

ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_INFOGENERAL_0008dc1e_Oblivion_RES: The Baliwog will stay away from the water. Water certainly doesn't heal them. Nope, not at all.

The Battle Raiment's already enchanted, so you can't muck with it. But aside from that, anything goes. Magic, stealth... whatever you need to win.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_INFOGENERAL_0006234c_Oblivion_RES: The Battle of Bruma was a great victory! The Mythic Dawn have learned that we are not defenseless.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_MQ00BrumaResponse_00062bf2_Oblivi: The Battle of Bruma will surely go down in history as the turning point in the Oblivion Crisis. Mark my words.
