ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GREETING_0002fd92_Oblivion_RESP3: The Black Hand has learned that the Dark Brotherhood has been infiltrated. By whom, and for what purpose, we do not yet know.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_Dark08FinChoice2A_00032be9_Oblivi: The Black Hand has sanctioned the Rose of Sithis. It is a magic arrow specifically enchanted to kill its target. In this case, Phillida.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GREETING_0002fdb3_Oblivion_RESP3: The Black Hand is most pleased with your progress. You have been invited to share in secrets that few within the Dark Brotherhood even know exist.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_SilencerTopic_0002fdb6_Oblivion_R: The Black Hand is the Dark Brotherhood's ruling council. That hand consists of four Speakers and one Listener. Four fingers and a thumb, as it were.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_CovenantTopic_000272af_Oblivion_R: The Black Hand is the ruling body of the Dark Brotherhood. It is made up of one Listener and Four Speakers. Four fingers and a thumb, if you will.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_INFOGENERAL_000624f2_Oblivion_RES: The Black Hand is trying to keep it very hush hush, but one of their own has been assassinated! It would seem the Brotherhood has been infiltrated.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_ImperialCityTopic_0004767b_Oblivi: The Black Horse Courier brings the news of the people to the people. We are funded by the Empire, so our broadsheets are always free!
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_INFOGENERAL_00066ccf_Oblivion_RES: The Black Horse Courier has a story about Rythe Lythandas. Here. Take my copy. I'm done with it.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_ImperialCityTopic_00047669_Oblivi: The Black Horse Courier is run by three Khajiit brothers. They buy freelance stories with an Imperial stipend, and give the papers away for free.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GREETING_0004767e_Oblivion_RESP1: The Black Horse Courier. Brothers Urjabhi and Ra'Jiradh, and I, Hassiri. We bring the news of the Empire to the people of the Empire! Fast, fast!
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_HorseInquiry_0004f00f_Oblivion_RE: The Black horses of Cheydinhal are the finest in all of Cyrodiil! None are faster and only the White horses of Anvil are stronger.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_INFOGENERAL_00032e28_Oblivion_RES: The Blackwood Company gets the contracts because the Fighters Guild is coming apart at the seams.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_INFOGENERAL_00032e26_Oblivion_RES: The Blackwood Company has a terrible reputation. But with the Fighters Guild in trouble, who else is there?
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_causingtrouble_0002ae34_Oblivion_: The Blackwood Company has taken that much of a foothold in Leyawiin. Those sons of....
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_INFOGENERAL_00032e25_Oblivion_RES: The Blackwood Company is gone. They were working high on Hist sap. That's why there were so many terrible 'accidents'.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_INFOGENERAL_00032e3c_Oblivion_RES: The Blackwood Company is just plain mean. They've got a bad reputation, but that won't hurt business in their line of work, will it?
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_INFOGENERAL_00032e2b_Oblivion_RES: The Blackwood Company is not popular, but they're still cheap and effective.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_LeyawiinTopic_000479cd_Oblivion_R: The Blackwood Company is proud of our beastfolk heritage, and we are solely owned and operated by Khajiit and Argonians.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_INFOGENERAL_00032e3e_Oblivion_RES: The Blackwood Company people are more hard-core than the fighters from the Guild.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_INFOGENERAL_00032e29_Oblivion_RES: The Blackwood Company seems to be winning the battle for mercenary contracts in Cyrodiil, but I wouldn't count the Fighters Guild out just yet.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_INFOGENERAL_00032e41_Oblivion_RES: The Blackwood Company takes any job, no matter how tough. Fighters Guild is more fussy.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_INFOGENERAL_00032e22_Oblivion_RES: The Blackwood Company were taking bad hist from a sick tree. No wonder they fought blood-mad and fearless.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_MQ09ArmorTopic_00026d6e_Oblivion_: The Blades are as touchy as priests about relics of Tiber Septim, it seems!
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_BladesTopic_00033df6_Oblivion_RES: The Blades are closely linked to the Order of Talos. We both serve Talos, of course, and many of our brothers are former Blades.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_MQJoinBladesDuties_00037cef_Obliv: The Blades are sworn to the service of the Emperor, as the mortal representative of the Dragon Blood of the divine Talos.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_MQ12JauffreMartin_0007be91_Oblivi: The Blades are, as always, at your disposal.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_MQ09ArmorTopic_00026d5f_Oblivion_: The Blades built a shrine in the catacombs of Sancre Tor, on the spot where Tiber Septim received the blessing of Akatosh.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_HELLO_000227b5_Oblivion_RESP1: The Blades have gotten the Emperor out of worse situations than this.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_ImperialSewers_00022cf1_Oblivion_: The Blades have occasion to use them in our undercover work, as well as a means to move around the city without attracting attention.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GREETING_0001efe0_Oblivion_RESP3: The Blades saluting me and hailing me as Martin Septim...
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_ImperialCityTopic_000476f5_Oblivi: The Bloated Float on the Waterfront is cheap... and a bit too interesting for my tastes.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_ImperialCityTopic_00047742_Oblivi: The Bloated Float rents beds. Only place on the waterfront. Cheap. And it's safe.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GREETING_00016ea6_Oblivion_RESP2: The Blood of Thadon has been consumed by Arden-Sul's will, and all of Mania welcomes you with open arms.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GREETING_0007dbff_Oblivion_RESP2: The Blood of Thadon has been consumed by Arden-Sul's will, and all of Mania welcomes you with open arms.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_NDBootsoftheCrusader_00002a40_Kni: The Boots are safeguarded by Kynareth herself. You must be tested, and prove yourself worthy to acquire them.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_INFOGENERAL_000029ff_Knights_RESP: The Boots of the Crusader have been given to a worthy knight, I understand. He must have been very brave!
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_MS14Thief_0001bb32_Oblivion_RESP4: The Bosmer must have leapt into the painting, then painted guardians inside to protect himself using the Brush of Truepaint.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_MaglirTOPIC_0002428c_Oblivion_RES: The Bosmer? I've seen him at the West Weald Tavern. Been there for days, from what I hear. Better go see him.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_INFOGENERAL_00062bce_Oblivion_RES: The Bruma guild hall has been decimated. Our hall could be next!
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_MS14MoreBrush_0001bb34_Oblivion_R: The Brush allows the artist to paint from within a canvas. It opens a portal into which the artist may enter to paint things life-sized.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_ArenaChampName2_00038b41_Oblivion: The Butcher, huh? I like it! Yeah, that'll do nicely. All right, it's time to see if you're crazy good or just plain crazy.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_MS48IlendA1_001778cf_Oblivion_RES: The Captain is still holding the barricade? I figured I was the last one left alive.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_BrumaTopic_0018d2a3_Oblivion_RESP: The Captain said you've been inside one of those Oblivion Gate things. Said you knew how to destroy them. I sure hope you can help us.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GREETING_0003a848_Oblivion_RESP1: The Captain's in charge. I'll follow his orders.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_DASanguineSpeech_000b121f_Oblivio: The Castle Leyawiin is a dull, dreary place. The mistress is an especially somber soul, and tomorrow she will hold another excruciating dinner party.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_SEChaliceofReversal_00043021_Obli: The Chalice has altered the effects that Felldew has on you. You'll find that it now provides minor benefits, without any of the withdrawal.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_INFOGENERAL_00043e84_Oblivion_RES: The Chalice has been returned to Thadon. He should use it while there is still time.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_SEChaliceofReversal_00013384_Obli: The Chalice is in Dunroot Burrow. Haven't you been listening?
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_INFOGENERAL_00043e92_Oblivion_RES: The Chalice is once again in its rightful place. And places are rightfully mine. And Chalices. Right?
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_SEChaliceofReversal_00082470_Obli: The Chalice is one of the Duke's prized possessions. He has been at a loss without it.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_INFOGENERAL_00043ec5_Oblivion_RES: The Chalice of Reversal is back in Thadon's hands, I hear. Wonder if it could be used as a blunt weapon.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_SEThadonWaitingForever_000131d8_O: The Chalice of Reversal is waiting for you. When I say you, I mean me, but it's no difference to the Chalice. One ends up being the other.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_SEDunrootBurrowTopic_0001338b_Obl: The Chalice, Felldew, Elytra... it's all connected. One without the others is no good, poison. Oh, a rough road awaits you.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GREETING_0001330c_Oblivion_RESP2: The Chalice, remember? Don't forget, because if I forget then no one will remember, and it might cease to exist. Reality is fickle like that.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_ModrynOreynTOPIC_00098197_Oblivio: The Champion? He was on the second floor last I saw him.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_BrumaTopic_0003c993_Oblivion_RESP: The Chapel has made enemies here in the past. The Nords prefer their dragon Ysmir to our Father Akatosh.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_Enemy_0002d77c_Oblivion_RESP2: The Chapel is cast down, and the faithful... my friends... all dead.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_SkingradTopic_00038aa9_Oblivion_R: The Chapel of Julianos is always open for worship and contemplation. Perhaps you should speak to Marie Palielle, our healer and Restoration trainer.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_INFOGENERAL_0000080A_AltarESPMain: The Chestnut Handy Stables now offers to protect your horse… seems handy enough!
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_ImperialCityTopic_0007be9b_Oblivi: The Chestnut Handy Stables used to sell horses. But they're gone. Our horses. All gone. Big mystery. No idea where they went. [burp]
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GREETING_00054170_Oblivion_RESP1: The Cheydinhal Black horse is the finest in Cyrodiil. Take good care of him.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_INFOGENERAL_0006266e_Oblivion_RES: The Chorrol guild hall had an unpleasant visit recently, from someone who had a grudge against Teekeeus.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_MS13Gate_000329e9_Oblivion_RESP7: The City Watch and the Knights of the Thorn are always at odds. They think we don't have what it takes, and Farwil wanted to show them.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_INFOGENERAL_0018bc8f_Oblivion_RES: The Colovian Highlands are barren wastelands along the border with Hammerfell.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_INFOGENERAL_0018bc90_Oblivion_RES: The Colovian Highlands? Near the Hammerfell border? No one lives there. That's barren wastelands.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_INFOGENERAL_0018bcae_Oblivion_RES: The Colovians are proud of their reputation for being independent, rough, and rebellious.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_NDTalkRelics2_00002c6c_Knights_RE: The Commander has recovered the Boots! Kynareth smiles upon our endeavor, there can be no doubt!
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_NDTalkRelicsShield_00002c60_Knigh: The Commander must truly be blessed with the wisdom of Julianos! Come, the others will want to hear the good news.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GREETING_000479ce_Oblivion_RESP2: The Company provides expert jihatt for selected customers. Very discreet.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_MG09Choice4C_00022bd9_Oblivion_RE: The Council has agreed to keep his nature a secret, and in exchange he occasionally provides us with useful information.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_INFOGENERAL_00062bc9_Oblivion_RES: The Council has turned on Traven. Things couldn't possibly get any worse for the guild.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GREETING_0000a0fb_Oblivion_RESP1: The Council is in complete disarray at the news of Mannimarco's presence in Cyrodiil.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_tasks_00035678_Oblivion_RESP1: The Council is investigating what happened at Wellspring Cave. Many of our resources are devoted to the task, leaving our ranks spread thin.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_MG12Choice1A_0000befd_Oblivion_RE: The Council of Mages has been aware of the increased Necromancer activity in Cyrodiil for some time.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_INFOGENERAL_00062bcc_Oblivion_RES: The Council of Mages has been dissolved. Arch-Mage Traven has been deserted. He's all we have left.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_INFOGENERAL_00062bd6_Oblivion_RES: The Council of Mages has this Necromancer situation under control. They must, or else we'd know about it, right?
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_ArcaneUniversityTopic_000473f2_Ob: The Council of Mages meets there in the Imperial City. That's where the real power of the guild lies.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GREETING_00115edc_Oblivion_RESP1: The Council requires more time. Please, be patient. I will have work for you soon enough.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_INFOGENERAL_000624c8_Oblivion_RES: The Council runs the Arena to amuse the masses, and it pays for itself, with all the fools who lose their shirts gambling.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_INFOGENERAL_00062681_Oblivion_RES: The Council seems very interested in this new group of Necromancers that has sprung up. I wonder how things will play out.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_MG12TravenSomeone_000835f9_Oblivi: The Council was initially reluctant to believe the information was reliable, but with recent events, they have little choice but to trust it.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GREETING_0018d29e_Oblivion_RESP1: The Count always says that Leyawiin stands alone, but your actions proved him wrong. Well done.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GREETING_0003c34a_Oblivion_RESP4: The Count and I thank you for helping bring Ulrich's hold on Cheydinhal to an end, and for doing so without unnecessary bloodshed.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GREETING_0003c339_Oblivion_RESP2: The Count and I thank you for helping bring Ulrich's hold on Cheydinhal to an end, though we would have preferred having him brought up on charges.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_LeyawiinTopic_00091b41_Oblivion_R: The Count appears for audiences in the County Hall near the throne weekdays between 8 AM and 4 PM.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GREETING_00034475_Oblivion_RESP1: The Count appreciates your efforts, but as the vampires have not yet been dealt with, he has no interest in seeing you at this time.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GREETING_00098122_Oblivion_RESP1: The Count awaits within. Please, do not delay.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_FawilTopic_00031c82_Oblivion_RESP: The Count fears the worst, and has posted guards here so we can watch and see if anyone comes back out. So far, nothing.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GREETING_00035672_Oblivion_RESP2: The Count has agreed to see you, but not here.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_MQ11BrumaAllies_00056e67_Oblivion: The Count has dispatched soldiers to Bruma, as he promised.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_MQ11BrumaAllies_00056e68_Oblivion: The Count has dispatched soldiers to Bruma, as he promised.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_MQ11BrumaAllies_00056e6b_Oblivion: The Count has instructed me to tell you that he will be happy to speak to you again once the Oblivion Gate threatening Skingrad is closed.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_SkingradTopic_0018d301_Oblivion_R: The Count has ordered the Guard to defend the city to the last man. There will be no panic here.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_JanusHassildorTopic_0003567a_Obli: The Count is a reclusive man, and sometimes difficult to see. Hopefully, your status as a representative of the Guild will aid you.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GREETING_000748a4_Oblivion_RESP1: The Count is on his way. Please, remain here and be patient.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_BravilTopic_00048902_Oblivion_RES: The Count is too preoccupied with his pastimes to spend time on county affairs. So the burden lies on me.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_MQ11BrumaAllies_00056e69_Oblivion: The Count left very specific instructions. He does not want to see you again on this matter until the Oblivion Gate outside Skingrad is closed.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_INFOGENERAL_00146005_Oblivion_RES: The Count made that Orc, Mazoga, into a knight? Well, well. Next thing, we'll be making horses into knights.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GREETING_00098121_Oblivion_RESP1: The Count needs more time. He will see you when he is ready.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_INFOGENERAL_000624a9_Oblivion_RES: The Count of Skingrad and I are not social intimates. In fact, I don't believe Janus Hassildor has any social intimates.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_INFOGENERAL_000624ed_Oblivion_RES: The Count of Skingrad is not all he seems. Let's just say I'm not the only one who enjoys his evenings...
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_BravilTopic_0018d2a7_Oblivion_RES: The Count put the Guard on high alert. We'll be ready if the daedra decide to attack, don't worry.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_BravilTopic_00048907_Oblivion_RES: The Count used to be a great man, but power and idleness have spoilt him. However, we remain loyal in memory of past kindnesses, and to serve Bravil.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_BravilTopic_000488bb_Oblivion_RES: The Count was once a tournament champion. Now he's a loafer and skirt-chaser. And his son, Gellius, is a spoiled good-for-nothing skooma-sucker.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_AnvilTopic_0003cf89_Oblivion_RESP: The Count went missing about ten years ago. No one knows what happened to him. Lady Millona rules County Anvil.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_AnvilTopic_00154cde_Oblivion_RESP: The Count went missing about ten years ago... but just recently he reappeared. It's a bit of a mystery, but the Countess seems pleased.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GREETING_00038ab2_Oblivion_RESP1: The Count will not see you now. Not now, not ever. He sees no one. I'm Mercator Hosidus, his steward. I believe that's all you need to know.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_INFOGENERAL_0003c1b3_Oblivion_RES: The Count's Arms is a very nice place for a meal. And Wilbur has an extensive knowledge of wines.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_DirectionsSleep_0018bd8e_Oblivion: The Count's Arms is next to the north gate.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_INFOGENERAL_00146007_Oblivion_RES: The Count's been asking questions about some Orc named Mazoga at the castle... she claims she's a knight.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_MG09Choice4A_00022bd5_Oblivion_RE: The Count's unique nature is not public knowledge. The Council wishes to keep it that way.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_CheydinhalTopic_0004e891_Oblivion: The Count, Andel Indarys, is a Hlaalu parvenu, but his steward, Naspia Cosma, does her best to coach him on the finer points of Imperial etiquette.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_MS10Count_0003c29b_Oblivion_RESP1: The Count? He could care less about our plight. As long as the roast suckling pig is delivered to his feast table, he's as happy as can be.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GreetingMazoga04_0009381f_Oblivio: The Count? Then I can talk to you. I'm Mazoga.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_AnvilTopic_0003e0b3_Oblivion_RESP: The Countess deserves all the credit. I do things my way, indeed, but she gives me the authority and support.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_TG04DarkSecrets_0004f9ea_Oblivion: The Countess has a secret passage somewhere in the basement that leads to her private quarters. That's where the torture chamber is.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GREETING_00097a6b_Oblivion_RESP1: The Countess has received word from Cloud Ruler Temple that grave matters are afoot. Nothing else concerns her at the moment.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_BrumaTopic_0003c97e_Oblivion_RESP: The Countess is Heartland Nibenean, and so are most guildsmen and chapelmen, but most others are as Nordish as you'll find.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_CountessCarvain_000980fa_Oblivion: The Countess is in attendance from 8 in the morning until 6 in the evening each day.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_CountessCarvain_00132aa2_Oblivion: The Countess is in attendance from 8 in the morning until 6 in the evening each day.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_CountessValga_000038cf_Oblivion_R: The Countess is in attendance from 8 in the morning until 6 in the evening.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_CountessValga_00159752_Oblivion_R: The Countess is in attendance from 8 in the morning until 6 in the evening.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_CountessCarvain_000980f9_Oblivion: The Countess is in attendance. Please observe proper etiquette.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_CountessCarvain_00132aa1_Oblivion: The Countess is in attendance. Please observe proper etiquette.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_CountessValga_000038d0_Oblivion_R: The Countess is in attendance. Proper etiquette is expected.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_CountessValga_00159751_Oblivion_R: The Countess is in attendance. Proper etiquette is expected.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_TG04AlessiasRing_0001e107_Oblivio: The Countess is very happy to have her ring back. I don't think she has taken it off for days. If you want to hear the whole story, talk to Hlidara.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_TG04GivePick_00035fb7_Oblivion_RE: The Countess rarely leaves the castle. Good luck getting it back.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_INFOGENERAL_0003481b_Oblivion_RES: The Countess seems much happier now that the item that was stolen from her was returned.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_BrumaTopic_0018d2a4_Oblivion_RESP: The Countess sent Captain Burd to deal with that Oblivion Gate outside of town. We're all praying that they'll be all right.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_INFOGENERAL_0003481c_Oblivion_RES: The Countess still seems quite sad. I hear someone tried to find the item stolen from the castle, but they had no luck. Oh well.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_MQ12JauffreMartin_0007be8e_Oblivi: The Countess will never agree to it...
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GREETING_0002d77a_Oblivion_RESP2: The Covenant is broken. The Enemy has won.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_ArenaChampName8_00038b3b_Oblivion: The Crimson Blade, huh? I like it! Yeah, that'll do nicely. All right, it's time to see if you're crazy good or just plain crazy.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_MS27HerminiaC1_000a5604_Oblivion_: The Crown of the Ayleids which Umbacano wants is not simply an ancient work of art.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GREETING_0000298e_Knights_RESP1: The Cuirass of the Crusader represents our greatest achievement as servants of the Nine. We protect it, even in death.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_KvatchTopic_000039d7_Oblivion_RES: The Daedra came out of the gate in the middle of the night.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_SE04JyggalagTopic_00091018_Oblivi: The Daedric Prince of Order, and the leader of the Greymarch. As I'm sure my Lord told you, Jyggalag has always been a threat to this Realm.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_SE04SheoIntro1_0008245e_Oblivion_: The Daedric Prince of Order. Or biscuits... No. Order. And not in a good way. Bleak. Colorless. Dead. Boring, boring, boring.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_INFOGENERAL_0005f427_Oblivion_RES: The Daedric armies are whole again. If only I could live to see them in battle. The chills are getting worse, though.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_PurificationTopic_0002fd9c_Oblivi: The Dark Brotherhood is an ancient organization. We have survived for millenia. Sometimes, to ensure that survival, drastic measures are required.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_specialarrangement_000253d8_Obliv: The Dark Brotherhood is not in the business of staging deaths, no matter how much gold is offered. Sithis demands blood, and blood must be paid.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_Dark19StatueTalk2_00086711_Oblivi: The Dark Brotherhood must seek out a Breton named Annabelle. She has need of our services, and we are only too happy to oblige.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_Dark19StatueTalk2_00086712_Oblivi: The Dark Brotherhood must seek out a Breton named Evangeline. She has need of our services, and we are only too happy to oblige.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_Dark19StatueTalk2_00086720_Oblivi: The Dark Brotherhood must seek out a Dark Elf named Hlanas. He has need of our services, and we are only too happy to oblige.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_Dark19StatueTalk2_00086719_Oblivi: The Dark Brotherhood must seek out a High Elf named Alwaen. She has need of our services, and we are only too happy to oblige.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_Dark19StatueTalk2_0008671d_Oblivi: The Dark Brotherhood must seek out a High Elf named Aranath. He has need of our services, and we are only too happy to oblige.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_Dark19StatueTalk2_00086721_Oblivi: The Dark Brotherhood must seek out a Khajiit named Dahlima. He has need of our services, and we are only too happy to oblige.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_Dark19StatueTalk2_00086716_Oblivi: The Dark Brotherhood must seek out a Khajiit named Shavari. She has need of our services, and we are only too happy to oblige.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_Dark19StatueTalk2_0008671b_Oblivi: The Dark Brotherhood must seek out a Nord named Erich. He has need of our services, and we are only too happy to oblige.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_Dark19StatueTalk2_0008671a_Oblivi: The Dark Brotherhood must seek out a Nord named Sonje. She has need of our services, and we are only too happy to oblige.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_Dark19StatueTalk2_00086718_Oblivi: The Dark Brotherhood must seek out a Redguard named Rhiannon. She has need of our services, and we are only too happy to oblige.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_Dark19StatueTalk2_00086713_Oblivi: The Dark Brotherhood must seek out a Wood Elf named Naarifin. She has need of our services, and we are only too happy to oblige.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_Dark19StatueTalk2_0008671c_Oblivi: The Dark Brotherhood must seek out a Wood Elf named Urunil. He has need of our services, and we are only too happy to oblige.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_Dark19StatueTalk2_00086717_Oblivi: The Dark Brotherhood must seek out an Argonian named Pasha. She has need of our services, and we are only too happy to oblige.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_Dark19StatueTalk2_00086715_Oblivi: The Dark Brotherhood must seek out an Imperial named Avresa. She has need of our services, and we are only too happy to oblige.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_Dark19StatueTalk2_00086714_Oblivi: The Dark Brotherhood must seek out an Imperial named Camilla. She has need of our services, and we are only too happy to oblige.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_Dark19StatueTalk2_0008671f_Oblivi: The Dark Brotherhood must seek out an Imperial named Florentius. He has need of our services, and we are only too happy to oblige.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_Dark19StatueTalk2_0008671e_Oblivi: The Dark Brotherhood must seek out an Imperial named Haderus. He has need of our services, and we are only too happy to oblige.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_Dark19StatueTalk2_00086723_Oblivi: The Dark Brotherhood must seek out an Imperial named Severio. He has need of our services, and we are only too happy to oblige.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_Dark19StatueTalk2_00086722_Oblivi: The Dark Brotherhood must seek out an Orc named Buramog. He has need of our services, and we are only too happy to oblige.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_INFOGENERAL_0007c0a9_Oblivion_RES: The Dark Brotherhood! They've actually murdered Adamus Phillida, the Imperial Legion commander! It's in the latest Black Horse Courier. Here.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_Dark05Convo_000282a6_Oblivion_RES: The Dark Brotherhood? Oh, you have been a naughty boy, Motierre, haven't you? Stand aside, assassin! Motierre is mine! My employers demand it!
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_Dark17Choice4B_00054037_Oblivion_: The Dark Brotherhood? Okay! Okay! Here! Here's the key! Just don't hurt me! I won't say a word, I swear!
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_ChallengeDarkElf_0009f9b1_Oblivio: The Dark Elves are my favored people. But I am fair-minded... the outcome is in your hands.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_SE10WellspringInfo_0001e971_Obliv: The Darkness is a frightening place, even to us, and so our Lord has given us this beacon, a light to guide us back to Him.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_SE10WellspringInfo_00043027_Obliv: The Darkness is a frightening place, even to us, and so our Lord has given us this beacon, a light to guide us back to Him.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GREETING_000475b0_Oblivion_RESP1: The Dividing Line between a live hero and a dead one is a sharp sword. Get the best you can afford from Tun-Zeeus...
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_INFOGENERAL_0003dfc4_Oblivion_RES: The Dividing Line is a good place to buy a sharp blade. Of course, you're likely to hear some of Tun-Zeeus' stories if you hang around.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_ArenaChampName6_00038b3d_Oblivion: The Divine Avenger, huh? I like it! Yeah, that'll do nicely. All right, it's time to see if you're crazy good or just plain crazy.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_INFOGENERAL_00002a0e_Knights_RESP: The Divine Crusader has returned, they say. None too soon, if you ask me.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GREETING_00002982_Knights_RESP1: The Divine Crusader herself! To what do I owe this honor?
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GREETING_00002981_Knights_RESP1: The Divine Crusader himself! To what do I owe this honor?
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_DEAkDisappearances_00014e21_Altar: The Divines are powerless to stop all these threats.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_TGDoyen_0001d4d4_Oblivion_RESP1: The Doyen are the eyes and claws of the guildmaster. As a hunter, you take orders from them, and you get your favors from them.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_TGDoyen_0001d4d2_Oblivion_RESP1: The Doyen are the hands and eyes of the guildmaster. You take your orders from them. You get your favors from them.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_TGDoyen_0001d4d3_Oblivion_RESP1: The Doyen are the hands and eyes of the guildmaster. You take your orders from them. You get your favors from them.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_MQ06MankarSpeech_0001f875_Oblivio: The Dragon Throne is empty, and we hold the Amulet of Kings!
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_DragonfiresTopic_00033fc8_Oblivio: The Dragonfires of Akatosh remain lit until the death of the Emperor. His successor then lights them anew upon ascending to the throne.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_INFOGENERAL_0004423f_Oblivion_RES: The Duchess of Dementia has been assassinated? Well, no need to finish her portrait then.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_SESylTopic_00044f56_Oblivion_RESP: The Duchess of Dementia. Ever wary, ever worried. A prisoner in her own House, in a way. And a delightful conversationalist, really.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_SE04SheoLearnWhat_00044f54_Oblivi: The Duke of Mania and the Duchess of Dementia. Seek them out, and let them show you what New Sheoth is. You might be surprised.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_INFOGENERAL_0005edfe_Oblivion_RES: The Duke of Mania has been assassinated? Well, no need to finish his portrait, then....
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_ImperialCityTopic_000476f1_Oblivi: The Earl is perhaps not well known in the city. He is a private man, and keeps to himself.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_INFOGENERAL_00064465_Oblivion_RES: The Earl of Imbel was attacked and killed in his own home. I heard the body burned in the sunlight.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_NDProphetSpeechMain_00002a6d_Knig: The Eight And One require a champion, a Divine Crusader reborn.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_NDProphetSpeechMQ2_00002d17_Knigh: The Eight and One favor only the righteous! And too few of you remain!
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_ND09ProphetQuestions04_00002c9b_K: The Eight created the Relics to withstand Umaril's fell power. Do not attempt to face him without this divine protection.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_ElderCouncilTopic_000add4a_Oblivi: The Elder Council Chambers are closed to the public for the duration of the emergency.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_INFOGENERAL_000624b7_Oblivion_RES: The Elder Council and the bureaucracy have managed the Empire's affairs for decades. The Emperor rules, but the Council handles all the details.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_ElderCouncilTopic_00037833_Oblivi: The Elder Council has been governing the Empire since the Emperor's murder. They will be overjoyed to have an heir to crown.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_ElderCouncilTopic_000adc6a_Oblivi: The Elder Council rules in the Emperor's absence, by ancient tradition.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_TG11P1WhatIsPlan_0001fb6e_Oblivio: The Elder Scrolls are kept in the Imperial Palace behind a door that cannot be breached.  Savilla's Stone has revealed a path around this door.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_ElixirofExploration_0004e946_Obli: The Elixir of Exploration is a multi-purpose potion that was obviously created with the dungeon explorer in mind.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_contract_0000bcb4_Oblivion_RESP1: The Elves of the Imperial City are a fairly close-knit community. One of them will have at least heard of Faelian. You should ask around.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_INFOGENERAL_00077c45_Oblivion_RES: The Elytra have wondrous poisons that can drain the very life from you.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_SEFelldew_00018b7e_Oblivion_RESP2: The Elytra in Dunroot Burrow, the ones that secrete it are immune, but they're the only ones.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_INFOGENERAL_0018b1fa_Oblivion_RES: The Emperor and his three sons, dead, right under the noses of the Imperial Guard. It's a disgrace.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_INFOGENERAL_0018b2f6_Oblivion_RES: The Emperor is dead, and so are his heirs. We're a Legion without a leader. The Blades were trusted with our Lord's protection... and they failed.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_MQ15MankarSpeech_0008b0a6_Oblivio: The Emperor is dead. The Amulet of Kings is mine.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GREETING_000178c7_Oblivion_RESP1: The Emperor may trust you, but I don't. Stay out of our way.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GREETING_00015b94_Oblivion_RESP1: The Emperor! I must get to the Emperor!
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_INFOGENERAL_00062354_Oblivion_RES: The Emperor's death was a harsh lesson for all of us. We failed in our duty to the Dragonborn. It must not happen again.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_BladesTalk5_0018d7ff_Oblivion_RES: The Emperor's death was a harsh lesson to learn. We can never be too vigilant. But now is the time for action, not talk. There is work to be done.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_BladesTopic_00033df8_Oblivion_RES: The Emperor's elite knights. They dedicate themselves to Talos above and the Septims here on earth.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_INFOGENERAL_0018bab4_Oblivion_RES: The Emperor's heir lives! The bloodline is unbroken! Long live Martin Septim!
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_MQ02JauffreD1_00092d85_Oblivion_R: The Emperor's words-- "Close shut the jaws of Oblivion"-- certainly suggest that he perceived some threat from Oblivion.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_MQ04MartinEmperor_0001efe2_Oblivi: The Emperor... that's an idea that will take some getting used to.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_BladesTalk2_0018d7f0_Oblivion_RES: The Empire has been saved, but the Septim bloodline, it's... it's broken. There is no Emperor. I can't help but feel a bit... obsolete.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_INFOGENERAL_0005ef4d_Oblivion_RES: The End is coming. You just wait, you'll see. Time to gather up your things while you can.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_Enemy_0002d77c_Oblivion_RESP3: The Enemy has won, and we are destroyed.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GOODBYE_00088b67_Oblivion_RESP1: The Eternal Garden is the testing ground for the new rulers of Tamriel. I intend to pass the Master's test.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_HELLO_00088b35_Oblivion_RESP1: The Eternal Garden... I used to dream about coming here. The Master made it sound so wonderful.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_MS43Scamps_00094eca_Oblivion_RESP: The Everscamp is unique. Not quite as powerful as a regular scamp, it can barely use magic and is more of an annoyance than a threat.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_SE32SiegeVitharn_0005a756_Oblivio: The Fanatics are about to break into the courtyard.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_SE32SiegeVitharn_0001b68f_Oblivio: The Fanatics caught us by surprise, attacking out of the Reservoir, killing the rear guard and opening the main gates. Now I do the dance of death.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_SE32SiegeVitharn_0001b68d_Oblivio: The Fanatics? What's to understand? They were just after my power. But it's mine, all mine.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_INFOGENERAL_00049927_Oblivion_RES: The Feed Bag isn't fancy, but it fills you up.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_Attack_0008ef88_Oblivion_RESP1: The Felldew is ours! You can't have it!
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_INFOGENERAL_00032e32_Oblivion_RES: The Fighters Guild got Azani Blackheart's ring. Not the Blackwood Company. Apparently the Blackwood Company made the whole thing up.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_INFOGENERAL_00032e4a_Oblivion_RES: The Fighters Guild got Lady Rogbut out safe and sound. With the Blackwood Company, you never know....
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_INFOGENERAL_00032e42_Oblivion_RES: The Fighters Guild has competition in Leyawiin. Called 'The Blackwood Company'. Very tough. Maybe too tough.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_INFOGENERAL_00032e36_Oblivion_RES: The Fighters Guild hasn't actually defaulted on any contracts. But still, all the confusion and delays are going to hurt them.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_FightersGuildTopic_00049973_Obliv: The Fighters Guild is a brotherhood of warriors. We provide a service to Tamriel, lending steel and shield to those who need our help.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_INFOGENERAL_00032e39_Oblivion_RES: The Fighters Guild is a family business. With Vitellus dead, Viranus is in line to succeed his mother.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_INFOGENERAL_000255b1_Oblivion_RES: The Fighters Guild is a good place to go if you need weapons training.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_jointheFightersGuild_0002427a_Obl: The Fighters Guild is always looking for new members. If you've got a clean record, and don't have a bounty on your head, we may be able to use you.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_DirectionsGuilds_0018bd8f_Oblivio: The Fighters Guild is east, by the bridge to the castle. The Mages Guild is south, by the bridge to the port.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_BravilTopic_00048908_Oblivion_RES: The Fighters Guild is good enough to encourage me in sharing the inner peace and spiritual harmony of the martial arts.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_INFOGENERAL_00061432_Oblivion_RES: The Fighters Guild is recruiting again. Not a bad way to make some money, if you've got the stones for it.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_INFOGENERAL_00032e3f_Oblivion_RES: The Fighters Guild needs to get aggressive if they're going to compete with the Blackwood Company in Leyawiin.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_INFOGENERAL_00032e52_Oblivion_RES: The Fighters Guild recovered the Stone of Alessia? I didn't know it was lost. Is it magical or something?
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_INFOGENERAL_00032e27_Oblivion_RES: The Fighters Guild still gets a little work from old friends, but the Blackwood Company gets all the big contracts.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_INFOGENERAL_00032e4f_Oblivion_RES: The Fighters Guild thing at Desolate Mine went perfectly, didn't it? They cleared out the goblins, and no one got hurt.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_INFOGENERAL_0003dfa0_Oblivion_RES: The Five Claws Lodge is a nice, clean place. Witseidutsei makes sure of it.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_LeyawiinNQDResponses_0003de4f_Obl: The Five Claws is a very clean place. Witseidutsei wouldn't have it any other way.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_TenetsTopic_000272ae_Oblivion_RES: The Five Tenets are as follows:
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_PurificationTopic_0002fd9c_Oblivi: The Five Tenets are the laws that guide and protect us. But, sometimes, even they must be broken to protect the sanctity of our beliefs.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_SEDementiaRumorResponses_000614a9: The Flame being re-lit is a good sign.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_SE06FlameAgnon_00012cc8_Oblivion_: The Flame is fed from the Altar of Rapture and the Altar of Despair. Only servants of Sheogorath can kindle the Altars.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_SE06GreetB1_0003e6b7_Oblivion_RES: The Flame is lit from the Shrine's two Altars. Once the Aureals are driven out of Cylarne, it will be our pleasure to light the Flame for Sheogorath.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_SE06FlameAgnon_0003e6af_Oblivion_: The Flame is only lit at the command of Sheogorath, from the Altars of Rapture and Despair within the Shrine itself.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_SEFlameofAgnonTopic_00019ad0_Obli: The Flame of Agnon can only be lit by the immortal servants of Sheogorath: the Golden Saints and Dark Seducers of His creation.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_HELLO_0008e659_Oblivion_RESP1: The Flame of Agnon! Sheogorath's blessing upon you!
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_SE06UlfriFinalC_000400e2_Oblivion: The Flame will be lit, by my Lord's command, not yours.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_BloatedFloat_00015726_Oblivion_RE: The Float has three decks. This deck is the inn deck, the next level up is the tavern deck and then there's the top deck.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GOODBYE_0003d4d8_Oblivion_RESP1: The Flowing Bowl attracts the worst Anvil has to offer. Always be on your guard.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_SE12FontofMadness_00017272_Oblivi: The Font flows with the sap of the Tree of Madness, which it draws up from deep beneath the palace.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_SE12HaskillGreetA1_00016cfe_Obliv: The Font which is unaccountably covered with crystals.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_MQ15ForbiddenGrotto_00047360_Obli: The Forbidden Grotto is the only way out of the Savage Garden.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GREETING_00078784_Oblivion_RESP1: The Fork for Big Head. Oh, where has Master put the Fork? It sings alone. Far from home. Sad, sad Fork. Sad, sad Big-Head.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GREETING_0007877e_Oblivion_RESP1: The Fork! Songs of bringing? The Fork for Big-Head?
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_SE45ForkTopic_00078789_Oblivion_R: The Fork! The precious, precious fork! Hear how it sings to Big-Head! Beautiful, perfect Fork of Horripilation!
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_SE12FontofMadness_00017272_Oblivi: The Fountainhead leads down to the Pools of Dementia and Mania, where the insanity of the Realm's inhabitants settles.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_INFOGENERAL_0005ef04_Oblivion_RES: The Fringe attacked? This may be our last day alive. Let's make the most of it.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_INFOGENERAL_0005ef82_Oblivion_RES: The Fringe can fend for itself. We have our own problems.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_INFOGENERAL_0005ef08_Oblivion_RES: The Fringe gone. We're next. I'm sure of it.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_INFOGENERAL_0005ef2c_Oblivion_RES: The Fringe has been attacked. I'm more than willing to help find out who's responsible.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_INFOGENERAL_0005ef1a_Oblivion_RES: The Fringe has been destroyed. Who knows what could happen next? I'll have to work quickly to get my affairs in order.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_INFOGENERAL_0005ef1b_Oblivion_RES: The Fringe has been laid to waste! I do hope none of my poor children were caught up in it.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GREETING_00045d2c_Oblivion_RESP1: The Fringe is outside Lord Sheogorath's mercy... but not his justice.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_INFOGENERAL_0005ef6e_Oblivion_RES: The Fringe is under attack! Probably a cat conspiracy.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_INFOGENERAL_0005effc_Oblivion_RES: The Fringe was destroyed! Did you hear? Gone. Everything turned to dust! You don't think that could happen here, do you?
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_SE09HaskillGardens_0004036f_Obliv: The Gardens are in the Fringe, near Passwall. Beware, Your Grace. Creatures of the sorceress' doing and undoing haunt those tunnels.
The Gardens of Flesh and Bone are where Sorceress Verenim lived and worked for many years.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_INFOGENERAL_000434ac_Oblivion_RES: The Gatekeeper dead. Can the rest of us be far behind?
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_SEManiaRumorResponses_000613f7_Ob: The Gatekeeper dead. I didn't think it possible.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_INFOGENERAL_000434ba_Oblivion_RES: The Gatekeeper dead. Let's drink to the Gatekeeper!
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_SEWildernessRumorResponses_000614: The Gatekeeper dead. That concerns me.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_INFOGENERAL_0005f1f0_Oblivion_RES: The Gatekeeper has been reborn. I wonder if there are pieces left over....
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_INFOGENERAL_0005f1ed_Oblivion_RES: The Gatekeeper has been rebuilt, which means the Realm is a little safer for now.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_INFOGENERAL_0005f1f6_Oblivion_RES: The Gatekeeper has been rebuilt. I wonder if I could get a little piece of the old one.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_INFOGENERAL_000434e0_Oblivion_RES: The Gatekeeper has been slain. I bet he died of a disease. I hope someone takes care of his corpse. Can you imagine how disgusting that will be?
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_INFOGENERAL_000434b4_Oblivion_RES: The Gatekeeper has been slain. That calls for a bit of Skooma, don't you think? I need a fix of Skooma! Please! You got some Skooma?
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_INFOGENERAL_000434c4_Oblivion_RES: The Gatekeeper has died. Wonder what got him. Collywobbles? Greenspore?
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_INFOGENERAL_0005f1f5_Oblivion_RES: The Gatekeeper has returned to its former glory... Arden-Sul blesses us once more.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_INFOGENERAL_000434b1_Oblivion_RES: The Gatekeeper is dead, you know. Now, that was a truly ugly creature. Perhaps now a handsome adventurer will come to steal me away.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_INFOGENERAL_00043503_Oblivion_RES: The Gatekeeper is dead. Did you kill him? You've got awfully sharp looking teeth. Don't eat me. Please!
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_INFOGENERAL_000434f2_Oblivion_RES: The Gatekeeper is dead. He's got really big bones.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_INFOGENERAL_000434e6_Oblivion_RES: The Gatekeeper is dead. Just great. Who's going to protect us now? I sure hope I don't have to move. I hate moving. It's depressing.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_INFOGENERAL_000434bf_Oblivion_RES: The Gatekeeper is dead. One more sign that the Realm is being run into the ground. This never should've happened.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_INFOGENERAL_000434cd_Oblivion_RES: The Gatekeeper is dead? Who will keep out the cats? They'll be everywhere!
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_SE02Gatekeeper_0008e553_Oblivion_: The Gatekeeper is my child, the consummation of Sheogorath's wisdom in the womb of my genius. It was a painful and bloody birth, but well worth it.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_INFOGENERAL_000434ad_Oblivion_RES: The Gatekeeper is no more. The Fork is missing. These are difficult times.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GREETING_00012f37_Oblivion_RESP1: The Gatekeeper is slain. Congratulations. The honor of taking the keys from his corpse is yours.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_INFOGENERAL_0005f210_Oblivion_RES: The Gatekeeper is still dead. That's fine. He never did anything useful, anyway.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_INFOGENERAL_0005f1ec_Oblivion_RES: The Gatekeeper protects us once again. But, can he protect us from the coming horror?
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_INFOGENERAL_000432cc_Oblivion_RES: The Gatekeeper should take care of anyone who doesn't belong.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_SE09HaskillGatekeeper_0004036a_Ob: The Gatekeeper stood guard over the Realm, keeping those not blessed by Sheogorath out... until you, Your Grace, slew him.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_SE03Xedilian_0006770c_Oblivion_RE: The Gatekeeper takes care of most of the unwanted, but he's dead. We'll have to remedy that soon, as well....
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_INFOGENERAL_0005f1e8_Oblivion_RES: The Gatekeeper walks again. He'll help keep Sheer-Meedish safe.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GREETING_00081da8_Oblivion_RESP1: The Gatekeeper walks again. This is good. Now maybe Relmyna will be in a better mood around here.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_INFOGENERAL_0005f218_Oblivion_RES: The Gatekeeper walks once more, but what good does that do me? Who knows what's already inside the Realm.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_INFOGENERAL_00043501_Oblivion_RES: The Gatekeeper was killed. Nobody asked me if I thought that was a good idea. Well, I do.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_INFOGENERAL_0005f212_Oblivion_RES: The Gatekeeper will keep out those adventurers again. Too bad. Some of them had exciting stories to tell.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_INFOGENERAL_000434bb_Oblivion_RES: The Gatekeeper's been killed, I hear. Now who knows what new faces I'll get a chance to mangle.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_INFOGENERAL_000434c3_Oblivion_RES: The Gatekeeper's been killed, you know. Uncle Leo is most distressed, but I'm thrilled. Can't wait to find out who's behind it.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_INFOGENERAL_000434ce_Oblivion_RES: The Gatekeeper's been killed. Now we're even more exposed to attack.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_INFOGENERAL_000434c8_Oblivion_RES: The Gatekeeper's been killed. This is only the first step; they'll be coming for me next.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_SE02Gatekeeper_000807a3_Oblivion_: The Gatekeeper's dead. As soon as you get one of those doors unlocked, we can go in. They're calling to me from in there.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_SE02Gatekeeper_000807a2_Oblivion_: The Gatekeeper's dead. He won't stop us from coming and going now.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_INFOGENERAL_000434fc_Oblivion_RES: The Gatekeeper's dead. I hope I get to help rebuild a new one.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_INFOGENERAL_000434ca_Oblivion_RES: The Gatekeeper's dead. Must have had some curse or weakness. There always is. Heroes kill monsters by exploiting a weakness.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_SE02Gatekeeper_0007eaa3_Oblivion_: The Gatekeeper's dead. Relmyna is very unhappy about that.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_INFOGENERAL_000434ab_Oblivion_RES: The Gatekeeper's dead? Probably got killed by the Gates of Madness falling down on his head.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_INFOGENERAL_0005f238_Oblivion_RES: The Gatekeeper's return can only mean one thing... time to begin a new painting of him.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_INFOGENERAL_000434af_Oblivion_RES: The Gatekeeper, dead! This could be the end for all of us!
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_NDGauntletsoftheCrusader_00002b19: The Gauntlets have been here far longer than any of us. I don't expect that to ever change.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_NDGauntletsoftheCrusader_00002b14: The Gauntlets were recovered by Sir Casimir. One of our few victories during our time. But then even our victories became our failure.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GREETING_00047672_Oblivion_RESP1: The Gilded Carafe, for all your alchemical needs. Claudette Perrick, service with a smile.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_INFOGENERAL_00049956_Oblivion_RES: The Gilded Carafe. A fine store with a terrible name.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_INFOGENERAL_00077c3d_Oblivion_RES: The Gnarl are strange creatures. Hit them with a fireball, and they get stronger, but they hate other elements even more.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_SE12GnarlTopic_0001a325_Oblivion_: The Gnarls can help you. Those that have not been poisoned may be able to reverse the spread of Order. Do not slay them heedlessly.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_SQ03Avenge_00189d07_Oblivion_RESP: The Goblins must have been watching me, as they knew right when to strike. I could hear Kayleen's screams from far away.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_SEManiaRumorResponses_0006178f_Ob: The Golden Saints will protect us.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_SE06GreetB1_0003e6b7_Oblivion_RES: The Grakedrig Ulfri will explain everything. You should speak to her at once.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GREETING_00022e8a_Oblivion_RESP1: The Gray Cowl is now yours. You are the new guildmaster of the Thieves Guild.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_TGGrayFox_0003c16f_Oblivion_RESP1: The Gray Fox and I are closer than brothers. We share a desire to remain unknown.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_HELLO_00071f6e_Oblivion_RESP1: The Gray Fox appreciates all you've done for the guild.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_StealNoCrime_0009838a_Oblivion_RE: The Gray Fox dares to steal from Fathis Aren?
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_TG08MethredhelDeliverMsg_00014700: The Gray Fox has a task for you. Meet him at Helvius Cecia's house in Bruma.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_TG09AmuseiDeliverMsg_00014824_Obl: The Gray Fox has a task for you. Meet him at Malintus Ancus' house in Chorrol.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_TG02TaxesTopic_0003fd45_Oblivion_: The Gray Fox has always guaranteed protection to the poor of the waterfront. He doesn't want to let this injustice stand. It's a matter of principle.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_TGSpecialJobs_0001ee44_Oblivion_R: The Gray Fox has asked me to take care of a problem, and I'm putting you on it.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GuardTalk1_0006fdd1_Oblivion_RESP: The Gray Fox has been spotted! Some of the men gave chase, but he eluded them. Don't worry, we'll bring that scoundrel in, no matter what it takes!
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_TG02GrayFoxCare_0003fd47_Oblivion: The Gray Fox has led our guild for over 300 years now. He has always guaranteed protection to the poor of the waterfront.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_TG02WhoIsLex_0003fd46_Oblivion_RE: The Gray Fox has led our guild for over 300 years now. He has always guaranteed protection to the poor of the waterfront.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_TGSpecialJobs_00014709_Oblivion_R: The Gray Fox himself may call on you soon, though. Wait for contact from him. Keep the guild fences busy. You can find your own work.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_HELLO_000982db_Oblivion_RESP1: The Gray Fox is hiding nearby. What do you know about him?
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GREETING_000982de_Oblivion_RESP1: The Gray Fox is waiting for you.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_HELLO_000982be_Oblivion_RESP1: The Gray Fox is waiting for you.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_HELLO_000a9786_Oblivion_RESP1: The Gray Fox is waiting inside.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_TGSpecialJobs_0001ee3e_Oblivion_R: The Gray Fox is watching your career carefully. He may contact you soon with a special job.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_INFOGENERAL_00064452_Oblivion_RES: The Gray Fox made a fool of Hieronymus Lex. While half the Watch was in the Waterfront, thieves made off with half the rest of the city.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_TG10AmuseiDeliverMsg_0001530b_Obl: The Gray Fox requests a meeting. Please travel to Ganredhel's house in Cheydinhal.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_TG11AmuseiDeliverMsg_0001fb61_Obl: The Gray Fox requests a meeting. Please travel to Othrelo's house in the Imperial City Elven Gardens.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GREETING_0009f911_Oblivion_RESP1: The Gray Fox seems very anxious to see you. Go inside.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_INFOGENERAL_00064445_Oblivion_RES: The Gray Fox sounds like a dangerous thief.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_TG07WhatIsPlan_000983a1_Oblivion_: The Gray Fox wants this list replaced with one that highly recommends Hieronymus Lex. From Anvil he can do little harm to the guild.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_ArenaChampName10f_00038b38_Oblivi: The Gray Prince is headed up to the Arena as we speak. Go up there and meet him, one Champion to the next. May the Divines have mercy on your soul.
