ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_INFOGENERAL_0003e9a3_Oblivion_RES: The Gray Prince is nothing but a fake. Haven't you heard? His father was a vampire! He's no Orc. He's a monster. Someone should put him down.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GREETING_00037ff5_Oblivion_RESP3: The Gray Prince is the best fighter the Arena has ever seen. He can't be beaten. Not by you. But hey, it's your right.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_INFOGENERAL_0018bc89_Oblivion_RES: The Great Forest was cleared for agriculture around Lake Rumare, but it's mostly wilderness outside of that.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_MQ13BattlePlans_000276a9_Oblivion: The Great Gate will allow them to bring out the siege machine to blast the walls of Bruma, just like at Kvatch.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_lightthedragonfires_000223e4_Obli: The Great God of All made a covenant with St. Alessia. So long as a true heir ruled the Empire, the Great God swore to protect the Empire.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_ShrineofAzuraTOPIC_0001ebe3_Obliv: The Great Lady has spoken... to you alone. The moon and star shall be your guide.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_INFOGENERAL_000441e4_Oblivion_RES: The Great Torch burning again is a sign that things aren't completely hopeless. Means someone is doing something right.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_SEManiaRumorResponses_00061719_Ob: The Great Torch burning is a good sign for us all.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_INFOGENERAL_000441e0_Oblivion_RES: The Great Torch burns again. That'll boost spirits around here. A shame, really.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_INFOGENERAL_000441d6_Oblivion_RES: The Great Torch burns at a temperature 13 times hotter than the average fire.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_INFOGENERAL_0004421d_Oblivion_RES: The Great Torch burns once more -- a beacon of comfort that only serves to mock my existence.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_INFOGENERAL_000441e7_Oblivion_RES: The Great Torch burns once more! This is good news for Thadon, I hope.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_INFOGENERAL_000441e9_Oblivion_RES: The Great Torch burns once more. Perhaps there's hope for all. Except me. Can't shake this cold....
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_INFOGENERAL_00044220_Oblivion_RES: The Great Torch burns with such vibrant color. I should try and incorporate the hues in my next work.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GREETING_0004013d_Oblivion_RESP1: The Great Torch flares with the light of Dementia! All of Crucible will be celebrating tonight!
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_INFOGENERAL_00044207_Oblivion_RES: The Great Torch has been relit. I wonder if that's a good sign, or a bad sign?
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_INFOGENERAL_00044210_Oblivion_RES: The Great Torch in New Sheoth is lit. Should be easier to count the dead bodies that get dumped on the city street at night now.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_INFOGENERAL_0004421b_Oblivion_RES: The Great Torch is burning again! This calls for a celebration! You can spot me, right? Just a few gold?
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_INFOGENERAL_00044205_Oblivion_RES: The Great Torch is lit in the Sacellum Arden-Sul. Have you read the book about Arden-Sul? It's fascinating!
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_INFOGENERAL_00044217_Oblivion_RES: The Great Torch is lit in the city. Do you hear it? I do.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_INFOGENERAL_000441d4_Oblivion_RES: The Great Torch is lit once more. Maybe we might be safe here after all.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_INFOGENERAL_000441d9_Oblivion_RES: The Great Torch is lit! This calls for a celebration. Break out the Skooma! You brought the Skooma, right?
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_INFOGENERAL_000441d2_Oblivion_RES: The Great Torch is lit. A romantic symbol, isn't it? I always hoped my first kiss would be in the glow of a torch.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_INFOGENERAL_000441e1_Oblivion_RES: The Great Torch is on fire again. I wonder if someone might accidentally knock me into it. Do I look flammable to you? I hope I'm flammable.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_INFOGENERAL_00044204_Oblivion_RES: The Great Torch is out again! I bet you didn't know that!
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_HELLO_0008e65b_Oblivion_RESP1: The Great Torch shines as a beacon of Mania!
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_SE06GreatTorchTopic_000910a0_Obli: The Great Torch shines brightly above New Sheoth, a beacon of hope for all the citizens.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GREETING_00040140_Oblivion_RESP1: The Great Torch shines with the pure light of Mania! You chose well!
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_HELLO_0008e65c_Oblivion_RESP1: The Great Torch spreads the light of Dementia across the land!
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_INFOGENERAL_00044213_Oblivion_RES: The Great Torch, the Great Torch! Why's everyone bothering me about that? I've got a Great Torch for you, right here.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_SE07RitualYesM_000139af_Oblivion_: The Greenmote flowed like water in a stream as the revelers voraciously succumbed to its rapturous ways.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_SE07RitualYesM02_00013a67_Oblivio: The Greenmote had taken its toll. The ground stained a deep crimson as the sanguine liquid flowed from their lifeless bodies.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_INFOGENERAL_00025570_Oblivion_RES: The Grey Mare isn't a bad place to stay, especially if you're low on Septims.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_SE04SheoIntro2_00082460_Oblivion_: The Greymarch comes, and Jyggalag walks. Or runs. Never skips, sidles, or struts. Mostly, he just destroys everything around him.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_SE10GreymarchTopic_0009148c_Obliv: The Greymarch continues, and Lord Sheogorath believes you may be the key to stopping it. Do as he commands. The Realm depends on it.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_SE07TheFringeTopic_000912a2_Obliv: The Greymarch has swept the Fringe. Order gathers its forces there as we speak. And I hate when people gather forces in My Fringe.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_SE07TheFringeTopic_0009130c_Obliv: The Greymarch has swept the Fringe. Order gathers its forces there as we speak. And I hate when people gather forces in My Fringe.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_SheoIntroSpeech2_0005604a_Oblivio: The Greymarch is coming. And you're going to stop it.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_INFOGENERAL_000607a7_Oblivion_RES: The Greymarch is complete and the House of Mania still stands tall.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_INFOGENERAL_000607cc_Oblivion_RES: The Greymarch is over, the war has been won, but at what cost? This timeline will never be the same.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_INFOGENERAL_000607c0_Oblivion_RES: The Greymarch is over. At least I'll be able to sleep a little safer now.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_INFOGENERAL_0006079e_Oblivion_RES: The Greymarch is over. Sheogorath has defeated Jyggalag! The whole world almost collapsed on us! But it didn't!
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_SE07SheoIntro1_00082467_Oblivion_: The Greymarch is upon us, and the Ordering begins. Armies of Order sweep My Realm. Death. Destruction. Then I have to pick up the pieces.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_Attack_0001a36b_Oblivion_RESP1: The Greymarch is upon you, fool!
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_SE11Tree_0008f12b_Oblivion_RESP3: The Grove and the Tree retain a number of psychotropic properties that supposedly bring one to personal revelation.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_NDProphetSpeechMQ2_00002d1a_Knigh: The Guardians have fallen and no one remains to watch their charges, and all the heavens are now banquet for the Princes of Misrule!
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_advancementFG_0003570f_Oblivion_R: The Guild has passed me by. You are its future. Take your responsibilty seriously. I wish you luck. You still have many duties to perform.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_CheydinhalTopic_0004e8b5_Oblivion: The Guild is going to hell in a hogcart. Look at what they give me? Keld of the Isles? Ohtimbar? Both Guardian rank? Phah! Useless.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_INFOGENERAL_0018bc86_Oblivion_RES: The Heartlands and Nibenean Valley are the agricultural breadbaskets of Cyrodiil.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_SE04ObelisksTopic_00091059_Oblivi: The Hearts of Order found on Jyggalag's Knights can be placed in the obelisks. Adding enough can cause the obelisk to become overloaded with power.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_INFOGENERAL_0008db8e_Oblivion_RES: The Heretic is a misguided man whose belief has gone astray. Steal a robe from their back and among them you can stay.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_SECreatureResponses_0008e137_Obli: The Heretic is a misguided man whose belief has gone astray. Steal a robe from their back and among them you can stay.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_SE06DerveninGreetA_000400e4_Obliv: The Hero who lights the Great Torch for Mania is traditionally awarded the Raiment of Arden-Sul. Not that this should influence your choice at all.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_contract_0002f87e_Oblivion_RESP1: The High Elf Faelian lives in the Imperial City, and fancies long walks. Speak with your fellow family members. They may offer their insights.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GREETING_000008d2_Oblivion_RESP1: The High Elf Faelian now swims in the maelstrom of darkness at the feet of our Dread Father, Sithis. And, there were no witnesses to your handiwork.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GREETING_0002ff08_Oblivion_RESP1: The High Elf Faelian now swims in the maelstrom of darkness at the feet of our Dread Father, Sithis. And, there were no witnesses to your handiwork.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_MS22Mission_0002af34_Oblivion_RES: The High Fane dates from the Late Ayleid Period, following the fall of White Gold Tower, a very troubled time for that ancient people.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_INFOGENERAL_0008da9c_Oblivion_RES: The Honorblade has been returned to the Castle after all these years! This is certainly a good omen.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_SE11HowlingHalls_00043f73_Oblivio: The Howling Halls are home to Ciirta's "Apostles of the Light," or whatever it is that they're calling themselves these days.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GREETING_0001a80a_Oblivion_RESP1: The Howling Halls, is it? It's been some time since I last saw this place.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_INFOGENERAL_00077c47_Oblivion_RES: The Hunger is one of Lord Sheogorath's favorite pets.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_INFOGENERAL_0018bcb0_Oblivion_RES: The Imperial City is densely urbanized, with a few large parks and waterside dock areas.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_INFOGENERAL_0018bcaf_Oblivion_RES: The Imperial City is located on a large island surrounded by Lake Rumare.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_INFOGENERAL_0018bcb1_Oblivion_RES: The Imperial City itself is a walled city, with separate inner walls protecting the Imperial palace.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_ArcaneUniversityTopic_000473ed_Ob: The Imperial City just wouldn't be the same without it. Maybe, some day, if you know the right people, you might get a chance to see it.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GREETING_0006fdc5_Oblivion_RESP1: The Imperial Legion is at your disposal, citizen. What seems to be the problem?
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_DirectionsLandmarks_0018bda5_Obli: The Imperial Palace is at the center. The six districts are arranged around the Palace like spokes of a wheel.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_contract_000251c4_Oblivion_RESP1: The Imperial Prison! Long did I languish there, in my youth, before the Brotherhood found me.  The guards are strong and cruel. So very cruel....
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GREETING_00098378_Oblivion_RESP1: The Imperial Watch has imposed a curfew. We have to remain in our homes until they catch the Gray Fox.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_HELLO_000363e3_Oblivion_RESP1: The Imperial Watch is asking around for anyone that might have seen Audens Avidius. He's escaped from prison!
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_INFOGENERAL_00064447_Oblivion_RES: The Imperial Watch seems awfully worried about the Gray Fox. Look at all those wanted posters.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_Covenant_0002d77b_Oblivion_RESP1: The Imperial line is dead, and the gods have forsaken us.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_CheydinhalTopic_0004e88b_Oblivion: The Imperials have the gold, houses, and top spots. Dark Elves like me left Morrowind and the whole priest-ridden Tribunal nightmare...
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_BrinaCrossInnTopic_0002fd6a_Obliv: The Inn lies north of Anvil. Speak with Arielle Jurard when you arrive. She will give you further instructions.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_SE05Conspiracy_000895e0_Oblivion_: The Inquisitor is now required to be secretive? Consider that Herdir's presence may be a detriment to you.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_SE05Conspiracy_00089604_Oblivion_: The Inquisitor now has significant evidence pointing towards Muurine. Perhaps a talk with her is in order.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_ArenaChampName10f_00038b38_Oblivi: The Iron Maiden, huh? I like it! Yeah, that'll do nicely. All right, it's time to see if you're crazy good or just plain crazy.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_SEShiveringIslesTOPIC_00078cac_Ob: The Isles, the Isles. A wonderful place! Except when it's horrible. Then it's horribly wonderful. Good for a visit. Or for an eternity.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_DirectionsSleep_0018bd94_Oblivion: The Jerall View is on the terraces, near the castle gate and facing the chapel. Olav's is next to the east gate.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_INFOGENERAL_000498a6_Oblivion_RES: The King and Queen Tavern isn't a bad place to stay if you're visiting the city.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_ICAllNQDResponses_000498a1_Oblivi: The King and Queen is a fine place, and it's much more reasonable than other places in town.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_ICAllNQDQuestionResponses_000498a: The King and Queen is a nice place. The Marillins treat everyone well.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_LeyawiinTopic_000478a6_Oblivion_R: The King is the Key, and the Hand guards the King.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GREETING_0000a0fb_Oblivion_RESP2: The King of Worms has obviously targeted the guild, but we have no idea why. No demands have been made.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_KingofWormsTopic_0000a0fe_Oblivio: The King of Worms stood over him, right before he died, and he... well, it looked like he sucked out Volanaro's soul!
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_SE08CommanderGreeting1_00018702_O: The Knights are relentless. They do not tire. They do not fear. And they do not stop coming.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_SE08CommanderGreeting1_00018c81_O: The Knights are relentless. They do not tire. They do not fear. And they do not stop coming.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_SE08KnightsTopic_0001ec1a_Oblivio: The Knights are relentless. We are the only thing standing between them and the total destruction of the Fringe.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_SE08KnightsTopic_0001ec1b_Oblivio: The Knights are relentless. We are the only thing standing between them and the total destruction of the Fringe.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GREETING_00040b78_Oblivion_RESP1: The Knights are sure to attack again.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_SE08KnightsTopic_00018c7c_Oblivio: The Knights began arriving shortly after the spire activated. They seem to have no interest in pushing us back, only in killing those who resist.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_INFOGENERAL_0005ef8c_Oblivion_RES: The Knights have returned with a vengeance, their blades stained with blood. Who will be able to stop them, to stem this deadly flood?
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_INFOGENERAL_0005ef6f_Oblivion_RES: The Knights of Order are here to protect us.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_INFOGENERAL_0005eed6_Oblivion_RES: The Knights of Order have returned as foretold. Arden-Sul save us!
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_INFOGENERAL_00002a1c_Knights_RESP: The Knights of the Nine are reforming! Can you believe it? My father used to tell me stories of the old knights when I was a lad.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_INFOGENERAL_00002a1d_Knights_RESP: The Knights of the Nine are reforming! Can you believe it? My father used to tell me stories of the old knights when I was a lass.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_Attack_00002a27_Knights_RESP1: The Knights of the Nine have come for you, foul beast!
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_NDKnightsTopic_00002bde_Knights_R: The Knights of the Nine have prevailed over Umaril. Truly, the gods have shown us favor.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_NDKnightsTopic_00002bd3_Knights_R: The Knights of the Nine stand together once again. I would not have thought it possible. We owe you a great debt.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_KnightsofThorn_00031c83_Oblivion_: The Knights of the Thorn are a bunch of rabble who fancy themselves true knights. Farwil formed the group around two years ago.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_HELLO_0003358b_Oblivion_RESP1: The Knights of the Thorn triumph once again!
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_INFOGENERAL_0018baad_Oblivion_RES: The Kvatch Oblivion Gate has been closed! Don't you understand what that means? We can beat the bastards!
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_SE04Audience_0001359b_Oblivion_RE: The Lady has refused any and all appointments of late. You'd have to try and find her on your own, and I don't recommend that course of action.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_LeyawiinTopic_000479ac_Oblivion_R: The Leyawiin chapter is just drifting along. Dagail isn't much of a mentor or leader. She isn't even coherent most of the time.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_BravilNQDResponses_00046582_Obliv: The Lonely Suitor certainly seems to be a source of great pride for him.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_INFOGENERAL_00046584_Oblivion_RES: The Lonely Suitor is a fine place. Bogrum gro-Galash is very focused on making it a success.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GREETING_00026a9f_Oblivion_RESP1: The Lord Bal has given you a task. Perform it well.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GREETING_0001ef77_Oblivion_RESP1: The Lord Hermaeus has set you on a new path. Follow it and return to him.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_SE13JyggalagVoice_00095ec4_Oblivi: The Lord of Order shall rule this Realm!
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_Attack_0004db78_Oblivion_RESP1: The Lord of Order will claim your throne!
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_INFOGENERAL_00060534_Oblivion_RES: The Mad One has vanished from the Isles, fear sits heavy on the brow. All our hopes go with one, but can he save us now?
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_HELLO_00081d65_Oblivion_RESP1: The Madgod Himself! Come to get some advice from me!
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GREETING_0006d17c_Oblivion_RESP1: The Madgod has given you a task. Surely, someone of your copious talent should be able to handle it.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_INFOGENERAL_0006050b_Oblivion_RES: The Madgod has vanished? Perhaps He simply stepped out of our time until the Greymarch passes.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_INFOGENERAL_000605ea_Oblivion_RES: The Madgod is gone. Can he die?
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_Attack_0001a375_Oblivion_RESP1: The Madgod is no match for my Lord Jyggalag!
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_INFOGENERAL_0005f461_Oblivion_RES: The Madgod's army has returned, their weapons primed to slay. Could this mean our downfall, or will we win the day?
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_DraconianMadstoneTopic_00018233_O: The Madstone appears as a snake coiled around and encircling itself. The eyes of the snake are supposed to be precious gems or some such.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_DraconianMadstoneTopic_0001822e_O: The Madstone awaits, and so does your reward if you retrieve it.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_DraconianMadstoneTopic_00018228_O: The Madstone is finally mine. It's the pinnacle of my collection. Many thanks to you again.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_INFOGENERAL_00062688_Oblivion_RES: The Mages Guild has been attacked by Necromancers. This proves they can't be trusted!
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_INFOGENERAL_0006c2a2_Oblivion_RES: The Mages Guild has made more than a few enemies since Necromancy was banned.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_DirectionsGuilds_0018bd9e_Oblivio: The Mages Guild is south of the chapel, by the west wall. The Fighters Guild is across the street from the Mages Guild.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_MagesGuildTopic_00062bbc_Oblivion: The Mages Guild is the single best resource for Alchemists in all of Cyrodiil. If Alchemy interests you, talk to Dagail about joining.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_ChorrolNQDResponses_00029fb8_Obli: The Mages Guild is, indeed, a fine organization.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_INFOGENERAL_0006c299_Oblivion_RES: The Mages Guild runs more or less like it always did, but we lost quite a few members when the practice of Necromancy was banned.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_INFOGENERAL_0001e06d_Oblivion_RES: The Mages Guild seems more disorganized than usual lately.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_ArcaneULecture4_00071958_Oblivion: The Mages Guild should fund further study of the early Imperial Legions, their battlemages, and their traditions of patrol and route-finding.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GREETING_0004e8a2_Oblivion_RESP1: The March Rider sells and repairs weapons and armor. Can I help you? I'm Tertia Viducia.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_contract_000251c6_Oblivion_RESP1: The Marie Elena, you say? I've seen that ship. There's a unique balcony at the stern. My guess is it leads to the captain's cabin. Could be useful.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_ICAllNQDResponses_000498a4_Oblivi: The Marillins say that they treat everyone like royalty at the King and Queen.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_Trespass_0002d932_Oblivion_RESP1: The Master doesn't like visitors. Leave this house. NOW.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GREETING_0002d923_Oblivion_RESP1: The Master doesn't like visitors. Leave this house. Now. If you're still here in twenty seconds, I will be forced to crush you.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_MehrunesDagonTopic_00097cc3_Obliv: The Master has promised us that the Time of Preparation is almost over! The Time of Cleansing is almost here!
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_MankarCamoranTopic_00097cc1_Obliv: The Master is preaching in the Shrine as we speak! Hurry, you should not miss the chance to hear the Master's words!
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_MankarCamoranTopic_00097cc2_Obliv: The Master knows the secret mind of Lord Dagon. He speaks with Him and teaches us from His holy book, the Mysterium Xarxes.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_HELLO_00088b3e_Oblivion_RESP1: The Master will call us back to Tamriel soon. I'm sure of it.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GOODBYE_000477fa_Oblivion_RESP1: The Master will soon deal with you.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_HELLO_000826d4_Oblivion_RESP1: The Mazken are unworthy to guard the Altar of Despair.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_SEAltarofDespairTopic_0007ff5f_Ob: The Mazken do not even allow us free passage to worship there, which is one of the many reasons why they are unfit to continue to guard it.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_HELLO_00080d8a_Oblivion_RESP1: The Mazken do not forget their friends.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_SENewSheothTOPIC_00078ca5_Oblivio: The Mazken guard Crucible in New Sheoth. We ensure the Demented remain orderly and respectful of our Lord Sheogorath.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_HELLO_00080d8f_Oblivion_RESP1: The Mazken no longer defile holy Cylarne, thanks to you.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_DaedraShrineTopic_000a383d_Oblivi: The Mephala shrine is northeast of the junction of the Red Ring Road and the Silver Road.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_ArenaChampName7_00038b3c_Oblivion: The Messenger of Death, huh? I like it! Yeah, that'll do nicely. All right, it's time to see if you're crazy good or just plain crazy.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_HELLO_0018ae75_Oblivion_RESP1: The Moth Priests seem agitated today.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_MouthofthePanther_00036601_Oblivi: The Mouth of the Panther is what they call the delta where the Panther River meets Niben Bay.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_HELLO_00038bbc_Oblivion_RESP1: The Mysterium Xarxes is the most dangerous daedric sorcery I've ever encountered.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_MagesGuildTopic_00062bd4_Oblivion: The Mystic Archives have a large collection of books. Look around, and you may learn a thing or two.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_MG11Choice1A_00002dcb_Oblivion_RE: The Mystic Archives have been consulted with minimal success. Guild members are investigating other avenues, but I believe more can be learned here.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_INFOGENERAL_00014d92_AltarDeluxe_: The Mythic Dawn have been leaving notes in Talos Plaza. I hope no one believes their lies.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_INFOGENERAL_0018baaf_Oblivion_RES: The Mythic Dawn murdered the Emperor and led those damn Daedra right into the heart of the Empire! They'll pay for their treachery!
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_INFOGENERAL_0006234a_Oblivion_RES: The Mythic Dawn will never take Cloud Ruler Temple. Not while any Blade still draws breath.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GREETING_00058e03_Oblivion_RESP1: The Mythic Dawn won't dare try anything now that the best soldiers in Cyrodiil are defending Bruma!
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_BladesTalk2_0018d7ec_Oblivion_RES: The Mythic Dawn. What do we really know about them? How far into the Empire have they infiltrated? They could have sympathizers... and spies.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_MQ05GwinasA3_00022b57_Oblivion_RE: The Mythic Dawn? Are you... I mean, I don't know what you're talking about! I don't know anything about any cult.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_MQ05GwinasB5_0009532c_Oblivion_RE: The Mythic Dawn? Are you... I mean, I don't know what you're talking about! I don't know anything about any cult.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GREETING_0000c08d_Oblivion_RESP4: The Necromancer's Amulet and the Bloodworm Helm have been taken.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_information_00009224_Oblivion_RES: The Necromancers are a sign of things to come. An old acquaintance of the guild has come to Cyrodiil, and they are answering his call.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_INFOGENERAL_0018bcb3_Oblivion_RES: The Nibenay Basin grades from rolling farmlands by the river east to the rugged uplands of the Valus Mountains.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_INFOGENERAL_0018bca7_Oblivion_RES: The Nibeneans think they're slick. 'Slippery' is more like it.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_Dark04Choice1B_00025275_Oblivion_: The Night Mo.... No! No! Guards! Guards! Help me! Somebody help! Assassin!
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_NightMother_000251f2_Oblivion_RES: The Night Mother is the Dark Brotherhood's Unholy Matron. She guides our actions, just as the Dread Father Sithis once guided hers.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_NightMother_0000567a_Oblivion_RES: The Night Mother must be awakened, so that we may seek her guidance. Are you ready to travel now to her resting place?
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_NightMother_000251f0_Oblivion_RES: The Night Mother speaks to only one member of the Dark Brotherhood -- the Listener of the Black Hand. And when Our Lady speaks, death follows.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_Attack_00090cba_Oblivion_RESP1: The Night Mother will fall by my hand! Her spirit will haunt my nightmares no longer!
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GREETING_00090798_Oblivion_RESP1: The Night Mother wishes for you to take some time to consider your new position. We will speak when we are back in the Sanctuary.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_Dark03Choice1B_00023f3f_Oblivion_: The Night Mother? What's this all about? I... I think you should leave now. You hear me? Get out! Gromm! Gromm! we have an intruder!
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_INFOGENERAL_000ace64_Oblivion_RES: The Nine Divines are boring. Daedra? They're never boring.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_NDTalkRelicsBoots_00002c64_Knight: The Nine be praised! Imagine, the very boots with which Pelinal Whitestrake once walked the earth! I must go and tell the others.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GREETING_00002965_Knights_RESP1: The Nine have given so much to us, and I take time to thank them for it.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GREETING_00002941_Knights_RESP1: The Nine preserve us! These Aurorans will slaughter us all!
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_ImperialCityTopic_00047707_Oblivi: The Nine say each of us is special, but that's just a lie. I don't mind, but it just sounds stupid.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GREETING_0003c990_Oblivion_RESP1: The Nine welcome you to Bruma. I'm Isa Raman, priestess of Talos.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_NelsTheNaughtyTopic_00028cda_Obli: The Nord has been murdered. Maybe I'll get lucky and the same thing will happen to you. Unless, of course, you're the one who did it....
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_CurrentEventsResponses_00025859_O: The Nords have always been protective of their territory. It's no wonder they get involved in these disputes.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_DirectionsSleep_0018bd9b_Oblivion: The Oak and Crosier and the Grey Mare are near the gate and fountain.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_INFOGENERAL_00025573_Oblivion_RES: The Oak and Crosier is a nice place, but that Talasma seems rather stuck-up to me.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_ChorrolTopic_0002a69e_Oblivion_RE: The Oak and Crosier is the place of choice for well-bred visitors to Chorrol. The Grey Mare is more suitable for... others.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_DragonfiresTopic_00037834_Oblivio: The Oblivion Gates will close, and Mehrunes Dagon's invasion will have failed.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_NDKnightsTopic_00002bdf_Knights_R: The Order lives once more. Pelinal himself would be proud of what we've accomplished.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GREETING_00070228_Oblivion_RESP1: The Order of the Black Worm will feast on your soul, mortal.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_ND10SirAmielSpeech03_00002cc4_Kni: The Order shall serve as the sword and the shield of the Nine in the dark times to come.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_HorseInquiry_00053235_Oblivion_RE: The Paint horses of Leyawiin are the least expensive in all of Cyrodiil! You can't get a better bargain.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_HELLO_0004bf9d_Oblivion_RESP1: The Palace is cut off, sire. We were the last to make it through from the Legion Compound.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_SE44PantsTopic_00078737_Oblivion_: The Pants! The Calming Pants! Finally! These Pants are key to my survival.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_INFOGENERAL_00043edf_Oblivion_RES: The Paranoid Duchess is at it again, from what I hear. If you ask me, we could do for a little more law and order around here, too.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_MQ05RavenSpeech_00022da6_Oblivion: The Path of Dawn is difficult. But the rewards are great.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_DASheogorathChoice5_00026af7_Obli: The Plague of Fear. I will not speak of this. Not to any outsider. I'll answer anything else I can. Is there something more?
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_SE06ObelisksTopic_000910fb_Oblivi: The Priests of Order are the key. They summon the Knights at the obelisks.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GREETING_0001e6fd_Oblivion_RESP2: The Prince of Destruction awakes, born anew in blood and fire. These cutthroats are but his mortal pawns.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_MQ02JauffreD1_00092d85_Oblivion_R: The Prince of Destruction he referred to is none other than Mehrunes Dagon, one of the lords of the demonic world of Oblivion.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_MQ02JauffreD2_00092d86_Oblivion_R: The Prince of Destruction, Mehrunes Dagon, is one of the lords of Oblivion.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_MQ15MankarRant_0008c224_Oblivion_: The Principalities have sparkled as gems in the black reaches of Oblivion since the First Morning.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GREETING_00002977_Knights_RESP4: The Prophet has arrived. He is preaching to the assembled Knights in the Chapel. You should speak to him at once.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_NDChapelAttackTopic_00002b97_Knig: The Prophet speaks true. This is the start of something terrible, I can feel it in my bones.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_PurificationTopic_0002fd9c_Oblivi: The Purification is one of the most extreme measures we are forced to carry out. Indeed, it has only been carried out twice. Before now, that is.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_INFOGENERAL_000607ba_Oblivion_RES: The Realm is a safe haven for all my hatchlings once more. If only I could get them to appreciate me.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_SE13JyggalagVoice_00096052_Oblivi: The Realm of Madness is mine!
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_BravilTopic_00048906_Oblivion_RES: The Renrijra Krin are Khajiit bandits and smugglers posing as guerillas and freedom fighters.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_INFOGENERAL_000434ef_Oblivion_RES: The Resonator draws adventurers to it once again. I suppose they won't need their belongings.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_INFOGENERAL_000434d1_Oblivion_RES: The Resonator has been reactivated, and the Isles are no longer open to invasion. Arden-Sul works in mysterious ways.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_INFOGENERAL_000434d0_Oblivion_RES: The Resonator has been reactivated. Why, if not to protect us from the coming storm?
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_INFOGENERAL_000434f4_Oblivion_RES: The Resonator is active once again? Perhaps it will draw the disease from my body.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_INFOGENERAL_00043521_Oblivion_RES: The Resonator is attracting again. Aren't you a cute little thing? Do you want me to scratch behind your ears?
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_INFOGENERAL_000434d9_Oblivion_RES: The Resonator is fixed again. What a shame. I looked forward to meeting new people. They always have such nice things.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_INFOGENERAL_00043506_Oblivion_RES: The Resonator is still broken. It never worked. And it never will.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_INFOGENERAL_000434f5_Oblivion_RES: The Resonator is working again, I understand. I do hope it doesn't confuse any of my brood, returning to me after all these years.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_INFOGENERAL_00043507_Oblivion_RES: The Resonator of Judgment is back on. I read about that somewhere. It helps keep the Realm clean of vagrants and ne'er-do-wells.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_INFOGENERAL_000434e2_Oblivion_RES: The Resonator of Judgment is fixed! How horrid! New adventurers mean new exhibits!
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_INFOGENERAL_0004350b_Oblivion_RES: The Resonator of Judgment is working again. I guess, since the Gatekeeper's dead now, that's a good thing.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_INFOGENERAL_000434cc_Oblivion_RES: The Resonator of Judgment sings again! Singing, singing!
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_INFOGENERAL_0004350f_Oblivion_RES: The Resonator sings again, drawing strangers near. Protecting us, our lives, our homes, and all that we hold dear.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_INFOGENERAL_000434e9_Oblivion_RES: The Resonator sings its sweet song once more. Promises of riches and fame, fulfilled with death and madness. How delightful.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_INFOGENERAL_000434eb_Oblivion_RES: The Resonator was my idea, you know. People never remember that, but it was. I'm glad it's working again.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_SE03AResonatorofJudgmentT_00018df: The Resonator works by drawing adventurers to itself with a sort of magical "siren's call".
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_SEManiaRumorResponses_00061424_Ob: The Resonator? Maybe it'll keep strangers out of Bliss.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_SE44RingTopic_00078739_Oblivion_R: The Ring of Desiccation! Perfect. It does everything I need it to. A wondrous piece of craftsmanship!
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_SE38TalkItem11_00082428_Oblivion_: The Ring of Disrobing -- removes your clothes if you put it on. Now, don't you go trying it! I have enough Oddities on display already, hahaha.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_INFOGENERAL_000441f5_Oblivion_RES: The Ritual is complete. Arden-Sul's will is done.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_INFOGENERAL_0005ed4f_Oblivion_RES: The Ritual is complete. Arden-Sul's will is done.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_INFOGENERAL_000441f2_Oblivion_RES: The Ritual is completed, and a new ruler presides over Dementia.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_contract_000039de_Oblivion_RESP1: The Rose of Sithis! Such an honor! Just make sure your marksmanship is up to the task. If you miss the target, the enchantment will be wasted.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_contract_000039e0_Oblivion_RESP1: The Rose will only work if Phillida is unarmored. So, when would a soldier not wear his armor? I only take my armor off to sleep or swim...
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_SQ09Scales_00068851_Oblivion_RESP: The Rumare slaughterfish are a special breed -- nastier than the regular kind. They have a spawning pool nearby, so this area is lousy with 'em.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_SEManiaRumorResponses_00061c66_Ob: The Saints and Seducers will protect us.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_HELLO_0008fa95_Oblivion_RESP1: The Saints stand strong, Your Grace.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_MQ09ArmorTopic_00026d6e_Oblivion_: The Septim blood may flow through my veins, but you have the soul of a hero. The Armor of Tiber Septim himself! Jauffre will be amazed to see it.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_NDShieldoftheCrusader_00002af1_Kn: The Shield is safeguarded within Fort Bulwark. It is protected, and care must be taken when attempting to find it.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_NDTalkRelics2_00002c6f_Knights_RE: The Shield, sir knight! The Commander braved the tests of Fort Bulwark and returned with the Shield of the Crusader!
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_SEShiveringIslesTOPIC_00078ca8_Ob: The Shivering Isles are a reflection of our Lord Sheogorath. Divided, yet perfect.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_SE11DyusChoice1_00019ccf_Oblivion: The Shivering Isles hold many secrets but few remain unseen by mortal eyes.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_SEShiveringIslesTOPIC_0009101a_Ob: The Shivering Isles is what Sheogorath wills it to be.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_ImperialCityTopic_000476b3_Oblivi: The Sintav clan is very close. We watch out for each other, and Uncle Iniel, he knows everything, and takes care of us.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_ImperialCityTopic_00047687_Oblivi: The Sintavs have always been one of the leading families in the City. We will refrain from contact with the Atius, unless provoked.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GottlesfontPrioryTopic_000ace82_O: The Sisters of Gottlesfont gather Steel Blue Entoloma and Lady's Mantle Leaves. Take what you need, and you're welcome to gather mushrooms nearby.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_Gelebourne_00038439_Oblivion_RESP: The Skingrad city watch informed us that Gelebourne was killed by Raynil not too long ago. Gelebourne was a vampire as well, obviously.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_ThoronirTopic_0001e83a_Oblivion_R: The Society triumphs once more! Thanks to you, of course.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GREETING_00014d86_AltarDeluxe_RES: The Sovereign of Destruction offers you equipment befitting someone as bloodthirsty as yourself.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GREETING_00014d88_AltarDeluxe_RES: The Sovereign of Destruction offers you equipment befitting someone as bloodthirsty as yourself.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GREETING_00014d8a_AltarDeluxe_RES: The Sovereign of Destruction offers you equipment befitting someone as bloodthirsty as yourself.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_ArenaChampName1_00038b42_Oblivion: The Spellslinger, huh? I like it! Yeah, that'll do nicely. All right, it's time to see if you're crazy good or just plain crazy.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_SE11DyusChoice1_00019ccf_Oblivion: The Staff is a tool of great vision and thus, requires the eye of one who has witnessed one of these unseen secrets firsthand.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_SE11HaskillChoice5_00014b62_Obliv: The Staff is the symbol of power in this Realm. He who rightfully holds the Staff may hold the throne of the Shivering Isles.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_SE11DyusChoice3_00019cd0_Oblivion: The Staff may allow you to occupy the Throne of Madness, but understand that such a feat has never been attempted.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_MS13StaffofIndarys_00031c97_Obliv: The Staff of Indarys it is. Again, I thank you on behalf of all the citizens of Cheydinhal, and I especially thank you as an elated father.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_SE11StaffOfSheogorath_00014b54_Ob: The Staff of Sheogorath contains a portion of the divine power of the Daedric Prince. It is the embodiment of Sheogorath and of this land.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_SE11Eye_00014b5d_Oblivion_RESP1: The Staff of Sheogorath holds the secrets of this Realm.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_SE11Eye_00016ec7_Oblivion_RESP1: The Staff of Sheogorath holds the secrets of this Realm.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_SE11Eye_00016ef6_Oblivion_RESP1: The Staff of Sheogorath holds the secrets of this Realm.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_SkingradNQDResponses_0003c226_Obl: The Surilie Brothers wine is some of the best in Tamriel, if you ask me.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_DavideSurilieTopic_0002366c_Obliv: The Surilie house is right next door to mine. A large house with a backyard conveniently located to observe my every move.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_INFOGENERAL_00002a0f_Knights_RESP: The Sword of the Crusader has been seen again! They say that no evil can withstand the holy sword wielded by a true knight.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_NDSwordTopic_00002bef_Knights_RES: The Sword was originally created by Arkay, according to legend. Perhaps it could be reconsecrated upon the altar of his Chapel?
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_ArenaChampName11_00038b44_Oblivio: The Tamriel Terror, huh? I like it! Yeah, that'll do nicely. All right, it's time to see if you're crazy good or just plain crazy.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_INFOGENERAL_00046580_Oblivion_RES: The Tap and Tack is a good place to get a quick bite, and Olav is a good man.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GarridansTears_00022e60_Oblivion_: The Tears are not just a namesake. They're literally the frozen tears of a knight named Garridan Stalrous who lived many years ago.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GarridansTears_00022e58_Oblivion_: The Tears are small crystals, bluish in appearance. Quite beautiful I'd imagine.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GOODBYE_0014c72f_Oblivion_RESP1: The Tears look beautiful in my collection. A thousand thanks once again.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_ImperialCityTopic_00047738_Oblivi: The Temple District is by far the most desirable address in the city. Why? Because I live here, of course. Don't you agree?
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_NDProphetSpeechMQ2_00002d18_Knigh: The Thief has found the lock that he cannot break! The Warrior, the foe that cannot fall! The Wizard, an incantation that takes not to his tongue!
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_TG01Armand1_0005143a_Oblivion_RES: The Thieves Guild is not a myth. We are followers of the Gray Fox, and I am his Doyen. Merely by finding me, you have passed the first test.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_TG04AmuseiStory_0000c05a_Oblivion: The Thieves Guild refused to take me, so I came here. Leyawiin is my home. It is where I was raised.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_MS13ThornbladeTopic_00031c96_Obli: The Thornblade it is. Again, I thank you on behalf of all the citizens of Cheydinhal, and I especially thank you as an elated father.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_INFOGENERAL_0003dfa2_Oblivion_RES: The Three Sisters Inn is a nice place, but that Shuravi sure is grumpy. I don't think she likes anyone.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_INFOGENERAL_000498d7_Oblivion_RES: The Tiber Septim Hotel is a nice place. It's not cheap, though.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_ImperialCityTopic_000476c3_Oblivi: The Tiber Septim Hotel is clean, comfortable, and quite exclusive. I don't mind paying a little extra for a little privacy.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_ImperialCityTopic_000476e0_Oblivi: The Tiber Septim Hotel is very nice, but very expensive. There's the Bloated Float at the Waterfront. Sleep on a boat. And cheap, too.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_DEAkTimeWound_00014e28_AltarDelux: The Time Wound has not fully opened yet.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_INFOGENERAL_000441e3_Oblivion_RES: The Torch alight! There's hope for us all.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_INFOGENERAL_000441ec_Oblivion_RES: The Torch burns again. This can't bode well.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_INFOGENERAL_000441d7_Oblivion_RES: The Torch burns brightly again. Like my love for dear Sheer-Meedish.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_INFOGENERAL_000441d1_Oblivion_RES: The Torch extinguished and relit? This does not bode well.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_INFOGENERAL_000441d8_Oblivion_RES: The Torch is relit. Wonderful. Just makes it a bit tougher to sneak around.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_INFOGENERAL_00044218_Oblivion_RES: The Torch lights the city once again. Fat lot of good it does those of use working out here.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_SEDementiaRumorResponses_000614aa: The Torch once again casts its light on Crucible.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_SEWildernessRumorResponses_000617: The Torch only matters to those in New Sheoth.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_INFOGENERAL_000441cf_Oblivion_RES: The Torch relit! It sings of things returned!
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_SEManiaRumorResponses_0006166f_Ob: The Torch shines brightly over Bliss.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_LeyawiinTopic_000478a6_Oblivion_R: The Tower guards the Gate, but the Gate holds the Key.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_SkingradNQDResponses_0003c18b_Obl: The Two Sisters is a fine place, and the two sisters themselves are nice people, too.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GREETING_0009db24_Oblivion_RESP1: The Ulfgars are all dead. Whatever possessed them to attack us like that?
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_MQ09GhostB_00036666_Oblivion_RESP: The Underking defeated and ensnared us in his evil enchantment, and bound us here to guard forever the defiled Shrine of Tiber Septim.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_NDProphetSpeechUmaril2_00002d0c_K: The Unfeathered has come during the Breaking of Gates!
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_ImperialCityTopic_0004769b_Oblivi: The Watch can't touch me. I'm careful, private-like. Don't like people following me. Sure, it makes people nervous, seeing me sneak around. Too bad.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_ImperialCityTopic_000476a3_Oblivi: The Watch is so completely on my ass. So I got to lay low for a while. I got some dosh stashed, so I'm fine for now.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_ForlornWatchman_00035cab_Oblivion: The Watchman looks like he may have been a sailor. No one knows where he came from, or why he looks so sad.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_DirectionsLandmarks_0018bda5_Obli: The Waterfront is south of Temple District. The Arcane University is south of the Arboretum. The Imperial Prison is north of Market District.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_SE10WellspringofAureal_0008f179_O: The Waters of Oblivion lead us to the Wellspring, where Lord Sheogorath has given us a place to return to His service.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_SE10WellspringofMazken_0008f17a_O: The Waters of Oblivion lead us to the Wellspring, where Lord Sheogorath has given us a place to return to His service.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_HELLO_000029db_Knights_RESP1: The Way of the Pilgrim awaits. Go now and pray for divine guidance.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_SE10WellspringInfo_0001e971_Obliv: The Wellspring is a cynosure, a place where the Animus of lost Aureal can return to this realm from the Waters of Oblivion.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_SE10WellspringInfo_00043027_Obliv: The Wellspring is a cynosure, a place where the Animus of lost Mazken can return to this realm from the Waters of Oblivion.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_SE10WellspringofMazken_0004302e_O: The Wellspring is an essential link between the Dark Seducers and the Shivering Isles. Syl knows this, and is likely trying to break it.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_SE10WellspringofAureal_0004302c_O: The Wellspring is an essential link between the Golden Saints and the Shivering Isles. Thadon knows this, and is likely trying to break it.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_SE10WhatWellspring_00017d17_Obliv: The Wellspring of the Aureal. It's what links us to this realm, where we return to the world from the Waters of Oblivion.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_SE10WhatWellspring_00017471_Obliv: The Wellspring of the Mazken. It's what links us to this Realm, where we return to the world from the Waters of Oblivion.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_DirectionsSleep_0018bda3_Oblivion: The West Weald Inn is across from the guilds inside the north walls. Two Sisters' Lodge is inside the south walls, in the west, near the gate.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_INFOGENERAL_0003aaa2_Oblivion_RES: The West Weald is a good place. Erina Jeranus isn't the friendliest person in the world, but not a bad sort when you get to know her.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GREETING_0002006e_Oblivion_RESP4: The Xarxes mentions four items needed for the ritual, but so far I have only deciphered one of them: the 'blood of a Daedra Lord'.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GREETING_000164d0_Oblivion_RESP1: The Yellow Team ain't gonna fight itself, you lazy Pit Dog! You ready for a match, or what?
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GREETING_0001c0cb_Oblivion_RESP1: The Yellow Team surprised even me with that match. Three against one! I guess they didn't know who they were dealin' with, huh? Well done!
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_Announcer_00046664_Oblivion_RESP1: The Yellow Team's combatant has slain many opponents with his magical dagger, Shimmerstrike! Let's see if the Blue Team can end his winning streak!
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_INFOGENERAL_0008db8f_Oblivion_RES: The Zealot is a misguided man whose belief has gone astray. Steal a robe from their back and among them you can stay.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_SECreatureResponses_0008e138_Obli: The Zealot is a misguided man whose belief has gone astray. Steal a robe from their back and among them you can stay.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_INFOGENERAL_00078159_Oblivion_RES: The Zealots in the lands of Dementia believe they worship Arden-Sul. Poor, deluded souls.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_SE03AChamber_00019847_Oblivion_RE: The adventurers will be subject to horrors beyond their imagination... visions of repugnance, death, and malevolence reside in this room.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_SE03AChamber_00018ff1_Oblivion_RE: The adventurers will have to overcome their feelings of greed as they set their eyes upon the huge piles of treasure locked behind that gate.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_CharGenMain_0005482b_Oblivion_RES: The age of the Septims is over, fool. A new age is dawning!
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_SQ09Scales_00066f2c_Oblivion_RESP: The alchemist was paying so much for the scales that I'm close to having enough saved so that I can retire.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_NecromancersAmuletTopic_000146cd_: The amulet is safe, however, and that must be enough for now. Thank you for returning it.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_SE08KnightsTopic_00043f3f_Oblivio: The appearance of the Knights of Order heralds the beginning of the Greymarch. As Lord Sheogorath feared, our time grows ever shorter.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_PoisonedAppleTopic_00091913_Obliv: The apple has been treated with a most deadly poison. It will likely kill whomever eats it, probably instantly.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GREETING_00024828_Oblivion_RESP1: The area is clear? Then as soon as Captain Matius gives the order, I'll escort the civilians to safety.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_INFOGENERAL_0005f47e_Oblivion_RES: The armies are back in order? I've got no use for armies. Killing is personal, not political.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_INFOGENERAL_0005f52a_Oblivion_RES: The armies are back together now, I hear. I'd never have let them get lost in the first place.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_INFOGENERAL_0005f55f_Oblivion_RES: The armies are restored, you say? My, what a smart little thing you are!
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_INFOGENERAL_0005f3f7_Oblivion_RES: The armies are restored? That calls for a celebration!
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_INFOGENERAL_0005f45d_Oblivion_RES: The armies have returned. Thank the Madgod! I've had nightmares about them disappearing.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_INFOGENERAL_0005f42a_Oblivion_RES: The armies of Sheogorath are renewed. Let them march now on the horrible cats! Wipe them from the Isles!
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_INFOGENERAL_0005f460_Oblivion_RES: The armies of Sheogorath have returned? Putting lots of people in the same place is known to spread disease. I hope they keep the barracks far away.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_INFOGENERAL_0005f3f4_Oblivion_RES: The armies of Sheogorath march again!
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_NDCrusadersRelicsTopic_00002a7f_K: The armor and weapons of the legendary Pelinal Whitestrake, the Divine Crusader. Knights have quested for them for thousands of years.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_SE02BoneArrows_00012063_Oblivion_: The arrows are ready. Here are some for you, and I'll keep some.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_SE02BoneArrows_00012062_Oblivion_: The arrows aren't ready yet. Come back later.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_INFOGENERAL_0018b1f6_Oblivion_RES: The assassinations. What else is there to talk about? Perfectly planned and executed... the Blades perfectly useless... a complete disaster.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_MQ05WhatBaurusLearned_00022b1e_Ob: The assassins who killed the Emperor were part of a daedric cult known as the Mythic Dawn.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_MysteriumXarxes_00033fcb_Oblivion: The author of the "Commentaries" claims the Xarxes was written by Mehrunes Dagon himself, but no one else has ever seen it.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GREETING_0000c1bd_Oblivion_RESP2: The authorities at the Imperial City took her off the ship as soon as we docked. I was also informed that there was a reward for her capture.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GREETING_0007b7df_Oblivion_RESP1: The bards will be busy composing songs in your honor for years to come. To think that we lived through such times!
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GREETING_0001e966_Oblivion_RESP2: The barrier can't be broken by you. It's too tough... use the chime! Ring the chime, and that may shatter it!
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GREETING_0001e967_Oblivion_RESP2: The barrier can't be broken by you. It's too tough... use the chime! Ring the chime, and that may shatter it!
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_TrainingQuestTopic_0018d888_Obliv: The barriers between planes are weak. Do more to strengthen them; seal the portals to Oblivion. Then we shall speak of training.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_TrainingQuestTopic_0006d7a7_Obliv: The barriers between worlds are weak. Close the doors to Oblivion, and then we shall speak of training.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_MS26CorruptGuard_000363b8_Oblivio: The bastard took every coin I had with me. I don't know his name, but I know his face.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_AzaniBlackheartTOPIC_0002c58f_Obl: The bastards! There was no battle. Azani must have made a deal with the Blackwood Company. My guess is that they paid him off.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GREETING_00018c79_Oblivion_RESP1: The battle is upon us, this is no time for talk.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GREETING_00017d97_Oblivion_RESP1: The battle is upon us. There is no time for conversation.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_MS43Scamps_0004f8c0_Oblivion_RESP: The beastly little creatures are nasty, smelly, noisy and wrecking my beautiful house! I must be rid of them!
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_bed_000b1299_Oblivion_RESP1: The bed is quite luxurious, is it not?
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_LeyawiinTopic_000475c7_Oblivion_R: The beggars and the wicked Thieves Guild still trouble me. I wish the Nine Divines offered charity and comfort to the poor like the Temple did.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_MS48Choice1A_00028030_Oblivion_RE: The best I can say is, good luck. If you make it back alive, we'll be waiting for you.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_INFOGENERAL_0007815e_Oblivion_RES: The best armor in the city is at The Missing Pauldron.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_DarMaTopic_00028739_Oblivion_RESP: The best daughter a mother could ask for, kind-hearted and a friend to everyone she meets.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_TGFences_000165e7_Oblivion_RESP1: The best fences are only available to the higher rank Thieves Guild members. Here's a list of who you can use.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_ElixirofExploration_0004e946_Obli: The best place for you to start would be Shadeleaf Copse, which is a part of the Great Forest northeast of here.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_TGInformation_000092b3_Oblivion_R: The best source of information are the beggars. Their eyes and ears seem to be everywhere.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_MagesGuildTopic_00062bc1_Oblivion: The best spells are closely guarded by the guild, but are available to high-ranking members. You should consider joining.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_VampireAshTopic_000977d9_Oblivion: The best they could do to was to imprison him underground, where he survives to this day.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_SECreatureResponses_00077c6e_Obli: The best thing to do is avoid the vile things.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_SE30ForgeHelmetMagic_00016cec_Obl: The best way for a blade to slip into a man's brain is through the eye socket, ear hole, or through the nose.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_poisonedknifetopic_000282fe_Obliv: The blade has been coated with a rare poison called Languorwine. One drop in a normal human bloodstream will mimic the effects of death immediately.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GOODBYE_0007b798_Oblivion_RESP1: The blade. It hungers for souls.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_DarkGiftTopic_0004ce48_Oblivion_R: The blessed curse of vampirism now flows through your veins. Be patient. Wait the entire three days, then sleep. Your dreams will guide the way.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_HELLO_000034a0_Oblivion_RESP1: The blessing of the Fox upon you.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GOODBYE_000029e7_Knights_RESP1: The blessings of the Nine upon your quest. Perhaps our paths will cross again.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_TG08SavillasStoneTopic_0009838d_O: The blind monks in the catacombs guard the stone. It's said to have magical powers.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_NDProphetSpeechMain_00002a6b_Knig: The blood of Dibella's slaughtered acolytes cries out for vengeance. Vengeance! Who will take up this holy crusade?
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_Idle_0018b58f_Oblivion_RESP1: The blue plates are nice, but the brown ones seem to last longer.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_RaynilDralasTopic_0003843c_Oblivi: The bodies were those of some beggars who used to wander the streets looking for handouts. Vampire probably thought no one would miss them.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GREETING_00013ffa_Oblivion_RESP3: The body on the bed isn't Syl, but merely an impersonator. The real Syl uses many such decoys to throw would-be killers off her trail.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_BladesTalk4_0018d7fa_Oblivion_RES: The bond we share is unbreakable, is it not? The Blades are as one, on this and every other matter.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_MQ08ArtifactTopic_00026efa_Oblivi: The book "Modern Heretics" is the best introduction to daedric cults. The library here has a copy if you need it.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_MG05Choice1A_0001e854_Oblivion_RE: The book is entitled "Fingers of the Mountain" -- it is of no use to you; you won't be able to read it. I, however, can, and would very much like to.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_MG05Choice1A_000224e4_Oblivion_RE: The book is entitled "Fingers of the Mountain" -- it is of no use to you; you won't be able to read it. I, however, can, and would very much like to.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_FingersoftheMountain_00028c02_Obl: The book is in safe hands for now; that is all you need to know.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_FingersoftheMountain_000285bf_Obl: The book is safe. That is all you need to know.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_NDBootsoftheCrusader_00002a46_Kni: The boots could only be granted to one who values Kynareth's works. It pleases me to see that you are that one.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_NDBootsoftheCrusader_00002a43_Kni: The boots have been guarded by Kynareth herself for the longest time. Sir Juncan went after them, and never returned.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_TG11P3Specifics_0001fb70_Oblivion: The boots of Springheel Jak will allow you to leap to an unreachable place. They will also protect you from a long fall.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_INFOGENERAL_0002a392_Oblivion_RES: The bread's hot and fresh, with a nice crust, and butter and honey, just like you like it.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_INFOGENERAL_0004420d_Oblivion_RES: The burning flame of the Great Torch casts a peaceful glow, but will the flame stay ablaze or will it one day go?
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_MQ12GetStone_00026efd_Oblivion_RE: The capital of one of the ancient Ayleid kingdoms which flourished in Cyrodiil before the rise of Men.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_CGEmperor01_0002ad12_Oblivion_RES: The captain and her men... it's their duty to protect me. I will do as they say.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_MS22HighFane_0002af35_Oblivion_RE: The carving you recovered from Malada will be invaluable in my research on the Late Ayleid Period.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_DirectionsLandmarks_0018bd89_Obli: The castle is east. The chapel is northwest. The shops and guilds are mostly along the north wall and river. The port is over a bridge to the south.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_DirectionsLandmarks_0018bd8a_Obli: The castle is north, on the hill. The guilds and shops are west of the river. The homes are east of the river.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_DirectionsLandmarks_0018bda1_Obli: The castle is on a hill outside the walls, south of town.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_DirectionsLandmarks_0018bd99_Obli: The castle is to the east. Inns are near the gate and fountain. Guilds are north, by the Great Oak.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_DirectionsLandmarks_0018bd92_Obli: The castle is to the west, the chapel and houses to the south, and guilds and shops to the north.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_DirectionsLandmarks_0018bda0_Obli: The castle's to the east, and the chapel near the west gate.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_Mg13CavernChoiceWhere_00033f56_Ob: The cavern is a short distance east of the castle. Far enough from town that few residents have reason to pass by it, thankfully.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_BloodcrustCavernTopic_00009227_Ob: The cavern is silent once more. I would be foolish to think that this might send a message to those who would encroach on my territory.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_MS46Goblins_000319d1_Oblivion_RES: The caves around here are infested with goblins. Normally goblins stay close to their lairs, and wouldn't be a huge problem.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_HELLO_000982d7_Oblivion_RESP1: The cemetary is well tended, brother Holger.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GREETING_0004e8b0_Oblivion_RESP2: The characterization is completely accurate. I despise the gods and those who bow before them.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_NDProphetTopic_00002a89_Knights_R: The church has taken no official position on his teaching yet. But from the reports I've heard, he may be truly inspired by the divines.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_NDProphetTopic_00002a8a_Knights_R: The church is still in turmoil from the attack on the Chapel of Dibella.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_INFOGENERAL_0004422c_Oblivion_RES: The circle has completed, the Ritual has been done. A new leader sits upon the throne, the royal post is won.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_INFOGENERAL_0005edbb_Oblivion_RES: The circle has completed, the Ritual has been done. A new leader sits upon the throne, the royal post is won.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GREETING_00058e09_Oblivion_RESP1: The cities of Cyrodiil are finally rallying together to make a stand against the Oblivion invasion.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GREETING_00012d13_Oblivion_RESP1: The citizens are in my way. Should I kill them? No? Too bad. If only I had more magicka. I could kill the Fanatics and then rule this town!
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GREETING_0001796d_Oblivion_RESP1: The citizens of Passwall must begin to rebuild. Much has been lost, and I fear that this is only the beginning.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_MG13HunterChoiceWhere_00033f58_Ob: The citizens will likely know more. I imagine many have noticed their presence here.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_MS04HeardNo_0003d30d_Oblivion_RES: The city guard hasn't done very much about it, because frankly, the men who are robbed are so embarrassed, they don't want to report it.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_INFOGENERAL_00044223_Oblivion_RES: The city isn't ruled by Dukes. It's ruled by elected representatives. And they wear funny hats.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_SkingradTopic_0003567b_Oblivion_R: The city lies southwest of the Imperial City. The castle overlooks the city from a steep hill. You should have no trouble finding it.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GREETING_00028558_Oblivion_RESP1: The city's in flames, and we've got nothing but a bunch of greenhorns. I doubt the situation could be much worse.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_FGD08Choice4_000356f5_Oblivion_RE: The clever mages made it possible. Magic and iron. But this is not the time to talk. You drink your gift and go with your new brothers.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GREETING_0018d293_Oblivion_RESP1: The common folk of Leyawiin recognize your valor, even if Count Terentius does not. What do you need, friend?
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_INFOGENERAL_00043ebc_Oblivion_RES: The conspiracy has been discovered and eliminated. That is all you need know.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_DragonfiresTopic_00033fc8_Oblivio: The coronation of each new Emperor is sealed when he uses the Amulet of Kings to light the Dragonfires in the Temple of the One.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_SEAltarofRaptureTopic_0007ff60_Ob: The counterpart to the Altar of Despair. Rapture is currently held by the Aureals, in their complacency, but that will soon change.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_INFOGENERAL_00043eb9_Oblivion_RES: The court of Dementia is in disarray once more. Good that Thadon is such a better ruler than Syl.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_MS40WitchWhere_0003ed40_Oblivion_: The covens are hidden to outsiders. The last I heard rumors of was a coven seen somewhere in Morrowind, years ago.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_ServeSentence_0004575c_Oblivion_R: The coward's way out. So be it.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_MS14Troll_0001bb35_Oblivion_RESP1: The creatures are now loose all over the forest and in the clearing where I was still working. The Brush is on the body of the Bosmer thief there.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_MS93Choice01B_00095a67_Oblivion_R: The crystal ball is in a chest in the ship's hold, but I can't get to it. I made it as far as the captain's cabin, but the spirits nearly killed me!
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_INFOGENERAL_00077d03_Oblivion_RES: The crystal obelisks that dot the Isles have recently started behaving strangely.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_RaynilDralasTopic_0003843f_Oblivi: The culprit in this crime has already been dealt with. It's just a matter of wrapping up the details.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_INFOGENERAL_00043ec8_Oblivion_RES: The cup of Thadon is back in hand, a vessel full of dew. It seems someone helped him find it, someone who is new.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_CureforVampirism_000977d5_Oblivio: The cure you seek is ready!
