ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_DASheogorathSpeech_00095729_Obliv: They are a rather superstitious group, living their lives based on omens and prophecy. One such prophecy, the K'sharra, was of particular interest.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GREETING_00035599_Oblivion_RESP2: They are called the Boots of Bloody Bounding, and carry a powerful enchantment. I'm sure you will find them most useful.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_TG08AncestorMoth_00048973_Oblivio: They are masters of fighting in the dark. If you intend to visit, make sure you bring lots of torches or a lantern or something.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_TG08BribeBeggar_00015f1b_Oblivion: They are masters of fighting in the dark. If you intend to visit, make sure you bring lots of torches or a lantern or something.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_SE06HelpDefend_000131b5_Oblivion_: They are overconfident, as usual. We have prepared many traps and ambushes. It will be a glorious slaughter.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_OblivionGateTopic_0009226b_Oblivi: They are stable portals between our world and Oblivion. They violate the most basic principles of daedric magic. They should be impossible.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_LeyawiinNQDQuestionResponses_0003: They argue a lot, but that's just their way. I don't think they're ever really angry with one another.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GREETING_0001ee25_Oblivion_RESP2: They attacked without warning. I was praying in the Chapel when I heard Prior Maborel shout. I had just time to arm myself.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_Creatures_000224ce_Oblivion_RESP1: They began raiding our farm a few days ago. There are more now, and I have no idea where they're coming from.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_INFOGENERAL_0005f237_Oblivion_RES: They built a new Gatekeeper! Yes they did. Yes they did. Aren't you just precious?
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_INFOGENERAL_0005f20a_Oblivion_RES: They built a new Gatekeeper, did they? Hope they didn't use anything of mine when putting him back together.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_INFOGENERAL_00032e51_Oblivion_RES: They call it the 'Stone of Alessia'. And they got it back. That's all I know.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GREETING_0003e096_Oblivion_RESP1: They call me 'Hauls-Ropes-Faster'. I don't care. They can't pronounce my Black Marsh name, anyway.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GREETING_0003e07d_Oblivion_RESP1: They call me 'Wilhelm the Worm,' because dirt suits me fine. Town lets me live in the warehouse to keep out the rats.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GREETING_0001e43b_Oblivion_RESP1: They call me Cutter. For a truly inspired blade, I can forge Madness Ore! Here. Hold onto this parchment. It lists what I need.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GREETING_000488e7_Oblivion_RESP1: They call me Isleif the Open-Handed. Because I'm so generous...
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_BlackSoulGemMG17_000151f9_Oblivio: They can aid you in defeating those that carry the gem. Once you have it, bring it here to me.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_MG00JoinA_0002d283_Oblivion_RESP4: They can be done in any order, but they all must be sent in to the Council before you can enter the Arcane University.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_SE08ObeliskTopic_00043f6c_Oblivio: They can be overloaded and rendered inert by placing the crystalline hearts of the Knights into the obelisk itself.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_SE08ObeliskTopic_0008247f_Oblivio: They can be overloaded and rendered inert by placing the crystalline hearts of the Knights into the obelisk itself.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_INFOGENERAL_0005f1f7_Oblivion_RES: They can build a new Gatekeeper, but I can't manage to get anything done. I'm over-tasked, I tell you.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_INFOGENERAL_0005f21d_Oblivion_RES: They can build a new Gatekeeper, but they can't send someone to aid me in fighting these Scalons?
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_TGPayCrimeGold_000983a5_Oblivion_: They can make all your outstanding warrants go away, for only half the price of the fines.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GREETING_00032469_Oblivion_RESP1: They cannot understand why I trust you. They've not seen what I've seen.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GREETING_00016b37_Oblivion_RESP3: They captured our commander, Dylora, and have her imprisoned somewhere inside. Our first priority must be rescuing her.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GREETING_00017d0a_Oblivion_RESP3: They captured our commander, Staada, and have her imprisoned somewhere inside. Our first priority must be rescuing her.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_INFOGENERAL_0003f152_Oblivion_RES: They charged me 5 gold for littering! Littering!! I barely make that in a year! These fines are ridiculous!
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_INFOGENERAL_00032e8a_Oblivion_RES: They cleared out the Desolate Mine, all right, but the other guys didn't make it, did they.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_INFOGENERAL_00032e88_Oblivion_RES: They cleared out the Desolate Mine, and everybody got out alive. Pretty slick, eh?
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GREETING_00017655_Oblivion_RESP2: They come to this Arena to see you, so go out there and give the people what they want!
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_MS12PaleNo_00018236_Oblivion_RESP: They didn't count on Lord Vivec forming an alliance with the Trident-Kings of the Dreugh. From Morrowind, he struck at their rear flank.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_SECreatureResponses_0008e7f1_Obli: They die quickly if you jejinak them. Jejinak! Jejinak!
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_MS45BrethrenTopic_00017788_Oblivi: They don't like the sunlight much. Dangerous, too. You'll want to avoid them if you can help it.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GREETING_0001b683_Oblivion_RESP1: They doubted my power. Now they'll see!
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_SEFellmoorTopic_0003be83_Oblivion: They dream terrible dreams and one day soon, they will rise up, consume us and the rest of the Shivering Isles. Get out while you can!
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_ND06Story_00002b0d_Knights_RESP2: They dropped to the floor right where he stood, and no one could lift them. It was a sign of the curse placed upon this knight by Stendarr, I think.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_SE01HaskillChoice5_000133e4_Obliv: They entered this Realm, and were ill prepared. Their minds are now the property of my Lord.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_Creatures_000224b4_Oblivion_RESP3: They expect me to go with them, but...  I fear in my old age, I'm not the warrior I once was. Would you... would you go in my place?
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_MythicDawnTopic_00022b40_Oblivion: They follow the teachings of Mankar Camoran, who calls for the return of the Mythic Age when Oblivion and the mortal world were not separate.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_MythicDawnTopic_00024e7f_Oblivion: They follow the teachings of Mankar Camoran, whom they call the Master. A shadowy figure in his own right.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_MS38Topic_00083068_Oblivion_RESP1: They gave me no choice. I'm not a violent person, but I can only be pushed so far.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_AzaniBlackheartTOPIC_0002c58f_Obl: They get the weapon for Argoth, collect the payment, and tell Azani where the mage is. Easy for Blackheart to retrieve the weapon and collect on it.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_SECreatureResponses_0008dc39_Obli: They hate water. They hate the land, too.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_MQWhatNext_00026ef5_Oblivion_RESP: They have been plundered one by one over the years, due to their great value to mages and occultists.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_SE08KnightsTopic_00018701_Oblivio: They have been upon us for hours. They have no interest in our surrender. Only our deaths.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_BlackwoodCompany_0002c8d7_Oblivio: They have caused trouble here as well. But they have gold to pay for the trouble. Things are always better when served with gold.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_MG13CavernChoiceWhy_000039b4_Obli: They have given in to their instincts, and are little more than animals. They need to be exterminated, one way or another.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_MQ15MankarRant_0008c231_Oblivion_: They have tricked you for Ages.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_SE03FinKnightsofOrder_000807ba_Ob: They haven't walked among us in many hundreds of years. Now that they've returned, there's no telling what may happen to us.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_MS45DeepOnes_0001778e_Oblivion_RE: They helped us. Made us rich. But there was a terrible price. Blood -- and worse.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_BloodwormHelmTopic_0000c08c_Obliv: They hope to learn enough from it to find some way to fight Mannimarco. I tried to dissuade them, but it was no use.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_SE10DyloraWhere_00017d0e_Oblivion: They imprisoned Dylora somewhere within Pinnacle Rock. If they killed her, she could return to us, so they keep her hostage.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_SE10StaadaWhere_00016b3a_Oblivion: They imprisoned Staada somewhere within Brellach. If they killed her, she could return to us through the Wellspring, so they keep her hostage.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_TG08BlindMonks_000983ac_Oblivion_: They live in utter darkness in the secret catacombs. Of course it doesn't affect them because they are blind.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_INFOGENERAL_0005f221_Oblivion_RES: They made a new Gatekeeper. I'd go see him, but that would take effort.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_MS93Choice01B_00095a67_Oblivion_R: They made the journey, and arrived back all right, but then... Someone murdered them! All of them! Now their spirits are haunting the ship!
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_SEMiscQuestResponses_000825df_Obl: They make armor and weapons. Magical ones, if you have the correct matrix.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_KnightsofThorn_00031c83_Oblivion_: They make grand boasts, and talk a good talk, but that's all they are. The real work goes to us, the City Guard.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GOODBYE_0003d4d1_Oblivion_RESP1: They met me at eleven as well. And believe me, I arrived right on time.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_SE03ATellMeMore_00018df7_Oblivion: They mistook the Focus Crystals for some sort of religious symbols, and removed them from their rightful places.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_TG06OpenDoor_0000c20a_Oblivion_RE: They oughta just give you guys a key. But no. I have to keep locking and unlocking the door for the slop drudges. Follow me.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_ChorrolTopic_00024e1d_Oblivion_RE: They probably call us 'the Dog People' here in town. Rimalus and I love dogs. We have quite a few. So sweet and well-behaved, you wouldn't believe.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_INFOGENERAL_00043eea_Oblivion_RES: They round up people like animals in New Sheoth. I should hunt those nobles. That's what I should do.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_INFOGENERAL_000624ae_Oblivion_RES: They say Alinor on Summerset Isle is more beautiful. I've never been. For the present, I must count the Imperial City the most glorious in Tamriel.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_INFOGENERAL_00043ecd_Oblivion_RES: They say Thadon is addicted to some drug. I can understand what that's like. The bones call to me like his drug calls to him.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_INFOGENERAL_0018b209_Oblivion_RES: They say a lost son of Uriel Septim has reappeared in Bruma. Troops are flocking to his banner from all over Cyrodiil!
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_INFOGENERAL_00064469_Oblivion_RES: They say a thief actually stole one of the Elder Scrolls from the Imperial Library. Who would have thought it was even possible?
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_INFOGENERAL_0000080C_AltarESPMain: They say a whole island, with an inhuman statue, appeared near Bravil. As if the world wasn't crazy enough already.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_SEServiceProviderResponses_0008e1: They say books aren't all Sontaire will sell, but I'm not one to kiss and tell.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_SEObeliskResponses_0008e14e_Obliv: They say from the obelisks Knights do spawn; stay clear of them unless you wish to be gone.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_SEMiscQuestResponses_0008e131_Obl: They say his fear of cats extends to the Khajiit, or pretty much anything with furry paws for feet.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_CGBaurusA_0001e8e6_Oblivion_RESP2: They say it's the Dragon Blood, that flows through the veins of every Septim. They see more than lesser men.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_INFOGENERAL_00060509_Oblivion_RES: They say our Lord just took off. Can you believe that? I need a drink. I need the Skooma.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_INFOGENERAL_00002a0a_Knights_RESP: They say someone finally laid poor Lord Vlindrel's shade to rest. That's good. He's been haunting these hills for too long.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_CurrentEventsResponses_000c459f_O: They say syndicates of wizards have led a boycott of Imperial goods in the land of the Altmer.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_INFOGENERAL_000af061_Oblivion_RES: They say that Akatosh appeared and killed Mehrunes Dagon, right in the middle of the Temple of the One! Do you believe it?
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_AnvilTopic_0003e0b1_Oblivion_RESP: They say that I was selected as Dibella's Primate in large part because of my loving nature and my striking looks.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_CurrentEventsResponses_00024e83_O: They say that King Helseth has made an alliance with House Dres. Together they pick apart the carcass of ruined Indoril.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_INFOGENERAL_000029fe_Knights_RESP: They say that Kynareth granted the boots of the Crusader to someone. I can't imagine what he must've gone through to get them.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_INFOGENERAL_0018b205_Oblivion_RES: They say that Oblivion Gates have opened outside cities all across Tamriel! Gods preserve us!
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_INFOGENERAL_00002a0d_Knights_RESP: They say that Pelinal Whitestrake has returned, and will soon put a stop to that Ayleid monster who's been terrorizing the chapels!
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_INFOGENERAL_0005ef26_Oblivion_RES: They say that invaders have come to the Shivering Isles. Of course, "they" say a lot of things, don't they?
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_CurrentEventsResponses_00024e3a_O: They say that slavery has been abolished in Morrowind. House Dres and Hlaalu have renounced the slave trade, and freed the beastfolk from servitude.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_INFOGENERAL_00002a05_Knights_RESP: They say that someone's taken up the prophet's call, and is questing for the Crusader's Relics. I hope they succeed.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_INFOGENERAL_000029f9_Knights_RESP: They say that the priests and priestesses of the Chapel of Dibella have all been murdered! No one even knows who did it!
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_INFOGENERAL_0003e4c1_Oblivion_RES: They say that when you murder someone, the Dark Brotherhood comes to you in your sleep. It's how they recruit new members.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_INFOGENERAL_00032e46_Oblivion_RES: They say the Fighters Guild got all the trolls in Swampy Cave, but I'm still not going anywhere near Harlun's Watch.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_SE02Gardens_0008e4f7_Oblivion_RES: They say the Gatekeeper's magical. I don't believe in magic. But I do believe in bones.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_SE30ForgeGauntletsMagic_00016ce9_: They say the heart anchors the soul to the man. Think of this while the heart of your enemy beats in your hand. Then squeeze.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_SE02GatesOfMadness_0008e4cd_Obliv: They say the keys are sewn up in the Gatekeeper's body. Basically, that means you're not getting in.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_INFOGENERAL_0003406e_Oblivion_RES: They say there are a bunch of people holed up in Summitmist Manor. Locked in. Some kind of weird party or something.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_HELLO_0003c14b_Oblivion_RESP1: They say there's a gate opened outside the city! Let's go!
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_INFOGENERAL_000432cb_Oblivion_RES: They say there's a newcomer about. I wonder where he's from?
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_NDChapelAttackTopic_00002b9a_Knig: They say there's a prophet in Anvil now, preaching about the end of the world. He may have a point.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_ICAllNQDQuestionResponses_000498a: They say they treat all their patrons like royalty. From what I've seen, it's the truth.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_SE30ForgeShield_0001f3e4_Oblivion: They say, "Behind every great man is a great woman." Mama said, "Men are squishy. Use a shield instead!"
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_SECreatureResponses_00077c68_Obli: They seem at home on land or in the water.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_SECreatureResponses_00077c6b_Obli: They seem to live fine on land and water.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_SE08Ally03Tactic2_00017d5d_Oblivi: They shall fall before my blade.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_SE08Ally03Tactic2_000181d2_Oblivi: They shall fall before my blade.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_SE02OrcConversation_0007eacd_Obli: They should have listened to me!
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_SE02OrcSpectators_0007ead3_Oblivi: They should have listened to me.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_MQ15KathutetD_0003e8fe_Oblivion_R: They show initiative, and Anaxes doubtless deserves humiliation, but I cannot permit this to continue.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_TG06CastleJobs_0000bf95_Oblivion_: They sometimes need folks to work in the castle. Most are afraid to go up there though. Try asking the butler, Shum gro-Yarug.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_StrangeLights_0000bed8_Oblivion_R: They started appearing a few nights ago. Odd, flickering lights. In the morning, there was nothing to see. But they were there at night.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GREETING_0003d496_Oblivion_RESP1: They still aren't letting me live this down.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_ICAllNQDResponses_0004992c_Oblivi: They sure do sell food. Yup. You can buy food there.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_MS38Topic_00083066_Oblivion_RESP1: They think I don't know. They think I don't see.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GREETING_0000c1dc_Oblivion_RESP3: They took myself and Ormil, the Float's owner, hostage and put the ship to sea. I have no idea what they're after.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_MQ15EldamilC2_0003fbe0_Oblivion_R: They tore me to pieces, although I have no doubt they were immediately killed by my companions.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_INFOGENERAL_00032ea5_Oblivion_RES: They train blunt, blade, heavy armor, and block in one of the guildhalls. Is it Anvil?
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GREETING_0001efe0_Oblivion_RESP5: They want an Emperor to tell them what to do. And I haven't the faintest idea...
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_DarMaTopic_0001778d_Oblivion_RESP: They want to bring back the Deep Ones. I thought I did, too, but ... she's so innocent.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_SE32SiegeVitharn_0001b68d_Oblivio: They wanted me to convert Vitharn, but I fooled them. I put them on the list. Oh, yes, they're on the list now!
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_MS27HerminiaE1_000a5607_Oblivion_: They were a bitterly divided people, with many warlords vying against each other for power.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_advancementFG_0003570f_Oblivion_R: They were also brave, and necessary. Because of this, I am hereby naming you Master of the Fighters Guild, effective immediately.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_SwordAndArmor_000091f1_Oblivion_R: They were buried with my grandfather in the family tomb. The sword and cuirass were enchanted, and should cover my debt. Please, get them for me.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_SwordAndArmor_000091fc_Oblivion_R: They were buried with my grandfather in the family tomb. The sword and cuirass were enchanted, and should cover my debt. Please, get them for me.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_RaynilDralasTopic_0003857e_Oblivi: They were part of some sort of brotherhood. They would roam Cyrodiil in search of legendary treasures and the like.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_StrangeLights_0000beda_Oblivion_R: They were seen around the Swampy Cave. Strange, moving lights. I've never seen anything like it. Old-timers have tales about such things.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_AldosOthranTopic_0003c2c2_Oblivio: They were traveling the road from the Imperial City when a bandit raiding party struck. He barely escaped alive.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_ND04CarodusGreetingAbout_00002abc: They were... they were both killed in an accident when I was young. I became a ward of the crown and was drafted into the Imperial Army.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_FGD04Choice3_0002c5bf_Oblivion_RE: They weren't always a threat. Small scale mercenary band, until Ri'Zakar took over. Then came the fat Imperial contracts.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_TG11RejectCowl_00022e8c_Oblivion_: They will not realize that you are the same person that just took off the cowl. To them, the Gray Fox just vanished into thin air.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_CharGenMain_00015134_Oblivion_RES: They won't be the first to underestimate the Blades.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_StolenGold_00093550_Oblivion_RESP: They won't do me any good in here.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_SEMiscQuestResponses_0008dc94_Obl: They won't make armor and weapons, especially not magic ones.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_DANamiraSpeech_0005c01c_Oblivion_: They worship me from the dark, basking in their misery and filth. Now, though, some would seek to bring light to their darkness.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_MythicDawnTopic_00035c58_Oblivion: They worship the daedra lord Mehrunes Dagon, according to the teachings of their leader, Mankar Camoran.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_TGHieronymusLex_00015f23_Oblivion: They would have no qualms about killing you once they had the Icestaff back.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_MS46GoblinMischief_0002f814_Obliv: They'd boast about it just as if they won it in a war, and pretty soon the Cracked Wood tribe would launch a war against THEM.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_MS23RolandAuthority_0001d4c7_Obli: They'd never believe he was a vampire. I retreated here to the cabin to collect my thoughts.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_NDGauntletsoftheCrusader_00002b19: They'll almost certainly be here long after we're all gone. Certainly after Kellen's family has died out.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_SE08ObeliskTopic_00091351_Oblivio: They'll get more and more active as the Greymarch continues. If they've already taken the Fringe, they must have one there already.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_MythicDawnTopic_000a31b6_Oblivion: They'll pay for the murder of the Emperor. Now that we know who they are, it's only a matter of time.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_ReadyForAMatch_0002b1e7_Oblivion_: They're Argonian prisoners, brought here from Black Marsh. They've been told they have to kill you in exchange for their freedom!
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_DASheogorathSpeech_000897bc_Obliv: They're a superstitious bunch. Everything is an omen or a portent. Let's make one come true. Find their shaman and ask about the K'Sharra prophecy.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_DASheogorathSpeech_0009760e_Obliv: They're a superstitious bunch. Everything is an omen or a portent. Let's make one come true. Find their shaman and ask about the K'Sharra prophecy.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_SQ03Avenge_00189cf9_Oblivion_RESP: They're all I have left of value, but you must have them. I insist.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_contract_0006edee_Oblivion_RESP1: They're all dead? Well, you'll have to take over for them. Get back there and clear out that mine. Get moving!
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_SE03GrommokChamberTwoManEnd02_000: They're all fake! Just come with me now!
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GREETING_0002d915_Oblivion_RESP1: They're all gone? I can leave the cave? Oh, thank you! I'm ever so grateful!
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_NelsTheNaughtyTopic_00028c37_Obli: They're all the same, full of mead and something to prove. We lost a lot of good men up there. A lot of good men.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_SECreatureResponses_00077c6d_Obli: They're amazing creatures, but hard to kill.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_CharGenMain_0001d112_Oblivion_RES: They're behind us! Wait here, sire.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_SECreatureResponses_00078180_Obli: They're bizarre people. I'm glad they stay out of the city.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_SECreatureResponses_0008dc35_Obli: They're certainly NOT dangerous. They're quite tame, actually.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_INFOGENERAL_0005ef83_Oblivion_RES: They're coming for me. Those Knights. I should have seen it coming.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_Creatures_000224b4_Oblivion_RESP1: They're coming from someplace in the Great Forest. I don't know where, but Rallus may know more by now.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_SECreatureResponses_00078182_Obli: They're confused souls, too far from Lord Sheogorath's protection.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_Attack_00073007_Oblivion_RESP1: They're everywhere! Get them! Get them!
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_DovesiDranTopic_00028a10_Oblivion: They're getting into this house somehow, which means there must be a way out as well! We need to find the secret exit and escape this madhouse!
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_SE06ObelisksTopic_000910fa_Oblivi: They're getting more active every day. Not a good sign.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_LeyawiinTopic_0003572d_Oblivion_R: They're gone now. Fighters Guild took care of them. And about time the Guild showed some sand. They are 'fighters', aren't they?
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_vampirehunters_000039bf_Oblivion_: They're in here to eat every afternoon, and bed down just before midnight. Outside of that, it's none of my business.

ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_INFOGENERAL_00085215_Oblivion_RES: Those new fellows here in town are making me nervous. Walking around with those big weapons; I hope they leave soon.

ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_MGExpelAccept_0002503b_Oblivion_R: Very well. Make no mistake: this task is simple, but has a purpose.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_MQJoinBladesNo_00037cf1_Oblivion_: Very well. Many serve the Empire in their own way. But we would be honored to have you, if you change your mind.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_MS21NotInterested_0002af30_Oblivi: Very well. Perhaps I misjudged you after all.

ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_BedYes_000b6c29_Oblivion_RESP1: Very well. Room number two, just near the entrance. If you need food or drink, let me know.

ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_MG05Choice2B_000277a9_Oblivion_RE: Very well. Should you happen to find it, it would be in the best interest of all for it to be secure here within the guild hall.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_TrainingQuestTopic_0006139d_Obliv: Very well. Simple task for you. I just dropped a favorite coin of mine into my pocket. If you can steal it from me, I'll train you.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_MSShadowscaleChoice1B_00035591_Ob: Very well. Speak to me later if you change your mind. I fear the issue will remain unresolved unless you can help.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_SE07RitualNoD_0001365f_Oblivion_R: Very well. Spoken like a true son of the Demented.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_Dark18Choice4A_0009079a_Oblivion_: Very well. Take your time. Enjoy the hospitalities of my... home. Ha ha ha ha ha ha ha!
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_MS14TruepaintTopic_0001c1c6_Obliv: Very well. The Brush showed up several years ago in the possession an artist who was serving in the Arnesian War of 396.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_MS48Convo_00024839_Oblivion_RESP1: Very well. The area outside the Chapel has been cleared, and these people need to be taken to safety. Escort them to the camp south of here at once.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_MS51Choice2_0003152e_Oblivion_RES: Very well. Then I must find someone else who can. I will do nothing else until that painting is recovered.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_MG10Choice1A_00032ad6_Oblivion_RE: Very well. There's a research project going on at one of the Ayleid ruin sites on the eastern side of the province.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_MG10Choice1A_00035f45_Oblivion_RE: Very well. There's a research project going on at one of the Ayleid ruin sites on the eastern side of the province.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_SE09VictimChoice5b_00082098_Obliv: Very well. This might hurt a little.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_MS27UmbacanoB1_000a657f_Oblivion_: Very well. Three days, then. Don't be late.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_TrainingAlterationYes_0018d158_Ob: Very well. We shall speak again in three hours. Good luck to you.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_MQ05PlanAInsist_00022cf5_Oblivion: Very well. We'll do it your way. Be careful, and remember, we can't leave here without that book. It's our best chance of getting the Amulet back.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_SE06HelpAttackA3C1_000192ea_Obliv: Very well. We'll risk it. The Underdeep it is. May Sheogorath's divine madness possess us today!
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_SE06HelpAttackA3C2_000192ed_Obliv: Very well. We'll risk it. The Underdeep it is. May Sheogorath's divine madness possess us today!
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_MS16Choice3C_0002ba58_Oblivion_RE: Very well. We're anxious to return to Weatherleah, so be sure to let me know as soon as you're ready.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_MG00JoinA_0002d282_Oblivion_RESP1: Very well. You are now an Associate of the Mages Guild. The full guild hall is now available for your use.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_BedYes_000bb9ba_Oblivion_RESP1: Very well. You can use either bed on the top floor. Oh, and do watch your step.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_MG08Choice2A_00035622_Oblivion_RE: Very well. You have three choices for what type of damage you'd like it to do: Fire, Frost, or Shock.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_BlackBows01_000908e0_Oblivion_RES: Very well. You may bring it to me at any time and receive your reward.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_SE06StelaGreetA3_00018f94_Oblivio: Very well... I shall be your guide to Cylarne, then. Proceed.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_MG00JoinA_0002d287_Oblivion_RESP2: Very well... you are now an Associate of the Mages Guild.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_SE41No_0006eab2_Oblivion_RESP1: Very well... you have doomed a frail woman to certain death....
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_INFOGENERAL_00049926_Oblivion_RES: Viator Accius has a good shield selection at Stonewall Shields.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_contract_000251c2_Oblivion_RESP1: Vicente wants YOU to infiltrate the Imperial Prison? I didn't realize you had such a good sense of humor.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_INFOGENERAL_0006090b_Oblivion_RES: Victory calls for celebration, don't you think? I wish I had the coin to drink a toast to Sheogorath.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GREETING_000131a9_Oblivion_RESP1: Victory is ours! I have already instructed my subordinates to kindle the Altar of Rapture.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GREETING_000131a8_Oblivion_RESP1: Victory is ours! I have already selected a candidate for the honor of kindling the Altar of Rapture.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GREETING_00017972_Oblivion_RESP1: Victory is ours... for the moment.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GREETING_00017d54_Oblivion_RESP1: Victory is ours... for the moment.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_INFOGENERAL_000607c9_Oblivion_RES: Victory over Order! That calls for a grand celebration. Break out the casks of Skooma!
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_INFOGENERAL_0003c236_Oblivion_RES: Vigge the Cautious is responsible for enchanted item recharge at the Mages Guild. Good thing he's cautious. I'd hate to have something go wrong.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_INFOGENERAL_00032e37_Oblivion_RES: Vilena Donton hasn't been very aggressive as head of the Fighters Guild. Maybe her son Viranus will show a bit more spunk.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_INFOGENERAL_000241e1_Oblivion_RES: Vilena Donton just hasn't been the same since her eldest son died. Still, she does a good job of running the Fighters Guild.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_INFOGENERAL_00032e38_Oblivion_RES: Vilena Donton needs to set a fire under the Fighters Guild if they expect to compete with the Blackwood Company.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_VitellusDontonTOPIC_0002d725_Obli: Vilena Donton's eldest son. Good man. We lost him on a botched mission recently. You've probably seen the other wounded around.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GREETING_00024e08_Oblivion_RESP1: Vilena Donton, Master of the Fighters Guild. Please excuse the mess. Paperwork. But what can I do for you?
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_ViranusDontonTOPIC_0002d71d_Obliv: Vilena coddles the boy too much. Doesn't want him in the line of fire. Suppose it's no surprise after Vitellus.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_INFOGENERAL_00032eb8_Oblivion_RES: Vilena is pretty useless since Vitellus died. Thank gods Oreyn is around to keep things together.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_FGD05Choice2_0002c5bc_Oblivion_RE: Vilena's gotten tentative since the Blackheart mission. She's worried about getting us killed. But we're just getting killed a little bit at a time.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GREETING_00047680_Oblivion_RESP1: Vinicia Melissaeia, Office of Imperial Commerce. You got complaints? Of course you got complaints. Who doesn't?
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_ICAllNQDQuestionResponses_0004997: Vinicia may have the worst job in Cyrodiil. She takes complaints all day, and nothing ever comes of them.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_INFOGENERAL_0004996f_Oblivion_RES: Vinivia Melissaeia takes all the merchant complaints in the city.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_INFOGENERAL_00032e76_Oblivion_RES: Viranus is a good kid. It's his mom who's getting in the way.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_INFOGENERAL_00032e75_Oblivion_RES: Viranus is just a kid. But he did pretty well at Nonwyll Cavern, I guess.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_INFOGENERAL_00032e79_Oblivion_RES: Viranus needs to stop hiding behind his mother's skirts if he expects to run this outfit someday.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_INFOGENERAL_00032e74_Oblivion_RES: Viranus wasn't alone at Nonwyll Cavern, you know. Would he have done that well without help?
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_INFOGENERAL_00032e30_Oblivion_RES: Viranus, the Fighters Guild son-and-heir, is dead, and Vilena kicked Modryn Oreyn out of the guild. The Fighters Guild is falling apart.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_INFOGENERAL_0018bc7b_Oblivion_RES: Virtuous visitors to Wayshrines of Kynareth may receive Blessings of Agility.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_INFOGENERAL_0005efe5_Oblivion_RES: Visit Passwall once, Relan did. Good that it burned. People there deserve pain.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_TrainingQuestTopic_0018d88e_Obliv: Visit her at the Leyawiin Guild hall. But be aware that she's a bit...  odd.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GREETING_0007f44e_Oblivion_RESP1: Visit me during store hours. These are private moments.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GREETING_000488eb_Oblivion_RESP1: Vlanarus Kvinchal. Kastav is my brother, all right, but I'm nothing like that deadbeat.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_HELLO_00081dc3_Oblivion_RESP1: Voices from nowhere. I don't get paid enough.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_MagesGuildTopic_0006260f_Oblivion: Volanaro has a twisted sense of humor, but he also has a few nice spells up his sleeve. If you want to summon a Bound sword, talk to him.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GREETING_0003c9a6_Oblivion_RESP1: Volanaro, at your service. Need a spell? Need an item recharged? Need a witty practical joke played on someone? I can handle it all.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_CheydinhalTopic_0004e8d5_Oblivion: Voranil got parties near about every night, and there's plenty of cooking and cleaning and preparing to be done. If you don't mind.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_Question_0003dfbf_Oblivion_RESP1: Voranil is such a fool. Have you seen how he treats his servants?
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_SE03GrommokChamberThreeMan01_0006: WHAT!? How in Oblivion can I be dead?
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_SE34Medallion_00066eaa_Oblivion_R: Wait a moment... if you'll pardon my manners, you reek of the bogs. You must have been to the Fetid Grove!
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_CharGenMain_0001d113_Oblivion_RES: Wait here with the Emperor. Guard him with your life.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_MQ11BrumaAllies_00056e6a_Oblivion: Wait here. I will tell the Count you are waiting to see him.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_MQ11BrumaAllies_00056e6c_Oblivion: Wait here. I will tell the Count you are waiting to see him.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_SE03SyndelChamberOneGrow01_00066e: Wait just a moment... what's that sound?
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_SE07AThadonShout_0008f530_Oblivio: Wait! I must speak! Halt! Cease! Desist!
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_SE07BSylShout_0008f57f_Oblivion_R: Wait! I must speak! The Ritual must not be completed!
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_HELLO_00022e0d_Oblivion_RESP1: Wait! I need to speak with you!
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_MQ05RavenSpeech_00095899_Oblivion: Wait! I've seen you before! You're the Blade that Brother Astav was tailing!
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_SE05Interrogate1_00013fee_Oblivio: Wait! Wait, no. Please. All I know is that on certain nights, Syl asked me to guard her chambers. She never said why. I think she went somewhere.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GREETING_00025273_Oblivion_RESP1: Wait, I know you... You... You're the one! That day the Emperor was killed! They went through your cell! You lucky bastard! But... You came back?
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GREETING_0004cad8_Oblivion_RESP1: Wait, I know you... You... You're the one! That day the Emperor was killed! They went through your cell! You lucky strumpet! But... You came back?
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_SE04XedilianChoice_00044f52_Obliv: Wait, scratch that. Cheese for no one. That can be just as much of a celebration, if you don't like cheese. True?
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_SE42Confused_0007322d_Oblivion_RE: Wait, this is yesterday's future. I'm the one that's confused.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_ArenaChoice1A_00029ca6_Oblivion_R: Wait, you're serious, aren't you? What is with you people? You walk in, want to be combatants, and your entrails end up decorating my Red Room.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_MQ15EldamilA1_0001587a_Oblivion_R: Wait. I know who you must be. You're the one who killed Raven and Ruma. They told me about you, when I was still in their father's favor...
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_MQ16MartinB_0004bfbd_Oblivion_RES: Wait. Yes. The Amulet was given to mortals by Akatosh... it contains His divine power...
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GOODBYE_00033593_Oblivion_RESP1: Wait... I have much to tell you!
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_Dark06Choice1A_0002fbb1_Oblivion_: Wait... You... You lied! Ohh... That's mean! Nordinor.. In Bravil... He sells skooma! Late at night... Go get me some... Okay?
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GREETING_00023e7f_Oblivion_RESP2: Wait... you don't work here, do you? But you do work for me. At least, you're supposed to be working for me. Off you go, then.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GREETING_0003b96e_Oblivion_RESP1: Wait... you're not one of them... no. You're fine. Cats. They're everywhere. But my babies protect me.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_Dark10SancChoice1A_00032bf0_Obliv: Waiting just outside is a magnificent steed named Shadowmere. She has served me well. I present her now to you, as a token of my trust and love.

ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_Dark10SancChoice1C_00032bf3_Obliv: Waiting just outside is a magnificent steed named Shadowmere. She has served me well. I present her now to you, as a token of my trust and love.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_HELLO_0018a955_Oblivion_RESP1: Waiting's been difficult, I hope your journey was successful.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_CharGenTaunt2_00033349_Oblivion_R: Wake up, Redguard! Ah, there you are. How do you like your cell, huh? Roomy enough for you?
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_CharGenTaunt2_0003333d_Oblivion_R: Wake up, kitty kitty. That's it. There's a rat in my cell, Khajiit. A fat, tasty rat. Does the kitty want it? Is the kitty hungry?
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_CharGenTaunt2_0003334a_Oblivion_R: Wake up, pretty Redguard! Ah, there you are. How do you like your cell, huh? Roomy enough for you?
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GOODBYE_00004b9f_DLCVileLair_RESP: Walk always in the Shadow of Sithis.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GOODBYE_00007972_DLCVileLair_RESP: Walk always in the Shadow of Sithis.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GOODBYE_00034031_Oblivion_RESP1: Walk always in the Shadow of Sithis.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_SE32WhatCanIDo_00012d05_Oblivion_: Walk among them. There were four who failed to protect the gate lever. Find out what they did wrong and help them correct it.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_BedYes_0018ae86_Oblivion_RESP1: Walk just up the stairs there, and it's the door on the right. Thank you.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GOODBYE_000243bd_Oblivion_RESP1: Walk where your road must take you.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GOODBYE_00034034_Oblivion_RESP1: Walk with darkness, child of the Night Mother.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GOODBYE_000029e8_Knights_RESP1: Walk with the Nine, Sir Knight.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_NDPilgrimageTopic_00002a9b_Knight: Walking the Pilgrim's Way is the traditional start of a holy quest.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_SkingradTopic_00038ab3_Oblivion_R: Wander the streets, fields, and public places of Skingrad to your heart's content. Just don't include me in your social explorations.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GREETING_00071f30_Oblivion_RESP1: Wanna buy a stick? I gotta fresh one right here. No? Then what can I do for ya?
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_SE30ForgeGreavesMagic_000400b8_Ob: Want some help putting these on?
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_LeyawiinTopic_000479b0_Oblivion_R: Want to hear a Khajiit joke?
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_BravilTopicGrayFox_0004891c_Obliv: Want to learn more? Visit the Waterfront District of the Imperial City. Find the Garden of Dareloth at midnight. Then ask your questions.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_INFOGENERAL_00032eb0_Oblivion_RES: Want to pick up a shield and go a few rounds later? Been a while since I saw real action.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GREETING_0007fde2_Oblivion_RESP1: War has come to the Shivering Isles at last. We stand ready to protect these lands.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GREETING_00022500_Oblivion_RESP1: Warmest greetings to you. I trust you've already spoken with Ocheeva? I am Vicente Valtieri. I provide assignments for all new family members.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GREETING_000251dd_Oblivion_RESP1: Warmest welcomes to you. I am Telaendril, Wood Elf and loyal daughter of Sithis. I hope you find our Sanctuary to your liking.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GREETING_0014684e_Oblivion_RESP1: Warrior? You? Ha ha ha ha ha ha ha ha! Just... Just look at you! Ha ha ha ha ha ha!
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_INFOGENERAL_00032ebf_Oblivion_RES: Was Vigdis our most recent recruit? Or Lensi Llharam? It's been so long, I forget.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GREETING_00012d07_Oblivion_RESP1: Was my sin so great that I must suffer for all eternity?
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_ADMIREDISLIKE_0018b2a5_Oblivion_R: Was that supposed to be a compliment?
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_Idle_0018b5a3_Oblivion_RESP1: Was that you? What did you eat?
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GOODBYE_00081d92_Oblivion_RESP1: Was that...? Nah, just my imagination.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GOODBYE_000343e6_Oblivion_RESP1: Waste no time. You must find Martin before the enemy does.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_INFOGENERAL_0018bcc3_Oblivion_RES: Watch for minotaurs in the forests. Aggressive beasts. They'll tear right through your armor, too.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_INFOGENERAL_00077c46_Oblivion_RES: Watch for the Elytra's stingers; their poison can be deadly. They don't like magic much, though.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_SE09Ceremony_00014aea_Oblivion_RE: Watch my child destroy the interlopers, or run to Sheogorath. Either way, tell Him of our doings here. Send Him my tribute... and my affections.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GOODBYE_00088b40_Oblivion_RESP1: Watch out for Anaxes. Some meddling fool must have let him loose.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_MS46Goblins_000319ce_Oblivion_RES: Watch out for them if you're heading north. We ran into goblin war parties northwest of here, while starting to build a new settlement.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_Attack_0006b82b_Oblivion_RESP1: Watch out! There may be more of them!
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_sons_0002573f_Oblivion_RESP1: Watch over them, and keep them safe. I couldn't bear to lose them to those monsters.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_DANamiraSpeech_0005dc94_Oblivion_: Watch over these souls, who have strayed from the light of your love.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GREETING_000917ca_Oblivion_RESP1: Watch your step in the Silo. Thadon doesn't want just anyone traipsing through there.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_INFOGENERAL_0018bcbe_Oblivion_RES: Watch yourself around goblins. Some of the nastier ones will toss spells at you.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_AnvilTopic_0003e0c1_Oblivion_RESP: Watch yourself around the Fo'c's'le. Sailors despise landsmen, and won't hesitate to treat them to a good beating when they're in their cups.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_SEFellmoorTopic_0003be76_Oblivion: Watch yourself while you're here. Cindanwe is out for us. She cares for nothing but work, and she keeps us as slaves!
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_INFOGENERAL_0018bc80_Oblivion_RES: Wayshrines of Arkay confer Blessings of Health on those who've pleased the Nine by righteous acts.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_INFOGENERAL_0018bc79_Oblivion_RES: Wayshrines of the Nine in the wilderness confer blessings on the righteous and faithful.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_BleakersWayTopic_0001ece0_Oblivio: We Dalvilus are good neighbors to the Ulfgars, and our leaders, Hrol Ulfgar and Nivan Dalvilu, work hard to keep it that way.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GREETING_00034510_Oblivion_RESP1: We agreed I would meet the Sponsor. You need to get out of sight before you blow the whole meeting.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_SEWildernessRumorResponses_000617: We all knew that's how Thadon would go. But, Syl?
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_LeyawiinTopic_000355cb_Oblivion_R: We all love Count Marius, and his father before him... Arkay bless his soul... such a fine young man...
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GREETING_0018d28c_Oblivion_RESP1: We all owe you a debt of gratitude for closing that Oblivion Gate. Thank you.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GREETING_00062be7_Oblivion_RESP1: We all owe you our lives. From what I've heard, the battle was hanging in the balance until you destroyed that horrible daedric machine.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_LeyawiinTopic_000475d0_Oblivion_R: We all profit by your lawful pursuit of the unlawful, and we encourage you to attack, burn, loot, and destroy them wherever you can.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_SE38Oddity8_00081e8d_Oblivion_RES: We already have one of those, I'm afraid. It wasn't all that Odd to begin with, honestly. We certainly can't have two.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_MQ07Spies_00020077_Oblivion_RESP3: We always see them near the runestone at dusk. They aren't too woodcrafty, but Grandmaster Jauffre has forbidden us to range too far from the walls.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_FGJoin1_0002427e_Oblivion_RESP1: We appreciate your interest, but I understand you've got a bounty on your head. Take care of that, and we'll consider your application.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_FGJoin1_00024281_Oblivion_RESP1: We appreciate your interest, but you've got quite a nasty reputation. Do something about that, and perhaps we'll consider your application.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_KnightsofThorn_00031842_Oblivion_: We are Knights sworn to uphold the laws of Cheydinhal. We fear no being, and we strike fast and true as lightning.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_KnightsofThorn_000c452c_Oblivion_: We are Knights sworn to uphold the laws of Cheydinhal. We fear no being, and we strike fast and true as lightning.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_duties_0000344b_Oblivion_RESP1: We are a brotherhood, a family. What affects one of us affects us all. Fighting, drunkenness, dereliction of duty are not tolerated.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_SEFellmoorTopic_0003be78_Oblivion: We are a farming community. Nothing more. Nothing less. That is, when I can get these layabouts to actually put in a day's work.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_OrderOfTalosTopic_00033dfc_Oblivi: We are a monastic order devoted to divine Talos, who was the mortal Tiber Septim, the founder of the empire.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_PellsGateTOPIC_00026b13_Oblivion_: We are a small community. Mostly keep to ourselves. Can't say it isn't nice to see a new face around, though.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_MG18Choice3A_00070487_Oblivion_RE: We are after the same things, your guild and I. Yet you worry about 'good' and 'evil' and do not accept they are manifestations of the same thing.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_NDKnightsTopic_00002bd8_Knights_R: We are all reunited once more. You have done what we once thought impossible.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GREETING_00055b03_Oblivion_RESP1: We are all that are left. The others were struck down by Order. How did this happen?
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GREETING_00079c09_Oblivion_RESP1: We are all that are left. The others were struck down by Order. How did this happen?
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GREETING_00002A2A_AltarDeluxe_RES: We are blessed by an Envoy of Lord Dagon!
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_SE06HelpDefend_000131b5_Oblivion_: We are expecting the Aureals to attack any moment. They'll come down the main passage from the Altar of Rapture. They always do.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_ImperialCityTopic_00020086_Oblivi: We are from the IC (not to be confused with the OC).
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_TG11LastHeist_0001fb4f_Oblivion_R: We are going to steal one of the Elder Scrolls from the Imperial Palace. Are you ready for this challenge?
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_OrderOfTalosTopic_00033dfb_Oblivi: We are honored to have Grandmaster Jauffre, or Brother Jauffre as he prefers, as a resident here.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GREETING_000251d6_Oblivion_RESP1: We are kin, yet I cannot help but despise you. Leave my sight, before I do something I regret.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_MSMiscKotT_000c453c_Oblivion_RESP: We are led by Farwil Indarys. Yes, the Count's son himself.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GREETING_0008511c_Oblivion_RESP1: We are not afraid of the dark. The Night Mistress gives us eyes to see night's secrets.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GREETING_000a78da_Oblivion_RESP1: We are not yet done with your test. When you have passed or failed, then we may have reason to speak.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_ElderCouncilTopic_000add0c_Oblivi: We are now the stewards of the Empire. We can hold the Empire together in the short term.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_BladesTalk4_0018d7f8_Oblivion_RES: We are one mind and one blade, of course.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_FGD07Choice2_00098198_Oblivion_RE: We are over one hundred strong now. We grow by the day!
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_SE06KanehGreetA_000131ab_Oblivion: We are preparing to sweep the Mazken scum from Cylarne. Perhaps Sheogorath sent you to help us?
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_SE06UlfriGreetA1_000131b2_Oblivio: We are preparing to wipe out the arrogant Aureals once and for all.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GOODBYE_0008d32a_Oblivion_RESP1: We are safe in your presence, Lord. Thank you.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_TG07WhyNotKillLex_0000c049_Oblivi: We are thieves, not murderers. That is the province of the Dark Brotherhood.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GREETING_0001d23f_Oblivion_RESP2: We are, for lack of a better word, defenders. We guard this city from an infestation that plagues it. We are vampire hunters.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_HenantierTopic_00027f31_Oblivion_: We aren't going far, so no need to prepare for a long journey. In fact, he's still in town. More I can't say aloud without risk of others hearing.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_MS31Selene04Negative_0000c1ef_Obl: We aren't here for that! My patience is at an end, as will soon be your life!
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_TG04WhereIsAmusei_00035fad_Oblivi: We arrested that miscreant. The stupid lizard tried to blackmail the Countess. I wouldn't waste much time thinking about him any more.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_MS16Choice1A_00028150_Oblivion_RE: We believe it's somewhere south of Chorrol, but south-west of Fort Carmala. It may be difficult to find.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_MG04ChoiceCarahilContinue_0004f22: We believe the killings are the actions of a rogue mage. Battlemages have been sent to the Brina Cross Inn, the only common link between the victims.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_MerchantTopic_0002ee50_Oblivion_R: We believe these deaths to be the actions of a rogue Mage.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_SEDementiaRumorResponses_00061b75: We can all sleep better with the armies at full strength.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_RulesOfCompetition_0003d7b4_Obliv: We can do them any time of the day. You kidding? The citizens of the Imperial City would love some late-night entertainment!
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_SE02GatesOfMadness_0007eaaa_Obliv: We can go in? Well... I better stay here. There's no telling what kind of diseases are floating around in there.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GenericBanditB_000a333d_Oblivion_: We can play it that way if you like.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_Recommendation_0002e5e5_Oblivion_: We can talk, so long as Falcar is out of earshot. If I didn't know any better, I'd say he's trying to get you killed!
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_OblivionGateConv_000545f4_Oblivio: We can use your help! Let's go!
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_OblivionGateConv_000980aa_Oblivio: We can use your help! Let's go!
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GREETING_00043cd2_Oblivion_RESP1: We can't advance until you get that gate open!
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GREETING_00000923_Oblivion_RESP1: We can't be seen talking!  I waited for you last night behind the Great Chapel, where WERE you?!  I'll meet you there tonight.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GREETING_000224a8_Oblivion_RESP1: We can't keep stopping to talk like this! We've got to get out there and fight!
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_CastleGateTopic_00090ab5_Oblivion: We can't open that gate from out here. The only mechanism for raising it is inside the gatehouse.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_INFOGENERAL_00032e63_Oblivion_RES: We can't talk about it. Just go about your business. If Oreyn needs something, he'll let us know.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_MS38StartQuest_0002a871_Oblivion_: We can't talk here. Too public. Meet me behind the Great Chapel at midnight. Don't let anyone follow you. I'll make it worth your while.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_MQ05BaurusA_00022b14_Oblivion_RES: We can't talk now! Just follow my lead.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_WeatherleahTopic_00028ac4_Oblivio: We can't wait to return to Weatherleah, now that the ogres are dead!
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_MS29ThoronirBad_0000bca2_Oblivion: We cannot do it ourselves, as he recognizes all of us. The job pays a fair bounty in gold when he is brought to justice.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_SE08CommanderGreeting3a_000186fc_: We cannot talk now -- we don't have very long until the next wave arrives.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_SE08CommanderGreeting3a_00018c7e_: We cannot talk now -- we don't have very long until the next wave arrives.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_NDKnightsStartCombat_00002b4f_Kni: We cannot win this battle! You must destroy the Orb at once!
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_SE07Become_00013657_Oblivion_RESP: We celebrate him with the Ritual of Accession... the path to Maniac Bliss.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GREETING_00034ea8_Oblivion_RESP1: We come to the real work at last.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_ICAllNQDResponses_00049964_Oblivi: We could just listen to people talking. It's uncanny how informed people are.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_KvatchTopic_0002855b_Oblivion_RES: We couldn't have been any less prepared for this. Seems like they came out of nowhere. There were just so many of them...
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_RaynilDralasTopic_0003843c_Oblivi: We did a follow up investigation, and it's true that no one recollects seeing Bradon out in the daylight. He's only been spotted at night.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GREETING_0003c144_Oblivion_RESP1: We did it! We showed those damned daedra a thing or two!
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_MQ09GhostB_00036666_Oblivion_RESP: We did not know that the Underking, who was Zurin Arctus, had arisen to take his first revenge upon his former lord.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_INFOGENERAL_000ace2c_Oblivion_RES: We don't go looking for new worshippers. If people are interested, they can find us.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GREETING_0004d827_Oblivion_RESP2: We don't have any horses for sale right now. You bought our last Bay horse.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GREETING_0004d16d_Oblivion_RESP2: We don't have any horses for sale right now. You bought our last White horse.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GREETING_0002c592_Oblivion_RESP1: We don't have time to talk. I want to find Blackheart. What do you need?
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_CharGenMain_00032b06_Oblivion_RES: We don't know that, Sire. The messenger only said they were attacked.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_HELLO_00028bc8_Oblivion_RESP1: We don't like strangers meddling in our affairs.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GREETING_00028212_Oblivion_RESP1: We don't like strangers poking their noses into our business.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_HackdirtTopic_000286a0_Oblivion_R: We don't look kindly on strangers asking questions.  If you need a room, try Moslin's Inn.  Otherwise, you'd best be moving on.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GREETING_0004e8c3_Oblivion_RESP2: We don't much like spellcasters in Hammerfell. Wizards steal souls and tamper with minds. If you use magic, you're weak or wicked.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_TGGrayFox_000165e4_Oblivion_RESP1: We don't talk about him in public. The Thieves Guild follows the Gray Fox. However, we make sure that most folks think he is just a myth.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_INFOGENERAL_000ace2a_Oblivion_RES: We don't want more worshippers. We just want to be left alone.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_INFOGENERAL_000ace48_Oblivion_RES: We don't welcome visitors, but we don't murder them either.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_BrumaTopic_0003c98b_Oblivion_RESP: We drink because we're happy. We're Nords. It's just the thick tongue and fat head the day after that makes me unhappy.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_MG09Choice5C_00022bdd_Oblivion_RE: We feared Hassildor may have been involved with the Necromancers. Thanks to your involvement, it would seem that he is not.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GREETING_00031036_Oblivion_RESP4: We figured it was time to move on to a new prank. This one was getting boring, anyway. So you can tell her you've found me!
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_INFOGENERAL_00032e89_Oblivion_RES: We filled the Desolate Mine contract, but the butcher's bill was pretty steep.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GOODBYE_0003c35a_Oblivion_RESP1: We finally got him! There'll be no excuses this time. Ulrich is mine.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_FGD05Choice9_0002c622_Oblivion_RE: We find Blackheart and get that weapon. We'll finish this contract and let all of Cyrodiil know what happened here.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_ND10FinThedretGreeting01a_00002ca: We found Umaril's body next to yours, but it seemed that you had met the same fate as Pelinal Whitestrake. We didn't know...
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_MS13Gate_000329e9_Oblivion_RESP5: We found the way back blocked by more daedra. So we were stuck here until rescued by you. It's just like Farwil to leap before he looks.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_ND03AltarofKynareth_00002a4f_Knig: We gather here to pay tribute to all of the blessings she bestows upon us.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GREETING_00022506_Oblivion_RESP1: We got plenty of rooms if you want one. Ain't nobody staying here these days 'cept old Rufio.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GaltusPreviaTOPIC_0002d729_Oblivi: We got the contract from his aunt. Was in Nonwyll looking for gems of some sort. Never heard from again. You and Viranus go find him.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GREETING_0003d49b_Oblivion_RESP1: We had a feeling you'd be surprised when you saw us in our real uniforms. I see you have a puzzled look on your face. Ask away.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_SE42AgreeLie_0007322e_Oblivion_RE: We had an agreement, don't you remember? I'm trying to build a skyboat and you are supposed to bring me calipers and tongs.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_KvatchTopic_000699fc_Oblivion_RES: We had everything here. Beautiful gardens. Fresh mountain air. Did you know Kvatch had the only Arena in Cyrodiil outside the Imperial City?
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_MS46Goblins_00033efc_Oblivion_RES: We had just set up at Cropsford when Mirisa came running in. Said goblins were heading our way. We barely escaped with our lives!
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_NDKnightsTopic_00002bd6_Knights_R: We had only the best of intentions. Truly, we did. We meant only to serve the Nine and the Empire. It's hard to believe it all went so wrong.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_MS26CorruptGuard_00035c98_Oblivio: We had to pay his "fine" or go to jail.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_MS26CorruptGuard_000363b8_Oblivio: We had to pay the "fine" or he was going to march us off to jail.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_MS46NewSettlement_000319d6_Oblivi: We have a charter from the county, everything done official and by the book.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GREETING_0003d49a_Oblivion_RESP1: We have a lot of paperwork and follow-up investigation to do. Please, leave us to it.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_MQ06MankarSpeech_0001fb36_Oblivio: We have a new Brother who wishes to bind himself to the service of Lord Dagon.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_MQ06MankarSpeech_0001fb35_Oblivio: We have a new Sister who wishes to bind herself to the service of Lord Dagon.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_INFOGENERAL_00032e60_Oblivion_RES: We have a new master. And with Oreyn to run daily affairs, we should be in good shape.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_MG00JoinA_0002d284_Oblivion_RESP4: We have a responsibility to look after one another, don't we? I dare say we do, no matter what the costs.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_TG06Trespassing_0000bf89_Oblivion: We have a... situation. The Count has sent most of the servants home. You have to leave. Sorry, but you ain't working here anymore either.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_MQ15SavageGarden_00047364_Oblivio: We have all died in the Master's service. Here in Gaiar Alata we are immortal, and wait to return to Tamriel after Lord Dagon's final victory.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_Accuse_00035659_Oblivion_RESP1: We have already been through this, and I admitted my guilt.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_HELLO_0001c4d9_Oblivion_RESP1: We have awaited your arrival, messenger.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GREETING_0007be56_Oblivion_RESP3: We have awaited your arrival. Tell us, what news do you bring from Akavir?
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_mission_000356f1_Oblivion_RESP1: We have been contracted by the town of Water's Edge to rid their town of goblins. They've been raiding for days, and appear to be in large numbers.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_MehrunesDagonTopic_00097cc3_Obliv: We have been preparing for the coming of Lord Dagon for many years. You come to us at a fateful time.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_ThreeSigns_0006bf17_Oblivion_RESP: We have but the six sheep in our pasture, and we make sure they are well-tended.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GREETING_00036646_Oblivion_RESP1: We have fulfilled our last duty. We go now to Aetherius without shame. Farewell.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_ThreeSigns_00026af5_Oblivion_RESP: We have had some livestock die recently, but not all of them, which is a relief.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_RaynilDralasTopic_00038438_Oblivi: We have it on good authority from officials in a neighboring city that Raynil is what he says he is. So I'm not sure what you're trying to prove.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GREETING_00023e7a_Oblivion_RESP2: We have much to discuss, but if you have time, I'd beg you stay a moment longer and hear about our home, Weatherleah.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_BlackSoulGemMG17_00015459_Oblivio: We have much to speak of, and very little time. A new task awaits you, and it is by far the most important you have been entrusted with.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GREETING_000685a3_Oblivion_RESP1: We have only once chance at this! Use the portal to Camoran's Paradise before it closes again!
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GREETING_0000291e_Knights_RESP2: We have orders to leave everything just the way it was until the investigation into the Chapel attack is finished.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_MG11ChoiceExplain_00033540_Oblivi: We have overlooked these questions because we are so focused on rooting out the Necromancers as quickly as possible.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_HorseInquiry_0004d82e_Oblivion_RE: We have some of the best Bay horses in Cyrodiil. They are hardier than the Chestnut and faster than the Paint horses.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_HorseInquiry_0004ce57_Oblivion_RE: We have the finest white horses in Cyrodiil. None are hardier, and only the black horses of Cheydinhal are faster.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GREETING_0004bf9b_Oblivion_RESP1: We have to get Martin to the Temple of the One or Mehrunes Dagon has won after all.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_StolenGold_0005371e_Oblivion_RESP: We have to get him to tell us about the gold. Use any trick you can.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_HELLO_0009837e_Oblivion_RESP1: We have to stay in our homes while the Watch searches for the Gray Fox.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_INFOGENERAL_00032ea0_Oblivion_RES: We have trainers for block and marksman in Skingrad. And there's a shepherd who teaches athletics, too, I think.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_AncotarTopic_000301e5_Oblivion_RE: We haven't seen him since that whole invisibility mess. I hope it stays that way!
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_SeersStone_00033793_Oblivion_RESP: We haven't yet spoken to the others, for fear they would be less than accepting of her situation. Perhaps it is time, though.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_MG13EridorWhy_0003446e_Oblivion_R: We heard tell that vampires have infiltrated the town. Came here to root them out.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_SE04Who_0001330b_Oblivion_RESP1: We hold on to fleeting things even as we slip. I knew, and yet I indulged myself anyway. I indulged her a fair bit, too. Hee hee!
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_SEAltarofDespairTopic_0007ff5e_Ob: We hold the Altar of Despair, here within the Shrine of the Flame of Agnon.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_HELLO_0005c0c2_Oblivion_RESP1: We honor the Rose and its bearer.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_HELLO_00033b26_Oblivion_RESP1: We is most pleased... eth... ified.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GREETING_00031036_Oblivion_RESP3: We just get tired of Jeanne lording her position over us, when she barely knows anything about magic. Every now and then, we like to trick her.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_HELLO_0004d0b7_Oblivion_RESP1: We just made it through to the Palace. The Market District was swarming with daedra.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_INFOGENERAL_00032e65_Oblivion_RES: We just need to keep our heads down and try to do our jobs. Oreyn's doing what he can from the outside.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_SE07BGreenmote_000167e3_Oblivion_: We keep the Greenmote safely tucked inside the Greenmote Silo. You can imagine the ruckus if its location was known.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_Attack_00090cb9_Oblivion_RESP1: We kill and kill and kill! All we know is death! It ends here!
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_DarkBrotherhoodTopic_000bba98_Obl: We kill for profit, for enjoyment, and for the glory of the Dread Father, Sithis. We are family, with bonds forged in blood and death.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_MS13Gate_000c4531_Oblivion_RESP3: We killed scores... nay, hundreds of evil daedra! The ground ran thick with their dark blood.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_ND10FinThedretGreeting01_00002c9d: We knew you had succeeded in destroying Umaril's physical form, but it seemed that you had met the same fate as Pelinal Whitestrake.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GREETING_000473c4_Oblivion_RESP2: We knew you would find your way here eventually. But it is of no consequence.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GREETING_0001ecdd_Oblivion_RESP1: We know how to deal with criminals in Bleaker's Way!
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GREETING_0000290d_Knights_RESP4: We laid you to rest in the undercroft... we kept your death a secret. We feared what would happen if our enemies thought you were dead.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_FGD05Choice5_0002c5c0_Oblivion_RE: We leave as soon as you're ready. I want to investigate Blackheart's stronghold at Arpenia. Meet me at the Leyawiin guild hall. We'll go from there.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GOODBYE_0007a022_Oblivion_RESP1: We live at your whim, Lord Sheogorath.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_WeatherleahTopic_00028abf_Oblivio: We look forward to returning to our family's ancestral home at Weatherleah, once the ogres are dead.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_INFOGENERAL_00032e6b_Oblivion_RES: We lost Vitellus and a lot of good men against Blackheart. Somebody must be pretty good to take him and all his people.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GREETING_00062be9_Oblivion_RESP3: We lost a lot of good men that day. But Bruma is still standing. That's what counts.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_MS48SalvianWhatHappened_00098142_: We lost the damned city, that's what happened!
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_MS13Gate_000329e9_Oblivion_RESP4: We lost two more in that skirmish, as well as Farwil and I being wounded badly. It was at this point we considered retreat.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_SE39RanarrJo_00072c95_Oblivion_RE: We made Sheogorath by planting little seeds in the ground and watering them with our tears and blood.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GREETING_0002e71e_Oblivion_RESP1: We made it!... errr, I mean... victory is ours once again! Huzzah!
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GREETING_00031eba_Oblivion_RESP1: We made it!... errr, I mean... victory is ours once again! Huzzah! It's a shame that Bremman didn't make it though. He was a good knight.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_ND07LathonGreetB1_00002b80_Knight: We made our way to Lord Vlindrel's crypt. Sir Roderic spoke the words that unsealed the tomb...
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_Barter_00062157_Oblivion_RESP1: We may be in the Choosy Beggar, but here you can eat like a king.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_SE05HerdirInvestigateCurrentTask_: We may have to torture dozens of people before we find one who knows something. How exciting!
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_DAVaerminaSpeech_0008ade3_Oblivio: We meet again, mortal, for we have met before, whether you know it or not.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GREETING_0000292f_Knights_RESP1: We meet again. I am here to join your Order, having received a divine vision from Kynareth herself.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_HELLO_000982ca_Oblivion_RESP1: We might be able to grow turnips next spring.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_jointheFightersGuild_00027f8b_Obl: We might be able to use someone of your talents... if you've got a clean record, and a good reputation. Are you interested?
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_DANocturnalSpeech_00084a50_Oblivi: We mock the thieves, for bitter is their loss. You, mortal, may take this. It shall open the secrets of dark places for you.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_SEDementiaRumorResponses_00061431: We must all be on watch.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_MQ13BattlePlans_000276a9_Oblivion: We must allow the Mythic Dawn to proceed with their plan to open three lesser Gates outside Bruma.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_NDTalkUmaril2_00002c55_Knights_RE: We must bide our time until our Commander has finished his quest for the Relics. It is hard, but the work of the gods cannot be rushed.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_SE05Conspiracy_000806ea_Oblivion_: We must carry out her wishes, however. And I, for one, am looking forward to, ahh... interacting with the citizens of Crucible.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_NDTalk2_00002bad_Knights_RESP1: We must deal with that situation in Daggerfall. You know... the ghost. Dead king or some such?
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GREETING_00017972_Oblivion_RESP2: We must discuss our next move. The spire is obviously their source of power. This battle will not end until we find a way to shut it down.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GREETING_00017d54_Oblivion_RESP2: We must discuss our next move. The spire is obviously their source of power. This battle will not end until we find a way to shut it down.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GREETING_0002822e_Oblivion_RESP1: We must escape! Do you understand? We're the only two left! We're next! If we don't find a way out of here, we're going to die!
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GREETING_00016ecb_Oblivion_RESP1: We must find Dylora and free her!
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GREETING_0002e57f_Oblivion_RESP1: We must find Galtus Previa. He must be here somewhere.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_Dark16Choice2A_000262d8_Oblivion_: We must find out who is behind this betrayal! We haven't much time... I am hunted day and night by the Black Hand! They want me dead!
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_Dark16Choice2B_000262d9_Oblivion_: We must find out who is behind this betrayal! We haven't much time... I am hunted day and night by the Black Hand! They want me dead!
