ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_TG06Theranis_00010500_Oblivion_RE: You mean the thief? He was in the big cell with that Argonian. They were always whispering to each other. The Pale Lady took him days ago.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_MS16Choice2B_000242b4_Oblivion_RE: You mean there are still ogres there?
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_TG04GoodWord_00035faf_Oblivion_RE: You mean with the Thieves Guild? Sure, that way I'll be a member in good standing when they put my head on a pole!
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_TG11TalkToMillona10_00022e84_Obli: You mean you were unable to return?
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_HorseTooMuchSkingrad_000545de_Obl: You mean you're too poor. That's a fair price for this horse.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_CheydinhalTopic_0004e896_Oblivion: You might also look at Quickwater Cave to the north. I cleared it out, but I haven't been there in years. It might have new tenants.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_ReadyForAMatch_0001c27e_Oblivion_: You might be ready, but the Arena ain't. Matches take place between 9:00 AM and 9:00 PM. Come back later, moron.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_ImpGallTOPIC_0002ee71_Oblivion_RE: You might check Robbers Glen Cave for the imp gall. That place has been known to contain the imps.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_MiscarcandTopic_00026efe_Oblivion: You might find 'Glories and Laments Among the Ayleid Ruins' useful. I have the library's copy at my table if you need it.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_SE44AllItems_0007873c_Oblivion_RE: You might find it handy to cause confusion in your enemies. You know... when the time comes.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_MG01Choice1A_0002d414_Oblivion_RE: You might want to ask around, and see if anyone can be of some help. Let me know when he's back, and you'll have your recommendation.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_BleakFlatsCaveTopic_0002d6e7_Obli: You might want to make sure she remembers. Especially the part about it being her idea.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_MG13EridorWhy_0003446f_Oblivion_R: You mind your business, and we'll mind ours.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_BradonLirrianTopic_00038f3d_Obliv: You must avenge his unjust death.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GREETING_0002c51a_Oblivion_RESP1: You must be Umbacano's new plaything. Well met! I am Claude Maric, another pawn in Umbacano's game.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_ReadyForAMatch_0000c167_Oblivion_: You must be downright determined to get yourself killed, huh? Okay then, head back up to the Arena and try not to die before the gate opens.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_MS12Reman_000980f6_Oblivion_RESP1: You must be joking, right? Who hasn't heard of the greatest known hero of the First Age?
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GREETING_0002d58e_Oblivion_RESP2: You must be new. Oh, it's so nice to see new faces in the guild!
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_MysteriumXarxes_00022b3c_Oblivion: You must be referring to Mankar Camoran's "Commentaries on the Mysterium Xarxes." A common mistake.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GREETING_0004f8b0_Oblivion_RESP1: You must be rid of the staff, or the scamps will follow you around forever!
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_MS26CorruptGuard_00035c9f_Oblivio: You must be stupid to accuse me of corruption to my face.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_NDBootsoftheCrusader_00002a49_Kni: You must be tested by Kynareth before you are worthy of the Boots.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_HELLO_000a7156_Oblivion_RESP1: You must be the Gray Fox. Your reputation precedes you, as I'm sure you know.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GREETING_000982d9_Oblivion_RESP1: You must be the cat burglar I've been told to expect. Follow me.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_HELLO_0000bf98_Oblivion_RESP1: You must be the new slop drudge.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GREETING_00028877_Oblivion_RESP1: You must be the reinforcement from the guild. Good. I hope you brought weapons for us.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_Dark09RetFinChoice1A_00032bec_Obl: You must break one of the Tenets you have sworn to uphold. I know this is an unexpected turn of events, but drastic measures must be taken.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_Dark09RetFinChoice1B_00032bed_Obl: You must break one of the Tenets you have sworn to uphold. I know this is an unexpected turn of events, but drastic measures must be taken.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_Dark09RetFinChoice1C_00032bee_Obl: You must break one of the Tenets you have sworn to uphold. I know this is an unexpected turn of events, but drastic measures must be taken.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GOODBYE_0003c360_Oblivion_RESP1: You must bring that evidence to Garrus. Make haste.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_TGSpecialJobs_00002de1_Oblivion_R: You must do more to fill the guild's treasury before I can assign you commission jobs.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_MQ07ProgressNone_00038fad_Oblivio: You must eliminate both the Mythic Dawn agents in Bruma. We cannot allow them to continue to plot against us.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GREETING_000685a4_Oblivion_RESP1: You must enter the portal to Camoran's Paradise and reclaim the Amulet of Kings!
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_HELLO_000029de_Knights_RESP1: You must excuse me, as I'm not feeling well.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_TrainingQuestTopic_0018bc60_Obliv: You must find J'baana, and learn from him.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_HistTreeTopic_0003570c_Oblivion_R: You must find a way to destroy the Hist, though I can imagine Ri'Zakar will have it well guarded. Expect an unfriendly welcome at their hall.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_HELLO_000029da_Knights_RESP1: You must finish what you have started if you wish the gods to look upon you with favor.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_ND09ProphetGreeting03_00002c11_Kn: You must first kill his living body. While beyond the power of most mortals, this is only the lesser of your two tasks.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GREETING_00009c7c_Oblivion_RESP5: You must fullfill your new duties. The statue in Bravil serves as a conduit between the Night Mother and the Listener.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_CGBaurusF_0001e90a_Oblivion_RESP1: You must get the Amulet to Jauffre. Take no chances, but proceed to Weynon Priory immediately. Got it?
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GREETING_00038580_Oblivion_RESP4: You must get there before he acquires whatever artifact is being kept there and makes his escape.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GREETING_00089938_Oblivion_RESP2: You must get to the top of the large tower. The Sigil Keep, they call it. That's what keeps the Oblivion Gate open!
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_HELLO_00022a12_Oblivion_RESP1: You must get us out of here.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_MQ02JauffreE1_0001e74e_Oblivion_R: You must go to Kvatch and find him at once. If the enemy is aware of his existence, as seems likely, he is in terrible danger.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_Dark04FinChoice1A_000253d7_Oblivi: You must go to the city of Chorrol and break into the house of Francois Motierre. Inside you will find Motierre waiting for you. Do not kill him!
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_MS31Selene05Positive_00015264_Obl: You must have been hiding down there and made your way up here. How did you get past Minx, Wrath and Lynch?
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_SE32WhatCanIDo_00012d05_Oblivion_: You must help us break the cycle of torment. Help my people overcome their weakness and defend Vitharn from the Fanatics.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GREETING_0000293f_Knights_RESP1: You must help us, Sir Knight! Save Cheydinhal from those monsters!
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GREETING_0000293c_Knights_RESP1: You must help! They appeared out of nowhere and started attacking!
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_MS29StopNo_0001e841_Oblivion_RESP: You must hurry. We cannot let him do this horrible task any longer.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_Dark06FinChoice1A_0003005d_Oblivi: You must infiltrate Fort Sutch, find Roderick's medicine, and replace it with a poisoned bottle I will provide. But you must remain undetected!
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_contract_000233d8_Oblivion_RESP1: You must infiltrate the Imperial Prison and kill Valen Dreth, a Dark Elf. He should be easy enough to eliminate, once you actually get inside.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_ServiceRefusal_0018d15c_Oblivion_: You must know your craft, and its history, before I will teach you anything.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_MS05WhatGives_0002c6db_Oblivion_R: You must learn to broaden your thoughts and hold your tongue! Allow me to explain before jumping to conclusions!
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GOODBYE_0003c35d_Oblivion_RESP1: You must locate Aldos. He's a danger to himself and others in his condition.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_BlackSoulGemMG17_000151f5_Oblivio: You must make sure the gem does not reach Mannimarco. We are doomed if it does.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GREETING_00094c38_Oblivion_RESP1: You must not have heard me the first time. Good day!
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GlarthirTopic_00029aa5_Oblivion_R: You must not have heard. He went crazy and killed Davide Surilie with an axe! Nobody can figure out why.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_MQ15Anaxes_00047366_Oblivion_RESP: You must not release him, for pity's sake!
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_Dark01Choice5A_00022ba9_Oblivion_: You must now go to the city of Cheydinhal, to the abandoned house near the eastern wall. Enter the basement, and attempt to open the Black Door.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_Dark01Choice5B_00022baa_Oblivion_: You must now go to the city of Cheydinhal, to the abandoned house near the eastern wall. Enter the basement, and attempt to open the black door.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_Dark01Choice5C_00022bab_Oblivion_: You must now go to the city of Cheydinhal, to the abandoned house near the eastern wall. Enter the basement, and attempt to open the black door.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GREETING_00035e02_Oblivion_RESP3: You must open these sealed orders immediately and follow their instructions to the letter. It would seem the Black Hand itself has a task for you.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_SE03AWhatWere_000807b9_Oblivion_R: You must proceed to Sheogorath at once and tell him the Knights have returned! Quickly now... go!
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_ND06CasimirGauntlets_00002b24_Kni: You must prove to Stendarr you are worthy to lift the Gauntlets once more. Seek out the priests in Chorrol. Perhaps they can help you.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_MG00JoinA_0002d289_Oblivion_RESP2: You must receive a recommendation from every local guild hall in Cyrodiil before you may advance through the ranks of the guild.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_DEAkTimeWound_00014e28_AltarDelux: You must retreive it at all costs, Hero.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GREETING_000459b5_Oblivion_RESP2: You must return any property that does not belong to you. Now, will you serve your sentence in the dungeon, or pay reparations?
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GREETING_000459b7_Oblivion_RESP2: You must return any stolen items. I regret that I have no choice but to escort you to the dungeon, as you are short of the required reparations.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_MQ02JauffreE1_0001e74d_Oblivion_R: You must return to Kvatch at once, and rescue Martin if he lives. There is no time to lose!
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GREETING_00024e54_Oblivion_RESP1: You must slay the sacrifice to bind yourself fully to Lord Dagon's service. Lord Dagon thirsts for blood.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GREETING_0001d243_Oblivion_RESP1: You must speak with Seridur first.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_Dark05Choice2A_0004cacf_Oblivion_: You must then flee from Chorrol, and Hides-His-Heart must not be killed! That way he can go back and tell his employers I'm dead.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_Dark05Choice2B_0004cad0_Oblivion_: You must then flee from Chorrol, and Hides-His-Heart must not be killed! That way he can go back and tell his employers I'm dead.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_NightMother_00188308_Oblivion_RES: You must understand our need for darkness and secrecy? Speak to me only between the hours of midnight and 3:00 AM, and we will be off.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_SE36Choice4SoWhat_00061c4c_Oblivi: You must... you must kill me.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_ChorrolTopic_00024e11_Oblivion_RE: You need a place to sleep in Chorrol? Well, why don't you just join the Fighters Guild, or Mages Guild? Sleep for free around Cyrodiil!
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GREETING_00091757_Oblivion_RESP2: You need his blood, so take it!
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_TGSpecialJobs_00034877_Oblivion_R: You need more experience before I can use you on a commission job. Ongar tells me that you haven't turned in much loot yet.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_bed_0003b346_Oblivion_RESP1: You need someplace to rest? I can rent you a room for the night for 10 gold.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GREETING_00004b9d_DLCVileLair_RES: You need something... special? Check out my wares. You won't find this stuff at your local general store, that's for damn sure.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GREETING_000c45bb_Oblivion_RESP1: You need something... special? Check out my wares. You won't find this stuff at your local general store, that's for damn sure.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_HELLO_00025292_Oblivion_RESP1: You need something? A room maybe?
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GREETING_00027d7e_Oblivion_RESP3: You need to close the Great Gate! We'll try to hold them off as long as we can!
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_MartinTopic_0003406c_Oblivion_RES: You need to find him at once and bring him safely back here.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GREETING_0007bacf_Oblivion_RESP1: You need to find the Count! Get moving!
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_contract_00003935_Oblivion_RESP1: You need to find the Stone of St. Alessia and return it to Cirroc at the Chapel of Talos in Bruma. Now, get to it.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_FGD02Insults_0002cfbf_Oblivion_RE: You need to find us work. You're supposed to be boss!
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GREETING_000091f6_Oblivion_RESP1: You need to finish out the contract with Biene Amelion in Water's Edge. What's the status?
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GREETING_0001e8b1_Oblivion_RESP1: You need to get out of here. There's no telling who will come first, the Blades or more assassins.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GREETING_0002006f_Oblivion_RESP1: You need to get the Mysterium Xarxes from the Mythic Dawn's Shrine of Dagon. It is our only hope to retrieve the Amulet of Kings.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GREETING_0000be61_Oblivion_RESP1: You need to go find Lady Rogbut, meat! Why are you standing here talking to me?
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GREETING_0008320d_Oblivion_RESP1: You need to help Arvena Thelas with her rat problem. What's on your mind?
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_Trespass_0007dfe9_Oblivion_RESP1: You need to leave this place, mortal. Quickly.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_BarterFail_000091e1_Oblivion_RESP: You need to make a better offer.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GREETING_00054221_Oblivion_RESP1: You need to see Ugak if you want to buy a horse. She's inside.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_SEFelldew_00043020_Oblivion_RESP2: You need to strike a balance with how often you ingest Felldew, and how willing you are to live with the side-effects.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_contract_00009c35_Oblivion_RESP1: You need to take care of those fugitives from the prison break in Bravil.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GREETING_00024da5_Oblivion_RESP1: You need to take care of you problems with the guild before we can talk.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_duties_0002e586_Oblivion_RESP1: You need to track down Maglir. Again. Look for him in Bravil. Now go.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_VidkunTopic_0002e5b1_Oblivion_RES: You needn't concern yourself with him. He was unfit to be a guild member, and it's better that he's no longer part of it.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_MagesStaff_0002c67c_Oblivion_RESP: You needn't tell me the details of what was involved in getting it; it's perhaps better that I know nothing about it.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_Barter_00038992_Oblivion_RESP1: You never know when you might need a good strong potion. Best to stock up now while you can!
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GREETING_00047630_Oblivion_RESP1: You new here? I'm Servatius Quintilius, Officer of the Watch. Just stay out of trouble, and we'll get along just fine.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_AnvilTopic_0003e0ba_Oblivion_RESP: You notice all the Nords around here? It's partly because Nords like ships and sailing. Mostly, we're sick of freezing our asses off in Skyrim.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_SE07ARuler_00031622_Oblivion_RESP: You now have the power to summon Dark Seducers. They've always served the Duke of Dementia. I think they have a thing for pain.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_SE07BRuler_0009130d_Oblivion_RESP: You now have the power to summon Golden Saints. They've always served the Duke of Mania. I think it's the bright colors. They just love 'em.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_SE11StaffOfSheogorath_00019cce_Ob: You now hold the physical component of the Staff of Sheogorath. Before it is complete however, it must be imbued with power.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_TG01ThievesTest_0001811e_Oblivion: You now owe your loyalty to our guildmaster, the Gray Fox. He has three rules you must follow.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_TG01ThievesTest_0001c14e_Oblivion: You now owe your loyalty to our guildmaster, the Gray Fox. He has three rules you must follow.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_UniqueSummoningTopic_00091914_Obl: You of course recall Rufio, the feeble old man I sent you to kill when we first met? He was weak in life, but his spirit is quite angry in death.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_advancementFG_0003355a_Oblivion_R: You outrank me, now, so there's certainly no more I can do for you. You might check with an old friend of yours, though.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GREETING_000a55ec_Oblivion_RESP1: You owe S'razirr. Will you pay?
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_SE09VictimChoice1b_00082090_Obliv: You persecute genius when you find it, because we are able to see around the sharp corners of your simplified "morality."
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GREETING_0002d765_Oblivion_RESP1: You picked a bad time to visit Kvatch.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_NDProphetSpeechLoremasters_00002d: You pore over your dusty tomes of lore. You study ancient genealogies and bloodlines.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_Dark18Choice2A_00090792_Oblivion_: You possess strength, and cunning, and a heart as black as midnight. You were marked by Sithis the moment you emerged from your mother's womb.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_Dark18Choice2B_00090793_Oblivion_: You possess strength, and cunning, and a heart as black as midnight. You were marked by Sithis the moment you emerged from your mother's womb.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_Dark18Choice2C_00090794_Oblivion_: You possess strength, and cunning, and a heart as black as midnight. You were marked by Sithis the moment you emerged from your mother's womb.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_SE11StaffOfSheogorath_0007eb5e_Ob: You possess the eye and the branch. Together, they shall form the physical shape of the Staff of Sheogorath.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_Dark01Choice2C_00022ba1_Oblivion_: You prefer silence, then? As do I, my dear child. As do I. For is silence not the symphony of death, the orchestration of Sithis himself?
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_BarterSellItem_0009ea87_Oblivion_: You probably cheated me, didn't you?
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_MS49ChoiceNoTime_00031d2c_Oblivio: You probably couldn't find it on your own. I'm coming with you. If we make it, I'll open the door for you.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_SE36Choice6HowDie_00061c4e_Oblivi: You probably want to do it without spectators though, so you don't get in trouble. Best to make it look like an accident.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_NDSirBerichTopic_00002c7c_Knights: You put right the evil that I began through my own weakness. Sir Berich is once again part of our fellowship, and shall be forevermore.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_SE38OddityDonate_00043439_Oblivio: You really are a dear! A true friend to the Museum. Perhaps Lord Sheogorath himself will come see the exhibit one day.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GREETING_000301e0_Oblivion_RESP1: You really enjoy this whole hero thing, don't you? Everybody fawning all over you? I'm not like that.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GREETING_00002983_Knights_RESP1: You really fought that Umaril creature in the sky over the Imperial City? I would have liked to have seen that!
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GREETING_00053774_Oblivion_RESP2: You really should be more careful when you talk in the dungeons... the sound tends to carry. Jorundr's such an idiot.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_SESheogorathHitTalk_0005552c_Obli: You really shouldn't have done that. Enjoy the view.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GREETING_00002914_Knights_RESP1: You redeemed my soul from the evil that had ensnared me. For that I am forever in your debt.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GREETING_0001e43e_Oblivion_RESP1: You remain faithful. That is good. I will cut your throat if you visit that other smith.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_HELLO_0007311e_Oblivion_RESP1: You remind me of a character from a book I'm reading.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_HELLO_00062cec_Oblivion_RESP1: You remind me of a witch I once knew. I hate witches.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_HELLO_00062cf5_Oblivion_RESP1: You remind me of my homeland. During the Blight.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_SE06HelpDefendA2_000131b8_Oblivio: You return to Kaneh and lead her into the trap. Once they are destroyed, I will kindle the Altars. Good hunting, friend.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GREETING_000029a4_Knights_RESP1: You return to Kynareth's Altar. Have you changed your mind? Do you still seek the Boots of the Crusader?
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GREETING_0003630e_Oblivion_RESP1: You return to me, yet you bear no news? Go, Silencer, uncover the identity of the traitor! The fate of the Dark Brotherhood rests in your hands!
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_ND03TestofKynareth_00002a56_Knigh: You return unsuccessful, but have involved yourself in other matters. Settle your combat, and return to me then.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_BarterBuyItem_000981b8_Oblivion_R: You ripped me off blind. I hope you're happy with yourself.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GREETING_00026ab1_Oblivion_RESP1: You risk much by speaking to me. You should leave this place. Now.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_SQ03Avenge_00189cf9_Oblivion_RESP: You risked life and limb for a cause that wasn't your own. For that, I'm grateful. Please, accept these gems as a token of my gratitude.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_MS10AldosTalk_0003c2b9_Oblivion_R: You s'wit! How dare you! Ulrich be damned! He can take his fine and stuff it up his backside!
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_ErthorTopic_0004b8e7_Oblivion_RES: You said he was at Bleak Flats Cave. Haven't you looked there for him?
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GREETING_0001dc2b_Oblivion_RESP1: You said you wanted me to solve this myself. And I am. Drastic measures. Didn't want to, but you're right, it is the only way.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GREETING_001896ac_Oblivion_RESP2: You saved my life. You brought me back from hell. I won't forget it.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GREETING_0000297f_Knights_RESP1: You saved the church from that wicked old Ayleid king, didn't you? Well done!
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GREETING_00041205_Oblivion_RESP1: You saw my last show, and came to mock me, right? Don't worry, I already know. I disgust myself.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_AldosOthranTopic_0003c3b1_Oblivio: You saw what happened, I had no choice. Aldos attacked first, and I had to defend myself.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_TGGrayFox_00000a1b_Oblivion_RESP1: You say a beggar told you seek me out? Good enough for me then. The beggars are the eyes and ears of the Gray Fox.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_MS46GoblinWar_00033ef6_Oblivion_R: You say you took the head from the Timberscar Cave goblins? Where is it, then?
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_StoneofStAlessiaTOPIC_0000392c_Ob: You say you've found it, but you no longer have it? What madness is this? Please, you must return it to us immediately!
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_FGD02Insults_0002cfd0_Oblivion_RE: You scare off my customers. Go away!
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_ImperialCityTopic_0004767d_Oblivi: You see Khajiit always running through the City? You see Ra'Jiradh and his brothers! We bring the Black Horse Courier to the good citizens, yes?
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_AnvilTopic_0003e0c2_Oblivion_RESP: You see a sailor in the streets of Anvil, best step out of his way. If it's in his mind to raise hell, a little jail time is just fair payment.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_NDProphetTopic_00002a85_Knights_R: You see me now a changed man. Lathon can testify to that. Before I met the Prophet, I was nothing more than a hired sword.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GREETING_00081792_Oblivion_RESP1: You see now what happens when those who oppose me fail, which they always do.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_Dark04FinChoice1A_000253d7_Oblivi: You see, Francois Motierre is a marked man. He owes a considerable sum to the wrong kind of people. So, they have sent an enforcer to kill him.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GOODBYE_0001e690_Oblivion_RESP1: You see, I am the Master Smith of New Sheoth, don't bother with that other smith in town.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_MS47AleswellInvisible_0003003d_Ob: You see, in order to increase the efficacy of the spell, the radius was likely to approach the... never mind. I don't mean to bore you.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_SEThadonWaitingLong_000131da_Obli: You see? You see what I have to deal with? I can't recall if I'm coming or you're going without the Chalice of Reversal. Oh, now you've upset me.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GREETING_0001fc4a_Oblivion_RESP1: You seek more from me, child? It is as I have seen.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_NDBootsoftheCrusader_00002a4a_Kni: You seek the Boots of the Crusader? Kynareth will show you no favor until your current conflicts are resolved. Finish your fights, then return here.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_TrainingQuestTopic_0018b18d_Obliv: You seek training? If I were to aid you, you would first have to assist me. I would strip the Creators of their works... you will help with this.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GREETING_0002db93_Oblivion_RESP1: You seek wisdom from me, child? Ah, no. You seek words.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GREETING_0003c296_Oblivion_RESP1: You seem far too nice to be one of Ulrich's men. What can I do for you?
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_HELLO_0001e7cd_Oblivion_RESP1: You seem in good spirits... do you have good news?
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GREETING_00028222_Oblivion_RESP1: You seem like a very nice person. I very much want to find the gold, but I wish you luck. May the best guest win. He he.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_HELLO_00062ca5_Oblivion_RESP1: You seem quite intriguing. Please, share your thoughts.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_Investigation_0003150a_Oblivion_R: You seem the trusting type. Perhaps you can assist me?
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_SE08SheldenGreeting1_00018e6c_Obl: You seem to have no trouble, though. Look at you, barely a scratch! You'd be the perfect person to protect me!
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GREETING_00002972_Knights_RESP1: You serve the Nine well, noble Knight.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GREETING_00018f86_Oblivion_RESP1: You served out the Mazken with their own medicine. Not the most glorious victory, perhaps, but Cylarne is ours at last thanks to you.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_HELLO_0001ad4b_Oblivion_RESP1: You set my blood on fire. Come closer and burn me.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_CGEmperor18_00032482_Oblivion_RES: You shall follow me yet for a while, then we must part.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GOODBYE_0004c5af_Oblivion_RESP1: You shall have a true Mages' Staff soon.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_SE09Ceremony_00014ad3_Oblivion_RE: You shall know them by the coldness in their minds. A darkness of spirit.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_poisonedknifetopic_000282fe_Obliv: You should also know that there's only enough Languorwine on the blade for this one contract. After Motierre is sliced, the knife will be useless.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_disappearances_0000be71_Oblivion_: You should ask Drarana Thelis about that.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_SE46DoublesTopic_0008fb69_Oblivio: You should ask Horkvir about it. Our Horkvir. Not the other one. He'd lie to you, I'm sure.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_HELLO_000451d1_Oblivion_RESP1: You should be elsewhere right now, shouldn't you?
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GREETING_00038fbd_Oblivion_RESP1: You should be gathering the items Martin needs for the Mysterium Xarxes ritual. There's no time to lose.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GREETING_00095a87_Oblivion_RESP1: You should be helping Irlav Jarol, shouldn't you?
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_HELLO_0004f3eb_Oblivion_RESP1: You should be helping out Elante by now.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GREETING_0008320c_Oblivion_RESP1: You should be helping out Norbert Lelles. What's on your mind?
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GREETING_00036621_Oblivion_RESP1: You should be looking for Pinarus! What are you doing here?
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GREETING_0008f514_Oblivion_RESP1: You should be off like the wind, solving problems and doing good deeds!
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GREETING_00022e02_Oblivion_RESP1: You should be on your way by now.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GREETING_0005c2fb_Oblivion_RESP1: You should be out acquiring a Mage's Staff for yourself. What do you need?
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GREETING_0003c139_Oblivion_RESP1: You should be proud of what you did here today, but remember, the war is not yet over.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_SE46DoublesTopic_00081ecb_Oblivio: You should be taking care of this, shouldn't you?
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_Recommendation_000174f3_Oblivion_: You should check his room in the living quarters. If you see the note, or anything else unusual, let me know. I'll gladly send it to the Council.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_TGOtherJobs_00018120_Oblivion_RES: You should check in with your Doyen every once in a while to see if there are any commission jobs available.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GREETING_00081527_Oblivion_RESP1: You should come see my museum, Lord Sheogorath. I've built it just to honor you.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_MQ06Cleansing_00036421_Oblivion_R: You should complete your initiation before we speak any further of that.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_MysteriumXarxes_00097cbf_Oblivion: You should complete your initiation before we speak any further of that.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_TrainingQuestTopic_0006244e_Obliv: You should consider going to Bruma, and talking with Helvius Cecia. He can teach you more than... well, probably anyone.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_TrainingQuestTopic_00062453_Obliv: You should consult her; I'm sure she can give you more training.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_MageTalk5_0006a873_Oblivion_RESP1: You should continue with your research. Consult some of the older tomes in the Mystic Archives. We'll talk again later after you learn more.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_contract_0002798c_Oblivion_RESP3: You should dress appropriately. The Deceiver's Finery, your recent quest reward, would serve this purpose nicely. If you earned it, that is...
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_TG01ThievesTest_0003563a_Oblivion: You should drop out now. You know I'm going to win.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GOODBYE_0008591b_Oblivion_RESP1: You should get back to work.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_TrainingQuestTopic_000613a1_Obliv: You should get out there, and experience things for yourself. Discover new places, travel to lands you've never seen.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_TestTodd_000281aa_Oblivion_RESP1: You should get this about 1/4 the time, too. The best way to test this is the click about 10 times and just jot down on notebook what you get.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_TestTodd_000281a9_Oblivion_RESP1: You should get this about 1/4 the time.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_AmuletofKingsTopic_0001efe3_Obliv: You should go back to the Imperial City. Baurus may have learned something about the assassins.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_NDProphetTopic_00002a8d_Knights_R: You should go to Anvil and hear him for yourself, if you're interested. They say he preaches outside the Chapel every day, rain or shine.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GOODBYE_00033582_Oblivion_RESP1: You should hasten to Castle Cheydinhal.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GREETING_00062be9_Oblivion_RESP1: You should have heard the cheer when you came out of that monster Gate with that Siege Machine right on your heels.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_Attack_000281a6_Oblivion_RESP1: You should have paid the fine!
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_Seen_0001a7ff_Oblivion_RESP1: You should have stayed hidden. Now you will taste my Lord's power.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_MythicDawnTopic_000a31be_Oblivion: You should keep working on getting a hold of those other Mythic Dawn books. That's our best lead right now.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_TG08LuckyGuess_0001474b_Oblivion_: You should know better than to give heed to rumors.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_TG04BribeBeggar_0000932f_Oblivion: You should know that there are other secrets in that castle.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_SE06DerveninGreetA_000400e4_Obliv: You should know, that in addition to the adulation of the people of Bliss, there is also a more... earthly reward.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_NDProphetTopic_00002a95_Knights_R: You should listen to him preach. He may sound crazy at first, but the longer you listen, the more sense he makes.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GREETING_0008ebf7_Oblivion_RESP1: You should not be here, Inquisitor. Perhaps you are lost? I have business to attend to. Excuse me.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_Trespass_0007dfea_Oblivion_RESP1: You should not be here, mortal.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GREETING_00098145_Oblivion_RESP1: You should not be here, mortal. Your blood is forfeit, your flesh is mine!
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_Trespass_0007dfe6_Oblivion_RESP1: You should not be in this place. It is best you leave.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_ShrineofNocturnalTOPIC_00026ac2_O: You should not be in this place. What is your business here? Do you believe yourself worthy to speak to Nocturnal?
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GREETING_000473c4_Oblivion_RESP3: You should not keep my father waiting any longer. He expected you hours ago. Come, you came here to see him, did you not?
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_TestChoice01_000281af_Oblivion_RE: You should only have goodbye as your option.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_DASanguineSpeech_000b121d_Oblivio: You should probably try to be inconspicuous. Or they might kill you. Oh, and the party is by invitation only. You'll have to find a way in. Have fun!
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_HELLO_0002412d_Oblivion_RESP1: You should really get to a healer. You're looking rather pale.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GOODBYE_00038fcb_Oblivion_RESP1: You should rendezvous with Captain Burd immediately. The sooner that gate is closed the better.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GREETING_0003020a_Oblivion_RESP2: You should return to Anvil and let Carahil know the work is complete. We'll remain here and clean things up.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GREETING_00017973_Oblivion_RESP4: You should return to the Palace and speak with Sheogorath. Ask Him how He plans to defend this Realm.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GREETING_0001796c_Oblivion_RESP4: You should return to the Palace and speak with Sheogorath. Ask him how he plans to defend this realm.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GREETING_0005a751_Oblivion_RESP1: You should return what you have stolen.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_MQ07ProgressAllDead_00020081_Obli: You should speak to Martin. I believe he has made some progress with the Mysterium Xarxes.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_MQ07ProgressPlans_00020085_Oblivi: You should speak to Martin. I believe he has made some progress with the Mysterium Xarxes.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GREETING_0001da58_Oblivion_RESP1: You should speak to Seridur first. He has your reward.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_VahtacenTopic_000150b7_Oblivion_R: You should speak to Skaleel before you do anything else. She's in charge of the project.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_SE06FlameAgnon_0003e6ad_Oblivion_: You should speak to the Grakedrig Ulfri at once. She will be glad of your help to rid Cylarne of the arrogant Aureals once and for all.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GOODBYE_00038fbf_Oblivion_RESP1: You should speak to the rulers of Cyrodiil as soon as possible. The danger to Bruma is growing by the day.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GREETING_00026ea8_Oblivion_RESP5: You should speak to the rulers of the other cities of Cyrodiil, as well as the Elder Council. Ask them to send aid to Bruma before it is too late.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_SE09HaskillGatekeeper_0004036a_Ob: You should speak with Relmyna Verenim as quickly as possible. I fear our time runs short.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_TG04WhatSecrets_0004b776_Oblivion: You should stay out of there, just in case.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_INFOGENERAL_00078165_Oblivion_RES: You should stop by the Museum of Oddities. I understand Una is always looking for more items to display.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_LucienLachanceTopic_00005679_Obli: You should take some time to admire his corpse. It really is a thing of beauty. The punctures and slashes are almost... poetic.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_FromTheDead_0001ce03_Oblivion_RES: You should take this book to Thoronir. Confronted with this, he may just see things differently.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_SE46DoublesTopic_0008faa8_Oblivio: You should talk to Horkvir. He knows what to do. Not their Horkvir... our Horkvir. I don't like the other one. Or any of them.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_MQWhatNext_00026ef4_Oblivion_RESP: You should talk to Jauffre. He needs your help. Trouble down in Bruma, I think.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GREETING_0008b614_Oblivion_RESP1: You should talk to Martin. He'll want to see the Mysterium Xarxes right away.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_MagesGuildTopic_00062bb2_Oblivion: You should think about joining the guild. If you're interested, talk to Jeanne Frasoric or one of the other local guild hall leaders.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_TrainingQuestTopic_000613a2_Obliv: You should track down Rusia Bradus in Anvil, and see if she can teach you anything more.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_MS38Next_00023669_Oblivion_RESP3: You should wait outside his house and see what he does when he's not watching me. I'll meet you here tomorrow night to get your report.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GREETING_0002a387_Oblivion_RESP1: You shouldn't be here now. I insist you leave.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_Trespass_000280c4_Oblivion_RESP1: You shouldn't be in here, stranger.  You better leave before somebody gets hurt.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_SE07GreymarchTopic_00091016_Obliv: You shouldn't be. It's the death of all things.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_SE07GreymarchTopic_00091273_Obliv: You shouldn't be. It's the death of all things.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_Attack_0004eda2_Oblivion_RESP1: You shouldn't have come after us!
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_Attack_000327c8_Oblivion_RESP1: You shouldn't have come for us!
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_HappyReceive_00023cd7_Oblivion_RE: You shouldn't have. That's very kind of you.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GOODBYE_00089931_Oblivion_RESP1: You shouldn't pass on golden opportunities.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_ND02SirAmielBattleCall_00002c04_K: You show a fury of faith that I have not seen in centuries. But now you face Sir Juncan.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_NDTalk5_00002bc6_Knights_RESP1: You show much wisdom, my friend. It would honor me if you were to lead this cause. I must go now. But we'll talk later, I promise.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_MSShadowscaleChoice2A_0003559e_Ob: You show unexpected mercy. For that I am thankful. My treasure is hidden in a hollowed-out rock near my campfire. It's yours.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_MaladaTopic_0002c523_Oblivion_RES: You showed admirable prudence. I was not half so sensible at your age, ha ha ha! Not to worry, I'm sure you will get the drop on me one day!
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GREETING_0001c0d1_Oblivion_RESP1: You showed that cat whose claws are sharper, eh? I would expect no less. Here's your gold. Now go wash up. You look awful.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GREETING_00022502_Oblivion_RESP1: You sleep rather soundly for a murderer. That's good. You'll need a clear conscience for what I'm about to propose.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_HELLO_0018bcb7_Oblivion_RESP1: You smell of death. Been conjuring up dead things?
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_MQ15KathutetB2_0003e8f3_Oblivion_: You speak directly like one of my people almost. I'm glad I did not kill you immediately.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_NDTalkRelics3_00002c6a_Knights_RE: You speak truly, brother. Go with the blessing.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_NDTalkGarlas3_00002c3e_Knights_RE: You speak truly, sir knight. We'll have time for more tales later, I'm sure. Farewell.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_NDTalkUmaril3_00002c51_Knights_RE: You speak truly. I will pray for more patience.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GREETING_0002db95_Oblivion_RESP1: You speak, yet I cannot hear. You listen, yet I cannot speak. When the voices grow quiet, then shall our time be at hand.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_MQ03MartinC2_00092268_Oblivion_RE: You spoke to the Emperor before he died? And he told you to find me?
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GREETING_000224f5_Oblivion_RESP2: You stand now in our Sanctuary. May it serve as your new home, a place of comfort and security whenever the need arises.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GREETING_000224f6_Oblivion_RESP3: You stand now in our Sanctuary. May it serve as your new home, a place of comfort and security whenever the need arises.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_CharGenVoice_00015136_Oblivion_RE: You stay here, prisoner. Don't try to follow us.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_CheydinhalTopic_0004e8cd_Oblivion: You stupid or something? What are you doing here? Go back where you came from. We don't like your kind here.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GREETING_00081f3b_Oblivion_RESP1: You sure didn't mess things up. No. Not at all. Didn't make things much worse. Not at all.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GREETING_0018d299_Oblivion_RESP1: You sure gave those damned daedra what for! It makes us all feel better to have someone like you around.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_MS29ShadyDeal_0001e7f4_Oblivion_R: You take what I get. I get notice at the last second, and I have to jump on it. No time to be picky about it.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_SE46DoublesTopic_0008fa8b_Oblivio: You talk to Horkvir. He can tell you what to do.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GREETING_0003c80b_Oblivion_RESP1: You test my patience, mortal. You are in my service. I expect my orders to be carried out.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_SE02OrcCaptainToPlayer_00018fc9_O: You there! Stay away from the Gatekeeper. Let us handle this!
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_Seen_0002d3fd_Oblivion_RESP1: You there! Stop where you are!
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GREETING_00035672_Oblivion_RESP1: You there. I have an update for you.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_HELLO_0001b68a_Oblivion_RESP1: You there. I'm watching you. Not so close to the armory door.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_SE05PostTortureGreet_00089615_Obl: You think I can't take that kind of pain? I've had worse. I won't tell you anything. There's nothing going on!
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_SEChaliceofReversal_00018b7b_Obli: You think I care for Thadon's toys? It matters not to me whether he suffers in agony, or erases his mind with drugs.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_MQ15MankarRant_0008c244_Oblivion_: You think I mock you? Not at all.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GREETING_0001e446_Oblivion_RESP1: You think I'm ugly, don't you? And that she's a prettier smith? Is that it?
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_NelsTheNaughtyTopic_0002817b_Obli: You think Nels might be the killer? He plays the buffoon, but it could all be an act. He is a Nord, and they're such a savage, uncivilized people.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_TG08GrayCowl_00014749_Oblivion_RE: You think this is Nocturnal's cowl? Where did you hear about that?
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_Attack_0008f586_Oblivion_RESP1: You think you can stop the Greymarch?
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GREETING_000473c2_Oblivion_RESP2: You think you can stop us? Soon Mehrunes Dagon will walk upon Tamriel for the first time since the Mythic Age, and our victory will be complete.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_TrainingQuestTopic_00061439_Obliv: You think you know what it's like to really, truly wield that kind of power? Hmm?
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_MountainLionsTOPIC_00036624_Obliv: You think you've gotten rid of them all? You do? Well, you haven't! There's one in my basement right now! Go get it!
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_Attack_00083061_Oblivion_RESP1: You thought I was weak, didn't you?
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_CharGenMain_00054827_Oblivion_RES: You thought the last Septim heir was safe from us?
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_Attack_0004ea49_Oblivion_RESP1: You thought we'd go down easy?
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GREETING_00045752_Oblivion_RESP1: You thought you could escape Lord Sheogorath's justice? Your stolen goods are now forfeit, and you can either pay reparations or face the dungeons.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_CharGenMain_0001e707_Oblivion_RES: You thought your secrets could be hidden from the Lord of Destruction?
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GREETING_00036617_Oblivion_RESP1: You told her? What have you done? I'll be ruined! Thanks a lot.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GREETING_00071f4c_Oblivion_RESP2: You too seek wealth, do you not? May you find it, and may tales of your journey be legendary.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_MS46GoblinWar_0002f810_Oblivion_R: You took care of the goblin menace? That's great news, my friend!
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_HELLO_0000bcd4_Oblivion_RESP1: You traveled a great distance to find me.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_Steal_000624f6_Oblivion_RESP1: You treacherous little filcher! How dare you steal from me!
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_HELLO_0001ad48_Oblivion_RESP1: You try my patience. Out with it!
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GREETING_00002e44_Oblivion_RESP1: You two are supposed to be taking care of those thieves in Anvil. What is it you need?
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_SE06UlfriFinalC_000400e2_Oblivion: You understand nothing, mortal. I go now to claim the highest honor attainable to my people. Stand aside.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GREETING_0000290d_Knights_RESP2: You vanished in Garlas Malatar. After the battle, we searched further into the ruin and found you next to Umaril's corpse.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_TG01Reject_000355e7_Oblivion_RESP: You walk a dangerous path. Keep the secret of the guild... or else. If you change your mind, I'll be here.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GREETING_00026aa8_Oblivion_RESP1: You walk in the shadow of the Corrupter. Why do you come to this place?
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_ImperialCityTopic_00047677_Oblivi: You want Light Armor? Pah! Why wear fluffy flutter, when you can wear real armor? But if you MUST have Light Armor, talk to Maro Rufus. Idiot.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GREETING_000545cf_Oblivion_RESP1: You want a horse? I can sell you one. There are no finer Bay horses than those sold by the Grateful Pass Stables.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_SEChaliceofReversal_0001344c_Obli: You want information from me? After what you put me through?
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_NevilleTopic_00028171_Oblivion_RE: You want me to mistrust him, don't you! You want to turn me against him! Maybe... maybe you're the murderer!
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_MS26FileCharges_00035ca3_Oblivion: You want me to publically accuse Audens Avidius of corruption? I'd sooner swim naked in a pool filled with slaughterfish and mudcrabs!
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_MS26FileCharges_00035ca6_Oblivion: You want me to testify against Audens Avidius? You're crazy. Exactly how do you intend to persuade me to do that?
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_NelsTheNaughtyTopic_000286f2_Obli: You want me to think Nels is the killer, is that it? Maybe you did it, eh? Maybe you're just trying to turn me against him!
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GREETING_00038ac9_Oblivion_RESP1: You want me? You sure? I'm Vigge. I'm Mages Guild, but I don't train or anything.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_TrainingQuestTopic_0006233d_Obliv: You want more training? Then you'll have to find Andragil. I learned most of what I know from her.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_TrainingQuestTopic_000613a7_Obliv: You want more training? Then you'll have to go to the best. Marana Rian, here in the Imperial City. She can help you better than I.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_DovesiDranTopic_00028ce4_Oblivion: You want my honest opinion? I think Nels is the killer. But I haven't yet ruled out that Dovesi may be working with him.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GREETING_00028b80_Oblivion_RESP1: You want my honest opinion? This whole setup -- the party, the chest of gold -- it doesn't make any sense.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_DAMalacathSpeech_000579cb_Oblivio: You want something? Then, if you're smart, you do what I tell you.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_StolenGold_00053798_Oblivion_RESP: You want the gold? You bring me Arnora's amulet... after she's dead.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_SE05PostTortureGreet_00080d7e_Obl: You want the leader. You want Muurine. But no amount of torture will get a confession from her.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_TrainingQuestTopic_0018d14d_Obliv: You want to be the best? Then you'd better head over to The Best Defense and talk to him. Getting him to train you will be no small feat, though.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_MS27AyleidCrown_0002e5cb_Oblivion: You want to buy my Ayleid Crown? It isn't for sale, at any price. I would think Umbacano would know that by now.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_ImperialCityTopic_0004765b_Oblivi: You want to buy or sell, the City is great. You want free? Go down the holes, kill some monsters. Sell your loot back in the city!
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_TrainingQuestTopic_0006143b_Obliv: You want to do as much damage as possible with an axe or a hammer? Find Irene Metrick, and talk to her.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_Help_00098144_Oblivion_RESP1: You want to help? You're kidding, right?
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_jointheBlackwoodCompany_000356ee_: You want to join us? Hmm... another guild rat leaving the ship. Very well. Speak with Jeetum-Ze. He handles recruitment here.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_MagesGuildTopic_0006260e_Oblivion: You want to join? Well, then either you'll  need to find Kud-Ei here in town, or go seek out one of the other local guild hall leaders.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_MagesGuildTopic_0002d016_Oblivion: You want to join? You'll need to speak with one of the local guild heads. That'd be Carahil here in Anvil.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_Recharge_0005e084_Oblivion_RESP1: You want to keep magic items charged at all times. The world could come crashing down at any moment, and you want to be prepared.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_SE02Gatekeeper_0007eaec_Oblivion_: You want to know about my child? Go see for yourself. He guards the Gates at the top of the hill. Be warned, he doesn't play nice.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_NevilleTopic_0002879f_Oblivion_RE: You want to know how I really feel about Neville's death? I'm afraid. I may hate the Imperial Legion, but its members are trained warriors.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GREETING_00028727_Oblivion_RESP1: You want to know something, my friend? I just don't care anymore. We're the only two left. I know I didn't kill those people, so that leaves you.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_DovesiDranTopic_00028d31_Oblivion: You want to know the truth? I thought for sure Nels was the killer. But with him dead, my bets are now on Dovesi.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_MS09SoIHear_00053778_Oblivion_RES: You want to know what happened? I'll tell you. I was betrayed. Stabbed in the back. I'm in here, and Arnora's out there living in my house.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_Nirnroot_0004e93d_Oblivion_RESP2: You want to speak to Sinderion of Skingrad. He's an alchemist over there who specializes in unusual plants, fungi and roots.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_HELLO_00086563_Oblivion_RESP1: You want to speak to me?
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_bed_0005e078_Oblivion_RESP1: You want to stay here for a night, eh? Just for sleeping... you keep to yourself, mind your business, and stay away from my wife.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_DovesiDranTopic_00028a08_Oblivion: You want to talk to me about Dovesi? Someone's been murdered, you idiot! There are more important matters to discuss right now!
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_TrainingQuestTopic_00062330_Obliv: You want training, from me? Well, perhaps I can accommodate you. If you're worth the time and effort, that is. I think a little test is in order.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_MS47Counterspell_00030131_Oblivio: You wasted it again, didn't you? It is truly pathetic that the fools in Aleswell actually trusted you to save them.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GREETING_00019fc3_Oblivion_RESP1: You wear our robes, but I hear the darkness that you bring in your very breath. You do not know harmony... you do not see my light.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GREETING_00015746_Oblivion_RESP1: You wear the Bands, but you're no prisoner. Who are you? What are you doing here?
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GREETING_0003f289_Oblivion_RESP1: You wear the shadows well, fellow thief.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_SE13JyggalagVoice_00095e51_Oblivi: You wear the trappings, but you are not the Madgod!
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GREETING_0005a02a_Oblivion_RESP1: You went inside that Gate, huh? You saved our necks, so thanks.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GREETING_0007b7da_Oblivion_RESP1: You were Martin's friend, weren't you? You were fortunate to have known him.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_SE11Dyus_00014b60_Oblivion_RESP1: You were expecting a book. An ancient tome filled with the secrets that you seek. But instead, you have found me. The last remnant.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_MysteriumXarxes_00097cc0_Oblivion: You were fortunate to have heard the Master read from its sacred pages.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_MS21AyleidStatueTopic_0002b45f_Ob: You were more resourceful than I had hoped. I esteem you greatly for your success in bringing the Ten Ancestors together again after all these years.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_TG03FoundBust_000092a5_Oblivion_R: You were right. The bust is here and Myvryna is guilty.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GREETING_00016480_Oblivion_RESP2: You were sent to acquire this gem so Mannimarco would not get his hands on it. With it, he would have marched on the University and come for me.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_contract_0000be7b_Oblivion_RESP1: You were supposed to check out those disappearances at Harlun's Watch. What's the status?
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_MartinTopic_0006c5c5_Oblivion_RES: You were there. You saw his true nature. The blood of the Dragon was revealed for all to see.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GREETING_00034896_Oblivion_RESP2: You were to avoid detection and kill Roderick by means of poison, yet you failed to follow these parameters.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GREETING_000a31c3_Oblivion_RESP1: You were told to sit down. Are you incapable of following such simple instructions?
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_MQ05RavenSpeech_00022da9_Oblivion: You were told to sit down. Are you incapable of following such simple instructions?
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_TG07NewCaptain_0009839b_Oblivion_: You what! But I didn't... I mean, of course. I'll take that letter now. I'll personally make sure that Lady Umbranox gets it.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_FGC01Choice2_0003663d_Oblivion_RE: You what? Well, I'm sure I don't know what you're talking about. I would never go skulking about....
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_ArenaChoice1A_00029ca6_Oblivion_R: You what? You want to be a combatant? Ha ha ha ha ha ha! Look at you! My granny could beat you, and she's dead!
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_ShrineofBoethiaTOPIC_0001ebd8_Obl: You who have returned from Boethia's realm, approach the shrine and learn your fate.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GREETING_00014d86_AltarDeluxe_RES: You will act as a herald of His coming and wear His attire!
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_advancementFG_0003356c_Oblivion_R: You will advance through the ranks of the Fighters Guild when you have proven your merit.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_advancementFG_0003356d_Oblivion_R: You will advance through the ranks of the Fighters Guild when you have proven your merit.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_SE06GSWardenGreet2_00018dc6_Obliv: You will answer for that with your blood, mortal!
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_Dark01Choice5A_00022ba9_Oblivion_: You will be asked a question. Answer thusly: "Sanguine, my Brother." You will gain entrance to the Sanctuary. Once inside, speak with Ocheeva.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_Dark01Choice5B_00022baa_Oblivion_: You will be asked a question. Answer thusly: "Sanguine, my Brother." You will gain entrance to the Sanctuary. Once inside, speak with Ocheeva.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_Dark01Choice5C_00022bab_Oblivion_: You will be asked a question. Answer thusly: "Sanguine, my Brother." You will gain entrance to the Sanctuary. Once inside, speak with Ocheeva.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_duties_00024287_Oblivion_RESP1: You will be asked to perform certain duties for the Guild. These are mainly internal matters--discipline problems, defaulted contracts, and the like.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_ServicetoLeyawiinTopic_JAWS12039_: You will be held responsible for Weebam-Na's death. Your disappointing performance proves you are not suited for service to Count Caro.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GOODBYE_00189d0b_Oblivion_RESP1: You will be included in my prayers forever. May the Divines smile upon you.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_SE05SylHelp_0001361f_Oblivion_RES: You will be my Grand Inquisitor. Expose the conspirators, and they will be punished, I assure you. Find out who keeps secrets, and what they are.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_TGSpecialJobs_0001ee45_Oblivion_R: You will be paid a modest sum. Do you want this job?
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_SE35EarilInitialHello_0008f7d5_Ob: You will be perfectly preserved. Taken out of time. Beautiful forever. I will display you with the rest in my collection.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_HELLO_0004b771_Oblivion_RESP1: You will be sweet, bloody nectar for the lady.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_ArcaneUniversityTopic_000473f1_Ob: You will come to know it well, in time. I have seen it.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_SEShiveringIslesTOPIC_00078ca9_Ob: You will enter soon, I imagine, through the Gates of Madness and into the lands of Mania and Dementia.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_MQ15KathutetC2_0003e8f7_Oblivion_: You will fail, mortal, and then where will you be? Dead. And nothing.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_BrinaCrossInnTopic_0002fd6b_Obliv: You will find her company most welcome, I believe.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_SE09HaskillRelmynaVerenim_0004036: You will find her in her Sanctum, hidden away in the dungeon of Xaselm.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_SE45Choice1_00078788_Oblivion_RES: You will find it! Bring the Fork! Hear the music. Music of toads. Music of roads! Sing to yourself, so all can hear!
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GREETING_00022e8a_Oblivion_RESP2: You will find that history has been altered tonight. Such is the power of Nocturnal's curse that lifting it can alter time itself.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_CGEmperor04_0002ad1b_Oblivion_RES: You will find your own path. Take care... there will be blood and death before the end.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_Dark18Choice3B_00090796_Oblivion_: You will get what you desire. But first, meditate upon all that has transpired. Perhaps you covet treasure? Take all my crypt has to offer!
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_MS22GiveCarving_0002c51b_Oblivion: You will go far in this business, my friend. You know when you've won, and when you've lost. Until we meet again!
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_SE09Gardens_00013570_Oblivion_RES: You will go there and gather the components needed to bring my new child into this world.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_TG07HowToForge_0000c237_Oblivion_: You will have to track down one on your own. I don't know of any in Bravil.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_TG11P1WhatIsPlan_0001fb6e_Oblivio: You will have to travel the Old Way. Once used as an escape route for Imperial Emperors, it has been forgotten for centuries.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_MGExpelAccept_00025037_Oblivion_R: You will help replenish alchemical supplies for the guild. Bring me 20 Vampire Dust and 20 Daedra Hearts.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_MGExpelAccept_0002503b_Oblivion_R: You will help replenish alchemical supplies for the guild. Deliver 20 Dragon's Tongue flowers, and 20 Redwort Flowers to me.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_DAMolagBalSpeech_00037821_Oblivio: You will let him kill you with this: the Cursed Mace. As you are doing this for me, I'll save your miserable life. Probably. Get out of my sight.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_MS22Mission_0002af34_Oblivion_RES: You will need this as well. It is the key to the inner chamber of the High Fane.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_contract_000251b7_Oblivion_RESP1: You will not make it past the sewers. Of this I am certain.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_LeyawiinTopic_000479e8_Oblivion_R: You will not stay in Leyawiin. You just visit. Of course. Too many Argonians here. Already. People here don't like Argonians. Too many already.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GREETING_00073267_Oblivion_RESP1: You will not stop us. The Order of the Black Worm will consume all in its path.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_BrinaCrossInnTopic_0002fd6b_Obliv: You will pose as a traveling merchant, and will spend a night at the Inn, which is north of Anvil. After that, continue east along the road.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_Dark03FinChoice1A_00023e54_Oblivi: You will receive a bonus if you fulfill the contract without killing any of the prison guards. Now go, and may the Night Mother go with you.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_TrainingQuestTopic_0006e602_Obliv: You will receive no training from me. Not now, or ever!
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GOODBYE_000c4539_Oblivion_RESP1: You will remember the day you met Farwil Indarys and treasure every moment after.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_DAClavicusSpeech_000243bc_Oblivio: You will retrieve for me a sword, a very special sword. It contains the soul of Umbra, a hero I have had dealings with in the past.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_MG05AChoice1B_0001e859_Oblivion_R: You will retrieve the book immediately, if you have any intention of ever receiving a recommendation from me!
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_MG02Choice1A_0002e5aa_Oblivion_RE: You will retrieve this ring for me. Should you manage to do so, I shall consider sending a recommendation to the University.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_ND04SirRalvasGreeting02_00002ad7_: You will see the Mace, separated from you by a great chasm. The chasm represents your doubt. Your faith must be your guide across it.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GREETING_0001b081_Oblivion_RESP4: You will seek the assistance of Relmyna Verenim in Xaselm to rebuild the Gatekeeper. You remember the creature you killed to get in here?
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_SE11HaskillChoice2_00014b65_Obliv: You will sit on the throne. It has always been Sheogorath's intent for you to be the new Madgod.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_TG11P5HowIsThat_0001fb72_Oblivion: You will take her place. Do not speak to the priests. They are blindfolded and will not realize it isn't her unless you speak.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_SE09Components_00013571_Oblivion_: You will travel to the Gardens of Flesh and Bone and collect for me these things:
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_SE09AssistanceRequest_0001356f_Ob: You will travel to the Gardens of Flesh and Bone. There you will gather mystical components needed for the ceremony.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_SE09AssistanceCommand_0001356e_Ob: You will travel to the Gardens of Flesh and Bone. There, you will gather mystical components needed for the ceremony.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_MS48Convo_0002482b_Oblivion_RESP1: You will, soldier. Once they're secure, get back here immediately. We'll need every available blade, and there'll be plenty of fighting to go around.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_TG06TakeJob_0000bf87_Oblivion_RES: You will?! I mean, good! Mind your manners in the castle. Stay out of Count Hassildor's quarters. And don't let me catch you in the wine cellar!
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_jointheBlackwoodCompany_000a5652_: You wish to join the Blackwood Company, do you? Hmm...I think I've heard of you, though.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GREETING_0003fd39_Oblivion_RESP1: You wish to join the Thieves Guild too? Maybe we will soon be brothers in the shadow. Only Armand can say.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_TrainingQuestTopic_0003c15a_Obliv: You wish to learn? Hmm. You have potential, I see, but your equipment!
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_SE04Audience_0001359b_Oblivion_RE: You wish to see Lady Syl, do you?
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GREETING_00086743_Oblivion_RESP1: You won the last round. I salute your bold spirit!
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GREETING_0002addd_Oblivion_RESP1: You won! Congratulations! Here are your winnings, my friend -- 100 gold pieces. Come back and bet on the matches as often as you like!
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GREETING_0002ade0_Oblivion_RESP1: You won! Congratulations! Here are your winnings, my friend -- 100 gold pieces. Come back and bet on the matches as often as you like!
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GREETING_0002addc_Oblivion_RESP1: You won! Congratulations! Here are your winnings, my friend -- 200 gold pieces. Come back and bet on the matches as often as you like!
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GREETING_0002addf_Oblivion_RESP1: You won! Congratulations! Here are your winnings, my friend -- 200 gold pieces. Come back and bet on the matches as often as you like!
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GREETING_0002adde_Oblivion_RESP1: You won! Congratulations! Here are your winnings, my friend -- 50 gold pieces. Come back and bet on the matches as often as you like!
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GREETING_0002ade1_Oblivion_RESP1: You won! Congratulations! Here are your winnings, my friend -- 50 gold pieces. Come back and bet on the matches as often as you like!
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GREETING_0008587c_Oblivion_RESP3: You won't be leaving, though. I'll see to that now.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_INFOGENERAL_0003403b_Oblivion_RES: You won't believe what's happened! Francois Motierre has been killed! Murdered by the Dark Brotherhood! It's true, I saw the body myself.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_HouseInquiry_0004f211_Oblivion_RE: You won't find a better property for sale. It's just inside the main gate, near the bridge to the chapel.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GREETING_000c47ce_Oblivion_RESP1: You won't get any of my blood! Get away from me!
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_MS38DeadNo_00023676_Oblivion_RESP: You won't help me? You're abandoning me now, just when I need you the most?!
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_NDJoinOrderAccept_00002b3a_Knight: You won't regret it, sir. You'll find us true-hearted and brave.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_HorseBuyCheydinhal_0004f012_Obliv: You won't regret it. Go out to the corral. Mivryna will have your new Black horse saddled and ready for you.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_HorseBuyBruma_00054222_Oblivion_R: You won't regret it. Humilis will have your new Paint horse saddled and ready for you outside.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_MS22SrazirrAgreed_0002c528_Oblivi: You won't regret it. This one will keep his eyes open, and wait for an opportunity to help you.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_MazogaSayNothing1_000860c3_Oblivi: You won't say 'Sir' to me? You are afraid to speak. It would shame me to fight a gutless thing like you. So go away.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_BladesTopic_00033fca_Oblivion_RES: You wonder to find me here? Discretion is our watchword. Only a few of us have the honor to serve publicly in the Imperial Guard.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_CheydinhalTopic_0004e8b1_Oblivion: You worship the Nine Divines, perhaps? Have they ever helped or harmed you? Of course not.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_SE07ARuler_00031622_Oblivion_RESP: You would be well served to remember that.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_SE07BRuler_0009130d_Oblivion_RESP: You would be well served to remember that.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_DAClavicusSpeech_000243ba_Oblivio: You would break our bargain? You dare to trifle with me? Take care, mortal. Clavicus Vile watches you now. And waits.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GREETING_0001647d_Oblivion_RESP1: You would dare to approach the King of Worms?
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_DAClavicusSpeech_000243b6_Oblivio: You would dare?!?! We had a bargain, little hero. You would risk my wrath for a pitiful little sword? I will be watching you mortal. And waiting.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_SE43KillBhisha_00072dbd_Oblivion_: You would do that for me? I would do just about anything for you if you make him go away. Permanently. For good. Never to be seen again.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_ND03RespectNature_00002be4_Knight: You would do well to remember this when it comes time for your test.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_ValusOdiilTopic_000224ac_Oblivion: You would join us, though you have no personal stake in this fight? An honorable deed... I gladly accept your help, then.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_DASheogorathChoice4_00026af8_Obli: You would mock our beliefs? Fool! When the three signs are upon us, you will learn!
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_NDProphetStartC1_00002c88_Knights: You would quest for the holy panoply of Pelinal Whitestrake? The legendary Relics that have been sought by mighty warriors throughout the ages?
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_NDBootsoftheCrusader_00002a4b_Kni: You would seek the holy relic Kynareth has bestowed upon the world? Then you must prove yourself worthy.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_TrainingQuestTopic_0006244b_Obliv: You would seek to better yourself? First, I would ask that you look to the poor and the suffering around Cyrodiil.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_TrainingQuestTopic_0018d88a_Obliv: You would seek training from me?
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GREETING_00025e20_Oblivion_RESP1: You would steal from your brothers? If you had a need for something, why would you not just ask? I will give you a chance, though.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_DASheogorathSpeech_00095904_Obliv: You would summon me? Wait... why are YOU summoning me? You've got things to do. Things I told you to do. This makes me frown.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_FGD09Choice2_00035710_Oblivion_RE: You would violate a direct order? I should expel you now! But... this does not all fall on your shoulders. Much of the fault is mine.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GREETING_0001e894_Oblivion_RESP1: You wouldn't happen to be in the market for a home would you? If you are, I just happen to be selling a manor located right here in Anvil.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_SEThadonWaitingLong_000131da_Obli: You wouldn't really know how long it's been, since you weren't here. If you'd been here, it would've been no time at all, so who's to say?
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_SkingradTopic_00038ada_Oblivion_R: You wouldn't think it, but our rocky soil is perfect for tomatoes. The same ground that produces our glorious wines produces my splendid tomatoes.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_SE38Oddity7_00081e8a_Oblivion_RES: You wouldn't think there would be two of those in the world, now would you? Sorry. Keep looking and I'm sure something truly Odd will turn up.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_HELLO_0001ad4c_Oblivion_RESP1: You wound me, and my heart bleeds with pleasure.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GREETING_00014d8a_AltarDeluxe_RES: You wrought destruction amongst insects and amused Him.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GREETING_00013565_Oblivion_RESP1: You! I remember you. You're the adventurer who slew my Gatekeeper, are you not?
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_CharGenVoice_0004f12b_Oblivion_RE: You! Prisoner! Stand aside. Over by the window. Stay out of the way, and you won't get hurt.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GREETING_00028726_Oblivion_RESP1: You! What do you want? If you're looking for something to drink, I can't help you. It's mine. It's all mine. It's the only thing I have...
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GREETING_0003b96d_Oblivion_RESP1: You! You're one of them! What do you want with me? Scratch me with your claws? Steal my breath? My babies will protect me!
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GREETING_0001f36c_Oblivion_RESP1: You! You're... No, you're not one of them. Still, you've no business being here. And if you see them, tell them Erver is ready and waiting.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GREETING_00071e76_Oblivion_RESP1: You! You've ruined everything! Why? WHY? I had a job! I had a home! You've taken it all! I'll kill you for this!
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_MS45BrethrenTopic_00028215_Oblivi: You'd be better off not asking such questions around here.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_SkingradNQDResponses_0003c19d_Obl: You'd be better off praying for a miracle than going to see Valandrus.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GOODBYE_000852b1_Oblivion_RESP1: You'd be smart to stay with the rest of the group. It's just not safe to go wandering off alone with a killer on the loose.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_SEServiceProviderResponses_000781: You'd be surprised what you can find there.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GREETING_0017c45e_Oblivion_RESP2: You'd best get back to the encampment. There's no telling when more of them will come out of that infernal Oblivion Gate.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GREETING_00035f37_Oblivion_RESP3: You'd best get that to Irlav back at the Imperial City as soon as possible. He'll want the mages there to examine it more closely.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_Recommendation_000175b5_Oblivion_: You'd best go see Deetsan before you do anything else.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GREETING_0002c4e9_Oblivion_RESP1: You'd better get up to the Arena or you'll miss the match! Just head through those doors on my left. If you win, come see me to collect your gold.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GREETING_0001f85b_Oblivion_RESP1: You'd better go talk to Jeanne before she really loses it.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GREETING_0001f85c_Oblivion_RESP3: You'd better go tell her you found me. That way you, at least, can get out of here.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GREETING_0003be81_Oblivion_RESP1: You'd better have a good reason for interrupting me. Keeping these miscreants working this mudhole is no simple task.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_Recommendation_000175b1_Oblivion_: You'd better speak to Deetsan about it.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_CharGenTaunt2_0003333e_Oblivion_R: You'd better take whatever you can get in here, Khajiit. They don't feed the new prisoners. Didn't you know that?
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GREETING_00014664_Oblivion_RESP1: You'd better talk to Caranya before you do anything else.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_Dark02PirateConvo_000493b6_Oblivi: You'd better watch your tongue, old man! Captain Tussaud hears you talkin' like that, he'll cut it out! Now come on. We been gabbin' long enough.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_ReadyForAMatch_00038b36_Oblivion_: You'd damn well better be ready! You've got an Arena full of people and the Grand Champion himself waiting for you! Now get up there and fight!
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_TG04LockPick_00035fb0_Oblivion_RE: You'd do that for me? Maybe you guild types aren't so bad after all. Okay. It's a deal. Give me a lockpick and I'll tell you about the ring.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_TrainingQuestTopic_000613af_Obliv: You'd never know it by looking at her, but Rusia Bradus did a lot of traveling in her younger days. She must have been in pretty good shape.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_TGGrayFox_00015f11_Oblivion_RESP5: You'd think he was Saint Nerevar the way they talk about him.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GREETING_0008263d_Oblivion_RESP1: You'd think that after all this work, I'd finally be able to get some sleep.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GREETING_000488c3_Oblivion_RESP1: You'll always get a fair deal here. I'm Nilawen. What can I get you?
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_ICAllNQDResponses_00049929_Oblivi: You'll always leave stuffed, assuming you can keep it down.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_MG08Choice4B_0003562a_Oblivion_RE: You'll be able to freeze opponents in their tracks for a short time with this staff. I can begin work now, or we can start over.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GOODBYE_0006770b_Oblivion_RESP1: You'll be back. They always come back.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_PowerAttack_000919b8_Oblivion_RES: You'll be but another notch in my hammer!
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GREETING_0002d928_Oblivion_RESP1: You'll be happy to know that Erthor is back in town.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_HouseInquiry_0004f212_Oblivion_RE: You'll be hard pressed to find a nicer home for sale in Cyrodiil.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_MS09AlternateWay_0005377e_Oblivio: You'll be hunted all over Cyrodiil. You don't want that do you? I don't think so. Good luck.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_SE06SheoIntro1_00082462_Oblivion_: You'll be my champion. You'll grow powerful. You'll grow to be me. Prince of Madness, a new Sheogorath. Or you'll die trying. I love that about you.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_infiltrate_000356eb_Oblivion_RESP: You'll be on your own. Steer clear of me and all of your Fighters Guild brothers. It'll be rough going, but you can do it.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_SE06SheoIntro1_00082462_Oblivion_: You'll be stopping the Greymarch. Altering the course of events, breaking the cycle.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_SE07SheoIntro1_00082467_Oblivion_: You'll change that. Break the cycle. You'll stop Jyggalag, and I'll have My Realm to come back to. I've never actually tried that before.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_PayGoldforCrime_00045765_Oblivion: You'll come with me, and you'll be searched for stolen property and pay reparations. Then, you're free to go.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GREETING_00035548_Oblivion_RESP3: You'll dance for me, little one, yes, you will. I'll make your corpse dance, and then tear itself apart!
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_AmuletofKingsTopic_0001efe3_Obliv: You'll find Baurus at Luther Broad's Boarding House in the Elven Gardens district of the Imperial City.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_JauffreTopic_0001e910_Oblivion_RE: You'll find Grandmaster Jauffre at Weynon Priory, living as a simple monk.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_ImperialCityTopic_000476f9_Oblivi: You'll find a lot of orcs serving as private guards. Watch work is too dull. Lots of folks say, 'Oooh, there's an orc, she's scary'. Makes it easy.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_BieneAmelionTOPIC_00009217_Oblivi: You'll find her at the Water's Edge settlement. It's marked on your map.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_SavlianMatiusTopic_001778cd_Obliv: You'll find him at the barricade at the top of the road. He's still trying to hold what's left of the Guard together.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_MG05Choice1A_0001e854_Oblivion_RE: You'll find it at an old ruin called Cloud Top. It's north of Chorrol, up in the mountains. I'm afraid I don't have an exact location.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_MG05Choice1A_000224e4_Oblivion_RE: You'll find it at an old ruin called Cloud Top. It's north of Chorrol, up in the mountains. I'm afraid I don't have an exact location.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_HouseBuyImperialCity_000531bc_Obl: You'll find it in the Waterfront District. It's not much to look at.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_HrotaCaveTOPIC_00002e8e_Oblivion_: You'll find it north of Anvil. Good luck, and give it to those bastards good.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_DirectionsServices_0018bda8_Obliv: You'll find smiths, alchemists, booksellers, mage shops, clothiers, armorers, and general traders in the Market District.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_SQ09Scales_00068850_Oblivion_RESP: You'll find the Rumare slaughterfish all over the lake around here. Just dive in, wrestle one down, cut its throat and bring me the scales.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_DASanguineSpeech_000b1219_Oblivio: You'll find your equipment in that chest over there. And here's a little something for your efforts. Maybe we'll celebrate again sometime....
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_SE06SheoIntro5_00082461_Oblivion_: You'll go to Cylarne and bring back the Flame of Agnon to relight the torch. Oh... and take care with my minions at Cylarne.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_MG08Choice3A_00035624_Oblivion_RE: You'll have a staff capable of creating fireballs. If that's what you want, I'll get started right away. Otherwise, we can start over.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_MS05DreamworldTopic_0002c6d9_Obli: You'll have to be very careful in there. If Henantier intended it as a training ground, there's no telling what you may encounter.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_SE06DSWardenGreet2_00018e84_Obliv: You'll have to do better than that, you ashen-faced god-cursed product of a Daedra's bowels.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_SE06DSWardenGreet2_00018e87_Obliv: You'll have to do better than that, you dust-dwelling goat-herder, pathetic remnant of infamous Yokuda.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_SE06DSWardenGreet2_00018e81_Obliv: You'll have to do better than that, you mud-crawling sap-licking jumped-up reptile. Crawl back to your hole.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_SE06DSWardenGreet2_00018e86_Obliv: You'll have to do better than that, you pasty-faced mongrel of an upstart race. Back to the slave pens where you were bred.
