ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_SE06DSWardenGreet2_00018e83_Obliv: You'll have to do better than that, you yellow-faced pointy-eared monkey.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_SE06DSWardenGreet2_00018e85_Obliv: You'll have to do better than that, you yellow-faced prig, inbred arrogant pretender to everything that the Mazken hold as our birthright.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_BarterFail_0005e081_Oblivion_RESP: You'll have to do better than that.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_TrainingQuestTopic_0018b2f8_Obliv: You'll have to find Pranal if you want to learn more. That's all there is to it.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_MG13EridorWho_0003446d_Oblivion_R: You'll have to forgive me if I don't answer. I don't trust you, frankly.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_JskarTopic_0003103c_Oblivion_RESP: You'll have to forgive me... I seem to have misplaced something. Hmm. Yes, well, let's nevermind that.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_Attack_00077c27_Oblivion_RESP1: You'll have to get me a new one if it dies!
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_Recommendation_0004a24a_Oblivion_: You'll have to get one from Falcar, if you can.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_Nd05ThedretHelp_00002afc_Knights_: You'll have to go on alone. But the knowledge I've gained may be of use to you.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_Recommendation_000514b4_Oblivion_: You'll have to speak to Dagail about that.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_Recommendation_00033794_Oblivion_: You'll have to speak to Dagail. I just don't understand what it is she wants.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_HouseInquiry_000711b0_Oblivion_RE: You'll have to speak with Shum gro-Yarug about that. He's the only one that can handle the deed.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GREETING_0002443c_Oblivion_RESP4: You'll have to tell father what you've done.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_MG05AChoice1A_00028c09_Oblivion_R: You'll just have to get the book back, that's all. Whatever it takes, yes? If you need to break in and steal it, that's what you'll do.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_MQ16MartinC_0004bfbe_Oblivion_RES: You'll just have to trust me. I now know what I was born to do. But I'll need your help. I have to get past Mehrunes Dagon, somehow.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GREETING_0002c7ae_Oblivion_RESP1: You'll keep your nose out of this, if you know what's good for you.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_SE03AInstUntilWhen_00018dfb_Obliv: You'll know you're done when they lie dead on the ground, or they are out of their minds.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_SE30ForgeCuirassMagic_000400bc_Ob: You'll look absolutely stunning in this. Maybe you'd like to give me a little fashion show?
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_SE06HelpAttackA3B3_000192e8_Obliv: You'll make a fine commander one day. Come. Let us surrender to the madness of battle!
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_Attack_0018bd7e_Oblivion_RESP1: You'll make a fine pair of boots, lizard!
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_JauffreTopic_000299ca_Oblivion_RE: You'll most likely find him in the library.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_MG00JoinA_0002d282_Oblivion_RESP2: You'll need a recommendation from each local guild hall in order to advance further. Until then, the Arcane University will be closed to you.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_Recommendation_00034e19_Oblivion_: You'll need a recommendation from each ranking member at the local guild halls around Cyrodiil before we may continue, Associate.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_SE05PostTortureGreet_00080d7e_Obl: You'll need more than just my confession. You'll need evidence, and I have none.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_MG00JoinA_0002d284_Oblivion_RESP2: You'll need to acquire recommendations from all the local guild hall leaders to advance further in the guild.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GREETING_0003569f_Oblivion_RESP1: You'll need to be careful on this mission. Sometimes new recruits have complications. They are not used to our methods.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_SE07SheoIntro3_00082466_Oblivion_: You'll need to control one of the Courts of Madness. Replace a current Duke. Or Duchess. Whichever. That will command respect!
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_TrainingQuestTopic_0018d14a_Obliv: You'll need to convince Gin-Wulm you're worth his time if you want further training.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_BarterFail_0005e045_Oblivion_RESP: You'll need to make a better offer.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_SE07TheFringeTopic_000912a2_Obliv: You'll need to put an end to that. Stop them. My armies should already be there, but I want you to see what you can do to help.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_SE07TheFringeTopic_0009130c_Obliv: You'll need to put an end to that. Stop them. My armies should already be there, but I want you to see what you can do to help.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_MG00JoinA_0002d283_Oblivion_RESP3: You'll need to receive a recommendation from each local guild hall in Cyrodiil to advance in the guild, and be given any sort of responsibility.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_Recommendation_0004a24c_Oblivion_: You'll need to see Falcar about that.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_Recommendation_0005323d_Oblivion_: You'll need to speak to Raminus Polus at the Arcane University now. Look at you, moving up in the world... how wonderful!
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_MagesGuildTopic_0006260b_Oblivion: You'll need to speak to one of the local guild heads to get into the guild. Talk to Kud-Ei if you just can't wait.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GREETING_0001b081_Oblivion_RESP3: You'll need to speak with Relmyna Verenim. She'll help you with your task. Strange woman. Has some unusual tastes.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_MagesGuildTopic_0006260d_Oblivion: You'll need to talk to Kud-Ei if you want to join the guild. Or any of the heads of the local guild halls, for that matter.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_MagesStaff_000355a9_Oblivion_RESP: You'll need wood for the staff before Delmar can assist you.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_INFOGENERAL_0004992e_Oblivion_RES: You'll never leave the Feed Bag on an empty stomach.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_Attack_0018bd61_Oblivion_RESP1: You'll never leave this Arena alive!
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_Attack_0008ef6a_Oblivion_RESP1: You'll not get the best of me!
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_Dark11Choice1A_00002db8_Oblivion_: You'll notice that the list gives each child's location and some suggestions for gifts. Oh, and here's the gold I'm supposed to give you.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_SE02Gardens_0008e4f7_Oblivion_RES: You'll pick that lock, and I'll collect the bones. Then I'll make some arrows, and we'll kill the Gatekeeper. Sound good?
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_SE07GreymarchTopic_00091015_Obliv: You'll see the miasma begin to spread. Where Order appears, the Realm dies. I only hope you are up to Sheogorath's task.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_SE07GreymarchTopic_0009127f_Obliv: You'll see the miasma begin to spread. Where Order appears, the Realm dies. I only hope you are up to Sheogorath's task.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_SE04ObelisksTopic_0009102d_Oblivi: You'll see those Knights of Order around them during the Greymarch. Drawn to them, like flies to honey. Or rotting flesh.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_Dark04DrethConvo_00045f88_Oblivio: You'll see, you Imperial dog! When I get out of here, all of Tamriel will know my name! Valen Dreth! Valen Dreth!
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_Attack_0007c3a8_Oblivion_RESP1: You'll taste my steel, Reman dog!
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GREETING_0008e616_Oblivion_RESP1: You'll uplift the poor, suffering folk of Dementia with the Flame, then?
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GREETING_00081a53_Oblivion_RESP4: You'll want to get all the details from the messenger. Unless you already have. You haven't, have you?
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_SE01HaskillChoice9_0005e371_Obliv: You'll want to pass through the Gates of Madness. Oh, and mind the Gatekeeper. He dislikes strangers to the Realm.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GREETING_00081ddf_Oblivion_RESP3: You'll want to seek out Lord Sheogorath. I believe He has plans for you. Try not to disappoint Him.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_SESheogorathTopic_00078ca3_Oblivi: You'll want to speak with Him soon, as I believe He has plans for you. You will find Him in New Sheoth, in His palace.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_MagesGuildTopic_00062606_Oblivion: You'll want to talk to Teekeeus, if you're interested in joining the guild. Any other leader of a local guild hall can help you as well.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_SE05Interrogate1_00013ff2_Oblivio: You'll.... You'll pay for this, Herdir. Make no mistake...
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GREETING_000b166d_Oblivion_RESP1: You're Fighters Guild! Get them out of here!
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_ReadyForAMatch_0001c28a_Oblivion_: You're a Bloodletter now, so your opponents aren't gonna hold back anymore! This is the real deal! Get into that Arena and make the Yellow Team pay!
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GREETING_0001768a_Oblivion_RESP1: You're a Champion now. I've got no more fights for you. If you think you can beat the Gray Prince, challenge him! If anyone can beat him, you can!
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GREETING_0001767e_Oblivion_RESP1: You're a Hero, my friend. That crowd is out there for one reason: to see you destroy the Yellow Team! Now go give 'em what they want!
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GREETING_00017655_Oblivion_RESP1: You're a Warrior now. That ain't no joke. They may not know your name, but the people out there, the spectators, they know you now.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GREETING_0002249a_Oblivion_RESP1: You're a bold little thing, aren't you? I'm afraid you're of no use to me. Goodbye.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GREETING_0002fc38_Oblivion_RESP1: You're a brave soul to attempt entry to Oblivion. Hopefully, your skill matches your fortitude.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_SE46DoublesTopic_0008faa8_Oblivio: You're a cute little bunny! Not like that other Urul here in Split. A sweet thing like you might be able to help.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GREETING_0008faa0_Oblivion_RESP1: You're a dangerous little rascal! Stay away from me!
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_HELLO_0018bcba_Oblivion_RESP1: You're a fit one. Been running a lot?
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_ResistArrest_000459d1_Oblivion_RE: You're a fool as well as a criminal, it seems.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GuardTalk2_0006fdd9_Oblivion_RESP: You're a good man. We could use more like you, that's for damned sure. You ask me, you'll be getting that promotion in no time.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GreetingMazoga01_0009381c_Oblivio: You're a liar. The Count is a man. And you aren't a man.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GreetingMazoga02_0009381d_Oblivio: You're a liar. You don't even look like a Count.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GREETING_00033dd0_Oblivion_RESP1: You're a likely looking prospect. Thinking about the Fighters Guild?
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GOODBYE_00086562_Oblivion_RESP1: You're a lying bastard. You killed Ra'vindra. And now I'm going to kill you.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_UmbacanoBribeB1_000a9850_Oblivion: You're a real friend of the working stiff, you know that? Maybe I'll see you there tonight, and we can drink to your generosity.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_TG04Going_0000a177_Oblivion_RESP1: You're a smart one then. I was going have to arrest you in a minute.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_Attack_0018bd69_Oblivion_RESP1: You're a traitor to your own race!
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_jointheMagesGuild_0002d280_Oblivi: You're a wanted criminal, hardly the sort of person that has a place in the guild. Clean up that record of yours, and maybe you'll be considered.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_jointheMagesGuild_0002d060_Oblivi: You're a wanted criminal. The guild doesn't accept criminals. Understand? Clear things up, and then come back.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GREETING_0002b108_Oblivion_RESP1: You're about to face off against the best the Yellow Team has to offer. Azura knows you're the best the Blue Team's got.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_bed_000b983a_Oblivion_RESP1: You're already staying in one room, and I don't rent multiple rooms to a single customer.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_HELLO_0003e210_Oblivion_RESP1: You're always welcome in Border Watch!
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GREETING_00146847_Oblivion_RESP1: You're at Bloodletter rank now, right? I caught your last match. Those were some pretty impressive moves!
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GREETING_00017684_Oblivion_RESP1: You're at the end of a long road, Hero. This is the last time you'll face off against the Yellow Team before being named Champion.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GREETING_0000c1bd_Oblivion_RESP1: You're awake.... good. I didn't want to disturb you. I suppose you're wondering what I did with Selene?
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GREETING_00022489_Oblivion_RESP1: You're back! And Antus is with you.... thank you for bringing him home safely.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GREETING_0002248d_Oblivion_RESP1: You're back! And Rallus is with you.... but where is Antus? I don't see him.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GREETING_00022490_Oblivion_RESP1: You're back! And you've brought my sons with you! How wonderful!
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_HELLO_0007b472_Oblivion_RESP1: You're back! Have a seat and tell me everything.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GREETING_000139aa_Oblivion_RESP3: You're back! How nice for you. Does that mean you've made a decision? Or are you lost? Suicidal? Just let me know.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_HELLO_000c42d3_Oblivion_RESP1: You're back! You must tell me everything!
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GREETING_0003c34d_Oblivion_RESP1: You're back, good. Did you find the evidence?
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GREETING_000270ea_Oblivion_RESP1: You're back. And you've got the Great Stone...
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_HELLO_000366e0_Oblivion_RESP1: You're back. Did you bring help?
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GREETING_00002e46_Oblivion_RESP1: You're back. Good. You have important duties to attend to.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_HELLO_0008daa1_Oblivion_RESP1: You're back. I trust everything went as planned?
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GREETING_0002e583_Oblivion_RESP1: You're back. What have you found out about Galtus Previa's disappearance?
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GREETING_00002e3f_Oblivion_RESP1: You're back. What have you found out?
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_HELLO_00038f33_Oblivion_RESP1: You're back. What news do you bring me?
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_HELLO_00038f35_Oblivion_RESP1: You're back. What news do you bring me?
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_contract_000039e7_Oblivion_RESP1: You're being sent to assassinate Adamus Phillida? Oh, finally Ocheeva has come to her senses! You'll be killed, and we'll finally be rid of you!
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_TrainingQuestTopic_0018d2b1_Obliv: You're beyond what I can teach. You might think about consulting Sinderion; he knows more about Alchemy than I do.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GREETING_00042ff0_Oblivion_RESP1: You're certainly a cute little thing aren't you? Did you fly a long way? You did? Come here and perch on my shoulder for awhile.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GREETING_0001764f_Oblivion_RESP1: You're cutting through the Yellow Team like a knife through scrib jelly! One more fight and you'll advance to Warrior rank!
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_ArenaChoice1B_00029ca7_Oblivion_R: You're damn right you will! This is a training hall, not a nursery! Now get back up those stairs while you still have legs! Damned tourists....
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GOODBYE_000432af_Oblivion_RESP1: You're doing quite well so far... keep it up!
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_advancementFG_00033562_Oblivion_R: You're due for advancement. I hereby name you Protector of the Fighters Guild.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GREETING_00028722_Oblivion_RESP1: You're enjoying all of this, aren't you? You like seeing us squirm! What in blazes is going on here? Do you have something to do with this?
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GarlicTopic_0005373e_Oblivion_RES: You're familiar with it, aren't you? Often used in cooking. It should be quite easy to find.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_SE03AReward_0007f3cf_Oblivion_RES: You're free to go at any time of course, just up that hallway. Good luck to you!
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GREETING_000860c0_Oblivion_RESP1: You're getting on my nerves. What do you want?
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_SE43Meat_00072dc5_Oblivion_RESP1: You're giving me free food? You're a good friend. Thank you.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_SheoIntroSpeech5_00056095_Oblivio: You're going to Xedilian, one of my favorite spots in the Isles. It's a little place I use to take care of unwanted visitors.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_SE05SylHelp_0001361f_Oblivion_RES: You're going to find out who knows. You're going to learn who keeps secrets, who conspires against me.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GREETING_0002a353_Oblivion_RESP1: You're going to get arrested if you don't leave right away!
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_BarterFail_00061ff2_Oblivion_RESP: You're going to have to do better than that.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GREETING_0003842d_Oblivion_RESP1: You're going to have to leave. This is a crime scene and no one other than ourselves or Raynil Dralas will be allowed access.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_contract_000039e3_Oblivion_RESP1: You're going to kill Adamus Phillida? You? Ha ha ha ha ha! Oh, it'll be a retirement, all right. Yours!
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_SE06JyggalagTopic_000910f6_Oblivi: You're going to stop him, though. And the first thing to do is to make my people feel safe. Otherwise, they tend to go work for him.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_SE06GreymarchTopic_000910ed_Obliv: You're going to stop the Greymarch by becoming Me. Or a version of Me. You'll be powerful. Powerful enough to stop Jyggalag.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GREETING_00023e84_Oblivion_RESP4: You're going to travel to Cheydinhal, and find out what sort of imposter is trying to besmirch my good name. And you're going to tell him... *hic*
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_MS09TyrelliusTalk_000908ec_Oblivi: You're gonna end up rotting here anyway, you idiot.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_SE12HaskillGreetA1_00016cfe_Obliv: You're having a bit of fun with me. Very good.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GREETING_0002d915_Oblivion_RESP2: You're heading back to Skingrad, aren't you? Could I... maybe come with you? It'd be safer, I think. So, what do you say?
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GREETING_0004a989_Oblivion_RESP1: You're here about that recommendation, I presume. I'll need to speak with Erthor before I write it.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GREETING_000151f6_Oblivion_RESP4: You're here from the Council, aren't you?
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GREETING_00017649_Oblivion_RESP1: You're hungry, Myrmidon! I can see it in your eyes! You ready to feed that hunger? Huh? You ready for another match?
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GREETING_00047658_Oblivion_RESP1: You're in Rindir's Staffs. And I'm Rindir. I sell magical staffs. Imagine that.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GREETING_0001544b_Oblivion_RESP1: You're in charge. Let us know what positions we should take up, but be quick about it. The Necromancers could come out of there any time now.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_HELLO_00062c9a_Oblivion_RESP1: You're in good company, friend. Welcome.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_MG05AChoice1A_00028c07_Oblivion_R: You're in the guild, aren't you? You should be able to walk right in, find it, and take it. And if you can't, then break in. I want that book.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_jointheMagesGuild_0002d281_Oblivi: You're interested in joining? Great things will be expected of you. Are you sure you're ready for it?
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_TGNocturnal_00018334_Oblivion_RES: You're kidding. Everybody knows Nocturnal. She is the daedra lord of shadows. The Mistress of Mystery. The Saint of Suspicion.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GREETING_0009db4e_Oblivion_RESP1: You're living on borrowed time, thief!
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_causingtrouble_0002c7c4_Oblivion_: You're looking for Rellian, Vantus Prelius, and Dubok gro-Shagk. I haven't had any trouble with them before, so find out what's going on.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_CharGenBaurus_0000b1c6_Oblivion_R: You're lucky I like you. Otherwise you'd be dead already.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_NDTalkGarlas2_00002c41_Knights_RE: You're lucky to have been with the Crusader on such a glorious day. We latecomers will always measure our deeds against Garlas Malatar.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_SE06HelpAttackA5_00012cd2_Oblivio: You're making a mistake. There is no other way to light the Flame.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_HELLO_00088fa8_Oblivion_RESP1: You're making me nervous, sneaking around like that. Just make sure you keep your hands to yourself.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_INFOGENERAL_0005f236_Oblivion_RES: You're more fearsome than the new Gatekeeper. Look at the teeth on you!
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_SE06DSWardenGreet3_00018e8a_Obliv: You're more intelligent that I expected from a mortal, and a male at that. Away with you, then.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GREETING_00038580_Oblivion_RESP6: You're my only hope at the moment. Please, you have my authorization to do everything you can to bring him to justice.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_contract_00047423_Oblivion_RESP1: You're needed in Chorrol. Report to Vilena Donton. She's got some duties for you to take care of.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GREETING_00038a80_Oblivion_RESP1: You're new here in Skingrad? Fine. I'll make sure the captain knows we have a stranger in town.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GREETING_00038acf_Oblivion_RESP1: You're new here, or you'd know me. Toutius Sextius. My people have lived in Skingrad since the Dawn. Father and the Count were best of friends.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GREETING_00041094_Oblivion_RESP1: You're new here, so I'll try to be patient with you.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_HELLO_0004735f_Oblivion_RESP1: You're new to Gaiar Alata, aren't you?
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_Attack_0008c237_Oblivion_RESP1: You're no better than the others.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GOODBYE_00071faf_Oblivion_RESP1: You're no fun. I bet you don't like dogs.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GREETING_00033dd5_Oblivion_RESP1: You're not afraid of trouble, are you? You'd like the Fighters Guild.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_NDTalkUmaril4_00002c4d_Knights_RE: You're not alone. We all find the waiting difficult at times. I will pray for you, and I ask the same of you. Go with the blessing.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_MS16Brothers_00084a9f_Oblivion_RE: You're not dreaming, Reynald. It's me, your brother. Guilbert.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GREETING_00022b8b_Oblivion_RESP1: You're not easy to get a hold of. What have you found out?
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_DovesiDranTopic_00028711_Oblivion: You're not even worthy enough to mention her name, you low-born parasite. Now get away from me before YOU wind up dead!
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_AnvilTopic_0003e0b9_Oblivion_RESP: You're not from around here, are you? Just a warning... be careful if you go swimming. It's the slaughterfish. They'll swarm you.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_SE02GatesOfMadness_0007eae7_Obliv: You're not getting in because you're not blessed by Sheogorath. You can try to get the keys. My Lord had them sewn into my child's body.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_MQ13MartinA1_00027101_Oblivion_RE: You're not going to like it. Jauffre doesn't like it. The Countess of Bruma certainly isn't going to like it.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_FGD02Insults_0002cfb5_Oblivion_RE: You're not half the man your father was.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_CharGenTaunt2_00033355_Oblivion_R: You're not leaving this prison 'til they throw your body in the lake. Oh, that's right. You're going to die in here, Breton! You're going to die!
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_CheydinhalTopic_0004e8cf_Oblivion: You're not on my list. And that's all I have to say. If you were somebody, I'd know. But I don't, so you aren't.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_ShrineofMalacathTOPIC_0001ec2f_Ob: You're not one of Malacath's favorite people. He likes Orcs. Too bad for you.  So you approach His shrine at your own risk.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_HELLO_0004735b_Oblivion_RESP1: You're not one of us, are you? Are you here to destroy Gaiar Alata and end our nightmare?
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GREETING_0000a172_Oblivion_RESP1: You're not supposed to be down here.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GREETING_0002a377_Oblivion_RESP1: You're not supposed to be here now. Leave, please.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_Trespass_00062272_Oblivion_RESP1: You're not supposed to be in here...
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_SE06DSWardenGreet2_00018e7f_Obliv: You're not very good at this are you?
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_AxeofDragol_0001fdba_Oblivion_RES: You're now the prey in Kurdan's insane hunt, just like I am. And here, we'll most likely die.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_SE37Errand_000452f8_Oblivion_RESP: You're offering to help me with my research? Well... I suppose I could find a use for you, despite your lack of training.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_FGD02Insults_0002cfce_Oblivion_RE: You're paying for all of this!
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_TestToddNeutral_0002830a_Oblivion: You're pissing me off, what next?
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_MaladaTopic_0002c52a_Oblivion_RES: You're probably wondering what this one is doing in this gods-forsaken wilderness. Same here. S'razirr doesn't get paid nearly enough for this.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_ReadyForAMatch_0003d7b3_Oblivion_: You're ready to fight? Good, good! All right then, head up to the Arena and give the people a great show!
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GOODBYE_0003c354_Oblivion_RESP1: You're really pushing it. Just keep disturbing me.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_NDTalkUmaril3_00002c50_Knights_RE: You're right, of course. When we strike, we will strike with the holy power of the gods behind us!
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_MS27HerminiaD2_000a5606_Oblivion_: You're right. Even if I persuade you, he'll send someone else, someone less amenable to reason.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_DANocturnalConvo1_00026ab3_Oblivi: You're right. I know. I'm just worried. I'll try to calm down.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_ChorrolNQDResponses_00029fe9_Obli: You're right. It's shameful. Still, what is anyone supposed to do? It's her life.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_AmuletofKingsTopic_0001efe3_Obliv: You're right. We must try to recover the Amulet before the enemy takes it out of our reach.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_MS48IlendA2_001778d0_Oblivion_RES: You're right. You're right. I can't just leave poor Menian to his fate. If he's still alive, we've got to try to save him.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_NDTalkDeadKnight3_00002cd9_Knight: You're right. You're right. Thank you. Perhaps we can reminisce more later.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GOODBYE_0003d4d5_Oblivion_RESP1: You're sharp for an adventurer. If you ever decide to retire, I'm sure the Anvil City Watch would love to have you.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GREETING_00028b7e_Oblivion_RESP1: You're starting to crowd me, friend. Why don't you just back off, eh?
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_SE46DoublesTopic_00081ed5_Oblivio: You're still annoying me, but not as much as the other J'zidzo.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GREETING_0002416b_Oblivion_RESP1: You're still around? I've told you why I defaulted on the contract. Not too much else to be said about it. Do what you must.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GREETING_0001bb25_Oblivion_RESP3: You're stuck here like I am.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GREETING_0000be60_Oblivion_RESP1: You're supposed to be helping out the folks at Harlun's Watch. What's the status?
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GREETING_0003450f_Oblivion_RESP1: You're taking the meeting. You'd better get in there before they realize you didn't come alone.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GREETING_000476fa_Oblivion_RESP1: You're talking to Algot the Northerner. Guess you've got nothing better to do.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_INFOGENERAL_0002a86a_Oblivion_RES: You're talking to me, and I don't like you. Goodbye.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GREETING_0001365a_Oblivion_RESP1: You're talking to me. You should be talking to the Priests. You can't be doing both, can you? Neat trick if you could.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_TG11TalkToMillona02_00022e7d_Obli: You're the Gray Fox! I've been betrayed!
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_HELLO_0003ab30_Oblivion_RESP1: You're the Gray Fox! Please don't hurt me!
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_HELLO_0003ab3a_Oblivion_RESP1: You're the Gray Fox! Thank you for everything you've done to help us here in the waterfront.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GREETING_000a80b1_Oblivion_RESP1: You're the Gray Fox! You're under arrest for... for... for all kinds of stuff! You're wanted dead or alive. I'm choosing dead.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_Attack_0018bd64_Oblivion_RESP1: You're the best the Blue Team has to offer? Ha!
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_duties_0006e2e6_Oblivion_RESP1: You're the boss. What orders do you have?
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GreetingFollowNo_00090b76_Oblivio: You're the boss. Whenever you're ready....
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_NDJoinOrderReject_00002b31_Knight: You're the commander. We know how to take orders. But I know that one day we'll earn your trust.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GREETING_000a944a_Oblivion_RESP1: You're the leader of this expedition. So lead on!
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_HELLO_0003c14e_Oblivion_RESP1: You're the one that saved Cheydinhal from that Oblivion Gate, aren't you?
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_SE05SylFindYou_0007fe20_Oblivion_: You're the one the Madgod sent, aren't you?
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_SkingradTopic_00038a88_Oblivion_R: You're the one who closed the Skingrad gate? You must be... the Hero of Kvatch.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GREETING_0018ad5c_Oblivion_RESP1: You're the one who closed the gate? Thank you.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GREETING_00002984_Knights_RESP1: You're the one who restored the Knights of the Nine, right? Well done, if I may say so. We could use more people like you these days.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_Pillar_00033534_Oblivion_RESP1: You're the one with the book. You tell me how it works!
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GREETING_0002887c_Oblivion_RESP1: You're the one with the weapons shipment, right? Let's talk about that.

ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_TrainingQuestTopic_000613a0_Obliv: You've got to have the know-how, or else I can't teach you anything at all. Do you have what it takes? Do you even know what it takes?
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GREETING_00036620_Oblivion_RESP1: You've got to take care of those mountain lions!
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_bed_000b124e_Oblivion_RESP1: You've got what 10 gold will buy you. I never said it'd be a palace.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_SE05Conspiracy_0008568c_Oblivion_: You've got what you need from me. I can't tell you anything more.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_BarterSellItem_000981b9_Oblivion_: You've got yourself a deal, idiot. Now I can sell it for 5 times its worth.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_INFOGENERAL_00049947_Oblivion_RES: You've gotta like a store named Slash 'N Smash.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_SE46DoublesTopic_00081ef3_Oblivio: You've gotten rid of the other one? Fantastic. I can finally get back to my book.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_breakins_000356b5_Oblivion_RESP1: You've gotten them? Wonderful! But... their names are familiar to me. All of those men have worked for me! Amazing.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_SE05HerdirInvestigateCurrentTask_: You've heard Ma'zaddha. Isn't it time to confront him with that fact?
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_DovesiDranTopic_00028d34_Oblivion: You've helped me come to my senses, friend. There's no time for evidence gathering, no time to collect proof! Dovesi is the murderer!
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GREETING_00041096_Oblivion_RESP1: You've interrupted my tree growth measurements! You've ruined a whole day's work! Why can't you just leave me alone?
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GREETING_0001fdb2_Oblivion_RESP1: You've killed all three? Wonderful! Now you must find the key. According to Kurdan, it should be on one of their bodies.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GREETING_00025dfa_Oblivion_RESP1: You've killed another of your brothers! During other times, I'd have you killed for this. One chance. Bring me twenty minotaur horns.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GREETING_0003e845_Oblivion_RESP1: You've killed my child! How dare you! Get out of my sight!
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_SE46DoublesTopic_00081f16_Oblivio: You've killed my double? Good work. Now, please... just leave me alone. I taste terrible.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GREETING_00025e24_Oblivion_RESP1: You've killed one of your Fighters Guild brothers! I'll have no more to do with you. If you have any hope of redemption, speak with Vilena Donton.

ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_SE46DoublesTopic_00081eca_Oblivio: You've made a mess of all that. You're a terrible worker.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GREETING_00081f17_Oblivion_RESP1: You've made a real mess of things here.

ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GREETING_00019858_Oblivion_RESP1: You've made short work of the intruders. Sheogorath should be proud to have such an efficient apprentice.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GREETING_00031613_Oblivion_RESP1: You've made your choice and forsaken the name Arden-Sul. I have no wish to speak to you.

ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GREETING_00143f0c_Oblivion_RESP1: You've made your choice... now leave me be.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GREETING_00014ac3_Oblivion_RESP1: You've made your selection. Now, we travel to the statue of our Lord, in the Fringe. There we will perform the ceremony. Make haste!
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GREETING_00081f18_Oblivion_RESP1: You've messed this place up. I'm tired just thinking about it.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_SE35Heart_00078677_Oblivion_RESP2: You've more than earned your reward. I believe a bit of a bonus is in order. Well done.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GREETING_00025e1f_Oblivion_RESP1: You've murdered one of your brothers. While we may die in battle, we do not expect to die at the hands of our friends.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GREETING_000b0718_Oblivion_RESP1: You've murdered the poor beasts! And ruined us! Leave us alone!
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_FGD02Insults_0002cf38_Oblivion_RE: You've never worked an honest day in your life, you stupid orc!
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_SE03AWhatWere_000807b9_Oblivion_R: You've not heard the legends? How could that be?
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GREETING_000a7159_Oblivion_RESP1: You've overstayed your welcome here, I'm afraid.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_Trespass_0018d83c_Oblivion_RESP1: You've overstayed your welcome, I'm afraid.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_ND04Mace_00002ac6_Knights_RESP1: You've passed Zenithar's challenge and redeemed Sir Ralvas. Congratulations. Sir Juncan will be pleased to hear this.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_MythicDawnTopic_00024e6c_Oblivion: You've piqued my curiousity about this puzzle. I will think on it myself and let you know if I have any ideas.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_DAHircineSpeech_00051ee1_Oblivion: You've pleased me, hunter. Take my token, and wear it well. Hereafter, take your prey, and whisper my name.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GREETING_00026a9a_Oblivion_RESP1: You've pleased the Madgod! You must be proud of yourself. I, for one, still would like to eat your eyes. But, good for you!
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_Announcer_0004666c_Oblivion_RESP1: You've prayed for it, and these combatants have bled for it -- a high stakes advancement match! Let's see who has what it takes to be your new Hero!
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_BarterFail_0003d07d_Oblivion_RESP: You've priced yourself out of a deal. Care to make a counter-offer?
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GREETING_0001b6a6_Oblivion_RESP5: You've probably figured that out by now. Let's hope so. Or we're in real trouble... and out come the intestines. And I skip rope with them!
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_ND04Mace_00002ac5_Knights_RESP1: You've retrieved the Mace! I... I can't beleive it! Sir Knight, I bend my knee in awe at your wisdom. You deserve to carry the mace.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_HELLO_000093c0_Oblivion_RESP1: You've returned! But where is Rythe?
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GREETING_0003a902_Oblivion_RESP1: You've returned! So, have you been to Crowhaven? Have you... Oh, I see you have not yet recovered any proof of my birth...
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GREETING_0003a903_Oblivion_RESP1: You've returned! So, have you been to Crowhaven? Have you... Oh, I see you have not yet recovered any proof of my birth...
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GREETING_0003b359_Oblivion_RESP1: You've returned! So, have you been to Crowhaven? Have you... What's this? The Journal of Lord Lovidicus? My friend, you've done it!
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_HELLO_00094ec0_Oblivion_RESP1: You've returned. And with the little ones in tow. Lovely.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GREETING_00090799_Oblivion_RESP1: You've returned. I trust you've weighed the importance of your new position. For you will soon hear words that will change lives, alter destinies.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_SE04XedilianChoice_00044f52_Obliv: You've run a maze like a good little rat, but no cheese for you yet. Well, maybe a little.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GREETING_0006143e_Oblivion_RESP1: You've seen Lucien Lachance, then? Good, good. I know whatever task he has for you will be carried out with skill and discretion.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_SE04SheoIntro1_0008245e_Oblivion_: You've seen his Knights. Not the warm and cuddly sort. Not a bit of original thought in their lifeless husks. So, you're going to help Me stop him.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GREETING_000b1213_Oblivion_RESP1: You've seen it! You've seen the first sign! Perhaps this is the beginning of the K'Sharra!
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_SE08CommanderGreeting2_00018c80_O: You've seen the Spire in Passwall. It is believed to be a monument from times past but its true purpose appears to be more sinister.

ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_NDGauntletsoftheCrusader_00002b16: You've seen them, I assume. The only evidence of what happened so many years ago.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_SE06HelpAttackA3B1_00012cce_Obliv: You've seen this with your own eyes? I must be sure it isn't a trap if I'm to take such a risk.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_SE06HelpAttackA3B2_000192e9_Obliv: You've seen this with your own eyes? I must be sure it isn't a trap if I'm to take such a risk.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_INFOGENERAL_0018bc82_Oblivion_RES: You've seen wayshrines in the wilderness? Those who've pleased the Nine may receive Blessings of Willpower at the Wayshrines of Mara.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GREETING_000192e5_Oblivion_RESP1: You've served Sheogorath well. Farewell. I go now to kindle the Altar of Despair.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GREETING_000192e7_Oblivion_RESP1: You've served Sheogorath well. Farewell. I go now to kindle the Altar of Despair.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GOODBYE_0001e7a4_Oblivion_RESP1: You've shown me mercy. I won't forget that. Thank you.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GREETING_0008f11e_Oblivion_RESP1: You've spoken to Dyus, yes? Then there is little more to say. Do as he instructs -- recreate the Staff of Sheogorath before it is too late.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_EmfridDEMOBittneldTOPIC_00028a31_: You've spoken to him by now, haven't you?
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GREETING_00002992_Knights_RESP1: You've spoken to him, haven't you.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GREETING_00026aa5_Oblivion_RESP1: You've spoken to the Madgod. Joy of joys! Are you elated? Excited? Aroused? Blessed are you. Blessed is He!
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_EmfridDEMOchoice2_00028a2f_Oblivi: You've spoken with him? Really? What did he say? I beg you, tell me.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GREETING_000356ae_Oblivion_RESP1: You've started the job; now you must finish it. You need to get back to Leyawiin. How can I help?
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GREETING_00025e2a_Oblivion_RESP1: You've stolen from the Fighters Guild! Go speak with Vilena Donton. None of your brothers will deal with you until you atone for your actions.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_causingtrouble_0002c7b6_Oblivion_: You've stopped them from fighting. Now find out why it went on. Then do something about it!
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GREETING_00017986_Oblivion_RESP1: You've survived! It is a miracle! Hail the warrior Duke of Mania!
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GREETING_0001ebf0_Oblivion_RESP1: You've survived! It... it cannot be!
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GOODBYE_0000a21c_Oblivion_RESP1: You've taken up enough of my time.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GREETING_00081f3a_Oblivion_RESP1: You've written a tragedy in our small town.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_MG13ChoiceWhatproblem_000039a4_Ob: You, however, can act with impunity, and so will take care of this for me. Then I will tell you what I know.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_DASheogorathSpeech_00095794_Obliv: You, of all people, should realize this is an inopportune time to be in Cyrodiil. Perhaps I've misjudged you.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_HELLO_00025285_Oblivion_RESP1: You. I hoped Sithis would have claimed you by now.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GREETING_0006fdc2_Oblivion_RESP1: You. I've seen your kind before. You've got blood on your hands. Keep your blade sheathed, you murdering bastard, or I'll put you down myself.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GREETING_0014684d_Oblivion_RESP1: You... You killed Agronak. The Gray Prince is... dead. He... He was my friend, my mentor... Congratulations, Grand Champion. Hope it was worth it.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_PickpocketNoCrime_000626b9_Oblivi: You... You picked their pocket! Shame on you...
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_Dark08Choice4B_00085861_Oblivion_: You... You would do that for me? You are truly a good friend. Yes, I... I fear this is beyond even my ability. I'm not as young as I used to be.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_Dark06Choice2C_0004e9af_Oblivion_: You... You're kind of weird. You know that? But... That's okay. I... I like crazy people. I like crazy people... and skooma! Ssshhh! Ha ha ha ha ha!
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GREETING_0002f4d9_Oblivion_RESP1: You... You're not the one Lachance was talking about! Please... Please, don't kill me! You can take anything you like, then just leave!
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_HELLO_00082472_Oblivion_RESP1: You... Your Grace. We did not expect you here.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GREETING_0002d916_Oblivion_RESP1: You... how did you get in here? Are those horrible creatures gone?
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GREETING_0008f11f_Oblivion_RESP1: You... you do not belong here. Quickly! Put on a robe before the others see you! They will kill you on sight!
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GREETING_00016b58_Oblivion_RESP1: You... you do not belong here. You are a stranger!
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GREETING_000286d9_Oblivion_RESP1: You... you murdering dog! How could you have killed all those people? For the gold, is that it? You filthy peasant!
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_SE05SylWho_000139b3_Oblivion_RESP: You... you will help me. Yes, yes. You will be most useful.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_MS08UrsanneNoWorry_0001f42c_Obliv: You... you will? Oh thank you! Please be careful, I don't wish any harm to befall you either.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GREETING_00072dab_Oblivion_RESP1: You... you're a cat! Get away from me!

ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GREETING_000286d6_Oblivion_RESP1: You... you're still alive... For all I know, you're the killer! You stand your ground, or so help me they'll be blood between us.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GREETING_0002822c_Oblivion_RESP1: You... you're the only one left... By Azura, no! Please, please don't kill me. I beg of you! Spare my life! Aggghhh!
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_PrimoAntoniusTopic_0002818d_Obliv: You... you're trying to turn me against that sweet boy. Make me think he's the murderer! Get away from me, you fiend!
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_SEBolwing_0008153b_Oblivion_RESP1: You...you can! Bless you, My Lord! I should have known that you of all people would be able to understand me!

ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GREETING_0003e901_Oblivion_RESP1: You? Why would I want to talk with you? Very well, out with it before I change my mind and add you to my list of experiments!
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_MS31Minx03Final_0001525c_Oblivion: You? You bested Lynch? I always knew he was out of practice. Oh well, I suppose it's up to me to do his job for him as usual!
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_FGD02Insults_0002cfb6_Oblivion_RE: You? You wouldn't know a good sword if it stabbed you in the throat!

ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GREETING_0001ebf1_Oblivion_RESP1: Your Grace, I bend my knee to you. How you survived the collapse, I cannot imagine.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GREETING_0001f380_Oblivion_RESP1: Your Grace, Issmi has been waiting for you. Please speak with her.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GREETING_0001796f_Oblivion_RESP1: Your Grace, a dark time has been thrust upon us. Passwall is under attack. We are outmatched and outnumbered.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GREETING_00040363_Oblivion_RESP1: Your Grace, has Relmyna sent you on an errand? Do you need help with your task?
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GREETING_00017967_Oblivion_RESP1: Your Grace, the situation is grim. Passwall is under attack. We are outmatched and outnumbered.

ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GREETING_000459b5_Oblivion_RESP1: Your Grace, you have committed a crime. Only the Lord Sheogorath is above the laws of this Realm.

ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_MQ04Conv_00037c3b_Oblivion_RESP1: Your Highness. The Blades are at your command. You will be safe here until you can take up your throne.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_HELLO_000276a8_Oblivion_RESP1: Your Highness? I am Narina Carvain, Countess of Bruma, at your service.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_ND09ProphetQuestionsEnd_00002c18_: Your Knights will assemble at Garlas Malatar and await you there. Gather all those who you deem worthy.

ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GREETING_00009c7b_Oblivion_RESP3: Your Purification of the Cheydinhal Sanctuary. You, a mere underling, even managed to single-handedly eliminate half of my Black Hand!

ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_advancementFG_0003355e_Oblivion_R: Your accomplishments are impressive. Because of this, I bestow upon you the rank of Warder of the Fighters Guild.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GREETING_0002d3a1_Oblivion_RESP4: Your actions are duly noted, and your reward will be in gold.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_MagesStaff_0002c67c_Oblivion_RESP: Your actions for the guild more than merit a recommendation. I shall send it to the University promptly.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GREETING_00025036_Oblivion_RESP1: Your actions have gotten you suspended from the guild.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_Gang_0008676b_Oblivion_RESP2: Your actions have set back our investigation, and maybe driven the rest of the gang into hiding. Nice work.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_SE14Attacks_00046825_Oblivion_RES: Your assistance may be needed in Hale, Lord. If you are otherwise occupied, I'm certain the survivors will understand.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_SE14Attacks_00046820_Oblivion_RES: Your attention is still needed at Highcross, though I realize it must be inconvenient for you.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_ND06CasimirHurryUp_00002b26_Knigh: Your attitude does not bode well. Nevertheless, you may yet succeed where I failed.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GatherClues_000034aa_Oblivion_RES: Your best bet is to speak to residents of the castle. Once you have found out all you can, search for physical clues.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GREETING_00018f96_Oblivion_RESP1: Your betrayal of the Aureals was a strategem worthy of one of my own people! Victory by means of treachery is the sweetest kind.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GREETING_00036414_Oblivion_RESP1: Your blood will satisfy Lord Dagon just as well as the prisoner's. It will be our honor to spill your blood for Him, if you choose that path.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_HouseTooMuchSkingrad_0004f218_Obl: Your blood? I wouldn't dream of paying 10,000 gold for your blood. But that is the price for that house. Take it or leave it.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_MG18Choice2B_00070486_Oblivion_RE: Your body will be preserved as a Worm Thrall. Your soul is mine; I intend to study both to learn more about the source of your power.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GREETING_0018d29f_Oblivion_RESP1: Your bravery is the talk of Skingrad. Well done!
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GREETING_0001ebb4_Oblivion_RESP1: Your business with Vaermina is complete. Tremble should she visit you in your dreams.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_MQ13NarinaMartin1_0002777e_Oblivi: Your champion has already explained the situation to me. I have agreed to it. We will not win this war through caution.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_MG08ChoiceStartOver_00035623_Obli: Your choices are Destruction, Illusion, or Mysticism. Which will it be?
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_TrainingQuestTopic_0006139e_Obliv: Your courage is admirable, but now is not the time. Once Kvatch is safe from these attackers, then we might speak of training.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_TG03Reveal_00045f69_Oblivion_RESP: Your credibility is suspect. You'll have to do better than that to persuade me.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GREETING_0000295c_Knights_RESP1: Your crimes are of no account to me. I am neither judge nor priest.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_Dark16Choice1A_000262d5_Oblivion_: Your dead drops went unvisited, your targets ignored. Instead, you have been systematically killing off all the members of the Black Hand!
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_Dark16Choice1B_000262d6_Oblivion_: Your dead drops went unvisited, your targets ignored. Instead, you have been systematically killing off all the members of the Black Hand!
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_Dark16Choice1C_000262d7_Oblivion_: Your dead drops went unvisited, your targets ignored. Instead, you have been systematically killing off all the members of the Black Hand!
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_ShrineofClavicusVileTOPIC_000b97c: Your deal is made. Return when you have done your part.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_DABoethiaChoice2_0001ec93_Oblivio: Your decision is a wise one. You would be foolish to think that you might gain the favor of Boethia.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GREETING_0007ec5e_Oblivion_RESP1: Your desires are my command, my lady.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GREETING_0007ec5d_Oblivion_RESP1: Your desires are my command, my lord.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_CharGenEmperor_0000bcac_Oblivion_: Your destiny calls you down a different road. Please help us.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_SE05PostTortureGreet_000811c7_Obl: Your efforts are futile. You'll get nothing from me!
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_Hit_00074a08_Oblivion_RESP1: Your efforts are in vain, mortal!
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_MQ11BrumaAllies_000270f0_Oblivion: Your efforts are starting to pay off. Just knowing we do not stand alone has raised the morale of the Bruma Guard.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GREETING_0009db23_Oblivion_RESP1: Your failure angers Mephala. Leave here.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_MQ15MankarRant_0008c23e_Oblivion_: Your false gods could not entirely rewrite history. Thus you remember tales of Lorkhan, vilified, a dead trickster, whose heart came to Tamriel.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_MS46Response_000343b4_Oblivion_RE: Your father was the one that got us into this mess! I'm tired of you always defending him.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_contract_00003885_Oblivion_RESP1: Your first contract requires the killing of a pirate captain, on his ship. Are you ready to accept?
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_Dark16Choice1A_000262d5_Oblivion_: Your first dead drop contract, you carried that out, killed Celedaen. After that, you eliminated the Draconis family, as ordered. Then, betrayal!
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_Dark16Choice1B_000262d6_Oblivion_: Your first dead drop contract, you carried that out, killed Celedaen. After that, you eliminated the Draconis family, as ordered. Then, betrayal!
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_Dark16Choice1C_000262d7_Oblivion_: Your first dead drop contract, you carried that out, killed Celedaen. After that, you eliminated the Draconis family, as ordered. Then, betrayal!
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_SE14Duties_0004b830_Oblivion_RESP: Your first duty is to attend to the needs of your subjects. You will find that there are constant threats to the residents of the Isles.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_duties_000356c4_Oblivion_RESP1: Your first duty should be to name your second-in-command. I can think of no one better for this job than Modryn Oreyn.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GREETING_00034065_Oblivion_RESP1: Your first priority now should be to find Martin and bring him back here.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_MS22HighFane_0002af36_Oblivion_RE: Your first task is to locate the ruins of the High Fane. I believe it must now be known by a different name.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_SE40SleepOutside_000790bf_Oblivio: Your friend ain't sleeping, eh? You could buy one of me sticks - a dreamstick, yes! Hit him over the head. Knock him into dreamland. No? Hmmm.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_TGPayBloodPrice_000153ae_Oblivion: Your generosity restores your honor within the guild. You may now seek membership.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_information_00009224_Oblivion_RES: Your guild does not fully appreciate the danger which quickly approaches. Hopefully when you return to them, their eyes will be opened.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_TGPayBloodPrice_000174ba_Oblivion: Your honor is restored. The Thieves Guild welcomes you back. This one may now pay you for finding the book.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_SE08CommanderPlan3_00018c88_Obliv: Your insight is impressive. While we draw their attention here, you should be able to slip inside Xeddefen.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_SE08CommanderPlan3_00018c89_Obliv: Your insight is impressive. While we draw their attention here, you should be able to slip inside Xeddefen.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_SE10GreymarchTopic_0009148a_Obliv: Your job is still to stop it. And to stop Jyggalag. You've already forced Order's hand.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_SE14Duties_0004b830_Oblivion_RESP: Your job is to protect them, either by dealing with the matter yourself, or sending your armies to take care of it for you.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GREETING_00009c7b_Oblivion_RESP2: Your killing of the old man Baenlin... the execution of Adamus Phillida... the way you stalked and murdered each member of the Draconis family...
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_NDTalkDeadKnight3_00002cda_Knight: Your kind words comfort me. I'll try to follow your example. Thank you for lending me your ear.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GREETING_0002fdb3_Oblivion_RESP4: Your life in the Sanctuary is over. Those contracts are behind you. Now, you will serve the Black Hand. You will serve me.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_Attack_0008f127_Oblivion_RESP1: Your light will shine no more.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_MQ15KathutetC6_0003e8fd_Oblivion_: Your mind follows the simple path ... the choice of an animal. You see an enemy and you attack it, unthinking.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_MQ15KathutetC2_0003e8f7_Oblivion_: Your mind follows the simple path, the choice of an animal. But you have courage, at least.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GREETING_0002e71e_Oblivion_RESP6: Your name shall be revered and your deeds placed into song to be performed by the greatest bards for generations to come. Congratulations!
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GREETING_00031eba_Oblivion_RESP6: Your name shall be revered and your deeds placed into song to be performed by the greatest bards for generations to come. Congratulations!
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GREETING_00018f97_Oblivion_RESP1: Your name will be hailed whenever we toast this day's victory in our halls at Pinnacle Rock.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_NDPelinalVisionSpeech_00002ab2_Kn: Your need must be great for the gods to allow us to speak.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_Dark10SancChoice1A_00032bf0_Obliv: Your next contract can be found at the dead drop on Hero Hill, southeast of here. A hollow in the moss-covered rock contains all you need to know.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_Dark10SancChoice1B_00032bf1_Obliv: Your next contract can be found at the dead drop on Hero Hill, southeast of here. A hollow in the moss-covered rock contains all you need to know.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_Dark10SancChoice1C_00032bf3_Obliv: Your next contract can be found at the dead drop on Hero Hill, southeast of here. A hollow in the moss-covered rock contains all you need to know.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_ReadyForAMatch_000182c6_Oblivion_: Your next opponent is a Khajiit. Not one of the quick, jumpy ones either. This cat goes in heavy, usually with an axe! Now go get 'em!
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_ReadyForAMatch_00018290_Oblivion_: Your next opponent is the most savage, blood-crazed Orc I've ever seen, and believe me I've seen a lot of 'em! This will not be fun!
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_ReadyForAMatch_000182b9_Oblivion_: Your next opponent wears a Heavy Raiment, but attacks with a short sword. She's like a heavily-armored wasp, and has the temper to match. Careful.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_INFOGENERAL_0009148d_Oblivion_RES: Your pardon, citizen. I must return to my post.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GOODBYE_00047373_Oblivion_RESP1: Your path is clear. Send Rufio to his death, and the Dark Brotherhood will embrace you as family.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GREETING_0003d7f5_Oblivion_RESP1: Your place is on the battlefield. I have trusted you this far. Do not fail me.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_MQ13BattlePlans_0003d7f7_Oblivion: Your plan is madness. There must be another way for you to recover the Amulet without risking Bruma's destruction.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_TG07WhereSkrivva_00098394_Oblivio: Your poor memory is my good fortune. What's it worth to ya?
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_NDPelinalVisionSpeech_00002ab0_Kn: Your prayers have woken me from my endless dream. Or perhaps you have entered my dream, and I still sleep.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_SEDyusTormentTopic_000807af_Obliv: Your predecessor cursed me with immortality and placed me in this remote location in order to "protect His Realm from my knowledge."
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_DASheogorathSpeech_00095779_Obliv: Your predecessor did have one task He wanted performed, though He never found a mortal suited for the task.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_Seen_001854ee_Oblivion_RESP1: Your presence here will not be tolerated!
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GREETING_00002985_Knights_RESP1: Your quest for the Crusader's Relics was the equal of any of the old tales! Well met, Sir Knight!
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GREETING_00002956_Knights_RESP1: Your quest proceeds apace. You may yet prove a worthy successor to Pelinal Whitestrake.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GREETING_0018d295_Oblivion_RESP1: Your reputation precedes you, Gate-Closer, Scourge of Oblivion, Hero of Kvatch!
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_MQ11BrumaAllies_000270fb_Oblivion: Your reputation precedes you, Hero of Kvatch! You have done my city a great service by closing the Oblivion Gate.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_HELLO_0007ec71_Oblivion_RESP1: Your return is most welcome, Your Grace.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_MS27UmbacanoD1_000a6583_Oblivion_: Your reward will be whatever plunder you wish to carry off from Nenalata.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_MQ06MankarSpeech_0001f87a_Oblivio: Your reward, Brothers and Sisters! The time of Cleansing draws nigh. I go now to Paradise. I shall return with Lord Dagon at the coming of the Dawn!
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_Advancement_00188f40_Oblivion_RES: Your role within the guild becomes ever more essential. You have now attained the rank of Warlock, and are freely able to access the Council Chamber.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_HELLO_000206c7_Oblivion_RESP1: Your safe return speaks volumes of your success.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_advancementFG_0003355f_Oblivion_R: Your service to the guild has not gone unnoticed. Henceforth, you will carry the rank of Defender. Bear the title proudly.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_Advancement_00084b4a_Oblivion_RES: Your services to the guild have not gone unnoticed. As of this moment, you have gained the rank of Evoker.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_SE13JyggalagVoice_00095e30_Oblivi: Your staff does not make you a Daedra, foolish mortal.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_MG08Choice3B_00035626_Oblivion_RE: Your staff will give you power over ice. Is that what you want? If not, we can start over.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_MG08Choice3C_00035627_Oblivion_RE: Your staff will let you wield the power of lightning. If you want something else instead, we can start over.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_CGEmperor14_00032473_Oblivion_RES: Your stars are not mine. Today the Apprentice shall serve you at the forge of destiny.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_CGEmperor14_00032474_Oblivion_RES: Your stars are not mine. Today the Atronach shall aid you with your appointed burden.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_CGEmperor14_00032478_Oblivion_RES: Your stars are not mine. Today the Lady shall fortify you in your quest for glory.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_CGEmperor14_00032479_Oblivion_RES: Your stars are not mine. Today the Lord shall prove a faithful patron in your quest for glory.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_CGEmperor14_0003247b_Oblivion_RES: Your stars are not mine. Today the Lover shall sweeten your journey as you confront your fate.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_CGEmperor14_00032472_Oblivion_RES: Your stars are not mine. Today the Mage shall light your way on the paths of glory.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_CGEmperor14_00032475_Oblivion_RES: Your stars are not mine. Today the Ritual shall speed you on your star-patterned path.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_CGEmperor14_0003247e_Oblivion_RES: Your stars are not mine. Today the Serpent shall sting the foes who seek your blood.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_CGEmperor14_0003247c_Oblivion_RES: Your stars are not mine. Today the Shadow shall hide you from destiny's cunning hounds.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_CGEmperor14_00032477_Oblivion_RES: Your stars are not mine. Today the Steed shall speed your progress on the road to destiny.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_CGEmperor14_0003247a_Oblivion_RES: Your stars are not mine. Today the Thief shall guide your steps on the road to destiny.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_CGEmperor14_0003247d_Oblivion_RES: Your stars are not mine. Today the Tower shall prove a stout refuge in time of need.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_CGEmperor14_00032476_Oblivion_RES: Your stars are not mine. Today the Warrior shall prove a stalwart companion when fortune fades.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GREETING_0008151e_Oblivion_RESP1: Your stick is a lot nicer than mine, Sheogorath.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_FromTheDead_0001d036_Oblivion_RES: Your story is ridiculous. This sounds like some lie created by Jensine and her damned "society" to have me run out of town.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_MQ15KathutetA_0003c80c_Oblivion_R: Your swift retribution earned you much respect among my people. We had not expected that a mortal would act with such resolution and honor.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GREETING_0000298c_Knights_RESP1: Your sword and your faith are true. You may claim the Cuirass with my leave.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_TG05WhatIsPlan_0000c05d_Oblivion_: Your target is the Arcane University. We've had our eye on Hrormir's Staff for some time, but have been waiting for the wizards to be distracted.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GREETING_000206ba_Oblivion_RESP1: Your task is nearly complete. All that's left is to touch the Altar and let Arden-Sul devour the Duchess' heart.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GREETING_0001a329_Oblivion_RESP1: Your task is only half done. The Font will not be fully cleansed while Order pollutes one of the pools that feed it.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_SE05HerdirInvestigateCurrentTask_: Your task now is to listen in on Ma'zaddha's conversation with Nelrene without being noticed.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_DASheogorathSpeech_0009571e_Obliv: Your task would be to make the first two signs of the prophecy occur. Your predecessor already put plans in motion for the final step. Good luck.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_tasks_0005e1db_Oblivion_RESP1: Your tasks now come directly from Arch-Mage Traven. Please speak with him if you're unsure what you should be doing.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_Recommendation_0005323f_Oblivion_: Your time has come. The Arcane University needs you, child. Raminus Polus waits for you even now.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_MQVoice_00033df9_Oblivion_RESP1: Your timing is excellent! I'll take the one on the right!
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GREETING_0007fde4_Oblivion_RESP1: Your victory at Xeddefen was well won, but the war still carries on.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_Dark08NelsNevConvo_000852c7_Obliv: Your words border on treason, Nord, and I will not tolerate them! You will respect the Empire! You will respect the memory of our dear Emperor!
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_SEPykeZoeMaleneResponses_00091b56: Your words warm my heart, my love. Being here is the best choice I've made in my life.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GREETING_0008ea34_Oblivion_RESP1: Your work is done here, Your Grace. I'm sure Sheogorath will want news of your success.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GREETING_0008ea35_Oblivion_RESP1: Your work is done here, Your Grace. I'm sure Sheogorath will want news of your success.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_Dark01Choice2A_00022b9f_Oblivion_: Your work, your deathcraft, pleases the Night Mother. And so, I come to you with an offering. An opportunity... to join our rather unique family.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_SE02OrcSpectators_0007ead6_Oblivi: Yuck. Look at all the blood and gore. I'm getting out of here.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_INFOGENERAL_0007815a_Oblivion_RES: Zealots have dedicated themselves to the worship of Arden-Sul.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_NDTombSpeech_00002d09_Knights_RES: Zenithar grants you good fortune. May you always endeavor to become the master of your craft.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GREETING_00040bc4_Oblivion_RESP1: Zoe Malene's the name. Sorry I don't have much time to have a formal introduction, but I must get my latest painting finished!
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_MS47NeedAntidote_0003003f_Oblivio: [Ancotar hands you a scroll.] Here. Stand in the center of town, to make sure you get everyone. Oh, and make sure... never mind. Should be fine.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_Announcer_00046679_Oblivion_RESP1: [Gasp!] Can this be? The Blue Team combatant is not wearing an Arena Battle Raiment! The Blue Team is hereby disqualified!
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_Pickpocket_000626b8_Oblivion_RESP: [Gasp!] Guards, guards! This filthy cutpurse has purloined my valuables!
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_Corpse_00027528_Oblivion_RESP1: [Gasp!] Oh my goodness. Excuse me, are you all right? I... By the Divines, this person's dead!
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_MageTalk3_0006a866_Oblivion_RESP1: [Gasp!] Surely you're joking! Are... Are you sure? I mean, I'm excited by this news of course, but think of the ramifications!
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_Pickpocket_00062277_Oblivion_RESP: [Gasp!] Why you dirty little thief! How dare you touch me!
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_Dark02PirateDoor_00049881_Oblivio: [Knock knock knock!] Captain! Captain Tussaud! Are you all right sir? We... We heard a clamor. Captain? We're coming in!
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_BladesTalk3_00068351_Oblivion_RES: [Sigh.] Look at me, acting the paranoid fool. I apologize, my lord. I meant no disrespect. My nerves are taut as a bowstring!
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_DarkSancTalk5_0003405a_Oblivion_R: [Sigh.] Well, I suppose I should get going. So many contracts, so little time.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_avmafrenagaia_00054021_Oblivion_R: mafre' seems to translate to frost. So a spell with frost damage should work for it. Anything else?
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_TestToddNeutral_00029914_Oblivion: my current disp is 30 or lower
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_TestToddNeutral_00029913_Oblivion: my current disp is 70 or higher
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_TestToddNeutral_00028f55_Oblivion: my current disp is between 30 and 70.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_TestToddNeutral_00028f54_Oblivion: my current disp is big fat zero.
